fields.desc_en: Models that synthesise audiovisual events from text, images and references. The fastest route to scenario material, but a clip is watched, not acted in.
fields.desc_zh: 根据文字、图像和参考素材合成视听事件的模型。这是制作情境素材最快的路径，但视频只能观看，不能在其中行动。

subs.zh: 前沿文生 / 图生视频
subs.desc_en: Closed flagship models (Sora, Veo, Kling, Runway, Luma, Hailuo, Seedance…), many now with native audio.
subs.desc_zh: 闭源旗舰模型（Sora、Veo、可灵、Runway、Luma、海螺、Seedance……），许多已能同时生成声音。

subs.desc_en: Wan, HunyuanVideo, LTX, CogVideoX, Mochi, Open-Sora and others that can be run, version-pinned and inspected.
subs.desc_zh: Wan、HunyuanVideo、LTX、CogVideoX、Mochi、Open-Sora 等可以本地运行、锁定版本并检查的模型。

subs.desc_en: Camera paths, motion transfer, reference characters, video-to-video editing and performance-driven animation.
subs.desc_zh: 镜头路径、动作迁移、参考角色、视频到视频编辑与表演驱动的动画。

subs.desc_en: Causal, autoregressive and distilled models that stream video live or keep generating for minutes.
subs.desc_zh: 因果、自回归与蒸馏模型：实时流式生成视频，或持续生成数分钟。

subs.desc_en: 360°, stereo and spatial video generation, and 2D-to-3D conversion for headsets.
subs.desc_zh: 面向头显的 360°、立体与空间视频生成，以及 2D 转 3D。

fields.desc_en: Faces and bodies generated live for conversation: video avatars that listen while they speak, audio-driven portraits, photoreal 3D avatars, and models of nonverbal behaviour.
fields.desc_zh: 为对话实时生成的脸和身体：边听边说的视频虚拟人、音频驱动的人像、照片级三维化身，以及非语言行为模型。

subs.desc_en: Full-duplex audio-visual agents rendered as video: Tavus, HeyGen, D-ID, Character.AI, Anam, Hedra and others.
subs.desc_zh: 以视频形式呈现的全双工视听智能体：Tavus、HeyGen、D-ID、Character.AI、Anam、Hedra 等。

subs.zh: 音频驱动的说话人像与全身
subs.desc_en: Speech-to-face and speech-to-body generation from a single image: VASA-1, EMO, OmniHuman, Hallo, LivePortrait…
subs.desc_zh: 由一张图像加语音生成脸部与全身动画：VASA-1、EMO、OmniHuman、Hallo、LivePortrait……

subs.desc_en: Codec Avatars, Gaussian head and body avatars, MetaHuman, Personas, NVIDIA ACE: drivable 3D people for XR.
subs.desc_zh: Codec Avatars、高斯头部与全身化身、MetaHuman、Personas、NVIDIA ACE：可驱动的 XR 三维人物。

subs.zh: 倾听、手势与双人互动行为
subs.desc_en: Models of backchannels, gaze, gesture and turn-taking between two people.
subs.desc_zh: 建模两人之间的回应信号、视线、手势与轮流发言。

fields.desc_en: The audio half of audio-visual immersion: full-duplex speech models that can be interrupted, expressive voices, generated sound effects and music, and spatial audio.
fields.desc_zh: 视听沉浸中“听”的一半：可以被打断的全双工语音模型、富有表现力的声音、生成的音效与音乐，以及空间音频。

subs.zh: 全双工语音与语音智能体
subs.desc_en: Speech-to-speech models that listen while they talk: Moshi, Sesame, GPT realtime, Gemini Live, Hume EVI…
subs.desc_zh: 边说边听的语音到语音模型：Moshi、Sesame、GPT realtime、Gemini Live、Hume EVI……

subs.zh: 富表现力语音与声音克隆
subs.desc_en: Text-to-speech with emotion, timing and voice design; cloning a voice from seconds of audio.
subs.desc_zh: 带情绪、节奏与音色设计的语音合成；用几秒音频克隆声音。

subs.desc_en: Generated foley, ambience, music and soundtracks matched to video.
subs.desc_zh: 生成拟音、环境声、音乐，以及与视频同步的配乐。

subs.desc_en: Sound placed and rendered in 3D space, generated or upmixed for headsets.
subs.desc_zh: 在三维空间中定位与渲染的声音，为头显生成或升混。

fields.desc_en: Action-conditioned models that generate the next moment of a world in response to keyboard, controller or agent input: Genie and its peers. Playable, though persistence, control and headset support are still open problems.
fields.desc_zh: 以动作为条件的模型：根据键盘、手柄或智能体的输入生成世界的下一刻，例如 Genie 及其同类。已经可以“玩”，但持久性、可控性与头显支持仍是未解问题。

subs.desc_en: Promptable, playable worlds from text or an image: Genie 3, Project Genie, GWM-1, Mirage, Odyssey, Matrix-Game, Hunyuan-GameCraft…
subs.desc_zh: 由文字或一张图像生成可交互的世界：Genie 3、Project Genie、GWM-1、Mirage、Odyssey、Matrix-Game、Hunyuan-GameCraft……

subs.desc_en: Games rendered frame by frame by a network: GameNGen, DIAMOND, Oasis, Muse / WHAM, WHAMM…
subs.desc_zh: 由神经网络逐帧渲染的游戏：GameNGen、DIAMOND、Oasis、Muse / WHAM、WHAMM……

subs.zh: 面向机器人与驾驶的世界模型
subs.desc_en: Physical-AI simulators that predict how the world responds to an agent: Cosmos, GAIA, V-JEPA 2, UniSim…
subs.desc_zh: 预测世界如何回应智能体的物理 AI 模拟器：Cosmos、GAIA、V-JEPA 2、UniSim……

subs.desc_en: Research on keeping a generated world coherent: spatial memory, long context, promptable events, state.
subs.desc_zh: 让生成的世界保持连贯的研究：空间记忆、长上下文、可提示事件与状态。

fields.desc_en: Generated environments with explicit geometry (Gaussian splats, meshes, panoramas) that can be walked through in a headset, edited and kept. Persistence comes with the representation.
fields.desc_zh: 带有显式几何（高斯泼溅、网格、全景图）的生成环境：可以戴着头显走进去、编辑并保存。持久性由表示方式本身保证。

subs.desc_en: Text or image to a navigable 3D world: Marble, Atlas, HunyuanWorld, WonderWorld, Lyra, Voyager…
subs.desc_zh: 由文字或图像生成可漫游的三维世界：Marble、Atlas、HunyuanWorld、WonderWorld、Lyra、Voyager……

subs.desc_en: Equirectangular worlds and skyboxes for VR, often the first layer of a generated scene.
subs.desc_zh: 用于 VR 的等距柱状全景与天空盒，常是生成场景的第一层。

subs.zh: 布局、程序化与代码生成场景
subs.desc_en: Scenes assembled by language models, procedural rules or programs: Holodeck, Infinigen, scene graphs.
subs.desc_zh: 由语言模型、程序化规则或代码拼装的场景：Holodeck、Infinigen、场景图。

subs.desc_en: One photo to a 3D scene with depth and parallax: spatial scenes, monocular depth, single-image splats.
subs.desc_zh: 把一张照片变成有深度与视差的三维场景：空间场景、单目深度、单图高斯泼溅。

fields.desc_en: Objects, characters and animation generated on demand: the props and actors of an authored situation.
fields.desc_zh: 按需生成的物体、角色与动画：一个被设计出来的情境里的道具与演员。

subs.desc_en: Meshes and textures from a prompt or photo: Meshy, Tripo, Rodin, Hunyuan3D, TRELLIS, SAM 3D…
subs.desc_zh: 由提示词或照片生成网格与贴图：Meshy、Tripo、Rodin、Hunyuan3D、TRELLIS、SAM 3D……

subs.desc_en: Generated characters with skeletons, auto-rigging and animation ready for engines.
subs.desc_zh: 带骨骼的生成角色、自动绑定与可直接用于引擎的动画。

subs.desc_en: Text- and audio-to-motion models for bodies, hands and interaction.
subs.desc_zh: 由文字或音频生成身体、手部与交互动作的模型。

fields.desc_en: Navigable 3D and 4D (3D plus time), captured from the real world or generated: radiance fields and Gaussian splatting, feed-forward reconstruction in seconds, dynamic scenes, volumetric video, and moving objects, scenes and worlds generated from text, images or video.
fields.desc_zh: 可漫游的三维与四维（三维加时间），既可从真实世界捕捉，也可以生成：辐射场与高斯泼溅、几秒内完成的前馈式重建、动态场景、体积视频，以及由文字、图像或视频生成的运动物体、场景与世界。

subs.desc_en: The representations that made photoreal real-time novel views possible.
subs.desc_zh: 让照片级、实时的新视角渲染成为可能的表示方法。

subs.desc_en: One network pass from images to geometry or splats: DUSt3R, VGGT, AnySplat…
subs.desc_zh: 一次网络前向就从图像得到几何或高斯泼溅：DUSt3R、VGGT、AnySplat……

subs.desc_en: Moving scenes reconstructed in space and time: 4D Gaussians, spacetime splats, 4D video.
subs.desc_zh: 在空间与时间上重建的运动场景：4D 高斯、时空泼溅、4D 视频。

subs.desc_en: People captured in 3D and streamed or replayed: Beam, volumetric studios, Gaussian video.
subs.desc_zh: 以三维形式捕捉并传输或回放的人：Beam、体积视频工作室、高斯视频。

subs.desc_en: Phone and headset capture, training and viewing tools: Luma, Polycam, Scaniverse, Postshot, Hyperscape, SuperSplat…
subs.desc_zh: 手机与头显捕捉、训练和查看工具：Luma、Polycam、Scaniverse、Postshot、Hyperscape、SuperSplat……

subs.desc_en: Moving 3D objects and characters generated from text, an image or a video, as dynamic Gaussians or deforming meshes: DreamGaussian4D, L4GM, SV4D…
subs.desc_zh: 由文字、单张图像或视频生成会动的三维物体与角色，以动态高斯或变形网格表示：DreamGaussian4D、L4GM、SV4D……

subs.desc_en: Moving scenes and worlds generated or completed with video priors, viewable from new angles as time passes: CAT4D, 4Real, 4DNeX, BulletGen…
subs.desc_zh: 借助视频先验生成或补全的运动场景与世界，可随时间推移从新视角观看：CAT4D、4Real、4DNeX、BulletGen……

fields.desc_en: Characters and populations driven by language models that remember, plan and act inside worlds: the social side of a generated situation.
fields.desc_zh: 由语言模型驱动、在世界中记忆、计划与行动的角色与群体：生成情境里“社会”的一面。

subs.zh: 生成式智能体与社会模拟
subs.desc_en: Believable agents with memory and reflection, from Smallville to simulations of whole populations.
subs.desc_zh: 带记忆与反思的可信智能体，从 Smallville 到整个人群的模拟。

subs.zh: 在三维世界中行动的智能体
subs.desc_en: Agents that perceive and act in games and generated worlds: Voyager, SIMA, game-playing agents.
subs.desc_zh: 在游戏与生成世界中感知并行动的智能体：Voyager、SIMA、玩游戏的智能体。

subs.desc_en: Engines for conversational characters in games and XR: Inworld, Convai, ACE, AI NPCs in shipped games.
subs.desc_zh: 游戏与 XR 中对话角色的引擎：Inworld、Convai、ACE，以及已上线游戏中的 AI NPC。

fields.desc_en: Generation inside headsets and glasses: in-situ co-creation in mixed reality, reality restyled live, generative cinema and enactment, and the generative features shipping in XR platforms.
fields.desc_zh: 发生在头显与眼镜里的生成：混合现实中的现场共创、实时重绘的现实、生成式电影与演绎，以及 XR 平台已经上线的生成功能。

subs.zh: MR / VR 中的现场共创
subs.desc_en: Speaking, sketching or gesturing content into the space around you: Editing Reality, LLMR, Social Conjuring…
subs.desc_zh: 通过说话、草图或手势，把内容放进身边的空间：Editing Reality、LLMR、Social Conjuring……

subs.desc_en: Diffusion and video-to-video models repainting passthrough or camera views as you look.
subs.desc_zh: 扩散模型与视频到视频模型，在你观看时重绘透视画面或摄像头画面。

subs.zh: 生成式电影、戏剧与演绎
subs.desc_en: Stories, films and scenarios that are generated or extended around the viewer.
subs.desc_zh: 围绕观众生成或延展的故事、电影与情境。

subs.zh: XR 平台中的生成功能
subs.desc_en: What headsets and glasses ship: spatial scenes, captured spaces, generative lenses, AI world editors.
subs.desc_zh: 头显与眼镜已经推出的功能：空间场景、空间捕捉、生成式镜头、AI 世界编辑器。

fields.zh: 沉浸式行为研究与训练
fields.desc_en: Where the situations are used: VR experiments in social psychology and criminology, simulation training with virtual humans and patients, clinical VR, presence theory, and the first studies that bring generative AI into immersive research.
fields.desc_zh: 这些情境被用在哪里：社会心理学与犯罪学中的 VR 实验、有虚拟人和虚拟病人参与的模拟训练、临床 VR、临场感理论，以及首批把生成式 AI 带入沉浸式研究的工作。

subs.zh: 临场感、似真性与方法论
subs.desc_en: Why people respond to virtual situations, and how to design and validate them: Slater, Steuer, Blascovich, Brunswik…
subs.desc_zh: 人为何会对虚拟情境作出反应，以及如何设计与验证这些情境：Slater、Steuer、Blascovich、Brunswik……

subs.zh: 社会心理学 VR 实验
subs.desc_en: Obedience, bystanders, embodiment and social interaction studied in immersive situations.
subs.desc_zh: 在沉浸式情境中研究服从、旁观者、具身与社会互动。

subs.desc_en: Burglary, aggression, threat and emergencies: situations that cannot be staged for real.
subs.desc_zh: 入室盗窃、攻击、威胁与紧急情况：无法真实布置的情境。

subs.desc_en: Virtual patients, interviewers and teammates for practising communication and judgement.
subs.desc_zh: 用于练习沟通与判断的虚拟病人、访谈者与队友。

subs.desc_en: Exposure, coaching and therapy delivered in virtual situations.
subs.desc_zh: 在虚拟情境中进行的暴露治疗、辅导与心理治疗。

subs.zh: 沉浸式研究中的生成式 AI
subs.desc_en: Studies and reviews that put LLM agents, generated scenarios or world models into research and training.
subs.desc_zh: 把语言模型智能体、生成情境或世界模型用于研究与训练的研究和综述。

fields.desc_en: What it takes to build and deliver: model APIs and inference hosts, real-time agent stacks, engines and splat runtimes, headsets and displays, and the datasets and benchmarks the field measures itself by.
fields.desc_zh: 构建与交付所需的一切：模型 API 与推理平台、实时智能体技术栈、引擎与泼溅渲染器、头显与显示设备，以及这个领域用来衡量自己的数据集与基准。

subs.zh: 模型 API 与推理平台
subs.desc_en: Where developers call video, 3D, world and avatar models: first-party APIs and hosts such as fal and Replicate.
subs.desc_zh: 开发者调用视频、三维、世界与虚拟人模型的地方：官方 API 以及 fal、Replicate 等托管平台。

subs.zh: 实时媒体与智能体技术栈
subs.desc_en: WebRTC, voice-agent and streaming frameworks that carry full-duplex interaction.
subs.desc_zh: 承载全双工交互的 WebRTC、语音智能体与流媒体框架。

subs.desc_en: Game engines, WebXR and splat renderers that put generated content in front of people.
subs.desc_zh: 把生成内容呈现给人的游戏引擎、WebXR 与泼溅渲染器。

subs.desc_en: The hardware generated worlds are delivered on.
subs.desc_zh: 生成世界最终运行的硬件。

subs.desc_en: The data these models learn from and the tests they are compared on.
subs.desc_zh: 这些模型学习所用的数据，以及比较它们的测试。

modalities: 人工制作的 VR 情境
timings: Generated before the experience (seconds to hours); people watch or explore the result.
在体验开始前生成（几秒到几小时），人们观看或探索生成结果。
Generates after each request, action or utterance; the person waits for the reply. Voice systems that can be interrupted (barge-in) but otherwise wait for silence belong here.
在每次请求、动作或发言之后生成，人需要等待回应。可以被打断（barge-in）、但平时要等对方说完才回应的语音系统也属于这一类。
Streams continuously at interactive rates while the person acts.
在人行动的同时，以可交互的速率持续生成。
Perceives and generates at the same time: keeps listening (and watching) while it speaks, overlaps speech, backchannels (“mm-hm”) and can be interrupted, without waiting for silence.
同时感知与生成：说话时仍在听（和看），会与对方话语重叠、发出“嗯嗯”之类的回应信号，也能被打断，不需要等待对方停顿。
Authored and rule-driven with no generative model at runtime: the baseline of classic VR studies.
人工制作、规则驱动，运行时没有生成模型：经典 VR 研究的基线。

collections.desc_en: Video and worlds generated live as you act: 720p at 20–40 fps became common in 2025–2026 (Genie 3, GWM Worlds 2, Matrix-Game 3.0), and live video-to-video reaches 1080p at 30 fps.
collections.desc_zh: 随你的动作实时生成的视频与世界：720p、每秒 20–40 帧在 2025–2026 年已很常见（Genie 3、GWM Worlds 2、Matrix-Game 3.0），实时视频到视频转换可达 1080p、30 帧。
collections.gap_en: Headsets need two views at 72–120 Hz; only one real-time generator reports stereo output so far (Vidu S2, technical report, 2026-09, developer-reported), none publishes end-to-end latency, and streams cannot be seeded, so a session must be recorded to be replayed.
collections.gap_zh: 头显需要以 72–120 Hz 输出双眼画面；目前只有一个实时生成器报告了立体输出（Vidu S2，技术报告，2026-09，开发者说法），没有生成器公布端到端延迟，流式输出也无法设定随机种子，只能录下来才能回放。
collections.next_en: Engine-plus-neural-rendering hybrids reach consumer GPUs (Matrix-Game 4.0 reports up to 67 fps on an RTX 5080), and Decart sells real-time models by API.
collections.next_zh: 引擎加神经渲染的混合方案开始在消费级显卡上运行（Matrix-Game 4.0 称在 RTX 5080 上最高 67 帧）；Decart 已通过 API 提供实时模型。

collections.en: From video models to world simulators
collections.zh: 从视频模型到世界模拟器
collections.desc_en: Action-conditioned models generate the next moment as you move. Genie 3 (2025) holds a world together for minutes; Project Genie opened to subscribers in 2026 with 60-second generations. Independent 2026 benchmarks find that no model keeps memory reliably over 10–60 s of play, and that objects stay frozen while out of view instead of changing (WRBench, 23 models).
collections.desc_zh: 以动作为条件的模型随你的移动生成下一刻。Genie 3（2025）能让世界在几分钟内保持一致；Project Genie 于 2026 年向订阅用户开放，每次生成限 60 秒。2026 年的独立基准发现，没有模型能在 10–60 秒的游玩中可靠地保持记忆，而且物体离开视野后会被“冻结”，不会随时间变化（WRBench，评测 23 个模型）。
collections.gap_en: Single 2D streams only (no stereo or 6DoF), minutes of persistence at best, no programmatic access to Genie, and Google, Runway and World Labs publish no per-minute price (Decart's driving-only Oasis 3 Preview costs $0.02/s).
collections.gap_zh: 只有单路二维视频流（没有立体或六自由度），持久性最多几分钟，Genie 没有程序化接口，Google、Runway 和 World Labs 都没有公布按分钟计的价格（Decart 仅限驾驶场景的 Oasis 3 预览版为每秒 0.02 美元）。
collections.next_en: Google aims to widen Project Genie access 'in time'; Runway's GWM Worlds 2 adds a timestamped event stream (WorldPrompt); Atlas will power future versions of Marble.
collections.next_zh: Google 表示会“逐步”扩大 Project Genie 的开放范围；Runway 的 GWM Worlds 2 加入了带时间戳的事件流（WorldPrompt）；Atlas 将用于未来版本的 Marble。

collections.en: World models turn to robots and cars
collections.zh: 世界模型转向机器人与汽车
collections.desc_en: The same world models now train and test robots and self-driving cars: OpenAI moved the Sora team to world simulation for robotics, Waymo built its simulator on Genie 3, and Decart, Odyssey and NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 launched physical-AI-first in 2026.
collections.desc_zh: 同一批世界模型如今用于训练和测试机器人与自动驾驶：OpenAI 把 Sora 团队转向面向机器人的世界模拟研究，Waymo 的模拟器建立在 Genie 3 之上，Decart、Odyssey 与 NVIDIA 的 Cosmos 3 在 2026 年都以物理 AI 为首要方向发布。
collections.gap_en: Human-facing features (stereo, comfort, social characters) may get less investment than robot interfaces.
collections.gap_zh: 面向人的功能（立体显示、舒适度、社会性角色）得到的投入，可能少于面向机器人的接口。
collections.next_en: Closed-loop action interfaces, rare-event generation and logged trajectories built for robot evaluation can carry over to behavioral experiments.
collections.next_zh: 为机器人评测而建的闭环动作接口、罕见事件生成与轨迹记录，可以迁移到行为实验中使用。

collections.en: Worlds you can keep: explicit 3D output
collections.zh: 可以保存的世界：显式三维输出
collections.desc_en: Generated worlds exported as Gaussian splats or meshes that persist, open in game engines and headsets, and can be logged and controlled: Marble and the World API, the open HY-World 2.0, Atlas, and a ratified glTF format for splats.
collections.desc_zh: 以高斯泼溅或网格导出的生成世界：可以长期保存，能在游戏引擎和头显中打开，也便于记录与控制——Marble 与 World API、开源的 HY-World 2.0、Atlas，以及已获批准的高斯泼溅 glTF 格式。
collections.gap_en: Exported worlds are static (people, weather and events must be added with an engine or agents), lighting is baked, scale is arbitrary, and image metrics miss floaters that stand out in stereo.
collections.gap_zh: 导出的世界是静态的（人物、天气和事件需借助引擎或智能体添加），光照是烘焙的，尺度不确定，而图像质量指标会漏掉在立体观看时才明显的漂浮伪影。
collections.next_en: Atlas will power future versions of Marble, and engine-plus-model hybrids (Matrix-Game 4.0) keep game state explicit while a network draws the pixels. Splats are becoming a native format in production tools: Houdini 22 (2026-06-22) trains and rigs them, three.js r186 (2026-09-24) renders them on the web, and Blender 5.3 imports and renders them (beta).
collections.next_zh: Atlas 将用于未来版本的 Marble；引擎加模型的混合方案（Matrix-Game 4.0）把游戏状态保存在引擎中，由神经网络绘制画面。高斯泼溅正成为制作工具的原生格式：Houdini 22（2026-06-22）可以训练和绑定泼溅，three.js r186（2026-09-24）可在网页中渲染，Blender 5.3 也支持导入和渲染（测试版）。

collections.desc_en: Agents that listen while they speak, and now show a face: full-duplex voice became an API product in 2026 (GPT-Live-1 at $0.05/min, Gemini 3.8 Live), and Tavus Griffin generates a talking face video-to-video while it listens.
collections.desc_zh: 边听边说、如今还能露脸的智能体：全双工语音在 2026 年成为 API 产品（GPT-Live-1 每分钟 0.05 美元、Gemini 3.8 Live），Tavus Griffin 则能边听边以视频到视频的方式生成说话的面孔。
collections.gap_en: All render a flat 2D face and none drives a 3D body in shared space; turn-taking decisions are not exported as logs; 'human-likeness' figures come from developer-run studies.
collections.gap_zh: 它们都只呈现平面的二维面孔，没有一个能在共享空间中驱动三维身体；轮流发言的决策不会导出为日志；“像真人”的数据来自开发者自己做的研究。
collections.next_en: Tavus plans a wider release; Meta's voice-driven Hologram comes to Ray-Ban Display (fall 2026) and Hologram Calling to Meta VR Glasses (Spring 2027).
collections.next_zh: Tavus 计划更大范围发布；Meta 由语音驱动的 Hologram 将登陆 Ray-Ban Display（2026 年秋），Hologram 通话将登陆 Meta VR Glasses（2027 年春）。

collections.desc_en: Speech, effects and ambience generated in the same pass as the picture: standard in frontier video since Veo 3 (2025), and in 2026 also in open weights (LTX-2.5) and a real-time world model (GWM Worlds 2).
collections.desc_zh: 对白、音效与环境声和画面一次生成：自 Veo 3（2025）起已是前沿视频模型的标配，2026 年开源模型（LTX-2.5）和实时世界模型（GWM Worlds 2）也能做到。
collections.gap_en: Products return one mono or stereo mix: no spatial (ambisonic or object) audio for headsets, and separate stems, to vary one sound while holding the rest constant, exist only in 2026 research models (Soundwich, SepGen).
collections.gap_zh: 产品生成的声音是一条单声道或立体声混音：没有面向头显的空间音频（全景声或对象音频）；能分轨、从而只改变一个声音而保持其余不变的，目前只有 2026 年的研究模型（Soundwich、SepGen）。
collections.next_en: Gemini Omni says it will add image and audio output 'in time'.
collections.next_zh: Gemini Omni 表示将“逐步”支持图像与音频输出。

collections.en: One model for video, 3D, audio and action
collections.zh: 一个模型统管视频、三维、声音与动作
collections.desc_en: Single models that read and generate text, images, video, audio, 3D and actions (Kling 3.0, Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni, Cosmos 3, Atlas), so one character or place can stay consistent across media; most are still video-first.
collections.desc_zh: 用一个模型读取并生成文字、图像、视频、声音、三维与动作（可灵 3.0、Seedance 2.0、Gemini Omni、Cosmos 3、Atlas），让同一角色或地点在不同媒介中保持一致；目前大多仍以视频为主。
collections.gap_en: 'Omni' is a developer label, and one closed model behind many modalities is a single point of failure for a study.
collections.gap_zh: “omni”是开发者的说法；一个闭源模型承担多种模态，对研究而言就是单点故障。
collections.next_en: Atlas will power future Marble versions; Gemini Omni adds output modalities 'in time'.
collections.next_zh: Atlas 将用于未来的 Marble；Gemini Omni 将“逐步”增加输出模态。

collections.desc_en: One forward pass turns photos or a video into cameras, depth and Gaussian splats in about a second (VGGT, AnySplat, Depth Anything 3, SHARP), so a real place can be in a headset the same day; D4RT extends this to moving scenes.
collections.desc_zh: 一次前向计算就能从照片或视频得到相机、深度与高斯泼溅，耗时约一秒（VGGT、AnySplat、Depth Anything 3、SHARP），真实的地点当天就能放进头显；D4RT 把这一能力扩展到运动场景。
collections.gap_en: Moving people remain the hard case; benchmarks report PSNR and SSIM, not presence or comfort in a headset; capturing real places also records bystanders.
collections.gap_zh: 运动的人仍是难点；基准报告的是 PSNR 和 SSIM，而不是头显中的临场感或舒适度；捕捉真实地点也会记录下旁人。
collections.next_en: The capability is moving into devices: visionOS 27 turns panoramas into spatial scenes, and XREAL AURA converts photos and videos to 3D (fall 2026).
collections.next_zh: 这一能力正进入设备：visionOS 27 把全景照片变成空间场景，XREAL AURA 可把照片和视频转换为三维（2026 年秋）。

collections.desc_en: Dynamic Gaussian and volumetric capture of people and events, reconstructed quickly and streamed; in 2026 it reaches people mainly as 3D video calls and holograms (Google Beam, Meta Hologram Calling), not yet as a media format.
collections.desc_zh: 以动态高斯与体积视频捕捉人物和事件，快速重建并流式传输；2026 年它主要以三维视频通话和“全息”通话的形式到达用户（Google Beam、Meta Hologram 通话），还不是一种普及的媒介格式。
collections.gap_en: There is no common player or format for 4D splat video, high-quality capture of people still needs multi-camera rigs or booths, and changing behaviour inside a captured performance is research-only.
collections.gap_zh: 4D 泼溅视频还没有通用的播放器或格式；高质量的人物捕捉仍需要多相机阵列或专用设备；改变已捕捉表演中的行为仍停留在研究阶段。
collections.next_en: Beam can be booked in shared offices from October 2026; Meta VR Glasses with Hologram Calling arrive in Spring 2027.
collections.next_zh: Beam 自 2026 年 10 月起可在共享办公空间预约使用；带 Hologram 通话的 Meta VR Glasses 将于 2027 年春上市。

collections.desc_en: Moving 3D content is now generated, not only captured: per-prompt optimisation (MAV3D, 2023) gave way to feed-forward open models (L4GM and SV4D in 2024, 4DNeX in 2025), and in 2026 open models turn a video, image or text into an animated mesh in about a minute (ActionMesh) or into a dynamic scene you can move through (NeoVerse, InSpatio-World).
collections.desc_zh: 会动的三维内容如今不仅能捕捉，也能生成：从逐个提示词优化的方法（MAV3D，2023），到前馈式的开源模型（2024 年的 L4GM、SV4D，2025 年的 4DNeX）；2026 年，开源模型能在约一分钟内把视频、图像或文字变成动画网格（ActionMesh），或变成可以在其中移动的动态场景（NeoVerse、InSpatio-World）。
collections.gap_en: Outputs last seconds and stay tied to a source video or a single object; there is no public 4D-generation API, the only product is Roblox Cube 4D (beta), and generated 4D content has no common format or player.
collections.gap_zh: 生成的内容只有几秒，并依附于源视频或单个物体；目前没有公开的 4D 生成 API，唯一的产品是 Roblox Cube 4D（测试版），生成的 4D 内容也没有通用的格式或播放器。
collections.next_en: 4D generation is starting to animate generated worlds: OuroWorld (2026-10) turns static Gaussian worlds made with Marble or Lyra 2.0 into looping 4D scenes.
collections.next_zh: 4D 生成开始为生成的世界加入运动：OuroWorld（2026-10）把用 Marble 或 Lyra 2.0 生成的静态高斯世界变成循环播放的 4D 场景。

collections.desc_en: Generation that starts from real imagery — Street View, a scan, your own photos — so a familiar place can be revisited or altered: Project Genie with Street View (2026), Waymo's Genie-based simulator, World Labs' real-to-sim work.
collections.desc_zh: 以真实影像为起点的生成——街景、扫描或你自己的照片——让熟悉的地点可以重访或被改写：接入街景的 Project Genie（2026）、基于 Genie 的 Waymo 模拟器、World Labs 的真实到模拟工作。
collections.gap_en: Grounding sets the first frame: beyond it the world is generated and its accuracy to the real place is not measured; Street View grounding is US-only; generating events at recognisable addresses needs ethical review.
collections.gap_zh: 锚定只决定第一帧：之后的世界是生成的，与真实地点的吻合度没有被测量；街景锚定只覆盖美国；在可辨认的地址上生成事件需要伦理审查。
collections.next_en: Street View grounding is to expand beyond the US 'over time'; World Labs runs a real-to-sim-to-real programme with SceniX.
collections.next_zh: 街景锚定计划“逐步”扩展到美国以外；World Labs 与 SceniX 推进从真实到模拟再到真实的项目。

collections.desc_en: AI agents that play, learn and are tested inside generated worlds (SIMA 2 in Genie 3 worlds, Odyssey-3, GWM Worlds 2); characters with memory who share those worlds with people are still early.
collections.desc_zh: 在生成世界中游玩、学习并接受测试的 AI 智能体（Genie 3 世界中的 SIMA 2、Odyssey-3、GWM Worlds 2）；能记住你、与人共处同一世界的角色仍处于早期。
collections.gap_en: No generated world keeps a character's identity, memory and relationship to a participant across a session, and characters' reactions have not been evaluated against human norms.
collections.gap_zh: 没有一个生成世界能在一次体验中保持角色的身份、记忆以及与参与者的关系；角色反应是否符合人类常态也还没有被评估。
collections.next_en: Odyssey's Agora-1 targets multi-agent shared worlds; Cosmos 3 is offered as a backbone for 'world action models'.
collections.next_zh: Odyssey 的 Agora-1 面向多智能体共享世界；Cosmos 3 被定位为“世界动作模型”的基础模型。

collections.en: Generative features reach headsets and glasses
collections.zh: 生成功能进入头显与眼镜
collections.desc_en: Generative features arrive on headsets and glasses as photos-to-3D, voice-driven avatars and assistants; generated worlds still reach them only as exported splats or flat streams. Research prototypes generate in situ.
collections.desc_zh: 生成式功能以照片转三维、语音驱动的虚拟形象和 AI 助手的形式进入头显和眼镜；生成的世界仍只能以导出的高斯泼溅或平面视频流呈现。研究原型已能现场生成。
collections.gap_en: No world model runs on a headset chip or outputs stereo; camera access for generation conditioned on the surroundings is restricted; no vendor offers a research SDK that logs generated content with gaze and motion.
collections.gap_zh: 没有世界模型能在头显芯片上运行或输出立体画面；以周围环境为条件的生成需要摄像头权限，而平台对此有限制；也没有厂商提供能把生成内容与视线、动作一起记录的研究工具包。
collections.next_en: Snap SPECS and XREAL AURA ship in fall 2026 and Meta VR Glasses in Spring 2027; research prototypes (Editing Reality, CinemaWorld, Social Conjuring) are ahead of products.
collections.next_zh: Snap SPECS 与 XREAL AURA 将于 2026 年秋发货，Meta VR Glasses 于 2027 年春上市；研究原型（Editing Reality、CinemaWorld、Social Conjuring）已走在产品前面。

collections.en: Open weights you can pin and inspect
collections.zh: 可锁定版本、可检查的开源权重
collections.desc_en: Models a lab can download, run, version-pin and inspect — now including real-time world models and joint audio-video; several frontier labs went the other way in 2026.
collections.desc_zh: 研究室可以下载、运行、锁定版本并检查的模型——如今已包括实时世界模型和音视频联合生成；而在 2026 年，几家前沿实验室走向了相反方向。
collections.gap_en: Open interactive models run at 480p–720p with few scenes or need large GPUs, licences differ (OpenMDW, gated LTX, Tencent and Skywork terms), and even stable APIs serve 'preview' model ids.
collections.gap_zh: 开源交互模型只有 480p–720p、场景有限或需要大显存显卡；许可证各不相同（OpenMDW、LTX 的门控许可、腾讯与昆仑万维的条款）；即使是稳定的 API 也在提供“预览版”模型。
collections.next_en: Tencent's HY-World releases continue in stages, and NVIDIA's Cosmos Coalition is expanding.
collections.next_zh: 腾讯 HY-World 持续分阶段发布；NVIDIA 的 Cosmos 联盟继续扩大。

collections.en: China leads open interactive world models
collections.zh: 中国主导开源交互式世界模型
collections.desc_en: Tencent and Skywork publish the open real-time world models labs can actually run (HY-World, Matrix-Game), while Kling and Seedance compete at the closed frontier of video.
collections.desc_zh: 腾讯与昆仑万维发布了研究室真正能运行的开源实时世界模型（HY-World、Matrix-Game），而可灵与 Seedance 则在闭源视频前沿竞争。
collections.gap_en: Chinese frontier video is mostly closed (MiniMax H3 is a partial exception: its base model is open, its 2K modules API-only), and Alibaba has released no new open base video model since Wan 2.2 (July 2025).
collections.gap_zh: 中国的前沿视频模型大多闭源（MiniMax H3 是部分例外：基础模型开源，2K 模块仅通过 API 提供）；阿里自 2025 年 7 月的 Wan 2.2 之后没有再发布新的开源基础视频模型。
collections.next_en: Kling 4.0 rolled out from 2026-09-28 and was officially launched on 2026-10-16, with API access said to follow; Matrix-Game 4.0 weights came out on 2026-10-15.
collections.next_zh: 可灵 4.0 自 2026-09-28 起逐步推出，并于 2026-10-16 正式发布，据称 API 随后开放；Matrix-Game 4.0 的权重于 2026-10-15 发布。

collections.zh: 每秒成本下降，实时仍受限
collections.desc_en: A second of generated video fell from $0.75 (Veo 3, 2025) to $0.05–0.40 (Veo 3.1 tiers, 2026) and live voice costs cents per minute. Real-time worlds are only starting to get prices: Decart's Oasis 3 Preview costs $0.02/s for driving scenes, while Google, Runway and World Labs publish none.
collections.desc_zh: 生成一秒视频的价格从 0.75 美元（Veo 3，2025）降到 0.05–0.40 美元（Veo 3.1 各档，2026），实时语音每分钟只需几美分。实时世界才刚开始有价格：Decart 的 Oasis 3 预览版驾驶场景每秒 0.02 美元，而 Google、Runway 和 World Labs 都没有公布价格。
collections.gap_en: At list prices (Oct 2026), a 10-minute 720p stimulus costs about $30–60 (Veo 3.1 Lite / Fast), a 30-minute full-duplex voice session about $0.70–1.50, and 30 minutes of Oasis 3 about $36, but only for driving scenes; a general-purpose real-time world cannot be bought at a published price.
collections.gap_zh: 按 2026 年 10 月标价估算：10 分钟 720p 刺激视频约需 30–60 美元（Veo 3.1 Lite / Fast），30 分钟全双工语音约 0.7–1.5 美元，30 分钟 Oasis 3 约 36 美元（仅限驾驶场景）；通用的实时生成世界则没有公开价格可买。
collections.next_en: Local inference becomes realistic on consumer GPUs and 128 GB laptops (RTX Spark, on sale 2026-10-16); Vidu Q4 Preview lists video from $0.014/s (2026-10-07).
collections.next_zh: 在消费级显卡和 128 GB 内存的笔记本（RTX Spark，2026-10-16 上市）上进行本地推理开始变得可行；Vidu Q4 预览版的视频生成价格低至每秒 0.014 美元（2026-10-07）。

collections.desc_en: World-model startups raised billions and began merging into chip and platform companies in 2026 (World Labs into AMD), while a flagship video service, Sora, shut down within a year.
collections.desc_zh: 2026 年，世界模型初创公司融资数十亿美元，并开始并入芯片与平台公司（World Labs 并入 AMD）；同时，旗舰视频服务 Sora 不到一年就关停了。
collections.gap_en: A study built on a startup's or lab's API may outlive the API: archive stimuli, prompts and model ids, and prefer open weights for anything that must be re-run.
collections.gap_zh: 基于初创公司或实验室 API 的研究，可能比这个 API 活得更久：请存档刺激材料、提示词与模型版本，凡需重跑的部分尽量使用开源权重。
collections.next_en: AMD's all-stock purchase of World Labs (about $8.2 billion, announced 2026-09-28) is expected to close by the end of 2026; Microsoft's Muse team moved into the Microsoft AI product group; Google retires the Veo 3.1 preview endpoints on 2026-10-22, and Hume shuts its EVI and TTS APIs on 2026-11-13.
collections.next_zh: AMD 以全股票方式收购 World Labs（约 82 亿美元，2026-09-28 宣布），预计 2026 年底完成；微软的 Muse 团队已并入 Microsoft AI 产品部门；Google 将于 2026-10-22 停用 Veo 3.1 预览接口，Hume 将于 2026-11-13 关闭 EVI 与 TTS API。

collections.en: Labels, watermarks and disclosure become law
collections.zh: 标注、水印与告知成为法律要求
collections.desc_en: Telling people they are talking to an AI, and marking generated media machine-readably, became legal duties in the EU (August 2026) and China (2025); vendors now watermark avatar audio and video (SynthID).
collections.desc_zh: 告知用户正在与 AI 交流、为生成内容加上机器可读标记，已在欧盟（2026 年 8 月）和中国（2025 年）成为法律义务；厂商已开始为虚拟人的音频和视频加水印（SynthID）。
collections.gap_en: Paradigms that rely on participants believing a generated person is human need legal review; the EU research exemption covers only systems built solely for research; labels become part of the stimulus.
collections.gap_zh: 依赖参与者相信生成人物是真人的研究范式需要法律审查；欧盟的科研豁免只适用于专为研究开发的系统；标签本身也会成为刺激的一部分。
collections.next_en: Systems on the EU market before 2026-08-02 must meet the marking duty by 2026-12-02; California's AI Transparency Act phases in through 2027–2028.
collections.next_zh: 2026-08-02 之前已在欧盟上市的系统，须在 2026-12-02 之前满足标记义务；加州《AI 透明度法案》在 2027–2028 年间分阶段生效。

collections.zh: 生成式 AI 进入行为研究
collections.desc_en: LLM-driven patients, teammates and self-avatars in VR studies, mostly in medical and communication training; a 2025 systematic review found only 26 GenAI-XR articles. The first experiments inside generated scenes appeared in 2026, in static 360° environments (an RCT with N = 60 found no benefit over imagery), not in interactive world models.
collections.desc_zh: VR 研究中由大语言模型驱动的病人、队友和自我化身，主要用于医学与沟通训练；2025 年的一篇系统综述只找到 26 篇生成式 AI 与 XR 的文章。2026 年出现了首批在生成场景中进行的实验，但用的是静态的 360° 环境（一项 N = 60 的随机对照试验发现其效果并不优于想象练习），而不是可交互的世界模型。
collections.gap_en: No published study yet runs participants inside a Genie-class or GWM-class world; there is no validated scale for the plausibility or presence of generated situations; closed models change or disappear; a 2026 review of 15 generative-AI virtual-patient studies found only one run in a headset.
collections.gap_zh: 还没有发表的研究让参与者置身于 Genie 或 GWM 一类的生成世界中；也没有经过验证的量表来衡量生成情境的似真性或临场感；闭源模型会变化甚至消失；2026 年一篇综述梳理的 15 项生成式 AI 虚拟病人研究中，只有一项使用了头显。
collections.next_en: Vendors now run their own human-likeness studies (Tavus, n = 54); independent replication is an open opportunity.
collections.next_zh: 厂商开始自行开展“像真人”研究（Tavus，n = 54）；独立的重复验证是一个空缺的研究机会。

collections.en: Core references: generative immersion for behavioral science
collections.zh: 核心文献：面向行为科学的生成式沉浸
collections.desc_en: The works a research agenda on generative immersion for behavioral science builds on: VR behavioral research traditions, video generation, dynamic 4D and action-conditioned world models.
collections.desc_zh: 一项面向行为科学的生成式沉浸研究议程所依据的工作：VR 行为研究传统、视频生成、动态 4D 与以动作为条件的世界模型。

collections.desc_en: Published at SIGGRAPH, SIGGRAPH Asia or in ACM Transactions on Graphics.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 SIGGRAPH、SIGGRAPH Asia 或 ACM Transactions on Graphics。

collections.desc_en: Published at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于 IEEE/CVF 计算机视觉与模式识别会议。

collections.desc_en: Published at the International or European Conference on Computer Vision.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于国际计算机视觉大会或欧洲计算机视觉会议。

collections.desc_en: Published at the main machine learning conferences.
collections.desc_zh: 发表于主要的机器学习会议。

en: Generated worlds run in real time at 720p and 20–40 fps, but they still forget: independent 2026 benchmarks find that no model keeps memory reliably over 10–60 s of play.
“World simulator” now mostly means a simulator for robots and cars. OpenAI shut down Sora (API removed 2026-09-24) and moved its team to world simulation for robotics.
Control and persistence come from hybrids rather than bigger video models: explicit 3D you can keep, engines that hold state while a model draws the pixels, and timestamped event streams.
Full-duplex audio-visual humans shipped as products in 2026, on flat screens. Bodies in shared 3D space have not arrived.

Regulation and platform risk are part of study design: EU disclosure and marking duties apply from 2026-08-02, and closed services can vanish within months — archive stimuli and prefer open weights for anything that must be re-run.
zh: 生成的世界已能以 720p、每秒 20–40 帧实时运行，但仍然会“遗忘”：2026 年的独立基准发现，没有模型能在 10–60 秒的游玩中可靠地保持记忆。
“世界模拟器”如今主要指为机器人和汽车服务的模拟器。OpenAI 关停了 Sora（API 于 2026-09-24 下线），并把团队转向面向机器人的世界模拟研究。
可控性与持久性来自混合方案，而不是更大的视频模型：可以保存的显式三维、由引擎保存状态而由模型绘制画面的设计，以及带时间戳的事件流。
全双工的视听虚拟人在 2026 年成为产品，但都在平面屏幕上；在共享三维空间中的身体还没有到来。
监管与平台风险已是研究设计的一部分：欧盟的告知与标记义务自 2026-08-02 起适用，闭源服务可能在几个月内消失——请存档刺激材料，凡需重跑的部分尽量使用开源权重。

lenses: Makes approved analogues of rare, dangerous or hard-to-stage situations practicable.
让罕见、危险或难以布置的情境，以合乎伦理的模拟形式变得可行。
Generates the visual, auditory and motion cues that matter for the task.
生成任务所需的视觉、听觉与运动线索。
People, objects and events act in contextually meaningful ways, with sensible consequences.
人物、物体与事件的行为合乎情境，后果合理。
Responds within task-relevant timescales: latency, turn-taking, interruption.
在任务所需的时间尺度内回应：延迟、轮流发言与打断。
Responds meaningfully to a wider range of what a person actually does.
对人实际做出的更多样行为作出有意义的回应。
Varies challenge, content or support from a person's history or state.
根据人的经历或状态调整难度、内容或支持。
Samples many meaningful variants of a situation.
生成同一情境的多种有意义的变体。
Lets more people specify and revise situations with less effort.
让更多人以更少投入来设定和修改情境。
Participants shape events, relationships, rules or meanings during the experience.
参与者在体验过程中塑造事件、关系、规则或意义。
Keeps objects, histories and commitments consistent across time and viewpoint.
让物体、经历与承诺在时间与视角变化中保持一致。
Conditions can be specified, inspected, logged, replayed and compared.
条件可以被设定、检查、记录、回放与比较。

构建这些模型与产品的业界实验室和公司。

Journals that publish immersive and behavioral research.
发表沉浸式与行为研究的期刊。
Public comparisons of video, 3D, world and voice models.
视频、三维、世界与语音模型的公开比较。

creators.name: Emergence AI
creators.role: Agent-systems company with a research lab
creators.role_zh: 带有研究实验室的智能体系统公司
creators.bio: New York company that builds autonomous agent systems for enterprises. Its research lab runs Emergence World, a long-running simulation of LLM-agent societies.
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于纽约的公司，为企业构建自主智能体系统。其研究实验室运营 Emergence World，一个长期运行的大语言模型智能体社会模拟。
creators.why: Runs agent societies for weeks rather than days and publishes what goes wrong, which is the timescale a persistent social situation needs.
creators.why_zh: 让智能体社会连续运行数周而非数天，并公开其中出现的问题；持续存在的社会情境正需要这样的时间尺度。

creators.name: Mingyu Ouyang
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者（新加坡国立大学）
creators.bio: Researcher at the National University of Singapore; first author of Player-1 (2026), written during an internship at Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡国立大学研究者；Player-1（2026）的第一作者，该工作完成于腾讯 ARC 实验室实习期间。
creators.why: Player-1 trains game agents in synthetic worlds instead of on human demonstrations alone.
creators.why_zh: Player-1 让游戏智能体在合成世界中学习，而不只依赖人类示范。

creators.name: Zhiyang Deng
creators.role: AI researcher (Tencent, National University of Singapore)
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者（腾讯、新加坡国立大学）
creators.bio: Researcher at the National University of Singapore; co-first author of WorldMind (2026), written during a research internship at Tencent.
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡国立大学研究者；WorldMind（2026）的共同第一作者，该工作完成于腾讯研究实习期间。
creators.why: WorldMind gives characters inside a game world model an explicit decision step.
creators.why_zh: WorldMind 为游戏世界模型中的角色加入了一个显式的决策环节。

creators.name: Kolby Nottingham
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者
creators.bio: Researcher on language-model agents in games; co-creator of Mindcraft with Max Robinson, whose Emergent Garden YouTube channel made the bot widely known.
creators.bio_zh: 研究游戏中的语言模型智能体；与 Max Robinson 共同开发 Mindcraft，后者的 YouTube 频道 Emergent Garden 让这个机器人广为人知。
creators.why: Mindcraft is the most widely used open framework for LLM agents that play Minecraft alongside people.
creators.why_zh: Mindcraft 是使用最广的开源框架之一，让大语言模型智能体与人一起玩 Minecraft。

creators.name: Studio Atelico
creators.role: Developer of an on-device AI engine for games
creators.role_zh: 面向游戏的本地端 AI 引擎开发商
creators.bio: Studio founded by AI and games veterans from Uber, Meta, SEGA and Creative Assembly that builds the Atelico AI Engine for characters that run on the player's own GPU.
creators.bio_zh: 由来自 Uber、Meta、世嘉与 Creative Assembly 的 AI 与游戏从业者创办的工作室，开发让角色在玩家自己的 GPU 上运行的 Atelico AI 引擎。
creators.why: Showed that a Smallville-style village of generative agents can run in real time on one consumer GPU, without cloud cost.
creators.why_zh: 证明了 Smallville 式的生成式智能体村庄可以在一块消费级 GPU 上实时运行，无需云端开销。

creators.name: GoodAI
creators.role: AI research company and game developer
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究公司与游戏开发商
creators.bio: Prague-based AI research company founded by Marek Rosa (Keen Software House); it developed AI People, a sandbox game of LLM-driven NPCs.
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于布拉格的人工智能研究公司，由 Marek Rosa（Keen Software House 创始人）创办；开发了由大语言模型驱动 NPC 的沙盒游戏 AI People。
creators.why: One of the first commercial attempts to sell a game whose whole cast is LLM agents, and an example of how fragile such products are.
creators.why_zh: 最早尝试售卖“整个角色阵容都是大语言模型智能体”游戏的商业项目之一，也说明了这类产品有多脆弱。

creators.name: Wemade Next
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商（Wemade 子公司）
creators.bio: Korean developer of the Legend of Mir MMORPG series, including MIR4 and MIR5, and a subsidiary of Wemade.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国游戏开发商，Wemade 旗下子公司，开发《传奇》（Legend of Mir）系列 MMORPG，包括 MIR4 与 MIR5。
creators.why: Announced the first LLM-driven boss built with NVIDIA ACE, moving AI characters from companions to adversaries.
creators.why_zh: 宣布了首个基于 NVIDIA ACE、由大语言模型驱动的首领角色，把 AI 角色从同伴扩展到对手。

creators.name: Linxi (Jim) Fan
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者（英伟达）
creators.bio: NVIDIA research scientist working on embodied agents and robot foundation models; first author of MineDojo (2022) and co-author of Voyager (2023).
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达研究科学家，研究具身智能体与机器人基础模型；MineDojo（2022）的第一作者，也是 Voyager（2023）的合作者。
creators.why: MineDojo set up Minecraft, and internet videos about it, as a shared testbed for open-ended agents.
creators.why_zh: MineDojo 把 Minecraft 及其海量网络视频，建成开放式智能体研究共享的试验场。

creators.name: Marcel Binz
creators.role_zh: 认知科学家（慕尼黑亥姆霍兹中心）
creators.bio: Researcher at Helmholtz Munich's Institute for Human-Centered AI who builds machine-learning models of human cognition; first author of Centaur (Nature, 2025).
creators.bio_zh: 慕尼黑亥姆霍兹中心“以人为本人工智能研究所”的研究者，构建人类认知的机器学习模型；Centaur（《自然》，2025）的第一作者。
creators.why: Centaur is the most direct attempt to build a model that stands in for human participants across many experiments.
creators.why_zh: Centaur 是在多类实验中替代人类被试的模型方向上最直接的尝试。

creators.name: Art from the Machine
creators.role_zh: 独立模组开发者
creators.bio: Pseudonymous developer of Mantella, an open-source mod that gives NPCs in Skyrim and Fallout 4 voice conversations driven by language models.
creators.bio_zh: 以化名活动的开发者，开发了开源模组 Mantella，让《上古卷轴 V：天际》与《辐射 4》中的 NPC 能进行由语言模型驱动的语音对话。
creators.why: Mantella showed, years before studios shipped AI NPCs, how players use LLM characters in a large existing game world.
creators.why_zh: 早在游戏公司推出 AI NPC 之前，Mantella 就展示了玩家如何在一个庞大的现成游戏世界中使用大语言模型角色。

creators.name: Ritik Vatsal
creators.role: Researcher, Department of Computer Science, University of British Columbia
creators.bio: Works with Robert Xiao at UBC on VR interaction; first author of Look2React (IEEE TVCG 2026).
creators.why: Look2React gives VR NPCs a view of the player and a vision model to react to body language.
creators.role_zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学计算机科学系研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在不列颠哥伦比亚大学与 Robert Xiao 合作研究 VR 交互，Look2React（IEEE TVCG 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Look2React 让 VR 中的 NPC 看得见玩家，并由视觉模型根据肢体语言作出反应。

creators.name: Nima Zargham
creators.role: Researcher, Digital Media Lab, University of Bremen
creators.bio: HCI and games researcher in Rainer Malaka's Digital Media Lab, working on speech interaction and conversational agents in games.
creators.why: Ran one of the larger player studies (N = 48) of LLM-driven, speech-based NPCs in VR.
creators.role_zh: 不来梅大学数字媒体实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互与游戏研究者，任职于 Rainer Malaka 领导的数字媒体实验室，研究游戏中的语音交互与对话智能体。
creators.why_zh: 完成了规模较大的一项 VR 中大语言模型语音 NPC 玩家研究（N = 48）。

creators.name: Joon Sung Park
creators.role: HCI researcher; co-founder and CEO of Simile
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者，Simile 联合创始人兼 CEO
creators.bio: Stanford computer science PhD who introduced generative agents in the 2023 Smallville paper and then built agents grounded in two-hour interviews with 1,052 Americans. Co-founded Simile with Michael Bernstein and Percy Liang.
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学计算机科学博士，2023 年以 Smallville 论文提出生成式智能体，随后用 1,052 名美国人的两小时访谈构建个体智能体。与 Michael Bernstein、Percy Liang 共同创办 Simile。
creators.why: His memory, reflection and planning architecture is the template most social simulations and LLM NPCs build on.
creators.why_zh: 他提出的记忆、反思与计划架构，是如今大多数社会模拟与 LLM NPC 的基础模板。

creators.name: Simile
creators.role_zh: 人类行为模拟公司
creators.bio: Company founded by Joon Sung Park, Michael Bernstein and Percy Liang that turns generative-agent research into simulations of customers and populations. It came out of stealth in February 2026.
creators.bio_zh: 由 Joon Sung Park、Michael Bernstein 与 Percy Liang 创办，把生成式智能体研究做成对客户与人群的模拟。2026 年 2 月公开亮相。
creators.why: The first well-funded company selling simulations of real people, raising the same validity questions behavioral researchers face.
creators.why_zh: 第一家获得大额融资、出售真实人群模拟的公司，它面对的效度问题也正是行为研究者要回答的问题。

creators.name: Andreessen Horowitz (a16z)
creators.role_zh: 风险投资机构（a16z 基础设施团队）
creators.bio: Venture firm whose infrastructure team released AI Town with Convex in 2023: an MIT-licensed starter kit for a browser town of chatting LLM characters.
creators.bio_zh: 风险投资机构，其基础设施团队于 2023 年与 Convex 合作发布 AI Town：一个 MIT 许可、可在浏览器中运行的 LLM 角色小镇起步套件。
creators.why: Made the Smallville idea something anyone could deploy and modify.
creators.why_zh: 让 Smallville 的想法变成任何人都能部署和改造的项目。

creators.name: Altera (Fundamental Research Labs)
creators.role_zh: AI 智能体初创公司
creators.bio: Startup building autonomous digital humans; in 2024 it ran Project Sid, simulations of 10 to more than 1,000 LLM agents in Minecraft. Its YouTube channel now carries the name Fundamental Research Labs.
creators.bio_zh: 构建自主数字人的初创公司；2024 年推出 Project Sid，在 Minecraft 中模拟 10 到 1,000 多个 LLM 智能体。其 YouTube 频道现名 Fundamental Research Labs。
creators.why: Showed what happens to roles, rules and culture when hundreds of agents share one persistent world.
creators.why_zh: 展示了数百个智能体共享同一个持续世界时，分工、规则与文化会如何演化。

creators.name: Google DeepMind
creators.role_zh: 谷歌旗下的人工智能研究实验室
creators.bio: Google's AI lab (Gemini, Genie, Veo). Its SIMA project trains agents that follow language instructions in commercial 3D games and, with SIMA 2, in worlds generated by Genie 3; it also maintains the Concordia library for generative social simulation.
creators.bio_zh: 谷歌的人工智能实验室（Gemini、Genie、Veo）。其 SIMA 项目训练能在商业三维游戏中听从语言指令的智能体，SIMA 2 还进入了 Genie 3 生成的世界；它也维护用于生成式社会模拟的 Concordia 库。
creators.why: Connects world models and embodied agents: the same lab generates the worlds and the agents that act in them.
creators.why_zh: 把世界模型与具身智能体连在一起：同一个实验室既生成世界，也训练在其中行动的智能体。

creators.name: Tsinghua University FIB Lab
creators.role: Research lab, Department of Electronic Engineering, Tsinghua University
creators.role_zh: 清华大学电子工程系研究实验室
creators.bio: Lab led by Yong Li working on urban science and LLM agents; released the AgentSociety simulator in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 由李勇领导的实验室，研究城市科学与大语言模型智能体；2025 年发布 AgentSociety 模拟器。
creators.why: Builds city-scale agent societies as testbeds for social-science experiments.
creators.why_zh: 构建城市尺度的智能体社会，作为社会科学实验的试验台。
creators.name_zh: 清华大学 FIB 实验室

creators.name: CAMEL-AI
creators.role_zh: 开源多智能体研究社区
creators.bio: Open-source community behind the CAMEL multi-agent framework and OASIS, a social-media simulator for up to one million LLM agents.
creators.bio_zh: CAMEL 多智能体框架与 OASIS 背后的开源社区；OASIS 是可容纳一百万个 LLM 智能体的社交媒体模拟器。
creators.why: Scaled LLM social simulation to a million users on X- and Reddit-like platforms.
creators.why_zh: 把 LLM 社会模拟扩展到一百万用户规模，覆盖类 X 与类 Reddit 平台。

creators.name: OpenAI
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究与产品公司
creators.bio: Developer of GPT, Sora and the realtime voice models; in 2019 its multi-agent hide-and-seek study showed agents inventing tool use in a 3D physics world.
creators.bio_zh: GPT、Sora 与实时语音模型的开发者；2019 年的多智能体捉迷藏研究展示了智能体在三维物理世界中自发学会使用工具。
creators.why: An early, widely seen demonstration that agents in a simulated world can produce behavior nobody scripted.
creators.why_zh: 较早且广为人知地展示了：模拟世界中的智能体可以产生没有人编写过的行为。

creators.name: NVIDIA
creators.role_zh: GPU 与人工智能计算公司
creators.bio: Maker of GPUs and of ACE, a stack of speech, language and facial-animation models for game characters; its research groups also built the Voyager and NitroGen game agents.
creators.bio_zh: GPU 厂商，并推出 ACE：一套面向游戏角色的语音、语言与面部动画模型；其研究团队还开发了 Voyager 与 NitroGen 等游戏智能体。
creators.why: Sets the reference stack for talking game characters and runs them on local GPUs.
creators.why_zh: 为会说话的游戏角色提供参考技术栈，并让它们在本地 GPU 上运行。

creators.name: Guanzhi Wang
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者（加州理工学院、英伟达）
creators.bio: Caltech PhD researcher working with NVIDIA; first author of Voyager (2023), an LLM agent that explores Minecraft by writing and storing code skills.
creators.bio_zh: 加州理工学院博士研究者，与英伟达合作；Voyager（2023）的第一作者，该智能体通过编写并保存代码技能来探索 Minecraft。
creators.why: Voyager turned LLM agents in open game worlds into a research line of its own.
creators.why_zh: Voyager 让“开放游戏世界中的 LLM 智能体”成为一条独立的研究路线。

creators.name: Weihao Tan
creators.role_zh: 人工智能研究者，游戏智能体方向
creators.bio: First author of Cradle (2024), which played Red Dead Redemption 2 from screenshots and keyboard-mouse output, and of Lumine (2025, ByteDance Seed), which completes hours-long Genshin Impact missions in real time.
creators.bio_zh: Cradle（2024）与 Lumine（2025，字节跳动 Seed）的第一作者：前者通过截图和键鼠输出游玩《荒野大镖客 2》，后者能实时完成数小时的《原神》任务。
creators.why: His two projects trace the shift from slow screenshot agents to real-time open-world agents.
creators.why_zh: 他的两个项目勾勒出从缓慢的截图式智能体到实时开放世界智能体的转变。

creators.name: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI)
creators.role_zh: 非营利人工智能研究机构
creators.bio: Non-profit research institute in Beijing; its agents team released Cradle, a framework for general computer control tested in commercial games and software.
creators.bio_zh: 位于北京的非营利研究机构；其智能体团队发布了 Cradle，一个在商业游戏与软件中测试的通用计算机控制框架。
creators.why: Pushed foundation-model agents from APIs to the same screen-and-keyboard interface players use.
creators.why_zh: 把基础模型智能体从 API 调用推向与玩家相同的屏幕加键鼠界面。
creators.name_zh: 北京智源人工智能研究院

creators.name: ByteDance Seed
creators.role_zh: 字节跳动的基础模型研究团队
creators.bio: Research team building ByteDance's foundation models (Doubao, Seedance, UI-TARS); in 2025 it released the game agents Game-TARS and Lumine.
creators.bio_zh: 构建字节跳动基础模型（豆包、Seedance、UI-TARS）的研究团队；2025 年发布游戏智能体 Game-TARS 与 Lumine。
creators.why: One of the few labs training generalist agents for real-time play in commercial 3D games.
creators.why_zh: 少数训练通用智能体在商业三维游戏中实时游玩的实验室之一。

creators.name: Convai
creators.role: Conversational AI platform for game and XR characters
creators.role_zh: 面向游戏与 XR 角色的对话式 AI 平台
creators.bio: Startup that provides an engine and plugins for characters that talk, perceive and act in Unreal Engine, Unity and web 3D; it built NVIDIA's 2023 Kairos demo with ACE.
creators.bio_zh: 为 Unreal Engine、Unity 与网页三维场景提供能说话、感知和行动的角色引擎与插件；2023 年与英伟达用 ACE 合作制作了 Kairos 演示。
creators.why: One of the main off-the-shelf ways to put LLM-driven characters into games and XR training scenes.
creators.why_zh: 把 LLM 驱动角色放进游戏和 XR 训练场景的主要现成途径之一。

creators.name: Inworld AI
creators.role: Real-time AI company, formerly an AI character engine for games
creators.role_zh: 实时 AI 公司，前身是游戏 AI 角色引擎
creators.bio: Founded in 2021 to build an engine for AI game characters, used in Ubisoft's NEO NPC and NVIDIA's Covert Protocol demos. By 2026 it mainly markets real-time voice models (TTS, STT, speech-to-speech) and a runtime for consumer AI apps.
creators.bio_zh: 2021 年成立，最初为游戏 AI 角色打造引擎，育碧 NEO NPC 与英伟达 Covert Protocol 演示都使用了它。到 2026 年，它主要推广实时语音模型（TTS、STT、语音到语音）以及面向消费级 AI 应用的运行时。
creators.why: Its path shows how NPC platforms turned into general real-time voice infrastructure.
creators.why_zh: 它的转型说明了 NPC 平台如何演变为通用的实时语音基础设施。

creators.name: Ubisoft
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏发行商
creators.bio: French publisher of Assassin's Creed and The Division; its Paris teams showed the NEO NPC prototype in 2024 and the playable Teammates experiment in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 《刺客信条》《全境封锁》的法国发行商；其巴黎团队在 2024 年展示 NEO NPC 原型，2025 年推出可游玩的 Teammates 实验。
creators.why: A major publisher testing voice-driven generative NPCs with real players.
creators.why_zh: 一家大型发行商在真实玩家身上测试语音驱动的生成式 NPC。

creators.name: KRAFTON
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏发行商
creators.bio: South Korean publisher of PUBG: Battlegrounds and inZOI; with NVIDIA ACE it introduced 'Co-Playable Characters' that run on small on-device language models.
creators.bio_zh: 韩国游戏公司，发行《绝地求生》与 inZOI；与英伟达 ACE 合作推出运行在本地小语言模型上的“可共玩角色”（CPC）。
creators.why: Puts on-device LLM teammates and autonomous citizens into mass-market games.
creators.why_zh: 把本地运行的 LLM 队友与自主市民放进大众市场游戏。

creators.name: Epic Games
creators.role: Game developer and engine maker (Fortnite, Unreal Engine)
creators.role_zh: 游戏开发商与引擎厂商（Fortnite、Unreal Engine）
creators.bio: Developer of Fortnite and Unreal Engine; launched a voice-chat AI Darth Vader in Fortnite in 2025 and opened the technology to creators as the Persona device, later called Conversations.
creators.bio_zh: Fortnite 与 Unreal Engine 的开发商；2025 年在 Fortnite 中上线可语音对话的 AI 达斯·维达，随后以 Persona 装置（后更名 Conversations）向创作者开放这项技术。
creators.why: Brought conversational NPCs to one of the largest game audiences and to user-made islands.
creators.why_zh: 把对话式 NPC 带给规模最大的游戏玩家群体之一，以及玩家自制的岛屿。
creators.based_zh: 美国北卡罗来纳州卡里

creators.name: Anuttacon
creators.role_zh: AI 游戏工作室
creators.bio: Studio founded by miHoYo co-founder Cai Haoyu to make AI-native games; released Whispers from the Star in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 由米哈游联合创始人蔡浩宇创办的 AI 原生游戏工作室；2025 年发布《Whispers from the Star》。
creators.why: An early commercial game built entirely around open-ended voice conversation with one AI character.
creators.why_zh: 较早完全围绕与单个 AI 角色开放式语音对话而构建的商业游戏。

creators.name: Proxima
creators.role_zh: 独立游戏工作室
creators.bio: Small studio behind Suck Up!, a comedy game in which players talk AI-driven townsfolk into letting a vampire in.
creators.bio_zh: 《Suck Up!》背后的小型工作室；在这款喜剧游戏里，玩家要说服由 AI 驱动的镇民让吸血鬼进门。
creators.why: An indie proof that free-form persuasion of LLM characters can be the whole game mechanic.
creators.why_zh: 一个独立游戏证明：对 LLM 角色的自由说服本身就可以构成整个玩法。

creators.name: NetEase Games
creators.role_zh: 电子游戏开发商与发行商
creators.bio: Chinese game company behind Justice Online, Eggy Party and NARAKA: BLADEPOINT; it shipped LLM-driven NPCs in Justice Online Mobile in 2023 and an on-device NVIDIA ACE AI teammate in NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mobile PC Version in 2025.
creators.bio_zh: 中国游戏公司，旗下有《逆水寒》《蛋仔派对》《永劫无间》；2023 年在《逆水寒》手游中上线 LLM 驱动的 NPC，2025 年在《永劫无间》手游 PC 版中上线基于英伟达 ACE、本地运行的 AI 队友。
creators.why: Shows Chinese studios shipping LLM characters to very large player bases.
creators.why_zh: 说明中国游戏公司已在超大规模玩家群体中上线 LLM 角色。

creators.name: Yi-Hua Huang
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: Researcher in Xiaojuan Qi's group at the University of Hong Kong and first author of AniGen (SIGGRAPH 2026), developed with VAST.
creators.why: AniGen generates a mesh together with its skeleton and skinning, so a generated object can be animated at once.
creators.role_zh: 香港大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学齐晓娟课题组研究者，与 VAST 合作完成的 AniGen（SIGGRAPH 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: AniGen 同时生成网格、骨骼和蒙皮权重，生成的物体可以直接拿去做动画。

creators.name: Hao Zhang
creators.role: PhD researcher, UIUC; research intern at Snap
creators.bio: University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign researcher and first author of RigMo, developed with Snap Research.
creators.why: RigMo learns rigs and motion together from raw deforming meshes, without hand-made skeletons.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校博士研究者，Snap 研究实习生
creators.bio_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校研究者，与 Snap Research 合作完成的 RigMo 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: RigMo 直接从原始的形变网格序列中同时学习绑定和动作，不需要人工制作的骨骼。

creators.name: Amir Mann
creators.bio: Technion researcher (with Or Litany) and first author of VideoMDM, which trains a 3D motion diffusion model from 2D video poses.
creators.why: VideoMDM points to ordinary video, not motion capture, as the data source for motion generators.
creators.role_zh: 以色列理工学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 以色列理工学院研究者（与 Or Litany 合作），VideoMDM 第一作者；该工作用视频中的二维姿态训练三维动作扩散模型。
creators.why_zh: VideoMDM 表明，动作生成模型的数据可以来自普通视频，而不一定要靠动作捕捉。

creators.name: Chuanrui Zhang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Nanyang Technological University; intern at ByteDance Seed
creators.bio: First author of SIMART (SIGGRAPH 2026), developed during an internship at ByteDance Seed with Nanyang Technological University.
creators.why: SIMART turns a single generated mesh into parts and joints that a physics simulator can use.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学博士研究者，字节跳动 Seed 实习生
creators.bio_zh: SIMART（SIGGRAPH 2026）第一作者，该工作在字节跳动 Seed 实习期间与南洋理工大学合作完成。
creators.why_zh: SIMART 能把一个整体生成的网格拆成物理仿真器可用的部件和关节。

creators.name: Matt Zhou
creators.bio: First author of Articraft, an agentic system for articulated 3D assets built with Shangzhe Wu's group at Cambridge and Oxford's Visual Geometry Group.
creators.why: Articraft has a language model write programs that build articulated objects, which can be loaded into VR and simulators.
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Articraft 第一作者；该系统由剑桥大学 Shangzhe Wu 课题组与牛津大学视觉几何组（VGG）合作完成，用智能体生成可活动的三维资产。
creators.why_zh: Articraft 让语言模型编写程序来搭建可活动的物体，生成结果可载入 VR 和仿真器。

creators.name: Uthana
creators.bio: Uthana makes text-to-motion, video-to-motion, auto-rigging and retargeting models for game animation and for humanoid-robot training, offered through a web app, an API and plugins for Blender, Maya and Unity AI.
creators.why: One of the few companies selling generated body motion as a product with an API.
creators.role_zh: AI 人体动作公司
creators.bio_zh: Uthana 提供文生动作、视频转动作、自动绑定与动作重定向模型，面向游戏动画和人形机器人训练，可通过网页应用、API 以及 Blender、Maya 和 Unity AI 插件使用。
creators.why_zh: 少数把生成的人体动作做成产品并提供 API 的公司之一。

creators.name: Math Magic (Hi3D)
creators.bio: Shenzhen company that develops Hi3D (formerly Hitem3D), an image-to-3D platform aimed at games, design and 3D printing, with model splitting and multi-colour print preparation.
creators.why: One of the commercial image-to-3D services compared head to head with Meshy, Rodin and Hunyuan3D in 2026.
creators.role_zh: Hi3D 背后的三维生成公司
creators.bio_zh: 深圳公司，开发 Hi3D（原名 Hitem3D）图生三维平台，面向游戏、设计和 3D 打印，提供模型拆分和多色打印准备等功能。
creators.why_zh: 2026 年与 Meshy、Rodin、混元3D 同台比较的商用图生三维服务之一。

creators.name: Ziang Cao
creators.bio: Researcher in Ziwei Liu's group at NTU and first author of the PhysX line of physical 3D generation work, including PhysX-Anything (CVPR 2026) and PhysX-Omni.
creators.why: PhysX-Omni generates objects with scale, material, joints and deformability, the properties a simulator needs.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学（S-Lab）博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学刘子纬课题组研究者，PhysX 系列物理三维生成工作的第一作者，包括 PhysX-Anything（CVPR 2026）和 PhysX-Omni。
creators.why_zh: PhysX-Omni 生成的物体带有尺度、材质、关节和可变形属性，正是仿真器所需要的。

creators.name: Linzhan Mou
creators.bio: Princeton graphics researcher (with Adam Finkelstein and Szymon Rusinkiewicz) and first author of UniMate (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026).
creators.why: UniMate generates motion for any rigged skeleton from a prompt, closing the step after auto-rigging.
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 普林斯顿大学图形学研究者（与 Adam Finkelstein、Szymon Rusinkiewicz 合作），UniMate（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: UniMate 能根据提示词为任意已绑定的骨骼生成动作，补上了自动绑定之后的那一步。

creators.name: Weiyu Li
creators.role: PhD researcher, HKUST; research intern at Meta AI
creators.bio: HKUST researcher (with Ping Tan) and first author of MeshFlow (CVPR 2026 Highlight), developed with Meta AI.
creators.why: MeshFlow generates artist-style mesh topology in about a second instead of token by token.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学博士研究者，Meta AI 研究实习生
creators.bio_zh: 香港科技大学研究者（与谭平合作），与 Meta AI 合作完成的 MeshFlow（CVPR 2026 Highlight）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: MeshFlow 约一秒即可生成艺术家风格的网格拓扑，而不必逐个 token 解码。

creators.name: Qirui Wu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Simon Fraser University; intern at NVIDIA
creators.bio: Simon Fraser University researcher (with Angel X. Chang) and first author of GATOR, developed with NVIDIA's Learning and Perception Research group.
creators.why: GATOR turns casual photos of a room into complete, posed object assets that a simulator can use.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学博士研究者，英伟达实习生
creators.bio_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者（与 Angel X. Chang 合作），与英伟达学习与感知研究组合作完成的 GATOR 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GATOR 能把随手拍的房间照片变成完整、带位姿、可用于仿真的物体资产。

creators.name: Zehuan Huang
creators.bio: Researcher in Lu Sheng's group at Beihang University's School of Software and first author of AnimaX (2025), developed with VAST.
creators.why: AnimaX transfers motion priors from video diffusion to skeletons of any shape, so a generated mesh can be animated from a text prompt.
creators.role_zh: 北京航空航天大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 北京航空航天大学软件学院 Lu Sheng 课题组研究者，与 VAST 合作完成的 AnimaX（2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: AnimaX 把视频扩散模型中的运动先验迁移到任意形状的骨骼上，生成的网格只需一句文字提示就能动起来。

creators.name: Bohong Chen
creators.role: Researcher, State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University
creators.bio: Researcher in Kun Zhou's group at Zhejiang University's State Key Lab of CAD&CG and first author of EchoAvatar (SIGGRAPH 2026).
creators.why: EchoAvatar animates a full 3D body from a live voice or music stream, the body that voice agents lack.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学 CAD&CG 国家重点实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学 CAD&CG 国家重点实验室周昆课题组研究者，EchoAvatar（SIGGRAPH 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: EchoAvatar 能根据实时语音或音乐流驱动完整的三维身体，补上语音智能体缺少的“身体”。

creators.name: Yiyi Cai
creators.bio: First author of FloodDiffusion (CVPR 2026) and FloodDiffusion 2 (2026), streaming text-to-motion models from ShandaAI Research Tokyo and the University of Tokyo; version 2 is published through Alaya Lab's GitHub and Hugging Face accounts.
creators.why: FloodDiffusion lets new text commands redirect a character's motion while it moves, in real time.
creators.role_zh: ShandaAI 东京研究院研究者
creators.bio_zh: FloodDiffusion（CVPR 2026）与 FloodDiffusion 2（2026）的第一作者，两者都是 ShandaAI 东京研究院与东京大学的流式文本生成动作模型；第二版通过 Alaya Lab 的 GitHub 与 Hugging Face 账号发布。
creators.why_zh: FloodDiffusion 让新的文字指令能在角色运动过程中实时改变其动作。

creators.name: Xiangyue Zhang
creators.role: Researcher, University of Tokyo and Tongyi Lab (Alibaba)
creators.bio: First author of StreamTalk (ECCV 2026) and of the earlier co-speech gesture models SemTalk (ICCV 2025) and EchoMask (ACM MM 2025); co-author of FloodDiffusion 2.
creators.why: StreamTalk keeps streamed co-speech gestures from drifting over long talks, which virtual humans in long conversations need.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学与通义实验室（阿里巴巴）研究者
creators.bio_zh: StreamTalk（ECCV 2026）以及此前伴随语音手势模型 SemTalk（ICCV 2025）、EchoMask（ACM MM 2025）的第一作者，也是 FloodDiffusion 2 的合著者。
creators.why_zh: StreamTalk 让流式生成的伴随语音手势在长时间讲话中不再跑偏，这是虚拟人进行长对话所必需的。

creators.name: Brian Nlong Zhao
creators.role: PhD researcher, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: Researcher with James M. Rehg at UIUC and co-first author of Kirin (ECCV 2026), with Stanford's Jiajun Wu and Cambridge's Shangzhe Wu.
creators.why: Kirin brings text- and image-conditioned motion generation to animals, learned from internet video.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校 James M. Rehg 课题组研究者，与斯坦福大学 Jiajun Wu、剑桥大学 Shangzhe Wu 合作完成的 Kirin（ECCV 2026）共同第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Kirin 把以文字和图像为条件的动作生成扩展到动物，并从网络视频中学习。

creators.name: Chuqiao Li
creators.bio: Researcher in Gerard Pons-Moll's group at the University of Tübingen and the Tübingen AI Center, first author of FrankenMotion (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: FrankenMotion gives each body part its own timed text prompt, the fine control that nonverbal-behaviour experiments need.
creators.role_zh: 图宾根大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 图宾根大学与图宾根 AI 中心 Gerard Pons-Moll 课题组研究者，FrankenMotion（CVPR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: FrankenMotion 为每个身体部位提供带时间安排的独立文字提示，正是非语言行为实验需要的精细控制。

creators.name: Jingcheng Ni
creators.bio: Researcher in Srinath Sridhar's group at Brown University and first author of Sonic-AMG (2026), with MIT, Yale and the University of Hong Kong.
creators.why: Sonic-AMG makes simulated people react in real time to what a sound is and where it comes from.
creators.role_zh: 布朗大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 布朗大学 Srinath Sridhar 课题组研究者，与麻省理工学院、耶鲁大学和香港大学合作完成的 Sonic-AMG（2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Sonic-AMG 让模拟人物能根据声音是什么、从哪里来，实时做出反应。

creators.name: Manwen Liao
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: First author of MegaParts (2026), developed during an internship at Shanghai AI Laboratory with the team behind MeshCoder.
creators.why: MegaParts scales part-aware 3D generation to objects of up to 300 separate parts.
creators.role_zh: 香港大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: MegaParts（2026）第一作者，该工作在上海人工智能实验室实习期间与 MeshCoder 团队合作完成。
creators.why_zh: MegaParts 把部件级三维生成扩展到最多由 300 个独立部件组成的物体。

creators.name: Guying Lin
creators.bio: First author of PAT3D (ICLR 2026), developed at Carnegie Mellon University with The University of Hong Kong and HKUST.
creators.why: PAT3D puts a differentiable physics simulator inside text-to-3D scene generation, so generated rooms are ready for simulation.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: PAT3D（ICLR 2026）第一作者，该工作由卡内基梅隆大学与香港大学、香港科技大学合作完成。
creators.why_zh: PAT3D 把可微物理仿真器放进文本生成三维场景的流程里，生成的房间可以直接用于仿真。

creators.name: Meshy
creators.bio: Startup behind Meshy, a web, app and API product for text-to-3D, image-to-3D, AI texturing, auto-rigging and animation; it shipped model generations from Meshy-1 (2023) to Meshy 7.1 (September 2026).
creators.why: One of the most widely used commercial 3D asset generators, with an API and an MCP server that let agents and other tools create props on demand.
creators.role_zh: AI 三维生成公司
creators.bio_zh: Meshy 的开发公司，提供文生三维、图生三维、AI 贴图、自动绑定与动画的网页、应用和 API；模型从 Meshy-1（2023 年）迭代到 Meshy 7.1（2026 年 9 月）。
creators.why_zh: 使用最广的商用三维资产生成工具之一，提供 API 和 MCP 服务器，让智能体和其他软件可以按需生成道具。

creators.name: Tripo AI (VAST)
creators.bio: VAST builds the Tripo 3D generation models and Tripo Studio, and publishes open research such as TripoSR (with Stability AI), TripoSG, UniRig and TripoSplat.
creators.why: A leading Chinese 3D-asset lab that releases both commercial models and open weights used across the community.
creators.role_zh: 三维生成公司（VAST）
creators.bio_zh: VAST 开发 Tripo 三维生成模型与 Tripo Studio，并发布 TripoSR（与 Stability AI 合作）、TripoSG、UniRig、TripoSplat 等开源研究。
creators.why_zh: 中国领先的三维资产团队，同时推出商用模型和社区广泛使用的开源权重。

creators.name: Deemos (Hyper3D Rodin)
creators.bio: ShanghaiTech-rooted company that builds the Rodin 3D generators (Gen-1 based on the CLAY research model, Gen-1.5, Gen-2, Gen-2.5) and the ChatAvatar face generator, sold through hyper3d.ai and an API.
creators.why: Pioneered 3D-native large generative models for production assets and pushes part-level and high-polygon generation.
creators.role_zh: Hyper3D Rodin 背后的三维生成公司
creators.bio_zh: 源自上海科技大学的公司，开发 Rodin 系列三维生成模型（Gen-1 基于 CLAY 研究模型，之后有 Gen-1.5、Gen-2、Gen-2.5）和 ChatAvatar 人脸生成，通过 hyper3d.ai 和 API 提供服务。
creators.why_zh: 率先把原生三维的大规模生成模型用于生产级资产，并推动部件级与高面数生成。

creators.name: Roblox
creators.bio: Platform where users build and play experiences; its Foundation AI team develops the Cube 3D foundation model, open-sourced in part, and in-experience 3D and 4D generation.
creators.why: Puts 3D generation in the hands of players at play time, inside a platform with tens of millions of daily users.
creators.role_zh: 在线游戏平台
creators.bio_zh: 用户在此搭建并游玩各类体验的平台；其基础 AI 团队开发了部分开源的 Cube 三维基础模型，以及在游戏内使用的三维与 4D 生成功能。
creators.why_zh: 让玩家在游戏进行中就能生成三维内容，平台日活用户以千万计。

creators.name: Luma AI
creators.bio: Started with NeRF capture apps and the Genie text-to-3D generator, then moved its focus to video generation (Dream Machine, Ray models).
creators.why: An early consumer-scale text-to-3D product and a bridge between 3D capture and generative video.
creators.role_zh: 生成式 AI 公司（三维拍摄、视频）
creators.bio_zh: 以 NeRF 拍摄应用和 Genie 文生三维起家，之后把重心转向视频生成（Dream Machine、Ray 系列模型）。
creators.why_zh: 较早面向大众的文生三维产品，也连接了三维拍摄与生成式视频。

creators.name: Stability AI
creators.bio: Company behind Stable Diffusion that also released open 3D models: TripoSR (with Tripo AI), Stable Fast 3D, SPAR3D and Stable Video 3D.
creators.why: Its permissively licensed fast image-to-3D models made feed-forward reconstruction easy to embed in other tools.
creators.role_zh: 开源生成模型公司
creators.bio_zh: Stable Diffusion 的开发公司，也发布了开源三维模型：TripoSR（与 Tripo AI 合作）、Stable Fast 3D、SPAR3D 和 Stable Video 3D。
creators.why_zh: 其宽松许可的快速图生三维模型，让前馈式重建可以方便地嵌入其他工具。

creators.name: Google
creators.role: Google Research, Google Labs and Google AR
creators.bio: Google's research and product groups outside DeepMind; Google Research authored DreamFusion, the 2022 paper that started text-to-3D via 2D diffusion.
creators.why: Source of several foundational methods for generating 3D and video content.
creators.role_zh: 谷歌研究院、Google Labs 与 Google AR
creators.bio_zh: 谷歌在 DeepMind 之外的研究与产品团队；谷歌研究院发表了 DreamFusion，这篇 2022 年的论文开启了借助二维扩散模型的文生三维路线。
creators.why_zh: 多项三维与视频内容生成基础方法的出处。

creators.name: Meta
creators.bio: Meta's AI research (FAIR) and Reality Labs groups; in 3D assets they released Meta 3D Gen, SAM 3D Objects and Body, ShapeR and the Meta Motivo humanoid model.
creators.why: Builds both the generative models and the headsets (Quest) where generated assets end up.
creators.role_zh: Meta AI 研究院 / FAIR / Reality Labs 现实实验室
creators.bio_zh: Meta 的 AI 研究（FAIR）与 Reality Labs 团队；在三维资产方面发布了 Meta 3D Gen、SAM 3D Objects 与 Body、ShapeR 以及 Meta Motivo 人形模型。
creators.why_zh: 既做生成模型，也做承载生成资产的头显（Quest）。

creators.name: Microsoft
creators.bio: Microsoft Research released TRELLIS (2024) and TRELLIS.2 (2025), MIT-licensed 3D generators built on structured 3D latents.
creators.why: Its open TRELLIS models are among the most downloaded 3D generators and a common base for community pipelines.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院
creators.bio_zh: 微软研究院发布了 TRELLIS（2024）和 TRELLIS.2（2025），两者都是基于结构化三维潜变量、采用 MIT 许可的三维生成模型。
creators.why_zh: 开源的 TRELLIS 系列是下载量最高的三维生成模型之一，也是许多社区流程的基础。

creators.name: Tencent Hunyuan
creators.bio: Tencent's Hunyuan team releases open and closed models across text, image, video, 3D (Hunyuan3D 1.0 to 3.x, HY 3D Studio) and motion (HY-Motion).
creators.why: Its open Hunyuan3D models are among the most used 3D generators worldwide, and HY-Motion scaled text-to-motion to a billion parameters.
creators.role_zh: 腾讯的基础模型团队
creators.bio_zh: 腾讯混元团队发布覆盖文本、图像、视频、三维（混元3D 1.0 至 3.x、HY 3D Studio）和动作（HY-Motion）的开源与闭源模型。
creators.why_zh: 开源的混元3D 模型是全球使用最多的三维生成模型之一，HY-Motion 则把文生动作扩展到十亿参数规模。

creators.name: Adobe
creators.bio: Maker of Photoshop and Substance 3D; Adobe Research co-authored LRM, the first large reconstruction model for single-image 3D.
creators.why: LRM set the feed-forward template that most fast image-to-3D systems follow.
creators.role_zh: 创意软件公司（Adobe 研究院）
creators.bio_zh: Photoshop 和 Substance 3D 的开发商；Adobe 研究院参与了 LRM，这是首个用于单张图像三维重建的大型重建模型。
creators.why_zh: LRM 奠定了如今多数快速图生三维系统沿用的前馈式模板。

creators.name: Anything World
creators.bio: Company offering automatic rigging and animation for arbitrary 3D models, including animals and vehicles, through a web app and game-engine plugins.
creators.why: Extends auto-animation beyond humanoid characters, which a populated scene needs.
creators.role_zh: AI 绑定与动画公司
creators.bio_zh: 为任意三维模型（包括动物和交通工具）提供自动绑定与动画的公司，提供网页应用和游戏引擎插件。
creators.why_zh: 把自动动画扩展到人形角色之外，这正是一个有生气的场景所需要的。

creators.name: DeepMotion
creators.bio: Company known for markerless motion capture from video (Animate 3D) and SayMotion, a text-to-3D-animation tool.
creators.why: One of the first commercial text-to-motion products aimed at animators and game developers.
creators.role_zh: AI 动作捕捉与动画公司
creators.bio_zh: 以基于视频的无标记动作捕捉（Animate 3D）和文生三维动画工具 SayMotion 著称。
creators.why_zh: 最早面向动画师和游戏开发者的商用文生动作产品之一。

creators.name: Ben Poole
creators.bio: Google researcher and first author of DreamFusion, which introduced Score Distillation Sampling for text-to-3D.
creators.why: His score distillation method underlies most optimization-based 3D and 4D generation that followed.
creators.role_zh: 谷歌研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 谷歌研究员，DreamFusion 第一作者，该论文提出了用于文生三维的分数蒸馏采样（SDS）。
creators.why_zh: 他的分数蒸馏方法是此后大多数基于优化的三维与 4D 生成的基础。

creators.name: Ruoshi Liu
creators.bio: Columbia University researcher (with Carl Vondrick's lab and Toyota Research Institute) and first author of Zero-1-to-3.
creators.why: Showed how to turn a 2D diffusion model into a camera-controllable view generator for single-image 3D.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 哥伦比亚大学研究者（Carl Vondrick 实验室，与丰田研究院合作），Zero-1-to-3 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 展示了如何把二维扩散模型变成可控视角的视图生成器，用于单张图像生成三维。

creators.name: Yicong Hong
creators.bio: Researcher at Adobe Research and first author of LRM: Large Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D (ICLR 2024).
creators.why: LRM made single-image 3D a seconds-long feed-forward step.
creators.role_zh: Adobe 研究院研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Adobe 研究院研究员，《LRM：用于单张图像三维重建的大型重建模型》（ICLR 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: LRM 让单图生成三维变成只需几秒的前馈步骤。

creators.name: Jiaxiang Tang
creators.bio: Peking University researcher and first author of DreamGaussian (ICLR 2024 oral), an early generative use of 3D Gaussian splatting.
creators.why: Cut optimization-based text/image-to-3D from hours to minutes.
creators.role_zh: 北京大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 北京大学研究者，DreamGaussian（ICLR 2024 口头报告）第一作者，是较早把三维高斯泼溅用于生成的工作。
creators.why_zh: 把基于优化的文生 / 图生三维从数小时缩短到几分钟。

creators.name: Longwen Zhang
creators.bio: First author of CLAY (SIGGRAPH 2024), the 3D-native generative model that became Rodin Gen-1.
creators.why: Helped establish training on native 3D data as the recipe for production-grade asset generation.
creators.role_zh: 上海科技大学 / 影眸科技研究者
creators.bio_zh: CLAY（SIGGRAPH 2024）第一作者，该原生三维生成模型后来成为 Rodin Gen-1。
creators.why_zh: 推动了以原生三维数据训练作为生产级资产生成的主流做法。

creators.name: Zhan Xu
creators.bio: First author of RigNet (SIGGRAPH 2020), done at UMass Amherst with Evangelos Kalogerakis.
creators.why: The first learned auto-rigging method for diverse articulated characters.
creators.role_zh: 研究者（马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校，后加入 Adobe）
creators.bio_zh: RigNet（SIGGRAPH 2020）第一作者，该工作完成于马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校 Evangelos Kalogerakis 团队。
creators.why_zh: 首个面向多样关节角色的学习式自动绑定方法。

creators.name: Zhiyang Guo
creators.role: PhD researcher, University of Science and Technology of China
creators.bio: First author of Make-It-Animatable (CVPR 2025), which rigs humanoid meshes and Gaussian splats in under a second.
creators.why: Sub-second rigging lets generated characters move as soon as they are created.
creators.role_zh: 中国科学技术大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Make-It-Animatable（CVPR 2025）第一作者，可在一秒内为人形网格和高斯泼溅完成绑定。
creators.why_zh: 亚秒级绑定让生成的角色一出现就能动起来。

creators.name: Jia-Peng Zhang
creators.bio: Tsinghua University researcher and first author of UniRig (SIGGRAPH 2025), developed with VAST.
creators.why: UniRig rigs humans, animals and other creatures with one model.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 清华大学研究者，与 VAST 合作的 UniRig（SIGGRAPH 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: UniRig 用一个模型为人类、动物和其他生物完成绑定。

creators.name: Chaoyue Song
creators.bio: NTU researcher and first author of Puppeteer (NeurIPS 2025 spotlight) and MagicArticulate, developed with ByteDance Seed.
creators.why: Works on turning static generated models into rigged, animated assets.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学研究者，与字节跳动 Seed 合作的 Puppeteer（NeurIPS 2025 亮点论文）和 MagicArticulate 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何把静态的生成模型变成已绑定、可动画的资产。

creators.name: Chuan Guo
creators.bio: Researcher (University of Alberta, later industry) who created the HumanML3D dataset (CVPR 2022) and MoMask (CVPR 2024).
creators.why: HumanML3D is the benchmark that most text-to-motion models are trained and scored on.
creators.role_zh: 人体动作生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者（阿尔伯塔大学，后进入业界），创建了 HumanML3D 数据集（CVPR 2022）和 MoMask（CVPR 2024）。
creators.why_zh: HumanML3D 是大多数文生动作模型训练与评测所用的基准。

creators.name: Guy Tevet
creators.bio: Tel Aviv University researcher (with Amit Bermano and Daniel Cohen-Or) and first author of the Human Motion Diffusion Model (MDM, ICLR 2023).
creators.why: MDM made diffusion the default approach for generating and editing human motion.
creators.role_zh: 特拉维夫大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 特拉维夫大学研究者（与 Amit Bermano、Daniel Cohen-Or 合作），人体动作扩散模型 MDM（ICLR 2023）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: MDM 让扩散模型成为生成和编辑人体动作的默认方法。

creators.name: Jonathan Tseng
creators.bio: Stanford researcher (with C. Karen Liu) and first author of EDGE, editable dance generation from music (CVPR 2023).
creators.why: Showed audio-driven full-body generation with editable constraints.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者（与 C. Karen Liu 合作），由音乐生成可编辑舞蹈的 EDGE（CVPR 2023）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 展示了可加编辑约束、由音频驱动的全身动作生成。

creators.name: Biao Jiang
creators.bio: Fudan University researcher and first author of MotionGPT (NeurIPS 2023), developed with Tencent.
creators.why: Put motion and language in one token stream.
creators.role_zh: 复旦大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 复旦大学研究者，与腾讯合作的 MotionGPT（NeurIPS 2023）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把动作和语言放进同一个 token 序列。

creators.name: Chen Tessler
creators.bio: NVIDIA research scientist working on physics-based character control; first author of MaskedMimic (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024) and maintainer of ProtoMotions.
creators.why: Brings unified, physically simulated humanoid controllers within reach of interactive applications.
creators.role_zh: 英伟达研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达研究科学家，研究基于物理的角色控制；MaskedMimic（SIGGRAPH Asia 2024）第一作者，并维护 ProtoMotions。
creators.why_zh: 让统一的、物理仿真的人形控制器可以用于交互应用。

creators.name: Kaifeng Zhao
creators.bio: ETH Zürich researcher (with Siyu Tang) and first author of ARDY (SIGGRAPH 2026), developed at NVIDIA.
creators.why: ARDY generates steerable human motion in real time.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院研究者（与 Siyu Tang 合作），在英伟达完成的 ARDY（SIGGRAPH 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: ARDY 能实时生成可随时操控的人体动作。

creators.name: xAI (SpaceXSI)
creators.role: AI company behind Grok; its 2026 pages carry the SpaceXSI name
creators.bio: xAI develops the Grok models and the Grok Voice speech-to-speech and transcription APIs.
creators.why: Grok Voice runs at scale in Tesla cars and Starlink support lines, a rare public account of voice agents in daily use.
creators.role_zh: Grok 背后的 AI 公司；其 2026 年的页面使用 SpaceXSI 名称
creators.bio_zh: xAI 开发 Grok 系列模型，以及 Grok Voice 语音到语音与语音转写 API。
creators.why_zh: Grok Voice 已大规模用于特斯拉汽车和 Starlink 客服热线，是语音智能体日常使用情况少有的公开记录。

creators.name: Mirelo
creators.role: Audio AI company making video-to-sound models
creators.bio: Mirelo builds generative models that add sound effects, foley and ambience to video, offered through a studio, an API and editor plugins.
creators.why: It treats the sound of generated video as a separate model layer that can be replaced without regenerating the picture.
creators.role_zh: 制作视频生成音效模型的音频 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: Mirelo 开发为视频添加音效、拟音与环境声的生成模型，通过在线工作室、API 和剪辑软件插件提供。
creators.why_zh: 它把生成视频的声音当作独立的模型层，无需重新生成画面就能替换。

creators.name: Fish Audio
creators.bio: Fish Audio runs a text-to-speech and voice-cloning platform and publishes open-weight TTS models, from Fish Speech to Drama 3.
creators.why: Its open multi-speaker models let a lab run expressive character voices on its own hardware and pin a version.
creators.role_zh: 语音 AI 公司（Hanabi AI Inc.）
creators.bio_zh: Fish Audio 运营语音合成与声音克隆平台，并发布开源权重的语音合成模型，从 Fish Speech 到 Drama 3。
creators.why_zh: 它的开源多说话人模型让实验室可以在自己的硬件上运行富有表现力的角色声音，并固定使用某一版本。

creators.name: Duowen Chen
creators.bio: Duowen Chen works on simulation and sound for generated 3D worlds in Bo Zhu's group at the Georgia Institute of Technology.
creators.why: First author of Audible World Models, which anchors generated sounds to the geometry of generated 3D worlds.
creators.role_zh: 仿真与图形学研究者（佐治亚理工学院）
creators.bio_zh: Duowen Chen 在佐治亚理工学院 Bo Zhu 课题组研究生成式三维世界中的仿真与声音。
creators.why_zh: Audible World Models 的第一作者，该方法把生成的声音锚定在生成三维世界的几何结构上。

creators.name: Pengjun Fang
creators.role: Audio generation researcher (HKUST and Noiz AI)
creators.bio: Pengjun Fang works on video-to-audio generation at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology and the start-up Noiz AI.
creators.why: First author of WorldSonus, a streaming video-to-stereo-audio model built for interactive world models.
creators.role_zh: 音频生成研究者（香港科技大学与 Noiz AI）
creators.bio_zh: Pengjun Fang 在香港科技大学和初创公司 Noiz AI 研究视频到音频的生成。
creators.why_zh: WorldSonus 的第一作者，这是一个为交互式世界模型设计的流式视频生成立体声模型。

creators.name: Zitong Lan
creators.role: Acoustics and spatial audio researcher (University of Pennsylvania)
creators.bio: Zitong Lan works on acoustic simulation and spatial audio in Mingmin Zhao's group at the University of Pennsylvania.
creators.why: First author of OmniDream, which turns a silent video into a 360° scene with spatially aligned sound.
creators.role_zh: 声学与空间音频研究者（宾夕法尼亚大学）
creators.bio_zh: Zitong Lan 在宾夕法尼亚大学 Mingmin Zhao 课题组研究声学仿真与空间音频。
creators.why_zh: OmniDream 的第一作者，该方法把无声视频变成声音与画面空间对齐的 360° 场景。

creators.name: Hanmo Chen
creators.role: Video-audio generation researcher (Xidian University and vivo BlueImage Lab)
creators.bio: Hanmo Chen works on joint video-audio generation at Xidian University and vivo's BlueImage Lab.
creators.why: First author of StereoBind, which makes the stereo position of generated sound follow its moving source on screen.
creators.role_zh: 音视频联合生成研究者（西安电子科技大学与 vivo 蓝图影像实验室）
creators.bio_zh: Hanmo Chen 在西安电子科技大学和 vivo 蓝图影像实验室研究音视频联合生成。
creators.why_zh: StereoBind 的第一作者，该方法让生成声音的立体声位置跟随画面中移动的声源。

creators.name: Ryu Furusawa
creators.bio: Ryu Furusawa is a Japanese video artist who restructures recorded footage in time and space.
creators.why: His installation Passing drives a real-time video-to-audio model from a live, viewer-responsive video stream.
creators.role_zh: 影像艺术家
creators.bio_zh: Ryu Furusawa 是日本影像艺术家，擅长在时间与空间上重组拍摄的影像。
creators.why_zh: 他的装置作品 Passing 用一段随观众在场而变化的实时影像流来驱动实时视频生成音频模型。

creators.name: Gradium
creators.role: Voice AI company founded by Kyutai's Moshi researchers
