creators.bio: Gradium sells streaming speech synthesis, recognition, translation and voice design for voice agents; it raised a $100M seed by July 2026.
creators.why: It shows the authors of the first open full-duplex model turning to production voice infrastructure.
creators.role_zh: 由 Kyutai 的 Moshi 研究者创立的语音 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: Gradium 为语音智能体提供流式语音合成、语音识别、翻译与声音设计；到 2026 年 7 月其种子轮融资达到 1 亿美元。
creators.why_zh: 它表明第一个开源全双工模型的作者们转向了面向生产的语音基础设施。

creators.name: Sony Group
creators.role: Electronics and entertainment group (Sony AI, Creative AI Lab)
creators.bio: Sony's Creative AI Lab researches generative audio, including sound-effect and video-to-audio models such as SpecMaskFoley.
creators.why: It brings audio generation research into artworks and production tools.
creators.role_zh: 电子与娱乐集团（Sony AI、Creative AI Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 索尼的 Creative AI Lab 研究生成式音频，包括音效生成和 SpecMaskFoley 等视频生成音频模型。
creators.why_zh: 它把音频生成研究带进艺术作品和制作工具。

creators.name: Ant Group
creators.bio: Ant Group, the operator of Alipay, publishes open AI models under its inclusionAI organisation, including the Realtime-Venus full-duplex interaction models (2026); its embodied-AI unit is Robbyant.
creators.why: Realtime-Venus is one of the open conversational models that keep listening while they talk and delegate tasks in the background.
creators.role_zh: 中国金融科技与人工智能公司（支付宝）
creators.bio_zh: 蚂蚁集团是支付宝的运营方，通过 inclusionAI 组织发布开源 AI 模型，其中包括 2026 年的 Realtime-Venus 全双工交互模型；其具身智能业务为 Robbyant。
creators.why_zh: Realtime-Venus 是一类开源对话模型的代表：边说边听，并把任务交给后台执行。

creators.name: Cheng-Kuang Chang
creators.bio: Cheng-Kuang Chang is first author of D2 (2026), which converts turn-based spoken language models into full-duplex ones, written at MIT CSAIL with the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab.
creators.why: D2 shows how to add duplex timing to a capable existing voice model instead of training one from scratch.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院 CSAIL 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Cheng-Kuang Chang 是 D2（2026）的第一作者。该工作在麻省理工学院 CSAIL 与 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab 合作完成，把回合制口语语言模型转换为全双工模型。
creators.why_zh: D2 展示了如何给已有的强语音模型加上双工时序，而不必从头训练。

creators.name: Zhuo Ning
creators.bio: Zhuo Ning is first author of Soundwich (2026), written at Simon Fraser University with Ali Mahdavi-Amiri, Daniel Cohen-Or and colleagues from Tel Aviv University and CYENS.
creators.why: Soundwich turns the single soundtrack of joint audio-video models into separate, editable stems.
creators.role_zh: 西蒙弗雷泽大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Zhuo Ning 是 Soundwich（2026）的第一作者。该工作在西蒙弗雷泽大学完成，合作者包括 Ali Mahdavi-Amiri、Daniel Cohen-Or 以及特拉维夫大学和 CYENS 的研究者。
creators.why_zh: Soundwich 把音视频联合模型的单一混音拆成可分别编辑的多条音轨。
creators.based_zh: 加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省本拿比

creators.name: Aviad Dahan
creators.bio: Aviad Dahan is first author of SepGen (2026), a multi-stem audio-video generation and separation model from Tel Aviv University with Lior Wolf, Raja Giryes and Google researchers.
creators.why: SepGen produces one audio track per sound source, which spatial audio rendering of generated scenes needs.
creators.role_zh: 特拉维夫大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Aviad Dahan 是 SepGen（2026）的第一作者。该工作来自特拉维夫大学，合作者包括 Lior Wolf、Raja Giryes 和谷歌的研究者，是一个多音轨音视频生成与分离模型。
creators.why_zh: SepGen 为每个声源输出单独的音轨，这是为生成场景渲染空间音频所需要的。

creators.name: Kyutai
creators.bio: Kyutai is a Paris non-profit research lab funded by Iliad, CMA CGM and Schmidt Sciences that releases its speech models openly.
creators.why: It built Moshi, the first openly released full-duplex voice model, and the Mimi codec many later voice models reuse.
creators.role_zh: 非营利开放科学 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: Kyutai 是位于巴黎的非营利研究实验室，由 Iliad、CMA CGM 与 Schmidt Sciences 资助，语音模型均公开发布。
creators.why_zh: 它做出了第一个公开发布的全双工语音模型 Moshi，以及被后来许多语音模型沿用的 Mimi 编解码器。

creators.name: Sesame
creators.bio: Sesame, co-founded by Oculus co-founder Brendan Iribe, builds conversational voice agents and the Conversational Speech Model (CSM), with eyewear announced.
creators.why: Its Maya and Miles demo set a public reference point for 'voice presence' in conversational speech.
creators.role_zh: 语音 AI 与硬件公司
creators.bio_zh: Sesame 由 Oculus 联合创始人 Brendan Iribe 参与创立，开发对话式语音智能体与对话语音模型 CSM，并已宣布眼镜产品。
creators.why_zh: 它的 Maya 与 Miles 演示成为对话语音“临场感”的公共参照。

creators.name: Hume AI
creators.role: Voice AI, expression-measurement and evaluation company
creators.bio: Hume AI builds the Empathic Voice Interface (EVI), the Octave text-to-speech models and the open-source TADA model; in 2026 it leads with Expression APIs (600+ dimensions of expression in 50+ languages) and tools and benchmarks for evaluating real-world voice AI, including RW-Voice-EQ Bench.
creators.why: Its models treat emotion and delivery as first-class outputs, and its measurement tools can score how a virtual interlocutor or a participant actually sounds.
creators.role_zh: 语音 AI、表达测量与评测公司
creators.bio_zh: Hume AI 开发共情语音接口 EVI、Octave 语音合成模型以及开源的 TADA 模型；2026 年其主打表达测量 API（50 多种语言、600 多个表达维度），以及用于评测真实场景语音 AI 的工具与基准，包括 RW-Voice-EQ Bench。
creators.why_zh: 它的模型把情绪与语气当作首要输出，其测量工具还能评估虚拟对话者或参与者实际听起来是什么状态。

creators.name: Alibaba Tongyi (Qwen)
creators.role: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab and Qwen team
creators.bio: Alibaba's Tongyi Lab develops the Qwen model family, the Wan video models and the Fun-Audio / CosyVoice speech models, many released as open weights.
creators.why: Qwen-Omni models are among the strongest open speech-in, speech-out models a lab can host.
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室与 Qwen 团队
creators.bio_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室开发千问 Qwen 系列、万相 Wan 视频模型以及 Fun-Audio / CosyVoice 语音模型，其中许多以开源权重发布。
creators.why_zh: Qwen-Omni 是实验室可以自行部署的最强开源“语音进、语音出”模型之一。

creators.name: OpenBMB
creators.role: Open-source model community of ModelBest and Tsinghua NLP
creators.bio: OpenBMB is the open-source effort behind the MiniCPM models, led by ModelBest with Tsinghua University's NLP lab.
creators.why: Its MiniCPM-o models bring full-duplex audio-visual interaction to devices small enough to run locally.
creators.role_zh: 面壁智能与清华 NLP 实验室的开源模型社区
creators.bio_zh: OpenBMB 是 MiniCPM 系列模型背后的开源项目，由面壁智能与清华大学自然语言处理实验室主导。
creators.why_zh: 它的 MiniCPM-o 模型把全双工视听交互带到可以本地运行的小型设备上。

creators.name: StepFun
creators.bio: StepFun develops the Step series of language, multimodal and audio models and open-sources several of them.
creators.why: Step-Audio 2 is an open-weight end-to-end speech model that listens for emotion and paralinguistic cues.
creators.role_zh: 中国基础模型公司
creators.bio_zh: 阶跃星辰开发 Step 系列语言、多模态与音频模型，并开源了其中多款。
creators.why_zh: Step-Audio 2 是能识别情绪与副语言线索的开源端到端语音模型。

creators.name: Amazon
creators.bio: Amazon develops the Nova foundation models, served on AWS Bedrock.
creators.why: Nova Sonic puts speech-to-speech agents into the cloud many institutions already use.
creators.role_zh: 亚马逊（AWS 与 Amazon AGI）
creators.bio_zh: 亚马逊开发 Nova 系列基础模型，在 AWS Bedrock 上提供服务。
creators.why_zh: Nova Sonic 把语音到语音智能体放进了许多机构已在使用的云平台。

creators.name: ElevenLabs
creators.bio: ElevenLabs builds text-to-speech, voice cloning, conversational agents, sound effects and music models used widely in media production.
creators.why: Its expressive TTS and music models are a default source of voiced and scored stimuli.
creators.role_zh: AI 音频公司
creators.bio_zh: ElevenLabs 开发语音合成、声音克隆、对话智能体、音效与音乐模型，在媒体制作中被广泛使用。
creators.why_zh: 它的富表现力语音合成与音乐模型是配音与配乐素材的常用来源。

creators.name: bilibili
creators.bio: bilibili is a Chinese video community whose Index team develops the open IndexTTS speech models.
creators.why: IndexTTS2 adds exact duration control to expressive voice cloning, which dubbing and synced scenes need.
creators.role_zh: 中国视频平台（Index 团队）
creators.bio_zh: 哔哩哔哩是中国视频社区，其 Index 团队开发开源的 IndexTTS 语音模型。
creators.why_zh: IndexTTS2 在富表现力的声音克隆上加入了精确时长控制，这正是配音与同步场景所需要的。

creators.name: Suno
creators.bio: Suno makes a widely used song generator that writes and sings complete tracks from a prompt.
creators.why: It shows how far consumer music generation has gone, including singing in a user's own voice.
creators.role_zh: AI 音乐公司
creators.bio_zh: Suno 打造了被广泛使用的歌曲生成器，能根据提示写出并演唱完整歌曲。
creators.why_zh: 它展示了面向大众的音乐生成已经走到哪里，包括用用户自己的声音演唱。

creators.name: Tu Anh Nguyen
creators.bio: Tu Anh Nguyen worked on textless spoken language modelling at Meta AI and the Cognitive Machine Learning team in Paris.
creators.why: First author of dGSLM, the first model to generate natural two-channel spoken dialogue.
creators.role_zh: 语音研究者（Meta AI / ENS–Inria）
creators.bio_zh: Tu Anh Nguyen 在 Meta AI 与巴黎认知机器学习团队从事无文本口语语言建模研究。
creators.why_zh: dGSLM 的第一作者，该模型首次生成自然的双声道口语对话。

creators.name: Ho Kei Cheng
creators.bio: Ho Kei (Rex) Cheng is a researcher known for video object segmentation (XMem, Cutie) and the MMAudio video-to-audio model, developed with Sony AI.
creators.why: First author of MMAudio, the open baseline for adding synchronized sound to silent video.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉研究者（伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校）
creators.bio_zh: Ho Kei（Rex）Cheng 以视频目标分割（XMem、Cutie）以及与 Sony AI 合作开发的 MMAudio 视频配音模型而知名。
creators.why_zh: MMAudio 的第一作者，该模型是为无声视频添加同步声音的开源基线。

creators.name: Jaeyeon Kim
creators.bio: Jaeyeon Kim researches audio-visual generation at Seoul National University's Vision and Learning Lab.
creators.why: First author of ViSAGe, which generates ambisonic sound from video and camera direction.
creators.role_zh: 视听学习研究者（首尔大学）
creators.bio_zh: Jaeyeon Kim 在首尔大学视觉与学习实验室研究视听生成。
creators.why_zh: ViSAGe 的第一作者，该方法根据视频与镜头方向生成全景声。

creators.name: Huadai Liu
creators.bio: Huadai Liu researches text-, video- and spatial-audio generation at Zhejiang University.
creators.why: First author of OmniAudio, which generates spatial audio for 360° video.
creators.role_zh: 音频生成研究者（浙江大学）
creators.bio_zh: Huadai Liu 在浙江大学研究文本、视频与空间音频的生成。
creators.why_zh: OmniAudio 的第一作者，该方法为 360° 视频生成空间音频。

creators.name: Xudong Xu
creators.bio: Xudong Xu works on audio-visual learning and 3D-aware generation; Sounding Bodies was developed with Meta Reality Labs Research.
creators.why: First author of Sounding Bodies, which renders the 3D sound field of a human body from headset audio and pose.
creators.role_zh: 视听学习研究者
creators.bio_zh: Xudong Xu 研究视听学习与三维感知生成；Sounding Bodies 与 Meta Reality Labs Research 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: Sounding Bodies 的第一作者，该方法根据头显音频与身体姿态渲染人体的三维声场。

creators.name: Peiwen Sun
creators.bio: Peiwen Sun researches language-driven audio generation at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology.
creators.why: First author of Both Ears Wide Open, which generates binaural audio whose sources follow a text description.
creators.role_zh: 空间音频生成研究者（香港科技大学）
creators.bio_zh: Peiwen Sun 在香港科技大学研究语言驱动的音频生成。
creators.why_zh: Both Ears Wide Open 的第一作者，该方法生成声源位置随文字描述变化的双耳音频。

creators.name: Yu Zhang
creators.bio: Yu Zhang is first author of EmbodiedHead (ECCV 2026), a real-time listening and speaking head for LLM agents, from the School of Computer Science and Technology at East China Normal University.
creators.why: EmbodiedHead is an inspectable academic baseline for an LLM face that stays quiet but attentive while the user talks.
creators.role_zh: 华东师范大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Yu Zhang 是 EmbodiedHead（ECCV 2026）的第一作者。该工作来自华东师范大学计算机科学与技术学院，为大模型智能体提供可实时倾听和说话的头部虚拟人。
creators.why_zh: EmbodiedHead 是一个可检视的学术基线：用户说话时，大模型的脸保持安静但专注。

creators.name: Kartik Teotia
creators.role: Researcher, Max Planck Institute for Informatics
creators.bio: Kartik Teotia works on conversational 3D head avatars in Christian Theobalt's group at the Max Planck Institute for Informatics and is first author of STEER (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026).
creators.why: STEER turns gaze, head rhythm and emotion of a listening avatar into explicit, editable controls.
creators.role_zh: 马克斯·普朗克信息学研究所研究者
creators.bio_zh: Kartik Teotia 在马克斯·普朗克信息学研究所 Christian Theobalt 团队研究对话式三维头部化身，是 STEER（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: STEER 把倾听中虚拟人的视线、头部节奏和情绪变成可显式编辑的控制量。

creators.name: Chengqian Ma
creators.bio: Chengqian Ma is first author of Motion-Omni (2026), an open spoken dialogue model that generates speech together with face, hand and full-body motion.
creators.why: Motion-Omni makes a conversational agent's body language come out of the same model that decides what to say.
creators.role_zh: 北京大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Chengqian Ma 是 Motion-Omni（2026）的第一作者。这是一个开源的语音对话模型，可在生成语音的同时生成面部、手部和全身动作。
creators.why_zh: Motion-Omni 让对话智能体的肢体语言与“说什么”出自同一个模型。

creators.name: Kim Youwang
creators.bio: Kim Youwang is a PhD researcher at POSTECH and first author of FiCA (2026), done while interning at Meta's Codec Avatars Lab, which builds a drivable Gaussian Codec Avatar from one portrait photo.
creators.why: FiCA brings Codec-Avatar-quality 3D heads within reach of a single selfie.
creators.role_zh: POSTECH 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Kim Youwang 是 POSTECH 的博士研究者，FiCA（2026）的第一作者。该工作在 Meta Codec Avatars 实验室实习期间完成，可从一张人像照片生成可驱动的高斯 Codec Avatar。
creators.why_zh: FiCA 让 Codec Avatar 级别的三维头部只需一张自拍即可获得。

creators.name: Zikai Liao
creators.bio: Zikai Liao is first author of GLARE (NeurIPS 2026), a listening-head dataset and model from Stony Brook University and Atmanity Inc.
creators.why: GLARE labels when and how a listener reacts, so listener behaviour can be generated and scored as reactions rather than as pixels.
creators.role_zh: 石溪大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Zikai Liao 是 GLARE（NeurIPS 2026）的第一作者。该工作来自石溪大学与 Atmanity Inc.，提供倾听头像的数据集与模型。
creators.why_zh: GLARE 标注了倾听者何时以及如何反应，使倾听行为能以“反应”而不是像素来生成和评估。

creators.name: Jingjing Jiang
creators.bio: Jingjing Jiang is first author of Moshi-Face (Interspeech 2026) at the Graduate School of Informatics, Nagoya University, in Ryuichiro Higashinaka's dialogue systems group.
creators.why: Moshi-Face is the first published full-duplex dialogue model that also reads and generates a face.
creators.role_zh: 名古屋大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Jingjing Jiang 是 Moshi-Face（Interspeech 2026）的第一作者，来自名古屋大学信息学研究科东中龙一郎（Ryuichiro Higashinaka）的对话系统团队。
creators.why_zh: Moshi-Face 是首个公开发表、同时能读取和生成面部的全双工对话模型。

creators.name: Koji Inoue
creators.bio: Koji Inoue studies spoken dialogue and listening behaviour (backchannels, turn-taking, nodding) for conversational robots and avatars in Tatsuya Kawahara's lab at Kyoto University.
creators.why: His real-time backchannel and nodding models, and a 2026 user study, test whether listening behaviour changes how present an AI clone feels.
creators.role_zh: 京都大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Koji Inoue 在京都大学河原达也（Tatsuya Kawahara）实验室研究对话机器人与虚拟人的语音对话和倾听行为（附和、话轮转换、点头）。
creators.why_zh: 他的实时附和与点头模型以及 2026 年的一项用户研究，检验了倾听行为是否会改变人们对 AI 分身临场感的感受。

creators.name: Cong Wei
creators.bio: Cong Wei is a PhD researcher at the University of Waterloo and first author of MoCha (2025), developed with Meta's GenAI team, which generates movie-style talking characters, including conversations between two characters, from speech and text.
creators.why: MoCha moved audio-driven video from a single talking head to scripted multi-character scenes.
creators.role_zh: 滑铁卢大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Cong Wei 是滑铁卢大学的博士研究者，MoCha（2025）的第一作者。该工作与 Meta GenAI 团队合作完成，可根据语音和文本生成电影风格的说话角色，包括两个角色之间的对话。
creators.why_zh: MoCha 把音频驱动视频从单个说话头像推进到多角色的剧本化场景。

creators.name: Chong Bao
creators.role: Researcher, Zhejiang University (State Key Lab of CAD&CG)
creators.bio: Chong Bao is a researcher at Zhejiang University's State Key Lab of CAD&CG and first author of Archon (CVPR 2026), a unified multimodal model for digital humans built with Google and Google DeepMind.
creators.why: Archon generates a digital human's script, speech, animation and video from one model, so a character can be specified once and edited in any modality.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学 CAD&CG 国家重点实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: Chong Bao 是浙江大学 CAD&CG 国家重点实验室的研究者，Archon（CVPR 2026）的第一作者；该统一多模态数字人模型与 Google 和 Google DeepMind 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: Archon 用一个模型生成数字人的台词、语音、动画和视频，因此只需设定一次角色，就能在任意模态中编辑。

creators.name: Siyin Wang
creators.bio: Siyin Wang is a PhD researcher in Chao Zhang's group at Tsinghua University and first author of ELLSA 2 (2026), a full-duplex dialogue model built with ByteDance on the SALMONN-omni line that also generates gestures and facial expressions.
creators.why: ELLSA 2 makes a voice agent's body keep reacting while it listens, inside the same full-duplex model that decides when to speak.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Siyin Wang 是清华大学张超团队的博士研究者，ELLSA 2（2026）的第一作者。该模型与字节跳动合作，基于 SALMONN-omni 系列构建，是一个同时生成手势和面部表情的全双工对话模型。
creators.why_zh: ELLSA 2 让语音智能体在倾听时身体仍持续做出反应，而决定何时开口的也是同一个全双工模型。

creators.name: Ziyi Liu
creators.bio: Ziyi Liu is a PhD researcher at Purdue University and first author of AgentHands (CHI 2026), done with Google XR, which gives an XR conversational agent hands that gesture at real objects in sync with its speech.
creators.why: AgentHands shows how an agent's nonverbal behaviour can be grounded in the participant's physical surroundings, not only in a rendered face.
creators.role_zh: 普渡大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Ziyi Liu 是普渡大学的博士研究者，AgentHands（CHI 2026）的第一作者。该工作与 Google XR 合作完成，为 XR 对话智能体配上一双与语音同步、指向真实物体的手。
creators.why_zh: AgentHands 展示了智能体的非语言行为可以扎根于参与者的真实物理环境，而不只是一张渲染出来的脸。

creators.name: Yu Han
creators.bio: Yu Han is first author of FaceGAN ('No Distillation Needed', 2026), a single-pass real-time talking-head model from Meta Reality Labs written with Alexander Richard, Wojciech Zielonka and Michael Zollhoefer.
creators.why: FaceGAN argues that a responsive audio-driven face does not need a distilled diffusion model.
creators.role_zh: Meta Reality Labs 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Yu Han 是 FaceGAN（《No Distillation Needed》，2026）的第一作者。该工作来自 Meta Reality Labs，是一个单次前向的实时说话头像模型，合作者包括 Alexander Richard、Wojciech Zielonka 和 Michael Zollhoefer。
creators.why_zh: FaceGAN 认为，一张能及时回应的音频驱动面孔并不需要蒸馏扩散模型。

creators.name: Koki Nagano
creators.bio: Koki Nagano works on digital humans at NVIDIA Research and is joint first author of DyaPlex (NeurIPS 2026), a full-duplex speech-and-motion model for two-person interaction.
creators.why: DyaPlex couples a full-duplex voice with listening and gesturing behaviour in one streaming model.
creators.role_zh: 英伟达研究院研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Koki Nagano 在英伟达研究院从事数字人研究，是 DyaPlex（NeurIPS 2026）的共同第一作者；DyaPlex 是面向双人互动的全双工语音与动作模型。
creators.why_zh: DyaPlex 在一个流式模型里把全双工语音与倾听、手势行为结合起来。

creators.name: Hezhen Hu
creators.role: Researcher, The University of Texas at Austin
creators.bio: Hezhen Hu is first author of HumanNOVA (CVPR 2026 Highlight), a feed-forward model that builds a 3D human avatar from one photo, with Georgios Pavlakos and Zhangyang Wang at UT Austin.
creators.why: HumanNOVA makes a photoreal full-body 3D person from a single image in under a second.
creators.role_zh: 得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校研究者
creators.bio_zh: Hezhen Hu是 HumanNOVA（CVPR 2026 Highlight）的第一作者，与得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的 Georgios Pavlakos、Zhangyang Wang 合作；HumanNOVA 是一个由单张照片前馈生成三维人体化身的模型。
creators.why_zh: HumanNOVA 能在一秒内由一张照片生成照片级的全身三维人物。
creators.based_zh: 美国得克萨斯州奥斯汀

creators.name: Gavriel Habib
creators.bio: Gavriel Habib is first author of PixReenact (2026), a streaming head-avatar reenactment model from OriginAI written with Dvir Samuel of NVIDIA.
creators.why: PixReenact lets a live performer drive another person's face in real time.
creators.role_zh: OriginAI 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Gavriel Habib 是 PixReenact（2026）的第一作者。该工作来自 OriginAI，合作者包括英伟达的 Dvir Samuel，是一个流式头像重演模型。
creators.why_zh: PixReenact 让真人表演者实时驱动另一张人脸。

creators.name: Simli
creators.bio: Simli sells a speech-to-video API that adds a lip-synced face to real-time voice agents, with plug-ins for LiveKit and Pipecat; in July 2025 it launched Trinity-1, a Gaussian-splat avatar model.
creators.why: A low-cost face layer that voice-agent stacks can plug in, which turns a talking face into a standard part of an interactive scenario.
creators.role_zh: 实时虚拟人 API 公司（Simli AS）
creators.bio_zh: Simli 提供语音转视频 API，为实时语音智能体加上一张口型同步的人脸，并提供 LiveKit 与 Pipecat 插件；2025 年 7 月推出基于高斯泼溅的虚拟人模型 Trinity-1。
creators.why_zh: 它是语音智能体技术栈可以直接接入的低成本“面孔层”，让会说话的面孔成为交互情境中的标准部件。

creators.name: Soul Machines
creators.role: Digital human company with autonomous animation (acquired by AppDirect in 2026)
creators.bio: Soul Machines was founded in 2016 by Mark Sagar and Greg Cross as a spin-out of the University of Auckland's Laboratory for Animate Technologies, home of the BabyX research; it sells Digital People whose faces are animated by a simulated 'Digital Brain'. AppDirect announced on 2026-09-28 that it had acquired the company.
creators.why: The longest-running attempt to drive a conversational face from a model of nervous-system processes rather than from generated video, and a 2026 example of avatar companies being absorbed by platforms.
creators.role_zh: 具备自主动画能力的数字人公司（2026 年被 AppDirect 收购）
creators.bio_zh: Soul Machines 由 Mark Sagar 与 Greg Cross 于 2016 年创立，源自奥克兰大学的 Laboratory for Animate Technologies（BabyX 研究的所在地）；公司出售由模拟“数字大脑”驱动面部动画的 Digital People。AppDirect 于 2026-09-28 宣布收购该公司。
creators.why_zh: 它是持续最久的一种尝试：用对神经系统过程的建模而非视频生成来驱动对话中的面孔；它在 2026 年被收购，也说明虚拟人公司正被平台公司吸收。

creators.name: Cheng Chen
creators.role: Researcher, Nanyang Technological University and A*STAR
creators.bio: Cheng Chen is first author of DiVA (2026), an interactive digital-life simulator built with Ant Group researchers including Hao Ouyang and Yujun Shen; the paper lists NTU, A*STAR's Institute for Infocomm Research and Ant Group as affiliations.
creators.why: DiVA treats a video character as a long-running loop of waiting, acting and returning to stable states rather than as one long clip.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学与新加坡科技研究局（A*STAR）研究者
creators.bio_zh: Cheng Chen 是 DiVA（2026）的第一作者。DiVA 是一个可交互的“数字生命”模拟系统，与蚂蚁集团的 Hao Ouyang、Yujun Shen 等研究者合作完成；论文署名单位为南洋理工大学、A*STAR 信息通信研究院和蚂蚁集团。
creators.why_zh: DiVA 把视频角色看作“等待—行动—回到稳定状态”的长期循环，而不是一段越来越长的视频。

creators.name: Tavus
creators.bio: Tavus builds models for face-to-face AI conversation: Phoenix (rendering), Raven (perception), Sparrow (turn-taking) and, since October 2026, Griffin, a unified full-duplex video-to-video model. Its Conversational Video Interface API and consumer PALs run on these models.
creators.why: Its model line is the clearest commercial trajectory from lip-synced video replies to full-duplex audio-visual humans.
creators.role_zh: 实时对话视频 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: Tavus 开发面对面 AI 对话所需的模型：Phoenix（渲染）、Raven（感知）、Sparrow（轮流发言），以及 2026 年 10 月发布的统一全双工视频到视频模型 Griffin。其对话视频接口（CVI）API 和面向个人用户的 PALs 都基于这些模型。
creators.why_zh: 它的模型序列最清楚地展示了从对口型视频回复走向全双工视听虚拟人的商业路径。

creators.name: HeyGen
creators.bio: HeyGen offers AI avatar video creation and, through LiveAvatar, a real-time avatar streaming API.
creators.why: One of the most widely used avatar platforms, it shows what real-time avatars cost and how they scale in deployment.
creators.role_zh: AI 视频虚拟人平台
creators.bio_zh: HeyGen 提供 AI 虚拟人视频制作，并通过 LiveAvatar 提供实时虚拟人流式 API。
creators.why_zh: 作为使用最广的虚拟人平台之一，它展示了实时虚拟人在部署中的成本与规模。

creators.name: Synthesia
creators.role: Enterprise AI video and avatar platform
creators.bio: Synthesia makes AI avatar videos for corporate training and communication, and in 2026 added real-time Interactive Avatars and the Sessions platform for roleplay and interviews.
creators.why: Its move from scripted training videos to two-way roleplay with avatars is a direct route into training and assessment settings.
creators.role_zh: 企业级 AI 视频与虚拟人平台
creators.bio_zh: Synthesia 为企业培训和内部沟通制作 AI 虚拟人视频，2026 年加入实时交互虚拟人和用于角色扮演与访谈的 Sessions 平台。
creators.why_zh: 它从脚本化培训视频转向与虚拟人双向角色扮演，直接进入了培训与评估场景。

creators.name: D-ID
creators.role: Digital human and visual AI agent company
creators.bio: D-ID animates faces from photos and offers real-time Visual AI Agents; its V4 Expressive avatars (2026) target interactive and scripted use.
creators.why: An early photo-to-talking-head company that now sells real-time conversational agents.
creators.role_zh: 数字人与可视化 AI 智能体公司
creators.bio_zh: D-ID 能让照片中的人脸动起来，并提供实时的可视化 AI 智能体；2026 年推出面向交互与脚本场景的 V4 Expressive 虚拟人。
creators.why_zh: 较早做照片说话头像的公司，如今销售实时对话智能体。

creators.name: Anam
creators.bio: Anam builds the CARA family of real-time avatar diffusion models and an API for face-to-face AI agents.
creators.why: Its CARA models and Director Notes expose how an avatar's performance can be directed while it talks.
creators.role_zh: 实时交互虚拟人公司
creators.bio_zh: Anam 开发 CARA 系列实时虚拟人扩散模型，并提供面对面 AI 智能体的 API。
creators.why_zh: 它的 CARA 模型与 Director Notes 展示了如何在虚拟人说话时指导它的表演。

creators.name: LemonSlice
creators.bio: LemonSlice builds real-time video diffusion models for interactive avatars (LemonSlice-2, 2025; Character World Model-1, 2026) that animate any character from one image.
creators.why: It frames the avatar as a 'character world model' that generates body, hands and scene, not only a face.
creators.role_zh: 交互式虚拟人模型公司
creators.bio_zh: LemonSlice 开发用于交互式虚拟人的实时视频扩散模型（2025 年的 LemonSlice-2、2026 年的 Character World Model-1），可从一张图像驱动任意角色。
creators.why_zh: 它把虚拟人定义为“角色世界模型”：生成的是身体、双手和场景，而不只是一张脸。

creators.name: Character.AI
creators.bio: Character.AI runs a large consumer platform for chatting with AI characters and develops video models (AvatarFX, TalkingMachines) to give them faces.
creators.why: Its scale makes it a test of what happens when millions of people talk to animated characters.
creators.role_zh: 面向大众的 AI 角色平台
creators.bio_zh: Character.AI 运营一个大型 AI 角色聊天平台，并开发视频模型（AvatarFX、TalkingMachines）为角色配上面孔。
creators.why_zh: 它的用户规模让人看到：当数以百万计的人与会动的角色交谈时会发生什么。

creators.name: Hedra
creators.bio: Hedra makes audio-driven character video models (Character-3) and a studio for talking characters.
creators.why: It turned single-image, audio-driven character animation into a widely used creator tool.
creators.role_zh: 生成式角色视频公司
creators.bio_zh: Hedra 开发音频驱动的角色视频模型（Character-3）和制作会说话角色的工作室。
creators.why_zh: 它把单图加音频驱动的角色动画做成了广泛使用的创作工具。

creators.name: Apple
creators.bio: Apple's Vision Pro creates a Persona, a 3D avatar of the wearer reconstructed from a face scan and driven by the headset's sensors.
creators.why: Personas are the most widely shipped photoreal avatars driven live by headset tracking.
creators.role_zh: 消费科技公司
creators.bio_zh: Apple Vision Pro 会为佩戴者生成 Persona：一个由面部扫描重建、由头显传感器驱动的三维化身。
creators.why_zh: Persona 是出货量最大的、由头显追踪实时驱动的照片级化身。

creators.name: Kuaishou
creators.bio: Kuaishou develops the Kling video models and open-sourced LivePortrait; its Kling team also published MIDAS, a real-time autoregressive digital human.
creators.why: LivePortrait became one of the most used open portrait-animation tools.
creators.role_zh: 短视频公司（可灵团队）
creators.bio_zh: 快手开发可灵视频模型并开源了 LivePortrait，其可灵团队还发布了实时自回归数字人模型 MIDAS。
creators.why_zh: LivePortrait 成为使用最多的开源人像动画工具之一。

creators.name: Alibaba Quark
creators.role: Alibaba's Quark / Qwen Applications research team
creators.bio: The Quark team in Alibaba's Qwen Applications Business Group released Live Avatar, a streaming 14B avatar model, with USTC.
creators.why: Live Avatar is an open baseline for real-time, infinite-length avatar streaming that later commercial models compare against.
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴夸克 / 千问应用研究团队
creators.bio_zh: 阿里巴巴千问应用事业群的夸克团队与中国科学技术大学合作发布了 14B 流式虚拟人模型 Live Avatar。
creators.why_zh: Live Avatar 是实时、无限时长虚拟人流式生成的开源基线，后来的商业模型也拿它做对比。

creators.name: Soul AI Lab
creators.role: AI lab of the Soul social app
creators.bio: Soul AI Lab, the research arm of the Soul social platform, open-sourced SoulX-FlashTalk, a 14B real-time streaming avatar model.
creators.why: A social app open-sourcing a real-time avatar model shows where conversational companions are heading.
creators.role_zh: 社交应用 Soul 的 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: Soul AI Lab 是社交平台 Soul 的研究部门，开源了 14B 实时流式虚拟人模型 SoulX-FlashTalk。
creators.why_zh: 一家社交应用开源实时虚拟人模型，说明对话陪伴正在走向何处。

creators.name: Meituan
creators.bio: Meituan's MeiGen team released MultiTalk and InfiniteTalk, open models for audio-driven talking video and dubbing.
creators.why: InfiniteTalk is a widely used open model for long, audio-driven full-body talking video.
creators.role_zh: 科技公司（MeiGen / LongCat 团队）
creators.bio_zh: 美团的 MeiGen 团队发布了 MultiTalk 和 InfiniteTalk，这是用于音频驱动说话视频与配音的开源模型。
creators.why_zh: InfiniteTalk 是被广泛使用的长时音频驱动全身说话视频开源模型。

creators.name: Avaturn Live
creators.bio: Avaturn Live builds real-time interactive avatars and released AVTR-1, an open stack with model weights, renderer and serving backend.
creators.why: AVTR-1 is a rare fully open stack (weights and serving) for real-time avatar conversation.
creators.role_zh: 实时交互虚拟人公司
creators.bio_zh: Avaturn Live 开发实时交互虚拟人，发布了包含模型权重、渲染器和服务后端的开源方案 AVTR-1。
creators.why_zh: AVTR-1 是少见的、从权重到服务都开放的实时虚拟人对话方案。

creators.name: K R Prajwal
creators.role: Researcher in lip sync and speech-driven video
creators.bio: K R Prajwal, then at IIIT Hyderabad, is first author of Wav2Lip (ACM Multimedia 2020).
creators.why: Wav2Lip's lip-sync discriminator became the common baseline and metric (LSE) for talking-face work.
creators.role_zh: 唇形同步与语音驱动视频研究者
creators.bio_zh: K R Prajwal 当时在印度海得拉巴国际信息技术学院（IIIT Hyderabad），是 Wav2Lip（ACM Multimedia 2020）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Wav2Lip 的唇形判别器成为说话人脸研究的通用基线和评价指标（LSE）。

creators.name: Evonne Ng
creators.role: Researcher in dyadic behaviour and gesture generation
creators.bio: Evonne Ng (UC Berkeley, later Meta) led Learning to Listen (CVPR 2022) and Audio2Photoreal (2024), models of how a listener's face and body respond in conversation.
creators.why: Her work treats the listener, not only the speaker, as something to generate.
creators.role_zh: 双人互动行为与手势生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: Evonne Ng（加州大学伯克利分校，后加入 Meta）主导了 Learning to Listen（CVPR 2022）和 Audio2Photoreal（2024），建模对话中倾听者的脸和身体如何回应。
creators.why_zh: 她的工作把倾听者（而不只是说话者）也当作生成对象。

creators.name: Shunsuke Saito
creators.role: Research scientist, Meta Codec Avatars Lab
creators.bio: Shunsuke Saito leads research on Gaussian Codec Avatars at Meta, including Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars (CVPR 2024) and Large-scale Codec Avatars (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: He bridges studio-captured photoreal avatars and generalizable, feed-forward avatar models.
creators.role_zh: Meta Codec Avatars 实验室研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Shunsuke Saito 在 Meta 主导高斯 Codec Avatars 研究，包括可重光照高斯 Codec Avatars（CVPR 2024）和大规模 Codec Avatars（CVPR 2026）。
creators.why_zh: 他把影棚采集的照片级化身与可泛化的前馈化身模型连接起来。

creators.name: Junxuan Li
creators.role: Research scientist, Meta Codec Avatars Lab
creators.bio: Junxuan Li is first author of URAvatar (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024) and Large-scale Codec Avatars (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: His work moves Codec Avatars from studio capture toward phone scans and world-scale populations.
creators.role_zh: Meta Codec Avatars 实验室研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Junxuan Li 是 URAvatar（SIGGRAPH Asia 2024）和大规模 Codec Avatars（CVPR 2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的工作让 Codec Avatars 从影棚采集走向手机扫描和覆盖全球人群的规模。

creators.name: Shenhan Qian
creators.role: PhD researcher, Technical University of Munich
creators.bio: Shenhan Qian, in Matthias Niessner's group at TUM, is first author of GaussianAvatars (CVPR 2024).
creators.why: GaussianAvatars made rigged 3D Gaussian head avatars a standard representation.
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Shenhan Qian 在慕尼黑工业大学 Matthias Niessner 组，是 GaussianAvatars（CVPR 2024）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GaussianAvatars 让绑定到网格的三维高斯头部化身成为常用表示。

creators.name: Taekyung Ki
creators.bio: Taekyung Ki is first author of Avatar Forcing (CVPR 2026), a real-time interactive head avatar that reacts to the user's voice and motion.
creators.why: Avatar Forcing conditions the avatar on the user, not just on its own speech.
creators.role_zh: 韩国科学技术院（KAIST）博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Taekyung Ki 是 Avatar Forcing（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，该模型是能对用户声音与动作作出反应的实时交互头部虚拟人。
creators.why_zh: Avatar Forcing 让虚拟人以用户为条件，而不只是以它自己的语音为条件。

creators.name: Habin Lim
creators.bio: Habin Lim is co-first author of FacePlex (2026), a full-duplex speech and facial-motion model with Gaussian-splatting rendering, from Korea University and Klleon.
creators.why: FacePlex is an academic, inspectable example of a talking face that plans its expression before its speech is emitted.
creators.role_zh: 高丽大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Habin Lim 是 FacePlex（2026）的共同第一作者。该模型来自高丽大学与 Klleon，可全双工地生成语音与面部动作，并用高斯泼溅渲染。
creators.why_zh: FacePlex 是一个可供检视的学术范例：说话的脸会在语音发出之前就预备好表情。

creators.name: Ailing Zeng
creators.role: Researcher in human motion and character generation
creators.bio: Ailing Zeng is first author and co-lead of LPM 1.0 (2026), a 17B video-based character performance model for real-time conversation.
creators.why: LPM 1.0 treats listening, speaking and emoting as one performance problem for conversational characters and NPCs.
creators.role_zh: 人体动作与角色生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: Ailing Zeng 是 LPM 1.0（2026）的第一作者和共同负责人，这是一个面向实时对话的 17B 视频角色表演模型。
creators.why_zh: LPM 1.0 把倾听、说话和情绪表达视为对话角色与 NPC 的同一个表演问题。

creators.name: Sandra C. Sandoval
creators.role: Researcher at the University of Maryland
creators.bio: Works on language, causal inference and policing; first author of a 2026 analysis of how police officers speak to virtual characters in VR simulations.
creators.why: Shows how VR scenes with randomly assigned characters can be read as causal experiments on bias in real officers' speech.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究语言、因果推断与警务；2026 年一项分析警察在 VR 模拟中如何与虚拟角色对话的研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 展示了随机分配虚拟角色的 VR 场景，如何被当作关于真实警察言语偏见的因果实验来分析。
creators.based_zh: 美国马里兰州大学公园市

creators.name: Rashawn Ray
creators.role: Sociologist at the University of Maryland; executive director of the Lab for Applied Social Science Research (LASSR)
creators.bio: Studies race, policing and inequality; his lab runs VR simulations with police officers to study implicit bias and de-escalation.
creators.why: His VR field experiments with serving officers are among the few immersive studies run with police rather than students.
creators.role_zh: 马里兰大学社会学家；应用社会科学研究实验室（LASSR）执行主任
creators.bio_zh: 研究种族、警务与不平等；其实验室用 VR 模拟让在职警察参与，研究内隐偏见与冲突降级。
creators.why_zh: 他与在职警察开展的 VR 现场实验，是少数以警察而非学生为对象的沉浸式研究之一。
creators.based_zh: 美国马里兰州大学公园市

creators.name: Yang Gao
creators.bio: First author of an IEEE VR 2026 study on how AI-reconstructed appearance and cloned voices affect trust in virtual celebrity agents.
creators.why: One of the first controlled comparisons of generated and hand-made versions of the same virtual person.
creators.role_zh: 北京航空航天大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: IEEE VR 2026 一项研究的第一作者，研究 AI 重建外观与克隆声音如何影响人们对虚拟名人智能体的信任。
creators.why_zh: 最早对同一虚拟人的“生成版”与“手工版”进行受控比较的研究之一。

creators.name: Enyao Chang
creators.role: Researcher at the School of Software Engineering, Beijing Jiaotong University
creators.bio: First author of a 2026 randomized study of LLM-driven coaching judges for VR public-speaking practice.
creators.why: Ran one of the larger randomized trials of LLM agents inside a VR training task, with one-month follow-up.
creators.role_zh: 北京交通大学软件学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年一项关于 VR 演讲练习中大语言模型驱动的“教练评委”的随机研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 开展了规模较大的、在 VR 训练任务中使用大语言模型智能体的随机试验之一，并随访一个月。

creators.name: Matt Gottsacker
creators.role: Researcher at the University of Central Florida
creators.bio: First author of the 2026 VERA paper that ran a remote cybersickness study with 263 participants on their own headsets.
creators.why: VERA tests whether VR experiments can leave the lab at scale and still replicate lab findings.
creators.role_zh: 中佛罗里达大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年 VERA 论文的第一作者，该研究让 263 名参与者用自己的头显远程完成晕动症实验。
creators.why_zh: VERA 检验了 VR 实验能否大规模走出实验室，同时仍能复现实验室结果。
creators.based_zh: 美国佛罗里达州奥兰多

creators.name: Bing Li
creators.bio: First author of CyberSelf, a VR system in which people talk with an LLM-driven avatar that looks and sounds like themselves.
creators.why: CyberSelf builds a generated doppelgänger from about 20 seconds of face video and voice, then studies it as a therapeutic tool.
creators.role_zh: 山东大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: CyberSelf 的第一作者：在这个 VR 系统中，人们与一个外貌和声音都像自己的大语言模型化身对话。
creators.why_zh: CyberSelf 只用约 20 秒的面部视频与语音就生成“数字分身”，并把它作为心理支持工具来研究。

creators.name: Joseph P. McCleery
creators.bio: Clinical scientist who has tested Floreo's VR Police Safety Module with autistic teens and adults since 2018, in partnership with the Center for Autism Research at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia.
creators.why: His trials measure VR training effects in live encounters with police officers, not only inside the headset.
creators.role_zh: 费城的自闭症研究者
creators.bio_zh: 临床科学家，自 2018 年起与费城儿童医院自闭症研究中心合作，在自闭症青少年与成人中测试 Floreo 的 VR 警察安全模块。
creators.why_zh: 他的试验在与真实警察的现场互动中测量 VR 训练的效果，而不只看头显里的表现。
creators.based_zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州费城

creators.name: Floreo
creators.role: VR platform for clinically designed lessons for autistic and neurodiverse learners
creators.bio: Delivers VR lessons (social skills, safety, police interactions) on a headset while a coach follows and guides the learner; co-founded by CEO Vijay Ravindran.
creators.why: One of the few VR training products evaluated in randomized trials with transfer to real-world encounters.
creators.role_zh: 为自闭症及神经多样性学习者提供临床设计课程的 VR 平台
creators.bio_zh: 在头显上提供 VR 课程（社交技能、安全、与警察互动），由辅导者跟进并引导学习者；联合创始人兼 CEO 为 Vijay Ravindran。
creators.why_zh: 少数在随机试验中接受评估、并检验向真实场景迁移效果的 VR 训练产品之一。

creators.name: Philippa Garety
creators.role: Professor of clinical psychology, King's College London
creators.bio: Clinical psychologist who led the AVATAR2 trial of digital avatar therapy for distressing voices in psychosis.
creators.why: AVATAR2 is the largest trial so far of therapy delivered through dialogue with a digital embodiment of a patient's voice.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦国王学院临床心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 临床心理学家，主持了针对精神病患者痛苦幻听的数字化身疗法 AVATAR2 试验。
creators.why_zh: AVATAR2 是迄今规模最大的、通过与患者“声音”的数字化身对话来实施治疗的试验。

creators.name: Xiaoran Yang
creators.role: HCI researcher working on LLM-driven agents in XR
creators.bio: First author of an ISMAR 2026 study on how embodied conversational agents in VR can signal uncertainty and sources.
creators.why: Treats hallucination as a design problem for generated characters, not only for chat interfaces.
creators.role_zh: 研究 XR 中大语言模型智能体的人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: ISMAR 2026 一项研究的第一作者，研究 VR 中的具身对话智能体如何提示不确定性与信息来源。
creators.why_zh: 把“幻觉”当作生成角色的设计问题，而不仅仅是聊天界面的问题。

creators.name: Robin S. Rosenberg
creators.role: Clinical psychologist; collaborator of Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Psychologist who writes on the psychology of superheroes and was first author of the 2013 VHIL study on flying like a superhero in VR.
creators.why: Virtual Superheroes showed that an ability granted in VR can carry over into helping behavior outside it.
creators.role_zh: 临床心理学家；斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室的合作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究“超级英雄心理学”的心理学家，2013 年斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室“在 VR 中像超级英雄一样飞行”研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: “虚拟超级英雄”研究表明，在 VR 中获得的能力会延续到现实中的助人行为。

creators.name: Max Kinateder
creators.role: Researcher on human behavior in fire and evacuation
creators.bio: Psychologist who uses VR to study evacuation decisions; the 2016 real-versus-virtual comparison was carried out with William H. Warren at Brown University.
creators.why: Ran one of the few direct validation studies comparing the same emergency in a real room and its VR replica.
creators.role_zh: 研究火灾与疏散中人类行为的研究者
creators.bio_zh: 用 VR 研究疏散决策的心理学家；2016 年的真实与虚拟环境对比研究是他与 William H. Warren 在布朗大学完成的。
creators.why_zh: 完成了少数直接比较真实房间与其 VR 复制品中同一紧急情况的验证研究之一。

creators.name: Mehrnaz Hosseinzadeh
creators.role: Researcher in cognitive and behavioral science
creators.bio: First author of a 2026 scoping review of toolboxes for building immersive VR experiments in psychology and cognitive neuroscience.
creators.why: Maps which experiment-building tools non-programmer researchers can use, a precondition for authoring accessibility.
creators.role_zh: 认知与行为科学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年一篇关于心理学与认知神经科学中沉浸式 VR 实验搭建工具的范围综述的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 梳理了不会编程的研究者能用哪些实验搭建工具，这是“创作可及性”的前提。

creators.name: Yvain Tisserand
creators.role: Researcher at the Swiss Center for Affective Sciences, University of Geneva
creators.bio: Builds virtual humans for VR training and affective research; first author of a 2026 study of a rule-based virtual suspect tested with Geneva police officers.
creators.why: Shows how two interpretable parameters can make a virtual suspect's threat both believable and experimentally controlled.
creators.role_zh: 日内瓦大学瑞士情感科学中心研究者
creators.bio_zh: 为 VR 训练与情感研究构建虚拟人；2026 年一项研究的第一作者，该研究用日内瓦警察测试了一个基于规则的虚拟嫌疑人。
creators.why_zh: 展示了两个可解释参数如何让虚拟嫌疑人的威胁既可信又可被实验控制。

creators.name: Duo Wang
creators.role: Researcher at the College of Media, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: First author of EmSim, an LLM-scored VR de-escalation simulator piloted with police trainees.
creators.why: In EmSim, an LLM's scoring of the trainee's words decides whether the virtual person calms down or escalates.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校传媒学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: EmSim 的第一作者：这是一个由大语言模型评分、在警校学员中试用的 VR 冲突降级模拟器。
creators.why_zh: 在 EmSim 中，大语言模型对学员话语的判断决定虚拟人是平静下来还是升级冲突。

creators.name: Yuting Wen
creators.bio: First author of a 2026 randomized trial comparing ChatGPT guidance with teacher-led instruction in VR dental skill training.
creators.why: One of the few randomized trials of generative AI as the tutor inside an immersive skills simulator, with eye tracking and fNIRS.
creators.role_zh: 口腔医学教育研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年一项随机试验的第一作者，比较了 VR 牙科技能训练中 ChatGPT 指导与教师现场指导的效果。
creators.why_zh: 少数以随机试验检验生成式 AI 在沉浸式技能模拟器中担任“导师”的研究之一，并结合了眼动追踪与功能性近红外光谱。

creators.name: Binyang Han
creators.role: Researcher at the University of Canterbury, New Zealand
creators.bio: First author of an IEEE VR 2026 study of an LLM-driven embodied agent that mediates between two people with conflicting goals in XR.
creators.why: Moves LLM agents in XR from one-to-one tutoring to shaping a group's social dynamics.
creators.role_zh: 新西兰坎特伯雷大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: IEEE VR 2026 一项研究的第一作者：在 XR 中，一个大语言模型驱动的具身智能体在目标冲突的两人之间进行调解。
creators.why_zh: 把 XR 中的大语言模型智能体从一对一辅导推进到影响群体的社会互动。

creators.name: Pao-Ju Chen
creators.role: Nursing educator at Asia Eastern University of Science and Technology
creators.bio: Works on simulation-based nursing education; first author of a 2026 randomised study of an AI-enhanced VR simulation for empathic communication in obstetric care.
creators.why: Tests whether AI dialogue and AI scoring inside VR can train and assess empathy at the level of educators.
creators.role_zh: 亚东科技大学护理教育者
creators.bio_zh: 从事基于模拟的护理教育研究；2026 年一项关于产科共情沟通的 AI 增强 VR 模拟随机研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 检验 VR 中的 AI 对话与 AI 评分能否达到教师水平来训练和评估共情。

creators.name: Patrick Pui Kin Kor
creators.role: Nursing researcher at the Hong Kong Polytechnic University
creators.bio: Studies nursing education and gerontological care; led a 2026 comparison of generative-AI and facilitator-led debriefing after immersive VR nursing simulation.
creators.why: One of the larger controlled comparisons (N = 178) of generative AI taking over a human role in immersive simulation training.
creators.role_zh: 香港理工大学护理学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究护理教育与老年护理；主持了 2026 年一项比较沉浸式 VR 护理模拟后生成式 AI 复盘与教师复盘的研究。
creators.why_zh: 这是让生成式 AI 接替沉浸式模拟训练中人类角色的较大规模对照比较之一（N = 178）。

creators.name: Franziska Grießenauer
creators.role: Psychology researcher at the University of Salzburg
creators.bio: Works in Thomas Probst's psychotherapy research group on relaxation and imagery techniques; first author of a 2026 randomized trial of AI-generated personal safe places in VR.
creators.why: The trial is among the first to place each participant in an environment generated from their own description and compare it with a non-VR control.
creators.role_zh: 萨尔茨堡大学心理学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在 Thomas Probst 的心理治疗研究组从事放松与意象技术研究；2026 年一项 VR 中 AI 生成个人安全之地随机试验的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 她的试验是最早让每位参与者进入按本人描述生成的环境、并与非 VR 对照组比较的研究之一。

creators.name: Yoojin Han
creators.role: Researcher in architecture and environmental psychology at Yonsei University
creators.bio: Studies how indoor spatial features such as greenery affect people, using immersive 360° stimuli; supervised a 2026 validation of generative-AI panoramas as experimental stimuli.
creators.why: Treats generated panoramas as controlled experimental materials and asks what validation they need before use.
creators.role_zh: 延世大学建筑与环境心理学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 利用沉浸式 360° 刺激研究绿植等室内空间特征如何影响人；主持了 2026 年一项把生成式 AI 全景用作实验刺激的验证研究。
creators.why_zh: 把生成的全景当作受控的实验材料，并追问它们在使用前需要怎样的验证。

creators.name: Ruoyu Wen
creators.role: HCI researcher at the University of Canterbury
creators.bio: Works on generative AI and VR for emotional support with Thammathip Piumsomboon and Mark Billinghurst; first author of OasisMind (IUI 2026).
creators.why: Compares worlds that participants generate themselves with validated, pre-authored VR scenes.
creators.role_zh: 坎特伯雷大学人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Thammathip Piumsomboon、Mark Billinghurst 合作研究用于情绪支持的生成式 AI 与 VR；OasisMind（IUI 2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把参与者自己生成的世界与经过验证的预设 VR 场景进行比较。

creators.name: Sarah Roßkopf
creators.role: Psychologist at the University of Regensburg (clinical psychology and psychotherapy)
creators.bio: Studies social stress, presence and audio realism in virtual versions of the Trier Social Stress Test with Andreas Mühlberger's group.
creators.why: Tests whether synthetic speech can replace recorded human voices in a validated virtual stress paradigm.
creators.role_zh: 雷根斯堡大学心理学家（临床心理学与心理治疗）
creators.bio_zh: 在 Andreas Mühlberger 的研究组中，研究虚拟版特里尔社会应激测试中的社会应激、临场感与声音真实感。
creators.why_zh: 检验合成语音能否在经过验证的虚拟应激范式中替代录制的真人语音。

creators.name: Mengxu Pan
creators.role: HCI researcher working on LLM-driven agents in social VR
creators.bio: First author of a CHI 2026 study in which English learners practised with an LLM-based embodied agent in social VR, with co-authors from the University of Victoria, the University of British Columbia and Northeastern University.
creators.why: Brings LLM-driven conversation partners into language-anxiety practice, a situation that is hard to staff with people.
creators.role_zh: 研究社交 VR 中大语言模型智能体的人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: CHI 2026 一项研究的第一作者：英语学习者在社交 VR 中与基于大语言模型的具身智能体练习；合作者来自维多利亚大学、不列颠哥伦比亚大学与东北大学。
creators.why_zh: 把大语言模型驱动的对话伙伴引入外语焦虑练习，这类情境很难长期由真人陪练。

creators.name: Tsehaye Haidemariam
creators.role: Researcher at BI Norwegian Business School
creators.bio: Works on virtual reality, the metaverse and social identity; first author of the 2026 synthetic-embodiment framework for AI-generated identity cues.
creators.why: Proposes how generated avatars could become controlled, audited stimuli for studies of identity and bias in VR.
creators.role_zh: 挪威 BI 商学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟现实、元宇宙与社会身份；2026 年“合成具身”框架（关于 AI 生成的身份线索）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 提出生成化身如何成为受控且经过审查的刺激材料，用于 VR 中关于身份与偏见的研究。

creators.name: Juming Jiang
creators.role: Health-education researcher at Hong Kong Metropolitan University
creators.bio: First author of a 2026 JMIR systematic review of generative-AI virtual patients in health care education.
creators.why: The review maps how little of the generative virtual-patient evidence is immersive or controlled.
creators.role_zh: 香港都会大学健康教育研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年 JMIR 一篇关于医疗卫生教育中生成式 AI 虚拟病人的系统综述的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 这篇综述表明，生成式虚拟病人的证据中沉浸式或有对照的研究少之又少。

creators.name: Raina Cao
creators.role: HCI researcher at the University of British Columbia
creators.bio: Studies conversational timing with LLM-based agents in social VR with Mirjana Prpa and Alexandra Kitson; first author of 'Quantifying Latencies' (CHI 2026).
creators.why: Measures the turn-taking gap that separates LLM-driven characters from human conversation partners.
creators.role_zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚大学人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Mirjana Prpa、Alexandra Kitson 合作研究社交 VR 中大语言模型智能体的对话时序；《Quantifying Latencies》（CHI 2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 测量了把大语言模型驱动角色与人类对话者区分开来的话轮转换差距。

creators.name: Pau Mora
creators.role: Researcher at the Universitat Politècnica de València
creators.bio: Builds generative VR tools for mental health with Mariano Alcañiz's group; first author of Refugio (2026).
creators.why: Runs a full open-model generation pipeline on a local server so that a therapeutic VR scene can be furnished by voice.
creators.role_zh: 瓦伦西亚理工大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在 Mariano Alcañiz 的研究组开发用于心理健康的生成式 VR 工具；Refugio（2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 在本地服务器上运行完整的开源模型生成流程，让治疗用 VR 场景可以通过语音布置。

creators.name: Nathalia Gomez
creators.bio: Works with Tiffany D. Do on embodied conversational agents in VR; first author of 'Listening and Mirroring' (VRST 2026).
creators.why: Separates what an LLM-driven agent says from how its body responds, and tests each against perceived empathy.
creators.role_zh: 德雷塞尔大学人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Tiffany D. Do 合作研究 VR 中的具身对话智能体；《Listening and Mirroring》（VRST 2026）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把大语言模型驱动智能体“说什么”与“身体如何回应”分开，分别检验它们对被感知共情的影响。
creators.based_zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州费城

creators.name: Yupei Duan
creators.role: Learning-technologies researcher at the University of Missouri
creators.bio: Designs immersive VR environments for nursing education; first author of a 2026 AIxVR study of generative-AI virtual standardized patients.
creators.why: Compares practice with generative virtual patients in VR against a control group on a real standardized-patient exam.
creators.role_zh: 密苏里大学学习技术研究者
creators.bio_zh: 为护理教育设计沉浸式 VR 环境；2026 年一项关于生成式 AI 虚拟标准化病人的 AIxVR 研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 在真实的标准化病人考核上，把 VR 中与生成式虚拟病人的练习与对照组进行比较。
creators.based_zh: 美国密苏里州哥伦比亚

creators.name: Mel Slater
creators.role: VR researcher, co-director of the EventLab, University of Barcelona
creators.bio: Computer scientist turned presence researcher who formulated place illusion and plausibility and ran the virtual Milgram, bystander and body-ownership experiments.
creators.why: His lab showed that people respond realistically to virtual situations that cannot be staged for real, the premise for using generated situations in behavioral science.
creators.role_zh: 虚拟现实研究者，巴塞罗那大学 EventLab 联合主任
creators.bio_zh: 从计算机科学转向临场感研究，提出“地点错觉”与“似真错觉”，主持了虚拟米尔格拉姆、旁观者与身体拥有感等一系列实验。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室证明，人们会对现实中无法布置的虚拟情境作出真实反应——这是把生成情境用于行为科学的前提。

creators.name: Jeremy Bailenson
creators.role: Founding director of the Virtual Human Interaction Lab (VHIL), Stanford University
creators.bio: Communication scholar who studies how avatars, virtual bodies and immersive media change attitudes and behavior, from the Proteus effect to large VR field studies.
creators.why: VHIL's experiments are the reference point for how self-representation and perspective-taking in VR carry over into real behavior.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学虚拟人交互实验室（VHIL）创始主任
creators.bio_zh: 传播学学者，研究化身、虚拟身体与沉浸式媒体如何改变态度与行为，从“普罗透斯效应”到大规模 VR 实地研究。
creators.why_zh: VHIL 的实验是理解 VR 中的自我呈现与换位思考如何影响真实行为的参照基准。

creators.name: Jean-Louis van Gelder
creators.role: Director at the Max Planck Institute for the Study of Crime, Security and Law; professor at Leiden University
creators.bio: Criminologist and psychologist who uses VR to study criminal decision-making (Virtual Burglary Project) and future-self interventions.
creators.why: He made the methodological case for VR as criminology's laboratory for situations that cannot be staged ethically.
creators.role_zh: 马克斯·普朗克犯罪、安全与法律研究所所长；莱顿大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 犯罪学家与心理学家，用 VR 研究犯罪决策（虚拟入室盗窃项目）和“未来自我”干预。
creators.why_zh: 他系统论证了 VR 可以作为犯罪学的实验室，用来研究那些在伦理上无法真实布置的情境。

creators.name: Sylvia Xueni Pan
creators.role: Researcher in virtual social interaction, Goldsmiths, University of London
creators.bio: Studies social interaction with virtual characters and co-wrote, with Antonia Hamilton, the standard review on using VR to study social interaction.
creators.why: Her work spells out the trade-off between experimental control and two-way realism that generated characters have to manage.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学金史密斯学院虚拟社会互动研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究人与虚拟角色的社会互动，与 Antonia Hamilton 合写了用 VR 研究社会互动的经典综述。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究阐明了实验控制与双向真实感之间的取舍，而生成角色必须处理好这一取舍。

creators.name: Jim Blascovich
creators.role: Social psychologist, University of California, Santa Barbara
creators.bio: Co-founded UCSB's Research Center for Virtual Environments and Behavior and argued for immersive VR as a method for social psychology.
creators.why: His 2002 target article is the founding statement of immersive virtual environments as a social-psychology method.
creators.role_zh: 社会心理学家，加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校
creators.bio_zh: 共同创办加州大学圣塔芭芭拉分校的虚拟环境与行为研究中心，倡导把沉浸式 VR 作为社会心理学的研究方法。
creators.why_zh: 他 2002 年的靶文章是把沉浸式虚拟环境确立为社会心理学方法的奠基之作。

creators.name: Jonathan Steuer
creators.bio: Wrote the 1992 paper that defined virtual reality by the experience of telepresence and its two determinants, vividness and interactivity.
creators.why: His vividness and interactivity axes still map onto the perceptual-realism and reactivity lenses used here.
creators.role_zh: 传播学研究者（1992 年时在斯坦福大学）
creators.bio_zh: 1992 年发表论文，以“远程临场”体验及其两个决定因素——生动性与交互性——来定义虚拟现实。
creators.why_zh: 他提出的生动性与交互性两条轴线，至今仍对应本站使用的“感知真实感”与“反应性”两个视角。

creators.name: Egon Brunswik
creators.bio: Hungarian-born psychologist whose probabilistic functionalism and lens model asked experiments to sample situations as carefully as participants.
creators.why: Representative design is the methodological argument for generating many situation variants instead of one hand-built scene.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家，加州大学伯克利分校（1903–1955）
creators.bio_zh: 出生于匈牙利的心理学家，提出概率功能主义与“透镜模型”，主张实验应像抽样被试一样认真地抽样情境。
creators.why_zh: 代表性设计为“生成大量情境变体，而非手工搭建一个场景”提供了方法论依据。

creators.name: Guido Makransky
creators.role: Professor of educational psychology, University of Copenhagen
creators.bio: Studies learning in immersive VR; co-authored CAMIL, which explains when presence and agency help or hurt learning.
creators.why: CAMIL gives a testable account of why immersive training works, which generated training scenarios inherit.
creators.role_zh: 哥本哈根大学教育心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究沉浸式 VR 中的学习，合作提出 CAMIL 模型，解释临场感与能动性何时促进、何时妨碍学习。
creators.why_zh: CAMIL 为沉浸式训练为何有效提供了可检验的解释，生成的训练情境同样适用。

creators.name: Michael Wiesing
creators.role: Researcher at the EventLab, University of Barcelona
creators.bio: Studies how VR experiences carry over into beliefs and actions in physical reality.
creators.why: His experiments probe the ethical edge of realism: when people mistake virtual objects and events for real ones.
creators.role_zh: 巴塞罗那大学 EventLab 研究员
creators.bio_zh: 研究 VR 体验如何延续到物理现实中的信念与行动。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验探索真实感的伦理边界：人们何时会把虚拟的物体与事件当成真的。

creators.name: Nick Yee
creators.role: Researcher on avatars and online games (Stanford VHIL; later co-founder of Quantic Foundry)
creators.bio: Named the Proteus effect with Jeremy Bailenson as a PhD student at Stanford, then studied player motivation at scale.
creators.why: The Proteus effect is the reason avatar choice is an experimental variable in every embodied study.
creators.role_zh: 化身与网络游戏研究者（斯坦福 VHIL；后联合创办 Quantic Foundry）
creators.bio_zh: 在斯坦福读博期间与 Jeremy Bailenson 一起提出“普罗透斯效应”，之后大规模研究玩家动机。
creators.why_zh: 普罗透斯效应说明，在任何具身研究中，化身的选择本身就是实验变量。

creators.name: Tabitha Peck
creators.bio: Studies virtual embodiment and avatar effects; lead author of the 2013 black-avatar implicit-bias study with Mel Slater's group.
creators.why: Her work shows that body ownership can move attitudes, which makes avatar design an ethical question.
creators.role_zh: 戴维森学院计算机科学家
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟具身与化身效应，2013 年与 Mel Slater 团队合作的“黑人化身与内隐偏见”研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究表明身体拥有感能改变态度，这让化身设计成为一个伦理问题。

creators.name: Mar Gonzalez-Franco
creators.role: XR research scientist (Google; formerly Microsoft Research)
creators.bio: Neuroscientist and engineer working on avatars, embodiment and social XR; led a VR replication of the Milgram paradigm.
creators.why: Her work links embodiment research to industrial XR platforms where generated avatars will be deployed.
creators.role_zh: XR 研究科学家（Google；曾任职于微软研究院）
creators.bio_zh: 从事化身、具身与社交 XR 研究的神经科学家与工程师，主导了米尔格拉姆范式的 VR 复现研究。
creators.why_zh: 她的工作把具身研究与工业界 XR 平台联系起来，而生成化身正将部署在这些平台上。

creators.name: Solène Neyret
creators.role: Researcher at the EventLab, University of Barcelona
creators.bio: Studies how embodied perspective-taking in VR changes conformity and harmful group behavior.
creators.why: Her experiments chain scenes, showing that one embodied experience changes behavior in the next.
creators.role_zh: 巴塞罗那大学 EventLab 研究员
creators.bio_zh: 研究 VR 中的具身换位思考如何改变从众行为与群体中的伤害行为。
creators.why_zh: 她的实验把多个场景串联起来，表明一次具身体验会改变下一个情境中的行为。

creators.name: Fernanda Herrera
creators.role: Researcher, Stanford Virtual Human Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Led the large-scale Becoming Homeless studies comparing VR and traditional perspective-taking.
creators.why: Her eight-week follow-ups set the standard for testing whether empathy built in VR lasts.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室研究员
creators.bio_zh: 主导了比较 VR 与传统换位思考的大规模《Becoming Homeless》研究。
creators.why_zh: 她长达八周的追踪研究，为检验 VR 中建立的共情能否持久树立了标准。

creators.name: Hal Hershfield
creators.role: Professor of marketing and behavioral decision making, UCLA Anderson School of Management
creators.bio: Studies the psychology of the future self; with Stanford VHIL he showed that meeting an aged avatar of oneself increases saving.
creators.why: His work is an early case of synthetic faces used as a behavioral intervention.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校安德森管理学院市场营销与行为决策教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究“未来自我”心理学；与斯坦福 VHIL 合作发现，见到自己变老的化身会增加储蓄。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究是把合成面孔用作行为干预的早期案例。

creators.name: David-Paul Pertaub
creators.bio: First author of the 2002 virtual-audience public speaking experiment with Mel Slater and Chris Barker.
creators.why: The study is the origin of virtual-audience training for social anxiety.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院研究者（2002 年）
creators.bio_zh: 2002 年与 Mel Slater、Chris Barker 合作的虚拟听众演讲实验的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 这项研究是面向社交焦虑的虚拟听众训练的源头。

creators.name: Claire Nee
creators.role: Professor of forensic psychology, University of Portsmouth
creators.bio: Studies burglars' expertise and decision-making; co-heads the Virtual Burglary Project.
creators.why: She validated virtual crime scenes against the behavior of real experts, the bar for any generated crime scenario.
creators.role_zh: 朴次茅斯大学司法心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 研究入室盗窃者的专业技能与决策，共同领导虚拟入室盗窃项目。
creators.why_zh: 她以真实“专家”的行为来检验虚拟犯罪场景，为任何生成的犯罪情境设定了标准。

creators.name: Sofia Seinfeld
creators.role: Researcher in virtual embodiment (EventLab, University of Barcelona)
creators.bio: Lead author of the study that embodied domestic-violence offenders in the body of a victim.
creators.why: Her work shows VR perspective-swapping as a targeted intervention with offenders.
creators.role_zh: 虚拟具身研究者（巴塞罗那大学 EventLab）
creators.bio_zh: 让家暴罪犯“进入”受害者身体的那项研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 她的研究展示了 VR 换位体验可以作为针对罪犯的定向干预。

creators.name: Mehdi Moussaïd
creators.role: Research scientist, Max Planck Institute for Human Development
creators.bio: Studies crowd behavior and collective dynamics, including crowd evacuations with real participants in shared virtual environments.
creators.why: His experiments show that emergencies involving many people can be studied safely in multi-user virtual worlds.
creators.role_zh: 马克斯·普朗克人类发展研究所研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 研究人群行为与集体动力学，包括让真实参与者在共享虚拟环境中进行人群疏散实验。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验表明，涉及众人的紧急情况可以在多人虚拟世界中安全地研究。

creators.name: Patrick McClanahan
creators.role: Criminologist, Pennsylvania Virtual Burglary Project (Max Planck Institute for the Study of Crime, Security and Law)
creators.bio: Led the Pennsylvania arm of the Virtual Burglary Project, which brought VR burglary tasks into US prisons and released its virtual neighborhoods as open access.
creators.why: Open, shared virtual stimuli are the replication infrastructure that generated scenarios will also need.
creators.role_zh: 犯罪学研究者，宾夕法尼亚虚拟入室盗窃项目（马克斯·普朗克犯罪、安全与法律研究所）
creators.bio_zh: 主导虚拟入室盗窃项目的宾夕法尼亚分支，把 VR 盗窃任务带进美国监狱，并以开放获取方式公开了虚拟街区。
creators.why_zh: 开放共享的虚拟刺激材料，是生成情境同样需要的复现基础设施。

creators.name: Connor Powelson
creators.bio: First author of a 2025 VR think-aloud study of police decisions in mental-health co-response calls.
creators.why: The study shows VR as a tool for opening up rare, high-risk police encounters to analysis.
creators.role_zh: 刑事司法研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2025 年一项关于警察在精神健康协同出警中如何决策的 VR 出声思维研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 该研究展示了 VR 可以把罕见、高风险的警民接触变成可分析的对象。

creators.name: Stanley J. Hamstra
creators.role: Medical education researcher (University of Ottawa; ACGME)
creators.bio: Studies simulation-based training; first author of the 2014 reappraisal of fidelity in simulation.
creators.why: His distinction between physical resemblance and functional alignment tells generated training what realism it actually needs.
creators.role_zh: 医学教育研究者（渥太华大学；美国毕业后医学教育认证委员会）
creators.bio_zh: 研究基于模拟的训练，2014 年重新审视模拟“保真度”一文的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 他对“物理相似性”与“功能一致性”的区分，告诉生成式训练真正需要哪种真实感。

creators.name: K. Anders Ericsson
creators.bio: Swedish psychologist who founded the study of expert performance and defined deliberate practice.
creators.why: Deliberate practice is the learning theory behind adaptive, repeatable training scenarios.
creators.role_zh: 心理学家，佛罗里达州立大学（1947–2020）
creators.bio_zh: 瑞典心理学家，开创了专家表现研究，并界定了“刻意练习”的概念。
creators.why_zh: 刻意练习是自适应、可重复训练情境背后的学习理论。
creators.based_zh: 美国佛罗里达州塔拉哈西

creators.name: USC Institute for Creative Technologies
creators.role: University-affiliated research center of the University of Southern California
creators.bio: Research institute founded in 1999 with US Army funding to combine AI, graphics and storytelling for training and health; home of the Virtual Human Toolkit, SimSensei and Bravemind.
creators.why: ICT built many of the first conversational virtual humans used for training, interviewing and therapy.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学下属的大学附属研究中心
creators.bio_zh: 1999 年在美国陆军资助下成立，把人工智能、图形与叙事结合用于训练和健康；虚拟人工具包、SimSensei 与 Bravemind 均出自这里。
creators.why_zh: ICT 打造了许多最早用于训练、访谈和治疗的对话式虚拟人。
creators.name_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所

creators.name: Patrick Kenny
creators.role: Researcher, USC Institute for Creative Technologies (2000s)
creators.bio: Led virtual human and virtual patient projects at USC ICT, including the 2007 I/ITSEC overview of building interactive virtual humans for training.
creators.why: His overview documents the hand-built pipeline that generative models now replace.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所研究员（2000 年代）
creators.bio_zh: 在 USC ICT 主持虚拟人与虚拟病人项目，包括 2007 年 I/ITSEC 上关于构建训练用交互式虚拟人的综述。
creators.why_zh: 他的综述记录了如今正被生成模型取代的手工构建流程。

creators.name: Kyle Johnsen
creators.role: Computer scientist (University of Florida, later University of Georgia)
creators.bio: Built and validated life-size virtual patients for medical interview training with Benjamin Lok's group.
creators.why: His CHI 2007 study validated a virtual-patient exam against the real-world exam, a step many LLM studies skip.
creators.role_zh: 计算机科学家（佛罗里达大学，后任职于佐治亚大学）
creators.bio_zh: 与 Benjamin Lok 团队合作构建并验证了用于医学问诊训练的真人大小虚拟病人。
creators.why_zh: 他在 CHI 2007 的研究以真实考试为标准验证了虚拟病人考试，这是许多大语言模型研究会跳过的一步。

creators.name: Matthew J. Smith
creators.role: Social work researcher (Northwestern University, later University of Michigan)
creators.bio: Lead author of trials of Virtual Reality Job Interview Training with the virtual interviewer Molly Porter.
creators.why: His trials are the evidence base that LLM-driven interview trainers now build on.
creators.role_zh: 社会工作研究者（西北大学，后任职于密歇根大学）
creators.bio_zh: 以虚拟面试官 Molly Porter 为核心的虚拟现实求职面试训练试验的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的试验构成了如今大语言模型面试训练系统所依据的证据基础。

creators.name: Mursion
creators.bio: Grew out of research on human-in-the-loop teaching simulators; trained simulation specialists voice and steer avatars live, and the company now markets AI-powered simulations.
creators.why: It is the large-scale deployment of the Wizard-of-Oz virtual human that LLM agents now try to automate.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式模拟训练公司
creators.bio_zh: 源于“人在回路”教学模拟器的研究；由受过训练的模拟专员实时为化身配音并操控其行为，公司如今主打 AI 驱动的模拟。
creators.why_zh: 它是“绿野仙踪”式虚拟人的大规模部署，而大语言模型智能体正试图将其自动化。

creators.name: Strivr
creators.bio: Spun out of Stanford's VHIL in 2015 to train athletes with 360-degree VR, then scaled VR training to employers such as Walmart; by 2026 it markets AI quality assurance on smart glasses.
creators.why: Its path from VR rehearsal to AI that watches real work is one trajectory for immersive training.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式培训公司
creators.bio_zh: 2015 年从斯坦福 VHIL 衍生，先用 360° VR 训练运动员，后把 VR 培训推广到沃尔玛等企业；截至 2026 年主推基于智能眼镜的 AI 质检。
creators.why_zh: 它从 VR 演练走向“看着真实工作的 AI”，代表了沉浸式培训的一种发展轨迹。

creators.name: Axon
creators.bio: Maker of TASER energy weapons and police body cameras that also sells VR training for officers.
creators.why: Its VR training puts empathy and de-escalation scenarios in front of police officers at department scale.
creators.role_zh: 公共安全科技公司（TASER 电击器、执法记录仪）
creators.bio_zh: TASER 电击武器与警用执法记录仪的制造商，也为警员提供 VR 训练。
creators.why_zh: 它的 VR 训练让大量警员接受共情与降级处置情境的训练。
creators.based_zh: 美国亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔

creators.name: SHOTPROS
creators.role: EU Horizon 2020 research project on VR police training (2019-2022)
creators.bio: Consortium of police organizations, universities and companies that studied decision-making and acting under stress and built a VR training framework.
creators.why: It treated stress as a controllable training parameter, a natural slot for adaptive generation.
creators.role_zh: 欧盟“地平线 2020”VR 警务训练研究项目（2019–2022）
creators.bio_zh: 由警务机构、大学与企业组成的联合体，研究压力下的决策与行动，并构建了一套 VR 训练框架。
creators.why_zh: 它把压力当作可控的训练参数，这正是自适应生成可以接入的位置。

creators.name: Talespin
creators.role: Immersive soft-skills training company, now part of Cornerstone
creators.bio: Built VR soft-skills simulations with virtual humans and the no-code authoring tool CoPilot Designer; talespin.com now redirects to Cornerstone's immersive-learning platform.
creators.why: It was among the first to put generative AI into VR training authoring.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式软技能培训公司，现已并入 Cornerstone
creators.bio_zh: 开发带虚拟人的 VR 软技能模拟和无代码创作工具 CoPilot Designer；talespin.com 现已跳转至 Cornerstone 的沉浸式学习平台。
creators.why_zh: 它是最早把生成式 AI 用于 VR 培训内容创作的公司之一。

creators.name: Bodyswaps
creators.bio: Builds VR and browser role-plays with AI avatars and automated feedback for students and employees.
creators.why: Its open AI role-plays with automated scoring show where commercial training has already moved.
creators.role_zh: 软技能培训公司
creators.bio_zh: 为学生和员工打造在 VR 与浏览器中进行的 AI 化身角色扮演，并提供自动反馈。
creators.why_zh: 其开放式 AI 角色扮演与自动评分，显示出商业培训已经走到了哪一步。

creators.name: AppliedVR
creators.bio: Maker of RelieVRx, a home VR program for chronic low back pain authorized by the FDA through the De Novo pathway.
creators.why: It shows the evidence and regulatory bar that clinical immersive programs have to clear.
creators.role_zh: 数字疗法公司
creators.bio_zh: RelieVRx 的开发商，这是一款经美国 FDA De Novo 途径授权、用于慢性下背痛的居家 VR 项目。
creators.why_zh: 它展示了临床沉浸式项目必须跨过的证据与监管门槛。

creators.name: Albert "Skip" Rizzo
creators.role: Director of Medical Virtual Reality, USC Institute for Creative Technologies
creators.bio: Clinical psychologist who built Virtual Iraq/Afghanistan and Bravemind for PTSD exposure therapy and led virtual-patient research.
creators.why: His clinician-controlled VR exposure is the template for adaptive immersive therapy.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所医学虚拟现实部门主任
creators.bio_zh: 临床心理学家，开发了用于 PTSD 暴露疗法的 Virtual Iraq/Afghanistan 与 Bravemind，并主持虚拟病人研究。
creators.why_zh: 他由临床医生操控的 VR 暴露疗法，是自适应沉浸式治疗的样板。

creators.name: Daniel Freeman
creators.role: Professor of clinical psychology, University of Oxford
creators.bio: Leads Oxford's automated VR therapy research for fear of heights, paranoia and agoraphobic avoidance in psychosis (gameChange).
creators.why: His trials show that a virtual coach can deliver therapy without a therapist present, the precedent for AI-guided therapy in VR.
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学临床心理学教授
creators.bio_zh: 主持牛津大学针对恐高、偏执以及精神病患者广场回避（gameChange）的自动化 VR 治疗研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的试验表明虚拟教练可以在没有治疗师在场的情况下实施治疗，为 VR 中由 AI 引导的治疗开了先例。

creators.name: Barbara Olasov Rothbaum
creators.bio: Clinical psychologist whose 1995 trial was one of the first controlled studies of virtual reality exposure therapy.
creators.why: Her work established VR exposure as a clinical method decades before generative tools.
creators.role_zh: 埃默里大学精神病学教授
creators.bio_zh: 临床心理学家，她 1995 年的试验是最早的虚拟现实暴露疗法对照研究之一。
creators.why_zh: 她的工作在生成工具出现数十年前就把 VR 暴露确立为一种临床方法。
creators.based_zh: 美国佐治亚州亚特兰大

creators.name: Hunter Hoffman
creators.bio: Developed SnowWorld with David Patterson to distract burn patients from pain during wound care.
creators.why: His work shows that the strength of immersion itself can be a clinical dose.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 与 David Patterson 合作开发 SnowWorld，在烧伤换药时分散患者对疼痛的注意。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究表明，沉浸感的强弱本身就可以是一种临床“剂量”。

creators.name: Tom Craig
creators.role: Professor of social psychiatry, King's College London
creators.bio: Led the AVATAR therapy trial in which people who hear voices talk with a therapist-voiced avatar of their persecutor.
creators.why: AVATAR is a clinical use of personalized virtual humans that generative models could scale.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦国王学院社会精神病学教授
creators.bio_zh: 主持 AVATAR 疗法试验：幻听者与由治疗师配音、代表其“迫害者”的化身对话。
creators.why_zh: AVATAR 是个性化虚拟人的一种临床用途，生成模型有望让它规模化。

creators.name: David DeVault
creators.role: Researcher in natural-language dialogue, USC Institute for Creative Technologies
creators.bio: Led the SimSensei Kiosk virtual human interviewer project.
creators.why: SimSensei's design cycle from human data to Wizard-of-Oz to automation is the method a generative interviewer still needs.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所自然语言对话研究者
creators.bio_zh: 主持 SimSensei Kiosk 虚拟人访谈者项目。
creators.why_zh: SimSensei 从人类数据到“绿野仙踪”原型再到自动化的设计流程，仍是生成式访谈者需要遵循的方法。

creators.name: Gale Lucas
creators.role: Researcher, USC Institute for Creative Technologies
creators.bio: Social psychologist who showed that people disclose more to a virtual human they believe is computer-controlled.
creators.why: Her finding makes what participants are told about an AI interlocutor an experimental variable.
creators.role_zh: 南加州大学创意技术研究所研究员
creators.bio_zh: 社会心理学家，发现人们在相信虚拟人由计算机控制时会披露更多。
creators.why_zh: 她的发现说明，告诉参与者对面的 AI 是什么，本身就是一个实验变量。

creators.name: Sofia Adelaide Osimo
creators.role: Researcher on virtual embodiment (EventLab, University of Barcelona)
creators.bio: Lead author of the 2015 self-counselling study in which participants alternate between their own body and Sigmund Freud's.
creators.why: The paradigm became the base for later AI-assisted VR self-talk.
creators.role_zh: 虚拟具身研究者（巴塞罗那大学 EventLab）
creators.bio_zh: 2015 年“自我咨询”研究的第一作者：参与者在自己的身体与西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的身体之间切换。
creators.why_zh: 这一范式成为后来 AI 辅助 VR 自我对话研究的基础。

creators.name: Domna Banakou
creators.role: Researcher in virtual embodiment (EventLab, University of Barcelona)
creators.bio: Studies how virtual bodies and gradual scene changes alter perception, attitudes and anxiety.
creators.why: Her imperceptible-change paradigm turns a multi-session exposure ladder into one continuously morphing scene.
creators.role_zh: 虚拟具身研究者（巴塞罗那大学 EventLab）
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟身体与场景的渐进变化如何改变知觉、态度与焦虑。
creators.why_zh: 她的“不可察觉变化”范式把多次暴露阶梯压缩成一个持续变形的场景。

creators.name: Xinyu Ning
creators.role: First author of a systematic review of generative AI in XR (Lik-Hang Lee's group)
creators.bio: Researcher who mapped the 2023-2025 literature combining generative AI with extended reality.
creators.why: The review is a baseline count of how young the generative XR field is.
creators.role_zh: 生成式 AI 与 XR 系统综述的第一作者（Lik-Hang Lee 团队）
creators.bio_zh: 梳理了 2023–2025 年生成式 AI 与扩展现实结合研究的研究者。
creators.why_zh: 这篇综述为“生成式 XR 领域有多年轻”提供了一个基准。

creators.name: Akilan Amithasagaran
creators.bio: Developed CLiVR, an LLM-driven virtual patient system for Meta Quest 3, with collaborators in medical education.
creators.why: CLiVR is one of the agenda's examples of LLM patients in headset VR.
creators.role_zh: CLiVR（2025）第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 与医学教育合作者一起开发了 CLiVR——一个基于 Meta Quest 3、由大语言模型驱动的虚拟病人系统。
creators.why_zh: CLiVR 是研究议程中头显 VR 里的大语言模型病人的范例之一。

creators.name: Jacob Barker
creators.bio: Develops the Virtual Operating Room Team Experience for training and evaluating surgical teamwork.
creators.why: VORTeX uses an LLM as a measurement instrument for team behavior in VR.
creators.role_zh: VORTeX（2026）第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 开发用于训练和评估外科团队协作的“虚拟手术室团队体验”（VORTeX）。
creators.why_zh: VORTeX 把大语言模型用作 VR 中团队行为的测量工具。

creators.name: Doron Friedman
creators.role: Head of the Advanced Reality Lab, Reichman University
creators.bio: Studies virtual humans, telepresence and VR for mental health; his lab builds LLM-driven virtual humans and automated scenario pipelines.
creators.why: His lab is one of the few connecting Slater-style VR paradigms with generative agents.
creators.role_zh: 赖克曼大学先进现实实验室负责人
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟人、远程临场与面向心理健康的 VR；其实验室开发由大语言模型驱动的虚拟人和自动化情境生成流程。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室是少数把 Slater 式 VR 范式与生成式智能体结合起来的团队之一。

creators.name: Dan Pollak
creators.role: Researcher, Advanced Reality Lab, Reichman University
creators.bio: First author of Inceptor, a pipeline that generates social VR episodes for mental-health training.
creators.why: Inceptor shows generation paying off for training content before any live LLM conversation.
creators.role_zh: 赖克曼大学先进现实实验室研究员
creators.bio_zh: Inceptor 的第一作者，该流程可为心理健康训练生成社会 VR 片段。
creators.why_zh: Inceptor 表明，在实时大语言模型对话之前，生成技术就已能为训练内容带来收益。

creators.name: Alon Shoa
creators.role: Researcher, Advanced Reality Lab, Reichman University
creators.bio: Developer of Milo, an open-source LLM-based virtual human platform for XR.
creators.why: Open virtual-human stacks let studies pin the model and pipeline they ran.
creators.role_zh: 赖克曼大学先进现实实验室研究员
creators.bio_zh: 开源 XR 大语言模型虚拟人平台 Milo 的开发者。
creators.why_zh: 开放的虚拟人技术栈让研究能够锁定所用的模型与管线。

creators.name: Moreah Zisquit
creators.bio: First author of a 2025 formative study that adds an AI agent to VR self-talk counselling.
creators.why: The study tests a lower-risk clinical role for LLMs: supporting a person's own reasoning in VR.
creators.role_zh: 赖克曼大学研究员
creators.bio_zh: 2025 年一项在 VR 自我对话咨询中加入 AI 智能体的形成性研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 该研究检验了大语言模型在临床中风险较低的角色：在 VR 中支持当事人自己的思考。

creators.name: Dehui Kong
creators.bio: First author of CoEmpaTeam (CHI 2026), a VR system for training cognitive empathy with LLM-driven avatars.
creators.why: CoEmpaTeam treats LLM personality as a pre-validated, controllable parameter.
creators.role_zh: 卡尔斯鲁厄理工学院研究员
creators.bio_zh: CoEmpaTeam（CHI 2026）的第一作者，这是一个用大语言模型化身训练认知共情的 VR 系统。
creators.why_zh: CoEmpaTeam 把大语言模型角色的性格当作经过预先验证的可控参数。

creators.name: Ziming Li
creators.bio: First author of an LLM-driven VR job-communication trainer for autistic individuals (CHI EA 2024) in Roshan Peiris's lab.
creators.why: The work shows coaches authoring VR scenarios through prompts instead of scripts.
creators.role_zh: 罗切斯特理工学院研究员
creators.bio_zh: Roshan Peiris 实验室中面向自闭症人士的大语言模型 VR 职场沟通训练研究（CHI EA 2024）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 这项工作展示了就业辅导员用提示词而非脚本来编写 VR 情境。

creators.name: Kamilla Bergsnev
creators.role: First author of a 2026 systematic review on AI for VR exposure therapy
creators.bio: Researcher who reviewed how artificial intelligence is used to tailor VR exposure therapy.
creators.why: The review maps the evidence for adaptive exposure, the clinical use case closest to real-time generation.
creators.role_zh: 2026 年一篇关于 AI 用于 VR 暴露疗法的系统综述的第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 系统梳理了人工智能如何被用来定制 VR 暴露疗法的研究者。
creators.why_zh: 这篇综述梳理了自适应暴露的证据，而它是最接近实时生成的临床用例。

creators.name: Gustav Bøg Petersen
creators.role: Researcher working with Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab
creators.bio: Studies learning and environmental attitudes in VR; first author of the OceanSpeak conversational-AI study.
creators.why: OceanSpeak's yoked-control design is a template for isolating the effect of generative conversation.
creators.role_zh: 与斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室合作的研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究 VR 中的学习与环境态度，OceanSpeak 对话式 AI 研究的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: OceanSpeak 的配对对照设计，是分离生成式对话效应的样板。

creators.name: Konstantin W. Kühlem
creators.role: Researcher, Visual Computing Institute, RWTH Aachen University
creators.bio: First author of a latency-optimized LLM dialogue system for embodied conversational agents in VR (IVA 2025).
creators.why: Latency is the first thing that breaks plausibility with LLM characters.
creators.role_zh: 亚琛工业大学视觉计算研究所研究员
creators.bio_zh: VR 中具身对话智能体低延迟大语言模型对话系统（IVA 2025）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 延迟是大语言模型角色最先破坏似真性的地方。

creators.name: Ramon Oliva
creators.bio: Develops VR systems and social VR studies with Mel Slater's group, including a 2026 study of an avatar swap and an LLM-driven Alan Turing on a conference panel.
creators.why: His study makes identity manipulation with look-alike avatars and LLM agents an empirical question.
creators.role_zh: 巴塞罗那大学 EventLab 研究员
creators.bio_zh: 与 Mel Slater 团队开发 VR 系统并开展社交 VR 研究，包括 2026 年关于会议小组讨论中化身互换与大语言模型驱动的艾伦·图灵的研究。
creators.why_zh: 他的研究把“用相似化身与大语言模型智能体操纵身份”变成了一个实证问题。

creators.name: Jianan Jiang
creators.role: PhD researcher, SNeC Lab, The Pennsylvania State University
creators.bio: HCI researcher on generative 3D authoring in extended reality, working with Bin Li at Penn State.
creators.why: PartInteractor makes generated XR objects editable part by part instead of regenerating them whole.
creators.role_zh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学 SNeC 实验室博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究扩展现实中的生成式三维创作，在宾州州立大学与 Bin Li 合作。
creators.why_zh: PartInteractor 让 XR 中生成的物体可以逐个部件编辑，而不必整体重新生成。
creators.based_zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州大学园

creators.name: Andy Serkis
creators.role: Actor, director and co-founder of Imaginarium Productions
creators.bio: Performance-capture actor and director (Gollum, Caesar) whose London studio Imaginarium works on performance capture and immersive storytelling.
creators.why: Co-directed Nevatars, a mixed-reality film for XR glasses in which animated characters hold Gemini-powered conversations with the viewer.
creators.role_zh: 演员、导演，Imaginarium Productions 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: 以动作捕捉表演闻名的演员与导演（咕噜、凯撒），其伦敦工作室 Imaginarium 从事表演捕捉与沉浸式叙事。
creators.why_zh: 联合执导 Nevatars：一部为 XR 眼镜打造的混合现实电影，动画角色通过 Gemini 与观众对话。

creators.name: Atlantic Studios
creators.role: Factual and immersive production company founded by Anthony Geffen
creators.bio: London studio (formerly Atlantic Productions) known for natural-history films with David Attenborough and for VR and XR documentaries.
creators.why: Its Galápagos: The Last Eden lets viewers talk to a Gemini-powered Charles Darwin inside a 3D natural-history film.
creators.role_zh: 由 Anthony Geffen 创立的纪实与沉浸式内容制作公司
creators.bio_zh: 伦敦制作公司（原名 Atlantic Productions），以与 David Attenborough 合作的自然历史影片和 VR、XR 纪录片知名。
creators.why_zh: 其作品《Galápagos: The Last Eden》让观众在三维自然历史影片中与由 Gemini 驱动的达尔文对话。

creators.name: Esen K. Tütüncü
creators.role: Researcher, Institute of Neurosciences, University of Barcelona
creators.bio: HCI and XR researcher; first author of PlayWrite, built with Autodesk Research in Toronto and San Francisco.
creators.why: PlayWrite turns playing with virtual characters on a table into a story an AI writes up with you.
creators.role_zh: 巴塞罗那大学神经科学研究所研究者
creators.bio_zh: HCI 与 XR 研究者，PlayWrite 的第一作者，该项目与 Autodesk Research（多伦多、旧金山）合作完成。
creators.why_zh: PlayWrite 把在桌面上摆弄虚拟角色的过程，变成与 AI 一起写出来的故事。

creators.name: Autodesk Research
creators.bio: Industrial research group on design, making and human-computer interaction, with a long record of UIST and CHI work on creative tools.
creators.why: Explores how generative AI can be steered by embodied, spatial interaction rather than text prompts.
creators.role_zh: Autodesk 的研究部门
creators.bio_zh: 专注设计、制造与人机交互的产业研究团队，长期在 UIST 和 CHI 发表创作工具方面的研究。
creators.why_zh: 探索如何用具身的空间交互、而不是文字提示，来引导生成式 AI。

creators.name: Weiwei Jiang
creators.role: Researcher, Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology
creators.bio: HCI researcher on human-AI co-design and virtual reality; led CoGen3D with collaborators in Japan, Australia, Denmark and Germany.
creators.why: CoGen3D tests at scale (N=120) whether people who co-design a VR scene's assets with an agent experience the scene differently.
creators.role_zh: 南京信息工程大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究人机协同设计与虚拟现实的 HCI 学者，与日本、澳大利亚、丹麦和德国的合作者共同完成 CoGen3D。
creators.why_zh: CoGen3D 以较大样本（N=120）检验：与智能体共同设计 VR 场景资产的人，体验场景时是否有所不同。

creators.name: Muzhe Wu
creators.bio: HCI researcher working with Anhong Guo and Xu Wang on AI-generated guidance for physical tasks.
creators.why: Generative Tutorial generates goal images and demonstration videos of the user's own workspace in AR, instead of replaying a tutorial shot elsewhere.
creators.role_zh: 密歇根大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Anhong Guo、Xu Wang 合作，研究为现实任务生成的 AI 指导。
creators.why_zh: Generative Tutorial 在 AR 中生成用户自己工作台的目标图与示范视频，而不是回放在别处拍摄的教程。
