creators.name: Yanni Mei
creators.role: PhD researcher, Technical University of Darmstadt
creators.bio: HCI researcher on perceptual manipulation in augmented reality, working with Jan Gugenheimer and Florian Müller.
creators.why: ShadAR lets a wearer rewrite how their passthrough view looks by typing what they want to see, or how they want to feel.
creators.role_zh: 达姆施塔特工业大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究增强现实中感知操控的 HCI 学者，与 Jan Gugenheimer、Florian Müller 合作。
creators.why_zh: ShadAR 让佩戴者只需写下想看到什么、甚至想有什么感受，就能改写透视画面的样子。

creators.name: Tareq Alsaleh
creators.role: Researcher, Laboratory of Innovations in Transportation (LiTrans), Toronto Metropolitan University
creators.bio: Transportation researcher in Bilal Farooq's LiTrans lab, which uses VR and XR for behavioural travel experiments.
creators.why: XARA lets transportation researchers build XR experiment scenes by speaking, without Unity skills.
creators.role_zh: 多伦多都会大学交通创新实验室（LiTrans）研究者
creators.bio_zh: Bilal Farooq 领导的 LiTrans 实验室的交通研究者，该实验室用 VR 与 XR 做出行行为实验。
creators.why_zh: XARA 让交通研究者用说话的方式搭建 XR 实验场景，无需掌握 Unity。

creators.name: Xianhao Carton Liu
creators.bio: HCI researcher on proxy-based interfaces for acting on real-world objects in AR, working with Zhu-Tian Chen and Mar Gonzalez-Franco.
creators.why: Generative Proxy generates, for each device and task, the virtual stand-ins through which a glasses wearer operates the physical world.
creators.role_zh: 明尼苏达大学 HCI 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究增强现实中通过代理界面操作现实物体的 HCI 学者，与陈朱天（Zhu-Tian Chen）、Mar Gonzalez-Franco 合作。
creators.why_zh: Generative Proxy 会针对每种设备和任务生成虚拟替身，眼镜佩戴者通过这些替身来操作物理世界。

creators.name: Sruti Srinidhi
creators.role: PhD researcher, WiSE Lab, Carnegie Mellon University
creators.bio: Works with Anthony Rowe at CMU on XR systems; first author of GenAssist (IEEE VR 2026).
creators.why: GenAssist generates running XR programs from a text prompt, so a scene's behaviour exists as readable code.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 WiSE 实验室博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在卡内基梅隆大学与 Anthony Rowe 合作研究 XR 系统，GenAssist（IEEE VR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GenAssist 能根据文字提示生成可直接运行的 XR 程序，让场景行为以可读的代码形式存在。
creators.based_zh: 美国宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡

creators.name: Jiayuan Wen
creators.role: Researcher, Virtual Environments and Computer Graphics group, University College London
creators.bio: Studies adaptive audio in VR with Anthony Steed, Daniele Giunchi and Eyal Ofek.
creators.why: Showed in a controlled VR study that live generated music changes both presence and motor performance.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院虚拟环境与计算机图形组研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Anthony Steed、Daniele Giunchi 和 Eyal Ofek 合作研究 VR 中的自适应音频。
creators.why_zh: 在受控 VR 实验中表明，实时生成的音乐同时改变临场感与动作表现。

creators.name: Yichen Chai
creators.role: Researcher, The Hong Kong Polytechnic University
creators.bio: Works with Henry Been-Lirn Duh on mixed-reality design tools; first author of GenerativeSurface (IEEE TVCG 2026).
creators.why: GenerativeSurface uses generation to give mid-air sketching a starting point instead of a finished object.
creators.role_zh: 香港理工大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Henry Been-Lirn Duh 合作研究混合现实设计工具，GenerativeSurface（IEEE TVCG 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GenerativeSurface 用生成来为空中草图提供起点，而不是直接给出成品。

creators.name: Cheng-Chih Tsai
creators.role: Researcher, National Taiwan University of Science and Technology
creators.bio: Works with Tse-Yu Pan and Ping-Hsuan Han on generative VR prototyping; first author of DreamCraft (IEEE VR 2026).
creators.why: Compared whole-scene and object-by-object generation as two ways of authoring a VR environment.
creators.role_zh: 台湾科技大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Tse-Yu Pan、Ping-Hsuan Han 合作研究生成式 VR 原型工具，DreamCraft（IEEE VR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把整场景生成与逐物体生成作为两种 VR 环境创作方式进行了对比。

creators.name: Dohui Lee
creators.role: Researcher, Graduate School of Metaverse, KAIST
creators.bio: Works with Sang Ho Yoon (KAIST) and Qi Sun (NYU) on VR interaction design; first author of HOICraft (CHI 2026).
creators.why: HOICraft uses a vision-language model to decide how objects in VR respond to hands.
creators.role_zh: 韩国科学技术院（KAIST）元宇宙研究生院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Sang Ho Yoon（KAIST）和 Qi Sun（纽约大学）合作研究 VR 交互设计，HOICraft（CHI 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: HOICraft 用视觉语言模型来决定 VR 中的物体如何回应双手。

creators.name: Yiliu Tang
creators.role: Researcher, School of Information Sciences, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
creators.bio: Works with Yun Huang on generative AI in XR; first author of 'Empowered XR through Generative AI' (CHI 2026).
creators.why: Gives a taxonomy that pairs each generative capability in XR with its risk.
creators.role_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校信息科学学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Yun Huang 合作研究 XR 中的生成式 AI，《Empowered XR through Generative AI》（CHI 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 提出一套分类，把 XR 中每一种生成能力与其对应风险配对起来。

creators.name: Chen Yang
creators.role: Researcher, Changchun University of Science and Technology
creators.bio: Studies collaborative virtual environments with Chunyi Chen; first author of 'One Word, One World' (Virtual Reality, 2026).
creators.why: Measured how voice-driven generation changes social presence in multi-user VR, with N = 48.
creators.role_zh: 长春理工大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Chunyi Chen 合作研究协同虚拟环境，《One Word, One World》（Virtual Reality，2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 以 N = 48 的实验测量了语音驱动生成如何改变多人 VR 中的社会临场感。

creators.name: Junlong Chen
creators.role: PhD researcher, Department of Engineering, University of Cambridge
creators.bio: Works with Per Ola Kristensson on LLM-assisted editing of immersive scenes.
creators.why: Quantified how often LLM scene editors misreport their own edits and how rarely users notice.
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学工程系博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Per Ola Kristensson 合作研究大语言模型辅助的沉浸式场景编辑。
creators.why_zh: 量化了大语言模型场景编辑器错误报告自身操作的频率，以及用户察觉的程度有多低。

creators.name: Duotun Wang
creators.role: PhD researcher, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
creators.bio: Works with Zeyu Wang and Mingming Fan on generative AI for mixed reality; first author of a 2026 IJHCI survey of visual GenAI in MR.
creators.why: The survey maps how visual generative models are being built into VR and AR interfaces.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Zeyu Wang、Mingming Fan 合作研究面向混合现实的生成式 AI，2026 年 IJHCI 视觉生成式 AI 与 MR 综述第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 该综述梳理了视觉生成模型如何被融入 VR 与 AR 界面。

creators.name: Haotian Mao
creators.bio: Haotian Mao is first author of LIVE-GS (IEEE VR 2026, TVCG), written with Xubo Yang and colleagues at Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Nianchen Deng of Shanghai AI Lab.
creators.why: LIVE-GS lets a language model set the physics of a captured Gaussian-splat scene so it can be handled in VR.
creators.role_zh: 上海交通大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Haotian Mao 是 LIVE-GS（IEEE VR 2026，TVCG）的第一作者，合作者包括上海交通大学的 Xubo Yang 等人以及上海人工智能实验室的 Nianchen Deng。
creators.why_zh: LIVE-GS 让语言模型为采集得到的高斯泼溅场景设定物理属性，使人可以在 VR 中直接操作它。

creators.name: Reality Design Lab
creators.role: Independent design research lab for mixed reality, directed by Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.bio: Makes mixed-reality artworks, open-source toolkits (HoloKit, HoloMask, MultipeerConnectivity for Unity) and teaching programmes under the motto 'design new realities'; its works have been shown at SIGGRAPH, CHI, IEEE VR and Ars Electronica.
creators.why: Builds generated situations that people act inside, from AI-generated video consequences for rehearsing choices to mixed-reality lenses that rewrite bodies as glyphs, and runs the research agenda behind this gallery.
creators.role_zh: 由 Botao 'Amber' Hu 主持的混合现实独立设计研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 以“设计新现实”为宗旨，创作混合现实艺术作品，开发开源工具（HoloKit、HoloMask、Unity 版 MultipeerConnectivity），并开展教学项目；作品曾在 SIGGRAPH、CHI、IEEE VR 与 Ars Electronica 展出。
creators.why_zh: 构建让人置身其中、采取行动的生成情境：从用 AI 生成的视频后果来预演选择，到把身体姿态改写为文字的混合现实镜头；也是本图鉴背后研究议程的发起者。

creators.name: Botao 'Amber' Hu
creators.role: Researcher, University of Oxford; founder of Reality Design Lab; inventor of HoloKit
creators.bio: Designer and researcher (Tsinghua BS, Stanford MS in AI) who leads Reality Design Lab's work on embodied, social mixed reality, speculative design and generative futuring; the lab's works have been shown at SIGGRAPH, CHI, TEI and Ars Electronica.
creators.why: Proposes Generative Enactments, a method in which participants act inside reactive AI-generated video scenarios and see the consequences of their choices unfold.
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学研究者；Reality Design Lab 创始人；HoloKit 发明者
creators.bio_zh: 设计师与研究者（清华大学本科、斯坦福大学人工智能硕士），主持 Reality Design Lab 在具身与社交混合现实、思辨设计和生成式未来构想方面的研究；实验室作品曾在 SIGGRAPH、CHI、TEI 与 Ars Electronica 展出。
creators.why_zh: 提出“生成式演绎”（Generative Enactments）方法：参与者在会作出反应的 AI 生成视频情境中行动，并看到自己选择带来的后果逐步展开。

creators.name: Danlin Huang
creators.role: Designer-researcher, School of Design Innovation, China Academy of Art
creators.bio: Designer and researcher who works with Reality Design Lab on speculative, body-centred mixed-reality works such as Body Oracle and FungiSync.
creators.why: Leads Body Oracle Translator, a handheld lens that turns live body postures into AI-generated glyphs.
creators.role_zh: 设计研究者，中国美术学院创新设计学院
creators.bio_zh: 与 Reality Design Lab 合作创作以身体为中心的思辨混合现实作品，如 Body Oracle 与 FungiSync。
creators.why_zh: 主导“身体甲骨文翻译器”：一个把实时身体姿态转写为 AI 生成文字的手持镜头。

creators.name: Ryo Suzuki
creators.role: Assistant Professor, ATLAS Institute and Computer Science, University of Colorado Boulder; director of the Programmable Reality Lab
creators.bio: HCI researcher working at the intersection of AR/VR, tangible interfaces and AI; the lab's 'Generative AR' theme aims to make the physical world a canvas for generative AI.
creators.why: Suzuki's lab produces a steady line of generative mixed-reality systems, including CinemaWorld, Editing Reality and Video2MR.
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校 ATLAS 研究所与计算机系助理教授，Programmable Reality Lab 负责人
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，研究 AR/VR、实体界面与 AI 的交叉；实验室的“生成式 AR”方向希望把物理世界变成生成式 AI 的画布。
creators.why_zh: 其实验室持续产出生成式混合现实系统，包括 CinemaWorld、Editing Reality 与 Video2MR。
creators.based_zh: 美国科罗拉多州博尔德

creators.name: Suibi Che-Chuan Weng
creators.role: HCI researcher, ATLAS Institute, University of Colorado Boulder
creators.bio: Researcher in creative mixed reality and generative AI; first author of Editing Reality (DIS 2026).
creators.why: Treats generation as a spatial design material that people shape in place, instead of a one-shot command.
creators.role_zh: 科罗拉多大学博尔德分校 ATLAS 研究所人机交互研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究创意混合现实与生成式 AI，Editing Reality（DIS 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把生成当作可以在现场塑造的空间设计材料，而不是一次性指令。
creators.based_zh: 美国科罗拉多州博尔德

creators.name: Keiichi Ihara
creators.role: PhD student, Programmable Reality Lab (University of Colorado Boulder) and University of Tsukuba
creators.bio: HCI researcher building mixed-reality systems that turn 2D media such as films and tutorial videos into spatial content.
creators.why: First author of CinemaWorld and Video2MR, which pull generated 3D content out of 2D video and place it in the viewer's room.
creators.role_zh: Programmable Reality Lab（科罗拉多大学博尔德分校）与筑波大学博士生
creators.bio_zh: 人机交互研究者，构建把电影、教学视频等二维媒介转化为空间内容的混合现实系统。
creators.why_zh: CinemaWorld 与 Video2MR 的第一作者：从二维视频中提取并生成三维内容，放进观者所在的房间。

creators.name: Amina Kobenova
creators.role: HCI researcher; first author of Social Conjuring with Microsoft collaborators
creators.bio: Researcher on social, multi-user creation with generative AI in virtual worlds; co-authors include Judith Amores and Jaron Lanier.
creators.why: Social Conjuring asks how prompting a world into existence changes when several people do it together.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者；与微软合作者完成 Social Conjuring 的第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟世界中借助生成式 AI 的多人社交创作；合作者包括 Judith Amores 与 Jaron Lanier。
creators.why_zh: Social Conjuring 追问：当几个人一起用提示词“召唤”世界时，生成过程会怎样改变。

creators.name: Fernanda De La Torre
creators.role: Researcher, MIT Brain and Cognitive Sciences; LLMR lead author with Microsoft
creators.bio: Researcher who led LLMR, a Microsoft framework for creating and editing interactive mixed-reality worlds with language models.
creators.why: LLMR showed that orchestrated language models can write and debug the code of a live Unity world from a spoken or typed request.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院脑与认知科学系研究者；与微软合作的 LLMR 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 主导 LLMR：微软用语言模型创建与修改交互式混合现实世界的框架。
creators.why_zh: LLMR 证明，多个语言模型协同可以根据口头或文字请求，为正在运行的 Unity 世界编写并调试代码。

creators.name: Lei Zhang
creators.role: HCI researcher (University of Michigan PhD; now New Jersey Institute of Technology)
creators.bio: Researcher on human-AI co-creation in immersive authoring, from VRCopilot (University of Michigan) to Capybara (with the Princeton HCI Lab).
creators.why: Studies how much control people keep when generative models build their VR and AR scenes for them.
creators.role_zh: 人机交互研究者（密歇根大学博士，现任职于新泽西理工学院）
creators.bio_zh: 研究沉浸式创作中的人机共创，从 VRCopilot（密歇根大学）到 Capybara（与普林斯顿 HCI 实验室合作）。
creators.why_zh: 研究当生成模型替人搭建 VR 与 AR 场景时，人还能保留多少控制权。

creators.name: Nels Numan
creators.role: PhD researcher, University College London; Microsoft Research collaborator
creators.bio: Researcher in collaborative mixed reality and telepresence; first author of SpaceBlender and co-author of XR Blocks.
creators.why: SpaceBlender generates shared VR spaces out of each participant's real surroundings, so a meeting place feels familiar to everyone.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦大学学院博士研究者；微软研究院合作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究协作式混合现实与远程临场，SpaceBlender 第一作者，也是 XR Blocks 的合作者。
creators.why_zh: SpaceBlender 用每位参与者的真实环境生成共享 VR 空间，让会面场所对每个人都有熟悉感。

creators.name: Cyrus Vachha
creators.role: Researcher, EECS, University of California, Berkeley
creators.bio: Researcher in immersive 3D authoring and radiance fields (NeRF, Gaussian splatting), working with Björn Hartmann.
creators.why: Dreamcrafter brings generative edits of captured radiance-field scenes into VR, with stand-in proxies while slow generations run.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校电子工程与计算机系研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究沉浸式三维创作与辐射场（NeRF、高斯泼溅），与 Björn Hartmann 合作。
creators.why_zh: Dreamcrafter 把对捕捉辐射场场景的生成式编辑带进 VR，并在生成较慢时用代理表示维持交互。

creators.name: Jaewook Lee
creators.role: PhD researcher, Makeability Lab, University of Washington
creators.bio: HCI researcher on AI-powered augmented reality; led ImaginateAR with Niantic Spatial.
creators.why: ImaginateAR lets anyone speak an outdoor AR scene into a real park or street.
creators.role_zh: 华盛顿大学 Makeability Lab 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究 AI 驱动的增强现实，与 Niantic Spatial 合作主导 ImaginateAR。
creators.why_zh: ImaginateAR 让任何人都能用一句话，把 AR 场景放进真实的公园或街道。

creators.name: Niantic Spatial
creators.role: Geospatial AI company spun out of Niantic
creators.bio: Builds large geospatial models, visual positioning and mapping for AR, after Niantic sold its games business in 2025.
creators.why: Its scene understanding and fast 3D asset generation power ImaginateAR's outdoor in-situ authoring.
creators.role_zh: 从 Niantic 独立出来的地理空间 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: 在 Niantic 于 2025 年出售游戏业务后，专注大型地理空间模型、视觉定位与 AR 地图。
creators.why_zh: 其场景理解与快速三维资产生成为 ImaginateAR 的户外现场创作提供支撑。

creators.name: Erzhen Hu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Department of Computer Science, University of Virginia
creators.bio: HCI researcher on XR communication; first author of Thing2Reality with Google XR collaborators.
creators.why: Thing2Reality turns any 2D image or object in a call into a 3D Gaussian object that remote participants can hold and point at.
creators.role_zh: 弗吉尼亚大学计算机系博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究 XR 通信，与 Google XR 合作者完成 Thing2Reality 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Thing2Reality 把通话中的任意二维图像或物体变成三维高斯物体，让异地参与者都能拿起来、指着讨论。
creators.based_zh: 美国弗吉尼亚州夏洛茨维尔

creators.name: Ruofei Du
creators.role: Interactive perception and graphics lead, Google XR
creators.based: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, USA
creators.bio: Researcher in interactive graphics and AI for XR; leads XR Blocks and co-authored Thing2Reality and Sensible Agent.
creators.why: Vibe Coding XR turns a one-line prompt into a working mixed-reality app that runs in a headset.
creators.role_zh: Google XR 交互感知与图形负责人
creators.bio_zh: 研究面向 XR 的交互图形与 AI，主导 XR Blocks，参与 Thing2Reality 与 Sensible Agent。
creators.why_zh: Vibe Coding XR 把一句提示词变成能在头显里运行的混合现实应用。

creators.name: Ryutaro Kurai
creators.bio: Researcher at the Japanese social VR platform Cluster, working on LLM-based creation tools for its users.
creators.why: MagicItem put LLM-written object behaviours into a live consumer metaverse and tested them with its ordinary users.
creators.role_zh: Cluster 公司研究者（Cluster Metaverse Lab）
creators.bio_zh: 日本社交 VR 平台 Cluster 的研究者，为平台用户开发基于大语言模型的创作工具。
creators.why_zh: MagicItem 把由大语言模型编写的物体行为放进真实运营的消费级元宇宙，并让普通用户实际使用。

creators.name: Zhuangze Hou
creators.role: Researcher, School of Creative Media, City University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: HCI researcher on AI-assisted spatial design in virtual reality; first author of EchoLadder (UIST 2025).
creators.why: EchoLadder turns vague spoken wishes into step-by-step scene suggestions that a VR designer can accept, regenerate or retract.
creators.role_zh: 香港城市大学创意媒体学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究虚拟现实中由 AI 辅助的空间设计，EchoLadder（UIST 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: EchoLadder 把模糊的口头意图拆成一步步的场景建议，VR 设计者可以采纳、重做或撤回。

creators.name: Haoyu Wang
creators.role: Researcher, Dyson School of Design Engineering, Imperial College London
creators.bio: HCI researcher on haptics and generative AI in mixed reality; led Prop-Chromeleon with collaborators at the University of Toronto's Dynamic Graphics Project.
creators.why: Prop-Chromeleon makes generated objects match the shape of whatever real object is in your hand, so sight and touch agree.
creators.role_zh: 伦敦帝国理工学院戴森设计工程学院研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究混合现实中的触觉与生成式 AI，与多伦多大学 Dynamic Graphics Project 合作者共同完成 Prop-Chromeleon。
creators.why_zh: Prop-Chromeleon 让生成的虚拟物体贴合你手中真实物体的形状，使视觉与触觉一致。

creators.name: Nozomu Iwai
creators.bio: Researcher at Preferred Networks; first author, with Fabrice Matulic, of the AR talking-objects study (CHI 2025 Extended Abstracts).
creators.why: Gives everyday household objects AI personalities that talk about, and react to, the room they are in.
creators.role_zh: Preferred Networks 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Preferred Networks 研究者，与 Fabrice Matulic 合作完成 AR 会说话物件研究（CHI 2025 扩展摘要）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 为家中日常物件赋予 AI 人格，让它们谈论并回应自己所处的房间。

creators.name: Preferred Networks
creators.bio: Tokyo-based AI company that develops deep-learning models, AI chips and applied research, including AR and character interaction.
creators.why: Its researchers built AR characters that live on real objects and hold grounded conversations about the room.
creators.role_zh: 日本人工智能公司
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于东京的 AI 公司，开发深度学习模型与 AI 芯片，并开展包括 AR 与角色交互在内的应用研究。
creators.why_zh: 其研究者打造了栖身于真实物体之上的 AR 角色，能围绕房间展开有现实依据的对话。

creators.name: Tianyi Xiao
creators.role: Researcher, Institute of Cartography and Geoinformation, ETH Zurich
creators.bio: Researcher on spatial cognition, sketch mapping and augmented reality.
creators.why: Sketch2Terrain turns a few AR pen strokes into a full terrain in real time and doubles as a uniform setup for spatial-cognition experiments.
creators.role_zh: 苏黎世联邦理工学院制图与地理信息研究所研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究空间认知、草图地图与增强现实。
creators.why_zh: Sketch2Terrain 把几笔 AR 草图实时变成完整地形，同时为空间认知实验提供统一的实验环境。

creators.name: Ars Electronica Futurelab
creators.role: Art and technology research lab of Ars Electronica
creators.bio: Interdisciplinary lab at the intersection of art, technology and society, known for Deep Space 8K and collaborations with industry partners.
creators.why: With Dai Nippon Printing it built NeXus Print, a shared Quest 3 sandbox where groups prompt 3D worlds together.
creators.role_zh: Ars Electronica 的艺术与科技研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 处于艺术、技术与社会交叉点的跨学科实验室，以 Deep Space 8K 及与产业伙伴的合作闻名。
creators.why_zh: 与大日本印刷（DNP）合作打造 NeXus Print：一个多人在 Quest 3 里共同用提示词搭建三维世界的沙盒。

creators.name: Figmin XR
creators.role: Independent team behind the mixed-reality creation app Figmin XR
creators.bio: Makes Figmin XR, a cross-platform app (Quest, Vision Pro, HoloLens) for building and sharing mixed-reality scenes, toys and scripted objects.
creators.why: One of the first consumer MR apps to put text-to-3D generation and LLM scripting inside the headset.
creators.role_zh: 混合现实创作应用 Figmin XR 背后的独立团队
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Figmin XR：一款跨平台（Quest、Vision Pro、HoloLens）的应用，用于搭建和分享混合现实场景、玩具与可编程物体。
creators.why_zh: 最早把文生三维与大语言模型编程放进头显的消费级混合现实应用之一。

creators.name: Stijn Spanhove
creators.role: XR developer, In The Pocket; Snap Spectacles creator
creators.bio: Developer who publishes short proofs of concept that combine AR glasses, Vision Pro and generative models.
creators.why: Spanhove's demos are an early public record of world models, real-time video models and splat pipelines running inside headsets and glasses.
creators.role_zh: In The Pocket 公司 XR 开发者；Snap Spectacles 创作者
creators.bio_zh: 持续发布把 AR 眼镜、Vision Pro 与生成模型结合起来的短小概念验证。
creators.why_zh: Spanhove 的演示较早公开记录了世界模型、实时视频模型与高斯泼溅流程在头显与眼镜中运行的样子。

creators.name: Bangbang Yang
creators.bio: Researcher in neural rendering and scene editing for XR.
creators.why: DreamSpace re-textures a scanned room from a text prompt so it can be walked through, restyled, in a headset.
creators.role_zh: 字节跳动 PICO 混合现实团队研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究面向 XR 的神经渲染与场景编辑。
creators.why_zh: DreamSpace 根据文字提示为扫描的房间重新生成纹理，让人戴上头显走进被重绘的空间。

creators.name: Xueyang Wang
creators.bio: HCI researcher on cross-reality authoring and spatially grounded generation; first author of Roomify (CHI 2026).
creators.why: Roomify keeps a room's furniture layout but restyles everything else, so people stay safe and still feel elsewhere.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究跨现实创作与空间锚定的生成，Roomify（CHI 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Roomify 保留房间家具的布局，只改换其余一切风格，让人既安全又仿佛身处他处。

creators.name: Decart
creators.role: AI lab building real-time generative video and world models
creators.based: San Francisco, CA, USA / Tel Aviv, Israel
creators.bio: Start-up behind Oasis (a real-time generated Minecraft-like world) and the MirageLSD live video-to-video model, offered through an API.
creators.why: Its open-source Decart XR app streams a headset's passthrough through a live video model, restyling the room from a spoken prompt.
creators.role_zh: 构建实时生成视频与世界模型的 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 初创公司，推出实时生成的类 Minecraft 世界 Oasis 与实时视频到视频模型 MirageLSD，并通过 API 提供。
creators.why_zh: 其开源应用 Decart XR 把头显透视画面送入实时视频模型，根据口头提示重绘整个房间。
creators.based_zh: 美国旧金山／以色列特拉维夫

creators.name: Roberto Coviello
creators.role: XR and AI engineer; author of QuestCameraKit
creators.bio: Engineer who maintains QuestCameraKit, open-source samples for Meta Quest's Passthrough Camera API.
creators.why: Built Decart XR with Decart, one of the first public apps that restyle passthrough with a real-time video model.
creators.role_zh: XR 与 AI 工程师；QuestCameraKit 作者
creators.bio_zh: 维护 QuestCameraKit：基于 Meta Quest 透视摄像头 API 的开源示例集。
creators.why_zh: 与 Decart 合作打造 Decart XR，这是最早用实时视频模型重绘透视画面的公开应用之一。

creators.name: Hugues Bruyère
creators.bio: Creative technologist who prototypes interactive installations and mixed-reality experiences with real-time generative models.
creators.why: Bruyère's MR + Diffusion prototype was among the first to run diffusion on Quest passthrough once Meta opened camera access in 2025.
creators.role_zh: Dpt.（蒙特利尔）合伙人与创新负责人
creators.bio_zh: 创意技术专家，用实时生成模型制作交互装置与混合现实体验原型。
creators.why_zh: Meta 在 2025 年开放摄像头访问后，Bruyère 的“MR + Diffusion”原型是最早在 Quest 透视画面上运行扩散模型的作品之一。

creators.name: Alessio Grancini
creators.role: AR engineer; Snap Spectacles developer relations
creators.bio: AR engineer (formerly at Magic Leap) who builds and teaches Spectacles experiments.
creators.why: Showed a real-time generative video filter running on see-through AR glasses at world scale.
creators.role_zh: AR 工程师；Snap Spectacles 开发者关系
creators.bio_zh: AR 工程师（曾任职 Magic Leap），制作并讲解 Spectacles 实验项目。
creators.why_zh: 展示了在透视式 AR 眼镜上以真实尺度运行的实时生成视频滤镜。

creators.name: Snap Inc.
creators.role: Camera company; Snapchat, Lens Studio and Spectacles / SPECS AR glasses
creators.bio: Maker of Snapchat Lenses, used billions of times a day, and of standalone AR glasses: Spectacles for developers (2024) and the consumer SPECS (2026).
creators.why: Moves generative models into AR lenses and glasses: on-device real-time image generation and the Snap3D API for creating 3D objects inside Lenses.
creators.role_zh: 相机公司；Snapchat、Lens Studio 与 Spectacles / SPECS AR 眼镜
creators.bio_zh: Snapchat 镜头（每天使用数十亿次）的开发者，也推出独立 AR 眼镜：面向开发者的 Spectacles（2024）与消费级 SPECS（2026）。
creators.why_zh: 把生成模型搬进 AR 镜头与眼镜：端侧实时图像生成，以及在镜头内生成三维物体的 Snap3D API。

creators.name: Naisha Agarwal
creators.role: Researcher, University of California, Los Angeles; Microsoft Research collaborator
creators.bio: HCI researcher who led Storycaster with Judith Amores and Andrew D. Wilson at Microsoft Research.
creators.why: Storycaster turns a projected room into a story that a narrator agent and the audience write together.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校研究者；微软研究院合作者
creators.bio_zh: 与微软研究院的 Judith Amores、Andrew D. Wilson 合作主导 Storycaster。
creators.why_zh: Storycaster 把投影房间变成由叙述者智能体与观众共同书写的故事。

creators.name: Light in the Head
creators.role: Studio of Marc Da Costa and Matthew Niederhauser
creators.bio: Artist duo working with machine learning, VR and installations; also co-founders of Sensorium.
creators.why: Their Tulpamancer generates a one-off VR journey from each visitor's answers and deletes it afterwards.
creators.role_zh: Marc Da Costa 与 Matthew Niederhauser 的工作室
creators.bio_zh: 使用机器学习、VR 与装置创作的艺术家二人组，也是 Sensorium 的联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: 他们的 Tulpamancer 根据每位观众的回答生成独一无二的 VR 旅程，结束后即删除。

creators.name: Transitional Forms
creators.role: AI entertainment studio founded by Pietro Gagliano
creators.bio: Studio that builds stories and games around live AI agents, from the dynamic film Agence (with the National Film Board of Canada) to multi-agent story simulations.
creators.why: Agence was an early 'dynamic film' whose characters are driven by reinforcement-learning agents that viewers can disturb.
creators.role_zh: 由 Pietro Gagliano 创立的 AI 娱乐工作室
creators.bio_zh: 围绕实时 AI 智能体创作故事与游戏的工作室，作品从与加拿大国家电影局合作的动态电影 Agence，到多智能体故事模拟。
creators.why_zh: Agence 是早期的“动态电影”：角色由强化学习智能体驱动，观众可以出手干预。

creators.name: Liquid City
creators.role: Design studio founded by Keiichi Matsuda
creators.bio: Studio led by the designer and filmmaker Keiichi Matsuda (Hyper-Reality, Merger) that designs AR, AI agents and spatial interfaces.
creators.why: Life Stories turns a person's spoken memory into an explorable 3D world.
creators.role_zh: 由 Keiichi Matsuda 创立的设计工作室
creators.bio_zh: 由设计师、电影人 Keiichi Matsuda（Hyper-Reality、Merger）领导的工作室，设计 AR、AI 智能体与空间界面。
creators.why_zh: Life Stories 把一个人口述的回忆变成可以漫游的三维世界。

creators.name: Tomoki Itamiya
creators.bio: Researcher who builds AR and VR disaster-education tools, such as flood and earthquake simulations overlaid on real rooms and streets.
creators.why: Uses generative video to stage a disaster inside the very room where people would need to react.
creators.role_zh: 爱知工科大学教授
creators.bio_zh: 开发 AR 与 VR 防灾教育工具，例如叠加在真实房间与街道上的洪水和地震模拟。
creators.why_zh: 用生成视频把灾害“搬进”人们真正需要作出反应的那个房间。

creators.name: Samsung Electronics
creators.role: Electronics company; maker of the Galaxy XR headset
creators.bio: Consumer-electronics company that co-developed Android XR with Google and Qualcomm and launched the Galaxy XR headset in October 2025.
creators.why: Galaxy XR is the first headset to ship Android XR's system-wide auto-spatialization of 2D apps and media.
creators.role_zh: 电子公司；Galaxy XR 头显制造商
creators.bio_zh: 与谷歌、高通共同开发 Android XR，并于 2025 年 10 月推出 Galaxy XR 头显。
creators.why_zh: Galaxy XR 是首款上线 Android XR 系统级二维应用与媒体自动空间化的头显。

creators.name: Ting-Bing Xu
creators.bio: First author of WorldRoamBench, built by Amap's computer-vision lab with Nanjing, Tsinghua and Peking universities.
creators.why: WorldRoamBench measures how interactive world models hold up over minute-long walks, not just a few seconds.
creators.role_zh: 高德地图视觉实验室（阿里巴巴）研究者
creators.bio_zh: WorldRoamBench 的第一作者；该基准由高德地图视觉实验室与南京大学、清华大学、北京大学共同构建。
creators.why_zh: WorldRoamBench 衡量交互式世界模型在接近一分钟的漫游中能否保持稳定，而不只是几秒钟。

creators.name: Shengjun Zhang
creators.bio: Co-first author of MBench with Zhang Zhang, from Yueqi Duan's group at Tsinghua with Tencent WeChat Vision.
creators.why: MBench turns 'does the world model remember?' into twelve measurable sub-questions.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与张章共同担任 MBench 第一作者，来自清华大学段岳圻课题组，并与腾讯微信视觉团队合作。
creators.why_zh: MBench 把“世界模型记得住吗？”拆成十二个可测量的子问题。

creators.name: Tsai-Shien Chen
creators.bio: First author of Panda-70M, made during an internship at Snap Research.
creators.why: Panda-70M is one of the large captioned video corpora that open video generators are trained on.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学默塞德分校 / Snap Research 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Panda-70M 的第一作者，该工作完成于其在 Snap Research 实习期间。
creators.why_zh: Panda-70M 是开源视频生成模型常用的大规模带字幕视频语料之一。

creators.name: Guan-Ting Lin
creators.bio: Speech researcher in Hung-yi Lee's lab and first author of Full-Duplex-Bench, developed with UC Berkeley collaborators.
creators.why: Full-Duplex-Bench is the shared test for pause handling, backchannels, turn-taking and interruption in voice models.
creators.role_zh: 台湾大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 李宏毅课题组的语音研究者，Full-Duplex-Bench 的第一作者，该基准与加州大学伯克利分校的合作者共同开发。
creators.why_zh: Full-Duplex-Bench 是检验语音模型停顿处理、附和回应、轮流发言与打断应对的通用测试。

creators.name: Rajmund Nagy
creators.role: PhD researcher, KTH Royal Institute of Technology
creators.bio: Works on gesture generation with Gustav Eje Henter at KTH; first author of the GENEA Challenge 2026 report.
creators.why: GENEA runs the large human evaluations that show how far generated gestures are from real conversational behavior.
creators.role_zh: 瑞典皇家理工学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在瑞典皇家理工学院与 Gustav Eje Henter 合作研究手势生成，GENEA Challenge 2026 报告的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GENEA 组织大规模人工评测，揭示生成手势距离真实对话行为还有多远。

creators.name: Kaining Ying
creators.role: Researcher at Fudan University; first author of WBench
creators.bio: First author of WBench (2026), a multi-turn benchmark and public leaderboard for interactive video world models built by Fudan University and Meituan's LongCat team.
creators.why: Gives interactive world models a shared multi-turn test across text, pose and keyboard control.
creators.role_zh: 复旦大学研究者，WBench 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WBench（2026）的第一作者。WBench 是复旦大学与美团 LongCat 团队构建的交互视频世界模型多轮评测基准，并设有公开排行榜。
creators.why_zh: 为交互世界模型提供一套跨文字、位姿与键盘控制的通用多轮测试。

creators.name: Kaixin Ding
creators.bio: First author of PlayWorld (2026), a benchmark from Kuaishou and the University of Hong Kong in which multimodal agents play world models toward long-horizon objectives.
creators.why: Evaluates world models by what an agent can accomplish inside them.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，PlayWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: PlayWorld（2026）的第一作者。PlayWorld 是快手与香港大学推出的基准，让多模态智能体在世界模型中追求长时程目标。
creators.why_zh: 以智能体能在世界模型中完成什么来评估世界模型。

creators.name: Jianjie Fang
creators.role: Researcher at Tsinghua University; first author of iWorld-Bench
creators.bio: First author of iWorld-Bench (ICML 2026), a benchmark and leaderboard for the interaction abilities of world models released under Tsinghua's EmbodiedCity project.
creators.why: Makes world models with different control interfaces comparable on distance perception and memory.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学研究者，iWorld-Bench 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: iWorld-Bench（ICML 2026）的第一作者。该基准与排行榜用于评测世界模型的交互能力，在清华大学 EmbodiedCity 项目下发布。
creators.why_zh: 让控制接口不同的世界模型能在距离感知与记忆上相互比较。

creators.name: Jinpeng Lu
creators.bio: First author of 'Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core' (2026), which introduces the WRBench diagnostic benchmark; the project page lists USTC, CASIA, X-Humanoid and TU Dresden among the contributing institutions.
creators.why: Tests whether generated worlds keep evolving when they are not being watched.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，WRBench 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 论文《Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core》（2026）的第一作者，该文提出诊断性基准 WRBench；项目主页列出的参与机构包括中国科学技术大学、中国科学院自动化研究所、X-Humanoid 与德累斯顿工业大学。
creators.why_zh: 检验生成的世界在无人注视时是否仍在继续演化。

creators.name: Sungnyun Kim
creators.role: PhD researcher, Kim Jaechul Graduate School of AI, KAIST
creators.bio: Works with Se-Young Yun at KAIST AI on speech and dialogue models; first author of DyaFDB (2026).
creators.why: DyaFDB evaluates full-duplex voice models by letting two of them talk to each other.
creators.role_zh: 韩国科学技术院（KAIST）金在哲人工智能研究生院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在 KAIST AI 与 Se-Young Yun 合作研究语音与对话模型，DyaFDB（2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: DyaFDB 让两个全双工语音模型彼此对话，以此评估它们。

creators.name: fal
creators.bio: Hosts more than 1,000 image, video, audio and 3D models behind one API and offers serverless GPUs.
creators.why: A common route by which apps reach many video and 3D generators, including Chinese models, through one integration.
creators.role_zh: 生成式媒体推理平台
creators.bio_zh: 通过一个 API 托管 1,000 多个图像、视频、音频与三维模型，并提供 Serverless GPU。
creators.why_zh: 应用常经由它，用一次接入调用众多视频与三维生成模型，其中也包括中国模型。

creators.name: Replicate
creators.bio: Runs open and proprietary models behind versioned HTTP endpoints; creator of the Cog container format.
creators.why: Version-pinned model endpoints make it easier to reproduce which generator produced a stimulus.
creators.role_zh: 模型托管平台（并入 Cloudflare）
creators.bio_zh: 以带版本号的 HTTP 接口运行开源与闭源模型，Cog 容器格式的创建者。
creators.why_zh: 可锁定版本的模型接口，让人更容易复现某个刺激材料出自哪个生成器。

creators.name: Runway
creators.bio: Maker of the Gen and Aleph video models and of world-model research (GWM-1); sells an app and a developer API.
creators.why: One of the main commercial sources of generated video and real-time characters for builders.
creators.role_zh: AI 视频公司
creators.bio_zh: Gen 与 Aleph 视频模型的开发者，也做世界模型研究（GWM-1）；同时提供应用与开发者 API。
creators.why_zh: 为开发者提供生成视频与实时角色的主要商业来源之一。

creators.name: World Labs
creators.bio: Founded by Fei-Fei Li and colleagues; makes the Marble world model and the Spark splat renderer.
creators.why: Its World API is the first public API that returns explicit, explorable 3D worlds.
creators.role_zh: 空间智能公司
creators.bio_zh: 由李飞飞等人创立，开发 Marble 世界模型与 Spark 泼溅渲染器。
creators.why_zh: 它的 World API 是第一个直接返回显式、可探索三维世界的公开 API。

creators.name: Volcano Engine (BytePlus)
creators.bio: ByteDance's cloud and model-as-a-service business, branded BytePlus outside China.
creators.why: It is the official API route to ByteDance Seed's Seedance video and Doubao models.
creators.role_zh: 字节跳动旗下云平台
creators.bio_zh: 字节跳动的云服务与模型即服务业务，海外品牌为 BytePlus。
creators.why_zh: 它是调用字节跳动 Seed 团队 Seedance 视频模型与豆包模型的官方 API 途径。

creators.name: LiveKit
creators.bio: Builds an open-source WebRTC media server, the LiveKit Agents framework and LiveKit Cloud.
creators.why: Its stack carries many production voice and avatar agents.
creators.role_zh: 实时音视频基础设施公司
creators.bio_zh: 开发开源 WebRTC 媒体服务器、LiveKit Agents 框架与 LiveKit Cloud。
creators.why_zh: 大量上线运行的语音与虚拟人智能体都跑在它的技术栈上。

creators.name: Daily
creators.role: WebRTC video and voice infrastructure company
creators.bio: Provides real-time video APIs and maintains the open-source Pipecat agent framework and Pipecat Cloud.
creators.why: Pipecat is a widely used open pipeline for voice and multimodal agents.
creators.role_zh: WebRTC 音视频基础设施公司
creators.bio_zh: 提供实时视频 API，维护开源智能体框架 Pipecat 与 Pipecat Cloud。
creators.why_zh: Pipecat 是使用广泛的开源语音与多模态智能体流水线。

creators.name: Agora
creators.bio: Runs a global real-time network for voice and video SDKs, the Conversational AI Engine, and backs the open-source TEN Framework.
creators.why: It brings network-level robustness to voice agents and virtual humans deployed outside the lab.
creators.role_zh: 实时互动平台
creators.bio_zh: 运营面向音视频 SDK 的全球实时网络，推出对话式 AI 引擎，并支持开源 TEN Framework。
creators.why_zh: 它为走出实验室的语音智能体与虚拟人提供网络层面的稳定性。
creators.based_zh: 美国圣克拉拉 / 中国上海

creators.name: Unity
creators.bio: Maker of the Unity engine, used by a large share of XR and mobile games and many VR research labs.
creators.why: Its AI tools put agentic scene editing inside the engine most VR studies are built with.
creators.role_zh: 游戏引擎公司
creators.bio_zh: Unity 引擎的开发者，大量 XR 与移动游戏以及许多 VR 研究实验室都在用它。
creators.why_zh: 它的 AI 工具把智能体式场景编辑放进了多数 VR 研究所用的引擎。

creators.name: PlayCanvas
creators.role: Web graphics engine company (part of Snap)
creators.bio: Develops the open-source PlayCanvas engine and the SuperSplat Gaussian-splat editor.
creators.why: Its engine is one of the main ways splat worlds are shown in browsers and headsets.
creators.role_zh: 网页图形引擎公司（Snap 旗下）
creators.bio_zh: 开发开源 PlayCanvas 引擎与 SuperSplat 高斯泼溅编辑器。
creators.why_zh: 在浏览器和头显中展示泼溅世界，主要途径之一就是它的引擎。

creators.name: W3C Immersive Web Working Group
creators.bio: The World Wide Web Consortium group that writes the WebXR Device API and its modules.
creators.why: Its standard makes immersive content deliverable as a web link.
creators.role_zh: 网页标准组织
creators.bio_zh: 万维网联盟（W3C）中负责制定 WebXR 设备 API 及其模块的工作组。
creators.why_zh: 它制定的标准让沉浸内容可以通过一个网页链接交付。

creators.name: The Khronos Group
creators.bio: Open industry consortium behind glTF, OpenXR, Vulkan and WebGL.
creators.why: Its glTF splat extension gives generated 3D worlds a common file format.
creators.role_zh: 图形与空间计算标准联盟
creators.bio_zh: 制定 glTF、OpenXR、Vulkan 与 WebGL 的开放行业联盟。
creators.why_zh: 它的 glTF 泼溅扩展为生成的三维世界提供了通用文件格式。

creators.name: XREAL
creators.bio: Chinese maker of display glasses (formerly Nreal) and of XREAL AURA, Android XR glasses co-developed with Google.
creators.why: It is bringing full XR apps to glasses-weight hardware.
creators.role_zh: AR 眼镜公司
creators.bio_zh: 中国显示眼镜厂商（原名 Nreal），与 Google 合作开发 Android XR 眼镜 XREAL AURA。
creators.why_zh: 它正把完整的 XR 应用带到眼镜级重量的硬件上。

creators.name: Valve
creators.role: Game company and maker of Steam
creators.bio: Runs Steam and makes Index, Steam Deck and the Steam Frame headset.
creators.why: Its streaming-first headset links PC-rendered worlds to a wireless display.
creators.role_zh: 游戏公司、Steam 运营方
creators.bio_zh: 运营 Steam，生产 Index、Steam Deck 与 Steam Frame 头显。
creators.why_zh: 它主打串流的头显，把 PC 渲染的世界无线送到眼前。

creators.name: Arena (formerly LMArena)
creators.bio: Grew out of the LMSYS Chatbot Arena at UC Berkeley; runs public blind-vote leaderboards for text, vision, image and video models.
creators.why: Its video arena is a widely cited human-preference ranking of video generators.
creators.role_zh: 众包 AI 评测平台
creators.bio_zh: 源自加州大学伯克利分校的 LMSYS Chatbot Arena，运营文本、视觉、图像与视频模型的公开盲投排行榜。
creators.why_zh: 它的视频竞技场是被广泛引用的视频生成模型人类偏好排名。

creators.name: Artificial Analysis
creators.bio: Benchmarks model quality, price and speed across providers, including blind-vote image and video arenas.
creators.why: Video labs cite its arena rankings when they launch models.
creators.role_zh: 独立 AI 基准评测公司
creators.bio_zh: 跨服务商评测模型的质量、价格与速度，并运营图像与视频盲投竞技场。
creators.why_zh: 视频模型厂商发布新模型时常引用它的竞技场排名。

creators.name: Ziqi Huang
creators.bio: Works on video generation and its evaluation with Ziwei Liu's group; first author of VBench and VBench++.
creators.why: VBench is the most widely used automatic benchmark for video generators.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 研究者
creators.bio_zh: 在刘子纬课题组研究视频生成及其评测，VBench 与 VBench++ 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: VBench 是使用最广的视频生成自动评测基准。

creators.name: Dian Zheng
creators.role: Researcher, Shanghai AI Laboratory and Sun Yat-sen University
creators.bio: First author of VBench-2.0, which tests the physical and commonsense faithfulness of generated video.
creators.why: VBench-2.0 moves video evaluation toward the plausibility of events.
creators.role_zh: 上海人工智能实验室、中山大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: VBench-2.0 的第一作者，该基准检验生成视频在物理与常识上的可信度。
creators.why_zh: VBench-2.0 把视频评测的重点推向事件的合理性。

creators.name: Haoyi Duan
creators.bio: Works with Jiajun Wu and Fei-Fei Li; first author of WorldScore.
creators.why: WorldScore is the first benchmark that compares video, 3D and 4D world generators on one task.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与吴佳俊、李飞飞合作，WorldScore 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: WorldScore 是第一个在同一任务上比较视频、三维与 4D 世界生成器的基准。

creators.name: Dylan Ebert
creators.bio: Works on 3D machine learning at Hugging Face; created 3D Arena.
creators.why: 3D Arena is the largest public human-preference evaluation of image-to-3D models.
creators.role_zh: Hugging Face 机器学习工程师
creators.bio_zh: 在 Hugging Face 从事三维机器学习，3D Arena 的创建者。
creators.why_zh: 3D Arena 是规模最大的图生三维模型公开人类偏好评测。

creators.name: Lu Ling
creators.bio: First author of DL3DV-10K, a large real-scene video dataset for 3D vision.
creators.why: DL3DV-10K is a standard training set for scene reconstruction and camera-controlled generation.
creators.role_zh: 普渡大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: DL3DV-10K 的第一作者，这是一个面向三维视觉的大型真实场景视频数据集。
creators.why_zh: DL3DV-10K 是场景重建与镜头可控生成的标准训练数据之一。

creators.name: Matt Deitke
creators.bio: Led the Objaverse and Objaverse-XL 3D datasets at the Allen Institute for AI.
creators.why: Objaverse-XL is the main open pretraining corpus for 3D generative models.
creators.role_zh: AI 研究者（Objaverse、Objaverse-XL）
creators.bio_zh: 在艾伦人工智能研究所主导了 Objaverse 与 Objaverse-XL 三维数据集。
creators.why_zh: Objaverse-XL 是三维生成模型最主要的开放预训练语料。

creators.name: Tinghui Zhou
creators.bio: First author of Stereo Magnification (SIGGRAPH 2018), which introduced multiplane images and the RealEstate10K dataset.
creators.why: RealEstate10K became the standard benchmark for novel-view synthesis and camera-controlled video.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉研究者（加州大学伯克利分校博士）
creators.bio_zh: Stereo Magnification（SIGGRAPH 2018）的第一作者，该论文提出了多平面图像表示与 RealEstate10K 数据集。
creators.why_zh: RealEstate10K 成了新视角合成与镜头可控视频生成的标准基准。

creators.name: Chuhan Zhang
creators.bio: First author of D4RT, the CVPR 2026 best paper on feed-forward 4D reconstruction and tracking.
creators.why: Showed that one queried transformer can recover depth, cameras and 3D motion from a video in seconds.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: D4RT 的第一作者，该论文获 CVPR 2026 最佳论文奖，研究前馈式 4D 重建与追踪。
creators.why_zh: 证明了一个可查询的 Transformer 就能在几秒内从视频中恢复深度、相机与三维运动。

creators.name: Shanghai AI Laboratory
creators.role: Public AI research institute in Shanghai
creators.bio: Large state-backed research institute (also known as PJLab) working on foundation models, embodied AI and 3D vision; home of the π³ reconstruction model.
creators.why: One of the Chinese labs whose open 3D geometry models are widely used as reconstruction backbones.
creators.role_zh: 位于上海的公共人工智能研究机构
creators.bio_zh: 大型公共科研机构（又称浦江实验室），研究基础模型、具身智能与三维视觉，π³ 重建模型出自这里。
creators.why_zh: 其开源三维几何模型被广泛用作重建骨干网络，是这一方向的重要中国实验室之一。

creators.name: Ruijie Zhu
creators.role: PhD researcher, NTU Singapore (intern at Tencent ARC Lab)
creators.bio: First author of MotionCrafter (CVPR 2026 Highlight), which reconstructs 4D geometry and scene flow from monocular video with a 4D VAE.
creators.why: Shows how video-diffusion priors can be turned into measurement of real motion rather than generation.
creators.role_zh: 新加坡南洋理工大学博士研究者（腾讯 ARC Lab 实习）
creators.bio_zh: MotionCrafter（CVPR 2026 Highlight）第一作者，该方法用 4D VAE 从单目视频重建 4D 几何与场景流。
creators.why_zh: 展示了视频扩散先验如何被用来测量真实运动，而不是生成新内容。

creators.name: Aashish Rai
creators.role: PhD researcher, Brown University (Interactive 3D Vision & Learning Lab)
creators.bio: First author of PackUV (CVPR 2026) and UVGS, which map Gaussian splats into UV images so they can be stored and streamed like video.
creators.why: Connects 4D Gaussian capture to ordinary video codecs and streaming.
creators.role_zh: 布朗大学交互式三维视觉与学习实验室博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: PackUV（CVPR 2026）与 UVGS 的第一作者，这两项工作把高斯泼溅映射为 UV 图像，使其能像视频一样存储与传输。
creators.why_zh: 把 4D 高斯捕捉与普通视频编解码和流媒体连接起来。

creators.name: Yongzhen Hu
creators.bio: Co-first author of InfiniSplat v2 (2026), a feed-forward Gaussian reconstructor for any number of input views.
creators.why: Pushes feed-forward splats toward views far from the captured ones, the case that matters when people walk around a scene in VR.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学三维视觉组研究者
creators.bio_zh: InfiniSplat v2（2026）共同第一作者，这是一个可接受任意数量输入视角的前馈式高斯重建模型。
creators.why_zh: 让前馈式泼溅在远离拍摄视角的位置也保持质量，这正是人在 VR 中绕场景走动时最重要的情形。

creators.name: Volinga
creators.role: Gaussian splatting tools for virtual production
creators.bio: Spanish company spun out of the Arquimea Research Center; it launched an Unreal Engine NeRF plugin in January 2023, moved to Gaussian splats later that year and sells a training suite plus an Unreal renderer.
creators.why: Brings captured static and moving splats into the engine and LED-volume pipelines where scenes are authored.
creators.role_zh: 面向虚拟制片的高斯泼溅工具公司
creators.bio_zh: 从 Arquimea 研究中心分拆出来的西班牙公司，2023 年 1 月推出 Unreal Engine 的 NeRF 插件，同年转向高斯泼溅，现销售训练套件与 Unreal 渲染器。
creators.why_zh: 把捕捉得到的静态与动态泼溅带进引擎和 LED 虚拟制片流程，也就是场景被创作的地方。

creators.name: Evercoast
creators.bio: Company whose Mavericks capture and Cloudbreak processing software turn synchronized multi-camera footage into 4D spatial video for music, sports, virtual production and robotics data.
creators.why: Its splat-based capture put 4D-recorded performers into a mainstream music video in 2026.
creators.role_zh: 4D 体积捕捉公司
creators.bio_zh: 旗下 Mavericks 采集软件与 Cloudbreak 处理软件可把同步多相机画面转换为 4D 空间视频，用于音乐、体育、虚拟制片与机器人数据。
creators.why_zh: 它基于泼溅的捕捉在 2026 年把 4D 录制的表演者带进了主流音乐录影带。

creators.name: Zhibing Li
creators.role: PhD researcher, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: Researcher in Dahua Lin's group at CUHK and co-first author of SS4D (SIGGRAPH Asia 2025), with Shanghai AI Laboratory.
creators.why: SS4D is a 4D generator trained directly on 4D data that turns a monocular video into a moving 3D object.
creators.role_zh: 香港中文大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港中文大学林达华课题组研究者，与上海人工智能实验室合作完成的 SS4D（SIGGRAPH Asia 2025）共同第一作者。
creators.why_zh: SS4D 是直接在 4D 数据上训练的生成器，能把单目视频变成会动的三维物体。

creators.name: Hongyuan Chen
creators.bio: Researcher in Anpei Chen's group at Westlake University and first author of Motion 3-to-4 (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: Motion 3-to-4 separates shape from motion, so a video can animate a 3D mesh with consistent geometry from all sides.
creators.role_zh: 西湖大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 西湖大学 Anpei Chen 课题组研究者，Motion 3-to-4（CVPR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Motion 3-to-4 把形状与运动分开处理，一段视频就能驱动三维网格，且各个角度的几何保持一致。

creators.name: Jiraphon Yenphraphai
creators.bio: Purdue PhD researcher (with Raymond A. Yeh) and first author of ShapeGen4D (ICLR 2026), carried out with Snap Research.
creators.why: ShapeGen4D generates mesh sequences from video that can change volume and topology, cases that rigs cannot capture.
creators.role_zh: 普渡大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 普渡大学博士研究者（导师 Raymond A. Yeh），与 Snap Research 合作完成的 ShapeGen4D（ICLR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: ShapeGen4D 能从视频生成体积和拓扑都会变化的网格序列，而这是骨骼绑定无法表现的。

creators.name: Chen Geng
creators.bio: Researcher in Jiajun Wu's group at Stanford and first author of NeuROK (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: NeuROK turns a scanned static object into one that deforms plausibly when acted on, without physical annotations.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学 Jiajun Wu 课题组研究者，NeuROK（CVPR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: NeuROK 能把扫描得到的静态物体变成受力时会合理形变的物体，无需物理标注。

creators.name: Liyuan Zhu
creators.bio: Stanford PhD researcher (with Iro Armeni and Gordon Wetzstein) and first author of World from Motion (NeurIPS 2026), carried out with NVIDIA.
creators.why: World from Motion uses a video model to fill in and correct 4D Gaussian scenes reconstructed from a single video.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者（与 Iro Armeni、Gordon Wetzstein 合作），与 NVIDIA 合作完成的 World from Motion（NeurIPS 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: World from Motion 借助视频模型补全并修正从单段视频重建的 4D 高斯场景。

creators.name: Yuyang Zhao
creators.bio: Researcher in Gim Hee Lee's group at NUS and first author of GenXD (ICLR 2025), developed with Microsoft.
creators.why: GenXD trains one model on both 3D and 4D data and released the CamVid-30K dataset of real-world 4D scenes.
creators.role_zh: 新加坡国立大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 新加坡国立大学 Gim Hee Lee 课题组研究者，与微软合作完成的 GenXD（ICLR 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GenXD 用同一个模型同时学习三维与 4D 数据，并发布了真实世界 4D 场景数据集 CamVid-30K。

creators.name: Hongxin Zhang
creators.bio: Researcher in Chuang Gan's Embodied AGI lab at UMass Amherst, also affiliated with Genesis AI, and first author of GS-Agent (2026).
creators.why: GS-Agent builds 4D worlds as physics simulations written by LLM agents, so they stay physically consistent and can be re-run.
creators.role_zh: 麻省大学阿默斯特分校博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 麻省大学阿默斯特分校 Chuang Gan 具身智能实验室研究者，同时隶属 Genesis AI，GS-Agent（2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: GS-Agent 让大语言模型智能体把 4D 世界写成物理仿真，因而物理上保持一致，也可以重复运行。

creators.name: Yihang Luo
creators.role: PhD researcher, S-Lab, Nanyang Technological University
creators.bio: Researcher in Chen Change Loy's group at NTU's S-Lab and first author of 4RC (ICML 2026).
creators.why: 4RC reconstructs the dense geometry and motion of a dynamic scene from a monocular video in one forward pass.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 吕健勤（Chen Change Loy）课题组研究者，4RC（ICML 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 4RC 一次前向即可从单目视频重建动态场景的稠密几何与运动。

creators.name: SideFX
creators.role: Maker of the Houdini procedural 3D software
creators.bio: Canadian software company (Side Effects Software) whose Houdini is a standard tool for visual effects, procedural modeling and game content in film and game studios.
creators.why: Houdini 22 (2026) made Gaussian splats a production data type that can be trained, rigged, animated, relit and composited like meshes.
creators.role_zh: 程序化三维软件 Houdini 的开发商
creators.bio_zh: 加拿大软件公司（Side Effects Software），其 Houdini 是电影和游戏工作室在视觉特效、程序化建模与游戏内容制作中的标准工具。
creators.why_zh: Houdini 22（2026）把高斯泼溅变成生产级数据类型，可以像网格一样训练、绑定、动画、重光照和合成。

creators.name: Sherwin Bahmani
creators.role_zh: 多伦多大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of 4D-fy, one of the most cited text-to-4D methods of 2023-2024.
creators.bio_zh: 4D-fy 的第一作者，这是 2023—2024 年被引用最多的文本到 4D 方法之一。
creators.why: 4D-fy showed how to combine image, multi-view and video models so that generated 4D scenes look right, hold their shape and move.
creators.why_zh: 4D-fy 展示了如何组合图像、多视角与视频模型，让生成的 4D 场景外观正确、形状稳定且会动。

creators.name: Huan Ling
creators.role: Research scientist, NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab
creators.role_zh: 英伟达多伦多 AI 实验室研究科学家
creators.bio: First author of Align Your Gaussians, NVIDIA's text-to-4D method built on dynamic 3D Gaussians.
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达基于动态三维高斯的文本到 4D 方法 Align Your Gaussians 的第一作者。
creators.why: Moved text-to-4D from slow NeRFs to Gaussian splats that can be composed into longer, multi-object scenes.
creators.why_zh: 把文本到 4D 从缓慢的 NeRF 推进到可组合成更长、多物体场景的高斯泼溅。

creators.name: Tianyuan Zhang
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院 CSAIL 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of PhysDreamer (ECCV 2024 oral), which gives static 3D objects physical responses learned from video models.
creators.bio_zh: PhysDreamer（ECCV 2024 口头报告）的第一作者，该方法让静态三维物体获得从视频模型中学到的物理响应。
creators.why: Showed that video generators can supply material properties, not only motion, for interactive 3D objects.
creators.why_zh: 证明了视频生成模型不仅能提供运动，还能为可交互的三维物体提供材料属性。

creators.name: Yanqin Jiang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
creators.role_zh: 中国科学院自动化研究所博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Consistent4D and Animate3D, two early reference points for video-to-4D and for animating existing 3D models.
creators.bio_zh: Consistent4D 与 Animate3D 的第一作者，这两项工作分别是视频到 4D 和为现有三维模型添加动画的早期参照。
creators.why: Animate3D turned 4D generation toward animating 3D assets people already have.
creators.why_zh: Animate3D 把 4D 生成引向为人们已有的三维资产制作动画。

creators.name: Zijie Wu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 华中科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of AnimateAnyMesh (ICCV 2025, with Alibaba DAMO Academy) and R-DMesh (SIGGRAPH 2026, with Tencent Hunyuan).
creators.bio_zh: AnimateAnyMesh（ICCV 2025，与阿里巴巴达摩院合作）和 R-DMesh（SIGGRAPH 2026，与腾讯混元合作）的第一作者。
creators.why: AnimateAnyMesh and R-DMesh animate arbitrary meshes from a text prompt or a reference video.
creators.why_zh: AnimateAnyMesh 与 R-DMesh 可根据文字提示或参考视频为任意网格生成动画。

creators.name: Bowen Zhang
creators.role: PhD researcher, University of Science and Technology of China
creators.role_zh: 中国科学技术大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion (ICCV 2025), a video-to-4D diffusion model developed with Microsoft Research Asia.
creators.bio_zh: 与微软亚洲研究院合作的视频到 4D 扩散模型 Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion（ICCV 2025）的第一作者。
creators.why: Trained a diffusion model directly on compressed 4D Gaussian animations instead of distilling video models per object.
creators.why_zh: 直接在压缩后的 4D 高斯动画上训练扩散模型，而不是为每个物体蒸馏视频模型。

creators.name: Remy Sabathier
creators.role: Researcher, Meta and University College London
creators.role_zh: Meta 与伦敦大学学院研究者
creators.bio: First author of ActionMesh (CVPR 2026), Meta's open model that turns a video, an image or text into an animated 3D mesh.
creators.bio_zh: ActionMesh（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，这是 Meta 的开源模型，可将视频、图像或文字变成动画三维网格。
creators.why: ActionMesh made animated-mesh generation fast and topology-consistent enough to drop into standard 3D tools.
creators.why_zh: ActionMesh 让动画网格生成足够快且拓扑一致，可直接导入常规三维软件。

creators.name: Yehonathan Litman
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Lift4D (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), which lifts monocular videos of deforming objects into complete 4D Gaussians.
creators.bio_zh: Lift4D（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）的第一作者，该方法把形变物体的单目视频提升为完整的 4D 高斯。
creators.why: Lift4D fills in the parts of a moving object the camera never saw, using single-view 3D and diffusion priors.
creators.why_zh: Lift4D 借助单视角三维与扩散先验，补全运动物体中相机从未拍到的部分。

creators.name: Yudong Jin
creators.role: PhD researcher, Zhejiang University and Robbyant
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学与蚂蚁灵波科技博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of 4DAnyone (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026), which turns a casual phone video of a person into a 4D Gaussian human.
creators.bio_zh: 4DAnyone（SIGGRAPH Asia 2026）的共同第一作者，该方法把一段随手拍的人物视频变成 4D 高斯人体。
creators.why: Brings free-viewpoint people to anyone with a single camera, by generating the missing views.
creators.why_zh: 通过生成缺失的视角，让只有一台相机的人也能得到可自由换视角的人物。

creators.name: Daniel Watson
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio: Co-first author of 4DiM and earlier 3D novel-view diffusion work (3DiM) at Google.
creators.bio_zh: 4DiM 及谷歌早期三维新视角扩散工作 3DiM 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: 4DiM was one of the first diffusion models to take both a camera pose and a timestamp as input for real scenes.
creators.why_zh: 4DiM 是最早同时以相机位姿和时间戳为输入、面向真实场景的扩散模型之一。

creators.name: Wenqiang Sun
creators.role: PhD researcher, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of DimensionX, an open image-to-3D/4D scene method from HKUST and Tsinghua University.
creators.bio_zh: DimensionX 的共同第一作者，这是香港科技大学与清华大学的开源图像到三维 / 4D 场景方法。
creators.why: DimensionX showed that one video model can be steered to vary only space or only time, the two ingredients of 4D.
creators.why_zh: DimensionX 证明可以引导同一个视频模型只改变空间或只改变时间，而这正是 4D 的两个要素。

creators.name: Chaoyang Wang
creators.role_zh: Snap Research 研究科学家
creators.bio: First author of 4Real-Video and 4Real-Video-V2, Snap's line of 4D video diffusion models.
creators.bio_zh: Snap 4D 视频扩散模型系列 4Real-Video 与 4Real-Video-V2 的第一作者。
creators.why: The 4Real-Video models generate a grid of views over time and lift it into Gaussians in one pass.
creators.why_zh: 4Real-Video 系列生成“视角 × 时间”的画面网格，并一次性提升为高斯。

creators.name: Haoyi Zhu
creators.role_zh: 上海人工智能实验室研究者
creators.bio: First author of Aether, Shanghai AI Lab's open geometry-aware world model.
creators.bio_zh: 上海人工智能实验室开源几何感知世界模型 Aether 的第一作者。
creators.why: Aether ties video prediction to 4D geometry so that a world model's output can be measured in 3D.
creators.why_zh: Aether 把视频预测与 4D 几何绑定，使世界模型的输出可以在三维中度量。

creators.name: Tianqi Liu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Huazhong University of Science and Technology and NTU S-Lab
creators.role_zh: 华中科技大学与南洋理工大学 S-Lab 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of Free4D (ICCV 2025) and Light-X, on 4D scene generation and rendering with video models.
creators.bio_zh: Free4D（ICCV 2025）与 Light-X 的第一作者，研究借助视频模型的 4D 场景生成与渲染。
creators.why: Free4D builds a 4D scene from one image without training a new model.
creators.why_zh: Free4D 无需训练新模型，就能从一张图像构建 4D 场景。

creators.name: Zizhang Li
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of WonderPlay (ICCV 2025 Highlight) in Jiajun Wu's group.
creators.bio_zh: 吴佳俊组 WonderPlay（ICCV 2025 Highlight）的共同第一作者。
creators.why: WonderPlay makes generated 3D scenes react to actions such as wind or a push.
creators.why_zh: WonderPlay 让生成的三维场景对风吹、推动等动作作出反应。

creators.name: Yuxue Yang
creators.role: PhD researcher, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, and CreateAI
creators.role_zh: 中国科学院自动化研究所与 CreateAI 博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of NeoVerse (CVPR 2026 Highlight), a 4D world model trained on in-the-wild monocular videos.
creators.bio_zh: NeoVerse（CVPR 2026 Highlight）的第一作者，这是一个在真实单目视频上训练的 4D 世界模型。
creators.why: NeoVerse scales 4D world modelling with ordinary videos instead of scarce multi-view 4D captures.
creators.why_zh: NeoVerse 用普通视频而非稀缺的多视角 4D 采集数据来扩展 4D 世界建模。

creators.name: You-Zhe Xie
creators.role: Researcher, National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and Alaya Lab
creators.role_zh: 阳明交通大学与 Alaya Lab 研究者
creators.bio: First author of OuroWorld (2026), which turns static 3D Gaussian worlds into looping 3D cinemagraphs.
creators.bio_zh: OuroWorld（2026）的第一作者，该方法把静态三维高斯世界变成循环播放的三维动态照片。
creators.why: OuroWorld adds motion to worlds generated by tools such as Marble, which are otherwise frozen in time.
creators.why_zh: OuroWorld 为 Marble 等工具生成的、原本静止的世界加入运动。

creators.name: InSpatio
creators.role: Chinese spatial-intelligence start-up building 3D and 4D world models
creators.role_zh: 构建三维与 4D 世界模型的中国空间智能初创公司
creators.bio: Company whose INSPATIO-WORLD paper is co-authored with Zhejiang University 3D-vision researchers (Guofeng Zhang, Hujun Bao); it releases open models such as InSpatio-World, InSpatio-WorldFM and QuerySplat.
creators.bio_zh: 其 INSPATIO-WORLD 论文与浙江大学三维视觉研究者（章国锋、鲍虎军）合著；公司发布了 InSpatio-World、InSpatio-WorldFM、QuerySplat 等开源模型。
creators.why: Its open InSpatio-World turns a single video into a dynamic scene that can be explored in real time.
creators.why_zh: 其开源的 InSpatio-World 能把单段视频变成可实时探索的动态场景。

creators.name: 4DV.ai
creators.bio: Startup building capture, playback and editing tools for 4D video based on Gaussian splatting; its CEO Jiaming Sun co-authored FreeTimeGS. Its Infinite Studio demo won Best in Show at SIGGRAPH 2025 Real-Time Live, as reported by Radiancefields.com.
creators.why: Treats 4D Gaussian video as a medium people can step into, which is the capture side of a navigable, time-varying situation.
creators.role_zh: 4D 高斯视频创业公司
creators.bio_zh: 基于高斯泼溅开发 4D 视频拍摄、播放与编辑工具的创业公司，CEO 孙佳明是 FreeTimeGS 的合著者。据 Radiancefields.com 报道，其 Infinite Studio 演示获得 SIGGRAPH 2025 Real-Time Live 最佳展示奖。
creators.why_zh: 把 4D 高斯视频当作人可以走进去的媒介，是可漫游、随时间变化的情境在捕捉一侧的实现。

creators.name: Gracia
creators.bio: Company that streams 4D Gaussian splat video to Quest, Pico, Apple Vision Pro, desktop and the browser, and in 2026 describes its focus as world reconstruction models for physical AI.
creators.why: Shows what it takes to ship dynamic splat captures to headsets at consumer bandwidths.
creators.role_zh: 体积高斯视频公司
creators.bio_zh: 将 4D 高斯泼溅视频流式传输到 Quest、Pico、Apple Vision Pro、桌面与浏览器的公司，2026 年起把重点表述为面向物理 AI 的世界重建模型。
creators.why_zh: 展示了以消费级带宽把动态泼溅捕捉送到头显上需要什么。

creators.name: Arcturus
creators.bio: Maker of HoloSuite, a toolset for editing, compressing and streaming volumetric video, which has since moved into Gaussian-splat sports replays.
creators.why: Represents the post-production layer that turns raw volumetric captures into deliverable, editable media.
creators.role_zh: 体积视频软件公司
creators.bio_zh: HoloSuite 的开发者，这套工具用于编辑、压缩与流式传输体积视频，后来转向基于高斯泼溅的体育回放。
creators.why_zh: 代表了把原始体积捕捉变成可交付、可编辑媒体的后期制作层。

creators.name: Jawset
creators.bio: Small software company that makes Postshot, a desktop application for training and editing radiance fields and Gaussian splats on a local GPU.
creators.why: Puts splat training on a researcher's own workstation, which matters when footage cannot leave the lab.
creators.role_zh: Postshot 开发商
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Postshot 的小型软件公司，Postshot 是在本地 GPU 上训练和编辑辐射场与高斯泼溅的桌面应用。
creators.why_zh: 让泼溅训练在研究者自己的工作站上完成，对素材不能离开实验室的情况很重要。

creators.name: Varjo
creators.bio: Finnish maker of high-resolution XR headsets that launched Teleport, a cloud service that turns phone or camera footage into Gaussian splat scenes.
creators.why: Links capture of real places to professional XR viewing and training use.
creators.role_zh: XR 头显与重建公司
creators.bio_zh: 芬兰高分辨率 XR 头显厂商，推出了 Teleport 云服务，把手机或相机素材转换为高斯泼溅场景。
creators.why_zh: 把真实地点的捕捉与专业 XR 观看和训练用途连接起来。

creators.name: NAVER LABS Europe
creators.bio: Grenoble research centre of the Korean company NAVER, home of the DUSt3R / MASt3R family of 3D foundation models.
creators.why: Its pointmap regression idea started the shift from slow structure-from-motion to one-pass reconstruction.
creators.role_zh: NAVER 的欧洲研究院
creators.bio_zh: 韩国 NAVER 公司位于格勒诺布尔的研究中心，DUSt3R / MASt3R 系列三维基础模型的出处。
creators.why_zh: 它提出的点图回归思路开启了从缓慢的运动恢复结构到一次前向重建的转变。

creators.name: Inria GraphDeco
creators.bio: Research group led by George Drettakis at Inria Université Côte d'Azur, origin of 3D Gaussian Splatting and its hierarchical extension.
creators.why: Made photoreal real-time novel views practical on consumer GPUs.
creators.role_zh: Inria 图形学研究组
creators.bio_zh: 由 George Drettakis 领导的 Inria 蔚蓝海岸大学研究组，3D 高斯泼溅及其层级扩展的出处。
creators.why_zh: 让照片级的实时新视角渲染在消费级 GPU 上变得可行。

creators.name: ZJU3DV
creators.bio: Computer vision group of Xiaowei Zhou and Sida Peng at Zhejiang University's State Key Lab of CAD&CG, active in dynamic human and scene capture.
creators.why: A main source of long volumetric video and 4D Gaussian methods, and the research lineage behind 4DV.ai.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学三维视觉组
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学 CAD&CG 国家重点实验室周晓巍、彭思达团队，长期研究动态人体与场景捕捉。
creators.why_zh: 长时体积视频与 4D 高斯方法的重要来源，也是 4DV.ai 的研究源头。

creators.name: Robbyant
creators.role: Embodied AI unit of Ant Group
creators.bio: Ant Group's embodied-intelligence company, which publishes the open LingBot family of models for robots and spatial perception.
creators.why: Its streaming reconstruction model is one of the most-starred open 3D releases of 2026.
creators.role_zh: 蚂蚁集团具身智能公司
creators.bio_zh: 蚂蚁集团旗下的具身智能公司，发布面向机器人与空间感知的开源 LingBot 系列模型。
creators.why_zh: 它的流式重建模型是 2026 年 GitHub 星标最多的开源三维发布之一。

creators.name: Ben Mildenhall
creators.bio: First author of NeRF (2020), later at Google Research, now a co-founder of World Labs.
creators.why: NeRF made learned, photoreal novel-view synthesis the starting point of the whole field.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，World Labs 联合创始人
creators.bio_zh: NeRF（2020）第一作者，后在 Google Research 工作，现为 World Labs 联合创始人。
creators.why_zh: NeRF 让可学习的照片级新视角合成成为整个领域的起点。

creators.name: Thomas Müller
creators.bio: NVIDIA researcher, first author of Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (instant-ngp).
creators.why: Cut NeRF training from hours to seconds, which made radiance fields interactive to make.
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 研究者
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 研究者，Instant Neural Graphics Primitives（instant-ngp）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把 NeRF 训练从几小时缩短到几秒，让辐射场的制作过程变得可交互。

creators.name: Jonathan T. Barron
creators.bio: Google researcher behind mip-NeRF, mip-NeRF 360, Zip-NeRF and many radiance-field quality benchmarks.
creators.why: His unbounded 360° scenes became the standard test of whether a capture holds up when you walk around.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Google 研究者，mip-NeRF、mip-NeRF 360、Zip-NeRF 等工作以及多项辐射场质量基准的作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的无界 360° 场景成了检验捕捉在绕行观看时是否站得住的标准。

creators.name: Bernhard Kerbl
creators.bio: Co-first author of 3D Gaussian Splatting (SIGGRAPH 2023) and first author of its hierarchical version for very large scenes.
creators.why: 3DGS is the representation most capture apps, viewers and 4D methods now build on.
creators.role_zh: Inria / 维也纳工业大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅（SIGGRAPH 2023）共同第一作者，也是其超大场景层级版本的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 3DGS 是如今大多数捕捉应用、查看器和 4D 方法所依赖的表示。

creators.name: Zehao Yu
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Andreas Geiger's group, first author of Mip-Splatting.
creators.why: Fixed the aliasing that appears when a splat scene is viewed at a different scale than it was captured.
creators.role_zh: 图宾根大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Andreas Geiger 团队的博士研究者，Mip-Splatting 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 解决了以不同于拍摄时的尺度观看泼溅场景时出现的走样问题。

creators.name: Binbin Huang
creators.bio: First author of 2D Gaussian Splatting (SIGGRAPH 2024).
creators.why: Made splats yield clean surfaces, so captures can become meshes for physics and interaction.
creators.role_zh: 上海科技大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 2D 高斯泼溅（SIGGRAPH 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 让泼溅可以得到干净的表面，使捕捉结果能变成用于物理与交互的网格。

creators.name: Nicolas Moenne-Loccoz
creators.bio: NVIDIA researcher, first author of 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing (3DGRT).
creators.why: Brought ray-traced effects such as reflections and wide-angle lenses to Gaussian scenes.
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 研究者
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 研究者，3D Gaussian Ray Tracing（3DGRT）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把反射、广角镜头等光线追踪效果带到了高斯场景中。

creators.name: Qi Wu
creators.bio: NVIDIA researcher, first author of 3DGUT (CVPR 2025).
creators.why: Made splats work with distorted cameras such as fisheye lenses and rolling shutters used on robots and headsets.
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 研究者
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 研究者，3DGUT（CVPR 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 让泼溅能处理机器人和头显上常见的鱼眼镜头、卷帘快门等畸变相机。

creators.name: Daniel Duckworth
creators.bio: Google researcher, first author of SMERF, a streamable radiance field for large scenes in a web browser.
creators.why: Showed house-scale radiance fields running in real time on phones and laptops.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究工程师
creators.bio_zh: Google 研究者，SMERF 第一作者，这是一种可在浏览器中流式加载大场景的辐射场。
creators.why_zh: 展示了房屋尺度的辐射场在手机与笔记本上实时运行。

creators.name: David Charatan
creators.bio: MIT researcher, first author of pixelSplat (CVPR 2024).
creators.why: One of the first networks to output Gaussian splats directly from two photos.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院研究者，pixelSplat（CVPR 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 最早从两张照片直接输出高斯泼溅的网络之一。

creators.name: Shuzhe Wang
creators.role: Researcher, Aalto University / NAVER LABS Europe
creators.bio: First author of DUSt3R (CVPR 2024), developed at NAVER LABS Europe.
creators.why: DUSt3R turned uncalibrated photo pairs into 3D pointmaps without camera poses.
creators.role_zh: 阿尔托大学 / NAVER LABS Europe 研究者
creators.bio_zh: DUSt3R（CVPR 2024）第一作者，该工作在 NAVER LABS Europe 完成。
creators.why_zh: DUSt3R 在没有相机位姿的情况下，把未标定的照片对直接变成三维点图。

creators.name: Vincent Leroy
creators.bio: NAVER LABS Europe researcher, first author of MASt3R (ECCV 2024).
creators.why: Added dense matching to the pointmap approach, making it usable for mapping and SLAM.
creators.role_zh: NAVER LABS Europe 研究者
creators.bio_zh: NAVER LABS Europe 研究者，MASt3R（ECCV 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 为点图方法加入稠密匹配，使其可用于建图与 SLAM。

creators.name: Jianyuan Wang
creators.bio: First author of VGGT (CVPR 2025 Best Paper) and VGGT-Ω (CVPR 2026 Oral), joint work of Oxford's Visual Geometry Group and Meta.
creators.why: VGGT made a single transformer pass the default way to get cameras, depth and points from a set of images.
creators.role_zh: 牛津 VGG / Meta AI 研究者
creators.bio_zh: VGGT（CVPR 2025 最佳论文）与 VGGT-Ω（CVPR 2026 Oral）第一作者，牛津视觉几何组与 Meta 的合作工作。
creators.why_zh: VGGT 让一次 Transformer 前向成为从一组图像得到相机、深度和点云的默认方式。

creators.name: Qianqian Wang
creators.bio: Berkeley researcher, first author of Shape of Motion and CUT3R.
creators.why: Works on recovering persistent 3D and motion from ordinary casual video.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校研究者
creators.bio_zh: 伯克利研究者，Shape of Motion 与 CUT3R 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 研究从普通随手视频中恢复持续的三维结构与运动。

creators.name: Lihan Jiang
creators.bio: First author of AnySplat (SIGGRAPH Asia 2025).
creators.why: AnySplat outputs a full splat scene from unposed photos in seconds.
creators.role_zh: 中国科学技术大学 / 上海人工智能实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: AnySplat（SIGGRAPH Asia 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: AnySplat 可在几秒内从无位姿照片输出完整的泼溅场景。

creators.name: Nikhil Keetha
creators.bio: First author of MapAnything, a Meta and Carnegie Mellon model for metric 3D reconstruction.
creators.why: MapAnything accepts whatever geometry hints are available (intrinsics, poses, depth) and returns metric scale.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学 / Meta 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: MapAnything 第一作者，这是 Meta 与卡内基梅隆大学合作的公制三维重建模型。
creators.why_zh: MapAnything 能接收任何可用的几何提示（内参、位姿、深度）并输出公制尺度。

creators.name: Tianye Li
creators.bio: First author of Neural 3D Video Synthesis (DyNeRF, CVPR 2022), done at Meta Reality Labs Research.
creators.why: Its multi-view kitchen dataset remains a standard test for dynamic scene methods.
creators.role_zh: Meta Reality Labs 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Neural 3D Video Synthesis（DyNeRF，CVPR 2022）第一作者，该工作在 Meta Reality Labs Research 完成。
creators.why_zh: 其多视角厨房数据集至今仍是动态场景方法的标准测试。

creators.name: Jonathon Luiten
creators.bio: First author of Dynamic 3D Gaussians (3DV 2024) and co-author of BulletGen at Meta.
creators.why: Showed that Gaussians can be tracked through time, giving 4D capture with dense correspondence.
creators.role_zh: Meta 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Dynamic 3D Gaussians（3DV 2024）第一作者，在 Meta 参与了 BulletGen。
creators.why_zh: 证明了高斯可以随时间被追踪，使 4D 捕捉带有稠密对应关系。

creators.name: Guanjun Wu
creators.role: Researcher, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
creators.bio: First author of 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering (CVPR 2024).
creators.why: His deformation-field 4DGS is the most-cited starting point for dynamic splats.
creators.role_zh: 华中科技大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 《4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering》（CVPR 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 他的形变场式 4DGS 是动态泼溅中引用最多的起点。

creators.name: Zhan Li
creators.role: Researcher, Portland State University / OPPO US Research
creators.bio: First author of Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting (CVPR 2024).
creators.why: Spacetime Gaussians reached 8K real-time playback of multi-view dynamic captures.
creators.role_zh: 波特兰州立大学 / OPPO 美国研究院研究者
creators.bio_zh: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting（CVPR 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Spacetime Gaussians 实现了多视角动态捕捉的 8K 实时播放。

creators.name: Junyi Zhang
creators.bio: First author of MonST3R (ICLR 2025).
creators.why: Extended pointmap reconstruction to scenes with moving people and objects.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: MonST3R（ICLR 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把点图重建扩展到有人物与物体运动的场景。

creators.name: Zhengqi Li
creators.bio: Google researcher working on dynamic scene reconstruction, first author of MegaSaM (CVPR 2025).
creators.why: MegaSaM recovers cameras and depth from casual videos that break classic SLAM.
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: 研究动态场景重建的 Google 研究者，MegaSaM（CVPR 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: MegaSaM 能从让传统 SLAM 失效的随手视频中恢复相机与深度。

creators.name: Yifan Wang
creators.bio: First author of FreeTimeGS (CVPR 2025) in the ZJU3DV group.
creators.why: FreeTimeGS is the published method behind 4DV.ai's 4D video.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学三维视觉组研究者，FreeTimeGS（CVPR 2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: FreeTimeGS 是 4DV.ai 4D 视频背后的已发表方法。

creators.name: Hanxue Liang
creators.bio: First author of BTimer, NVIDIA's feed-forward bullet-time reconstruction model.
creators.why: Moved dynamic reconstruction from per-scene optimisation to a single forward pass.
creators.role_zh: 剑桥大学 / NVIDIA 研究者
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 前馈式子弹时间重建模型 BTimer 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把动态重建从逐场景优化推进到一次前向。

creators.name: Linyi Jin
creators.role: PhD researcher, University of Michigan / Google DeepMind
creators.bio: First author of Stereo4D (CVPR 2025), built with Google DeepMind from internet VR180 videos.
creators.why: Mined stereo internet video for real-world 3D motion at scale.
creators.role_zh: 密歇根大学 / Google DeepMind 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Stereo4D（CVPR 2025）第一作者，与 Google DeepMind 合作，利用互联网 VR180 视频构建。
creators.why_zh: 从互联网立体视频中大规模挖掘真实世界的三维运动。

creators.name: Uriel Singer
creators.bio: Meta researcher, first author of Make-A-Video and of MAV3D (text-to-4D, 2023).
creators.why: MAV3D was the first system to turn a text prompt into a dynamic 3D scene.
creators.role_zh: Meta AI 研究科学家
creators.bio_zh: Meta 研究者，Make-A-Video 与 MAV3D（文本到 4D，2023）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: MAV3D 是第一个把文本提示变成动态三维场景的系统。

creators.name: Jiawei Ren
creators.bio: First author of DreamGaussian4D and of L4GM (NeurIPS 2024, with NVIDIA).
creators.why: Took 4D generation from hours of score distillation to minutes, then to a single forward pass.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab / NVIDIA 研究者
creators.bio_zh: DreamGaussian4D 与 L4GM（NeurIPS 2024，与 NVIDIA 合作）的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把 4D 生成从数小时的分数蒸馏缩短到几分钟，再到一次前向。

creators.name: Heng Yu
creators.bio: First author of 4Real (NeurIPS 2024), done with Snap Research.
creators.why: 4Real generated photoreal 4D scenes rather than isolated objects.
creators.role_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 4Real（NeurIPS 2024）第一作者，与 Snap Research 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: 4Real 生成的是照片级的 4D 场景，而不是孤立的物体。

creators.name: Rundi Wu
creators.role: PhD researcher, Columbia University / Google DeepMind
creators.bio: First author of CAT4D (CVPR 2025), built at Google DeepMind.
creators.why: CAT4D turns a single monocular video into a 4D scene with a multi-view video diffusion model.
creators.role_zh: 哥伦比亚大学 / Google DeepMind 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: CAT4D（CVPR 2025）第一作者，在 Google DeepMind 完成。
creators.why_zh: CAT4D 借助多视角视频扩散模型，把单目视频变成 4D 场景。

creators.name: Denis Rozumny
creators.bio: Meta researcher, first author of BulletGen.
creators.why: BulletGen uses a video generator to fill what a single camera never saw in a 4D reconstruction.
creators.role_zh: Meta 研究者
creators.bio_zh: Meta 研究者，BulletGen 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: BulletGen 用视频生成模型补全 4D 重建中单个相机从未看到的部分。

creators.name: Zhaoxi Chen
creators.bio: First author of 4DNeX, a feed-forward image-to-4D model.
creators.why: 4DNeX turns one image into a dynamic point cloud with a fine-tuned video model.
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 前馈式图像到 4D 模型 4DNeX 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 4DNeX 用微调后的视频模型把一张图像变成动态点云。

creators.name: Alvaro Collet
creators.bio: First author of High-Quality Streamable Free-Viewpoint Video (SIGGRAPH 2015), the system behind Microsoft's Mixed Reality Capture Studios.
creators.why: Defined the studio volumetric-video pipeline that Gaussian video now replaces.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究者（2015）
creators.bio_zh: 《High-Quality Streamable Free-Viewpoint Video》（SIGGRAPH 2015）第一作者，该系统是微软混合现实捕捉工作室的基础。
creators.why_zh: 确立了如今正被高斯视频取代的影棚体积视频流程。

creators.name: Martin de La Gorce
creators.bio: Microsoft researcher, first author of VoluMe (2025).
creators.why: VoluMe predicts a 3D Gaussian person from a single webcam stream in real time.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究者
creators.bio_zh: 微软研究者，VoluMe（2025）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: VoluMe 能从单路网络摄像头画面实时预测出一个三维高斯人像。

creators.name: Matthew Tancik
creators.bio: Co-author of NeRF and lead author of Nerfstudio at UC Berkeley; later joined Luma AI.
creators.why: Nerfstudio gave researchers a shared, modular codebase for radiance-field experiments.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，Nerfstudio 联合创建者
creators.bio_zh: NeRF 合著者，在伯克利主导了 Nerfstudio，后加入 Luma AI。
creators.why_zh: Nerfstudio 为研究者提供了共享、模块化的辐射场实验代码库。

creators.name: Zhen Xu
creators.bio: ZJU3DV researcher behind EasyVolcap and first author of Representing Long Volumetric Video with Temporal Gaussian Hierarchy (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024).
creators.why: Pushed Gaussian volumetric video from seconds to minutes, a precondition for 4D video as a medium.
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学三维视觉组研究者，EasyVolcap 的作者，《Representing Long Volumetric Video with Temporal Gaussian Hierarchy》（SIGGRAPH Asia 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 把高斯体积视频从几秒推进到几分钟，这是 4D 视频成为一种媒介的前提。

creators.name: Polycam
creators.bio: Maker of a phone, web and drone 3D capture app covering LiDAR, photogrammetry and Gaussian splats.
creators.why: A common route from a phone walk-through to a usable 3D scene.
creators.role_zh: 三维捕捉应用公司
creators.bio_zh: 一款覆盖 LiDAR、摄影测量与高斯泼溅的手机、网页与无人机三维捕捉应用的开发商。
creators.why_zh: 从手机走拍到可用三维场景的常见途径。

creators.name: Haotong Lin
creators.bio: First author of Depth Anything 3.
creators.why: Unified monocular and multi-view geometry in one open model.
creators.role_zh: 字节跳动 Seed / 浙江大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Depth Anything 3 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 在一个开源模型中统一了单目与多视角几何。

creators.name: Lingen Li
creators.bio: The Chinese University of Hong Kong researcher, first author of CubeComposer (CVPR 2026), developed with Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.why: CubeComposer generates native 4K 360° video, the resolution headsets need for immersive viewing.
creators.role_zh: 全景视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港中文大学研究者，CubeComposer（CVPR 2026）第一作者，该工作与腾讯 ARC 实验室合作完成。
creators.why_zh: CubeComposer 可原生生成 4K 360° 视频，这是头显沉浸式观看所需的分辨率。

creators.name: Ke Xing
creators.bio: Beijing Jiaotong University researcher (with Dzine AI), first author of StereoWorld (CVPR 2026).
creators.why: StereoWorld converts ordinary video into headset-ready stereo with a generative video prior.
creators.role_zh: 立体视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 北京交通大学研究者（与 Dzine AI 合作），StereoWorld（CVPR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: StereoWorld 借助生成式视频先验，把普通视频转换为可在头显中观看的立体视频。

creators.name: JD.com
creators.bio: Chinese retail and technology group whose JoyAI team releases open models through jd-opensource.
creators.why: Released JoyAI-Video-Edit, an open real-time editor that restyles a live camera stream from text instructions.
creators.role_zh: 中国电商与科技公司
creators.bio_zh: 中国零售与科技集团，其 JoyAI 团队通过 jd-opensource 发布开源模型。
creators.why_zh: 发布了开源实时编辑模型 JoyAI-Video-Edit，可按文字指令改写实时摄像头画面。

creators.name: Alibaba Token Hub (ATH)
creators.role: Alibaba Group business group behind HappyHorse and HappyOyster
creators.bio: Alibaba Group business group whose AI Innovation Unit (formerly the Future Life Lab of Taobao and Tmall Group) builds the HappyHorse audio-video models served through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; it also launched the HappyOyster world-model product in 2026.
creators.why: HappyHorse reached the top of public video arenas in 2026 as a second Alibaba video line alongside Wan.
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴集团旗下推出 HappyHorse 与 HappyOyster 的事业群
creators.bio_zh: 阿里巴巴集团旗下事业群，其 AI 创新事业部（前身为淘天集团未来生活实验室）研发通过阿里云百炼提供的 HappyHorse 音视频模型；2026 年还推出了世界模型产品 HappyOyster。
creators.why_zh: HappyHorse 在 2026 年登上公开视频竞技场前列，成为阿里在 Wan 之外的第二条视频模型线。

creators.name: Kandinsky Lab
creators.role: Generative-model team behind the Kandinsky image and video models
creators.bio: Research team that releases the Kandinsky image, video and world models, most as open weights; Kandinsky 6.0 Video (2026) generates video with synchronized audio.
creators.why: One of the few open-weight joint audio-video model families outside the US and China, with native Russian-language support.
creators.role_zh: Kandinsky 图像与视频模型的研发团队
creators.bio_zh: 发布 Kandinsky 图像、视频与世界模型的研究团队，多数模型为开源权重；Kandinsky 6.0 Video（2026）可生成带同步音频的视频。
creators.why_zh: 美国与中国之外为数不多的开源音视频联合生成模型系列之一，原生支持俄语。

creators.name: Leia Inc.
creators.bio: Maker of switchable 2D/3D lightfield displays and the Immersity platform, whose software estimates depth in ordinary photos and videos to show them in 3D.
creators.why: Its conversion tools turn flat images and clips into depth-based 3D for 3D screens and VR without a stereo camera.
creators.role_zh: 3D 显示与空间 AI 公司（Immersity）
creators.bio_zh: 可切换 2D/3D 光场显示屏与 Immersity 平台的开发者，其软件估计普通照片和视频的深度，从而以 3D 方式呈现。
creators.why_zh: 其转换工具无需立体摄影机，就能把平面图片和视频变成适用于 3D 屏幕与 VR 的深度 3D 内容。

creators.name: Xinyu Wang
creators.bio: Tsinghua University researcher, first author of LiveEdit (ECCV 2026).
creators.why: LiveEdit edits a video stream frame by frame in real time while keeping unedited regions stable.
creators.role_zh: 流式视频编辑研究者
creators.bio_zh: 清华大学研究者，LiveEdit（ECCV 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: LiveEdit 逐帧实时编辑视频流，同时让未编辑区域保持稳定。

creators.name: Justin Cui
creators.bio: UCLA researcher, first author of Self-Forcing++, developed with ByteDance Seed.
creators.why: Self-Forcing++ stretches a few-second autoregressive video model to minutes without a long-video teacher.
creators.role_zh: 长视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校研究者，Self-Forcing++ 第一作者，该工作与字节跳动 Seed 合作完成。
