creators.why_zh: Self-Forcing++ 无需长视频教师模型，就把只能生成几秒的自回归视频模型延伸到数分钟。

creators.name: Kunhao Liu
creators.bio: Nanyang Technological University researcher, first author of Rolling Forcing (ICLR 2026), developed with Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.why: Rolling Forcing streams multi-minute video in real time on one GPU with little drift.
creators.role_zh: 流式视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学研究者，Rolling Forcing（ICLR 2026）第一作者，该工作与腾讯 ARC 实验室合作完成。
creators.why_zh: Rolling Forcing 可在单张 GPU 上实时流式生成数分钟视频，漂移很小。

creators.name: Yuwei Guo
creators.bio: The Chinese University of Hong Kong researcher, first author of AnimateDiff (ICLR 2024).
creators.why: AnimateDiff made community image models animate, seeding the open video tooling ecosystem.
creators.role_zh: 视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港中文大学研究者，AnimateDiff（ICLR 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: AnimateDiff 让社区图像模型能够生成动画，催生了开源视频工具生态。

creators.name: Jingwei Ma
creators.bio: University of Washington researcher, first author of VidPanos (SIGGRAPH Asia 2024) with Google DeepMind.
creators.why: VidPanos turns a casual panning clip into a wide panoramic video in which the whole scene keeps moving.
creators.role_zh: 全景视频合成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 华盛顿大学研究者，与 Google DeepMind 合作的 VidPanos（SIGGRAPH Asia 2024）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: VidPanos 把随手拍的摇镜头视频变成整个场景都在运动的宽幅全景视频。

creators.name: Kevin Xie
creators.role: Researcher at NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab
creators.bio: NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab researcher, co-first author of VideoPanda.
creators.why: VideoPanda generates 360° video from text or a single ordinary video.
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 多伦多 AI 实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 多伦多 AI 实验室研究者，VideoPanda 共同第一作者。
creators.why_zh: VideoPanda 可根据文字或一段普通视频生成 360° 视频。

creators.name: Michal Geyer
creators.bio: Weizmann Institute of Science researcher, first author of Eye2Eye (work done at Google DeepMind).
creators.why: Eye2Eye generates the second eye's view of a video directly, without depth estimation and warping.
creators.role_zh: 视频合成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 魏茨曼科学研究所研究者，Eye2Eye 第一作者（工作在 Google DeepMind 完成）。
creators.why_zh: Eye2Eye 不经深度估计与扭曲，直接生成视频的另一只眼视图。

creators.name: Peng Dai
creators.role: Researcher in stereoscopic and spatial video
creators.bio: The University of Hong Kong researcher, first author of S²VG, developed with Google.
creators.why: S²VG turns the output of an ordinary video generator into stereo and spatial video without retraining.
creators.role_zh: 立体与空间视频研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学研究者，与 Google 合作的 S²VG 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: S²VG 无需重新训练，就能把普通视频生成模型的输出变成立体视频与空间视频。

creators.name: Ting-Hsuan Chen
creators.bio: University of Southern California researcher, co-first author of Pantheon360 (CVPR 2026) with Bosch Research and NYCU.
creators.why: Pantheon360 generates camera-controlled 360° video that stays geometrically consistent, aimed at digital twins.
creators.role_zh: 360° 视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 南加州大学研究者，与博世研究院、阳明交通大学合作的 Pantheon360（CVPR 2026）共同第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Pantheon360 生成几何一致、可控镜头路径的 360° 视频，面向数字孪生。

creators.name: Sixiao Zheng
creators.role: Researcher in controllable video world models
creators.bio: Fudan University researcher, first author of VerseCrafter (CVPR 2026) with Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.why: VerseCrafter lets camera and several objects be directed through one explicit 4D scene state.
creators.role_zh: 可控视频世界模型研究者
creators.bio_zh: 复旦大学研究者，与腾讯 ARC 实验室合作的 VerseCrafter（CVPR 2026）第一作者。
creators.why_zh: VerseCrafter 通过一个显式的 4D 场景状态同时调度镜头与多个物体。

creators.name: Eyeline Labs (Netflix)
creators.role: Research lab of Netflix's Eyeline production-technology group
creators.bio: Netflix-affiliated research lab working on generative video and capture for film production, including Vista4D (CVPR 2026 highlight).
creators.why: Brings film-production requirements such as reshooting a captured scene from a new camera path into generative video research.
creators.role_zh: Netflix 旗下 Eyeline 制作技术团队的研究实验室
creators.bio_zh: 隶属 Netflix 的研究实验室，研究面向影视制作的生成式视频与拍摄技术，成果包括 Vista4D（CVPR 2026 Highlight）。
creators.why_zh: 把影视制作中的需求（例如用新镜头路径重拍已拍摄的场景）带入生成式视频研究。

creators.name: Hongzhou Zhu
creators.bio: Hongzhou Zhu is first author of Causal Forcing (ICML 2026) in Jun Zhu's machine learning group at Tsinghua University and a co-author of Shengshu's Vidu S2 report.
creators.why: Causal Forcing is an open, widely reused recipe for turning video diffusion models into real-time autoregressive generators.
creators.role_zh: 清华大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Hongzhou Zhu是 Causal Forcing（ICML 2026）的第一作者，来自清华大学朱军教授的机器学习组，也是生数科技 Vidu S2 技术报告的作者之一。
creators.why_zh: Causal Forcing 是一套开源、被广泛复用的方法，可把视频扩散模型变成实时自回归生成器。

creators.name: Bowen Xue
creators.bio: Bowen Xue is first author of Ring Forcing (ECCV 2026), written at Stanford University with Lvmin Zhang and Maneesh Agrawala and with ByteDance researchers.
creators.why: Ring Forcing addresses object permanence, the memory a long generated scenario needs to stay consistent.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: Bowen Xue 是 Ring Forcing（ECCV 2026）的第一作者，该工作在斯坦福大学完成，合作者包括张吕敏（Lvmin Zhang）、Maneesh Agrawala 以及字节跳动的研究者。
creators.why_zh: Ring Forcing 关注物体恒存性，这是长时生成情境保持前后一致所需的记忆。

creators.name: Yang-Tian Sun
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: Yang-Tian Sun is first author of Stereo World Model (CVPR 2026), developed at The University of Hong Kong with VAST and ByteDance Pico.
creators.why: Stereo World Model generates both eyes of a video together, which is what headset playback needs.
creators.role_zh: 香港大学博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Yang-Tian Sun是 Stereo World Model（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，该工作由香港大学与 VAST、字节跳动 Pico 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: Stereo World Model 同时生成左右眼视频，这正是头显播放所需要的。

creators.name: Shiqian Li
creators.role: Researcher, Peking University and Tencent Hunyuan
creators.bio: Shiqian Li is first author of 4DStreamCtrl (2026), a streaming video generator with 3D camera and object control, from Peking University and Tencent Hunyuan.
creators.why: 4DStreamCtrl lets a person steer camera and object motion while the video is being generated.
creators.role_zh: 北京大学与腾讯混元研究者
creators.bio_zh: Shiqian Li是 4DStreamCtrl（2026）的第一作者。该工作来自北京大学与腾讯混元，是一个可用三维方式控制镜头和物体的流式视频生成器。
creators.why_zh: 4DStreamCtrl 让人在视频生成的同时操控镜头和物体运动。

creators.name: Haocheng Xi
creators.bio: Haocheng Xi is first author of Video DeltaNet (2026), an open hybrid-attention version of MiniMax H3, written at UC Berkeley during an internship at Impossible, Inc.
creators.why: Video DeltaNet makes an open audio-video model generate faster than playback.
creators.role_zh: 加州大学伯克利分校博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: Haocheng Xi 是 Video DeltaNet（2026）的第一作者。该工作是 MiniMax H3 的开源混合注意力版本，在加州大学伯克利分校完成，部分工作在 Impossible, Inc. 实习期间进行。
creators.why_zh: Video DeltaNet 让一个开源音视频模型的生成速度快过播放速度。

creators.name: Visko
creators.bio: Visko Platform Inc. was founded in 2025 by Qing (Will) Yin and released Orbis, a model that streams video continuously while users change the prompt; it announced a $10 million pre-seed round on 2026-09-01.
creators.why: Visko frames generated video as a process that keeps running and accepts direction, rather than a clip that is rendered and finished.
creators.role_zh: 开发实时“活模型”（Live Model）视频生成的创业公司
creators.bio_zh: Visko Platform Inc. 由 Qing（Will）Yin 于 2025 年创立，发布了 Orbis：一个在用户随时修改提示词时仍持续流式生成视频的模型。公司于 2026 年 9 月 1 日宣布完成 1000 万美元种子前轮融资。
creators.why_zh: Visko 把生成视频看作一个持续运行、可随时被引导的过程，而不是渲染完就结束的片段。

creators.name: MiniMax
creators.name_zh: 稀宇科技 MiniMax（海螺 AI）
creators.bio: Chinese AI company behind the Hailuo video models, the MiniMax language models and speech models; it released the H3 video model with open weights in July 2026.
creators.why: One of the few labs releasing a flagship audio-video model with downloadable weights.
creators.role_zh: 大模型公司（海螺 AI）
creators.bio_zh: 海螺视频模型、MiniMax 语言模型与语音模型的开发者；2026 年 7 月以开源权重发布 H3 视频模型。
creators.why_zh: 少数把旗舰级音视频模型以可下载权重形式发布的团队之一。

creators.name: Shengshu Technology (Vidu)
creators.role: Video-generation company spun out of Tsinghua University
creators.bio: Founded by Tsinghua researchers; launched Vidu in April 2024 and later the Q-series and real-time S-series models.
creators.why: Its real-time Vidu S line brings conversation-paced video generation to a consumer product.
creators.role_zh: 源自清华大学的视频生成公司
creators.bio_zh: 由清华大学研究者创立；2024 年 4 月发布 Vidu，此后推出 Q 系列与实时 S 系列模型。
creators.why_zh: 其实时 Vidu S 系列把跟得上对话节奏的视频生成带进了消费级产品。

creators.name: Pika
creators.bio: Founded in 2023 by Stanford PhD students; known for Pika 1.0 and playful editing effects.
creators.why: An early example of video generation designed for casual creators rather than studios.
creators.role_zh: 面向大众的视频生成初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 2023 年由斯坦福博士生创立，以 Pika 1.0 和趣味化编辑特效著称。
creators.why_zh: 较早为普通创作者而非影视公司设计视频生成的例子。

creators.name: Midjourney
creators.role: Independent image and video generation lab
creators.bio: Self-funded lab known for its aesthetic image models; released its first video model in June 2025.
creators.why: States real-time open-world simulation as its long-term goal.
creators.role_zh: 独立图像与视频生成实验室
creators.bio_zh: 自筹资金的实验室，以审美导向的图像模型著称；2025 年 6 月发布首个视频模型。
creators.why_zh: 公开把实时开放世界模拟作为长期目标。

creators.name: Moonvalley
creators.bio: Builds Marey, a video model trained only on licensed footage, together with the studio Asteria.
creators.why: Shows a licensed-data route to generated footage that institutions can clear legally.
creators.role_zh: 面向影视创作者的视频生成公司
creators.bio_zh: 与工作室 Asteria 一同开发只用授权素材训练的视频模型 Marey。
creators.why_zh: 展示了一条基于授权数据的生成素材路线，便于机构完成版权审查。

creators.name: Zhipu AI
creators.role: Foundation-model company spun out of Tsinghua University
creators.bio: Maker of the GLM language models and the open CogVideoX video models behind its Qingying product.
creators.why: Released the first strong open text-to-video model from a Chinese lab.
creators.role_zh: 源自清华大学的大模型公司
creators.bio_zh: GLM 语言模型及开源 CogVideoX 视频模型（“清影”产品底座）的开发者。
creators.why_zh: 发布了国内首个表现强劲的开源文生视频模型。

creators.name: Genmo
creators.bio: Startup that released Mochi 1, a 10B-parameter open text-to-video model under Apache 2.0.
creators.why: A permissively licensed base widely used in academic video research.
creators.role_zh: 开源视频模型初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 发布了 100 亿参数、Apache 2.0 许可的开源文生视频模型 Mochi 1。
creators.why_zh: 许可宽松，被学术视频研究广泛采用。

creators.name: Lightricks
creators.role: Creative-app company and maker of LTX
creators.bio: Maker of Facetune and LTX Studio; releases the open LTX-Video, LTX-2 and LTX-2.5 models.
creators.why: Pushes open video toward real-time speed and production resolution with audio.
creators.role_zh: 创意应用公司，LTX 模型开发者
creators.bio_zh: Facetune 与 LTX Studio 的开发者，发布开源的 LTX-Video、LTX-2 与 LTX-2.5 模型。
creators.why_zh: 推动开源视频模型达到实时速度和带音频的生产级分辨率。

creators.name: Sand AI
creators.bio: Startup that open-sourced MAGI-1, a 24B-parameter autoregressive video model, in April 2025.
creators.why: Released one of the first large open autoregressive video models.
creators.role_zh: 视频生成初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 2025 年 4 月开源了 240 亿参数的自回归视频模型 MAGI-1。
creators.why_zh: 发布了最早的大规模开源自回归视频模型之一。

creators.name: Skywork (Kunlun Tech)
creators.bio: Kunlun Tech's AI unit, which open-sources the SkyReels video models and the Matrix world models.
creators.why: Its SkyReels-V2 brought diffusion forcing to open, unlimited-length video.
creators.role_zh: 昆仑万维旗下人工智能业务
creators.bio_zh: 昆仑万维的人工智能业务，开源 SkyReels 视频模型与 Matrix 世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 其 SkyReels-V2 把扩散强制方法带入开源的无限时长视频生成。

creators.name: Krea
creators.bio: Creative-tool company known for real-time image generation; released the open Krea Realtime 14B video model in October 2025.
creators.why: Showed real-time video at 14B-parameter scale with open weights.
creators.role_zh: 实时创意 AI 工具公司
creators.bio_zh: 以实时图像生成著称的创意工具公司；2025 年 10 月发布开源的 Krea Realtime 14B 视频模型。
creators.why_zh: 以开源权重展示了 140 亿参数规模的实时视频生成。

creators.name: Tencent ARC Lab
creators.role: Applied research center of Tencent PCG
creators.bio: Tencent research lab working on visual generation and editing, including StereoCrafter and Rolling Forcing.
creators.why: Its stereo conversion work targets headset playback of ordinary video.
creators.role_zh: 腾讯 PCG 应用研究中心
creators.bio_zh: 腾讯从事视觉生成与编辑研究的实验室，成果包括 StereoCrafter 与 Rolling Forcing。
creators.why_zh: 其立体转换工作面向在头显中播放普通视频。

creators.name: Tianwei Yin
creators.bio: MIT PhD researcher, first author of DMD distillation and CausVid.
creators.why: CausVid turned slow video diffusion into streaming generation.
creators.role_zh: 快速生成模型研究者
creators.bio_zh: MIT 博士研究者，DMD 蒸馏与 CausVid 的第一作者。
creators.why_zh: CausVid 把缓慢的视频扩散变成了流式生成。

creators.name: Xun Huang
creators.bio: Research scientist (Adobe Research at the time of Self Forcing), known for AdaIN style transfer and real-time video diffusion.
creators.why: Self Forcing became a common training recipe for real-time video and world models.
creators.role_zh: 生成式视频研究者
creators.bio_zh: 研究科学家（Self Forcing 发表时任职于 Adobe Research），以 AdaIN 风格迁移和实时视频扩散研究著称。
creators.why_zh: Self Forcing 成为实时视频与世界模型常用的训练方法。

creators.name: Shuai Yang
creators.bio: Researcher affiliated with NVIDIA and HKUST (Guangzhou), first author of LongLive.
creators.why: LongLive showed minutes-long, prompt-switchable video in real time.
creators.role_zh: 长视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 就职于 NVIDIA 与香港科技大学（广州）的研究者，LongLive 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: LongLive 展示了可实时切换提示、长达数分钟的视频生成。

creators.name: Akio Kodaira
creators.bio: Lead author of StreamDiffusion, developed with collaborators including UC Berkeley researchers.
creators.why: StreamDiffusion made live camera-feed diffusion practical for artists.
creators.role_zh: 实时扩散流水线开发者
creators.bio_zh: StreamDiffusion 的主要作者，与 UC Berkeley 等研究者合作完成。
creators.why_zh: StreamDiffusion 让艺术家能实际使用对实时画面的扩散重绘。

creators.name: Lvmin Zhang
creators.bio: Stanford PhD researcher, author of ControlNet, IC-Light and FramePack.
creators.why: FramePack made minute-long video possible on laptop GPUs.
creators.role_zh: 可控生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福博士研究者，ControlNet、IC-Light 与 FramePack 的作者。
creators.why_zh: FramePack 让笔记本 GPU 也能生成分钟级视频。

creators.name: Jianhong Bai
creators.bio: Zhejiang University researcher who developed ReCamMaster with Kuaishou's Kling team.
creators.why: Re-rendering real footage from new viewpoints approaches free-viewpoint video.
creators.role_zh: 镜头可控视频研究者
creators.bio_zh: 浙江大学研究者，与快手可灵团队合作完成 ReCamMaster。
creators.why_zh: 从新视角重新渲染真实视频，接近自由视点视频。

creators.name: Qian Wang
creators.bio: Peking University (Shenzhen Graduate School) researcher, first author of 360DVD.
creators.why: 360DVD was among the first text-to-360° video models.
creators.role_zh: 全景视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 北京大学深圳研究生院研究者，360DVD 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: 360DVD 是最早的文本生成 360° 视频模型之一。

creators.name: Jing Tan
creators.bio: CUHK researcher, first author of Imagine360.
creators.why: Imagine360 turns ordinary video into 360° video.
creators.role_zh: 沉浸式视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港中文大学研究者，Imagine360 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Imagine360 把普通视频变成 360° 视频。

creators.name: Sijie Zhao
creators.bio: Tencent researcher, co-first author of StereoCrafter.
creators.why: StereoCrafter converts 2D video into stereo 3D for headsets.
creators.role_zh: 立体视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 腾讯研究者，StereoCrafter 共同第一作者。
creators.why_zh: StereoCrafter 把 2D 视频转换为头显可用的立体 3D。

creators.name: Guibao Shen
creators.bio: HKUST (Guangzhou) researcher, first author of StereoPilot, developed during an internship with Kuaishou's Kling team.
creators.why: StereoPilot makes generated or recorded video headset-ready in one pass.
creators.role_zh: 立体转换研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）研究者，StereoPilot 第一作者，该工作在快手可灵团队实习期间完成。
creators.why_zh: StereoPilot 一次推理即可让生成或录制的视频适配头显。

creators.name: Ziyi Wu
creators.bio: University of Toronto PhD researcher; first author of 360Anything, done at Google DeepMind.
creators.why: 360Anything lifts any image or video, including world-model footage, to 360°.
creators.role_zh: 生成式三维与视频研究者
creators.bio_zh: 多伦多大学博士研究者；360Anything 第一作者，该工作在 Google DeepMind 完成。
creators.why_zh: 360Anything 能把任意图像或视频（包括世界模型画面）提升为 360°。

creators.name: Shenghai Yuan
creators.bio: Peking University researcher (Li Yuan's group, with ByteDance), first author of Helios.
creators.why: Helios shows real-time generation at 14B-parameter scale.
creators.role_zh: 实时视频生成研究者
creators.bio_zh: 北京大学研究者（袁粒课题组，与字节跳动合作），Helios 第一作者。
creators.why_zh: Helios 展示了 140 亿参数规模的实时生成。

creators.name: Haiyu Zhang
creators.bio: Co-first author of WorldPlay2 (2026), a follow-up to Tencent Hunyuan's WorldPlay real-time world model written by several of the same authors.
creators.why: Works on making real-time world models controllable by actions and text events over long sessions.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，WorldPlay2 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WorldPlay2（2026）的共同第一作者；该工作是腾讯混元实时世界模型 WorldPlay 的后续研究，作者与 WorldPlay 多有重合。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何让实时世界模型在长时会话中同时受动作与文字事件控制。

creators.name: Haoxuan Che
creators.role: Researcher at HKUST; first author of GameGen-X
creators.bio: First author of GameGen-X (2024), a diffusion transformer for generating and interactively controlling open-world game video.
creators.why: His team built one of the first large game-video datasets for training game world models.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学研究者，GameGen-X 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: GameGen-X（2024）的第一作者；该模型是用于生成并交互控制开放世界游戏视频的扩散 Transformer。
creators.why_zh: 其团队构建了最早用于训练游戏世界模型的大规模游戏视频数据集之一。

creators.name: Ruili Feng
creators.role: Researcher at Alibaba Tongyi Lab; first author of The Matrix
creators.bio: First author of The Matrix (2024), a world simulator from Alibaba's Tongyi Lab with the University of Hong Kong, the University of Waterloo and the Vector Institute.
creators.why: Showed that game footage with action labels can teach a world model controls that transfer to real scenes.
creators.role_zh: 阿里通义实验室研究者，The Matrix 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: The Matrix（2024）的第一作者；该世界模拟器由阿里通义实验室与香港大学、滑铁卢大学和 Vector Institute 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: 证明带动作标注的游戏画面可以教会世界模型一套能迁移到真实场景的控制方式。

creators.name: Junliang Guo
creators.role: Researcher at Microsoft Research; first author of MineWorld
creators.bio: First author of MineWorld (2025), Microsoft Research's open real-time interactive world model of Minecraft.
creators.why: Pushed token-based game world models to playable speeds with parallel decoding.
creators.role_zh: 微软研究院研究者，MineWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: MineWorld（2025）的第一作者；MineWorld 是微软研究院开源的 Minecraft 实时交互世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 借助并行解码，把基于离散 token 的游戏世界模型推进到可游玩的速度。

creators.name: Alaya Lab
creators.bio: A lab working on AI game creation, world models and game agents; it released the Yume interactive world models (2025), the Sekai exploration datasets and the open AlayaWorld framework (2026).
creators.why: One of the most consistent sources of fully open interactive world models: weights, code and part of the data.
creators.role_zh: AI 游戏与世界模型实验室
creators.bio_zh: 一家研究 AI 游戏创作、世界模型与游戏智能体的实验室，发布了 Yume 交互世界模型（2025）、Sekai 探索数据集以及开源的 AlayaWorld 框架（2026）。
creators.why_zh: 开源交互世界模型最稳定的来源之一：公开权重、代码和部分训练数据。

creators.name: Xiaofeng Mao
creators.bio: First author of Yume (2025) and Yume 1.5, open interactive world-generation models later published under Alaya Lab.
creators.why: Helped make a real-world interactive world model fully open, from data to weights.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，Yume 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Yume（2025）与 Yume 1.5 的第一作者；这两个开源交互世界生成模型后来以 Alaya Lab 的名义发布。
creators.why_zh: 参与把一个面向真实场景的交互世界模型从数据到权重完整开源。

creators.name: Noiz AI
creators.bio: Company that, with the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, released HelixWorld (2026), a real-time world model that generates video together with spatial stereo sound.
creators.why: Adds spatial sound, not just pictures, to what an interactive world model generates.
creators.role_zh: 音视频生成式 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: 与香港科技大学合作发布 HelixWorld（2026）的公司；HelixWorld 是一个同时生成视频与空间立体声的实时世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 让交互世界模型生成的不只是画面，还有空间声音。

creators.name: Astronex
creators.bio: Team behind Astronex-World 1.0 (2026), an open-weight real-time world-model foundation released through the Astronex-Robotics GitHub organisation; little else about it is public.
creators.why: Shows how far a small team can take an open 5B world model on modest GPUs.
creators.role_zh: 机器人与世界模型团队
creators.bio_zh: 开源实时世界模型基座 Astronex-World 1.0（2026）的发布团队，通过 GitHub 组织 Astronex-Robotics 发布；其他公开信息很少。
creators.why_zh: 展示了一个小团队用有限的 GPU 能把开源 5B 世界模型做到什么程度。

creators.name: Runjia Li
creators.role: PhD researcher at the University of Oxford (VGG); first author of VMem
creators.bio: First author of VMem (ICCV 2025 highlight), a surfel-indexed view memory for consistent interactive scene video, with Philip Torr, Andrea Vedaldi and Tomas Jakab.
creators.why: Showed that indexing memory by 3D surfaces makes revisits in generated scenes consistent and cheap.
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学 VGG 博士研究者，VMem 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: VMem（ICCV 2025 Highlight）的第一作者；该工作与 Philip Torr、Andrea Vedaldi、Tomas Jakab 合作，提出以面元为索引的视图记忆，使交互式场景视频保持一致。
creators.why_zh: 证明按三维表面为记忆建立索引，可以让生成场景中的“回访”既一致又省算力。

creators.name: Ryan Po
creators.role: PhD researcher at Stanford University; first author of Long-Context State-Space Video World Models
creators.bio: First author of Long-Context State-Space Video World Models (2025), with collaborators from Stanford, Princeton and Adobe Research.
creators.why: Brought state-space models into video world models as a way to remember far back at low cost.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学博士研究者，《长上下文状态空间视频世界模型》第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 《长上下文状态空间视频世界模型》（2025）的第一作者，合作者来自斯坦福大学、普林斯顿大学与 Adobe Research。
creators.why_zh: 把状态空间模型引入视频世界模型，以较低成本记住更久以前的内容。

creators.name: Kiwhan Song
creators.role: Researcher at MIT; first author of History-Guided Video Diffusion
creators.bio: First author of History-Guided Video Diffusion (ICML 2025), which introduced the Diffusion Forcing Transformer with Boyuan Chen, Max Simchowitz, Yilun Du, Russ Tedrake and Vincent Sitzmann.
creators.why: Gave video world models a principled way to condition on, and lean on, a variable amount of history.
creators.role_zh: MIT 研究者，《历史引导视频扩散》第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 《历史引导视频扩散》（ICML 2025）的第一作者；该工作与 Boyuan Chen、Max Simchowitz、Yilun Du、Russ Tedrake、Vincent Sitzmann 合作提出 Diffusion Forcing Transformer。
creators.why_zh: 为视频世界模型提供了一种有理论依据的方法，可以以可变长度的历史为条件并加强其作用。

creators.name: Junyi Wu
creators.bio: First author of World-T3 (2026), a real-time video world model with test-time-training memory, from the University of Illinois Chicago and Meta Reality Labs.
creators.why: Treats memory as weights that keep learning during play, rather than as a growing context window.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，World-T3 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: World-T3（2026）的第一作者；该实时视频世界模型采用测试时训练记忆，由伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校与 Meta Reality Labs 合作完成。
creators.why_zh: 把记忆看作在使用过程中持续学习的权重，而不是不断变长的上下文窗口。

creators.name: Liangyang Ouyang
creators.role: PhD researcher at the University of Tokyo; first author of HelloWorld
creators.bio: First author of HelloWorld (2026), a video world model with socially responsive characters, with Alaya Lab and Yoichi Sato's lab at the University of Tokyo.
creators.why: Moves world models from places toward people who notice and respond to the viewer.
creators.role_zh: 东京大学博士研究者，HelloWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: HelloWorld（2026）的第一作者；该视频世界模型让画面中的角色能对用户做出社交回应，由 Alaya Lab 与东京大学佐藤洋一实验室合作完成。
creators.why_zh: 让世界模型从“场所”走向会注意并回应观看者的“人”。

creators.name: Fangfu Liu
creators.role: Researcher; first author of Gamma-World (with NVIDIA)
creators.bio: First author of Gamma-World (2026), a multi-agent interactive world model from NVIDIA Research's Spatial Intelligence Lab.
creators.why: Works on world models where several people or agents share one generated world.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，Gamma-World 第一作者（与 NVIDIA 合作）
creators.bio_zh: Gamma-World（2026）的第一作者；该多智能体交互世界模型来自 NVIDIA Research 空间智能实验室。
creators.why_zh: 研究多人或多个智能体共处于同一生成世界中的世界模型。

creators.name: Moxin
creators.bio: Company behind MoWorld (2026), which it describes as the first real-time interactive world model built on neural processing units; shown at WAIC 2026 and open-sourced in September 2026.
creators.why: Shows real-time world models running on domestic Chinese accelerators rather than NVIDIA GPUs.
creators.role_zh: 基于 NPU 构建世界模型的公司
creators.bio_zh: MoWorld（2026）的开发公司；它称 MoWorld 是首个基于神经网络处理器（NPU）构建的实时交互世界模型，曾在 2026 年世界人工智能大会展出，并于 2026 年 9 月开源。
creators.why_zh: 展示了实时世界模型可以在国产加速芯片而非 NVIDIA GPU 上运行。

creators.name: Insta360
creators.role: 360° camera maker with an AI research team
creators.bio: Maker of consumer 360° cameras whose research team, with the Institute of Automation of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, released the PanoWorld panoramic world model in 2026.
creators.why: Panoramic generation is the format a headset can show directly, and Insta360 owns large amounts of 360° footage.
creators.role_zh: 拥有 AI 研究团队的全景相机厂商
creators.bio_zh: 消费级全景相机厂商；其研究团队与中国科学院自动化研究所合作，于 2026 年发布全景世界模型 PanoWorld。
creators.why_zh: 全景生成正是头显可以直接呈现的格式，而 Insta360 拥有大量全景素材。

creators.name: Haoyuan Li
creators.bio: First author of PanoWorld (2026), a panoramic world model with long-range memory from Insta360 Research and the Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences.
creators.why: Brings 360° output, the native format of headsets, to interactive world models.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，PanoWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: PanoWorld（2026）的第一作者；该具备长程记忆的全景世界模型由 Insta360 研究团队与中国科学院自动化研究所合作完成。
creators.why_zh: 把头显的原生格式——360° 画面——带入交互世界模型。

creators.name: Georgy Savva
creators.role: Researcher at New York University; first author of Solaris
creators.bio: First author of Solaris (2026), a multiplayer video world model for Minecraft built with an automated multi-agent data-collection system at New York University.
creators.why: Works on world models that several players share, rather than a single observer.
creators.role_zh: 纽约大学研究者，Solaris 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Solaris（2026）的第一作者。Solaris 是纽约大学推出的《我的世界》多人视频世界模型，配套一套自动化的多智能体数据采集系统。
creators.why_zh: 研究多名玩家共享的世界模型，而不只是单一观察者。

creators.name: Li Hu
creators.role: Researcher at Alibaba Tongyi Lab; first author of WanToFight
creators.bio: First author of WanToFight (2026), a real-time two-player fighting-game engine generated by a video model at Alibaba's Tongyi Lab.
creators.why: Brings adversarial, contact-heavy two-player interaction into generative game engines.
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴通义实验室研究者，WanToFight 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WanToFight（2026）的第一作者。WanToFight 是阿里巴巴通义实验室用视频模型生成的实时双人格斗游戏引擎。
creators.why_zh: 把充满肢体接触的双人对抗交互引入生成式游戏引擎。

creators.name: Ziyang Ye
creators.role: Researcher at CUHK-Shenzhen; first author of WorldCast
creators.bio: First author of WorldCast (2026), a distributed multiplayer world model for Counter-Strike 2, with co-authors from CUHK-Shenzhen, SLAI, Tsinghua SIGS, Didi's Voyager Research and USTC.
creators.why: Shows how a shared generated world could scale the way a networked game does.
creators.role_zh: 香港中文大学（深圳）研究者，WorldCast 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WorldCast（2026）的第一作者。WorldCast 是面向《反恐精英 2》的分布式多人世界模型，合作者来自香港中文大学（深圳）、SLAI、清华大学深圳国际研究生院、滴滴 Voyager Research 与中国科学技术大学。
creators.why_zh: 展示了共享的生成世界如何像联网游戏一样扩展。

creators.name: Junchao Huang
creators.role: Researcher at CUHK-Shenzhen; first author of SolarWM
creators.bio: First author of SolarWM (2026), a fully open data and training stack for long-horizon video world models, and co-author of WorldCast.
creators.why: Makes world-model training reproducible with open data, code and weights.
creators.role_zh: 香港中文大学（深圳）研究者，SolarWM 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: SolarWM（2026）的第一作者，该工作为长时视频世界模型提供完全开放的数据与训练技术栈；他也是 WorldCast 的合作者。
creators.why_zh: 用开放的数据、代码与权重，让世界模型训练可以复现。

creators.name: RhOS.ai
creators.role: AI company; co-developer of the Khora multi-agent world model
creators.bio: Developed Khora with Ophilus.AI, a multi-agent world model released as a technical report with an online demo in August 2026.
creators.why: Works on a shared world state that many simultaneous players can query.
creators.role_zh: AI 公司，多智能体世界模型 Khora 的联合开发方
creators.bio_zh: 与 Ophilus.AI 联合开发多智能体世界模型 Khora，于 2026 年 8 月发布技术报告与在线演示。
creators.why_zh: 研究可供许多玩家同时查询的共享世界状态。

creators.name: Ophilus.AI
creators.role: AI company; co-developer of the Khora multi-agent world model
creators.bio: Co-developed Khora with RhOS.ai, a world model that renders any number of players' views from one shared world state (technical report, August 2026).
creators.why: Works on multi-agent world models in which participants can be added at run time.
creators.role_zh: AI 公司，多智能体世界模型 Khora 的联合开发方
creators.bio_zh: 与 RhOS.ai 联合开发 Khora：一个从同一份共享世界状态渲染任意数量玩家画面的世界模型（2026 年 8 月发布技术报告）。
creators.why_zh: 研究可在运行时增加参与者的多智能体世界模型。

creators.name: Zhifei Chen
creators.role: Researcher at HKUST (Guangzhou); first author of ReWorld
creators.bio: First author of ReWorld (2026), a real-time interactive world model with long-horizon memory developed at HKUST (Guangzhou) with Alibaba's ATH group.
creators.why: Works on world models that remember places over long sessions while still responding in real time.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学（广州）研究者，ReWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: ReWorld（2026）的第一作者。ReWorld 是香港科技大学（广州）与阿里巴巴 ATH 事业群合作开发的实时交互世界模型，具备长时记忆。
creators.why_zh: 研究在长时会话中记住地点、同时保持实时响应的世界模型。

creators.name: MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models
creators.role: Foundation-model institute of Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence
creators.bio: Research institute at MBZUAI; in September 2026 its world-model group released LOCI (spatial linear memory) and Memorizon (training beyond the context window).
creators.why: Works on keeping streaming world models consistent when the camera revisits a place.
creators.role_zh: 穆罕默德·本·扎耶德人工智能大学（MBZUAI）的基础模型研究院
creators.bio_zh: MBZUAI 下属研究院；2026 年 9 月，其世界模型团队发布了 LOCI（空间线性记忆）与 Memorizon（超出上下文窗口的训练）。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何让流式世界模型在相机重访同一地点时保持一致。

creators.name: Ji Xia
creators.role: Researcher at the MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models; first author of LOCI
creators.bio: First author of LOCI (2026), a streaming world model with a hybrid spatial memory, from the MBZUAI Institute of Foundation Models group that also published Memorizon.
creators.why: Works on memory architectures that keep revisited places faithful at constant cost.
creators.role_zh: MBZUAI 基础模型研究院研究者，LOCI 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: LOCI（2026）的第一作者。LOCI 是采用混合空间记忆的流式世界模型，出自 MBZUAI 基础模型研究院的同一团队，该团队还发表了 Memorizon。
creators.why_zh: 研究以恒定开销让重访地点保持忠实的记忆结构。

creators.name: Hanlin Wang
creators.role: Researcher at HKUST; first author of WorldDirector
creators.bio: First author of WorldDirector (2026), a controllable video world model with persistent memory of moving objects, from HKUST and Ant Group.
creators.why: Works on keeping moving people and objects consistent in generated worlds.
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学研究者，WorldDirector 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: WorldDirector（2026）的第一作者。WorldDirector 是香港科技大学与蚂蚁集团合作的可控视频世界模型，能持久记住运动物体。
creators.why_zh: 研究如何让生成世界中运动的人和物保持一致。

creators.name: Seedleap.ai
creators.role: AI company behind the Zing world model and its Loopit web app
creators.bio: Released Zing-0.5, an open-weight real-time world model with joint keyboard and text control, in September 2026, with an SGLang serving stack and a web app at zing.loopit.me.
creators.why: Pushes playable real-time world models toward low serving cost.
creators.role_zh: 推出 Zing 世界模型及其 Loopit 网页应用的 AI 公司
creators.bio_zh: 2026 年 9 月发布开源权重的实时世界模型 Zing-0.5，支持键盘与文字联合控制，并提供基于 SGLang 的服务部署方案以及网页应用 zing.loopit.me。
creators.why_zh: 推动可玩的实时世界模型降低服务成本。

creators.name: Yang Zhou
creators.role: Researcher in Youku's Orange 3DV team; first author of MoVerse
creators.bio: First author of MoVerse (2026), a real-time world model that builds a panoramic 3D Gaussian scaffold from one image, from the Orange 3DV team of Youku's Moku Lab (Alibaba's Hujing Digital Media & Entertainment Group).
creators.why: Combines explicit 3D structure with video generation for worlds that keep their geometry.
creators.role_zh: 优酷 Orange 3DV 团队研究者，MoVerse 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: MoVerse（2026）的第一作者。MoVerse 是一个从单张图像构建全景三维高斯骨架的实时世界模型，出自优酷 Moku Lab 的 Orange 3DV 团队（阿里巴巴虎鲸文娱集团）。
creators.why_zh: 把显式三维结构与视频生成结合，让世界保持几何不变。

creators.name: Linxi Xie
creators.role: Researcher at Stanford University; first author of Generated Reality
creators.bio: First author of Generated Reality (CVPR 2026 Findings), a VR video world model controlled by tracked head and hand poses, from Gordon Wetzstein's group at Stanford with co-authors from NYU Shanghai and UNC.
creators.why: Connects world models to the body tracking that headsets already provide.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者，Generated Reality 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: Generated Reality（CVPR 2026 Findings）的第一作者。该工作是由头部与手部追踪控制的 VR 视频世界模型，出自斯坦福大学 Gordon Wetzstein 团队，合作者来自上海纽约大学与北卡罗来纳大学。
creators.why_zh: 把世界模型与头显已有的身体追踪连接起来。

creators.name: XGEN Labs
creators.bio: A lab that calls itself a frontier lab for world intelligence; in September 2026 it released XGEN-JING, an open egocentric audio-video world model, and in October 2026 the technical report on DAO, its world engine.
creators.why: Pairs a generated first-person view with an explicit shared world state, so consequences remain after an observer leaves.
creators.role_zh: 世界模型实验室
creators.bio_zh: 自称“面向世界智能的前沿实验室”；2026 年 9 月开源了第一人称音视频世界模型 XGEN-JING，10 月发布了其世界引擎 DAO 的技术报告。
creators.why_zh: 把生成的第一人称画面与一个明确的共享世界状态结合起来，观察者离开后，行动的后果依然存在。

creators.name: Zhexiao Xiong
creators.role: Researcher at Washington University in St. Louis; first author of ActWorld
creators.bio: First author of ActWorld (NeurIPS 2026), an interactive world model with object interaction, written during an internship with ByteDance's Intelligent Creation team.
creators.why: Works on world models in which a player can act on objects, not only move through a scene.
creators.role_zh: 圣路易斯华盛顿大学研究者，ActWorld 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: ActWorld（NeurIPS 2026）的第一作者。这是一个支持物体交互的交互式世界模型，完成于其在字节跳动智能创作团队实习期间。
creators.why_zh: 研究玩家不只能在场景中移动、还能动手操作物体的世界模型。

creators.name: Waymo
creators.bio: Alphabet's self-driving company, operating driverless ride-hailing in several U.S. cities.
creators.why: Its Waymo World Model shows a general world model (Genie 3) being post-trained into a multi-sensor driving simulator.
creators.role_zh: Alphabet 旗下的自动驾驶公司
creators.bio_zh: Alphabet 旗下的自动驾驶公司，在多座美国城市运营无人驾驶网约车。
creators.why_zh: Waymo 世界模型展示了如何把通用世界模型（Genie 3）后训练成多传感器驾驶模拟器。

creators.name: Dynamics Lab
creators.bio: Startup that released Mirage (July 2025) and Mirage 2 (August 2025), browser-playable generative world engines; its website and launch posts were offline when checked in October 2026.
creators.why: One of the first teams to put a real-time, image-to-world engine in front of the public.
creators.role_zh: 生成式游戏引擎初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 推出 Mirage（2025 年 7 月）与 Mirage 2（2025 年 8 月）这两款可在浏览器中游玩的生成式世界引擎的初创公司；2026 年 10 月核查时，其网站与发布帖均已下线。
creators.why_zh: 最早把实时“图像变世界”引擎开放给公众的团队之一。

creators.name: Odyssey
creators.bio: AI lab founded in 2023 by Oliver Cameron and Jeff Hawke to build general-purpose world models; it released Odyssey-1, -2 and -3, the multi-agent Agora models and an API.
creators.why: It ships interactive world models publicly and fast, and is pushing them toward shared multi-agent worlds and robot control.
creators.role_zh: 世界模型 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 由 Oliver Cameron 与 Jeff Hawke 于 2023 年创立的 AI 实验室，致力于通用世界模型，先后发布 Odyssey-1、-2、-3、多智能体 Agora 系列模型及 API。
creators.why_zh: 它以很快的节奏公开发布交互式世界模型，并把它们推向多人共享世界与机器人控制。

creators.name: Tencent
creators.bio: Shenzhen-based internet and games company; several of its research teams, besides Hunyuan, publish interactive video work.
creators.why: Its 'Yan Team' showed 1080p, 60 fps game simulation with text-editable worlds.
creators.role_zh: 中国科技与游戏公司
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于深圳的互联网与游戏公司；除混元外，其多个研究团队也发表交互式视频方面的工作。
creators.why_zh: 其“Yan 团队”展示了 1080p、60 fps 的游戏模拟，以及可用文字编辑的世界。

creators.name: PixVerse
creators.bio: Beijing-based maker of the PixVerse video generator and app, developed by AIsphere; in 2026 it added the real-time R1 and R2 world models.
creators.why: It is the first consumer video app to turn its generator into a real-time, steerable world with sound.
creators.role_zh: AI 视频公司（爱诗科技）
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于北京的 PixVerse 视频生成器与应用的开发者，由爱诗科技打造；2026 年推出实时世界模型 R1 与 R2。
creators.why_zh: 它是首个把视频生成器变成可实时操控、带声音的世界的消费级视频应用。

creators.name: Overworld
creators.bio: Startup releasing open-weight, real-time diffusion world models (Waypoint) that run locally on consumer GPUs, plus the open-source Biome client.
creators.why: It targets the latency and hardware gap: world models people can run at home.
creators.role_zh: 开源世界模型初创公司
creators.bio_zh: 发布可在消费级显卡本地运行的开源实时扩散世界模型（Waypoint）及开源客户端 Biome 的初创公司。
creators.why_zh: 它瞄准延迟与硬件门槛：做人们在家里就能运行的世界模型。

creators.name: Etched
creators.bio: Startup designing Sohu, a transformer-specific inference chip; co-developed Oasis with Decart.
creators.why: Its Oasis collaboration framed real-time world models as an inference-hardware problem.
creators.role_zh: AI 芯片公司
creators.bio_zh: 设计 Transformer 专用推理芯片 Sohu 的初创公司，与 Decart 合作开发了 Oasis。
creators.why_zh: 它与 Decart 合作的 Oasis 把实时世界模型定位为推理硬件问题。

creators.name: Wayve
creators.bio: London company building end-to-end driving models, and the GAIA line of generative driving world models since 2023.
creators.why: GAIA tracks the move from generating driving video to closed-loop simulation with the driver in the loop.
creators.role_zh: 具身智能自动驾驶公司
creators.bio_zh: 总部位于伦敦的公司，开发端到端驾驶模型，并自 2023 年起推出 GAIA 系列生成式驾驶世界模型。
creators.why_zh: GAIA 记录了从生成驾驶视频到让驾驶模型参与闭环仿真的转变。

creators.name: 1X Technologies
creators.bio: Norwegian-American maker of the EVE and NEO humanoid robots.
creators.why: Its 1X World Model (2024) was an early action-conditioned simulator for evaluating humanoid policies.
creators.role_zh: 人形机器人公司
creators.bio_zh: 挪威与美国背景的人形机器人公司，产品包括 EVE 与 NEO。
creators.why_zh: 其 1X 世界模型（2024）是较早用于评估人形机器人策略的、以动作为条件的模拟器。
creators.based_zh: 美国帕洛阿尔托 / 挪威莫斯

creators.name: General Intuition
creators.role: AI lab for agents acting in space and time
creators.bio: AI lab spun out of the game-clip platform Medal that trains agents and world models on large archives of gameplay video.
creators.why: Co-developed MIRA, an open multiplayer world model, with Kyutai.
creators.role_zh: 研究在时空中行动的智能体的 AI 实验室
creators.bio_zh: 从游戏片段平台 Medal 分拆出来的 AI 实验室，利用大规模游戏视频档案训练智能体与世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 与 Kyutai 合作开发了开源多人世界模型 MIRA。

creators.name: David Ha
creators.role: Researcher, first author of World Models (2018)
creators.bio: Machine-learning researcher, then at Google Brain, later co-founder of Sakana AI; co-wrote World Models with Jürgen Schmidhuber.
creators.why: World Models popularised the idea of an agent learning inside its own generated 'dream'.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，《World Models》（2018）第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 机器学习研究者，时任职于 Google Brain，后联合创立 Sakana AI；与 Jürgen Schmidhuber 合著《World Models》。
creators.why_zh: 《World Models》让“智能体在自己生成的梦境中学习”这一想法广为人知。

creators.name: Seung Wook Kim
creators.role: Researcher at NVIDIA, first author of GameGAN
creators.bio: Researcher at NVIDIA's Toronto AI lab working on neural simulation of games and driving.
creators.why: GameGAN (2020) was the first widely shown neural re-creation of a playable game.
creators.role_zh: 英伟达研究员，GameGAN 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 英伟达多伦多 AI 实验室研究员，研究游戏与驾驶的神经模拟。
creators.why_zh: GameGAN（2020）是第一个被广泛展示的、用神经网络重建的可玩游戏。

creators.name: Eloi Alonso
creators.bio: Machine-learning researcher (University of Geneva) working on diffusion world models for reinforcement learning.
creators.why: DIAMOND showed that a small diffusion model can become a playable Counter-Strike world on one consumer GPU.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，DIAMOND 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 日内瓦大学的机器学习研究者，研究用于强化学习的扩散世界模型。
creators.why_zh: DIAMOND 证明了一个小型扩散模型就能在单张消费级显卡上变成可玩的《反恐精英》世界。

creators.name: Danijar Hafner
creators.role: Research scientist, author of the Dreamer agents
creators.bio: Research scientist at Google DeepMind known for the Dreamer line of world-model agents.
creators.why: Dreamer 4 trains agents entirely inside a learned, real-time world model.
creators.role_zh: 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列智能体作者
creators.bio_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，以 Dreamer 系列世界模型智能体闻名。
creators.why_zh: Dreamer 4 让智能体完全在学到的实时世界模型里完成训练。

creators.name: Sherry Yang
creators.bio: Researcher (Google DeepMind and UC Berkeley at the time of UniSim) working on video models as real-world simulators.
creators.why: UniSim framed video generation as a universal interactive simulator for agents.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，UniSim 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 研究者（发表 UniSim 时任职于 Google DeepMind 与加州大学伯克利分校），研究把视频模型用作真实世界模拟器。
creators.why_zh: UniSim 把视频生成定位为面向智能体的通用交互式模拟器。

creators.name: Amir Bar
creators.role: Researcher at Meta FAIR, first author of Navigation World Models
creators.bio: Computer-vision researcher (Meta FAIR, Tel Aviv University) working on visual prediction and world models.
creators.why: Navigation World Models showed that a video world model can be used to plan routes, not just to render.
creators.role_zh: Meta FAIR 研究员，导航世界模型第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 计算机视觉研究者（Meta FAIR、特拉维夫大学），研究视觉预测与世界模型。
creators.why_zh: 导航世界模型表明，视频世界模型不仅能渲染，还能用来规划路径。

creators.name: Boyuan Chen
creators.role: Researcher at MIT, first author of Diffusion Forcing
creators.bio: PhD researcher at MIT working on video world models and robot learning.
creators.why: Diffusion Forcing is the training recipe behind many stable, long autoregressive world models.
creators.role_zh: 麻省理工学院研究者，Diffusion Forcing 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 麻省理工学院的博士研究者，研究视频世界模型与机器人学习。
creators.why_zh: Diffusion Forcing 是许多稳定、长时自回归世界模型背后的训练方法。

creators.name: Zeqi Xiao
creators.bio: Researcher at Nanyang Technological University (S-Lab) working on consistent video world simulation.
creators.why: WorldMem made explicit memory banks a standard tool for keeping generated worlds consistent.
creators.role_zh: 研究者，WorldMem 第一作者
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 研究者，研究一致的视频世界模拟。
creators.why_zh: WorldMem 让显式记忆库成为保持生成世界一致性的常用工具。

creators.name: Jiwen Yu
creators.role: Researcher at the University of Hong Kong
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Hong Kong working with Kuaishou's Kling team on interactive video generation.
creators.why: First author of GameFactory and Context-as-Memory, two reference works on controllable and consistent game video.
creators.role_zh: 香港大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学博士研究者，与快手可灵团队合作研究交互式视频生成。
creators.why_zh: GameFactory 与 Context-as-Memory 的第一作者，这两项工作是可控、一致的游戏视频的参考之作。

creators.name: Tong Wu
creators.bio: Researcher in Gordon Wetzstein's group at Stanford working on 3D-aware video generation.
creators.why: First author of the long-term spatial-memory world model that stores the scene as a point cloud.
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学 Gordon Wetzstein 组的研究者，研究具备三维感知的视频生成。
creators.why_zh: 以点云保存场景的长期空间记忆世界模型的第一作者。

creators.name: Xindi Wu
creators.bio: PhD researcher at Princeton University who worked with NVIDIA on memory for video world models.
creators.why: First author of WorldTrace, which keeps a world model's memory addressable beyond its training horizon.
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学与英伟达研究者
creators.bio_zh: 普林斯顿大学博士研究者，与英伟达合作研究视频世界模型的记忆机制。
creators.why_zh: WorldTrace 的第一作者，这项工作让世界模型在超出训练时长后仍能准确调取记忆。

creators.name: Amap (Alibaba)
creators.role: Alibaba Group's mapping and navigation service, whose CV Lab builds generative 3D Earth and world models
creators.role_zh: 阿里巴巴集团旗下的地图与导航服务，其视觉实验室（CV Lab）研发生成式三维地球与世界模型
creators.bio: Amap (Gaode) is the digital map and navigation service of Alibaba Group; its CV Lab released the ABot-Earth generative 3D Earth model in 2026.
creators.bio_zh: 高德是阿里巴巴集团的数字地图与导航服务；其视觉实验室于 2026 年发布了生成式三维地球模型 ABot-Earth。
creators.why: A map company is turning satellite imagery into generated, walkable 3D cities at city and planet scale.
creators.why_zh: 一家地图公司正在把卫星影像变成可漫游的生成式三维城市，规模从城市延伸到整个星球。

creators.name: Jiahao Lu
creators.role: PhD researcher, The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
creators.role_zh: 香港科技大学博士研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of GAE (2026), a geometry-native latent space for world generation developed with Tencent ARC Lab.
creators.bio_zh: GAE（2026）的共同第一作者；该工作与腾讯 ARC 实验室合作，为世界生成提出了几何原生的潜空间。
creators.why: GAE argues that 3D consistency in generated worlds is a representation problem, not only a modelling one.
creators.why_zh: GAE 认为，生成世界的三维一致性不只是建模问题，也是表示问题。

creators.name: Wangbo Yu
creators.role_zh: 北京大学博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of ViewCrafter (2024, TPAMI 2025) and of the follow-up WorldCrafter video world model (2026).
creators.bio_zh: ViewCrafter（2024，TPAMI 2025）及其后续视频世界模型 WorldCrafter（2026）的第一作者。
creators.why: ViewCrafter's point-cloud-guided video diffusion became a template for camera-controlled scene generation.
creators.why_zh: ViewCrafter 以点云引导视频扩散的做法，成为相机可控场景生成的常用范式。

creators.name: Nicolas von Lützow
creators.role: PhD researcher, Visual Computing & AI Lab, Technical University of Munich
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学视觉计算与人工智能实验室博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of GaussianGPT (ECCV 2026 oral), developed in Matthias Niessner's group at TUM.
creators.bio_zh: GaussianGPT（ECCV 2026 口头报告）的第一作者，该工作完成于慕尼黑工业大学 Matthias Niessner 的研究组。
creators.why: GaussianGPT is an early fully autoregressive generator of explicit 3D scenes, an alternative to diffusion.
creators.why_zh: GaussianGPT 是较早的完全自回归式显式三维场景生成器，为扩散模型之外提供了另一条路线。

creators.name: Jiaxin Huang
creators.role: Researcher, X-D Lab (Yiyi Liao), Zhejiang University
creators.role_zh: 浙江大学 X-D Lab（廖依伊课题组）研究者
creators.bio: First author of Gen3R (CVPR 2026), which couples a video diffusion model with the VGGT reconstruction model.
creators.bio_zh: Gen3R（CVPR 2026）的第一作者，该工作把视频扩散模型与 VGGT 重建模型耦合在一起。
creators.why: Gen3R makes every generated view arrive with camera poses, depth and a point cloud that can be checked.
creators.why_zh: Gen3R 让每个生成视角都附带可检验的相机位姿、深度和点云。

creators.name: Horizon Robotics
creators.role: Chinese maker of AI processors and software for vehicles and robots
creators.role_zh: 中国的车载与机器人 AI 芯片及软件公司
creators.bio: Horizon Robotics develops AI processors and driving software; its robotics team released the open EmbodiedGen toolkit (2025) and EmbodiedGen V2 (2026).
creators.bio_zh: 地平线研发 AI 处理器与智能驾驶软件；其机器人团队开源了 EmbodiedGen 工具包（2025）和 EmbodiedGen V2（2026）。
creators.why: It is one of the Chinese companies open-sourcing generators of simulation-ready 3D worlds.
creators.why_zh: 它是开源“可直接仿真”的三维世界生成器的中国公司之一。

creators.name: Muyao Niu
creators.role: PhD researcher, The University of Tokyo; works with Alaya Lab
creators.role_zh: 东京大学博士研究者，与 Alaya Lab 合作
creators.bio: First author of WorldSculpt (2026), a joint project of Alaya Lab and the University of Tokyo.
creators.bio_zh: WorldSculpt（2026）的第一作者，该项目由 Alaya Lab 与东京大学合作完成。
creators.why: WorldSculpt shows how generated or captured worlds can be broken into separate, editable objects.
creators.why_zh: WorldSculpt 展示了如何把生成或拍摄得到的世界拆成一个个可单独编辑的物体。

creators.name: Manycore Tech
creators.role: Hangzhou company behind the Kujiale interior-design platform; open-sources spatial AI models
creators.role_zh: 杭州公司，运营酷家乐室内设计平台，并开源空间智能模型
creators.bio: Manycore Tech runs the Kujiale interior-design platform and has open-sourced spatial AI models such as SpatialLM (2025) and SpatialGen (2025).
creators.bio_zh: 群核科技运营酷家乐室内设计平台，并开源了 SpatialLM（2025）和 SpatialGen（2025）等空间智能模型。
creators.why: Its large store of designed interiors feeds layout-controlled indoor scene generation.
creators.why_zh: 它积累的大量室内设计数据，支撑起可由布局控制的室内场景生成。

creators.name: Rafail Fridman
creators.role: Researcher, Weizmann Institute of Science (Tali Dekel's group)
creators.role_zh: 魏茨曼科学研究所研究者（Tali Dekel 课题组）
creators.bio: First author of SceneScape (NeurIPS 2023), text-driven perpetual scene generation with a unified mesh.
creators.bio_zh: SceneScape（NeurIPS 2023）的第一作者，该工作以统一网格实现文本驱动的无限场景生成。
creators.why: SceneScape was one of the first methods to keep an explicit 3D memory during an endless generated walk.
creators.why_zh: SceneScape 是最早在无限生成的漫游中保留显式三维记忆的方法之一。

creators.name: Sensen Gao
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of PixWorld (2026), developed at Nanyang Technological University with AIsphere, the company behind PixVerse.
creators.bio_zh: PixWorld（2026）的共同第一作者，该工作由南洋理工大学与 PixVerse 背后的爱诗科技合作完成。
creators.why: PixWorld treats 3D scene generation and reconstruction as one pixel-space diffusion problem.
creators.why_zh: PixWorld 把三维场景生成与重建视为同一个像素空间扩散问题。

creators.name: Paul Engstler
creators.role: PhD researcher, Visual Geometry Group (VGG), University of Oxford
creators.bio: Works with Iro Laina, Christian Rupprecht and Andrea Vedaldi on 3D scene generation; author of SynCity (2025) and SynCity 3000 (2026).
creators.why: SynCity 3000 turns object-level image-to-3D generators into a convolutional operator for whole scenes.
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学视觉几何组（VGG）博士研究者
creators.bio_zh: 与 Iro Laina、Christian Rupprecht 和 Andrea Vedaldi 合作研究三维场景生成，SynCity（2025）与 SynCity 3000（2026）作者。
creators.why_zh: SynCity 3000 把物体级的图生三维模型改造成可用于整个场景的卷积式算子。

creators.name: Applied Intuition
creators.role: Vehicle software and autonomy simulation company
creators.bio: Builds simulation, autonomy and vehicle-software tools for automotive, trucking and defence customers; publishes research through Applied Intuition Research.
creators.why: Released open weights for Building Rome, single-image 3D scene meshes for indoor and outdoor scenes.
creators.role_zh: 车辆软件与自动驾驶仿真公司
creators.bio_zh: 为汽车、卡车和国防客户提供仿真、自动驾驶与车辆软件工具，并以 Applied Intuition Research 名义发表研究。
creators.why_zh: 开源了 Building Rome 的权重，可从单张照片生成室内外三维场景网格。
creators.based_zh: 美国加利福尼亚州山景城

creators.name: Jaejun Park
creators.bio: Jaejun Park is first author of GenTouchVR (IEEE VR 2026, TVCG), written with Soyeon Nam, Jeongwoo Kim, Uison Ju and Seungmoon Choi at POSTECH's haptics and virtual reality laboratory.
creators.why: GenTouchVR generates the force feedback of a VR scene, not only its appearance, from a single photo.
creators.role_zh: 浦项工科大学（POSTECH）交互实验室研究者
creators.bio_zh: Jaejun Park 是 GenTouchVR（IEEE VR 2026，TVCG）的第一作者，合作者为 POSTECH 触觉与虚拟现实实验室的 Soyeon Nam、Jeongwoo Kim、Uison Ju 和 Seungmoon Choi。
creators.why_zh: GenTouchVR 从一张照片生成的不只是 VR 场景的外观，还有它的力反馈。

creators.name: Blockade Labs
creators.role_zh: Skybox AI 的开发者
creators.bio: Startup that makes Skybox AI, a web tool and API for generating 360° equirectangular skyboxes and environments.
creators.bio_zh: 开发 Skybox AI 的初创公司：一个生成 360° 等距柱状天空盒与环境的网页工具和 API。
creators.why: Skybox AI was one of the first generators that let creators make a VR-ready 360° backdrop from a prompt.
creators.why_zh: Skybox AI 是最早让创作者用一句提示词做出可直接用于 VR 的 360° 背景的生成工具之一。

creators.name: SpAItial
creators.role_zh: 三维世界模型初创公司（Echo）
creators.bio: Startup co-founded by TUM professor Matthias Niessner that builds spatial foundation models; it raised a $13 million seed round in 2025 and released Echo (Dec 2025) and Echo-2 (Apr 2026).
creators.bio_zh: 由慕尼黑工业大学教授 Matthias Niessner 联合创立的初创公司，研发空间基础模型；2025 年获 1300 万美元种子轮融资，先后发布 Echo（2025 年 12 月）和 Echo-2（2026 年 4 月）。
creators.why: It is one of the few companies besides World Labs selling persistent 3D-splat world generation.
creators.why_zh: 它是除 World Labs 之外少数提供持久三维泼溅世界生成服务的公司之一。

creators.name: Xinyang Li
creators.role: PhD researcher, MAC Lab, Xiamen University
creators.role_zh: 厦门大学 MAC 实验室博士研究者
creators.bio: First author of FlashWorld, developed with Tencent Hunyuan.
creators.bio_zh: FlashWorld 的第一作者，该工作与腾讯混元合作完成。
creators.why: FlashWorld cut single-image-to-3D-world generation to seconds on one GPU.
creators.why_zh: FlashWorld 把单图生成三维世界的时间缩短到单卡几秒。

creators.name: Hong-Xing (Koven) Yu
creators.role_zh: 斯坦福大学研究者
creators.bio: Computer-vision researcher in Jiajun Wu's group at Stanford, first author of WonderJourney and WonderWorld.
creators.bio_zh: 斯坦福大学吴佳俊组的计算机视觉研究者，WonderJourney 与 WonderWorld 的第一作者。
creators.why: His work moved scene generation from one fixed view to open-ended, user-steered journeys.
creators.why_zh: 他的工作把场景生成从单一固定视角推进到由用户引导、无限延伸的旅程。

creators.name: Jaeyoung Chung
creators.role: Researcher, Computer Vision Lab, Seoul National University
creators.role_zh: 首尔国立大学计算机视觉实验室研究者
creators.bio: Co-first author of LucidDreamer in Kyoung Mu Lee's lab at Seoul National University.
creators.bio_zh: 首尔国立大学 Kyoung Mu Lee 实验室的研究者，LucidDreamer 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: LucidDreamer was among the first to generate whole Gaussian-splat scenes from a prompt or photo.
creators.why_zh: LucidDreamer 是最早从提示词或照片生成整片高斯泼溅场景的工作之一。

creators.name: Lukas Höllein
creators.role_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Matthias Niessner's Visual Computing & AI lab at TUM, first author of Text2Room.
creators.bio_zh: 慕尼黑工业大学 Matthias Niessner 视觉计算与 AI 实验室的博士研究者，Text2Room 的第一作者。
creators.why: Text2Room showed that a 2D image model plus depth can build a complete textured room mesh.
creators.why_zh: Text2Room 证明二维图像模型加上深度估计就能拼出完整的带纹理房间网格。

creators.name: Andrew Liu
creators.role_zh: Google Research 研究者
creators.bio: First author of Infinite Nature (ICCV 2021) with Noah Snavely and Angjoo Kanazawa at Google Research.
creators.bio_zh: Infinite Nature（ICCV 2021）的第一作者，与 Noah Snavely、Angjoo Kanazawa 等在 Google Research 合作。
creators.why: Infinite Nature defined perpetual view generation, the ancestor of today's explorable-world models.
creators.why_zh: Infinite Nature 提出了“无限视图生成”，是今天可探索世界模型的前身。

creators.name: Haozhe Xie
creators.role_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab 研究者
creators.bio: Researcher in Ziwei Liu's S-Lab at NTU, first author of CityDreamer and CityDreamer4D.
creators.bio_zh: 南洋理工大学刘子纬 S-Lab 的研究者，CityDreamer 与 CityDreamer4D 的第一作者。
creators.why: CityDreamer generates unbounded cities, a scale that room- and object-level methods do not reach.
creators.why_zh: CityDreamer 能生成无边界的城市，这是房间级、物体级方法达不到的尺度。

creators.name: Shitao Tang
creators.role_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Yasutaka Furukawa's group at Simon Fraser University, first author of MVDiffusion.
creators.bio_zh: 西蒙菲莎大学 Yasutaka Furukawa 组的博士研究者，MVDiffusion 的第一作者。
creators.why: MVDiffusion made panorama generation a multi-view consistency problem.
creators.why_zh: MVDiffusion 把全景图生成转化为多视角一致性问题。

creators.name: Shijie Zhou
creators.role: Researcher, University of California, Los Angeles
creators.role_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Achuta Kadambi's lab at UCLA, first author of DreamScene360.
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学洛杉矶分校 Achuta Kadambi 实验室的博士研究者，DreamScene360 的第一作者。
creators.why: DreamScene360 lifted a generated panorama into a 360° Gaussian-splat scene.
creators.why_zh: DreamScene360 把生成的全景图提升为 360° 高斯泼溅场景。

creators.name: Shuai Yang
creators.role: Researcher, Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai AI Laboratory
creators.role_zh: 上海交通大学与上海人工智能实验室研究者
creators.bio: First author of LayerPano3D (SIGGRAPH 2025), written with CUHK, Stanford and NTU collaborators.
creators.bio_zh: LayerPano3D（SIGGRAPH 2025）的第一作者，合作者来自香港中文大学、斯坦福与南洋理工。
creators.why: LayerPano3D separates a panorama into depth layers so that a viewer can move inside it.
creators.why_zh: LayerPano3D 把全景图拆成按深度分层的图层，让观看者可以在其中移动。

creators.name: Yue Yang
creators.role_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Pennsylvania who led Holodeck with the Allen Institute for AI.
creators.bio_zh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的博士研究者，与艾伦人工智能研究所合作主导了 Holodeck。
creators.why: Holodeck showed that a language model can lay out full, interactive multi-room environments.
creators.why_zh: Holodeck 证明语言模型可以布置完整的、可交互的多房间环境。

creators.name: Allen Institute for AI (Ai2)
creators.role_zh: 非营利 AI 研究机构
creators.bio: Non-profit research institute behind AI2-THOR, ProcTHOR, Objaverse and Holodeck.
creators.bio_zh: 非营利研究机构，开发了 AI2-THOR、ProcTHOR、Objaverse 与 Holodeck。
creators.why: Its simulators and asset libraries are the testbeds where generated houses meet embodied agents.
creators.why_zh: 它的模拟器和资产库是生成房屋与具身智能体相遇的试验场。

creators.name: Alexander Raistrick
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿视觉与学习实验室研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher with Jia Deng at Princeton, first author of Infinigen, Infinigen Indoors and ProcFunc.
creators.bio_zh: 普林斯顿大学邓嘉组的博士研究者，Infinigen、Infinigen Indoors 与 ProcFunc 的第一作者。
creators.why: Infinigen generates unlimited photoreal worlds from code alone, with exact ground truth.
creators.why_zh: Infinigen 仅靠代码就能生成无限多的照片级世界，并附带精确的真值标注。

creators.name: Princeton Vision & Learning Lab
creators.role: Jia Deng's computer-vision lab at Princeton University
creators.role_zh: 普林斯顿大学邓嘉的计算机视觉实验室
creators.bio: Academic lab led by Jia Deng that develops the Infinigen procedural world generator.
creators.bio_zh: 由邓嘉领导的高校实验室，开发了 Infinigen 程序化世界生成器。
creators.why: It maintains the main open procedural generator for natural and indoor 3D worlds.
creators.why_zh: 它维护着自然与室内三维世界最主要的开源程序化生成器。

creators.name: Weixi Feng
creators.role_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in William Wang's group at UCSB, first author of LayoutGPT.
creators.bio_zh: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校王威廉组的博士研究者，LayoutGPT 的第一作者。
creators.why: LayoutGPT showed that a text-only language model can write numeric 3D room layouts.
creators.why_zh: LayoutGPT 证明只懂文字的语言模型也能写出带数值的三维房间布局。

creators.name: Siddharth Ahuja
creators.role_zh: BlenderMCP 开发者
creators.bio: Independent developer who released BlenderMCP, an open-source Model Context Protocol bridge between language models and Blender.
creators.bio_zh: 独立开发者，发布了开源的 BlenderMCP：连接语言模型与 Blender 的 Model Context Protocol 桥接工具。
creators.why: BlenderMCP made chat-driven scene building in a full 3D tool something anyone could install.
creators.why_zh: BlenderMCP 让任何人都能安装并用对话在完整的三维软件里搭建场景。

creators.name: Lihe Yang
creators.role: Researcher, The University of Hong Kong
creators.role_zh: 香港大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher with Hengshuang Zhao at HKU, first author of Depth Anything and Depth Anything V2 (with ByteDance/TikTok).
creators.bio_zh: 香港大学赵恒爽组的博士研究者，与字节跳动（TikTok）合作的 Depth Anything 与 Depth Anything V2 的第一作者。
creators.why: Depth Anything is the default monocular depth model in many photo-to-3D tools.
creators.why_zh: Depth Anything 是许多照片转三维工具默认使用的单目深度模型。

creators.name: Meng-Li Shih
creators.role: Researcher (Virginia Tech, then University of Washington)
creators.role_zh: 研究者（弗吉尼亚理工，后至华盛顿大学）
creators.bio: First author of 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting (CVPR 2020), with Jia-Bin Huang and Johannes Kopf.
creators.bio_zh: 《3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting》（CVPR 2020）的第一作者，合作者包括黄嘉斌与 Johannes Kopf。
creators.why: The method is the direct ancestor of one-photo parallax features such as spatial scenes.
creators.why_zh: 该方法是“空间场景”等单照片视差功能的直接前身。

creators.name: Ruiqi Gao
creators.role_zh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
creators.bio: Generative-model researcher at Google DeepMind and co-first author of CAT3D and CAT4D.
creators.bio_zh: Google DeepMind 的生成模型研究者，CAT3D 与 CAT4D 的共同第一作者。
creators.why: CAT3D made multi-view diffusion the standard way to fill in unseen parts of a scene.
creators.why_zh: CAT3D 让多视角扩散成为补全场景未见部分的标准做法。

creators.name: Stanislaw Szymanowicz
creators.role_zh: 牛津大学视觉几何组研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher in Oxford's Visual Geometry Group (Splatter Image, Flash3D) and first author of Bolt3D, done with Google.
creators.bio_zh: 牛津大学视觉几何组的博士研究者（Splatter Image、Flash3D），与 Google 合作完成 Bolt3D 并任第一作者。
creators.why: His work drives the shift to feed-forward splat generation in seconds.
creators.why_zh: 他的工作推动了几秒内前馈生成泼溅的转变。

creators.name: Hanwen Liang
creators.role_zh: 多伦多大学研究者
creators.bio: PhD researcher at the University of Toronto and first author of Wonderland, done with Snap Research.
creators.bio_zh: 多伦多大学的博士研究者，与 Snap Research 合作完成 Wonderland 并任第一作者。
creators.why: Wonderland reads 3D splats directly out of a video model's latent space.
creators.why_zh: Wonderland 直接从视频模型的潜空间读出三维泼溅。

creators.name: Xuanchi Ren
creators.role_zh: NVIDIA 研究科学家
creators.bio: Researcher at NVIDIA's Toronto AI Lab, first author of GEN3C and co-author of Lyra.
creators.bio_zh: NVIDIA 多伦多 AI 实验室研究者，GEN3C 的第一作者，Lyra 的合作者。
creators.why: GEN3C adds an explicit 3D cache to video generation for exact camera control.
creators.why_zh: GEN3C 在视频生成中加入显式三维缓存，实现精确的镜头控制。

creators.name: Kaixin Yao
creators.role_zh: 上海科技大学与影眸科技研究者
creators.bio: First author of CAST (SIGGRAPH 2025 Best Paper), developed at ShanghaiTech University and Deemos.
creators.bio_zh: CAST（SIGGRAPH 2025 最佳论文）的第一作者，该工作由上海科技大学与影眸科技完成。
creators.why: CAST rebuilds a photo as separate, physically consistent objects rather than one fused surface.
creators.why_zh: CAST 把一张照片重建为彼此独立、物理关系一致的物体，而不是一整块融合的表面。

works.title: Generative Enactments
works.description: Participants act inside a scenario and receive AI-generated first-person video of the consequences, either after a short wait or streamed reactively, so they can watch a situation unfold in response to what they do.
works.description_zh: 参与者在一个情境中行动，并收到由 AI 生成的第一人称后果视频（短暂等待后返回，或实时流式反应），从而看到情境随自己的行为展开。
works.idea_en: Uses fast, cheap video generation to let people rehearse situations that are unsafe, unethical or not yet possible to stage, with a configuration that researchers can specify and compare.
works.idea_zh: 借助快速、廉价的视频生成，让人预演那些不安全、不合伦理或尚无法布置的情境，并提供研究者可以设定和比较的配置。
works.method: A configuration form specifies how researchers, participants and AI systems propose, generate, contest and revise pathways; illustrated with domestic-robot attention (adversarial, turn-based), bystander intervention (choice-based) and trainee-teacher rehearsal (reactive streaming), with implementation and pilot evidence.
works.method_zh: 用一张配置表规定研究者、参与者与 AI 系统如何提出、生成、质疑和修改不同路径；以家用机器人的注意分配（对抗式、回合制）、旁观者干预（选择式）和实习教师后果预演（实时流式）三个案例说明，并报告实现与试用证据。
works.title_zh: 生成式演绎

works.title: When Generative Artificial Intelligence Meets Extended Reality: A Systematic Review
works.description: PRISMA systematic review of 26 articles from 2023 to 2025 that combine generative AI with XR, summarizing the application areas and key technical implementations and pointing out research gaps.
works.description_zh: 按 PRISMA 流程筛选出 26 篇 2023–2025 年将生成式 AI 与 XR 结合的文章，总结其应用领域与关键技术实现，并指出研究空白。
works.idea_en: The field is young and small: three years of work fit in 26 papers, so methods for generative immersive research are still open territory.
works.idea_zh: 这一领域年轻且规模不大：三年的工作只有 26 篇论文——生成式沉浸研究的方法论仍是一片有待开拓的领域。
works.method: Systematic review following PRISMA with database search, screening and thematic analysis of the included articles.
works.method_zh: 遵循 PRISMA 的系统综述，包括数据库检索、筛选与对纳入文章的主题分析。

paper.venue: International Journal of Human-Computer Interaction (2026; online 2025-09-30)
paper.title: When Generative Artificial Intelligence Meets Extended Reality: A Systematic Review

works.title_zh: 当生成式人工智能遇上扩展现实：一项系统综述

works.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft
works.description: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents, each controlling a Minecraft player through the open-source Mineflayer library and coordinating by in-game chat and shared notes, started bare-handed in a random survival world and defeated the Ender Dragon after 27 hours 14 minutes, writing 2,783 programs and dying 605 times. Google DeepMind reports it as the first end-to-end autonomous completion of Minecraft by AI agents.
works.description_zh: 四个 Gemini 4 Argon 智能体各自通过开源库 Mineflayer 操控一名 Minecraft 玩家，借助游戏内聊天与共享笔记协作，从随机生成的生存世界中赤手空拳起步，在 27 小时 14 分钟后击败末影龙，期间编写了 2,783 个程序、死亡 605 次。Google DeepMind 称这是 AI 智能体首次端到端自主通关 Minecraft。
works.idea_en: A team of agents can now stay coherent for a day across thousands of dependent steps in a game world, though through an interface that tells them what a human player would have to see.
works.idea_zh: 一组智能体已能在游戏世界中跨越数千个相互依赖的步骤、连续一天保持目标一致；不过它们依靠的接口直接告诉它们人类玩家需要亲眼看到的信息。
works.method: No roles, game logic or skills were given: the agents planned, wrote and debugged their own programs against Mineflayer, which supplies block and entity perception and pathfinding instead of pixels, while an observer agent and researchers watched every program, message and game event on a live dashboard.
works.method_zh: 不预设角色、游戏逻辑或技能：智能体自行规划、编写并调试调用 Mineflayer 的程序；Mineflayer 直接提供方块与实体信息以及寻路，而不是画面像素；一个观察者智能体与研究人员通过实时面板查看每个程序、消息与游戏事件。
works.specs: 4 agents · 27 h 14 min · 2,783 programs · ~24,000 model calls · ~1.35B input tokens · ~US$520 at introductory list price

paper.title: A team of Gemini 4 Argon agents beats Minecraft

works.title_zh: Gemini 4 Argon 智能体团队通关 Minecraft

works.title: ELLSA 2
works.description: ELLSA 2 is an end-to-end full-duplex dialogue model that listens and speaks at the same time and also streams upper-body gestures, hand motion and facial expressions for a 3D character, including nods and smiles while it is verbally silent and meaningful gestures chosen from the dialogue. It is evaluated on a human-verified set covering backchannels, overlaps and interruptions; as of October 2026 the data pipeline, evaluation code, test set and a standalone streaming gesture-expression generator are released under Apache 2.0, not the full joint model.
works.description_zh: ELLSA 2 是一个端到端全双工对话模型，能同时听和说，并为三维角色流式生成上半身手势、手部动作和面部表情，包括在不说话时点头、微笑，以及根据对话内容选择有意义的手势。评测采用人工核验的测试集，涵盖附和、话语重叠与打断；截至 2026 年 10 月，已以 Apache 2.0 协议发布数据处理流程、评测代码、测试集和独立的流式手势-表情生成器，完整的联合模型尚未发布。
works.idea_en: Puts listening behaviour under the same full-duplex clock as speech, so a character can react bodily to what a participant is saying before it decides to take the turn.
works.idea_zh: 让倾听行为与语音共用同一条全双工时钟，角色在决定接话之前就能用身体对参与者正在说的话作出反应。
works.method: A full-duplex speech dialogue backbone in the SALMONN-omni line feeds separate listening and speaking hidden states, plus pretrained acoustic features from both sides, to an autoregressive chunk-wise synthesizer that emits SMPL-H upper-body, hand, FLAME expression and mouth codes every 0.8 s; contextual semantic calls and template guidance decide when and how to perform semantic gestures, trained on curated Seamless Interaction data.
works.method_zh: 一个属于 SALMONN-omni 系列的全双工语音对话主干，将分开的倾听与说话隐藏状态以及双方的预训练声学特征输入一个自回归分块合成器，每 0.8 秒输出 SMPL-H 上半身、手部、FLAME 表情和口型编码；上下文语义调用与模板引导分别决定何时以及如何做出语义手势，训练数据整理自 Seamless Interaction。
works.specs: gesture/expression codes every 0.8 s · test set 138 clips (67 full-duplex, 71 semantic) · Apache 2.0

paper.title: Full-Duplex Interaction with Speech, Expressions and Gestures

works.title_zh: ELLSA 2：语音、表情与手势的全双工交互

works.title: Instant Soundtracks
works.description: An ElevenLabs feature that scores an uploaded video with original music and places generated sound effects at the moments the model detects, such as a whoosh on a logo reveal; effects stay on separate layers that can be moved or swapped. It can take the video's existing audio as a reference for genre, tempo and instrumentation, and has been available in ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API since 15 October 2026.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 的一项功能：为上传的视频配上原创音乐，并在模型识别出的时刻放置生成的音效，例如标志出现时的“嗖”声；音效保留在独立的图层上，可以移动或替换。它还能把视频原有的音频作为曲风、速度与配器的参考，自 2026 年 10 月 15 日起在 ElevenCreative、ElevenMusic 和 API 中提供。
works.idea_en: Music and effects come back as separate, timed layers rather than one baked track, which keeps them editable per condition.
works.idea_zh: 音乐与音效以分开且带时间点的图层返回，而不是一条合成好的音轨，因此可以按实验条件分别修改。
works.method: Video analysis for effect cues and mood changes drives ElevenLabs' music model (likely Music v2) and sound-effect generation, aligned to timestamps on an editor timeline.
works.method_zh: 通过视频分析找出音效时机与情绪变化，驱动 ElevenLabs 的音乐模型（很可能是 Music v2）和音效生成，并对齐到编辑器时间线上的时间点。
works.title_zh: Instant Soundtracks 视频即时配乐

works.title: Matrix-Game 4.0
works.description: An open release that keeps the game logic, physics and player input in a real game engine and uses a causal video model only to turn the engine's low-poly frames into detailed visuals; it ships three playable games (medieval castle, ancient Egypt, city racing) with weights and source.
works.description_zh: 一次开源发布：游戏逻辑、物理与玩家输入都留在真正的游戏引擎中，因果视频模型只负责把引擎输出的低多边形画面变成精细画面；附带三款可玩游戏（中世纪城堡、古埃及、城市赛车）的权重与源代码。
works.idea_en: Hands state and rules back to an engine and leaves only appearance to the model, which restores persistence and experimental control.
works.idea_zh: 把状态与规则交还给引擎，只让模型负责外观，从而找回持久性与实验控制。
works.method: Streaming neural rendering: a few-step causal video model renders successive chunks conditioned on low-poly RGB frames and text prompts from an executable engine.
works.method_zh: 流式神经渲染：少步因果视频模型以可执行引擎输出的低多边形 RGB 画面和文字提示为条件，逐段渲染后续画面。
works.title_zh: Matrix-Game 4.0（昆仑万维）

works.title: XARA
works.description: Inside an immersive Unity scene, a transportation researcher speaks commands such as adding cars, pedestrians or street furniture and setting their movement, and an LLM pipeline builds and saves the driving, crossing or street-design scenario for a behavioural experiment.
works.description_zh: 交通研究者置身沉浸式 Unity 场景中，用语音下达指令，例如添加车辆、行人或街道设施并设定它们的运动；大语言模型流程据此搭建并保存驾驶、过街或街道设计情境，供行为实验使用。
works.idea_en: Voice-driven generation of experiment scenes aimed at behavioural researchers themselves, with saved scenes that can be rerun as conditions.
works.idea_zh: 面向行为研究者本人的语音式实验场景生成，场景可以保存并作为实验条件反复使用。
works.method: A dual-LLM architecture transcribes speech, translates it into structured commands and applies them to a Unity XR scene in real time (object creation, spatial manipulation, animation, persistence), with hand gestures for placement; described as a system paper without a user study.
works.method_zh: 双大语言模型架构先转写语音，再把它转成结构化指令并实时作用于 Unity XR 场景（创建物体、空间操作、动画控制与场景保存），并用手势辅助摆放；论文为系统描述，尚无用户研究。

paper.title: XARA: A Multimodal Agentic System for eXtended Reality Experiment Generation

works.title_zh: XARA：生成扩展现实实验的多模态智能体系统

works.title: Grok Voice 3.0
works.description: xAI's third speech-to-speech model, offered in the Voice Agent API at $0.08 per minute and used in Tesla cars, the Grok Bot voice mode and Starlink support lines. xAI cites Artificial Analysis results of 13 October 2026 that rank it first on the Speech-to-Speech Index (86.9, ahead of GPT-Live-1 and Gemini 3.8 Live) and at 97% on Full Duplex Bench.
works.description_zh: xAI 的第三代语音到语音模型，在 Voice Agent API 中按每分钟 0.08 美元提供，已用于特斯拉汽车、Grok Bot 的语音模式和 Starlink 客服热线。xAI 引用 Artificial Analysis 2026 年 10 月 13 日的结果：它在 Speech-to-Speech Index 上排名第一（86.9 分，高于 GPT-Live-1 与 Gemini 3.8 Live），在 Full Duplex Bench 上得分 97%。
works.idea_en: Voice-agent rankings now combine reasoning, task success and turn-taking, and the current leader is tuned for resolving support calls rather than for companionship.
works.idea_zh: 语音智能体的排名如今同时考察推理、任务完成与轮流发言，而目前的领先者是为解决客服来电而调校的，并非陪伴型产品。
works.method: Native speech-to-speech model (architecture unpublished); grok-voice-latest switched to it automatically. There is no published evidence that it backchannels while the user speaks, so it is listed as turn-based.
works.method_zh: 原生语音到语音模型（架构未公开）；grok-voice-latest 已自动切换到该模型。目前没有公开证据表明它会在用户说话时发出附和，因此按回合制归类。
works.specs: $0.08/min · <1 s latency (developer claim) · AA Speech-to-Speech Index 86.9

works.title: InfiniSplat v2
works.description: InfiniSplat v2 from Zhejiang University's ZJU3DV group predicts a 3D Gaussian scene directly from any number of photos, with or without known camera poses, and targets views that stay clean when the camera moves far from the inputs. Weights and a Hugging Face demo were released with the paper on 14 October 2026.
works.description_zh: 浙江大学三维视觉组的 InfiniSplat v2 可以从任意数量的照片直接预测三维高斯场景，相机位姿已知或未知均可，目标是在相机远离输入视角时画面依然干净。2026 年 10 月 14 日随论文发布了权重和 Hugging Face 演示。
works.idea_en: Feed-forward splats are now judged by how they look from far-off viewpoints, the case that matters when people walk around a reconstructed place in VR.
works.idea_zh: 前馈式泼溅如今要看它在远离拍摄位置时的效果，而这正是人在 VR 中绕着重建场景走动时最关键的情形。
works.method: A dual-branch network keeps a pretrained geometry branch frozen and learns Gaussian attributes separately, with opacity suppressing inconsistent points; training aligns predictions to scale-aligned ground-truth cameras and supervises large-angle target views.
works.method_zh: 双分支网络冻结预训练的几何分支，单独学习高斯属性，并用不透明度抑制不一致的点；训练时将预测与尺度对齐的真实相机对齐，并对大角度目标视角进行监督。
works.specs: mean LPIPS −25.8%, DISTS −32.9% vs. compared methods (pose-conditioned, 6 datasets; authors)

paper.title: InfiniSplat v2: Analyzing and Improving Feed-Forward 3DGS from Any Views

works.title: Mirelo SFX 2.0
works.description: A video-to-sound model that replaces a clip's audio without regenerating the picture: it keeps the dialogue, removes unwanted music and generates sound effects, foley and ambience synced to the action and consistent across cuts, for videos up to 10 minutes. Released on 14 October 2026 in Mirelo's studio and API and on platforms such as fal and Runway.
works.description_zh: 一个视频生成音效模型，无需重新生成画面就能替换片段的声音：它保留对白，去掉不需要的音乐，生成与动作同步、跨镜头保持一致的音效、拟音和环境声，单个视频最长 10 分钟。2026 年 10 月 14 日在 Mirelo 的工作室和 API 上线，也可在 fal、Runway 等平台使用。
works.idea_en: Separates the sound layer from generated video again, so a study can hold the picture fixed and vary only what is heard.
works.idea_zh: 把声音层重新从生成视频中分离出来，研究者可以固定画面，只改变听到的内容。
works.method: Video-conditioned audio generation with dialogue detection and preservation and removal of non-dialogue audio (architecture unpublished); Mirelo reports blind listening tests against other video-to-sound models and the native audio of video models.
works.method_zh: 以视频为条件的音频生成，包含对白检测与保留、非对白音频去除（架构未公开）；Mirelo 报告了与其他视频生成音效模型及视频模型原生音频的盲听比较。
works.specs: up to 10 min per pass (Studio and API)
works.title_zh: Mirelo SFX 2.0 视频生成音效

works.title: Player-1
works.description: A recipe that turns a computer-use model into a game-playing agent. After fine-tuning on 6,044 gameplay trajectories from 172 games, the agent learns by reinforcement in sixteen synthetic 2D and 3D training games and then plays Minecraft, ViZDoom and GameWorld tasks it never trained on.
works.description_zh: 把计算机操作模型变成游戏智能体的训练方法。智能体先在来自 172 款游戏的 6,044 条游戏轨迹上微调，再在 16 个合成的二维与三维训练游戏中通过强化学习练习，随后去完成从未训练过的 Minecraft、ViZDoom 与 GameWorld 任务。
works.idea_en: Cheap, randomized synthetic games can stand in for hand-collected demonstrations as the place where agents learn to act; generated worlds could take the same role.
works.idea_zh: 廉价、可随机化的合成游戏可以代替人工收集的示范，成为智能体学习行动的场所；生成的世界也可以承担同样的角色。
works.method: Qwen3.5-based computer-use models (9B and 35B-A3B) get an extended keyboard-and-mouse action space (relative pointer motion, held keys, composite actions), supervised fine-tuning on trajectories annotated with instructions and reasoning, then multi-environment PPO in Player-1-Gym with rewards computed from game state and randomized appearance, camera, scene and controls.
works.method_zh: 以 Qwen3.5 为基础的计算机操作模型（9B 与 35B-A3B）获得扩展的键鼠动作空间（相对指针移动、持续按键、组合动作），先在带指令与推理标注的轨迹上监督微调，再在 Player-1-Gym 中做多环境 PPO 强化学习；奖励直接由游戏状态计算，外观、镜头、场景与操控参数均随机化。
works.specs: Player-1-9B · MineDojo-300 success 10.54% (SFT) → 38.33% (RL), best external baseline 12.63% · 16 synthetic environments

paper.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience

works.title: ShadAR
works.description: A wearer types what should change in their passthrough view, such as 'blur all people' or 'make me laugh', and an LLM writes a pixel shader that is applied live to the matching region of the camera image.
works.description_zh: 佩戴者写下希望透视画面发生的变化，比如“把所有人都模糊掉”或“让我笑一笑”，大语言模型随即编写像素着色器，实时作用在摄像头画面中对应的区域上。
works.idea_en: Prompted, real-time edits of what a person sees, including end-goal prompts about mood or behaviour, make perception itself a generated and manipulable condition.
works.idea_zh: 通过提示实时改写人所看到的画面，甚至可以用关于情绪或行为的“目标式”提示，让感知本身成为可生成、可操控的条件。
works.method: An LLM (GPT-5.2 per the paper) interprets the prompt, an object detector (YOLO) localises targets in the passthrough view, and the generated shader is injected into the passthrough pipeline; an exploratory study with 21 HCI researchers mapped application domains and prompt patterns.
works.method_zh: 由大语言模型（论文中为 GPT-5.2）理解提示，目标检测器（YOLO）在透视画面中定位目标，再把生成的着色器注入透视渲染管线；一项由 21 位 HCI 研究者参与的探索性研究梳理了应用领域与提示方式。

paper.title: ShadAR: Real-time Prompting On-demand Visual Augmentation in Augmented Reality

works.title_zh: ShadAR：在增强现实中用提示实时改写视觉

works.title: Drama 3
works.description: An open-weight text-to-speech model for multi-character scenes: one script can carry up to 16 tagged speakers, each cloned from a short reference clip, with inline cues such as [sighs] or [laughs]. Fish Audio released the weights on Hugging Face under its research licence on 13 October 2026, and Artificial Analysis listed the preview as the top open-weights TTS model.
works.description_zh: 一个面向多角色场景的开源权重语音合成模型：一段脚本最多可包含 16 个带标签的说话人，每个声音都可以用一小段参考音频克隆，并支持 [sighs]、[laughs] 这类行内提示。Fish Audio 于 2026 年 10 月 13 日在 Hugging Face 以其研究许可发布权重，Artificial Analysis 将其预览版列为开源权重语音合成模型第一名。
works.idea_en: A whole multi-voice scene can be generated and versioned on a lab's own GPU instead of being rented line by line from a closed voice API.
works.idea_zh: 整场多声音的戏可以在实验室自己的 GPU 上生成并固定版本，而不必逐句租用封闭的语音 API。
works.method: Mixture-of-experts text backbone (35B parameters, 3B active per token) with hybrid full and linear attention and a causal multi-codebook audio decoder (10 codebooks); served with SGLang-Omni and vLLM-Omni.
works.method_zh: 混合专家文本主干（350 亿参数，每个词元激活 30 亿），结合全注意力与线性注意力，配合因果多码本音频解码器（10 个码本）；可用 SGLang-Omni 与 vLLM-Omni 部署。
works.specs: 35B MoE (3B active) · up to 16 speakers · 83 languages (developer claim)
works.title_zh: Drama 3 多角色语音合成

works.title: AA-3D
works.description: A benchmark from Artificial Analysis for AI models that build interactive 3D scenes: each model works as an agent in an offline sandbox (Blender, Rapier physics, Python, a headless browser and a CC0 asset library) for up to three hours and 250 turns, turning a written brief into a three.js web page. A recruited panel votes blind between pairs of scenes built from the same brief; at launch (v1.0) Claude Sonnet 5.5 led at 1,194 Elo, statistically tied with three other Anthropic and OpenAI models.
works.description_zh: Artificial Analysis 推出的基准，评测 AI 模型搭建交互式三维场景的能力：每个模型作为智能体在离线沙盒里工作（配有 Blender、Rapier 物理引擎、Python、无头浏览器与 CC0 资源库），最长三小时、250 轮，把一份文字需求变成一个 three.js 网页。招募的评审在同一需求生成的两个场景之间盲选；上线时（v1.0），Claude Sonnet 5.5 以 1,194 Elo 居首，与另外三个 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 模型在统计上并列。
works.idea_en: Measures the code-writing route to generated worlds, explicit and editable scenes built by agents, rather than pixels from a video model; the top models inspect renders of their own scene early.
works.idea_zh: 衡量的是通往生成世界的“写代码”路线：由智能体搭建、显式且可编辑的场景，而不是视频模型输出的像素；排名靠前的模型都很早就开始查看自己场景的渲染图。
works.method: 55 briefs across domains (landmarks, machines, natural phenomena, bodies, games, space, stories); agents write code, render and look at screenshots, and revise; blind pairwise human votes are fitted to Elo with 95% confidence intervals, alongside cost per scene ($0.20–$32.08).
works.method_zh: 55 个需求覆盖地标、机械、自然现象、人体、游戏、太空与故事等领域；智能体编写代码、渲染并查看截图后再修改；人工盲选两两投票拟合为带 95% 置信区间的 Elo 分数，并报告每个场景的成本（0.20–32.08 美元）。
works.specs: 55 briefs · 1,000+ scenes · 20+ models · ≤3 h / 250 turns per scene · output: three.js page · Elo from blind votes

works.title: D2 (Dialogue-to-Duplex)
works.description: D2 (MIT CSAIL with the MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab, 2026-10-12) converts capable turn-based spoken language models, Qwen3-Omni and LLaMA-Omni 2, into models that listen while they speak, answer when the user finishes and yield when interrupted, while keeping most of their question-answering ability. The authors report 99.2% turn-taking success at 521 ms and 99.5% interruption success at 403 ms for Qwen3-Omni-D2; it has no backchannels, so it is classed as turn-based here.
works.description_zh: D2（麻省理工学院 CSAIL 与 MIT-IBM Watson AI Lab，2026-10-12）把能力较强的回合制口语语言模型 Qwen3-Omni 和 LLaMA-Omni 2 转换为边说边听的模型：用户说完时回答，被打断时让出话轮，同时保留大部分问答能力。作者报告 Qwen3-Omni-D2 的轮次交接成功率为 99.2%（521 毫秒），打断处理成功率为 99.5%（403 毫秒）；它不发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制。
works.idea_en: Narrows the trade-off between a capable model and a fluent conversational partner by retrofitting duplex timing onto an existing backbone rather than training a duplex model from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 通过给现有主干模型补上双工时序、而不是从头训练双工模型，缩小了“能力强”与“对话流畅”之间的取舍。
works.method: Distils a frozen offline speech encoder into a chunk-causal streaming encoder without transcripts, then fine-tunes the backbone on aligned user and assistant audio with delayed self-audio feedback and explicit control tokens for starting and stopping, at 80–160 ms chunks.
works.method_zh: 先在不需要转写的情况下，把冻结的离线语音编码器蒸馏成块内双向、块间因果的流式编码器；再用对齐的用户与助手音频、延迟的自身音频反馈，以及表示开始和停止的显式控制 token 微调主干，块长 80–160 毫秒。
