works.specs: 12.5 Hz updates · 80 ms chunks · VoiceBench 70.1 · turn-taking 99.2% at 521 ms · interruption 99.5% at 403 ms (developer-reported)

paper.title: D2: High-Capability Full-Duplex Spoken Language Models from Half-Duplex Backbones

works.title_zh: D2：由半双工主干构建高能力全双工口语模型

works.title: World-T3
works.description: A camera-controlled video world model from the University of Illinois Chicago and Meta Reality Labs that stores what it has seen in a set of weights updated at test time, so a place looks the same on an out-and-back path while generation runs in real time.
works.description_zh: 伊利诺伊大学芝加哥分校与 Meta Reality Labs 提出的镜头可控视频世界模型：把看到的内容存入一组在测试时更新的权重，沿原路返回时同一地点保持不变，同时实时生成。
works.idea_en: Memory with constant cost per frame is what long, real-time sessions in a generated place would need.
works.idea_zh: 每帧成本恒定的记忆，正是在生成场所中进行长时实时会话所需要的。
works.method: Test-time-training memory: past observations are consolidated into dedicated parameters with a recursive least-squares update, so memory cost does not grow with rollout length.
works.method_zh: 测试时训练记忆：用递推最小二乘更新把历史观察整合进专门的参数中，使记忆成本不随推演长度增长。

paper.title: World-T3: Test-Time Training as Persistent Memory for Real-Time Video World Models

works.title_zh: World-T3：以测试时训练作持久记忆

works.title: Hyper3D Agentic Mode
works.description: An agent mode in Deemos's Hyper3D (Rodin) app that interprets what a person asks for, rewrites the input and chooses how to model it, producing editable n-gon models with adjustable dimensions for CAD, architecture and product design, and adding animation; Deemos calls it 'vibe modeling'.
works.description_zh: Deemos 旗下 Hyper3D（Rodin）应用中的智能体模式：它理解用户的意图、改写输入并决定建模方式，生成可编辑、尺寸可调的 N 边形（n-gon）模型，面向 CAD、建筑和产品设计，也能为模型添加动画；Deemos 称之为“氛围建模”（vibe modeling）。
works.idea_en: Following Meshy's 3D Agent, the main asset vendors now put a planning agent in front of the generator; the person states intent and the agent decides the steps.
works.idea_zh: 继 Meshy 3D 智能体之后，主要的三维资产厂商都在生成器前面加了一个负责规划的智能体：人只需说明意图，步骤由智能体决定。
works.method: Proprietary; Deemos describes an agentic layer that optimises the prompt and selects a modelling route over its Rodin generators, but has not published the design.
works.method_zh: 专有系统；Deemos 称其为一个智能体层，负责优化提示词并在自家 Rodin 生成器之上选择建模路线，具体设计未公开。
works.title_zh: Hyper3D 智能体模式

works.title: Sonic-AMG
works.description: Brown University model (with MIT, Yale and the University of Hong Kong) that streams full-body human reactions to sounds as they occur, using both what is heard and where it comes from; the demos show reactions to a phone call, a cough, a fire alarm, an aircraft and an insect. The authors describe it as the first streaming model of motion from spatial audio; code is listed as coming soon.
works.description_zh: 布朗大学（与麻省理工学院、耶鲁大学和香港大学合作）的模型：根据声音的内容和方位，实时流式生成人对声音的全身反应；演示涵盖对来电、咳嗽、火警、飞机和昆虫声音的反应。作者称这是首个从空间音频流式生成动作的模型；代码标注为“即将发布”。
works.idea_en: Background characters can react in real time to the sound events of a scene, a cue that emergency and bystander situations depend on.
works.idea_zh: 背景角色能实时对场景中的声音事件做出反应，而紧急情况与旁观者情境恰恰依赖这类线索。
works.method: Acoustic content and body-relative source position are encoded as separate tokens for a causal transformer with a flow head that emits motion latents; rehearsal training on short self-rollouts and spatial feedback, which recomputes the source direction from the generated root pose, reduce the gap between training and streaming inference.
works.method_zh: 把声音内容和相对身体的声源位置编码为两类 token，输入带流匹配头的因果 Transformer，输出动作潜变量；用短程自回放的“排练训练”和“空间反馈”（根据生成的根节点姿态重新计算声源方向）缩小训练与流式推理之间的差距。

paper.title: Sonic-AMG: Streaming Human Motion Generation from Spatial Audio

works.title_zh: Sonic-AMG 由空间音频流式生成人体动作

works.title: FaceGAN (No Distillation Needed)
works.description: FaceGAN (Meta Reality Labs, 2026-10-08) drives a talking head from streaming audio with one forward pass per frame, outputting facial expression and head pose for a rendered head avatar as the audio arrives. The authors report quality that matches or exceeds diffusion-based talking-head methods, and generation of unbounded length without drift.
works.description_zh: FaceGAN（Meta Reality Labs，2026-10-08）用流式音频驱动说话头像，每帧只需一次前向计算，随音频到来输出面部表情和头部姿态，再渲染成头像。作者报告，其生成质量与基于扩散模型的说话头像方法相当或更好，并能无限时长生成而不漂移。
works.idea_en: Questions the default of distilling large diffusion models for live avatars: for facial motion a small causal GAN may be enough, which lowers the cost of a responsive face in a study.
works.idea_zh: 质疑了“实时虚拟人就要蒸馏大型扩散模型”的默认做法：对面部动作而言，一个小型因果 GAN 可能就够了，这降低了在研究中使用及时回应面孔的成本。
works.method: A causal, time-invariant generator maps audio to expression and head pose; because its driving noise is synthetic, the future of the noise can be sampled ahead and shaped acausally, which removes the spectral limit of causal generators driven by i.i.d. noise while the audio path stays causal; bounded attention windows keep long generation stable.
works.method_zh: 一个因果、时不变的生成器把音频映射为表情和头部姿态；由于驱动噪声是合成的，可以提前采样噪声的“未来”并对其做非因果整形，从而突破 i.i.d. 噪声驱动的因果生成器在频谱上的限制，同时音频路径保持因果；有界注意力窗口保证长时间生成稳定。
works.specs: 1 network evaluation per frame · unbounded length (developer-reported)

paper.title: No Distillation Needed: Single-Pass Real-Time Talking Heads via Acausal Noise Shaping

works.title_zh: FaceGAN：无需蒸馏的单次前向实时说话头像

works.title: GATOR
works.description: NVIDIA and Simon Fraser University system that recovers complete textured object assets, with their pose in the room, from one or a few casual photos, then lets an agent repair each mesh in Blender by comparing renders with the photos; the composed rooms are shown running in physics simulation with humanoid robots.
works.description_zh: 英伟达与西蒙菲莎大学的系统：由一张或几张随手拍的照片恢复完整、带纹理的物体资产及其在房间中的位姿，再由智能体在 Blender 中对照照片与渲染结果修补每个网格；组合出的房间被放进物理仿真，与人形机器人一起演示。
works.idea_en: Generation fills in what the camera did not see, and an agent checks the result against what it did see, a route from a quick capture of a real room to an interactive copy of it.
works.idea_zh: 生成负责补全相机没拍到的部分，智能体再拿拍到的部分来核对结果，这是从一次快速拍摄到真实房间的可交互副本的一条路径。
works.method: A local modality mixer couples patch-aligned RGB, target-mask and pointmap features with text-guided adapters for structure, geometry and appearance; an image-grounded edit-render-review agent then refines each asset within a ten-minute budget, keeping edits only when renders match the evidence.
works.method_zh: 局部模态混合模块把逐块对齐的 RGB、目标掩码和点图特征结合起来，并通过文本引导的适配器分别控制结构、几何与外观；之后由“编辑—渲染—复查”的图像驱动智能体在每个物体十分钟的预算内进行修补，只有渲染结果与观测相符时才保留修改。

paper.title: GATOR: Generative and Agentic 3D Object Reconstruction From Casual Images

works.title_zh: GATOR：生成式、智能体驱动的三维物体重建

works.title: OuroWorld
works.description: OuroWorld takes a static 3D Gaussian world, for example one generated with Marble or Lyra 2.0, and makes it move as an endlessly looping 3D cinemagraph: water flows, plants sway and lights change, viewable from any position.
works.description_zh: OuroWorld 以一个静态三维高斯世界（例如由 Marble 或 Lyra 2.0 生成的世界）为输入，让它变成无限循环的三维动态照片：水流动、植物摇曳、光线变化，可从任意位置观看。
works.idea_en: A cheap way to bring frozen generated worlds to life: ambient motion that loops without seams gives a place time without needing a full world model.
works.idea_zh: 让静止的生成世界“活”起来的低成本办法：无缝循环的环境运动给场景加入时间，而不需要完整的世界模型。
works.method: A vision-language model proposes plausible dynamics and guides a video model to generate a reference video, which is lifted and completed into multi-view videos; an inconsistency-robust periodic 4D Gaussian model with a Fourier-series deformation field (looping by construction) and a drift field anchored to the reference view is fitted to them.
works.method_zh: 视觉语言模型推断合理的动态并引导视频模型生成参考视频，再提升并补全为多视角视频；随后拟合一个对不一致具有鲁棒性的周期性 4D 高斯模型，其傅里叶级数形变场保证循环，锚定参考视角的漂移场吸收视角间的不一致。

paper.title: OuroWorld: Bringing Any 3D World Alive as Diverse, Endlessly Looping 3D Cinemagraphs

works.title_zh: OuroWorld 让三维世界变成循环动态照片

works.title: SepGen
works.description: SepGen (Tel Aviv University with Google, 2026-10-08) extends a pretrained audio-video generator to output, in one sampling run, the video, the mixed soundtrack and one waveform per captioned source, for example one track per speaker in a dialogue; in separation mode it splits an existing recording by text description. The separate sources can then be placed and moved in a 3D scene to render spatial audio; code, checkpoints and data are open.
works.description_zh: SepGen（特拉维夫大学与谷歌，2026-10-08）扩展了一个预训练的音视频生成模型，使其在一次采样中同时输出视频、混音音轨，以及每个带文字描述的声源各自的波形，例如对话中每位说话人一条音轨；在分离模式下，它可以按文字描述拆分已有录音。分离出的声源可以在三维场景中定位和移动，从而渲染空间音频；代码、权重和数据均已开源。
works.idea_en: Per-source audio is what spatial rendering needs: a generated scene whose voices and sounds are separable can be heard from wherever the participant stands.
works.idea_zh: 空间渲染需要按声源分开的音频：一个人声和声音可分离的生成场景，无论参与者站在哪里都能听得对。
works.method: Fine-tunes a joint audio-video generator to emit additional audio streams conditioned on per-source captions alongside the mix; a separation mode keeps the input mix clean and extracts the captioned sources from it.
works.method_zh: 微调音视频联合生成模型，使其在混音之外，按每个声源的文字描述额外输出音频流；分离模式下保持输入混音不变，从中提取被描述的声源。

paper.title: SepGen: Multi-Stem Audio-Video Separation and Generation in a Single Model

works.title_zh: SepGen：单一模型中的多音轨音视频分离与生成

works.title: USDCraft
works.description: NVIDIA research (with NTU) in which a pretrained LLM writes and revises an executable program for an articulated object, such as a drawer, a toaster or a piano, from a partial or corrupted scan, an image or a prompt; the output is a USD asset with joints and physical properties that loads into Isaac Sim without manual adjustment. Code and dataset were still listed as to come in October 2026.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA（与南洋理工大学合作）的研究：由预训练大语言模型根据残缺或有缺陷的扫描网格、一张图像或一段文字，编写并反复修改可执行程序，生成抽屉、烤面包机、钢琴等带关节的物体；输出为带关节和物理属性的 USD 资产，无需手动调整即可载入 Isaac Sim。截至 2026 年 10 月，代码与数据集仍标注为“待发布”。
works.idea_en: Objects that open, slide and click arrive as editable programs with physics attached, so a generated room can be operated, not only looked at.
works.idea_zh: 能打开、滑动、按下的物体以附带物理属性、可编辑的程序形式交付，生成的房间不只是能看，还能动手操作。
works.method: Source geometry analysis turns the input mesh into a metric text description that separates observed surface from unknown space; the LLM writes a USD program, each candidate is re-encoded the same way so that discrepancies point to program edits, and visual feedback plus physical authoring guidance finish the asset, with no task-specific training.
works.method_zh: “源几何分析”把输入网格转为区分已观测表面与未知空间的度量化文字描述；大语言模型据此编写 USD 程序，每个候选结果再用同样方式重新编码，差异直接指向需要修改的程序；最后借助视觉反馈和物理建模指引完成资产，无需针对任务的训练。
works.specs: output: OpenUSD with joints and physical properties · loads in Isaac Sim

paper.title: USDCraft: Geometrically Grounded Programmatic Modeling of Articulated 3D Assets for Simulation

works.title_zh: USDCraft 面向仿真的关节三维资产程序化建模

works.title: WorldCast
works.description: A distributed multiplayer world model for Counter-Strike 2: each player's client generates its own view and exchanges only compact player and scene states with the others, so adding a player adds a client instead of enlarging one joint model; the authors report 16+ fps per client for 2 to 16 players, one GPU each.
works.description_zh: 一个面向《反恐精英 2》的分布式多人世界模型：每名玩家的客户端各自生成自己的画面，彼此只交换精简的玩家状态与场景状态，因此增加一名玩家只需多一个客户端，而不必扩大一个联合模型；作者称在 2 到 16 名玩家、每人一张 GPU 的条件下，每个客户端可达 16 fps 以上。
works.idea_en: Shared generated worlds could scale like networked games, with each participant rendering locally and only state travelling between them.
works.idea_zh: 共享的生成世界可以像联网游戏一样扩展：每位参与者在本地渲染，彼此之间只传递状态。
works.method: Each client pairs a video generator with a state model that estimates the player's position from generated video and controls; clients exchange player states, project them into camera-aligned player-state fields that guide where and how other players are drawn, and reuse each other's observations as shared scene state.
works.method_zh: 每个客户端由一个视频生成器和一个状态模型组成，状态模型根据生成画面与操作输入估计玩家位置；客户端之间交换玩家状态，并把它们投影为与相机对齐的“玩家状态场”，指导其他玩家在何处、以何种样子被画出，同时把彼此的观测复用为共享场景状态。
works.specs: 2–16 players · 16+ fps per client · 1 GPU per client · ~3.5 Mb/s received per client (developer-reported)

paper.title: WorldCast: Distributed Multiplayer World Models

works.title_zh: WorldCast：分布式多人世界模型

works.title: Playground (with Unity Spark)
works.description: Google's experimental browser platform, opened on 2026-10-07 to people aged 18+: you describe a game in text prompts, test it at once, change its physics, rules, characters or environment by asking, and publish it to a community gallery with leaderboards and, in some genres, multiplayer. Google and Unity announced the same day that Unity Spark, Unity's no-code game maker built on Asset Store art and a web editor, will come to Playground later in 2026; as of October 2026 Spark has only a waitlist.
works.description_zh: Google 推出的实验性浏览器平台，2026-10-07 起向 18 岁以上用户开放：用文字描述一款游戏即可立刻试玩，想改物理、规则、角色或环境也只需开口，完成后可以发布到社区画廊，带排行榜，部分类型还支持多人游戏。Google 与 Unity 同日宣布，Unity 的零代码游戏制作工具 Unity Spark（基于 Asset Store 美术资源与网页编辑器）将在 2026 年晚些时候接入 Playground；截至 2026 年 10 月，Spark 只开放了候补名单。
works.idea_en: Prompt-to-playable-game with publishing and leaderboards built in, the fast authoring loop a researcher wants for task variants; the output is casual browser games, not immersive scenes.
works.idea_zh: 从提示词到可玩游戏，发布与排行榜一并内置；这正是研究者快速制作任务变体所需的创作循环，但产出的是轻量浏览器游戏，而不是沉浸式场景。
works.method: A conversational interface generates and revises the game from prompts with Google AI models that Google does not name, Play Games profiles supply identity and leaderboards, and Unity Spark is to add Unity's runtime and artist-made assets.
works.method_zh: 通过对话界面，由 Google 未具名的 AI 模型根据提示生成并修改游戏；Play Games 账号提供身份与排行榜，Unity Spark 计划补上 Unity 的运行时与美术师制作的资源。
works.specs: browser-based · 18+ · text-prompt creation · leaderboards, multiplayer in select genres · Unity Spark: waitlist, later in 2026
works.title_zh: Playground（含 Unity Spark）

works.title: Vidu Q4 Preview
works.description: Vidu Q4 Preview (2026-10-07) is the public preview of Shengshu's next flagship audio-video model, aimed at character performance: facial expression, body movement and voice are generated together, guided by up to 15 reference images and 3 reference audio clips, with 2K or 4K output in 10-bit colour.
works.description_zh: Vidu Q4 Preview（2026-10-07）是生数科技下一代旗舰音视频模型的公开预览版，重点在角色表演：面部表情、肢体动作与声音一同生成，可用最多 15 张参考图和 3 段参考音频来约束，输出 2K 或 4K、10 bit 色深。
works.idea_en: Reference audio as well as reference images: a scenario's characters can keep the same face and the same voice across many generated shots.
works.idea_zh: 除了参考图像还有参考音频：情境中的角色可以在多个生成镜头里保持同一张脸和同一种声音。
works.method: Joint audio-video generation conditioned on multi-image and multi-audio references (architecture not disclosed).
works.method_zh: 以多张参考图与多段参考音频为条件的音视频联合生成（架构未公开）。
works.specs: 2K / 4K · 10-bit · up to 15 image + 3 audio references · from $0.014/s (launch price)

works.title: Building Rome from a Single Image
works.description: Give it one photograph of a room or a street and it generates a complete metric 3D scene mesh, including surfaces the camera never saw, which can be orbited, walked through and measured in metres in a browser viewer.
works.description_zh: 给它一张房间或街道的照片，它就会生成一个完整、带真实尺度的三维场景网格，包括相机没有拍到的表面；在浏览器查看器里可以环绕、行走，并以米为单位测量距离。
works.idea_en: An object generator's shape prior, re-chunked for whole scenes, fills in what a single photo hides, so a real place can become a walkable, metric stand-in with open weights.
works.idea_zh: 把物体生成器的形状先验按整场景重新分块使用，就能补出单张照片看不到的部分，让一个真实地点变成可行走、有真实尺度的替身，而且权重开放。
works.method: Redesigns the object-centric TRELLIS 2 generator for scenes: adaptive chunks that grow with distance from the camera, image features lifted onto observed surfaces with voxels labelled free, visible or hidden, autoregressive generation that reuses overlapping latents between chunks, and about 4,000 synthesized outdoor scenes added to mostly indoor training data. Applied Intuition reports it beats World Tracing, GenRecon, VolFill and Lyra 2.0 on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++ and in-the-wild images.
works.method_zh: 把以物体为中心的 TRELLIS 2 生成器改造用于场景：随距相机远近增大的自适应分块；把图像特征投到可见表面上，并把体素标为空闲、可见或被遮挡；在相邻分块间复用重叠潜变量的自回归生成；并在以室内为主的训练数据中加入约 4,000 个合成户外场景。Applied Intuition 称其在 Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++ 和野外照片上优于 World Tracing、GenRecon、VolFill 与 Lyra 2.0。
works.specs: Single image → metric scene mesh · indoor and outdoor · ~4,000 synthetic outdoor training scenes

paper.title: Building Rome from a Single Image

works.title_zh: 从一张照片建起罗马：单图生成完整三维场景

works.title: DyaFDB
works.description: Instead of testing a full-duplex voice model against recordings or a scripted examiner, DyaFDB has two models talk to each other in assigned roles with shared or conflicting goals (booking a room, guarding a secret), then scores both sides offline with an external judge.
works.description_zh: DyaFDB 不再让全双工语音模型面对录音或照本宣科的考官，而是让两个模型按分配的角色直接对话，目标或一致或冲突（订会议室、守住秘密），再由外部评审在事后为双方打分。
works.idea_en: Turn-taking, overlap and interruption are joint products of two speakers, so a virtual human has to be tested against a partner that reacts; each model reshapes how the other behaves.
works.idea_zh: 轮流发言、重叠与打断是两个说话者共同造成的，所以虚拟人必须在会作出反应的对象面前测试；每个模型都会改变对方的表现。
works.method: Two full-duplex models are bridged in an 80 ms lockstep loop, each with a private role brief in a shared situation; four tasks (e.g., information pooling, attack and defence of a secret) as 140 scenarios and 7,560 recorded conversations across six self- and cross-play pairings of PersonaPlex, MiniCPM-o and Raon-SpeechChat, scored by an external judge. Scenarios, role prompts and recording protocols are announced for release.
works.method_zh: 用 80 毫秒步进同步的桥接把两个全双工模型连起来，各自拿到一份私密的角色说明，处在同一情境中；共四类任务（如信息汇集、秘密的攻防），140 个场景、7,560 段录制对话，覆盖 PersonaPlex、MiniCPM-o 与 Raon-SpeechChat 的六种自对与互对组合，由外部评审打分。场景、角色提示与录制规程已宣布将公开。

paper.title: Conversation Is a Two-Body Problem: Dyadic Evaluation of Full-Duplex Dialogue Models

works.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video
works.description: Kandinsky 6.0 Video (2026-10-06) is an open family of text- and image-to-audio-video models in two sizes, Lite (3B) and Pro (29B), that generate 5-second clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio including lip-synced speech, with native Russian-language understanding. Code and weights are released under the MIT licence with Diffusers and ComfyUI support.
works.description_zh: Kandinsky 6.0 Video（2026-10-06）是开源的文生 / 图生音视频模型系列，分 Lite（30 亿参数）与 Pro（290 亿参数）两种规模，可生成 5 秒、带同步 44 kHz 音频（含口型同步语音）的片段，并原生理解俄语。代码与权重以 MIT 许可证发布，支持 Diffusers 与 ComfyUI。
works.idea_en: MIT-licensed joint audio-video weights broaden who can run talking-character clips locally, beyond the English- and Chinese-centred models.
works.idea_zh: MIT 许可的音视频联合权重，让更多人能在本地生成会说话的角色片段，不再局限于以英文和中文为主的模型。
works.method: Diffusion transformers that generate synchronized video and audio, trained in stages with supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning post-training and distillation (per the technical report).
works.method_zh: 生成同步视频与音频的扩散 Transformer，经监督微调、强化学习后训练与蒸馏分阶段训练（据技术报告）。
works.specs: Lite 3B · Pro 29B · 5 s clips · 44 kHz audio · MIT licence

paper.title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation

works.title: WorldSonus
works.description: A streaming video-to-audio model meant to give interactive world models a soundtrack: it generates stereo sound in 100 ms chunks as frames arrive, follows camera motion and scene layout, and accepts new sound instructions mid-stream. The authors report a real-time factor of 0.41 and quality matching offline bidirectional models on open-domain video-to-audio benchmarks; weights are released for non-commercial use.
works.description_zh: 一个流式视频生成音频模型，目标是为交互式世界模型配上声音：随着画面帧到来，它以 100 毫秒为单位生成立体声，跟随镜头运动与场景布局，并能在生成过程中接受新的声音指令。作者报告其实时率为 0.41，在开放领域的视频生成音频基准上与离线双向模型质量相当；权重以非商用许可发布。
works.idea_en: Sound can be generated live beside a playable world model and redirected during play, instead of being added afterwards to a finished clip.
works.idea_zh: 声音可以和可玩的世界模型同步实时生成，并在体验过程中被改变方向，而不是事后为成片补配。
works.method: Causal autoregressive diffusion over audio chunks with chunk-indexed prompt scheduling from an audio-centric captioning pipeline, trained with stereo supervision curated from stereo and ambisonic recordings.
works.method_zh: 对音频片段做因果自回归扩散，用面向音频的字幕流程生成按片段编号调度的提示，并以从立体声与全景声录音中整理出的立体声数据进行监督训练。
works.specs: stereo · 100 ms chunks · RTF 0.41 · CC BY-NC 4.0 weights

paper.title: WorldSonus: Bringing Sound to Worlds

works.title_zh: WorldSonus：为世界模型配上声音

works.title: PixReenact
works.description: PixReenact (OriginAI with NVIDIA, 2026-10-04) animates a reference portrait from a live driving video in a stream, so one person's expressions and head motion play on another face as they happen. The authors report about 240 ms mean emission latency and identity held over a five-minute stream, including extreme head turns and occlusions.
works.description_zh: PixReenact（OriginAI 与英伟达，2026-10-04）用实时驱动视频流式地驱动一张参考人像，让一个人的表情和头部动作即时呈现在另一张脸上。作者报告，平均输出延迟约 240 毫秒，五分钟的连续视频流中身份保持稳定，极端转头和遮挡时也是如此。
works.idea_en: Live reenactment lets a hidden confederate or actor puppeteer a generated face in real time, a Wizard-of-Oz route to controlled virtual interlocutors.
works.idea_zh: 实时重演让幕后的实验助手或演员即时操纵一张生成的面孔，这是实现可控虚拟对话者的一条“绿野仙踪”式路径。
works.method: A causal video diffusion model conditioned directly on VAE latents of the reference and driving frames, without separate identity or motion encoders, trained with cross-identity pseudo-supervision and long self-rollouts, then distilled with separate teachers for cold start and steady state into a 4-step rolling student that emits four frames per update.
works.method_zh: 因果视频扩散模型直接以参考帧和驱动帧的 VAE 潜变量为条件，不使用单独的身份或动作编码器；训练采用跨身份伪监督和长程自回放，再分别用冷启动和稳态两个教师蒸馏成 4 步滚动学生模型，每次更新输出 4 帧。
works.specs: 4 NFE · 4 frames per update · ~239 ms mean emission latency · 5-min identity test (developer-reported)

paper.title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment

works.title_zh: PixReenact：像素条件因果视频扩散的流式头像重演

works.title: 4Director
works.description: 4Director (Stability AI and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, 2026-10) directs a video from a single image by reconstructing each object once as a mesh and moving it with one rigid 3D transform per frame, so camera moves, existing objects and newly inserted objects are controlled in one shared 3D space and objects keep their shape when seen from new angles.
works.description_zh: 4Director（Stability AI 与伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校，2026 年 10 月）从一张图像出发“导演”视频：每个物体只重建一次为网格，并按帧施加一个刚体 3D 变换，因此镜头运动、已有物体与新插入的物体都在同一个 3D 空间中控制，物体从新角度看也保持形状。
works.idea_en: Blocking a scene like a 3D layout (object paths plus camera) and getting photoreal video back is close to how an experimenter would script a staged event.
works.idea_zh: 像布置 3D 场景那样安排物体路径和镜头，再得到逼真的视频，这已接近实验者编排一场情境事件的方式。
works.method: The controlled mesh scene is rendered as a depth video and a Motion Adapter turns it into video with view-consistent appearance, lighting and non-rigid motion; trained on RealCOD-Rigid, 20,774 clips annotated with rigid 3D scenes.
works.method_zh: 把受控的网格场景渲染为深度视频，再由 Motion Adapter 转换成外观、光照与非刚性运动都视角一致的视频；训练数据为 RealCOD-Rigid，含 20,774 段标注了刚体 3D 场景的视频。

paper.title: 4Director: Controlling Video World Models with Rigid 3D Geometry

works.title_zh: 4Director：用刚体 3D 几何控制视频世界模型

works.title: Effects of Generative AI-Supported Virtual Reality Dental Skill Training on Learning Performance, Visual Behavior, and Cortical Activation Among Dental Students: Stratified Randomized Controlled Trial
works.description: Dental students practised operative skills in a VR simulator for seven days with either ChatGPT guidance and no human tutor (n=62) or on-site instructor guidance (n=61). The ChatGPT group scored higher on the operative skills test (77.3 vs. 67.4, d=0.70), with eye tracking and fNIRS recorded during training.
works.description_zh: 牙科学生在 VR 模拟器中进行为期七天的操作技能训练，一组只有 ChatGPT 指导、没有人类导师（n=62），另一组由教师现场指导（n=61）。ChatGPT 组的操作技能测试得分更高（77.3 对 67.4，d=0.70）；训练中同时记录了眼动与功能性近红外光谱数据。
works.idea_en: Generative AI as the tutor inside an authored simulator, not as the simulator itself, can be tested against a human teacher in a randomized design.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 作为人工制作的模拟器中的导师（而不是模拟器本身），可以在随机设计中与人类教师正面比较。
works.method: Stratified randomized controlled trial (by baseline theory score) of GenAI-assisted vs. teacher-led VR dental training; research assistants screened AI outputs only for safety; outcomes were operative exams, eye tracking, fNIRS, visual-spatial tests and questionnaires.
works.method_zh: 按理论基线分层的随机对照试验，比较生成式 AI 辅助与教师主导的 VR 牙科训练；研究助理仅出于安全目的审查 AI 输出；结局包括操作考核、眼动追踪、功能性近红外光谱、视觉空间测验与问卷。

paper.title: Effects of Generative AI-Supported Virtual Reality Dental Skill Training on Learning Performance, Visual Behavior, and Cortical Activation Among Dental Students: Stratified Randomized Controlled Trial

works.title_zh: 生成式 AI 辅助的虚拟现实牙科技能训练对学习表现、视觉行为与皮层激活的影响：分层随机对照试验

works.title: Griffin
works.description: Griffin is a full-duplex video-to-video model for live video calls: it watches and hears the person, decides moment by moment whether to speak, hold, back-channel or yield, and generates the speech and every pixel of a 720p person in real time from one reference image. Tavus reports that 48% of people in one-minute calls thought it was a real person; Griffin-Lite is a research preview for selected testers as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Griffin 是一个面向视频通话的全双工视频到视频模型：它同时看和听对方，每隔不到一秒判断该说话、停顿、附和还是让出话轮，并从一张参考图像实时生成语音和 720p 画面中人物的每一个像素。Tavus 报告称，在一分钟的通话中有 48% 的参与者认为对方是真人；截至 2026 年 10 月，Griffin-Lite 仅以研究预览形式向部分测试者开放。
works.idea_en: The first commercial virtual human that listens while it talks, can be interrupted and nods mid-sentence, so face-to-face timing becomes a generated, studyable variable.
works.idea_zh: 第一个边说边听、可被打断、会在对方说话时点头的商用虚拟人，让面对面的时机本身成为可生成、可研究的变量。
works.method: A continuous conversational model reads incoming audio and video at sub-second intervals and emits text plus control signals; a streaming autoregressive diffusion speech generator (on a 48 kHz continuous codec) and a few-step causal video DiT distilled with DMD2, teacher forcing and Self-Forcing render the reply.
works.method_zh: 一个连续对话模型以亚秒间隔读取输入的音视频并输出文本和控制信号；随后由流式自回归扩散语音生成器（基于 48 kHz 连续编解码器）和经 DMD2、teacher forcing 与 Self-Forcing 蒸馏的少步因果视频 DiT 渲染回应。
works.specs: 720p · real time · 0.43 s avg audio-to-video latency (H100) · 48% judged human in 1-min calls · VideoFDB generation 3.83 (human 3.92)
works.title_zh: Griffin 人类交互模型

works.title: PROWL-2
works.description: A training framework from Odyssey in which a team of agents learns inside a learned world model while that world model is repaired wherever it mispredicts. It is shown on StarCraft II squad combat (SMACv2) and on cooperative quadruped-robot tasks.
works.description_zh: Odyssey 提出的训练框架：一组智能体在学习得到的世界模型中训练，同时在世界模型预测出错的地方对其进行修复。演示场景包括《星际争霸 II》小队作战（SMACv2）和多台四足机器人的协作任务。
works.idea_en: Before agents learn from a generated world, check the world: rollouts the model gets wrong are kept out of training and used to fix the model instead.
works.idea_zh: 在让智能体从生成的世界中学习之前，先检查这个世界：模型推演错的片段不用于训练，而是转去修正模型本身。
works.method: Agents train on world-model rollouts from start states ranked by learning potential (unsupervised environment design), a developer agent explores the real environment for mispredictions, and a fidelity gate compares imagined with recorded real trajectories so that low-fidelity start states go to world-model repair until the model predicts them correctly.
works.method_zh: 智能体在世界模型生成的推演中训练，起始状态按学习潜力排序（无监督环境设计）；一个“开发者”智能体在真实环境中寻找模型预测错误之处；保真度闸门把想象轨迹与记录的真实轨迹对比，保真度低的起始状态先交给世界模型修复，直到模型能正确预测后才重新用于训练。
works.specs: SMACv2 9 scenarios (5v5, 10v10, 10v11) · up to 91% relative gain over the baseline world-model learner · MQE Gate-3 success 29.8% → 70.4%

paper.title: PROWL-2: Fidelity-Gated Exploration for Multi-Agent World-Model Dual Curricula

works.title: Sessions (Interactive Avatars)
works.description: Sessions is Synthesia's platform for two-way conversations with real-time avatars: Roleplay Sessions (first released in July 2026) let employees rehearse sales, coaching or support conversations with an avatar that pushes back, followed by AI scoring and feedback, and Survey Sessions turn a form into a spoken interview. An Interactive Avatars API exposes the same avatars to developers.
works.description_zh: Sessions 是 Synthesia 用于与实时虚拟人双向对话的平台：Roleplay Sessions（2026 年 7 月首发）让员工与会“反驳”的虚拟人演练销售、辅导或客服对话，结束后由 AI 打分并反馈；Survey Sessions 把问卷变成口头访谈。Interactive Avatars API 向开发者开放同一套虚拟人。
works.idea_en: A mainstream training vendor now sells scored roleplay with a responsive avatar, which is the deliberate-practice loop of simulation training at enterprise scale.
works.idea_zh: 主流培训厂商开始销售与会回应的虚拟人进行可打分的角色扮演，这正是模拟训练中“刻意练习”循环的企业级版本。
works.method: Likely a cascaded stack (speech recognition, an LLM scenario prompt, TTS and Synthesia's real-time avatar renderer) with a separate LLM coach that grades transcripts.
works.method_zh: 很可能是级联方案（语音识别、大模型情境提示、语音合成和 Synthesia 的实时虚拟人渲染器），另有一个大模型教练对对话记录评分。
works.title_zh: Sessions 交互虚拟人会话

works.title: GLARE
works.description: GLARE generates a listener's face in a two-person conversation and decides when to react and how: nodding, head shaking, smiling, laughing, frowning or looking surprised. It comes with about 147 hours of paired speaker-listener video carrying 64,557 event-level reaction labels, and metrics that score whether a reaction was appropriate rather than only how realistic it looks.
works.description_zh: GLARE 在两人对话中生成倾听者的面部，并决定何时、以何种方式反应：点头、摇头、微笑、大笑、皱眉或表现惊讶。它附带约 147 小时的说话者-倾听者配对视频，含 64,557 条事件级反应标注，以及衡量反应是否恰当（而不只是画面是否逼真）的指标。
works.idea_en: Treats listener behaviour as discrete, labelled reactions with timing, which is the form behavioural coding already uses.
works.idea_zh: 把倾听行为看作带有时间点的离散、可标注反应，这正是行为编码本来就采用的形式。
works.method: A flow-matching transformer animates a reference portrait from the speaker's audio, conditioned on prosody features from Qwen2-Audio and trained with a temporal reaction loss on clips curated from RealTalk and Seamless Interaction.
works.method_zh: 一个流匹配 Transformer 根据说话者音频驱动参考人像，以 Qwen2-Audio 提取的韵律特征为条件，并在从 RealTalk 与 Seamless Interaction 整理出的片段上用时序反应损失训练。
works.specs: ~147 h paired speaker-listener video · 64,557 reaction annotations · 6 reaction types

paper.title: GLARE: Generating Listening Heads with Appropriate Reactions

works.title_zh: GLARE：生成做出恰当反应的倾听头像

works.title: LOCI
works.description: A streaming, camera-controlled world model with a hybrid spatial memory: half of its transformer blocks keep a cache of past frames, the other half a compact recurrent memory addressed by camera geometry, so a place looks the same when the camera returns; the authors stream it on one H200 and report about 30% lower peak memory than full attention.
works.description_zh: 一个流式、可控相机的世界模型，采用混合空间记忆：一半 Transformer 模块保留历史帧缓存，另一半使用按相机几何寻址的紧凑循环记忆，因此相机回到原处时画面依旧；作者在单张 H200 上流式运行，并称峰值显存比全注意力低约 30%。
works.idea_en: Combines exact recall of what was seen with a fixed-size summary, so revisits stay faithful without memory growing with session length.
works.idea_zh: 把对已见画面的精确回忆与固定大小的摘要结合起来，使重访保持忠实，而记忆不会随会话时长膨胀。
works.method: Alternating blocks: cache-backed main attention, and chunk-local attention complemented by a recurrent linear-attention memory whose reads and writes are conditioned on projective camera geometry; recurrent readouts feed the queries of later cache-backed blocks; a four-step distilled student streams the video.
works.method_zh: 交替使用两类模块：一类是带缓存的主注意力；另一类只关注当前片段，并辅以循环线性注意力记忆，其读写都以相机投影几何为条件；循环记忆的读出作为后续带缓存模块的查询输入；由四步蒸馏的学生模型流式生成视频。
works.specs: 864×480 · 4 denoising steps per chunk · 1 H200 · ~30% lower peak memory than full softmax (developer-reported)

paper.title: LOCI: Spatial Linear Memory for Streaming World Models

works.title_zh: LOCI：流式世界模型的空间线性记忆

works.title: Soundwich
works.description: Soundwich (Simon Fraser University with Tel Aviv University, 2026-09-30) makes an existing joint audio-video generator output separate, synchronised tracks for voices, music, effects and ambience instead of one mixed soundtrack, each with its own timing, so a sound can be retimed, muted, replaced or remixed without regenerating the picture. It needs no training and runs on frozen open models such as LTX-2.5 and MiniMax H3.
works.description_zh: Soundwich（西蒙弗雷泽大学与特拉维夫大学，2026-09-30）让现有的音视频联合生成模型输出相互同步、各自可控时间的独立音轨（人声、音乐、音效、环境声），而不是一条混音；这样就能在不重新生成画面的情况下调整某个声音的时间、静音、替换或重新混音。它无需训练，可直接运行在 LTX-2.5、MiniMax H3 等冻结的开源模型上。
works.idea_en: Separate stems turn generated sound from a fixed property of a clip into experimental variables: the same scene can be shown with and without a siren or a voice.
works.idea_zh: 独立音轨让生成的声音从片段的固定属性变成可操纵的实验变量：同一场景可以分别呈现有或没有警笛、人声的版本。
works.method: A training-free sampling scheme generates one stem per source with a shared scene representation that passes global audiovisual context between stems, and routes each stem's cross-modal attention to its own visual source.
works.method_zh: 无需训练的采样方案：为每个声源生成一条音轨，用共享的场景表示在音轨之间传递全局视听上下文，并把每条音轨的跨模态注意力引向它对应的画面声源。

paper.title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio

works.title_zh: Soundwich：分层可控音频的视频生成

works.title: StereoBind
works.description: Extends joint video-audio generation to stereo, so that a generated sound moves left or right with its source on screen, a property the authors call dynamic spatial correspondence. The Xidian University and vivo team also built StereoWorld-29K, a stereo audio-video dataset with motion tracks, and StereoWorldBench for measuring audio-visual spatial consistency.
works.description_zh: 把音视频联合生成扩展到立体声，让生成的声音随画面中的声源左右移动，作者称之为“动态空间对应”。西安电子科技大学与 vivo 团队还构建了带运动轨迹的立体声音视频数据集 StereoWorld-29K，以及衡量音画空间一致性的 StereoWorldBench。
works.idea_en: Native audio in generated video starts to carry direction, a cue headsets need and mono soundtracks lack.
works.idea_zh: 生成视频的原生音频开始带有方向感，这正是头显所需、而单声道配乐缺少的线索。
works.method: Motion tracks condition a joint video-audio generator through visual motion binding, a spatial track encoder for absolute source position and a residual track RoPE for relative motion.
works.method_zh: 用运动轨迹为音视频联合生成器提供条件：视觉运动绑定建立声源对应，空间轨迹编码器表示声源的绝对位置，残差轨迹 RoPE 刻画相对运动。

paper.title: Hear the World in Stereo: Learning Dynamic Spatial Correspondence for Immersive Joint Video-Audio Generation

works.title_zh: StereoBind：音视频联合生成中的动态立体声

works.title: Audible World Models
works.description: A training-free pipeline that gives text-generated 3D worlds sound sources with fixed positions: it builds a panoramic 3D proxy of the world, finds sound-producing objects and ambient regions, synthesizes dry audio for each and renders what a listener hears as they move. Across 80 generated scenes the authors (Georgia Tech and Dolby) report higher spatial consistency than text-, video- and panorama-conditioned baselines; NeurIPS 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个无需训练的流程，为文本生成的三维世界配上位置固定的声源：先构建世界的全景三维代理，找出发声物体与环境声区域，为每一项合成干声，再按听者的移动渲染其听到的声音。在 80 个生成场景上，作者（佐治亚理工学院与杜比）报告其空间一致性高于以文本、视频和全景图为条件的基线；论文发表于 NeurIPS 2026。
works.idea_en: Puts sound into the world state rather than into a rendered video, so a source stays where it is when the visitor walks around it.
works.idea_zh: 把声音放进世界状态而不是渲染出的视频里，访客绕着声源走动时，声源仍待在原处。
works.method: Panorama-to-3D proxy with semantic layer separation, per-label dry audio synthesis, sources anchored to reconstructed geometry, and listener-dependent rendering by geometric acoustic propagation.
works.method_zh: 全景图转三维代理并做语义分层，按标签合成干声，把声源锚定到重建的几何上，再用几何声学传播做随听者位置变化的渲染。

paper.title: Audible World Models: Spatially Aware Sound Generation for 3D Worlds

works.title_zh: Audible World Models：为三维世界生成空间感知的声音

works.title: Eleven v4
works.description: ElevenLabs' 2026 text-to-speech generation, with a new architecture, a Turbo variant for low-latency agents, one voice across many languages and more consistent voice cloning. ElevenLabs says it follows inline direction such as [laughs], [said angrily in French accent] or sound cues like [light rain] more accurately than v3.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 2026 年的新一代语音合成：新架构、面向低延迟智能体的 Turbo 版本、同一声音跨多种语言，以及更稳定的声音克隆。ElevenLabs 表示，它比 v3 更准确地遵循 [laughs]、[said angrily in French accent] 这类行内指示，甚至 [light rain] 这样的声音提示。
works.idea_en: Acting direction and inline sound cues in one pass blur the line between a voice line and a small sound scene.
works.idea_zh: 一次生成里同时包含表演指示和行内声音提示，模糊了“一句台词”和“一个小型声音场景”之间的界线。
works.method: New TTS architecture (unpublished) with a separate Turbo model for real-time use; follows audio tags and direction prompts.
works.method_zh: 新的语音合成架构（未公开），另有用于实时场景的 Turbo 模型；遵循音频标签与表演指示提示。

works.title: FlowAct-R2
works.description: FlowAct-R2 streams a 720p digital human for hours that keeps acting on its own when nobody writes in, and responds when viewers do: it chats on video calls, sells products it holds and tries on, sings and dances for live-stream comments, and handles interruptions. ByteDance reports large human-preference wins over Shengshu's Vidu-S1 for video quality and real-time interaction.
works.description_zh: FlowAct-R2 可连续数小时流式生成 720p 数字人：无人互动时它按自己的安排行动，观众发言时立即回应；它能在视频通话中聊天、手持并试穿商品进行直播带货、根据弹幕唱歌跳舞，也能处理打断。字节跳动报告称，在视频质量和实时互动的人类偏好评测中明显优于生数科技的 Vidu-S1。
works.idea_en: Moves the avatar from answering to carrying a session: a persona, an agenda and reusable skills let a generated person keep a situation going between a participant's actions.
works.idea_zh: 让虚拟人从“回答问题”走向“主持一场互动”：人设、议程和可复用技能让生成的人在参与者两次行动之间也能把情境维持下去。
works.method: A streaming multimodal-reference Diffusion Transformer adapted from the Seedance 2.0 Mini reference-to-video model with diffusion forcing, video-aligned RoPE and partially noised history frames, driven by a proactive agent that plans a persona, agenda and skills offline and schedules, interrupts and resumes behaviours online.
works.method_zh: 一个流式多模态参考扩散 Transformer，由 Seedance 2.0 Mini 参考生视频模型改造而来，采用 diffusion forcing、与视频对齐的 RoPE 和部分加噪的历史帧；再由一个主动式智能体在离线阶段规划人设、议程与技能，在线时调度、打断和恢复各种行为。
works.specs: 720p · hour-level streams · GSB +54.76% video quality / +40.48% real-time interaction vs Vidu-S1 (developer-reported)

paper.title: FlowAct-R2: Beyond Talking Avatar via Streaming Multimodal References and Proactive Agent Planning

works.title_zh: FlowAct-R2：基于流式多模态参考与主动式智能体规划的交互数字人

works.title: Kling 4.0
works.description: Kling 4.0, introduced on 2026-09-28 (Kling 4.0 Flash went first to a limited group of users), extends single generations to 30 seconds with up to 10 keyframes, 10-bit HDR at 1080p and 4K and two-channel stereo sound; Kling announced on 2026-10-16 that it is fully available on kling.ai. No Kling 4.0 API model had been announced as of 2026-10-17.
works.description_zh: 可灵 4.0 于 2026-09-28 推出（可灵 4.0 Flash 先向部分用户开放），单次生成延长到 30 秒，支持最多 10 个关键帧、1080p 与 4K 下的 10 bit HDR 以及双声道立体声；可灵于 2026-10-16 宣布其已在 kling.ai 全面开放。截至 2026-10-17，尚未公布可灵 4.0 的 API 模型。
works.idea_en: Thirty-second takes can hold a whole short interaction (approach, exchange, reaction) in one continuous shot.
works.idea_zh: 30 秒的长镜头可以在一个连续镜头里容纳一段完整的短互动（接近、交流、反应）。
works.method: Next Kling generation; reported to accept up to 10 keyframe images per clip and to output up to 4K; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 可灵新一代模型；据报道每段最多可用 10 张关键帧图像并输出最高 4K；架构未公开。
works.specs: 3–30 s per generation · up to 10 keyframes · 720p / 1080p / 4K · 10-bit HDR · stereo audio
works.title_zh: 可灵 4.0

works.title: OmniDream
works.description: Turns a silent, narrow field-of-view video into a 360° audiovisual scene: alongside a panoramic expansion of the picture, each visible sound source gets its own generated audio, which is propagated through a simulated scene and rendered as spatial audio that stays aligned as the viewer looks around. The University of Pennsylvania authors report better audio-visual alignment, spatial correctness and rated immersion than baselines.
works.description_zh: 把一段无声、视野狭窄的视频变成 360° 视听场景：在把画面扩展为全景的同时，为每个可见声源单独生成声音，经模拟场景传播后渲染成空间音频，观众转头环顾时声音始终与画面对齐。宾夕法尼亚大学的作者报告，其音画对齐、空间正确性与主观沉浸感均优于基线。
works.idea_en: Any ordinary clip can become a looked-around scene that also sounds right in every direction, without recording spatial audio.
works.idea_zh: 任意一段普通视频都能变成可以环顾、且各个方向听起来都对的场景，无需录制空间音频。
works.method: Training-free: an object-centric audio representation separates each source's intrinsic sound from scene-dependent acoustics, so sources are generated independently, propagation is simulated physically, and the result is rendered as first-order ambisonics.
works.method_zh: 无需训练：以物体为中心的音频表示把每个声源的本征声音与场景相关的声学效果分开，从而分别生成声源、用物理方法模拟传播，并渲染为一阶全景声。

paper.title: Enabling Immersive Audio-Visual Experience from Any Video

works.title_zh: OmniDream：从任意视频生成沉浸式视听体验

works.title: WorldPlay2
works.description: A follow-up to Tencent Hunyuan's WorldPlay (HY-World 1.5) by several of its authors: a real-time world model steered by keyboard and camera actions plus a structured text prompt that sets the scene, the controlled character and timed events (lighting a stove, a balloon rising) separately, while staying consistent over longer journeys.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元 WorldPlay（HY-World 1.5）的后续研究，作者多有重合：一个实时世界模型，由键盘与镜头动作以及结构化文字共同驱动，文字分别设定场景、被控角色和定时事件（点燃炉灶、气球升起），并在更长的旅程中保持一致。
works.idea_en: Separating 'what the world is', 'who I am' and 'what happens now' in the prompt is a step toward scripting events inside a running world.
works.idea_zh: 在提示中把“世界是什么”“我是谁”“现在发生什么”分开，是在运行中的世界里编排事件的一步。
works.method: Factorized hybrid control (frame-aligned actions plus a caption split into scene, entity and event fields), a learnable history compressor that turns past frames into compact memory tokens, and 'Stable Forcing' distillation into a few-step autoregressive student.
works.method_zh: 分解式混合控制（逐帧对齐的动作，加上拆分为场景、实体与事件三个字段的描述），把历史帧压缩为紧凑记忆 token 的可学习压缩器，以及蒸馏为少步自回归学生模型的 “Stable Forcing” 方法。

paper.title: WorldPlay2: Extending Real-Time Interactive World Models in Control and Horizon

works.title: FloodDiffusion 2
works.description: Streaming text-to-motion model that keeps a 3D character moving continuously while its text prompt changes, for example from jogging to jumping, and can now also follow a given root path at a set speed; weights, data and a live Hugging Face demo are public. It succeeds FloodDiffusion (CVPR 2026) from ShandaAI Research Tokyo and the University of Tokyo, and the authors report about 11 times faster denoising, at 2.3 ms per update.
works.description_zh: 流式文本生成动作模型：文字提示变化时（例如从慢跑改为跳跃），三维角色的动作始终连贯不断，新版还能让角色按指定路径和速度移动；权重、数据和 Hugging Face 在线演示均已公开。它是 ShandaAI 东京研究院与东京大学 FloodDiffusion（CVPR 2026）的后续版本，作者报告去噪速度提升约 11 倍，每次更新耗时 2.3 毫秒。
works.idea_en: A character can be redirected mid-motion by typed or spoken commands and steered along a path, the way a game master or an experimenter cues an actor.
works.idea_zh: 角色在动作进行中就能被文字或语音指令改变动作、沿指定路径行进，就像游戏主持人或实验者给演员下提示一样。
works.method: Diffusion forcing tailored to motion (bidirectional attention, a lower-triangular noise schedule, time-varying text conditioning); version 2 adds partial attention for KV-cached inference, a forward-kinematics-induced loss and root-path conditioning.
works.method_zh: 针对动作定制的扩散强迫（diffusion forcing）：双向注意力、下三角噪声调度和随时间变化的文字条件；第二版加入支持 KV 缓存推理的部分注意力、由正向运动学导出的损失函数以及根轨迹条件。
works.specs: 2.3 ms per update · 11.3× faster denoising and 4.6× less training compute than v1 · FID 0.053 on HumanML3D (developer figures)

paper.title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation

works.title_zh: FloodDiffusion 2 流式动作生成

works.title: Agora-2
works.description: A playable research preview of a multi-agent world model in which up to 20 humans and AI agents share one generated world in real time, each participant's actions changing what the others see; it was trained on Diablo II gameplay captures.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩的多智能体世界模型研究预览：最多 20 名人类与 AI 智能体实时共处于同一个生成世界，每个人的动作都会改变其他人看到的画面；训练数据来自《暗黑破坏神 II》的游戏录像。
works.idea_en: A shared generated world is the precondition for social situations; Agora-2 shows it working, but in one game's visual world.
works.idea_zh: 共享的生成世界是社会情境的前提；Agora-2 展示了它的可行性，但目前局限于一款游戏的画面世界。
works.method: A world model trained on Diablo II captures that pair observations with actions and game state, predicting a shared state from many participants' simultaneous actions; it extends Agora-1 (May 2026) to 5× more participants and multiple environments.
works.method_zh: 以配对了观察、动作与游戏状态的《暗黑破坏神 II》录像训练的世界模型，根据多名参与者的同时动作预测共享状态；相较 Agora-1（2026 年 5 月）参与人数增加 5 倍，并支持多个环境。
works.title_zh: Agora-2：多智能体世界模型

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Live with Live Avatar
works.description: Live Avatar couples Google's Gemini 3.8 Live dialogue model with near-real-time video generation, so an enterprise agent appears as a talking character that sees and hears the user, lip-syncs across 97 languages (switching mid-conversation) and keeps talking while tools run in the background. It is available in Gemini Enterprise with preset avatars; custom avatars from a reference image are allowlist-only, and all audio and video carry SynthID watermarks.
works.description_zh: Live Avatar 把 Google 的 Gemini 3.8 Live 对话模型与近实时视频生成结合起来，让企业智能体以一个会说话的角色出现：它能看到和听到用户，在 97 种语言间（可在对话中途切换）保持口型同步，并在后台调用工具时继续对话。它已在 Gemini Enterprise 中提供预设虚拟人；用参考图像定制虚拟人仅向白名单企业开放，所有音频和视频都带有 SynthID 水印。
works.idea_en: A frontier-lab virtual human ships with provenance built in: every generated frame and word is watermarked, which matters for studies that must disclose synthetic interlocutors.
works.idea_zh: 前沿实验室的虚拟人在发布时就内置了溯源标识：生成的每一帧画面和每一句话都带水印，这对需要披露“对话者是合成的”研究很重要。
works.method: Gemini 3.8 Live native audio dialogue (audio and video in, speech out) natively coupled with a low-latency streaming video generator; turn-taking is handled by the Live model, with interruption support as in the Live API (Google describes 'fluid turn-taking', not overlapping speech).
works.method_zh: Gemini 3.8 Live 原生音频对话（音视频输入、语音输出）与低延迟流式视频生成器原生耦合；轮流发言由 Live 模型处理，像 Live API 一样支持打断（Google 的描述是“流畅的轮流发言”，而非重叠说话）。
works.specs: 97 languages · near-real-time streaming video · SynthID in audio and video
works.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 Live 实时虚拟人（Live Avatar）

works.title: Character World Model-1 (CWM-1)
works.description: CWM-1 generates an entire live video-call scene from one image of any character (person, anime, animal): face, body, hands, hair and surroundings, with an emotion engine that triggers actions such as shrugging, leaning in or picking up a phone. It follows LemonSlice-2 (December 2025), a 20B causal model that ran at 20 fps on one GPU.
works.description_zh: CWM-1 只需任意角色（真人、动漫、动物）的一张图像，就能生成整个实时视频通话画面：脸、身体、手、头发和周围环境；其情绪引擎会触发耸肩、前倾、拿起手机等动作。它接替了 2025 年 12 月发布的 LemonSlice-2（一个在单 GPU 上以 20 fps 运行的 20B 因果模型）。
works.idea_en: Treats the avatar as a small world model centred on a character, so body language and object interaction are generated rather than rigged.
works.idea_zh: 把虚拟人看作以角色为中心的小型世界模型，肢体语言和与物体的互动都是生成出来的，而不是靠绑定动画。
works.method: A causal, few-step video diffusion transformer conditioned on audio, a prompt and action/emotion states predicted by a separate emotion engine that reads the conversation.
works.method_zh: 一个因果、少步的视频扩散 Transformer，以音频、提示词以及独立情绪引擎（读取对话内容）预测的动作/情绪状态为条件。
works.specs: LemonSlice-2: 20B params · 20 fps on 1 GPU · 471 ms p99 latency (platform)
works.title_zh: 角色世界模型 CWM-1

works.title: Hologram (Meta Ray-Ban Display / Meta VR Glasses)
works.description: Hologram is a photorealistic, live version of your face for video calls made from glasses: after a short self-capture with the phone, the person you call sees your face and expressions, which Meta says are driven entirely by your voice on Meta Ray-Ban Display. Announced at Connect on 2026-09-23, it rolls out in Early Access on WhatsApp for Ray-Ban Display users in the US in fall 2026 and will ship on Meta VR Glasses in spring 2027.
works.description_zh: Hologram 是在眼镜上打视频电话时使用的照片级实时人脸：用手机做一次简短的自我采集后，通话对方就能看到你的脸和表情；Meta 称在 Meta Ray-Ban Display 上它完全由你的声音驱动。该功能于 2026-09-23 的 Connect 大会发布，2026 年秋季起在美国通过 WhatsApp 向 Ray-Ban Display 用户抢先开放，并将在 2027 年春季随 Meta VR Glasses 推出。
works.idea_en: A wearer with no camera pointed at their face still appears face-to-face, because the face is inferred from speech: the expression the other person sees is generated, not captured.
works.idea_zh: 即使没有摄像头对着自己的脸，佩戴者仍能“面对面”出现，因为面孔是从语音推断出来的：对方看到的表情是生成的，而不是拍到的。
works.method: A personal face model is built from a short phone self-capture in the Meta AI app, and a hologram model infers expression from what is said and how it is said; Meta has not published the architecture, which is likely related to its Codec Avatars research.
works.method_zh: 先在 Meta AI 应用中用手机做简短自我采集，建立个人面部模型；再由 hologram 模型根据说话内容和语气推断表情。Meta 尚未公开架构，可能与其 Codec Avatars 研究相关。
works.title_zh: Hologram 全息人像（Meta Ray-Ban Display / Meta VR Glasses）

works.title: Listening and Mirroring: The Effects of Verbal Attunement and Behavioral Mimicry on Social and Empathic Perceptions of Embodied AI Agents in VR
works.description: An embodied AI counsellor in VR that answers through GPT-4o mini and can mirror the user's facial expressions, head tilt and posture as tracked by a Meta Quest Pro. In a 2 × 2 within-subjects study (N = 20), verbally attuned responses raised perceived empathy, while mimicry had only a marginal effect on perceived humanness and the two did not add up.
works.description_zh: VR 中的具身 AI 咨询师：通过 GPT-4o mini 作答，并能借助 Meta Quest Pro 的追踪模仿用户的面部表情、头部倾斜与姿势。在 2 × 2 被试内研究（N = 20）中，言语上的共情回应提高了被感知的共情，而行为模仿只对“像人程度”有边缘效应，两者的作用也不能简单相加。
works.idea_en: For an LLM-driven character, what it says moves perceived empathy more than whether its body mirrors you.
works.idea_zh: 对大语言模型驱动的角色来说，说什么比身体是否模仿你更能左右被感知到的共情。
works.method: Unity application with Deepgram speech recognition and TTS, GPT-4o mini via LiveKit, a Ready Player Me avatar and Quest Pro face tracking for mimicry; 2 × 2 repeated-measures design (verbal attunement × behavioural mimicry), N = 20, repeated-measures ANOVA.
works.method_zh: Unity 应用，结合 Deepgram 语音识别与语音合成、经 LiveKit 调用的 GPT-4o mini、Ready Player Me 化身以及 Quest Pro 面部追踪实现模仿；2 × 2 重复测量设计（言语共情 × 行为模仿），N = 20，重复测量方差分析。

paper.title: Listening and Mirroring: The Effects of Verbal Attunement and Behavioral Mimicry on Social and Empathic Perceptions of Embodied AI Agents in VR

works.title_zh: 倾听与镜像：言语共情与行为模仿对 VR 中具身 AI 智能体社会与共情感知的影响

works.title: Meta VR Glasses
works.description: Meta's VR headset in a glasses form factor, announced at Connect on 2026-09-23: about 100 g on the face, with compute, battery and storage in a pocket puck on an optical tether, a 5K micro-OLED display at 37 pixels per degree, color passthrough and eye, hand and voice control with Meta's AI agent in the operating system. Existing Quest apps run on it, it adds photoreal 'hologram' video calls, and it goes on sale in spring 2027 at $1,299.99.
works.description_zh: Meta 做成眼镜形态的 VR 设备，于 2026-09-23 的 Connect 大会发布：戴在脸上的部分约 100 克，计算、电池与存储放在通过光纤连接的口袋计算盒里；配备 5K Micro-OLED 显示屏（每度 37 像素）、彩色透视，以及眼动、手势与语音操控，Meta 的 AI 智能体直接集成在操作系统中。现有 Quest 应用可以在上面运行，它还新增了照片级真实的“全息影像”视频通话，将于 2027 年春季以 1,299.99 美元开售。
works.idea_en: Cuts VR down to a weight people can wear through a full film or a long session, which matters for longer generated situations as much as resolution does; until spring 2027 it is an announcement, not a lab device.
works.idea_zh: 把 VR 的重量降到能戴着看完一整部电影、撑过一次长时间体验的程度；对于更长的生成情境，这一点和分辨率同样重要。不过在 2027 年春季之前，它还只是发布，实验室还用不上。
works.method: A two-part design: the glasses hold the sensors, micro-OLED panels and custom pancake lenses, while a tethered puck with Qualcomm's Snapdragon Reality Elite carries compute and a battery Meta rates at up to three hours of video playback.
works.method_zh: 分体式设计：眼镜部分只放传感器、Micro-OLED 屏幕与定制的折叠光路（pancake）镜片，经连线接驳的计算盒搭载高通骁龙 Reality Elite，负责计算并内置电池，Meta 称可连续播放视频最长三小时。
works.specs: ~100 g glasses + tethered puck · 5K micro-OLED · 37 ppd · Snapdragon Reality Elite · up to 3 h media playback · $1,299.99 · on sale spring 2027
works.title_zh: Meta VR 眼镜

works.title: Muse Realtime Avatar
works.description: Muse Realtime Avatar gives Meta's Muse agent a face in live video chat: from one reference image (a photo, an illustration, an animal or an object) it animates the character's face, hands and body as Muse Realtime Voice speaks, for as long as the conversation lasts. Meta reports that raters preferred it over Runway Characters and HeyGen LiveAvatar in two- to three-minute live calls; video chat is available in the Muse app as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Muse Realtime Avatar 让 Meta 的 Muse 智能体在视频聊天中有了一张脸：只需一张参考图（照片、插画、动物甚至物件），它就能在 Muse Realtime Voice 说话时实时驱动角色的面部、双手和身体，对话持续多久就生成多久。Meta 称在两到三分钟的实时通话中，评测者更偏好它而不是 Runway Characters 和 HeyGen LiveAvatar；截至 2026 年 10 月，Muse 应用已开放视频聊天。
works.idea_en: Voice and face are generated from one shared speech-token stream, so delivery, lips and expression stay in step, and a lab can give any image a live body at consumer scale.
works.idea_zh: 语音和面孔由同一条语音 token 流生成，语气、口型和表情因此同步；任何一张图都能以消费级规模获得一个实时的身体。
works.method: An audio-driven Diffusion Transformer reads the speech-token stream of Muse Realtime Voice, the reference media and a rolling window of recent video latents, and generates short causal chunks; a 40-step teacher with three-way CFG is distilled by self-forcing and distribution matching into an unguided two-step student, served with 4-bit quantisation and persistent KV caches, and every frame carries a Video Seal watermark.
works.method_zh: 一个音频驱动的扩散 Transformer 读取 Muse Realtime Voice 的语音 token 流、参考素材和最近视频潜变量的滚动窗口，逐段生成短的因果视频块；40 步、三路 CFG 的教师模型通过 self-forcing 与分布匹配蒸馏成无引导的两步学生模型，以 4 比特量化和持久 KV 缓存部署，每一帧都嵌入 Video Seal 水印。
works.specs: 448×768 · 25 fps · ~870 ms from end of user turn to first byte · 2 NFE per chunk (from 120) · 12 sessions per GB200 (developer-reported)

works.title: Passing
works.description: A video installation that turns one continuous monorail-window recording into an endless, shifting journey by resampling it as a space-time volume; a camera detects whether someone stands in front of the screen and steers the transitions. The video stream is sonified live by Sony's real-time video-to-audio model SpecMaskFoley, which proposes sound for a landscape that no longer follows ordinary space and time.
works.description_zh: 一件影像装置：把一段连续拍摄的单轨列车车窗影像当作时空体重新采样，变成一段没有尽头、不断变化的旅程；摄像头检测屏幕前是否有人，并据此引导画面转换。影像流由索尼的实时视频生成音频模型 SpecMaskFoley 现场配声，为一个不再遵循常规时空的风景“设想”出可能的声音。
works.idea_en: Uses a video-to-audio model as a live listener to images it was never trained on, and lets audience presence steer what it hears.
works.idea_zh: 把视频生成音频模型当作一位实时“聆听者”，面对它从未见过的画面，并让观众的在场引导它听到什么。
works.method: Frames stacked into a spatiotemporal volume and sliced along nonlinear trajectories; camera-based presence detection selects sequences; real-time SpecMaskFoley generates the synchronized soundscape.
works.method_zh: 把帧堆叠成时空体并沿非线性轨迹切片；基于摄像头的在场检测选择片段；实时 SpecMaskFoley 生成同步声景。

paper.title: Passing: An Endless Journey through Reconstructed Spacetime with AI-Generated Sound

works.title: Signals of AI Hallucination: Designing Hallucination-Aware Cues for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR
works.description: A GPT-4o-driven embodied agent in VR answered questions while signalling uncertainty and sources in one of three ways: gestures and posture, status icons, or color-coded text with citations. In a within-subjects study (N=24), all three helped people spot hallucinated content compared with no cues; embodied cues raised trust and immersion, and text cues were the easiest to interpret.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，一个由 GPT-4o 驱动的具身智能体回答问题，并以三种方式之一提示不确定性与来源：手势与姿态、状态图标，或带引用的彩色标注文本。被试内研究（N=24）显示，与无提示相比，三种方式都帮助人们识别出幻觉内容；具身提示提高了信任与沉浸感，文本提示最容易理解。
works.idea_en: Generated characters will sometimes say false things; how the character itself signals doubt changes both whether people catch it and how much they trust it.
works.idea_zh: 生成的角色难免说错话；角色自己如何表达“不确定”，既影响人们能否发现错误，也影响他们有多信任它。
works.method: Within-subjects comparison of embodied, icon and text cues against a no-cue baseline, with a faithfulness-based hallucination detector as backend; hallucination-identification logs, trust, immersion and task-load questionnaires, and interviews.
works.method_zh: 被试内比较具身、图标与文本三种提示和无提示基线，后端采用基于忠实度的幻觉检测；收集幻觉识别日志、信任、沉浸感与任务负荷问卷及访谈。

paper.title: Signals of AI Hallucination: Designing Hallucination-Aware Cues for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR

works.title_zh: AI 幻觉的信号：为 VR 中的具身对话智能体设计幻觉提示

works.title: From Grasping to Speaking: Generative AI-Based Environment-Grounded VR Communication Training for Autistic Individuals
works.description: Follow-up to the team's LLM job-communication trainer in which agents generate dialogue grounded in the VR workplace and in what the trainee's hands are doing. An exploratory ASSETS 2026 study with 9 autistic trainees and 7 job coaches compared conversation only, conversation with objects, and conversation with objects and grasping; both groups preferred the most grounded condition.
works.description_zh: 这是该团队大语言模型职场沟通训练系统的后续工作：智能体生成的对话与 VR 工作场景以及受训者手上的动作相关联。ASSETS 2026 上的一项探索性研究有 9 名自闭症受训者和 7 名就业辅导员参与，比较了仅对话、对话加物体、对话加物体与抓取三种条件；两类参与者都更喜欢关联程度最高的条件。
works.idea_en: Grounding the agent's talk in the task at hand moves soft-skills practice from isolated chat to communication embedded in work.
works.idea_zh: 让智能体的话语与手头任务相关联，把软技能练习从孤立的聊天变成嵌入工作中的沟通。
works.method: Prompting schema that feeds VR object state and hand-interaction events to LLM agents; exploratory within-subjects comparison of three grounding conditions with usability, workload and preference measures.
works.method_zh: 提示词框架把 VR 物体状态与手部交互事件输入大语言模型智能体；以可用性、工作负荷与偏好为指标，对三种关联条件做探索性的被试内比较。
works.title_zh: 从抓取到表达：面向自闭症人士、基于生成式 AI 并与环境关联的 VR 沟通训练

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS
works.description: Google's text-to-speech models, generally available in the Gemini API since 22 September 2026: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for directed acting, regional dialects and two-speaker dialogue, and Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume use and real-time agent pipelines. A new Voices endpoint designs persistent voices from a text prompt and replicates a voice after consent verification; Hume's Real World VoiceEQ leaderboard ranked Flash TTS first two days later.
works.description_zh: 谷歌的语音合成模型，自 2026 年 9 月 22 日起在 Gemini API 中正式可用：Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 面向有表演指导的演绎、地方口音和双人对话，Flash-Lite TTS 面向大批量生成和实时智能体流程。新的 Voices 接口可以根据文字提示设计可长期保存的声音，并在验证授权后复刻某个声音；两天后，Hume 的 Real World VoiceEQ 排行榜把 Flash TTS 排在第一位。
works.idea_en: Prompt-designed voices that persist across sessions make it cheap to cast a stable set of characters, with consent checks built into cloning.
works.idea_zh: 可以跨会话保存的提示设计声音，让低成本地为一组角色稳定“选角”成为可能，克隆声音时还内置了授权核验。
works.method: Gemini-based speech generation (architecture unpublished) steered by natural-language direction; Flash-Lite replaces gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview (April 2026).
works.method_zh: 基于 Gemini 的语音生成（架构未公开），用自然语言指导发声；Flash-Lite 取代 2026 年 4 月的 gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview。
works.specs: 150+ prebuilt and custom voices · two-speaker dialogue
works.title_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash 语音合成

works.title: PixVerse R2
works.description: A real-time world model for continuous audiovisual play: users move with WASD, change weather or call in a vehicle by prompt, speak or add references, and the consequences carry forward; PixVerse's own demos include questioning an AI suspect in real time.
works.description_zh: 一个用于连续音视频交互的实时世界模型：用户用 WASD 移动，用提示改变天气或召来车辆，也可以说话或添加参考素材，而这些改变的后果会延续下去；PixVerse 自己的演示中包括实时审问一名 AI 嫌疑人。
works.idea_en: Consequences that persist inside a running world, plus spoken input, move world models toward interactive scenarios such as interviews.
works.idea_zh: 让后果在运行中的世界里延续，再加上语音输入，使世界模型向审讯、访谈这类交互情境靠近。
works.method: Movement, prompt, audio and reference inputs at different rates are merged into one continuous generation loop on top of PixVerse's audio-video model.
works.method_zh: 在 PixVerse 音视频模型之上，把不同速率的移动、提示、音频与参考输入融合进同一个连续生成循环。
works.title_zh: PixVerse R2（爱诗科技）

works.title: GAE (Geometry-Native Autoencoder)
works.description: An open 1B-parameter generator from HKUST and Tencent ARC Lab that turns one image and a prompt into a camera-controlled multi-view video whose every frame also decodes into depth, camera poses and point maps, so the generated world comes out as consistent 3D rather than pixels alone.
works.description_zh: 香港科技大学与腾讯 ARC 实验室推出的开源 10 亿参数生成模型：由一张图像和一句提示生成相机可控的多视角视频，每一帧同时可解码为深度、相机位姿和点图，生成的世界因此直接带有一致的三维结构，而不只是像素。
works.idea_en: Generating in a latent that already encodes geometry, instead of checking geometry afterwards, is one route to video-like worlds that stay put when you look back.
works.idea_zh: 在本身就编码几何的潜空间里生成，而不是事后再补几何，是让类视频世界在回头看时仍保持不变的一条路径。
works.method: Features of a geometry foundation model are reparameterised into a compact latent (the geometry-native autoencoder) that decodes jointly to appearance, depth, cameras and point maps, and a standard conditional flow-matching model generates directly in that latent; with the generator and training protocol held fixed, the authors report better visual quality and measured 3D coherence than with an appearance-only latent.
works.method_zh: 把几何基础模型的特征重新参数化为一个紧凑潜空间（几何原生自编码器），它可同时解码出外观、深度、相机与点图；再用标准的条件流匹配模型直接在该潜空间中生成。作者报告，在生成器与训练流程不变的对照中，换用该潜空间后，画质和独立测量的三维一致性都优于只编码外观的潜空间。
works.specs: 1B parameters · image + prompt → multi-view video with depth, cameras and point maps

paper.title: GAE: Learning a Geometry-Native Latent Space for 3D-Consistent World Generation

works.title_zh: GAE：几何原生自编码器

works.title: Generative Tutorial
works.description: An AR prototype watches the user's workspace during a physical task and generates, for each next step, a goal image and a short demonstration video that show the user's own tools and materials in their current state.
works.description_zh: 一个 AR 原型在用户做手工任务时观察其工作台，并为每一步生成目标图和简短示范视频，画面里是用户自己的工具和材料以及它们当前的状态。
works.idea_en: Guidance generated from the live scene rather than pre-recorded footage; participants performed better, but generation errors changed how far they trusted the instructions.
works.idea_zh: 指导根据现场画面生成，而不是事先录好的视频；参与者完成得更好，但生成错误会影响他们对指导的信任程度。
works.method: A formative test of current image and video generators on 15 physical tasks informed a pipeline that predicts the visual outcome of preceding actions and generates step images and videos from the observed workspace; a 24-participant lab study compared it with pre-authored guidance.
works.method_zh: 先用 15 个现实任务对现有图像与视频生成模型做形成性测试，据此搭建流程：预测前序动作的视觉结果，并根据观察到的工作台生成每一步的图像与视频；24 人的实验室研究将其与预先制作的指导作比较。

paper.title: Generative Tutorial: Towards Live Contextualized Visual Instructions for Physical Tasks

works.title_zh: 生成式教程：为现实任务实时生成贴合情境的可视化指导

works.title: WorldCrafter
works.description: A video world model from Tencent ARC Lab whose memory is queried by the camera: past views are compressed into a fixed set of tokens shaped by the viewpoint being requested, which keeps revisited places and orbits consistent; base and distilled fast weights and a Hugging Face demo are public.
works.description_zh: 腾讯 ARC 实验室的视频世界模型，其记忆由相机来“查询”：历史画面按照即将请求的视角被压缩成固定数量的 token，从而让重访的地点和环绕镜头保持一致；基础版与蒸馏加速版权重以及 Hugging Face 在线演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Letting the next viewpoint decide what to keep from the past is a cheap way to hold a world together within a fixed token budget.
works.idea_zh: 让下一个视角决定从过去保留什么，是在固定 token 预算内维持世界一致性的低成本办法。
works.method: A memory encoder and a pose-conditioned readout module, trained jointly with the video generator, integrate historical observations into a fixed set of target-view-specific tokens (an implicit 3D-aware memory).
works.method_zh: 与视频生成器联合训练的记忆编码器和以位姿为条件的读出模块，把历史观测整合为一组固定数量、针对目标视角的 token（隐式的三维感知记忆）。

paper.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory

works.title_zh: WorldCrafter：隐式三维感知记忆的一致性视频世界模型

works.title: Mira-Scene
works.description: Open model from VAST and The University of Hong Kong that turns a single photo into an editable 3D scene: every object is generated as its own mesh and placed where it sits in the image, and an environment map is added. The inference code, both checkpoints and the fine-tuning data are public; the authors report 39.8% higher 3D-IoU layout accuracy than SAM 3D.
works.description_zh: VAST 与香港大学推出的开源模型：把一张照片变成可编辑的三维场景，每个物体都单独生成为网格并放到它在照片中的位置，再补上环境贴图。推理代码、两个阶段的权重和微调数据均已公开；作者报告其布局精度的 3D-IoU 比 SAM 3D 高 39.8%。
works.idea_en: A photo of a real room becomes a set of separate, movable objects in the right places, a starting point for restaging or simulating that room.
works.idea_zh: 一张真实房间的照片变成一组摆在正确位置、可以单独移动的物体，可据此重新布置或仿真这个房间。
works.method: A multimodal diffusion transformer generates each object's geometry together with a Canonical Coordinate Map that links every visible pixel to a point in the object's own bounded space; matched against a monocular point map, it gives each object's pose by robust geometric alignment, so training needs only object-level 3D data and no scene layout labels.
works.method_zh: 多模态扩散 Transformer 同时生成每个物体的几何和一张规范坐标图（Canonical Coordinate Map），把每个可见像素对应到物体自身有界空间中的一点；再与单目几何估计得到的点云图匹配，通过稳健的几何对齐求出每个物体的位姿，因此训练只需物体级三维数据，无需场景布局标注。

paper.title: Mira-Scene: Pixel-Aligned Layouts for Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction

works.title_zh: Mira-Scene 像素对齐布局的生成式三维场景重建

works.title: AVTR-1
works.description: AVTR-1 is an open stack for real-time avatar conversations: a small motion generator listens to both the user's and the voice agent's audio, and a renderer and serving backend turn it into a synchronized audio-video stream that handles interruptions. Weights, renderer and backend are released under component-specific licenses.
works.description_zh: AVTR-1 是一个开源的实时虚拟人对话方案：一个小型动作生成器同时听用户和语音智能体的声音，再由渲染器和服务后端把结果变成同步的音视频流，并能处理打断。模型权重、渲染器和后端均按各组件的许可证发布。
works.idea_en: An open, measurable reference for the plumbing of live avatars, including a test (R-DGG) of whether the listener's motion actually depends on the other speaker.
works.idea_zh: 为实时虚拟人的底层管线提供开放、可测量的参照，还给出一个检验倾听者动作是否真的依赖对方说话的指标（R-DGG）。
works.method: A 153M-parameter autoregressive flow-matching motion generator conditioned on both participants' audio, with a self-distilled streaming audio encoder and analytically bounded user-facing latency.
works.method_zh: 一个 1.53 亿参数的自回归流匹配动作生成器，以双方音频为条件，配合自蒸馏的流式音频编码器，并对用户可感知的延迟给出解析上界。
works.specs: 153M-param motion model · real time on data-center and consumer GPUs

paper.title: AVTR-1: Open Stack for Real-Time Interactive Avatars

works.title_zh: AVTR-1：实时交互虚拟人开源方案

works.title: Astronex-World 1.0
works.description: An open-weight (Apache 2.0) world-model foundation that predicts video from a prompt or a first frame under camera paths, continuous actions and an embodiment tag, and accepts text events inserted at chosen points of a rollout; its causal variant streams in real time on a single 48 GB GPU.
works.description_zh: 一个以 Apache 2.0 协议开源权重的世界模型基座：根据提示或首帧，在镜头轨迹、连续动作和具身标识的条件下预测视频，并接受在推演中指定位置插入的文字事件；其因果版本可在单张 48 GB GPU 上实时流式生成。
works.idea_en: A small open model with a single action interface for cameras, game controls and robots makes it easier to test the same scenario across embodiments.
works.idea_zh: 一个小型开源模型用同一个动作接口处理镜头、游戏操控与机器人，便于在不同具身形态下测试同一情境。
works.method: Built on the Wan2.2-TI2V-5B video prior, with PRoPE camera encoding, a 64-dimensional action stream that modulates every transformer layer, and a block-causal variant with cross-block KV caching; all five training stages ran on two NVIDIA L20 GPUs.
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 视频先验，用 PRoPE 编码相机参数，以 64 维动作流调制每一层 Transformer，并提供带跨块 KV 缓存的块因果版本；五个训练阶段均在两张 NVIDIA L20 上完成。
works.specs: 5B parameters · 832×480 · 24 fps on one L20 48 GB (developer-reported)

paper.title: Astronex-World 1.0: Real-Time Interactive World Model Foundation

works.title: DAO and JING
works.description: A generative world simulation from XGEN Labs in two parts: DAO, a world engine that keeps the state of characters, objects and places and advances it by rules, and JING, an open model that renders each observer's first-person video and sound from that state. A person can walk around, handle objects and talk with characters, and what they change stays changed.
works.description_zh: XGEN Labs 推出的生成式世界模拟，分为两部分：DAO 是一个世界引擎，记录角色、物体与空间的状态并按规则推进；JING 是一个开源模型，根据这一状态为每位观察者生成第一人称的画面与声音。人可以四处走动、操作物体、与角色交谈，改变过的东西会一直保持改变。
works.idea_en: Separates the world from the picture of it: consequences live in an explicit shared state that outlasts any one viewer, and the video model renders only what each observer can perceive.
works.idea_zh: 把世界本身与世界的画面分开：后果保存在一个明确的共享状态里，不会因某个观察者离开而消失；视频模型只渲染每位观察者能感知到的部分。
works.method: DAO keeps an entity graph with interaction rules and world time and derives observer-specific conditions for JING, which adapts MiniMax-H3's joint audio-video model through bidirectional camera-control training, causal autoregressive training with resampling forcing, memory adaptation and few-step distillation; the released JING-Flash-v1 is the four-step bidirectional variant, and the causal model is announced as coming soon.
works.method_zh: DAO 维护一张带有交互规则与世界时间的实体图，并为每位观察者生成条件交给 JING；JING 在 MiniMax-H3 音视频联合模型的基础上，依次经过双向镜头控制训练、带重采样强制（resampling forcing）的因果自回归训练、记忆适配与少步蒸馏。已发布的 JING-Flash-v1 是四步双向版本，因果版本官方称即将推出。
works.specs: JING-Flash-v1 · 4-step bidirectional · video + audio · demo on 6× H100 · WBench Full 81.0 (2026-09-12 submission)

paper.title: Generative World Simulation with DAO and JING

works.title_zh: DAO 道与 JING 镜

works.title: Gemini 3.8 Live
works.description: Two audio-to-audio models for the Live API, generally available since 15 September 2026: Gemini 3.8 Live for low-latency dialogue and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, which reasons in the background during the conversation. Google highlights asynchronous function calls and proactive audio, where the agent speaks only when relevant.
works.description_zh: 两款用于 Live API 的音频到音频模型，自 2026 年 9 月 15 日起正式可用：Gemini 3.8 Live 面向低延迟对话，Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking 能在对话进行中于后台推理。谷歌重点介绍了异步函数调用与主动音频，即智能体只在相关时才开口。
works.idea_en: Background reasoning during speech closes the gap between a fast voice and a smart one, useful for characters that must stay responsive while working through complex scenario logic.
works.idea_zh: 说话时在后台推理，缩小了“反应快”和“想得深”之间的差距，适合需要一边保持回应、一边处理复杂情境逻辑的角色。
works.method: Audio-to-audio Gemini models with interleaved reasoning and default asynchronous function calling, succeeding gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview (March 2026).
works.method_zh: 音频到音频的 Gemini 模型，支持交错推理与默认异步函数调用，接替 2026 年 3 月的 gemini-3.1-flash-live-preview。

works.title: Odyssey-3
works.description: Odyssey's third foundation world model, which the company says can both generate interactive worlds and, with small action decoders trained on hours of data, control robot arms, humanoids, cars, drones and video-game characters. On 2026-10-08 Odyssey opened a public research preview with Pro and Flash tiers and reported a Physics-IQ Verified score of 66.1 for Odyssey-3 Pro (developer claim).
works.description_zh: Odyssey 的第三代基础世界模型；公司称，它既能生成交互世界，也能借助用数小时数据训练的小型动作解码器，控制机械臂、人形机器人、汽车、无人机和游戏角色。2026 年 10 月 8 日，Odyssey 开放了公开研究预览（分 Pro 与 Flash 两档），并称 Odyssey-3 Pro 在 Physics-IQ Verified 上得分 66.1（开发者自述）。
works.idea_en: One world model as both simulator and controller, which would let the same model play the environment and the agents in it.
works.idea_zh: 同一个世界模型既是模拟器又是控制器，这意味着同一个模型可以同时扮演环境和其中的智能体。
works.method: An autoregressive diffusion transformer trained on a large collection of visual observations; task-specific action decoders translate its internal representations into control signals.
works.method_zh: 在大量视觉观察数据上训练的自回归扩散 Transformer；针对具体任务的动作解码器把其内部表征转换为控制信号。
works.specs: few to tens of hours of task data per embodiment · Physics-IQ Verified 66.1 for Pro (developer-reported)

works.title: Zing-0.5
works.description: An open-weight 5B world model from Seedleap.ai in which a player walks through a generated world with the keyboard and types text to change what happens next, without restarting generation; the developers report 832×480 at 24 fps for about US$0.009 of server rental per stream-minute.
works.description_zh: 涌跃智能（Seedleap.ai）推出的开源权重 5B 世界模型：玩家用键盘在生成的世界中行走，同时可以输入文字改变接下来发生的事，且无需重新开始生成；开发者称其以 832×480、24 fps 运行，每分钟流式画面的服务器租用成本约 0.009 美元。
works.idea_en: Keyboard and text control together let someone steer events mid-scene, and the reported cost makes long sessions cheap.
works.idea_zh: 键盘与文字同时控制，让人能在场景进行中改变事件走向；开发者报告的成本让长时间体验变得便宜。
works.method: Unified conditioning on magnitude-aware keyboard inputs and temporally aligned text instructions; a segment-level teacher trained on multi-prompt videos supervises a block-causal student through DMD; four-step generation with context-preserving streaming, served by an SGLang-based WebSocket server.
works.method_zh: 把带力度信息的键盘输入与时间对齐的文字指令统一作为条件；在多提示词连续视频上训练的片段级教师模型，通过 DMD 监督块因果学生模型；四步生成配合保留上下文的流式推理，并以基于 SGLang 的 WebSocket 服务部署。

paper.title: Zing-0.5: Toward Playable Worlds with Real-Time Joint Action and Text Control

works.title_zh: Zing-0.5：动作与文字实时联合控制的可玩世界

works.title: DiVA
works.description: DiVA (NTU, A*STAR and Ant Group, 2026-09-12) is a 'digital life simulator': a video character, a person or an animal created from one reference image, idles while it waits, answers each turn with speech, gestures and actions such as standing up, and then returns to a stable pose, so an interaction can run for many turns without the picture degrading.
works.description_zh: DiVA（南洋理工大学、A*STAR 与蚂蚁集团，2026-09-12）是一个“数字生命模拟器”：由一张参考图生成的视频角色（人或动物）在等待时保持细微的待机动作，每一轮用语音、手势以及站起来之类的动作回应，然后回到稳定的姿态，因此互动可以持续很多轮而画面不退化。
works.idea_en: Treats a generated character as a loop of waiting, acting and returning to anchor states rather than as one ever-longer clip, a practical pattern for long sessions with a video-generated person.
works.idea_zh: 把生成的角色看作“等待—行动—回到锚定状态”的循环，而不是一段越拉越长的视频，这是与视频生成人物进行长时间互动的一种实用模式。
works.method: A multimodal LLM (GPT-5 or Qwen, steered by in-context examples) routes each turn and writes the reply, CosyVoice speaks it, and a stacked pipeline generates waiting video, audio-driven action video, and transitions back to anchor states (pre-generated from the reference image by image editing) with an Anchored Video Continuation module fine-tuned with LoRA on Wan 2.1 14B FLF.
works.method_zh: 一个多模态大语言模型（GPT-5 或 Qwen，通过上下文示例引导）负责每一轮的路由并写出回复，由 CosyVoice 合成语音；一条分层的视频管线依次生成待机视频、音频驱动的动作视频，以及回到锚定状态的过渡，锚定状态事先由参考图经图像编辑生成，过渡由基于 Wan 2.1 14B FLF、用 LoRA 微调的 Anchored Video Continuation 模块完成。
works.specs: 4 sampling steps × about 4 s per step on one H800 (high-quality setting) · user study: 30 raters, 60 transitions

paper.title: DiVA: Enabling Interactive Digital Life Simulation via Video Models

works.title_zh: DiVA：基于视频模型的可交互数字生命模拟

works.title: Realtime-Venus
works.description: Realtime-Venus (Ant Group with Tsinghua University, 2026-09-12) is a pair of open 9B conversational models, one for speech and one for speech plus camera video, that keep listening while they talk: they carry on through a user's 'uh-huh', stop for a real interruption, react to sounds and sights such as a microwave beep, and hand longer jobs such as a flight search to a background agent while the conversation continues. It does not produce its own backchannels while listening, so it is classed as turn-based here; weights and an Android beta app are public.
works.description_zh: Realtime-Venus（蚂蚁集团与清华大学，2026-09-12）是两个开源的 9B 对话模型，一个处理语音，一个处理语音加摄像头视频。它们边说边听：用户说“嗯嗯”时继续讲，用户真正打断时停下，能对微波炉提示音之类的声音和画面作出反应，还能把查航班这类较长的任务交给后台智能体，同时对话照常进行。它在倾听时不会主动发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制；权重和 Android 测试版应用均已公开。
works.idea_en: Splits a voice agent into a fast conversational front end and a slower delegated back end, so a virtual interlocutor can stay responsive while it looks something up or reasons.
works.idea_zh: 把语音智能体拆成快速的对话前端和较慢的后台委托执行，让虚拟对话者在查资料或推理时仍能及时回应。
works.method: Both front ends adapt the open MiniCPM-o 4.5 (9B) to predict interaction-control tokens, response text and delegation requests on one causal timeline, post-trained on synthesised duplex, proactive and delegation scenarios; a separate Harness runs delegated tasks and returns prepared replies that the front end decides when to speak.
works.method_zh: 两个前端都基于开源的 MiniCPM-o 4.5（9B），在同一条因果时间线上预测交互控制 token、回复文本和委托请求，并用合成的双工、主动发言和任务委托场景做后训练；独立的 Harness 执行委托任务并准备好回复，由前端决定何时说出。
works.specs: 2 × 9B (Omni: audio + video; Audio) · Full-Duplex-Bench v1.5: 75% interruption response, 97% continuation under user backchannels (developer-reported)

paper.title: Realtime-Venus: A full-duplex interaction system with asynchronous delegation

works.title: StepAudio 3 Realtime
works.description: StepFun's 2026 voice-conversation model, built on a listen-converse-think-act loop: it keeps talking through a listener's 'right' or 'mm-hm', yields to real interruptions, reasons privately while it speaks and runs tools in the background. StepFun reports first place on Artificial Analysis's Full Duplex Bench (98.9 overall); it is offered through the StepFun Realtime API and Voice Studio.
works.description_zh: 阶跃星辰 2026 年的语音对话模型，围绕“听—说—想—做”的循环构建：听者说“对”“嗯”时它会继续讲，真正被打断时让出话轮，边说边在后台私下推理，并在后台调用工具。阶跃星辰报告其在 Artificial Analysis 的 Full Duplex Bench 上排名第一（总分 98.9）；通过阶跃 Realtime API 和 Voice Studio 提供。
works.idea_en: Floor management learned from both audio streams lets a voice character tell an acknowledgement from a correction, though the report does not show it backchanneling itself.
works.idea_zh: 从双方两路音频中学到的话轮管理，让语音角色能分辨对方是在附和还是在纠正；不过报告没有展示它自己发出附和。
works.method: Mixture-of-experts audio-language model (about 196B total, 11B active parameters) on a Step 3.7 Flash backbone with a Qwen3-Omni AuT audio encoder, user and model audio as two synchronized streams, and think-while-speaking. The report describes handling user backchannels but not producing them, so it is listed as turn-based.
works.method_zh: 混合专家音频语言模型（总参数约 1960 亿、激活 110 亿），以 Step 3.7 Flash 为主干，采用 Qwen3-Omni 的 AuT 音频编码器，用户与模型音频作为两路同步流，并支持边说边想。报告描述了如何处理用户的附和，但没有描述模型自己发出附和，因此按回合制归类。
works.specs: ~196B MoE (11B active) · AA Full Duplex Bench 98.9 (developer-reported)

paper.title: StepAudio 3 Realtime Technical Report

works.title_zh: 阶跃星辰 StepAudio 3 Realtime

works.title: Galápagos: The Last Eden
works.description: An XR-glasses natural-history experience narrated by Margot Robbie and shown at Venice Immersive 2026: viewers step into 16K 3D footage of the Galápagos and can ask questions of a Gemini-powered digital Charles Darwin.
works.description_zh: 一部为 XR 眼镜制作、由 Margot Robbie 旁白的自然历史体验，在 2026 年威尼斯沉浸单元展出：观众走进 16K 三维拍摄的加拉帕戈斯群岛，还可以向一位由 Gemini 驱动的数字达尔文提问。
works.idea_en: Puts a conversational historical figure inside a captured documentary world, so the guide answers the visitor's own questions rather than a fixed script.
works.idea_zh: 把一位能对话的历史人物放进实拍的纪录片世界，让向导回答观众自己的问题，而不是只念固定台词。
works.method: Stereoscopic 16K 3D capture presented spatially on Android XR glasses, with a Darwin character whose dialogue is generated by Gemini (per Google's 100 Zeros team, which co-produced).
works.method_zh: 以 16K 立体三维拍摄素材在 Android XR 眼镜上进行空间呈现，其中的达尔文角色对话由 Gemini 生成（据联合制作方 Google 100 Zeros 团队介绍）。
exhibited: Venice Immersive 2026 (83rd Venice International Film Festival)
works.title_zh: 加拉帕戈斯：最后的伊甸园

works.title: Nevatars
works.description: A 31-minute mixed-reality animated film for XR glasses, premiered at Venice Immersive 2026, in which discarded digital characters appear in the viewer's room and talk with them; Google describes it as filled with Gemini-powered conversations and interactive moments.
works.description_zh: 一部 31 分钟、为 XR 眼镜打造的混合现实动画电影，在 2026 年威尼斯沉浸单元首映：被遗弃的数字角色出现在观众的房间里并与之交谈；Google 称片中充满由 Gemini 驱动的对话与互动时刻。
works.idea_en: A star-led festival film that lets scripted characters answer the viewer in open conversation, a test of how much improvisation an authored story can absorb.
works.idea_zh: 一部由明星主导的电影节作品，让按剧本塑造的角色以开放对话回应观众，考验一个精心编排的故事能容纳多少即兴。
works.method: Authored animation and performance capture staged in passthrough mixed reality on Android XR, with conversational segments driven by Gemini and Vertex AI (per Google); produced by Imaginarium, Boona, Google 100 Zeros and 3Dar.
works.method_zh: 在 Android XR 的透视混合现实中呈现人工制作的动画与表演捕捉，对话段落由 Gemini 和 Vertex AI 驱动（据 Google 介绍）；由 Imaginarium、Boona、Google 100 Zeros 与 3Dar 联合制作。
exhibited: Venice Immersive 2026 (83rd Venice International Film Festival)

works.title: Roblox Build and AI creation tools
