works.description: At RDC 2026 (2026-09-11) Roblox described an 'AI creation layer' on its engine: Build, a tab in the Roblox app where anyone makes a game from prompts (about 9,000 games published in its New Zealand alpha, now expanding to Serbia and Singapore), and Scene Generator, due later in 2026, which turns a text prompt plus a reference image into a functional layout editable in Studio. These sit alongside Studio's Assistant and the open Cube 3D model.
works.description_zh: 在 RDC 2026（2026-09-11）上，Roblox 介绍了建在引擎之上的“AI 创作层”：Build 是 Roblox 应用里的一个标签页，任何人都能用提示词做游戏（新西兰内测期间已发布约 9,000 款，现扩展到塞尔维亚和新加坡）；Scene Generator 将于 2026 年晚些时候推出，可把文字提示加参考图变成可在 Studio 中继续编辑的功能性布局。它们与 Studio 的 Assistant 以及开源的 Cube 3D 模型并列。
works.idea_en: Prompt-to-game on a platform with 29 billion play-hours a quarter means generated situations reach players at scale, a recruitment and ecological-validity channel as much as a tool.
works.idea_zh: 在一个每季度 290 亿小时游玩时长的平台上用提示词做游戏，意味着生成的情境能大规模触达玩家：它既是工具，也是招募被试、提升生态效度的渠道。
works.method: LLM agents and generative 3D models (Cube) likely produce Luau scripts, assets and layouts inside Roblox's engine and cloud services; games publish instantly to Roblox's multiplayer infrastructure.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型智能体与生成式三维模型（Cube）很可能在 Roblox 引擎与云服务中生成 Luau 脚本、资源与布局；游戏可即时发布到 Roblox 的多人在线基础设施上。
works.specs: Build alpha: ~9,000 games by 2026-09-01; 71% of Build creators had never used Studio · Scene Generator: later 2026
works.title_zh: Roblox Build 与 AI 创作工具

works.title: StepAudio 3 Gen
works.description: A general audio model that produces a whole sound scene from one description: several characters with designed voices, emotions and dialects talking to each other, plus sound effects, ambience, background music and singing, placed in a specified order on one timeline. StepFun released it on 11 September 2026 as a free preview in its API (stepaudio-3-gen-preview), alongside StepAudio 3 TTS and Music.
works.description_zh: 一个通用音频模型，能根据一段描述生成完整的声音场景：多个角色以设计好的音色、情绪和方言彼此对话，再加上音效、环境声、背景音乐和演唱，并按指定顺序排在同一条时间线上。阶跃星辰于 2026 年 9 月 11 日以免费预览形式在 API 中发布（stepaudio-3-gen-preview），同时推出 StepAudio 3 TTS 与 Music。
works.idea_en: Moves from generating a voice line to generating an audio situation: who speaks, what happens around them and the music, specified together in words.
works.idea_zh: 从生成一句台词走向生成一个声音情境：谁在说话、周围发生了什么、配什么音乐，都用文字一并设定。
works.method: Discrete autoregressive generator over a shared 12.5 Hz RVQ code space (16 × 2048) for speech, sound and music: the backbone predicts the first codebook over time and a light causal Transformer completes the other fifteen, with interference-aware progressive pretraining to keep the LLM's text abilities.
works.method_zh: 在语音、音效与音乐共享的 12.5 Hz RVQ 码空间（16 × 2048）上做离散自回归生成：主干沿时间预测第一层码本，轻量因果 Transformer 补全其余十五层；采用考虑干扰的渐进式预训练，以保留大模型的文本能力。

paper.title: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report

works.title_zh: 阶跃星辰 StepAudio 3 Gen 全要素音频生成

works.title: Vidu S2
works.description: Vidu S2 is Shengshu's second real-time video system: S2-Avatar animates a character from a reference image as it listens and answers, now at 720p, with references that can be swapped mid-stream and actions such as dancing, while S2-Editing restyles a live camera feed or a video as it plays (outfit, character or background replacement). Shengshu also shows both streams converted into left- and right-eye views for VR headsets and passthrough; a playable demo is on vidu.com as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Vidu S2 是生数科技的第二代实时视频系统：S2-Avatar 根据一张参考图驱动角色边听边答，分辨率提升到 720p，参考图可在生成过程中随时更换，还能执行跳舞等动作；S2-Editing 则在视频播放或摄像头直播时实时改写画面，替换服装、人物或背景。生数还展示了把两种视频流实时转换为左右眼画面、用于 VR 头显和透视画面的效果；截至 2026 年 10 月，vidu.com 提供可试玩的在线演示。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation is no longer only a character that talks back: the same stream can rewrite what a camera or headset sees, so a video model can become a live layer over the participant's own surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 实时生成不再只是一个会回话的角色：同一条视频流还能改写摄像头或头显看到的画面，让视频模型成为覆盖在参与者真实环境之上的实时图层。
works.method: Causal autoregressive video diffusion in the Vidu S1 line (built with TurboDiffusion and TurboServe), with history caches kept at different noise levels for the backbone and a one-step super-resolution Refiner that lifts the 540p backbone to 720p; S2-Editing conditions each output chunk on the incoming source frames, and stereo views are produced inside the streaming pipeline.
works.method_zh: 延续 Vidu S1 的因果自回归视频扩散路线（基于 TurboDiffusion 与 TurboServe），主干与精修模块分别使用不同噪声水平的历史缓存，再用一步超分 Refiner 把 540p 主干输出提升到 720p；S2-Editing 让每个输出片段以输入的源视频帧为条件，立体视图则在流式管线内部生成。
works.specs: 720p · 25–42 fps real-time (Vidu S1: 540p) · live camera-stream editing · stereo output explored (developer-reported)

paper.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation

works.title: Hyper3D WorldGen
works.description: Hyper3D's scene generator turns a single photo into a 3D scene of independent, editable objects (generated as Rodin meshes with estimated collision geometry, mass and friction) set in a Gaussian-splat background, for robotics simulation, film, games and spatial computing.
works.description_zh: Hyper3D 的场景生成产品：把一张照片变成由独立、可编辑物体组成的三维场景——物体由 Rodin 生成网格，并估计碰撞几何、质量和摩擦——背景则用高斯泼溅呈现，面向机器人仿真、影视、游戏和空间计算。
works.idea_en: Objects arrive with physical properties, so a photographed room can become an interactive scene rather than a backdrop.
works.idea_zh: 物体自带物理属性，一张房间照片因此能变成可交互的场景，而不是一块背景板。
works.method: Building on CAST, objects are detected automatically or by user boxes, completed in 3D, placed via a contact, support and suspension relation graph with estimated pose, scale and physics, while the background is reconstructed as 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 在 CAST 的基础上，自动检测物体或由用户框选，补全三维形状，借助接触、支撑与悬挂的关系图估计位姿、尺度与物理属性并完成摆放，背景则重建为三维高斯泼溅。

works.title: Suno v6
works.description: Suno's 2026 generation of music models, developed with Warner Music Group, BMG and Believe; Suno describes them as faster and more expressive with more creative control, and pairs them with screening of uploaded audio and lyrics for unauthorized use. On 1 October 2026 Suno added Speech (beta), which generates a spoken voice and its background music as one track.
works.description_zh: Suno 2026 年的新一代音乐模型，与华纳音乐、BMG 和 Believe 合作开发；Suno 称其更快、更有表现力、可控性更强，同时对上传的音频和歌词进行未授权使用筛查。2026 年 10 月 1 日，Suno 又推出 Speech（测试版），把人声朗读与背景音乐作为一条音轨同时生成。
works.idea_en: Training with label partners, rather than on scraped catalogues, becomes part of a frontier music model's pitch, which matters when generated music appears in published studies or exhibited work.
works.idea_zh: 与唱片公司合作训练、而非抓取曲库，成了前沿音乐模型的卖点之一；当生成音乐出现在发表的研究或展出的作品中时，这一点很重要。
works.method: Music generation models (architecture unpublished) developed with record labels and publishers, with upload screening against unauthorized material.
works.method_zh: 与唱片公司和版权方合作开发的音乐生成模型（架构未公开），并对上传内容做未授权素材筛查。

works.title: Gander (Multimodal Duplex Interaction Agent)
works.description: Gander (Tencent Hunyuan Speech Team with Zhejiang University and Shanghai Jiao Tong University, 2026-09-08) is an open audio-video conversational agent that keeps listening while it speaks: it continues through a user's brief acknowledgement, stops for an explicit request, speaks up when something relevant appears on screen, and runs coding or tool tasks in the background while the conversation goes on. Weights, code and training data are released; it does not produce its own backchannels while listening, so it is classed as turn-based here.
works.description_zh: Gander（腾讯混元语音团队与浙江大学、上海交通大学，2026-09-08）是一个开源的音视频对话智能体，边说边听：用户简短附和时继续讲，用户明确要求停下时暂停，画面中出现相关内容时主动提醒，还能在对话进行的同时在后台完成编程或工具任务。模型权重、代码和训练数据均已发布；它在倾听时不会主动发出回应信号，因此这里归为回合制。
works.idea_en: Like Realtime-Venus, a fast 'cerebellum' handles conversational timing while a slower 'brain' does the work, a pattern that lets a virtual human stay socially responsive during a long task.
works.idea_zh: 与 Realtime-Venus 类似，快速的“小脑”负责对话节奏，较慢的“大脑”负责干活；这种模式让虚拟人在执行长任务时仍能保持社交上的及时回应。
works.method: A streaming Thinker–Talker 'Cerebellum' built on MiniCPM-o 4.5 flattens user inputs and model outputs into one chunk-level token stream (1-second chunks, 128-chunk context) and calls a 'Brain' agent through tool calls; trained on about 2.7 million samples covering speech, audio-video, agent and interference scenarios.
works.method_zh: 基于 MiniCPM-o 4.5 的流式 Thinker–Talker“小脑”把用户输入和模型输出按块展平为一条 token 流（每块 1 秒，上下文 128 块），通过工具调用与“大脑”智能体协作；训练语料约 270 万条，涵盖语音、音视频、智能体和抗干扰场景。
works.specs: 1 s streaming chunks · 128-chunk context · ~2.7M training samples · MiniCPM-o 4.5 base

paper.title: Multimodal Duplex Interaction Agent

works.title_zh: Gander：多模态双工交互智能体

works.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals
works.description: In OceanSpeak, participants scuba-dive in VR and talk with an AI-powered harbor seal about ocean acidification and overfishing. A preregistered study (N=106) used a yoked control: control participants saw identical content, including another participant's AI conversation, but could not talk themselves.
works.description_zh: 在 OceanSpeak 中，参与者在 VR 里潜水，并与一只 AI 驱动的港海豹谈论海洋酸化与过度捕捞。一项预注册研究（N=106）采用“配对对照”设计：对照组看到完全相同的内容，包括另一位参与者与 AI 的对话，但自己不能开口。
works.idea_en: Yoked controls address the core problem of studying generative conversation: each control sees exactly what a treated participant got, which isolates the effect of interacting.
works.idea_zh: 配对对照解决了研究生成式对话的核心难题：每个对照者看到的正是某位实验组参与者得到的内容，从而分离出“互动”本身的效应。
works.method: Preregistered between-subjects experiment with Stanford's Virtual Human Interaction Lab using yoked replay of AI conversations; outcomes were ocean connectedness, empathy with seals, pro-ocean behaviors and knowledge.
works.method_zh: 与斯坦福虚拟人交互实验室合作的预注册被试间实验，以配对回放 AI 对话作为对照；结局指标包括海洋联结感、对海豹的共情、护海行为与知识。

paper.title: VR scuba diving with harbor seals increases ocean connectedness, and the effect of conversational AI on pro-environmental engagement depends on prior experience with seals

works.title_zh: 与港海豹一起 VR 潜水可增强海洋联结感，而对话式 AI 对护海参与的影响取决于此前与海豹的接触经历

works.title: Tripo P2.0
works.description: Tripo's character model that generates animation-ready characters with clean quad topology from an image or a prompt; it appeared as a preview on 6 September 2026 and was released officially on 1 October 2026. Tripo's rebuilt auto-rigging (October 2026) adds hand bones, five engine skeleton presets and 1–10-second text-to-motion clips that can be chained in up to five segments.
works.description_zh: Tripo 的角色模型，可由图像或提示词生成带干净四边形拓扑、可直接做动画的角色；2026 年 9 月 6 日发布预览，10 月 1 日正式上线。2026 年 10 月 Tripo 重做了自动绑定：加入手部骨骼和五种引擎骨骼预设，并可由文字生成 1–10 秒的动作片段，最多串联五段。
works.idea_en: Quad topology with sensible edge flow is what lets a generated character deform properly when it moves; P2.0 targets the gap between a statue and an actor.
works.idea_zh: 布线合理的四边形拓扑，是生成角色在运动时能正确变形的前提；P2.0 针对的正是“雕像”与“演员”之间的差距。
works.method: Proprietary; VAST has not published the architecture.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；VAST 尚未公开其架构。

works.title: Video DeltaNet (VDN-H3)
works.description: Video DeltaNet (UC Berkeley with Impossible, Inc., 2026-09-06) is an open hybrid-attention version of the MiniMax H3 audio-video model (VDN-H3) that returns a 14.4-second 768p clip with sound in about 9 seconds on eight B200 GPUs, faster than it plays back, with near-lossless quality according to the authors. Weights, training and inference code are open, and the community FreeVideo project built on it runs H3 on GPUs with 8 GB of memory.
works.description_zh: Video DeltaNet（加州大学伯克利分校与 Impossible, Inc.，2026-09-06）是 MiniMax H3 音视频模型的开源混合注意力版本（VDN-H3）：在 8 张 B200 上约 9 秒就能生成一段 14.4 秒、768p 的有声视频，比播放还快，作者称画质几乎无损。权重、训练与推理代码均已开源，社区项目 FreeVideo 在此基础上让 H3 可在 8 GB 显存的显卡上运行。
works.idea_en: Once an open audio-video model renders faster than real time, scenario clips can be generated on demand between trials instead of in advance.
works.idea_zh: 当一个开源音视频模型的渲染速度超过实时，情境片段就可以在两次试验之间按需生成，而不必提前准备。
works.method: Replaces part of the video-to-video attention with Video Delta Attention, a frame-wise bidirectional linear memory, alongside local softmax attention (kept for text and audio interactions), introduced by staged teacher alignment, distilled to eight steps and served with SGLang Diffusion.
works.method_zh: 把部分视频到视频的注意力替换为 Video Delta Attention（逐帧更新的双向线性记忆），并保留局部 softmax 注意力（涉及文本和音频的交互仍用 softmax）；通过分阶段的教师对齐引入新分支，再蒸馏到 8 步，用 SGLang Diffusion 部署。
works.specs: 14.4 s · 768p with audio · ~9.0 s end-to-end on 8×B200 (6.9 s denoising) · 8 steps · 14.5× over 50-step dense H3 (developer-reported)

paper.title: Video DeltaNet: A Video-Native Hybrid Attention for Livestream Video Generation

works.title_zh: Video DeltaNet：面向直播式视频生成的混合注意力（VDN-H3）

works.title: Beyond the Lab: Large-Scale Remote Cybersickness Research in Virtual Reality Using the VERA Platform
works.description: The NSF-funded Virtual Experience Research Accelerator (VERA) recruited 263 participants through Prolific to run a standard cybersickness testbed on their own Meta Quest headsets. Results matched a published in-lab study (N=30) in direction and time course, and the larger sample confirmed effects of sex, susceptibility and expectation.
works.description_zh: 由美国国家科学基金会资助的“虚拟体验研究加速器”（VERA）通过 Prolific 招募 263 名参与者，让他们在自己的 Meta Quest 头显上运行标准的晕动症测试平台。结果在方向与时间进程上与已发表的实验室研究（N=30）一致，更大的样本还证实了性别、易感性与预期的影响。
works.idea_en: Remote, unsupervised VR studies can reproduce lab findings at nine times the sample, but the sample is experienced headset owners, not the general public.
works.idea_zh: 无人监督的远程 VR 研究能以九倍样本复现实验室结果，但样本是有经验的头显用户，而非普通公众。
works.method: Remote adaptation of the Cybersicker testbed deployed via VERA, compared with an in-lab dataset and a demographically matched remote subset on SSQ, FMS and symptom-onset trajectories; regression on demographic and individual-difference predictors.
works.method_zh: 通过 VERA 部署 Cybersicker 测试平台的远程版本，在 SSQ、FMS 与症状出现轨迹上，与实验室数据及人口学匹配的远程子样本比较；并对人口学与个体差异因素做回归分析。
works.specs: remote N=263 vs in-lab N=30 · consumer Meta Quest headsets

paper.venue: arXiv preprint (2026; under review at IEEE TVCG)
paper.title: Beyond the Lab: Large-Scale Remote Cybersickness Research in Virtual Reality Using the VERA Platform

works.title_zh: 走出实验室：基于 VERA 平台的大规模远程 VR 晕动症研究

works.title: UniMate
works.description: Princeton model that animates any rigged 3D asset from a text prompt, whether a human, a cat, a snake or an eagle, without per-skeleton training or reference motion; it also supports motion editing and in-betweening, with code, models and a dataset released.
works.description_zh: 普林斯顿大学的模型：输入任意已绑定骨骼的三维资产和一段文字提示，就能为其生成动画，无论是人、猫、蛇还是鹰，无需针对每种骨骼单独训练或提供参考动作；还支持动作编辑和中间帧补全，代码、模型和数据集均已公开。
works.idea_en: Text-to-motion stops being human-only: any creature or object an author rigs can be told what to do.
works.idea_zh: 文生动作不再只适用于人：创作者绑定好的任何生物或物体，都可以用文字告诉它做什么。
works.method: A topology-aware diffusion transformer that builds the skeleton graph into attention through a graph-aware bias from pairwise joint relations and related mechanisms, trained on a multi-skeleton motion dataset.
works.method_zh: 拓扑感知的扩散 Transformer，通过基于关节两两关系的图感知注意力偏置等机制把骨骼图结构融入注意力，在多骨骼动作数据集上训练。

paper.title: UniMate: One Unified Model to Animate Diverse Skeletons

works.title_zh: UniMate：为任意骨骼生成动画的统一模型

works.title: WorldSculpt
works.description: WorldSculpt turns a video of a cluttered room, given instance masks and 3D boxes, into hundreds of separate, complete object meshes in one shared frame; the authors also run it on Marble-generated splat worlds to break them into editable objects. Code, model and a benchmark are open.
works.description_zh: WorldSculpt 把一段杂乱房间的视频（附实例掩码与三维包围盒）变成同一坐标系下数百个独立、完整的物体网格；作者还把它用于 Marble 生成的泼溅世界，将其拆成可编辑的物体。代码、模型与基准均已开源。
works.idea_en: Splitting a world into individual objects is what makes it editable item by item: move the chair, remove the bag, keep everything else identical across conditions.
works.idea_zh: 把世界拆成一个个物体，才能逐件编辑：挪动椅子、拿走包，其余一切在不同实验条件间保持不变。
works.method: Pixal3D, a single-object 3D generative prior, is extended with a multi-view conditioning pathway so that each object is completed from occluded views and placed by its 3D box in a shared world frame.
works.method_zh: 在单物体三维生成先验 Pixal3D 上加入多视角条件通路，使每个物体都能从被遮挡的多个视角补全，并按其三维包围盒放置到共享的世界坐标系中。
works.specs: hundreds of objects per scene · per-object meshes

paper.title: WorldSculpt: Generating Compositional Worlds from Grounded Videos

works.title_zh: WorldSculpt：由视频生成可组合的世界

works.title: GWM Worlds 2
works.description: A research preview of a playable world model that streams video and sound together; one person can play a character while another 'directs' the scene with text actions addressed to any subject, such as a sword slash, a spoken reply or a room flooding.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩世界模型的研究预览，同时流式生成画面与声音；一个人扮演角色，另一个人可以用发给任何对象的文字动作“导演”场景，比如挥剑、说一句话，或让房间进水。
works.idea_en: Separates what persists (scene, subjects, rules) from what happens (timestamped events), which is close to how an experimenter would script a situation.
works.idea_zh: 把“持续存在的东西”（场景、角色、规则）与“发生的事”（带时间戳的事件）分开，这与实验者编排情境的方式非常接近。
works.method: Built on Runway's audio-video model and driven by 'WorldPrompt': a genesis prompt with scene, subjects and laws, a first frame, a timestamped stream of free-text actions, and per-frame camera input.
works.method_zh: 基于 Runway 的音视频生成模型，由“WorldPrompt”驱动：包含场景、角色与规则的创世提示、首帧、带时间戳的自由文本动作流，以及逐帧镜头输入。
works.specs: 720p · 24 fps · 48 kHz audio · no preset session length (developer-reported)

works.title: HelixWorld
works.description: A real-time world model from Noiz AI and HKUST that generates video together with camera-grounded stereo sound: the sound field turns with the viewpoint, and sounds stop and start with the actions that cause them; a browser preview turns an uploaded photo into a world you can enter with sound, and the code is released under Apache 2.0.
works.description_zh: Noiz AI 与香港科技大学推出的实时世界模型，同时生成视频与随镜头变化的立体声：声场随视角转动，声音随引发它的动作起止；网页预览版可以把上传的照片变成带声音的可进入世界，代码以 Apache 2.0 协议开源。
works.idea_en: Spatial sound that follows head and camera movement is what headset experiences need; this is one of the first world models to generate it rather than dub it afterwards.
works.idea_zh: 随头部与镜头移动而变化的空间声音正是头显体验所需要的；它是最早直接生成、而不是事后配音的世界模型之一。
works.method: A bidirectional audio-visual teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera paths and user actions, trained on a curated stereo dataset with metric camera poses, then distilled into a causal low-latency student.
works.method_zh: 以 6 自由度镜头轨迹和用户动作为条件的双向音视频教师模型，在带有度量级相机位姿的立体声数据集上训练，再蒸馏为因果、低延迟的学生模型。
works.specs: 768×512 · 24 fps · real-time factor 0.77 on one H800 (developer-reported)

paper.title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model

works.title: SolarWM
works.description: A fully open stack for building long-horizon interactive world models: 1.43 million camera-annotated clips (25 TB) from ten datasets, one training recipe, and four released models of 5B to 33B parameters built on Wan2.2, LTX-2.5 and MiniMax-H3; the authors report minute- to hour-scale real-time rollouts from models trained on five-second clips.
works.description_zh: 一套完全开放、用于构建长时交互世界模型的技术栈：来自十个数据集、带相机标注的 143 万段视频（25 TB），一套统一的训练方法，以及基于 Wan2.2、LTX-2.5 与 MiniMax-H3 的四个 5B 至 33B 参数模型；作者称这些只用五秒片段训练的模型可以实时推演数分钟乃至数小时。
works.idea_en: An open, documented data and training pipeline makes world models something a lab can rebuild and compare, not only download.
works.idea_zh: 开放且有完整文档的数据与训练流程，让世界模型成为实验室可以复现、可以比较的东西，而不只是下载来用。
works.method: A reconfigurable multi-source data engine converts clips into one frame-aligned format (observations, metric camera geometry, captions, quality and provenance metadata); a backbone-native adaptation framework applies a three-stage recipe (bidirectional adaptation, teacher-forced autoregressive initialization, distribution matching distillation) to each video backbone.
works.method_zh: 可重新配置的多源数据引擎把视频片段转换为统一的逐帧对齐格式（画面、真实尺度的相机几何、文字描述、质量与来源元数据）；“保留骨干原生结构”的适配框架对每个视频骨干模型执行三阶段训练：双向适配、教师强制的自回归初始化，以及分布匹配蒸馏。

paper.title: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models

works.title_zh: SolarWM：长时视频世界模型的开放数据与可扩展训练

works.title: Atlas
works.description: World Labs' 'omni' world model, pretrained from scratch on text, images, video and 3D: from one to a few reference images and a hand-designed camera path it generates up to one minute of 1440p video, reconstructs real places from one to over a hundred photos, and outputs point clouds or Gaussian splats. Early access only as of October 2026; World Labs says it will power future versions of Marble.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的“全模态”世界模型，从零开始在文本、图像、视频和三维数据上预训练：给定一到几张参考图和手工设计的镜头路径，可生成最长一分钟的 1440p 视频；能用一张到一百多张照片重建真实地点，并输出点云或高斯泼溅。截至 2026 年 10 月仅开放抢先体验；World Labs 表示它将驱动未来版本的 Marble。
works.idea_en: One model now spans imagined and real places: the more photos of a site you give it, the less it invents, which makes 'grounded versus imagined' a dial a study can set.
works.idea_zh: 同一个模型既能想象也能重建：给它的现场照片越多，它编造的就越少，“真实与想象”的比例变成研究可以设定的一个旋钮。
works.method: A multimodal autoregressive diffusion transformer encodes every input image at a 3D position in a shared spatial context and generates new frames and depth maps conditioned on it with pixel-exact camera geometry; depth is fused into point clouds and completed into 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 多模态自回归扩散 Transformer 把每张输入图像放在共享空间上下文中的三维位置上，再以像素级精确的相机几何为条件生成新画面与深度图；深度被融合成点云，并补全为三维高斯泼溅。
works.specs: up to 60 s video at 1440p · 1–6 reference images for generation · reconstruction from 1 to 100+ images · point cloud / 3DGS output

works.title: Kirin
works.description: Framework from UIUC, Penn, Stanford and Cambridge that learns quadruped motion from internet videos and turns one image plus a text prompt into a rigged, animated 3D animal; it comes with AiM3D, which the authors describe as the first large dataset of aligned video, text and 3D motion for quadrupeds (downloadable as of October 2026, code still to come).
works.description_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校、宾夕法尼亚大学、斯坦福大学与剑桥大学合作的框架：从网络视频中学习四足动物的动作，再根据一张图像和一句文字生成带骨骼、会动的三维动物；同时发布 AiM3D，作者称这是首个对齐视频、文字与三维动作的大规模四足动物数据集（截至 2026 年 10 月数据集已可下载，代码尚未发布）。
works.idea_en: Dogs, horses and other animals can be written into a scene by description, a gap that human-motion models left open.
works.idea_zh: 狗、马等动物也能靠描述写进场景里，补上了人体动作模型留下的空白。
works.method: 3D motion is reconstructed from in-the-wild animal videos and captioned to build AiM3D; a visual-guided generator conditioned on text and an image produces motion, which is applied to a mesh from an off-the-shelf image-to-3D model after automatic rigging.
works.method_zh: 从真实动物视频中重建三维动作并配上文字说明，构成 AiM3D；以文字和图像为条件的视觉引导生成模型产生动作，再借现成的图生三维模型得到网格，自动绑定骨骼后施加动作。

paper.title: Kirin: Animal Motion Generation from In-the-Wild Video

works.title_zh: Kirin 从网络视频学习动物动作生成

works.title: Hey AI: Can you trigger me? A comparison of Text-to-Speech synthesis and human speech in a virtual social stress paradigm
works.description: A virtual version of the Trier Social Stress Test in which the evaluating committee spoke either with text-to-speech or with prerecorded human voices. Both versions produced strong stress responses; heart-rate increases were statistically equivalent between voice conditions, while equivalence for self-reported stress and presence was only moderately supported.
works.description_zh: 虚拟版特里尔社会应激测试（TSST）中，评审委员会分别使用文本转语音或预先录制的真人语音。两种条件都引发了明显的应激反应；两种语音条件下的心率上升在统计上等效，而自评应激与临场感的等效性只得到中等程度的支持。
works.idea_en: Synthetic voices can carry social-evaluative threat, which frees virtual evaluators to say new things instead of replaying recordings.
works.idea_zh: 合成语音同样能传递社会评价威胁，这让虚拟评审可以说出新内容，而不必只回放录音。
works.method: Randomized controlled trial comparing TTS with prerecorded human speech for the virtual committee in a VR-TSST; heart rate, trapezius EMG and self-reported stress, presence and affect, analysed with equivalence tests.
works.method_zh: 随机对照试验，在 VR-TSST 中比较虚拟委员会使用文本转语音与预录真人语音；测量心率、斜方肌肌电以及自评应激、临场感与情绪，并做等效性检验。
works.specs: RCT · VR-TSST · TTS vs. prerecorded human speech

paper.venue: Computers in Human Behavior: Artificial Humans (2026)
paper.title: Hey AI: Can you trigger me? A comparison of Text-to-Speech synthesis and human speech in a virtual social stress paradigm

works.title_zh: “嘿，AI，你能让我紧张吗？”虚拟社会应激范式中文本转语音与真人语音的比较

works.title: Motion-Omni
works.description: Motion-Omni is a spoken dialogue model that answers a spoken question with speech and, from the same hidden states, explicit facial expression and hand, upper-body and lower-body motion, so a 3D character's gestures are produced together with what it says instead of by a second model run on the finished audio. The model code, training recipe and data are open; weights were still being prepared as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Motion-Omni 是一个语音对话模型：对口头提问，它在用语音作答的同时，从同一组隐藏状态直接生成面部表情以及手部、上半身和下半身动作，因此三维角色的手势与说话内容一同产生，而不是在语音生成完后再由另一个模型补上。模型代码、训练方案和数据已开源；截至 2026 年 10 月，权重仍在准备中。
works.idea_en: When body language comes from the model that chooses the words, gesture can carry meaning a cascade cannot know about, such as emphasis on the word it decided to stress.
works.idea_zh: 当肢体语言出自选择措辞的同一个模型，手势就能表达级联系统无从得知的信息，例如对它自己决定强调的词加以强调。
works.method: An LLM-based spoken dialogue model with a speech generator and a motion generator reading the same hidden states, trained jointly on speech and motion objectives; the authors show that freezing the speech pathway leaves motion misaligned.
works.method_zh: 一个基于大语言模型的语音对话模型，语音生成器和动作生成器读取同一组隐藏状态，在语音与动作两个目标上联合训练；作者发现若冻结语音通路，动作就会与语音错位。

paper.title: Motion-Omni: End-to-End Joint Speech and Full-Body Motion for Spoken Dialogue

works.title_zh: Motion-Omni：端到端联合生成语音与全身动作的语音对话模型

works.title: Ring Forcing
works.description: Ring Forcing (Stanford University with ByteDance, ECCV 2026) targets object permanence in autoregressive long video: when a book, a vehicle or a painting leaves the frame and comes back up to a minute later, it should look the same. The authors report minutes-long coherence and more faithful re-appearance than earlier long-video methods.
works.description_zh: Ring Forcing（斯坦福大学与字节跳动，ECCV 2026）针对自回归长视频中的物体恒存性：一本书、一辆车或一幅画离开画面，最长一分钟后再回到画面时，应当保持原样。作者报告，它能维持数分钟的连贯性，物体重新出现时也比以往的长视频方法更忠实。
works.idea_en: Memory, not resolution, limits scenario video that lasts minutes: a generated room has to give back the object it showed earlier, which is what experimental control over a long clip requires.
works.idea_zh: 限制数分钟情境视频的是记忆而不是分辨率：生成的房间必须把先前出现过的物体原样还回来，长片段的实验控制正需要这一点。
works.method: Ring-structured training clips that play forward and back force the model to retrieve content from distant history; compressed history and timestep composition stretch the effective context to minutes under a fixed sequence length, and a sparse RoPE adapts pretrained video priors to the long memory.
works.method_zh: 用正放再倒放的环形训练片段，迫使模型从久远的历史中检索内容；通过历史压缩和时间步组合，在固定序列长度下把有效上下文延伸到数分钟；稀疏 RoPE 让预训练视频先验适配长记忆。
works.specs: re-appearance after gaps of 15–60 s · minutes-long effective history (developer-reported)

paper.title: Ring Forcing: Towards Precise Long-Term Memory for Autoregressive Video Diffusion

works.title_zh: Ring Forcing：自回归视频扩散的精确长时记忆

works.title: Sparrow-2
works.description: Sparrow-2 is Tavus' turn-taking model: it decides every 10 ms whether a voice or video agent should listen, wait or speak, distinguishing a thinking pause from the end of a turn and real interruptions from background noise. Tavus reports it leads the TurnBench benchmark in end-of-turn (92.4% recall) and interruption detection (97.4% recall).
works.description_zh: Sparrow-2 是 Tavus 的轮流发言模型：它每 10 ms 判断一次语音或视频智能体应该听、等还是说，能区分思考中的停顿与话轮结束，也能区分真正的打断与背景噪声。Tavus 称它在 TurnBench 基准上的话轮结束检测（召回率 92.4%）和打断检测（召回率 97.4%）均排名第一。
works.idea_en: Conversational timing is now a measurable model output with its own benchmark, which makes response latency something an experiment can set.
works.idea_zh: 对话时机如今是有专门基准的可测量模型输出，这让回应延迟成为实验可以设定的变量。
works.method: A streaming acoustic-semantic model over the whole audio scene (speaker intent, prosody, environment) that replaces silence timers and VAD endpointing; successor to Sparrow-0 (2025) and Sparrow-1 (January 2026).
works.method_zh: 一个基于整体音频场景（说话意图、韵律、环境）的流式声学-语义模型，取代静音计时与 VAD 端点检测；前代为 Sparrow-0（2025）和 Sparrow-1（2026 年 1 月）。
works.specs: 10 ms decision frame · TurnBench end-of-turn recall 92.4% · interruption recall 97.4%
works.title_zh: Sparrow-2 轮流发言模型

works.title: 4DStreamCtrl
works.description: 4DStreamCtrl (Peking University with Tencent Hunyuan, 2026-08-26) generates video in a stream while the user steers the camera and individual objects through 3D point tracks, so a ball can be rolled, a can pushed or a person moved with a brush stroke while the clip plays. The authors report 20 fps at 480p on one high-end GPU, coherence over hundreds of frames, and describe it as the first interactive 4D-controllable streaming generator.
works.description_zh: 4DStreamCtrl（北京大学与腾讯混元，2026-08-26）在流式生成视频的同时，让用户通过三维点轨迹操控镜头和单个物体：在视频播放中用笔刷就能让球滚动、推动罐子或移动人物。作者报告，它在单张高端显卡上以 480p、20 fps 运行，数百帧内保持连贯，并称其为首个可交互 4D 控制的流式生成器。
works.idea_en: Unifies camera, object motion and depth into one 3D control signal that can be changed mid-stream, the kind of closed-loop control an experimenter needs to script events inside generated video.
works.idea_zh: 把镜头、物体运动和深度统一为一种可在生成中途修改的三维控制信号，这正是实验者在生成视频里编排事件所需的闭环控制。
works.method: Camera motion, object trajectories and depth are encoded as 3D point tracks by a lightweight Geometric Motion Head plugged into a pretrained video diffusion model, trained on OpenVidHD-Motion3D tracks mined from in-the-wild video, then distilled into a causal four-step streaming student whose memory does not grow with length.
works.method_zh: 镜头运动、物体轨迹和深度被统一编码为三维点轨迹，由一个轻量的 Geometric Motion Head 接入预训练视频扩散模型；训练数据是从真实视频中挖掘的 OpenVidHD-Motion3D 轨迹；之后蒸馏成一个四步因果流式学生模型，显存占用不随视频长度增长。
works.specs: 480p · 20 fps on one high-end GPU · 4 denoising steps · hundreds of frames (developer-reported)

paper.title: 4DStreamCtrl: Interactive Video Generation with Online 4D Control

works.title_zh: 4DStreamCtrl：在线 4D 控制的交互式视频生成

works.title: TurnBench
works.description: A turn-taking benchmark led by Sesame with academic co-authors: 30 hours of studio-recorded two-person conversations across six conversation types, triple-annotated for end-of-turn and interruption events, with a public leaderboard that scores recall, false-positive rate and latency. Its leaderboard ranks dedicated turn detectors alongside Tavus Sparrow-2, Gemini 3.1 Live, OpenAI Realtime and Moshi.
works.description_zh: 由 Sesame 牵头、联合多位学界作者推出的轮流发言基准：30 小时录音棚录制的双人对话，覆盖六种对话类型，每段由三人独立标注“说完一轮”与“打断”事件，并设公开排行榜，按召回率、误报率与延迟打分。排行榜把专门的话轮检测器与 Tavus Sparrow-2、Gemini 3.1 Live、OpenAI Realtime 和 Moshi 放在一起比较。
works.idea_en: People start replying a median 151 ms before the other person finishes; no system on the board matches that without interrupting too often, which bounds how natural a generated conversation partner can feel.
works.idea_zh: 人在对方说完前约 151 毫秒（中位数）就开始接话；榜上没有一个系统能做到这一点而不频繁抢话，这限定了生成的对话伙伴能有多自然。
works.method: Dual-channel dyadic recordings (154 dialogues, 106 actors, Fleiss' κ = 0.78) with held-out test labels; systems output event times, scored against a false-positive budget of 0.15; a 104-hour training set uses the same protocol; paper at IEEE SLT 2026.
works.method_zh: 双声道双人对话录音（154 段对话、106 名演员，Fleiss κ = 0.78），测试集标签不公开；系统输出事件时间点，在误报率不超过 0.15 的约束下评分；另附按同一规范标注的 104 小时训练集；论文发表于 IEEE SLT 2026。
works.specs: 30 h test corpus · 6 conversation types · 104 h training set · metrics: recall, FPR, p50 latency · 14 systems in paper

paper.title: TurnBench: A Multi-Domain Benchmark for Turn-Taking Dynamics in Spoken Dialogue

works.title: EchoWM
works.description: JD's open omnimodal world model, part of JoyAI-Echo 1.5: as a user moves through a scene in first or third person, it generates 720p video together with environmental sound, music and speech that stay synchronized over long sessions.
works.description_zh: 京东开源的全模态世界模型，属于 JoyAI-Echo 1.5 的一部分：用户以第一或第三人称在场景中移动时，它同时生成 720p 视频以及环境音、音乐与语音，并在长时会话中保持同步。
works.idea_en: Sound is generated with the picture inside the world model, so an entered scene can sound right from the start instead of having audio added afterwards.
works.idea_zh: 声音与画面在世界模型内部一起生成，进入的场景从一开始就有合适的声音，而不是事后再配音。
works.method: Discrete commands and continuous poses map to one metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory; third-person camera-character dynamics are learned from data; a dedicated data engine, progressive joint audio-visual training and autoregressive post-training extend generation to long horizons.
works.method_zh: 把离散指令与连续位姿统一映射为真实尺度的相对六自由度轨迹；第三人称下相机与角色的运动关系直接从数据中学习；借助专门的数据引擎、渐进式音视频联合训练与自回归后训练，把生成延伸到长时程。

paper.title: EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models

works.title_zh: EchoWM：可进入的开源全模态世界模型

works.title: ReWorld
works.description: An interactive world model driven by keyboard and mouse that streams 704×1280 video in real time and keeps places consistent when the player leaves and returns, using a bounded memory of pose-indexed landmarks; from HKUST (Guangzhou) with Alibaba's ATH group, with 5B checkpoints released in September 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个由键盘和鼠标驱动的交互世界模型：实时流式输出 704×1280 视频，玩家离开后再回来时场景依然一致，靠的是一个按相机位姿索引“地标”、容量有上限的记忆；由香港科技大学（广州）与阿里巴巴 ATH 事业群合作，2026 年 9 月公开了 5B 模型权重。
works.idea_en: Real-time control and long memory can share one model if memory is budgeted: the world remembers a place without the cost growing as you roam.
works.idea_zh: 只要给记忆设定预算，实时控制与长时记忆就能共存于一个模型：世界记得去过的地方，而开销不会随着漫游距离增长。
works.method: Mixed per-head attention windows (most heads local, a few global over the whole history) with random head routing and chunk dropping in training; at inference a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank; a metric-scale data engine puts eight sources on one action scale, and DMD distillation in a LoRA adapter gives a four-step real-time mode.
works.method_zh: 训练时为注意力头设置不同窗口（多数头只看近处，少数全局头看完整历史），并随机路由注意力头、随机丢弃片段；推理时使用有上限的 KV 缓存，配合按位姿索引的地标库；按真实尺度对齐的数据引擎把八类数据源统一到同一动作尺度；在 LoRA 适配器中做 DMD 蒸馏，得到四步实时模式。

paper.title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

works.title_zh: ReWorld：具备长时记忆的交互世界模型

works.title: Speech Agent Arena
works.description: Artificial Analysis's arena for voice agents: screened, paid participants hold live conversations with two hidden speech-to-speech models or cascaded systems on the same scenario (15 tasks that need tool calls, such as ordering takeout, and 20 that do not), then pick the one they preferred. At launch Gemini 3.1 Flash Live led on preference while Grok Voice and GPT-Realtime models led on task success; it complements the firm's Speech to Speech Index (2026-06-23), which combines Big Bench Audio, part of Full-Duplex-Bench and τ-Voice.
works.description_zh: Artificial Analysis 为语音智能体设立的竞技场：经过筛选的付费参与者在同一情境下分别与两个匿名的语音到语音模型或级联系统实时对话（15 个需要调用工具的任务，如点外卖；20 个不需要的任务），再选出更喜欢的一方。上线时，Gemini 3.1 Flash Live 在偏好上领先，Grok Voice 与 GPT-Realtime 系列在任务完成率上领先；它与该公司 2026-06-23 推出的 Speech to Speech Index 互为补充，后者综合了 Big Bench Audio、Full-Duplex-Bench 的一部分与 τ-Voice。
works.idea_en: The model people prefer to talk to is not always the one that gets the task done: a sounding-right agent can claim success after a failed tool call.
works.idea_zh: 人们更愿意交谈的模型，不一定是能把事办成的那个：一个听起来很到位的智能体，可能在工具调用失败后仍声称已经完成。
works.method: Blind pairwise preference votes after separate live conversations, fitted to an Elo score, plus a task-success rate checked against the correct final tool call; scenario prompts and tool schemas are mostly kept private to limit overfitting.
works.method_zh: 参与者分别完成两段实时对话后进行盲选两两投票，拟合为 Elo 分数；另以最终工具调用是否正确来计算任务完成率。为减少过拟合，大多数情境提示与工具定义不公开。
works.specs: 35 scenarios (15 agentic, 20 non-agentic) · preference Elo + task success rate · native and cascaded systems
works.title_zh: 语音智能体竞技场

works.title: 4DAnyone
works.description: 4DAnyone turns a casual monocular video of a person, with no calibration or rig, into a 4D Gaussian human that can be replayed from any viewpoint. Code and model are open (Apache-2.0).
works.description_zh: 4DAnyone 能把一段随手拍摄的人物单目视频（无需标定、无需绑定骨骼）变成可从任意视角回放的 4D 高斯人体。代码与模型以 Apache-2.0 开源。
works.idea_en: Free-viewpoint people from one camera: the missing views are generated rather than captured, removing the multi-camera stage of volumetric video.
works.idea_zh: 一台相机即可得到可自由换视角的人物：缺失的视角靠生成而非拍摄，省去了体积视频的多机位采集环节。
works.method: A camera-controlled video diffusion model generates tens of consistent novel-view videos, using Reference Context Packing (a fixed-length reference context) and Target Context Routing (rotating view groups during denoising), and the views are fitted with 4D Gaussian splatting; training mixes a game-engine dataset (MVGameHuman), light-stage and in-the-wild videos.
works.method_zh: 相机可控的视频扩散模型生成数十路一致的新视角视频，采用“参考上下文打包”（固定长度的参考上下文）与“目标上下文路由”（去噪过程中轮换视角分组），再用 4D 高斯泼溅拟合；训练数据混合了游戏引擎数据集 MVGameHuman、光场舞台数据与真实视频。

paper.title: 4DAnyone: Create Anyone in 4D from a Casual Monocular Video

works.title_zh: 4DAnyone 单目视频生成 4D 人体

works.title: Does Listening Matter? Backchanneling and Nodding in an AI Clone
works.description: A within-subjects study (N=35) at Kyoto University and Sony CSL: participants talked with an AI clone of a real researcher (cloned voice, LLM replies) with and without verbal backchannels and head nods predicted in real time while they spoke. With listening behaviour, the clone was rated as more attentive, more like talking to the real person, and higher in co-presence.
works.description_zh: 京都大学与 Sony CSL 的一项被试内研究（N=35）：参与者与一位真实研究者的 AI 分身（克隆声音、大模型回复）交谈，对比在其说话时有无实时预测的语言附和与点头。加入倾听行为后，分身被评为更专注、更像在与真人交谈，共在感也更强。
works.idea_en: Evidence that a clone's fidelity includes how it listens: backchannels and nods change perceived presence even when voice and content stay the same.
works.idea_zh: 证据表明，分身的逼真度也包括它如何倾听：即使声音和内容不变，附和与点头也会改变人们感受到的临场感。
works.method: Counterbalanced AB/BA within-subjects design comparing an AI clone with and without listening behaviour, driven by real-time Voice Activity Projection models that predict backchannel timing and the timing and kinematics of nods (Kato et al., ICMI 2026).
works.method_zh: 采用 AB/BA 平衡的被试内设计，比较有无倾听行为的 AI 分身；倾听行为由基于 Voice Activity Projection 的实时模型驱动，预测附和时机以及点头的时机和运动参数（Kato 等，ICMI 2026）。

paper.title: Does Listening Matter? Backchanneling and Nodding in AI Clone

works.title_zh: 倾听重要吗？AI 分身中的附和与点头

works.title: MultiCube
works.description: Research model from Roblox, Carnegie Mellon and Stanford that generates a 3D object as separate part meshes from a text prompt, a list of named parts and a bounding box for each part, so the same layout can be filled with different parts or the same parts rearranged. Published as a preprint with a project page; no code was linked as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Roblox 与卡内基梅隆大学、斯坦福大学合作的研究模型：输入一句文字提示、一份带名称的部件清单以及每个部件的包围盒，就能生成由独立部件网格组成的三维物体；同一布局可以换上不同部件，同一组部件也可以重新摆放。以预印本和项目主页形式发布，截至 2026 年 10 月未公开代码。
works.idea_en: Props are specified the way a level designer thinks, which parts and where, rather than by hoping a prompt yields the right structure.
works.idea_zh: 像关卡设计师那样指定道具——要哪些部件、各放在哪里——而不是寄希望于一句提示词恰好生成正确的结构。
works.method: Two-stage diffusion: a mesh aligned with the part schema and layout is generated first, then decomposed into all part meshes at once; a Part Layout Adapter encodes each part's label and box independently of the others.
works.method_zh: 两阶段扩散：先生成与部件清单和布局一致的整体网格，再一次性拆分为各个部件网格；Part Layout Adapter 独立编码每个部件的名称与包围盒。

paper.title: MultiCube: Compositional 3D Generation With Part-Level Semantic and Spatial Control

works.title_zh: MultiCube 部件级可控的组合式三维生成

works.title: Hi3D 3.0 (Twinkle3D)
works.description: Third-generation Hi3D image-to-3D model, built on a geometry model called Twinkle3D, that Math Magic says reconstructs geometry at 2048³ voxel resolution with textures up to 8K, aimed at small identity details such as engravings, holes and seams; announced on 23 July and live from 18 August 2026.
works.description_zh: 第三代 Hi3D 图生三维模型，基于名为 Twinkle3D 的几何模型；Math Magic 称其几何重建分辨率达 2048³ 体素、纹理最高 8K，重点还原刻字、孔洞、接缝等体现物体特征的细节；2026 年 7 月 23 日发布预告，8 月 18 日上线。
works.idea_en: Shows the commercial image-to-3D race moving to geometric fidelity (whether the copy has the same holes and engravings), measured with published side-by-side comparisons rather than a score.
works.idea_zh: 表明商用图生三维的竞争转向几何保真度（复制出来的物体是否有同样的孔洞和刻字），并用公开的并排对比而不是单一分数来展示。
works.method: Proprietary; Math Magic describes a new high-precision 3D representation at 2048³ voxels and an upgraded UV-completion algorithm, without a published paper.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；Math Magic 称其采用了新的 2048³ 体素高精度三维表示和升级的 UV 补全算法，未发表论文。
works.specs: 2048³ voxel geometry · up to 8K PBR textures (developer claims)

works.title: Visual Generative AI in Mixed Reality: A Survey
works.description: A survey of how visual generative AI (2D and 3D content generation and vision-language models) is built into VR and AR, based on an in-depth review of 102 papers published 2018–2025 and organised by techniques, interaction designs and evaluations.
works.description_zh: 一篇综述，考察视觉生成式 AI（二维与三维内容生成以及视觉语言模型）如何被用于 VR 与 AR；基于对 2018–2025 年 102 篇论文的深入审阅，按技术、交互设计与评估方法组织。
works.idea_en: Generative models and MR interaction design have co-evolved in three places: immersive visualisation, controllable generation and synthetic data.
works.idea_zh: 生成模型与 MR 交互设计在三个方面共同演进：沉浸式可视化、可控生成与合成数据。
works.method: Screening of publications from international venues 2018–2025, followed by an in-depth review of 102 papers coded for 2D and 3D visual content creation, VLM integration, interaction design and evaluation.
works.method_zh: 筛选 2018–2025 年国际会议与期刊发表的论文，再对 102 篇进行深入审阅，按二维与三维视觉内容生成、视觉语言模型集成、交互设计与评估进行编码。

paper.title: Visual Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) in Mixed Reality (MR): A Survey of Techniques, Interaction Designs, and Evaluations

works.title_zh: 混合现实中的视觉生成式 AI 综述

works.title: WorldMind
works.description: A game world model in which a boss character's next move is decided from an explicit game state read back from the generated frames, instead of being left implicit in the video generator or supplied from outside. The project page shows one continuous hour of closed-loop boss fights.
works.description_zh: 一个游戏世界模型：首领角色的下一步动作，由从生成画面中重建出的显式游戏状态来决定，而不是隐含在视频生成器里，或由外部直接给定。项目页展示了连续一小时的闭环首领战。
works.idea_en: Separating what a generated character decides from how it is rendered gives an inspectable decision layer, the hook an experiment needs to control and log NPC behavior.
works.idea_zh: 把生成角色“决定做什么”与“如何被画出来”分开，就得到一个可检查的决策层；实验要控制并记录 NPC 行为，正需要这样的接口。
works.method: Four layers in a loop: an understanding layer builds a compact state from generated frames, a decision layer plans the NPC action, a control layer turns it into temporally aligned conditions and a distilled video generator renders the outcome; trained on BOSS-140K, gameplay videos paired with internal game states collected by an agent.
works.method_zh: 四层闭环：理解层从生成画面中构建紧凑状态，决策层规划 NPC 动作，控制层将其转为时间对齐的条件，经蒸馏的视频生成器渲染结果；训练数据为 BOSS-140K，即由智能体自动采集、与游戏内部状态配对的游戏视频。
works.specs: BOSS-140K dataset · 1-hour continuous rollout · two-step distilled generator · preferred over baselines in ~70% of pairwise comparisons

paper.title: WorldMind: Decoupled Game World Model for State-Aware NPC Behavior

works.title: Alaya-EVOKE
works.description: An open interactive world model from Alaya Lab that streams video under camera control for as long as a session lasts, keeps scene geometry outside the model in a store indexed by camera pose, and accepts new prompts mid-rollout (an aurora lights up, a storm rolls in) without a cut. Its Turbo version was listed first on WBench's navigation track (82.0) on 2026-09-11.
works.description_zh: Alaya Lab 推出的开源交互世界模型：在镜头控制下持续流式生成视频，会话多长都可以；场景几何保存在模型之外、按相机位姿索引的存储里；生成过程中可以随时更换提示（极光亮起、风暴来临），画面不中断。其 Turbo 版本于 2026 年 9 月 11 日在 WBench 导航赛道以 82.0 分位列第一。
works.idea_en: Moving memory out of the model's context lets a session run on without trading its length against what the world remembers.
works.idea_zh: 把记忆移出模型的上下文，会话就能一直进行下去，不必在时长与世界记得多少之间取舍。
works.method: A three-step student without classifier-free guidance is distilled with a 30-second distribution-matching objective under self-forced rollouts from a long-horizon teacher built on LingBot-World, whose sparse attention (chunk grouping, retrieval of selected distant frames and a linear-attention global state) grows linearly in memory and compute; at inference only view-relevant geometry is read from the external world state bank.
works.method_zh: 在自强制（self-forced）滚动生成下，用 30 秒的分布匹配目标，从一个基于 LingBot-World 的长时程教师模型蒸馏出三步、无需无分类器引导的学生模型；教师的稀疏注意力结合分块分组、远处关键帧检索与线性注意力全局状态，显存与计算随时长线性增长。推理时只从外部世界状态库读取与当前视角相关的几何信息。
works.specs: 384×640 · 3 steps, no CFG · 1.5 s chunk in 2.11 s on one H200 · WBench Navi 82.0 (Evoke-Turbo, 2026-09-11)

paper.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World

works.title: MiniMax Music 3.0
works.description: MiniMax's open-weight song model: from lyrics with section tags and a structured description (genre, BPM, key, vocals, arrangement) it generates a complete song of up to five minutes with vocals in one pass. Weights are on Hugging Face and GitHub, and the model is also served through the MiniMax API.
works.description_zh: MiniMax 的开源权重歌曲模型：根据带段落标签的歌词和结构化描述（曲风、BPM、调性、人声、编曲），一次生成最长五分钟、带人声的完整歌曲。权重已发布在 Hugging Face 和 GitHub，也可通过 MiniMax API 调用。
works.idea_en: Gives labs an open, version-pinnable model for full-length music with section-level control instead of a closed subscription app.
works.idea_zh: 为实验室提供一个开放、可固定版本、能按段落控制的完整歌曲生成模型，而不是封闭的订阅应用。
works.method: Hybrid language model: an 8B global LLM (initialised from Qwen3-8B) predicts the first of eight RVQ codebooks for long-range structure, a 0.6B local LLM predicts the rest, and a 2.4B flow-matching decoder with a Flow-VAE renders 32 kHz audio from their fused hidden states.
works.method_zh: 混合语言模型：80 亿参数的全局大模型（由 Qwen3-8B 初始化）预测八层 RVQ 中的第一层以把握长程结构，6 亿参数的局部模型预测其余各层，再由 24 亿参数的流匹配解码器结合 Flow-VAE，从两者融合的隐藏状态渲染 32 kHz 音频。
works.specs: 8B global + 0.6B local LM · 2.4B flow matching · up to 5 min · 32 kHz
works.title_zh: MiniMax Music 3.0 音乐生成模型

works.title: PlayWorld
works.description: A benchmark from Kuaishou and the University of Hong Kong in which multimodal AI agents play world models toward long-horizon goals across 171 scenarios, such as turning a full circle to check the scene or wading into water to look for ripples. Tested on nine models including Genie 3, HappyOyster and HY-World 2, it finds them unreliable on long-horizon interaction.
works.description_zh: 快手与香港大学推出的基准：让多模态 AI 智能体在 171 个情境中操控世界模型、追求长时程目标，例如原地转一圈检查场景是否一致，或走进水里看是否出现涟漪。在包括 Genie 3、HappyOyster 与 HY-World 2 在内的九个模型上测试后发现，它们在长时程交互上仍不可靠。
works.idea_en: Judges a world model by what an agent can accomplish in it, which is fairer to models with different controls than replaying a fixed action list.
works.idea_zh: 以智能体能在世界模型里完成什么来评判它；对于控制方式各异的模型，这比回放固定动作序列更公平。
works.method: Agent players choose their own actions to reach each scenario's objective; models are scored on geometry consistency, interaction fidelity, and in-sight and out-of-sight evolution, plus basic video-quality and controllability metrics.
works.method_zh: 智能体玩家自行选择动作以达成每个情境的目标；模型从几何一致性、交互保真度以及视野内与视野外的演化等维度评分，并辅以视频质量与可控性等基础指标。

paper.title: PlayWorld: Benchmarking World Models with Agent Players over Long-Horizon Objectives

works.title_zh: PlayWorld：以智能体玩家评测世界模型的长时目标基准

works.title: Meshy 7
works.description: Meshy's image-to-3D model tuned for geometry alignment, meaning how closely the generated shape matches the input image, launched with Meshy's own alignment benchmark; the Meshy 7.1 update (10 September 2026) adds an Ultra 4K mode that generates geometry at 4096³ with raw meshes of up to 80 million triangles.
works.description_zh: Meshy 针对“几何对齐”（生成形状与输入图像的吻合程度）调优的图生三维模型，并随模型发布了自建的对齐基准；2026 年 9 月 10 日的 Meshy 7.1 更新加入 Ultra 4K 模式，几何分辨率达 4096³，原始网格最多 8000 万个三角面。
works.idea_en: Once obvious failures are rare, 3D generators compete on faithfulness to a reference and on surface detail, which matters when a generated prop must match a specific real object. Meshy reports that Meshy 7 and 7.1 lead its own benchmarks; these are not independent tests.
works.idea_zh: 当明显的失败已不多见，三维生成的竞争就落在对参考图的忠实度和表面细节上，这在生成的道具必须对应某个真实物体时尤其重要。Meshy 称 Meshy 7 和 7.1 在其自建基准上领先，但这些并非独立测试。
works.method: Proprietary image-to-3D foundation model; for 7.1 Meshy scaled its voxel geometry representation and generation backbone from 2048³ to 4096³ and added high-precision mesh extraction and simplification.
works.method_zh: 专有的图生三维基础模型；7.1 把体素几何表示和生成主干从 2048³ 扩展到 4096³，并加入高精度网格提取与简化。
works.specs: 7.1 Ultra 4K: 4096³ geometry · up to 80M raw triangles

works.title: GENEA Challenge 2026
works.description: The fourth GENEA Challenge: a large human evaluation of speech-driven gesture generation, with five team systems trained on Meta's Seamless Interaction dataset of two-person conversations and four user studies (over 23,000 votes from 869 raters). Motion capture set the ceiling in every study; the best system reached 32% on speech alignment against 62% for real motion, and in the dyadic study no system scored substantially above chance at reacting to the other person.
works.description_zh: 第四届 GENEA Challenge：对语音驱动手势生成的大规模人工评测。五支队伍的系统都在 Meta 的双人对话数据集 Seamless Interaction 上训练，共开展四项用户研究（869 名评审、23,000 多票）。在每项研究中，真实动作捕捉都是上限；在语音对齐上，最好的系统得分 32%，真实动作为 62%；在双人研究中，没有一个系统在回应对方方面明显高于随机水平。
works.idea_en: Generated bodies still do not listen: gesture models can move well while ignoring the person they are talking to, which is what a social situation tests.
works.idea_zh: 生成的身体还不会“听”：手势模型动作可以很自然，却对谈话对象视而不见，而社交情境检验的恰恰是这一点。
works.method: Disentangled crowdsourced studies rate motion realism and speech alignment separately, a dyadic mismatch study swaps the interlocutor to test listening, and a new text-mismatch study on the Grounded Gestures subset tests semantic gestures.
works.method_zh: 通过解耦的众包研究分别评估动作真实感与语音对齐；在双人错配研究中替换对话者以检验“倾听”；并在 Grounded Gestures 子集上新增文本错配研究，检验语义手势。
works.specs: 5 systems · 4 user studies · 23,000+ votes · 869 raters · Seamless Interaction dataset

paper.title: The GENEA Challenge 2026: A Large-Scale Disentangled Evaluation of Speech-Driven Gesture Generation on the Seamless Interaction Dataset

works.title_zh: GENEA 手势生成挑战赛 2026

works.title: LTX-2.5
works.description: LTX-2.5 (2026-08-11) is Lightricks' 22-billion-parameter open-weight audio-video model, which LTX markets as an 'open world model': it renders multi-shot sequences that keep character, scene and voice across cuts, and ships with IC-LoRAs for HDR, alpha mattes, restoration and layout-to-render. Weights are on Hugging Face under the LTX community licence, with day-one ComfyUI support.
works.description_zh: LTX-2.5（2026-08-11）是 Lightricks 的 220 亿参数开源权重音视频模型，LTX 将其称为“开放世界模型”：它能一次生成多镜头序列，在镜头切换间保持角色、场景与声音一致，并配套 HDR、Alpha 遮罩、修复、布局到渲染等 IC-LoRA。权重以 LTX 社区许可证发布在 Hugging Face，发布当天即支持 ComfyUI。
works.idea_en: A pinned, fine-tunable open model that already handles multi-shot scenes with sound, so a lab can version-lock its stimulus generator and train it on its own footage.
works.idea_zh: 可锁定版本、可微调的开源模型已能生成带声音的多镜头场景，实验室可以固定刺激材料生成器的版本，并用自己的素材训练它。
works.method: Diffusion transformer in an 8x temporally compressed latent space with a new diffusion video decoder, a Gemma 4 text encoder with prompt enhancer and 'Diffusion Fidelity Rendering' that adds high-fidelity keyframes according to scene complexity (per LTX).
works.method_zh: 在 8 倍时间压缩的潜空间中运行的扩散 Transformer，配合新的扩散式视频解码器、Gemma 4 文本编码器与提示增强器，以及按场景复杂度增加高保真关键帧的“Diffusion Fidelity Rendering”（据 LTX）。
works.specs: 22B · open weights · native multi-shot · synchronized audio · 16 GB min VRAM (claimed)

works.title: MegaParts
works.description: Research model from Shanghai AI Laboratory, The University of Hong Kong and partner universities that generates a 3D object from a text prompt as an assembly of up to 300 separate part meshes; an object bounding box and per-part boxes can be given as spatial instructions. It is the base model of MeshCoder 1.5 and was published as a technical report with a project page in August 2026; code was announced but not released as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 上海人工智能实验室、香港大学与多所合作高校推出的研究模型：根据一句文字提示生成由最多 300 个独立部件网格组装而成的三维物体，还可以用整体包围盒和每个部件的包围盒作为空间指令。它是 MeshCoder 1.5 的基础模型，2026 年 8 月以技术报告和项目主页形式发布；截至 2026 年 10 月，代码已宣布但尚未公开。
works.idea_en: Complex props such as a camera, a dish rack or a building come out as hundreds of editable, articulable pieces rather than one fused shell.
works.idea_zh: 相机、碗碟架或一栋建筑这样的复杂道具，生成出来就是数百个可编辑、可做关节的部件，而不是一整块熔合的外壳。
works.method: A causal vector-quantized tokenizer gives each part an adaptive number of shape tokens (16 to 4,096 by geometric complexity), and a long-context language model generates the object box, the part boxes and the part shape tokens as one sequence of up to 256K tokens.
works.method_zh: 因果向量量化分词器按几何复杂度给每个部件分配 16 到 4096 个不等的形状 token，再由长上下文语言模型把物体包围盒、部件包围盒和部件形状 token 作为一条最长 256K token 的序列依次生成。

paper.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling

works.title_zh: MegaParts 扩展到 300 个部件的部件级三维生成

works.title: CaliBench
works.description: A benchmark from Odyssey that asks whether video world models reproduce the right spread of physical outcomes rather than one plausible clip: from the same starting frame a model generates many rollouts of a Galton board, a fork in a path, dice, cards or a roulette wheel, and the outcomes are compared with the known distribution. Across six image-to-video models (including Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.0 and Runway Gen-4.5) Odyssey reports widespread mode collapse, with Veo 3.1 producing the same die face for every seed.
works.description_zh: Odyssey 推出的基准，问的是视频世界模型能否复现物理结果的正确分布，而不只是生成一段看似合理的视频：从同一起始帧出发，模型对高尔顿板、岔路、骰子、扑克牌或轮盘生成多次推演，再把结果与已知分布比较。在六个图生视频模型（包括 Veo 3.1、Seedance 2.0 与 Runway Gen-4.5）上，Odyssey 报告普遍存在模式坍缩，Veo 3.1 在每个随机种子下都掷出同一个点数。
works.idea_en: A generated situation that always plays out the same way is not a simulation of chance: for studies that rely on varied outcomes, calibration matters as much as realism.
works.idea_zh: 一个每次都以同样方式展开的生成情境，并不是对偶然性的模拟；对依赖结果多样性的研究来说，校准与真实感同样重要。
works.method: Outcomes are read from each generated video by a vision-language model (Gemini 3.1 Pro, about 93% agreement with human annotators) and reported as scorability (share of readable outcomes) and calibration (normalised total variation distance from the analytic distribution); paper in TMLR.
works.method_zh: 由视觉语言模型（Gemini 3.1 Pro，与人工标注一致率约 93%）从每段生成视频中读出结果，报告“可判读率”（结果清晰可读的比例）与“校准度”（与解析分布之间的归一化总变差距离）；论文发表于 TMLR。
works.specs: 9 scenes · 32 generations per model and scene · 6 image-to-video models · metric: mnTV

paper.title: CaliBench: Are the Stochastic Dynamics of Video World Models Physically Calibrated?

works.title: Generative Proxy
works.description: On lightweight AR glasses without a wide display or hand and eye tracking, the system generates proxy interfaces: virtual stand-ins for distant, cluttered or occluded real objects that the wearer operates with the device's limited inputs, tailored to the scene, the task and the device.
works.description_zh: 在没有大视场显示、也没有手部和眼动追踪的轻量 AR 眼镜上，系统会生成代理界面：为远处、杂乱或被遮挡的真实物体生成虚拟替身，佩戴者用设备有限的输入方式就能操作它们，界面会按场景、任务和设备量身生成。
works.idea_en: The wearer acts on a generated abstraction of the room rather than on the room itself, so which parts of reality become controllable, and how, is decided per device and intent by a generator.
works.idea_zh: 佩戴者操作的是房间的生成式抽象，而不是房间本身；现实中哪些部分可被操控、以何种方式操控，由生成器按设备和意图来决定。
works.method: Generation is a constrained synthesis over three specifications (scene, intent, device capabilities) that enumerates valid proxy UIs; candidates are ranked by semantic and articulatory distance from direct-manipulation theory, combining rule-based costs with LLM ergonomic scores and an LLM coherence check on the shortlist. Prototypes ran on Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest 3, Meta Ray-Ban Display and Project Aria with watch, phone and Neural Band input; 12 XR developers and researchers rated the generated UIs positively.
works.method_zh: 生成过程被表述为基于三类规格（场景、意图、设备能力）的约束合成，先枚举出有效的代理界面；再依据直接操纵理论中的语义距离与动作距离对候选排序，排序结合了基于规则的代价、大语言模型给出的人机工效评分，以及对入围候选的大语言模型一致性检查。原型运行于 Apple Vision Pro、Meta Quest 3、Meta Ray-Ban Display 和 Project Aria，并支持手表、手机与 Neural Band 输入；12 位 XR 开发者与研究者对生成界面给出了正面评价。

paper.title: Generative Proxy: Synthesizing Proxy-Based Interfaces for Real-World Interaction Across AR Glasses

works.title_zh: Generative Proxy：为 AR 眼镜合成用于现实世界交互的代理式界面

works.title: Khora
works.description: A multi-agent world model that keeps one shared world state and renders each player's view by querying it, so more observers can join at inference time without retraining; RhOS.ai and Ophilus.AI show it on Counter-Strike-style maps with an online demo and report roughly linear cost as views are added.
works.description_zh: 一个多智能体世界模型：维护一份共享的世界状态，每名玩家的画面都通过查询这份状态渲染出来，因此推理时可以加入更多观察者而无需重新训练；RhOS.ai 与 Ophilus.AI 在《反恐精英》类地图上展示了它，提供在线演示，并称成本随视角数量大致线性增长。
works.idea_en: Separates what is true in the world from what each person sees, the split a shared social situation needs once it holds more than a handful of people.
works.idea_zh: 把“世界里发生了什么”与“每个人看到了什么”分开；一旦共享的社会情境里不止寥寥几人，就需要这种拆分。
works.method: World-state evolution is decoupled from visual rendering, and a population-agnostic rendering mechanism brings in other agents' information, so cross-view consistency comes from the shared state rather than from dense attention between observation streams inside the video generator.
works.method_zh: 把世界状态的演化与画面渲染解耦，并以与人数无关的渲染机制引入其他智能体的信息，使跨视角一致性来自共享状态，而不是依赖视频生成器内部各观测流之间的稠密注意力。
works.specs: any number of agents at inference · ~linear scaling with views (developer-reported)

paper.title: Population-Scalable Multi-Agent World Modeling

works.title_zh: Khora：可按人数扩展的多智能体世界模型

works.title: WorldClaw
works.description: A Tencent Hunyuan agentic system that turns one open-ended prompt into a large, explorable open-world 3D scene with terrain, regions and editable instance-level assets.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元的智能体系统：把一句开放式提示词变成大尺度、可探索的开放世界三维场景，包含地形、分区和可编辑的实例级资产。
works.idea_en: Agents that plan, build and then inspect renders can scale generation from a room to a landscape while keeping every object editable.
works.idea_zh: 会规划、会搭建、还会检查渲染结果的智能体，可以把生成规模从一个房间扩展到一片地景，同时让每个物体都保持可编辑。
works.method: Planning agents write a structured specification (regions, terrain, assets, materials, spatial relations); a region-aware height field and semantic layout form the terrain, detailed regions are generated as terrain-conditioned compositions and reconstructed into textured meshes, and render-based agents refine terrain, objects and contacts.
works.method_zh: 规划智能体先写出结构化规格（分区、地形、资产、材质、空间关系）；由分区感知的高度场和语义布局构成地形，细节区域以地形为条件生成组合并重建为带纹理的网格，最后由基于渲染的智能体修正地形、物体与接触关系。

paper.title: WorldClaw: Agentic 3D Open-World Generation at Scale

works.title_zh: WorldClaw：智能体驱动的大规模开放世界生成

works.title: WorldTrace
works.description: A training-free fix for interactive video world models that forget once a session runs past their training length: it keeps the model's compressed memory addressable so long rollouts stay smooth and previously visited scenes can be recalled.
works.description_zh: 一种无需重新训练的修补方法，针对会话超出训练长度后就开始遗忘的交互视频世界模型：让模型压缩后的记忆仍可被准确寻址，使长时推演保持平滑，并能回想起曾经到过的场景。
works.idea_en: Pinpoints why world models forget (positional encodings drift out of range) and fixes it without retraining, so existing models can run longer sessions.
works.idea_zh: 指出世界模型遗忘的原因在于位置编码超出训练范围，并在不重新训练的情况下加以修复，让现有模型能运行更长的会话。
works.method: The KV cache is compressed into fixed in-distribution slot positions with canonical-key writers, avoiding averaging across incompatible RoPE phases; two variants target smooth rollouts (Field) and scene recall (Landmark).
works.method_zh: 把 KV 缓存压缩到固定、处于训练分布内的槽位，并用规范化键写入，避免把相位不兼容的 RoPE 平均在一起；两个变体分别面向平滑推演（Field）与场景回想（Landmark）。

paper.title: Addressable Memory for Video World Models

works.title_zh: WorldTrace：视频世界模型的可寻址记忆

works.title: Wan 3.0
works.description: Wan 3.0 entered public beta on Alibaba Cloud on 2026-08-06 and was generally available on Model Studio by late August, with a faster wan3.0-video-prime variant from 2026-08-20; unlike the open Wan 2.1 and 2.2 it is closed and API-only, and it takes text, image, video and audio in one prompt. Wan 2.5 (2025-09) and Wan 2.6 (2025-12) had already added native audio and reference casting.
works.description_zh: 通义万相 Wan 3.0 于 2026-08-06 在阿里云开启公测，8 月下旬已在百炼正式提供，并自 2026-08-20 起提供更快的 wan3.0-video-prime 版本；与开源的 Wan 2.1、2.2 不同，它闭源、仅提供 API，可在一个提示中同时接收文本、图像、视频和音频。此前 Wan 2.5（2025 年 9 月）和 Wan 2.6（2025 年 12 月）已加入原生音频与参考角色功能。
works.idea_en: Even the leading open-weight video lab now keeps its newest flagship closed, so open Wan models trail by a generation.
works.idea_zh: 就连最重要的开源视频团队也开始把最新旗舰闭源，开源的 Wan 模型因此落后一代。
works.method: Multimodal audio-video generation model served through Alibaba Cloud Model Studio; architecture and weights not published as of October 2026.
works.method_zh: 通过阿里云百炼提供服务的多模态音视频生成模型；截至 2026 年 10 月，架构与权重均未公开。
works.title_zh: 通义万相 3.0

works.title: HelloWorld
works.description: A video world model whose characters respond to the viewer: while the camera moves through a scene, pressing one key makes an on-screen person turn toward the camera and wave, nod, bow or say a short greeting, timed to the key press; it ships with HelloWorldBench, which scores action accuracy, timing and gaze direction.
works.description_zh: 一个让画面中的角色回应观看者的视频世界模型：镜头在场景中移动时，按下一个键，画面里的人就会转向镜头挥手、点头、鞠躬或简短问候，时机与按键对应；同时发布的 HelloWorldBench 从动作准确度、时机与视线方向三方面评分。
works.idea_en: A first step from worlds that ignore you to characters that acknowledge you, with gaze and timing measured rather than assumed.
works.idea_zh: 从“对你视而不见的世界”迈向“会回应你的角色”的第一步，而且视线与时机是被测量的，而不是想当然。
works.method: Self-distillation: the base video model is fine-tuned on clips it synthesized itself that combine social responses with camera motion, and a training-free temporal cross-attention mask confines the response to the key-press window (University of Tokyo with Alaya Lab).
works.method_zh: 自蒸馏：用基础视频模型自己合成的、同时包含社交回应与镜头运动的片段来微调它，再用无需训练的时间交叉注意力掩码，把回应限定在按键对应的时间窗内（东京大学与 Alaya Lab 合作）。

paper.title: HelloWorld: Enabling Socially Interactive Characters in Video World Models

works.title_zh: HelloWorld：会社交回应的世界模型角色

works.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0
works.description: Tencent Hunyuan3D's single model that describes a 3D asset, generates one from text, edits it from a written instruction and pulls out a named part; it was published as a technical report with a project page in August 2026, with code announced but not released as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元3D 的统一模型：能描述一个三维资产、由文字生成资产、按文字指令编辑资产，并按名称提取其中的部件；2026 年 8 月以技术报告和项目主页形式发布，截至 2026 年 10 月代码已预告但尚未公开。
works.idea_en: Puts describe, make, change and take apart into one model, so a prop can be revised by instruction instead of regenerated from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 把“描述、生成、修改、拆分”放进同一个模型，道具可以按指令修改，而不必每次从头重新生成。
works.method: Hunyuan3D-VLM provides semantic, structural and spatial conditions to a Hunyuan3D DiT generator, which also receives the source asset for editing and part generation; trained on an 87M-sample 3D corpus whose 12M editing pairs were produced with Nano3D-v2.
works.method_zh: Hunyuan3D-VLM 为 Hunyuan3D DiT 生成器提供语义、结构与空间条件，编辑和部件生成时还把原始资产一并输入；训练语料共 8700 万条三维样本，其中 1200 万条编辑样本由 Nano3D-v2 生成。

paper.title: Hunyuan3D-Buffalo 1.0: A Unified Multimodal Model for Scalable 3D Generation, Understanding, and Editing

works.title_zh: 混元3D-Buffalo 1.0

works.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit
works.description: JoyAI-Video-Edit (JD.com, 2026-08-05) edits a live camera stream or uploaded video as the frames arrive, following a text instruction or reference image: swap a person's costume, change the background or restyle the scene while the rest stays in place. JD reports about 30 fps at 720p on one B200 and 24 fps at 840x480 on a single RTX 5090; weights, code and a browser webcam demo are public.
works.description_zh: JoyAI-Video-Edit（京东，2026-08-05）在画面到达时即时编辑实时摄像头流或上传的视频，按文字指令或参考图换装、换背景或改变画风，其余部分保持不变。京东称其在单张 B200 上以约 30 fps 输出 720p，在单张 RTX 5090 上以 24 fps 输出 840x480；权重、代码与浏览器摄像头演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Open, consumer-GPU live restyling of a camera feed: the same room or person can be re-dressed as a different situation while the participant moves.
works.idea_zh: 开源、可在消费级显卡上运行的摄像头实时改写：参与者在活动时，同一个房间或同一个人就能被换成另一种情境。
works.method: 16B multimodal diffusion transformer with an MLLM condition encoder and causal video VAE, adapted chunk-wise to autoregressive generation and distilled to two steps with source-anchored distribution matching.
works.method_zh: 160 亿参数多模态扩散 Transformer，配合多模态大模型条件编码器与因果视频 VAE，按块改造为自回归生成，并通过源锚定分布匹配蒸馏到两步。
works.specs: 16B · ~30 fps 720p on 1 B200 · 24 fps 840x480 on RTX 5090 (reported)

paper.title: JoyAI-Video-Edit: Real-Time Open-Ended Video Editing with Autoregressive Diffusion

works.title_zh: 京东 JoyAI-Video-Edit：实时开放式视频编辑

works.title: SeedRealtime
works.description: ByteDance Seed's native audio-visual full-duplex model, which watches, listens and speaks at once, chimes in or pauses at the right moment, and ignores bystander chatter and background noise. Seed reports that it halves conversational pacing problems compared with cascaded systems in human evaluation, and that it is fully rolled out at scale.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的原生视听全双工模型：能同时看、听、说，在合适的时机插话或停顿，并能忽略旁人闲聊和背景噪音。Seed 报告称，人工评测中它的对话节奏问题比级联系统减少一半，并已全量大规模上线。
works.idea_en: Proactive, interference-robust timing in a deployed product: the system decides when to speak from what it sees and hears, not from silence.
works.idea_zh: 在已部署的产品中实现主动、抗干扰的对话时机：系统根据看到和听到的内容决定何时开口，而不是依据静音。
works.method: A unified architecture that natively fuses continuous audio, video and text streams and models the user's conversational state, replacing an external voice-activity detector.
works.method_zh: 统一架构原生融合连续的音频、视频与文本流，并对用户的对话状态建模，取代外部的语音活动检测器。
works.title_zh: SeedRealtime 视听全双工大模型

works.title: The Effect of Perceived Race and Gender on Police Language Use: Experimental Evidence from VR Simulations
works.description: Re-analysis of VR field experiments in which 70 U.S. police officers talked with virtual characters in three scenes (a house, a bus stop, a convenience store), with the character's race and gender assigned at random. Most officers spoke less deferentially to characters depicted as Black men, especially when the character was known to be a suspect.
works.description_zh: 对一组 VR 现场实验的再分析：70 名美国警察在三个场景（住宅、公交站、便利店）中与虚拟角色对话，角色的种族与性别随机分配。多数警察对被呈现为黑人男性的角色说话时更不客气，在已知该角色是嫌疑人时尤其明显。
works.idea_en: Randomly assigning who the virtual person is turns a VR scene into a causal test of bias in what officers actually say, turn by turn.
works.idea_zh: 随机分配虚拟人物的身份，让一个 VR 场景变成检验警察逐轮实际话语中偏见的因果实验。
works.method: Utterance-level causal analysis of crowd-rated deference (0–10) in 3,897 officer statements from Doan et al.'s VR experiments, with LLM text features, propensity weighting and LLM-generated paraphrases used to validate effect estimates; the paper contributes an annotated dataset.
works.method_zh: 基于 Doan 等人的 VR 实验数据，对 3,897 条警察话语的众包“恭敬程度”评分（0–10）做话语层面的因果分析；用大语言模型提取文本特征、做倾向得分加权，并用大语言模型生成的改写句验证效应估计；论文还贡献了一个标注数据集。
keywords: video shows the source VR program

paper.title: The Effect of Perceived Race and Gender on Police Language Use: Experimental Evidence from VR Simulations

works.title_zh: 感知种族与性别对警察用语的影响：来自 VR 模拟的实验证据

works.title: GAIA-4
works.description: The fourth GAIA world model, which puts Wayve's AI Driver in the loop: a recorded drive becomes the starting point of a simulation in which the camera view changes with every braking or steering decision, so engineers can test futures that never happened.
works.description_zh: 第四代 GAIA 世界模型，让 Wayve 的 AI 驾驶员参与闭环：一段真实行驶记录成为仿真的起点，每一次刹车或转向决定都会改变摄像头看到的画面，工程师因此可以测试从未发生过的未来。
works.idea_en: Closed-loop and anchored to a real recording: the counterfactual changes only what the agent's decision changes, a clean design for 'what if' tests.
works.idea_zh: 闭环且锚定在真实记录上：反事实只改变由智能体决定所引起的部分，是做“如果……会怎样”测试的干净设计。
works.method: A multimodal world model that re-simulates sensor input conditioned on the driving model's actions while keeping the underlying scene tied to the original recording as a deterministic baseline.
works.method_zh: 多模态世界模型，以驾驶模型的动作为条件重新模拟传感器输入，同时让底层场景与原始记录保持一致，作为确定性的基线。

works.title: StreamTalk
works.description: Co-speech gesture model from Tongyi Lab (Alibaba) and the University of Tokyo that generates 3D body and hand motion clip by clip as speech arrives, at 76 fps; at the end of each clip it retrieves a plausible key pose from the speaker's own motion library and refines toward it, which keeps long monologues from drifting.
works.description_zh: 通义实验室（阿里巴巴）与东京大学的伴随语音手势模型：随着语音输入逐段生成三维身体与手部动作，速度达 76 fps；每段结束时从该说话人自己的动作库中检索一个合理的关键姿态并朝它修正，从而避免长时间讲话中动作逐渐跑偏。
works.idea_en: A talking character can keep its gestures in sync for minutes without slowly sliding into odd poses, as open-loop streaming models tend to do.
works.idea_zh: 说话的角色可以连续数分钟保持手势同步，不会像开环流式模型那样慢慢滑向怪异的姿势。
works.method: Generate-retrieve-refine cycle: a part-aware DiT with separate hand, body and translation streams predicts a coarse clip, a tail key pose is retrieved from a speaker-specific database and the clip is refined toward it; stochastic anchor masking in training teaches recovery from sparse boundary poses.
works.method_zh: “生成—检索—修正”循环：分部位 DiT（手、身体、位移分别建模）先预测粗略片段，再从说话人专属数据库中检索末尾关键姿态，并据此修正片段；训练时用随机锚点遮挡，让模型学会从稀疏的边界姿态恢复完整动作。

paper.title: StreamTalk: Streaming Co-Speech Gesture Generation with Key-Pose Anchoring

works.title_zh: StreamTalk 流式伴随语音手势生成

works.title: PartInteractor
works.description: In an XR headset, a user describes, sketches or photographs an object; the system generates it as a 3D asset split into named parts, which the user can then grab, swap, restyle or regenerate one component at a time.
works.description_zh: 用户在 XR 头显中用语音描述、画草图或拍照来表达想要的物体；系统把它生成为由若干命名部件组成的三维资产，用户随后可以逐个部件地抓取、替换、换风格或重新生成。
works.idea_en: Treating generated objects as part hierarchies turns one-shot prompt-to-object generation into an ongoing edit, so a scene can be revised without starting over.
works.idea_zh: 把生成的物体当作部件层级来处理，一次性的“提示到物体”就变成了可持续的编辑，场景修改无需从头再来。
works.method: An LLM/VLM interpreter turns speech, in-situ sketches or headset images into candidate 2D concepts (retrieval plus generation), then part-aware image-to-3D generation produces semantically decomposed assets that are manipulated per component in the headset; evaluated against whole-object regeneration.
works.method_zh: 由 LLM/VLM 解析器把语音、现场草图或头显拍摄的图像转成候选二维概念图（检索加生成），再用部件感知的图生三维模型生成按语义拆分的资产，在头显中按部件操作；并与整体重新生成的方式作对比评估。

paper.title: PartInteractor: Intent-Driven Part-Aware 3D Authoring for Continuous Co-Creation in XR

works.title_zh: PartInteractor：面向 XR 持续共创的意图驱动、部件感知三维创作

works.title: MiniMax H3
works.description: MiniMax H3 (2026-07-31) generates up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound from text, image, video and audio context and edits video by instruction; unusually for a flagship, MiniMax published the weights on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: MiniMax H3（2026-07-31）可根据文本、图像、视频和音频上下文生成最长 15 秒、2K 分辨率并带原生立体声的视频，也能按指令编辑视频；少见的是，MiniMax 把这款旗舰模型的权重发布在了 Hugging Face 上。
works.idea_en: A flagship-level audio-video model with downloadable weights lets a lab pin the exact model behind its stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 可下载权重的旗舰级音视频模型，让实验室能锁定刺激材料背后的确切模型版本。
works.method: Contextual Omni Representation with an H3-VAE, an H3-Omni Transformer and in-context regeneration for editing (per MiniMax).
works.method_zh: MiniMax 称其采用上下文全模态表征（Contextual Omni Representation），包括 H3-VAE、H3-Omni Transformer，以及用于编辑的上下文再生成。
works.specs: up to 15 s · 2K · native stereo audio

works.title: One Word, One World
works.description: In a shared VR space, collaborators speak an object into existence: a placeholder appears for everyone at once and is replaced by the generated 3D asset, which any participant can then move and edit. A within-subjects study (N = 48) compared this with building from an asset library.
works.description_zh: 在共享的 VR 空间里，协作者只要说出一个物体，所有人眼前就会同时出现一个占位体，随后被生成的三维资产替换，任何参与者都可以移动和编辑它。一项被试内实验（N = 48）把它与从资产库搭建的方式作了比较。
works.idea_en: Voice-driven generation changed who takes part, not only how fast: social presence and psychological safety rose most for people with little 3D experience.
works.idea_zh: 语音驱动的生成改变的不只是速度，还有谁能参与：对三维经验很少的人，社会临场感与心理安全感提升最明显。
works.method: Speech recognition plus generative 3D asset creation in a multi-user VR environment with shared placeholders, soft locking, synchronised state and authorship visualisation. Within-subjects, N = 48, against an asset-library baseline: higher creative throughput (p < .001) and expert-rated design quality (p = .007), with higher social presence and psychological safety.
works.method_zh: 多人 VR 环境中结合语音识别与生成式三维资产创建，提供共享占位体、软锁定、状态同步和作者可视化。被试内设计，N = 48，以资产库为基线：创作产出更高（p < .001），专家评定的设计质量更高（p = .007），社会临场感与心理安全感也更高。

paper.title: “One Word, One World”: a generative AI-empowered real-time VR co-creation system and its impact on social presence and collaboration patterns

works.title_zh: “一语一世界”：生成式 AI 驱动的实时 VR 共创

works.title: Visko Orbis 1.0
works.description: Visko Orbis 1.0 is a 'live model' that keeps generating video while the user changes the prompt, with each change visible in the running stream; Visko reports 4K at 24 fps in real time and hour-long rollouts without visible colour or quality drift. Public access opened on visko.ai (with sign-in) on 2026-09-01.
works.description_zh: Visko Orbis 1.0 是一个“活模型”（Live Model）：用户随时修改提示词时，它仍持续生成视频，每次修改都会在正在播放的视频流中立刻体现。Visko 称它能以 4K、24 fps 实时生成，连续运行一小时也没有明显的色彩或画质漂移。2026 年 9 月 1 日起，visko.ai 对公众开放（需登录）。
works.idea_en: Treats a generated scene as a process that keeps running and accepts direction, not a clip to request, which is the framing a long, steerable experimental scenario needs.
works.idea_zh: 把生成的场景当作一个持续运行、可随时引导的过程，而不是一次次请求的片段；长时、可调控的实验情境正需要这种框架。
works.method: A distilled chunk-wise causal streaming generator with a bounded multi-scale memory across chunks, aligned with a latent world-model reward, followed by a streaming video upscaler and an optimised GPU serving engine (team report; architecture details limited).
works.method_zh: 经过蒸馏的分块因果流式生成器，带有跨块的有界多尺度记忆，并用潜空间世界模型奖励对齐；之后接流式视频超分和优化的 GPU 推理引擎（来自团队技术报告，架构细节有限）。

paper.title: Visko Orbis 1.0: A Live Model for Real-Time Interactive Long Video Generation

works.title_zh: Visko Orbis 1.0：实时交互长视频“活模型”

works.title: Real-time AI style transfer on Spectacles
works.description: An experiment connects Snap Spectacles to Decart's real-time video model and projects the transformed camera feed back into the wearer's view at real-world scale, so the street appears restyled live.
works.description_zh: 一项实验把 Snap Spectacles 接入 Decart 的实时视频模型，再把改造后的摄像头画面按真实尺度投回佩戴者视野，让街景实时呈现另一种风格。
works.idea_en: On see-through glasses, restyling has to decide what to augment and where, not just filter the whole frame.
works.idea_zh: 在透视式眼镜上，重绘需要决定增强什么、在哪里增强，而不只是给整个画面加滤镜。
works.method: The Spectacles camera stream is sent over WebRTC to Decart's real-time video-to-video API and the returned frames are rendered at world scale in the lens; the prototype was built in a day with an agentic coding loop.
works.method_zh: Spectacles 摄像头画面经 WebRTC 发送到 Decart 的实时视频到视频 API，返回的画面在镜头中按真实尺度渲染；这个原型借助智能体编程循环在一天内完成。
works.title_zh: Spectacles 上的实时 AI 风格迁移

works.title: Real-to-Sim-to-Real (R2S2R) engine
works.description: World Labs' real-to-sim-to-real engine, from the SceniX team that joined it in July 2026: a real robot task is captured and rebuilt as an interactive simulation that matches its appearance and physics, then varied in lighting, clutter, objects, physics and camera views; World Labs reports manipulation policies trained with zero real-world data and simulated tests that predict which policies fail on hardware.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的“真实到仿真再到真实”引擎，来自 2026 年 7 月并入的 SceniX 团队：先采集一个真实的机器人任务，把它重建成外观与物理都相符的交互式仿真，再改变光照、杂物、物体、物理参数与相机视角；World Labs 称，由此训练的操作策略无需任何真实数据，仿真测试也能预测哪些策略会在真机上失败。
works.idea_en: The same move a behavioral lab would want: rebuild one real situation faithfully, then vary it systematically and check that results in the copy predict results in reality.
works.idea_zh: 这正是行为实验室想做的：先忠实重建一个真实情境，再系统地改变它，并检验在副本中的结果能否预测现实中的结果。
works.method: Generative world models produce spatially coherent environments that are combined with task-aligned robot simulation; each reconstruction is validated by replaying the same open-loop actions in simulation and reality and comparing observations and outcomes.
works.method_zh: 用生成式世界模型构建空间上连贯的环境，并与按任务对齐的机器人仿真结合；每次重建都通过在仿真与现实中回放同一组开环动作、比较观测与结果来验证。

works.title: STEER
works.description: STEER drives a 3D head avatar in a two-person conversation and lets the user steer how it listens and reacts: gaze contact or aversion, the rhythm of head motion and emotion are explicit controls that can be edited together, and a live interface runs it while a person talks to it.
works.description_zh: STEER 在两人对话中驱动一个三维头部化身，并让使用者调控它如何倾听和反应：注视或回避目光、头部动作的节奏以及情绪都是可同时编辑的显式控制量；它还提供可与真人实时对话的交互界面。
works.idea_en: Gaze and nodding become independent variables an experimenter can set and log, instead of side effects of the audio.
works.idea_zh: 视线和点头成为实验者可以设定和记录的自变量，而不是音频的副产品。
works.method: A causal flow-matching motion prior generates the target's 61-D FLAME state (expression, jaw, neck, eye rotation, eyelids) from the partner's motion and audio and the target's own audio, with gaze, head-rhythm and emotion controls learned from dyadic corpora that a new tracking and annotation pipeline labels frame by frame; inference code is open.
works.method_zh: 一个因果流匹配动作先验，根据对方的动作与音频以及目标人物自己的音频，生成目标人物 61 维 FLAME 状态（表情、下颌、颈部、眼球转动、眼睑）；视线、头部节奏和情绪控制量来自双人对话语料，由新的追踪与标注流程逐帧标注；推理代码已开源。

paper.title: STEER: Steerable Dyadic Head Avatars

works.title_zh: STEER：可调控的双人对话头部化身

works.title: Confabulations in LLM-Assisted Immersive Scene Editing
works.description: 24 non-expert users edited three VR scenes (an office, a loft and a city) by speaking to a GPT-5.2-based assistant; the authors coded every turn for confabulations, where the system misstated what it had done or what the scene contained, and compared them with what users noticed.
works.description_zh: 24 名非专业用户通过与基于 GPT-5.2 的助手对话来编辑三个 VR 场景（办公室、阁楼和城市）；作者逐轮标注“虚构”现象，即系统错误陈述自己做了什么或场景里有什么，并与用户察觉到的情况对比。
works.idea_en: In the busier scenes users noticed only about a third of the editor's confabulations, and their estimates stopped tracking reality as errors piled up, so generated scenes need machine-checked edit logs rather than user trust.
works.idea_zh: 在较复杂的场景中，用户只察觉到大约三分之一的虚构，而且错误越多，用户的估计越脱离实际；因此生成场景需要可由机器核验的编辑日志，而不能依赖用户的信任。
works.method: Speech is transcribed, a rule-based classifier routes intent and GPT-5.2 executes edits on selected objects (Oculus Quest 2). Exploratory study, N = 24: 437 of 1,612 interaction turns (27.1%) contained a confabulation; a nine-category taxonomy led by spatial placement errors (299 occurrences); a 'perception-reality gap', with median perceived vs actual counts of 2 vs 6 (office) and 4 vs 10.5 (city).
works.method_zh: 语音先转为文字，由规则分类器判别意图，再由 GPT-5.2 对选中的物体执行编辑（Oculus Quest 2）。探索性研究，N = 24：1,612 个交互轮次中有 437 个（27.1%）出现虚构；得出九类分类，空间放置错误最多（299 次）；并提出“感知与现实差距”：感知与实际次数的中位数分别为 2 对 6（办公室）和 4 对 10.5（城市）。

paper.title: A Taxonomy of Confabulations and the Perception-Reality Gap in LLM-Assisted Immersive Scene Editing

works.title_zh: 大语言模型辅助沉浸式场景编辑中的虚构现象与感知—现实差距

works.title: AI-Generated Personalized Visualization of the Safe Place in Virtual Reality vs Traditional Safe Place Imagery: Randomized Controlled Trial
works.description: Sixty adults imagined a personal 'safe place', went through a stress task and then relaxed for three minutes, either inside a 360° panorama generated from their own description and viewed on a Meta Quest 3 (n = 30) or with eyes closed imagining it (n = 30).
