Relaxation rose equally in both groups, with no difference immediately or over a five-day follow-up; presence and satisfaction with the generated place did not predict relaxation, while imagery vividness did.
works.description_zh: 60 名成人先想象一个属于自己的“安全之地”，完成压力任务后放松三分钟：一组在 Meta Quest 3 中进入根据本人描述生成的 360° 全景（n = 30），另一组闭眼想象（n = 30）。两组放松程度同样上升，即时与五天随访均无差异；临场感和对生成场景的满意度不能预测放松效果，而想象的生动程度可以。
works.idea_en: One of the first randomized trials that puts each participant inside a world generated from their own words, and the generated place did no better than imagination.
works.idea_zh: 最早让每位参与者进入由其本人描述生成的世界的随机试验之一；结果是生成的场景并不比想象更有效。
works.method: Randomized controlled trial (30 + 30) with stress induction; each experimental participant's safe place was rendered by MindGap AI in PsyTechVR (a Stable-Diffusion-class latent diffusion model with an LDM3D depth extension) as a static 360° panorama without sound; Relaxation State Questionnaire, VVIQ and IPQ, and daily online follow-up for five days.
works.method_zh: 随机对照试验（30 + 30），含压力诱导；实验组每人的安全之地由 PsyTechVR 平台中的 MindGap AI（与 Stable Diffusion 同类的潜在扩散模型，带 LDM3D 深度扩展）生成为无声的静态 360° 全景；测量放松状态问卷、视觉意象生动性问卷与 IPQ 临场感量表，并进行为期五天的每日在线随访。

paper.title: AI-Generated Personalized Visualization of the Safe Place in Virtual Reality vs Traditional Safe Place Imagery: Randomized Controlled Trial

works.title_zh: VR 中 AI 生成的个性化安全之地与传统安全之地想象的比较：随机对照试验

works.title: GS-Agent
works.description: Multi-agent system from UMass Amherst and Genesis AI that builds a dynamic 3D world from a text description by writing code for a physics simulator: agents curate and place assets, tune materials, script motion and set cameras and lights, then run the simulation, so that liquids, deformable objects and rigid bodies interact physically. Because the output is a simulation rather than pixels, every frame has consistent geometry; the authors compare it with Sora 2 and Wan 2.2.
works.description_zh: 麻省大学阿默斯特分校与 Genesis AI 的多智能体系统：根据一段文字描述，为物理仿真器编写代码来构建动态三维世界——智能体负责挑选和摆放资产、调整材质、编排运动、设置镜头与灯光，然后运行仿真，让液体、可变形物体与刚体发生符合物理的交互。由于输出是仿真而非像素，每一帧的几何都保持一致；作者将其与 Sora 2 和 Wan 2.2 做了对比。
works.idea_en: Instead of predicting how a world should look, it builds one that obeys physics and can be re-run with one parameter changed, which is what an experiment needs.
works.idea_zh: 它不是去预测世界“看起来”该是什么样，而是搭建一个遵守物理规律、改一个参数就能重跑的世界，这正是实验所需要的。
works.method: LLM agents with distinct roles (asset curation, material tuning, placement, motion control, camera and lighting) interact with a physics engine through code, check multimodal feedback on the rendered results and iterate until the rollout matches the description.
works.method_zh: 分工不同的大语言模型智能体（资产挑选、材质调整、摆放、运动控制、镜头与灯光）通过代码与物理引擎交互，查看渲染结果的多模态反馈并反复迭代，直到仿真过程符合文字描述。

paper.title: GS-Agent: Creating 4D Physical Worlds With Generative Simulation

works.title_zh: GS-Agent 以生成式仿真构建 4D 物理世界

works.title: Open Virtual Human Toolkit (2026)
works.description: The 2026 open release of USC ICT's Virtual Human Toolkit is a Unity project for building conversational 3D characters that see and hear a person and reply with speech and nonverbal behaviour, on web, mobile, desktop and Quest. Every capability (speech recognition, LLM, speech synthesis, sensing, nonverbal behaviour) sits behind one API with 20+ cloud or fully local providers; it won Best Technical Demonstration at IVA 2026 and is free for non-commercial use.
works.description_zh: USC ICT 的 Virtual Human Toolkit 于 2026 年开放发布：这是一个 Unity 项目，用于构建能看见、听见用户并以语音和非语言行为回应的对话式三维角色，可部署到网页、手机、桌面和 Quest。语音识别、大模型、语音合成、感知和非语言行为等每项能力都通过同一个 API 接入，可在 20 多家云端服务或完全本地的方案间切换；它获得 IVA 2026 最佳技术演示奖，可免费用于非商业用途。
works.idea_en: The research lineage behind SimSensei-style virtual humans, rebuilt so a lab can swap the LLM or voice in one dropdown, run everything locally for sensitive studies, and keep the rest of the character constant.
works.idea_zh: SimSensei 式虚拟人背后的研究传统被重新打造：实验室可通过一个下拉菜单更换大模型或声音，为敏感研究完全在本地运行，同时保持角色其余部分不变。
works.method: A modular Unity architecture with a common provider API for audio-visual sensing (e.g. OpenFace, DeepFace), ASR (Whisper, Azure, OpenAI Realtime), LLMs (Claude, GPT, Gemini, Ollama, vLLM), TTS (ElevenLabs, Piper, Kokoro), keyword or embedding retrieval for knowledge grounding, and rule- or model-based nonverbal behaviour on Reallusion characters.
works.method_zh: 模块化的 Unity 架构，为音视频感知（如 OpenFace、DeepFace）、语音识别（Whisper、Azure、OpenAI Realtime）、大模型（Claude、GPT、Gemini、Ollama、vLLM）、语音合成（ElevenLabs、Piper、Kokoro）、基于关键词或向量的知识检索，以及 Reallusion 角色上基于规则或模型的非语言行为提供统一的接入 API。
works.specs: 20+ providers · cloud or fully local · Web, iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, Quest

paper.title: Demonstrating the Open Virtual Human Toolkit: Any Character, Any Technology, Anywhere

works.title_zh: 开放虚拟人工具包（Virtual Human Toolkit，2026）

works.title: Volinga 4DGS for Unreal Engine
works.description: Volinga's July 2026 update to its Suite and Unreal Engine plugin plays 4D Gaussian splat captures inside Unreal as timeline assets: per-frame PLY sequences from tools such as Gracia or Houdini are packed into one compressed NVOL file and driven by Unreal's Sequencer, with lighting interaction, culling and OCIO colour management.
works.description_zh: Volinga 在 2026 年 7 月更新了其套件与 Unreal Engine 插件，使 4D 高斯泼溅捕捉能以时间轴资产的形式在 Unreal 中播放：来自 Gracia、Houdini 等工具的逐帧 PLY 序列被打包为一个压缩的 NVOL 文件，由 Unreal 的 Sequencer 驱动，并支持光照交互、裁剪体积与 OCIO 色彩管理。
works.idea_en: A captured moving performance can be placed, lit and timed in a game engine like any other asset, so a 4D recording can become one element of an authored, interactive scene.
works.idea_zh: 捕捉到的动态表演可以像其他资产一样在游戏引擎中摆放、打光和安排时序，4D 录像因此能成为人工编排的交互场景中的一个元素。
works.method: Volinga Suite converts thousands of per-frame PLYs into a single near-lossless NVOL asset; the Volinga Renderer plugin (Unreal Engine 5.8, beta) plays the frames through Sequencer tracks with no cap on 4DGS assets per scene.
works.method_zh: Volinga Suite 把成千上万个逐帧 PLY 转换为一个近乎无损的 NVOL 资产；Volinga Renderer 插件（Unreal Engine 5.8，测试版）通过 Sequencer 轨道播放这些帧，每个场景中的 4DGS 资产数量不设上限。
works.specs: Unreal Engine 5.8 · PLY / SPZ / SOG import · NVOL container · free watermarked trial, then subscriptions
works.title_zh: Volinga：Unreal Engine 中的 4D 高斯泼溅

works.title: Seed Audio 1.0
works.description: ByteDance Seed's scene-level audio creation model that generates speech, sound effects, ambience and background texture together from one prompt, so a line of dialogue arrives with its room tone, footsteps and alarms already in place. It is available through BytePlus.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的场景级音频创作模型，用一个提示同时生成语音、音效、环境声与背景质感，让一句台词连同房间混响、脚步声和警报声一起出现。可通过 BytePlus 使用。
works.idea_en: Generates the sound scene rather than separate clips, which is closer to how an immersive situation is actually heard.
works.idea_zh: 生成的是整个声音场景，而不是零散的片段，更接近人们在沉浸情境中真实听到的样子。
works.method: A unified generative framework that models the speech, effects and ambience of one scene jointly (architecture unpublished).
works.method_zh: 统一的生成框架，联合建模同一场景中的语音、音效与环境声（架构未公开）。
works.title_zh: Seed Audio 1.0 音频创作模型

works.title: Comparing the effects of GenAI-assisted and facilitator-led debriefing on knowledge and non-technical skills in immersive virtual reality simulation in nursing education: A quasi-experimental study
works.description: After an immersive VR hospital simulation, 178 undergraduate nursing students were debriefed either by a generative-AI tool plus a 10-minute facilitator summary (n = 102) or by a facilitator alone (n = 76). Knowledge rose in both groups (d = 0.79 vs. 0.72) with no difference between them after adjusting for baseline, and self-reported non-technical skills did not differ.
works.description_zh: 在一次沉浸式 VR 医院模拟之后，178 名护理本科生分别接受生成式 AI 工具主导的复盘加 10 分钟教师总结（n = 102），或仅由教师主持的复盘（n = 76）。两组知识得分均有提高（d = 0.79 与 0.72），校正基线后组间无差异，自评非技术技能也无差异。
works.idea_en: Generative AI can take over the debrief rather than the scenario; whether 'comparable' holds once groups are randomised is still open.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 可以接手复盘而不是情境本身；在随机分组之后“效果相当”是否仍然成立，还有待检验。
works.method: Quasi-experimental two-group pretest–posttest study with allocation by course enrolment; multiple-choice knowledge test before and after, self-reported non-technical skills after, ANCOVA adjusted for baseline knowledge.
works.method_zh: 准实验两组前后测设计，按选课分组；前后测采用选择题知识测验，后测加自评非技术技能，并以基线知识为协变量做协方差分析。

paper.title: Comparing the effects of GenAI-assisted and facilitator-led debriefing on knowledge and non-technical skills in immersive virtual reality simulation in nursing education: A quasi-experimental study

works.title_zh: 沉浸式 VR 护理模拟中生成式 AI 辅助复盘与教师主导复盘对知识和非技术技能的影响：准实验研究

works.title: WanToFight
works.description: A generative game engine that renders two-player The King of Fighters '97 matches frame by frame from both players' keyboards, with the fight's contacts and outcomes produced by the network rather than by game code; Alibaba's Tongyi Lab reports 30 fps for a full match on one RTX 5090.
works.description_zh: 一个生成式游戏引擎：根据两名玩家各自的键盘输入，逐帧渲染双人对战的《拳皇 97》比赛，招式接触与胜负结果都由神经网络而非游戏代码生成；阿里巴巴通义实验室称其可在单张 RTX 5090 上以 30 fps 跑完整场比赛。
works.idea_en: Two people acting against each other in one generated scene at game speed: the adversarial, contact-heavy case that single-player world models avoid.
works.idea_zh: 两个人在同一个生成场景里以游戏速度相互对抗：这正是单人世界模型回避的、充满肢体接触的对抗情形。
works.method: Built on the Wan-1.3B video diffusion transformer: a streaming autoregressive generator with block-causal attention and a rolling KV cache, a visually grounded Player Association module that binds each keyboard stream to one character, and gated, locally causal keyboard injection trained with a single-player-to-full-match curriculum; a four-step DMD-distilled student with a pruned VAE decoder runs in real time.
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan-1.3B 视频扩散 Transformer：采用块因果注意力与滚动 KV 缓存的流式自回归生成器；以画面为依据、把每路键盘信号绑定到对应角色的“玩家关联”模块；以及按“从单人到完整对局”课程训练的门控、局部因果键盘注入模块；经四步 DMD 蒸馏的学生模型配合剪枝后的 VAE 解码器实时运行。

paper.title: WanToFight: Real-Time Generative Game Engine for Multi-Player Combat Interaction

works.title_zh: WanToFight：多人格斗实时生成式游戏引擎

works.title: Wan-Dancer
works.description: Wan-Dancer (Alibaba Tongyi Lab, 2026-07-13) generates a dance video of the person in a reference image from a full music track, following its rhythm and structure across genres such as Chinese classical, K-pop, street, tap and Latin, with outfit changes and keyframe-based movement control. Tongyi reports stable 720p, 30 fps videos longer than a minute (the project page shows 2 min 36 s); the 14B weights and inference code are open under Apache-2.0, with demos on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
works.description_zh: Wan-Dancer（阿里巴巴通义实验室，2026-07-13）根据整首音乐，让参考图中的人物跳舞并生成视频，动作跟随音乐的节奏与结构，覆盖中国古典舞、K-pop、街舞、踢踏舞、拉丁舞等风格，还支持换装和基于关键帧的动作控制。通义称其可稳定生成超过一分钟的 720p、30 fps 视频（项目页展示了 2 分 36 秒的样例）；14B 权重和推理代码以 Apache-2.0 协议开源，Hugging Face 和魔搭上有在线演示。
works.idea_en: Breaks the roughly 20-second limit of audio-driven body video by planning keyframes over the whole track first, so a generated performer can carry a full song without drifting in identity or motion.
works.idea_zh: 先对整首曲子规划关键帧，突破了音频驱动全身视频约 20 秒的时长限制，让生成的表演者能完整演完一首歌而不出现身份或动作漂移。
works.method: A hierarchical image-to-video diffusion pipeline on Wan: a global stage plans keyframes from the full music track, and a local stage refines the motion between them, with time-mapped RoPE for dynamic frame rates, an optical-flow loss for motion continuity and motion-speed control for fast movements.
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan 的分层图生视频扩散管线：全局阶段根据整首音乐规划关键帧，局部阶段细化关键帧之间的动作；通过时间映射 RoPE 适配动态帧率，用光流损失增强动作连续性，并用动作速度控制保留快速动作中的细节。
works.specs: 720p · 30 fps · >1 min per video (up to 2 min 36 s shown) · 14B parameters

paper.title: Wan-Dancer: A Hierarchical Framework for Minute-scale Coherent Music-to-Dance Generation

works.title_zh: Wan-Dancer：分钟级连贯的音乐驱动舞蹈视频生成

works.title: PanoWorld
works.description: A panoramic (360°) world model from Insta360 Research and the Chinese Academy of Sciences that generates real-world 360° video as the viewpoint travels and remembers places it has passed, released with weights and World360, a dataset of panoramic drone footage and simulated clips.
works.description_zh: Insta360 研究团队与中国科学院合作的全景（360°）世界模型：随视点移动生成真实场景的 360° 视频，并记住经过的地方；同时发布了模型权重和 World360 数据集（全景无人机实拍与仿真片段）。
works.idea_en: A world model whose native output is a full sphere is the shortest path to putting generated places in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 原生输出就是完整球面画面的世界模型，是把生成场所放进头显的最短路径。
works.method: Uses the rotation equivariance of panoramas to reduce camera paths to translations with fixed headings, with Dense Panoramic Ray-Conditioning for actions and Geometry-aware Memory Augmentation for long-range memory, trained in three stages.
works.method_zh: 利用全景图的旋转等变性，把相机轨迹简化为固定朝向下的平移；用“稠密全景射线条件”表示动作，用“几何感知记忆增强”实现长程记忆，分三阶段训练。

paper.title: PanoWorld: Real-World Panoramic Generation

works.title: ARDY
works.description: Streaming motion generator from NVIDIA and ETH Zürich that produces 3D human motion in real time while accepting new text prompts and kinematic constraints on the fly: root paths, waypoints, full-body keyframes and sparse joint targets.
works.description_zh: 英伟达与苏黎世联邦理工学院的流式动作生成模型，可实时生成三维人体动作，并能随时接收新的文字提示和运动学约束：根轨迹、路径点、全身关键帧和稀疏关节目标。
works.idea_en: Moves text-to-motion from offline clips to a live, steerable body, the property a generated virtual human needs when a participant changes the situation mid-scene.
works.idea_zh: 把文生动作从离线片段推进到实时、可操控的身体——当参与者在场景中途改变情境时，生成的虚拟人正需要这种能力。
works.method: A two-stage autoregressive transformer denoiser over a hybrid representation (explicit root features plus a latent body embedding), with variable history context and long-horizon constraint conditioning, trained on a large motion-capture corpus.
works.method_zh: 基于混合表示（显式根节点特征加潜在身体嵌入）的两阶段自回归 Transformer 去噪器，支持可变长度的历史上下文和长时程约束条件，在大规模动捕语料上训练。

paper.title: ARDY: Autoregressive Diffusion with Hybrid Representation for Interactive Human Motion Generation

works.title: CyberSelf: Embodied Self-Distancing for Emotional Support in Virtual Reality
works.description: Users talk in VR with a doppelgänger: an avatar reconstructed from a 20-second face video, speaking in their cloned voice, with LLM-driven dialogue. A short-term study (n=24) compared text, text+voice and text+voice+appearance; a four-week study (n=12) with stressed PhD students tested repeated use.
works.description_zh: 用户在 VR 中与“数字分身”对话：这个化身由约 20 秒的面部视频重建，用其克隆的声音说话，对话由大语言模型驱动。短期研究（n=24）比较了纯文本、文本+声音、文本+声音+外貌三种条件；为期四周的研究（n=12）以压力较大的博士生为对象，检验了反复使用的效果。
works.idea_en: Self-resemblance becomes a dial: each layer of generated likeness (text, voice, face) can be switched on separately and its effect on emotion regulation measured.
works.idea_zh: “像自己”的程度变成可调参数：生成的相似性（文本、声音、面孔）可以逐层打开，并分别测量其对情绪调节的作用。
works.method: Unreal Engine 5 avatar reconstruction from a short face video, voice cloning, Whisper speech input and LLM dialogue; within-subjects comparison of three representation levels with questionnaires and physiological measures, plus a four-week longitudinal self-compassion study.
works.method_zh: 用 Unreal Engine 5 从短视频重建化身，结合声音克隆、Whisper 语音输入与大语言模型对话；被试内比较三种表征层级，测量问卷与生理指标，并开展为期四周的自我关怀纵向研究。
works.specs: N=36 (24 short-term + 12 four-week) · ~20 s face video + ~19 s voice sample

paper.title: CyberSelf: Embodied Self-Distancing for Emotional Support in Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: CyberSelf：在虚拟现实中以具身自我疏离提供情绪支持

works.title: AlayaWorld
works.description: An open, full-stack framework for playable video worlds, released with training and inference code, weights and part of the training data: a 15B autoregressive model streams 720p at 24 fps under on-screen joystick camera control, switches prompts on the fly and runs for over a minute per clip without visible drift.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩视频世界的开源全栈框架，公开了训练与推理代码、权重以及部分训练数据：15B 自回归模型在屏幕摇杆控制镜头的情况下以 720p、24 fps 流式生成，可随时切换提示，每段可连续生成一分钟以上且无明显漂移。
works.idea_en: Open training code and data, not only weights, are what let a lab retrain a world model on its own scenarios.
works.idea_zh: 开放的不只是权重，还有训练代码与数据，这才让实验室能够用自己的情境重新训练世界模型。
works.method: Chunk-wise autoregressive video generation distilled to a few steps (DMD), trained on drifted histories with an error bank that re-injects accumulated artifacts; v1.1 (August 2026) replaced depth-warping spatial memory with a streaming 3D point-cache renderer.
works.method_zh: 分块自回归视频生成，经 DMD 蒸馏为少步推理；在带漂移的历史上训练，并用“误差库”重新注入累积伪影；v1.1（2026 年 8 月）把基于深度扭曲的空间记忆换成流式三维点缓存渲染器。
works.specs: 720p · 24 fps · 15B parameters · over 1 min per rollout (developer-reported)

paper.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation

works.title: Designing and evaluating LLM-driven coaching agents for VR public speaking practice
works.description: Embodied virtual judges in a VR auditorium give spoken, performance-contingent coaching after each speech, generated by ERNIE Bot from speech recognition and gaze cues. In a two-arm randomized study (N=120), adaptive coaching reduced self-reported speaking anxiety more than attention-matched generic feedback, and the difference was still visible at one-week and one-month follow-ups.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 礼堂中，具身的虚拟评委在每次演讲后给出口头的、针对表现的指导，内容由文心一言（ERNIE Bot）根据语音识别与视线线索生成。两臂随机研究（N=120）显示：与注意力匹配的通用反馈相比，自适应指导更明显地降低了自评演讲焦虑，差异在一周和一个月随访时仍可见。
works.idea_en: An attention-matched control isolates what the LLM adds: tailored coaching, not just the presence of a talking agent.
works.idea_zh: 注意力匹配的对照组分离出了大语言模型的贡献：起作用的是量身定制的指导，而不只是“有个会说话的智能体”。
works.method: VR system with ASR, TTS, gaze-related cues and structured prompting of ERNIE Bot at three coaching levels; randomized 60/60 user study with repeated state-anxiety and PRCA measures and follow-ups after one week and one month.
works.method_zh: VR 系统集成语音识别、语音合成、视线线索，并以三级结构化提示调用文心一言；60/60 随机用户研究，重复测量状态焦虑与 PRCA 量表，并在一周和一个月后随访。

paper.title: Designing and evaluating LLM-driven coaching agents for VR public speaking practice

works.title_zh: 面向 VR 演讲练习的大语言模型教练智能体：设计与评估

works.title: EmbodiedGen V2
works.description: Horizon Robotics' open toolkit turns text, images and natural-language dialogue into simulation-ready assets, task-driven rooms and large multi-room scenes that load in Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Genesis, SAPIEN and PyBullet; version 2 (July 2026) follows EmbodiedGen (June 2025).
works.description_zh: 地平线的开源工具包：把文字、图像和自然语言对话变成可直接仿真的资产、按任务生成的房间以及大型多房间场景，可在 Isaac Sim、MuJoCo、Genesis、SAPIEN 和 PyBullet 中加载；第二版（2026 年 7 月）接续 2025 年 6 月的 EmbodiedGen。
works.idea_en: Authoring a task environment by conversation ('vibe coding' the scene) lowers the cost of building many variants of the same situation.
works.idea_zh: 通过对话来搭建任务环境（用“氛围编程”写场景），降低了为同一情境制作大量变体的成本。
works.method: A unified sim-ready representation links generated assets (with collision and affordance data), task-driven layouts, multi-room scene generation and a stateful LLM coding loop; the authors report 96.5% human acceptance of assets and 83.3% of task worlds usable without manual fixes.
works.method_zh: 以统一的“可仿真”表示串起生成资产（含碰撞与可供性数据）、按任务布局、多房间场景生成和有状态的语言模型编程循环；作者报告资产的人工认可率为 96.5%，83.3% 的任务世界无需人工修改即可使用。
works.specs: 96.5% asset acceptance · 83.3% task worlds usable as generated · Isaac Sim / MuJoCo / Genesis / SAPIEN / PyBullet

paper.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI

works.title_zh: 地平线 EmbodiedGen V2

works.title: GPT-Live
works.description: A full-duplex voice model that now powers ChatGPT Voice: it listens while it speaks, says 'mhmm' or 'yeah' to show attention and can stay quiet while the user thinks. Harder requests are handed to a frontier model (GPT-5.5 at launch) in the background while the conversation continues. GPT-Live-1 became generally available in the API on 10 September 2026, and GPT-Live-1.1 (15 October 2026) added voices and accents in ChatGPT.
works.description_zh: 一个全双工语音模型，现在驱动 ChatGPT 语音：它边说边听，会用“嗯哼”“对”表示在听，也能在用户思考时保持安静。较难的请求会在后台交给前沿模型（发布时为 GPT-5.5）处理，对话不中断。GPT-Live-1 于 2026 年 9 月 10 日在 API 中正式可用，GPT-Live-1.1（2026 年 10 月 15 日）为 ChatGPT 增加了新声音和口音。
works.idea_en: OpenAI's own break with turn-based voice: the mainstream ChatGPT voice now overlaps and backchannels, so full-duplex timing is no longer a research-only property.
works.idea_zh: OpenAI 自己告别了回合制语音：主流的 ChatGPT 语音如今会重叠发言、会附和，全双工的对话节奏不再只是研究原型的特性。
works.method: Full-duplex architecture that processes input continuously while generating output, with background delegation to a reasoning model; outputs carry SynthID watermarks since 31 July 2026.
works.method_zh: 全双工架构：在生成输出的同时持续处理输入，并把推理任务委托给后台模型；自 2026 年 7 月 31 日起输出带有 SynthID 水印。
works.specs: GPT-Live-1 and GPT-Live-1 mini · ChatGPT · API GA 2026-09-10 (v1/live/sessions) · $0.05/min billed per second (backend model billed separately)

works.title: LingBot-World 2.0
works.description: The second LingBot world model (also called LingBot-World-Infinity), which Robbyant describes as the first hour-long interactive world model: an unbounded interaction horizon, attacks, archery and spell-casting actions, text-driven events, and an agent harness with a 'pilot' agent that plays and a 'director' agent that adds scene elements.
works.description_zh: 第二代 LingBot 世界模型（又名 LingBot-World-Infinity），灵波科技称其为首个可交互一小时的世界模型：交互时长不设上限，支持攻击、射箭、施法等动作和文字驱动的事件，并配有智能体框架：“驾驶员”智能体负责游玩，“导演”智能体负责添加场景元素。
works.idea_en: Pairs a world model with two LLM agents, one acting and one directing, a pattern that maps directly onto confederate and experimenter roles.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型与两个大模型智能体搭配：一个负责行动、一个负责导演，这一模式可以直接对应实验中的“同谋者”与“实验者”角色。
works.method: Causal pretraining for unbounded rollouts, a distilled real-time variant, and an agentic harness in which a pilot agent plans character behavior and a director agent synthesizes new environmental elements as the scene progresses.
works.method_zh: 通过因果预训练实现无上限的推演，蒸馏出实时版本，并加入智能体框架：驾驶员智能体规划角色行为，导演智能体随场景推进合成新的环境元素。

paper.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions

works.title_zh: LingBot-World 2.0（蚂蚁灵波）

works.title: MoWorld
works.description: A 'flash' interactive video world model trained and served on domestic NPUs (the code targets Huawei Ascend): Moxin reports continuous-control generation at up to 50 fps and an inference cost of 30–50% of existing world-model systems; shown at WAIC 2026 and open-sourced in September 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个在国产 NPU 上训练和部署的“闪电”交互视频世界模型（代码面向华为昇腾）：Moxin 称其可连续控制生成、最高 50 fps，推理成本为现有世界模型方案的 30%–50%；曾在 2026 年世界人工智能大会展出，并于 2026 年 9 月开源。
works.idea_en: Real-time world models that do not depend on NVIDIA hardware change who can afford to run them, especially in China.
works.idea_zh: 不依赖 NVIDIA 硬件的实时世界模型，会改变谁能负担得起运行它们，在中国尤其如此。
works.method: Training clips from a 3D-native data engine for geometric consistency, curriculum cross-frame pre-training, denoising-step distillation and a mixed-precision parallel inference stack on NPUs.
works.method_zh: 用三维原生数据引擎生成几何一致的训练片段，配合课程式跨帧预训练、去噪步数蒸馏，以及 NPU 上的混合精度并行推理框架。
works.specs: up to 50 fps on NPUs · 30–50% of reference inference cost (developer-reported)

paper.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model

works.title: MIRA
works.description: An open multiplayer world model of Rocket League in which four people play a 2v2 match in a browser, each seeing a consistent generated view at 20 fps, with boost, goals and demolitions tracked by the model alone; an autopilot mode lets the model play for absent players.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的《火箭联盟》多人世界模型：四名玩家在浏览器中进行 2 对 2 比赛，每人看到的生成画面都保持一致，帧率 20 fps；加速槽、进球与撞毁全部由模型自行追踪；“自动驾驶”模式还能让模型替缺席的玩家上场。
works.idea_en: Several people share one generated situation and see each other's actions, with no game engine underneath; the developers report it runs indefinitely without diverging.
works.idea_zh: 多人共享同一个生成情境并看到彼此的动作，背后没有任何游戏引擎；开发者称它可以无限运行而不发散。
works.method: A 5B-parameter diffusion transformer over a 600M-parameter video representation codec, trained on bot gameplay with action dropout, conditioned on all four players' inputs; developed by General Intuition and Kyutai with Epic Games.
works.method_zh: 以 6 亿参数的视频表征编解码器为基础的 50 亿参数扩散 Transformer，在机器人对局录像上以“动作随机丢弃”方式训练，并以四名玩家的输入为条件；由 General Intuition 与 Kyutai 联合 Epic Games 开发。
works.specs: 4 players · 20 fps · 576p split across players · 5B + 600M parameters (developer-reported)

paper.title: Multiplayer Interactive World Models with Representation Autoencoders

works.title_zh: MIRA：多人交互世界模型

works.title: PixWorld
works.description: One open diffusion model that both reconstructs the views it is given and generates the ones it is not: posed input images go in, and a pixel-aligned 3D Gaussian scene comes out in a single forward pass, from NTU and AIsphere (PixVerse).
works.description_zh: 一个同时完成重建与生成的开源扩散模型：对给定的视角做重建，对缺失的视角做生成；输入带位姿的图像，单次前向即可输出像素对齐的三维高斯场景。由南洋理工大学与爱诗科技（PixVerse）合作完成。
works.idea_en: When reconstruction and generation are one model, how much of a scene is captured versus invented becomes a matter of how many views you supply.
works.idea_zh: 当重建与生成是同一个模型时，场景中有多少是拍到的、有多少是想象的，就取决于你提供了多少视角。
works.method: Posed multi-view inputs are split into a clean subset (reconstruction) and a noisy subset (generation), processed by a two-stream diffusion transformer and decoded into pixel-aligned 3D Gaussians, with a flow-matching loss defined on rendered images plus a geometry-perception loss.
works.method_zh: 把带位姿的多视角输入分成干净子集（重建）和加噪子集（生成），由双流扩散 Transformer 处理并解码为像素对齐的三维高斯；损失直接定义在渲染图像上的流匹配目标，并加入几何感知损失。

paper.title: PixWorld: Unifying 3D Scene Generation and Reconstruction in Pixel Space

works.title: SynCity 3000
works.description: From one text prompt, and optionally a layout, SynCity 3000 generates a large, coherent 3D Gaussian-splat scene (a suburb, a theme park, desert ruins, sea ice with an icebreaker) that can be explored from any angle, without the visible tile grid of the earlier SynCity.
works.description_zh: 只需一句文字提示（可选地再给一个布局），SynCity 3000 就能生成一个大范围、整体连贯的三维高斯泼溅场景（郊区街道、主题乐园、沙漠遗迹、带破冰船的海冰），可以从任意角度探索，也不再有早期 SynCity 那样明显的分块网格。
works.idea_en: Using an object generator as a convolution over a whole-scene image gives worlds of arbitrary size with placement control, a route to large generated situations that stay editable.
works.idea_zh: 把物体生成器当作在整幅场景图上滑动的卷积来用，就能得到任意大小、可控制布局的世界，这是一条通向大规模且仍可编辑的生成情境的路线。
works.method: Two stages: a high-resolution dimetric 2D scene template is generated from the prompt with joint diffusion over overlapping latent windows (MultiDiffusion-style, with optional layout constraints); an image-to-3D generator fine-tuned on 320k procedurally generated scenes from a new synthetic data engine then converts it region by region into 3D Gaussian splats, with surrounding context for coherence.
works.method_zh: 分两步：先根据提示用重叠潜变量窗口上的联合扩散（类似 MultiDiffusion，可加布局约束）生成高分辨率的二等角二维场景模板；再用一个在新合成数据引擎生成的 32 万个程序化场景上微调过的图生三维模型，逐区域把模板转换为三维高斯泼溅，并参考周围上下文保持一致。
works.specs: Text → 3DGS scene of arbitrary size · fine-tuned on 320k synthetic scenes

paper.title: SynCity 3000: Bootstrapping Scene-Scale 3D Diffusion

works.title: CoGen3D
works.description: An agent interviews a user about the object they want for a VR scene, shows a concept image for confirmation, then generates a 3D asset and places it in the immersive scene; a 120-person study compared people who co-designed assets with people who only experienced the scenes.
works.description_zh: 智能体先就用户想为 VR 场景添加的物体进行提问，给出概念图供确认，再生成三维资产并放入沉浸式场景；一项 120 人的研究比较了共同设计资产的人和只体验场景的人。
works.idea_en: Co-designed assets were linked to higher engagement and shifted emotional responses, while people still preferred the concept images to the final 3D models, a measure of the image-to-3D quality gap.
works.idea_zh: 共同设计的资产与更高的投入度和情绪反应的变化相关，但人们仍更喜欢概念图而不是最终的三维模型，这反映出图像到三维之间的质量落差。
works.method: Staged pipeline: conversational intent elicitation by an LLM agent, concept-image confirmation, image-to-3D generation and direct deployment to six affectively different VR scenes on Meta Quest 3; 60 designers and 60 validators.
works.method_zh: 分阶段流程：由大语言模型智能体对话式地引出意图，确认概念图，再进行图生三维并直接部署到 Meta Quest 3 上六个情绪基调不同的 VR 场景；60 名设计者与 60 名验证者参与。

paper.title: CoGen3D: An Agentic Human-AI Co-Design Pipeline for 3D Asset Generation for Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: CoGen3D：为虚拟现实生成三维资产的人机协同设计智能体流程

works.title: Toolboxes for creating immersive virtual reality experiments in psychological, behavioral, and cognitive research: A scoping review
works.description: Scoping review that maps the software toolboxes researchers use to build head-mounted-display experiments in psychology, behavioral science and cognitive neuroscience, and turns the map into a decision framework for researchers who do not program.
works.description_zh: 一篇范围综述：梳理心理学、行为科学与认知神经科学研究者用来搭建头显实验的软件工具箱，并据此为不会编程的研究者提供选型决策框架。
works.idea_en: Before generation, the bottleneck is authoring: this map shows how much of a VR experiment non-programmers can already build and control.
works.idea_zh: 在“生成”之前，瓶颈是“创作”：这份梳理展示了不会编程的研究者目前已能搭建并控制 VR 实验的多大部分。
works.method: Scoping review of published VR experiment toolboxes, charting usability and application features into an evidence map and a decision-support framework.
works.method_zh: 对已发表的 VR 实验工具箱做范围综述，按可用性与应用特征整理成证据地图与决策支持框架。

paper.title: Toolboxes for creating immersive virtual reality experiments in psychological, behavioral, and cognitive research: A scoping review

works.title_zh: 用于心理学、行为与认知研究的沉浸式虚拟现实实验工具箱：范围综述

works.title: Vidu S1
works.description: Vidu S1 (2026-07-03) is Shengshu's real-time interactive video model: a generated character or scene responds within milliseconds as you talk to it, for uses such as talking pets or gaming companions.
works.description_zh: Vidu S1（2026-07-03）是生数科技的实时交互视频模型：你对它说话时，生成的角色或场景会在毫秒级作出回应，可用于“会说话的宠物”、游戏陪伴等场景。
works.idea_en: Conversation-paced video generation moves video models into the turn-taking loop of virtual humans.
works.idea_zh: 跟得上对话节奏的视频生成，把视频模型带进了虚拟人的轮流对话循环。
works.method: Real-time video generation conditioned on streaming voice input; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 以流式语音输入为条件的实时视频生成；架构未公开。

works.title: WorldDirector
works.description: A controllable world-simulator framework in which a language model first plans the 3D paths of moving characters and the camera, and a video model then renders them, so a person or animal that leaves the frame returns in the right place with the same appearance; from HKUST and Ant Group, with 14B weights released.
works.description_zh: 一个可控的世界模拟框架：先由语言模型规划运动角色与相机的三维轨迹，再由视频模型渲染出来，因此离开画面的人或动物再次出现时，位置正确、外观不变；由香港科技大学与蚂蚁集团合作，已公开 14B 模型权重。
works.idea_en: Keeping the plan of who moves where outside the pixels lets a generated world remember moving things, not just static scenery.
works.idea_zh: 把“谁往哪里走”的计划放在像素之外，生成的世界就能记住会动的东西，而不只是静态布景。
works.method: Decouples semantic motion orchestration from visual generation: an LLM coordinates 3D object trajectories with camera movement, and the orchestrated trajectories condition a 14B video generator at 480p.
works.method_zh: 把语义层面的运动编排与画面生成解耦：由大语言模型协调物体三维轨迹与相机运动，再以编排好的轨迹作为条件，驱动 14B 视频生成模型输出 480p 视频。

paper.title: WorldDirector: Building Controllable World Simulators with Persistent Dynamic Memory

works.title_zh: WorldDirector：带持久动态记忆的可控世界模拟器

works.title: World from Motion
works.description: NVIDIA and Stanford method that turns an ordinary monocular video of a dynamic scene, such as a street, a store or a dancer, into a dynamic 3D Gaussian scene that can be rendered from new viewpoints: a video model conditioned on the initial reconstruction fills in unseen regions and fixes artefacts, and its output is distilled back into one consistent 4D representation. The project page includes a browser viewer of the results.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 与斯坦福大学的方法：把一段普通的动态场景单目视频（例如街道、商店或舞者）转换为可从新视角渲染的动态三维高斯场景；以初始重建为条件的视频模型负责补全看不到的区域、修正瑕疵，其输出再蒸馏回同一个一致的 4D 表示。项目主页提供了可在浏览器中查看结果的查看器。
works.idea_en: A single handheld clip can become a walk-around 4D scene, with the unseen sides filled in by a video model rather than left as holes.
works.idea_zh: 一段手持拍摄的视频就能变成可以绕着走的 4D 场景，看不到的那一面由视频模型补上，而不是留下空洞。
works.method: A video generator is conditioned on dense pixel-aligned renderings of appearance, geometry and 3D scene motion along input and target camera paths; trained on aligned multi-view video pairs with simulated monocular-reconstruction artefacts, its generations for new viewpoints are distilled into a single dynamic 3DGS.
works.method_zh: 视频生成器以沿输入与目标相机路径渲染的外观、几何和三维场景运动等稠密像素对齐图为条件；用带有模拟单目重建瑕疵的对齐多视角视频对训练，再把它为新视角生成的画面蒸馏进同一个动态 3DGS。

paper.title: World from Motion: Generative Dynamic Gaussian Reconstruction from Monocular Video

works.title_zh: World from Motion 单目视频的生成式动态高斯重建

works.title: MemLearner
works.description: A learned memory query for video world models: instead of retrieving past frames by hand-written rules such as camera overlap, the model uses query tokens to decide what context to read, which keeps scenes consistent through occlusions and moving objects (HKU with Kuaishou).
works.description_zh: 一种为视频世界模型学习得到的记忆查询方式：不再按相机视野重叠之类的人工规则调取历史帧，而是用查询 token 决定读取哪些上下文，从而在遮挡和物体移动时保持场景一致（香港大学与快手合作）。
works.idea_en: Moves memory retrieval from a fixed rule to something the model learns, which matters once scenes contain people and objects that move.
works.idea_zh: 把记忆检索从固定规则变成模型自己学会的能力；一旦场景里有会移动的人和物，这一点就很关键。
works.method: Learnable query tokens bridge stored context and the tokens being predicted, using the pretrained video generator itself to query memory, without training a separate retrieval model.
works.method_zh: 用可学习的查询 token 连接已存储的上下文与正在预测的 token，直接利用预训练视频生成模型本身查询记忆，无需另训检索模型。

paper.title: MemLearner: Learning to Query Context memory for Video World Models

works.title_zh: MemLearner：学习查询上下文记忆

works.title: WorldRoamBench
works.description: A benchmark from Amap (Alibaba) with Nanjing, Tsinghua and Peking universities that tests interactive world models over 10–60 s rollouts on more than 1,000 first- and third-person cases in indoor, nature and urban scenes. It scores per-frame action following, visual drift, interaction physics (collision, clipping, gravity, reflections, shadows) and memory, and keeps a leaderboard of 10+ open and closed models including Genie 3; as of October 2026 the dataset download is marked 'coming soon'.
works.description_zh: 由高德地图（阿里巴巴）与南京大学、清华大学、北京大学共同推出的基准，用 1,000 多个第一人称与第三人称测试用例（室内、自然、城市场景）检验交互式世界模型在 10–60 秒推演中的表现。它对逐帧动作跟随、画面漂移、交互物理（碰撞、穿模、重力、反射、阴影）与记忆分别打分，并维护一个包含 Genie 3 在内、覆盖 10 多个开源与闭源模型的排行榜；截至 2026 年 10 月，数据集下载仍标注为“即将推出”。
works.idea_en: A model can follow a path well on average and still miss individual key presses, and respecting collisions can pull it off the prescribed path: averages hide what a participant would actually feel.
works.idea_zh: 一个模型可以在平均意义上很好地沿路径行进，却仍会漏掉单次按键；而遵守碰撞约束又可能让它偏离预定路线。平均分掩盖了参与者真正会感受到的东西。
works.method: Model rollouts on a shared test suite are scored by four modules (action, vision, physics, memory); memory is measured by reconstructing scene point clouds, which separates forgetting from action-following drift.
works.method_zh: 在统一的测试集上运行各模型，由动作、视觉、物理与记忆四个模块打分；记忆通过重建场景点云来衡量，从而把“遗忘”与动作跟随偏差区分开。
works.specs: 1,000+ cases · 10–60 s rollouts · 4 dimensions · 10+ models (open and closed)

paper.title: WorldRoamBench: An Open-World Benchmark for Long-Horizon Stability of Interactive World Models

works.title: FacePlex
works.description: FacePlex generates a conversational avatar's speech and facial motion together, token by token, while the user talks, prepares mouth shapes before the matching audio is emitted, and adds non-verbal reactions grounded in the dialogue, rendered with Gaussian splatting.
works.description_zh: FacePlex 在用户说话的同时逐 token 地联合生成对话虚拟人的语音和面部动作，在对应音频发出之前就准备好口型，并加入与对话内容相关的非语言反应，最后用高斯泼溅渲染。
works.idea_en: Shows that a full-duplex face needs to anticipate its own speech, not just follow it.
works.idea_zh: 说明全双工的脸需要预判自己将要说的话，而不只是跟着语音动。
works.method: A unified streaming framework that places speech tokens, facial-motion tokens and Gaussian-splatting rendering on one shared timeline, built on a full-duplex spoken dialogue model.
works.method_zh: 一个统一的流式框架，把语音 token、面部动作 token 和高斯泼溅渲染放在同一条时间线上，基于全双工语音对话模型构建。

paper.title: FacePlex: Toward Natural Full-Duplex Conversational Avatars

works.title_zh: FacePlex：全双工对话虚拟人

works.title: Synthetic embodiment: a framework for AI-generated identity cues in virtual reality and immersive environments
works.description: A hypothesis-and-theory article that treats avatar identity as a controllable design space (phenotype, gender presentation, age, cultural markers, ambiguity, intersectional cues) and proposes the Embodiment Categorization Bias model, in which identity cues shape embodiment strength, then social categorization, then intergroup outcomes such as bias, empathy and cooperation. A feasibility demonstration turns specified identity variables into prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini (Nano Banana Pro) and Tripo, producing nine preliminary avatar stimuli that the authors explicitly do not treat as validated.
works.description_zh: 一篇假说与理论文章：把化身身份视为一个可控的设计空间（表型、性别呈现、年龄、文化标记、模糊性、交叉性线索），并提出“具身分类偏差”（ECB）模型——身份线索先影响具身强度，再影响社会分类，最终影响偏见、共情与合作等群际结果。可行性演示把设定好的身份变量转化为提示词，交给 ChatGPT、Gemini（Nano Banana Pro）和 Tripo，得到九个初步化身刺激；作者明确说明这些刺激尚未经过验证。
works.idea_en: Generative avatars could turn identity into an independent variable that varies in fine steps, provided every generated stimulus is perceptually validated and audited for bias.
works.idea_zh: 生成式化身可以把身份变成能精细调节的自变量，前提是每个生成刺激都经过感知验证和偏差审查。
works.method: Conceptual framework plus a five-stage methodological pipeline (generation, standardisation, immersive integration, perceptual validation, fairness auditing) and an illustrative prompt-to-avatar demonstration across three generative systems.
works.method_zh: 概念框架，加上五阶段方法流程（生成、标准化、沉浸式集成、感知验证、公平性审查），以及在三个生成系统上从提示词到化身的示例演示。

paper.title: Synthetic embodiment: a framework for AI-generated identity cues in virtual reality and immersive environments

works.title_zh: 合成具身：虚拟现实与沉浸式环境中 AI 生成身份线索的框架

works.title: SimFoundry
works.description: From a short video of a real tabletop or room, NVIDIA's SimFoundry builds a physics-ready simulation scene (a Gaussian-splat background plus textured object meshes, including articulated ones) in under an hour, then generates 'digital cousins' that vary objects, layout and task; the code was released under Apache 2.0 in August 2026.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 SimFoundry 由一段真实桌面或房间的短视频，在一小时内自动搭建可做物理仿真的场景（高斯泼溅背景加带纹理的物体网格，包括可活动的关节物体），再生成改变物体、布局与任务的“数字表亲”；代码于 2026 年 8 月以 Apache 2.0 许可开源。
works.idea_en: A real setting becomes a family of controlled variants with the same affordances, and the authors show that evaluation in those variants predicts real-world results, the property a study would want from a simulated room.
works.idea_zh: 一个真实场景变成一组功能可供性相同、受控变化的变体，作者还表明在这些变体中的评估能预测真实世界的结果：这正是研究希望模拟房间具备的性质。
works.method: A modular pipeline segments every object (SAM 3), estimates depth (Depth Anything 3) and pose (FoundationPose), generates textured meshes (Hunyuan3D-2) and compiles an OmniGibson scene with physical parameters, task proposals and affordance-preserving variations.
works.method_zh: 模块化流程：分割每个物体（SAM 3）、估计深度（Depth Anything 3）与位姿（FoundationPose）、生成带纹理网格（Hunyuan3D-2），再编译成带物理参数、任务建议和保持可供性的变体的 OmniGibson 场景。
works.specs: video → sim scene in < 1 h · sim-vs-real policy evaluation: mean Pearson r = 0.911 (7 tasks, 5 policy architectures)

paper.title: SimFoundry: Modular and Automated Scene Generation for Policy Learning and Evaluation

works.title: LiveEdit
works.description: LiveEdit (Tsinghua University and HKUST, ECCV 2026) edits a live video stream frame by frame from a text instruction, changing only the requested region while background and unedited parts stay stable; the authors report 12.66 fps with a 4-step distilled causal model.
works.description_zh: LiveEdit（清华大学与港科大，ECCV 2026）按文字指令逐帧编辑实时视频流，只改动指定区域，背景与未编辑部分保持稳定；作者报告其 4 步蒸馏的因果模型可达 12.66 fps。
works.idea_en: Region-preserving live edits are what passthrough restyling needs: change one object in a person's view without the rest of the room flickering.
works.idea_zh: 保留未编辑区域的实时编辑正是透视画面改写所需要的：只改变视野中的一个物体，房间其余部分不会闪烁。
works.method: Three-stage distillation from a bidirectional editing model into a causal, chunk-wise streaming DiT, plus an AR-oriented mask cache that reuses computation for unedited regions.
works.method_zh: 三阶段蒸馏，把双向编辑模型迁移为因果、按块的流式 DiT，并用面向自回归的掩码缓存复用未编辑区域的计算。

paper.title: LiveEdit: Towards Real-Time Diffusion-Based Streaming Video Editing

works.title_zh: LiveEdit：基于扩散的实时流式视频编辑

works.title: Wan-Streamer
works.description: Wan-Streamer is an end-to-end model that listens, sees, thinks, speaks and responds on video at the same time, inside one Transformer, with no separate speech recognition, LLM, TTS or avatar modules. Version 0.3 (July 2026) adds 'world + event stream' video pretraining for free-form behaviour; the demos show real-time full-duplex video conversation.
works.description_zh: Wan-Streamer 是一个端到端模型，在同一个 Transformer 中同时完成听、看、思考、说话和视频回应，不依赖单独的语音识别、大模型、语音合成或虚拟人模块。0.3 版（2026 年 7 月）加入“世界设定 + 事件流”的视频预训练以支持自由行为；演示展示了实时的全双工视频对话。
works.idea_en: Collapses the whole cascade into one streaming model, so timing, turn-taking and expression are learned jointly rather than stitched together.
works.idea_zh: 把整条级联压缩进一个流式模型，时机、轮流发言和表情都在一起学习，而不是拼接起来。
works.method: Interleaved visual, audio and text input and output tokens in a single Transformer with block-causal attention, causal encoders and decoders for incremental streaming.
works.method_zh: 在单个 Transformer 中交错排列视觉、音频与文本的输入和输出 token，配合块因果注意力以及因果编码器与解码器，实现增量式流式生成。

paper.title: Wan-Streamer v0.1: End-to-end Real-time Interactive Foundation Models

works.title_zh: Wan-Streamer：面向实时交互的端到端基础模型

works.title: FiCA
works.description: FiCA (Feed-forward instant Gaussian Codec Avatars) turns one casually taken portrait photo into a photorealistic, drivable 3D Gaussian head avatar in about five seconds, which can then be animated with new expressions in real time, without per-person optimisation.
works.description_zh: FiCA（前馈即时高斯 Codec Avatars）只需一张随手拍的人像照片，约五秒即可生成照片级、可驱动的三维高斯头部化身，随后可实时驱动出新的表情，无需针对每个人做优化。
works.idea_en: A selfie becomes a Codec-Avatar-grade 3D head in seconds, which lowers the cost of putting a specific face into an XR scene to almost nothing.
works.idea_zh: 一张自拍在几秒内变成 Codec Avatar 级别的三维头部，把特定面孔放进 XR 场景的成本降到接近于零。
works.method: Fine-tuned Sapiens models unwrap the photo into partial UV texture, normal and geometry maps; a UV-space diffusion model completes them, a feed-forward refinement network sharpens identity, and a universal Codec Avatar prior decodes the mesh into 3D Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 先用微调的 Sapiens 模型把照片展开为不完整的 UV 纹理、法线和几何图，再由 UV 空间扩散模型补全，前馈细化网络增强身份特征，最后由通用 Codec Avatar 先验把网格解码成三维高斯。
works.specs: single image · ~5 s per avatar · real-time animation

paper.title: FiCA: Feed-forward instant Gaussian Codec Avatars from a Single Portrait Image

works.title_zh: FiCA：从单张人像前馈即时生成高斯 Codec Avatars

works.title: Houdini 22 Gaussian Splats
works.description: Houdini 22, announced at SideFX's London launch event on 2026-06-22, makes Gaussian splats a production data type: captures can be trained on render farms and cleaned up, splats can be rigged and animated with the standard deformation tools or driven by simulations, relit with prototype SideFX Labs tools, composited, and generated directly from Karma renders. Houdini 21 had offered only read-only viewing and rendering of splats.
works.description_zh: Houdini 22 于 2026 年 6 月 22 日在 SideFX 伦敦发布会上公布，把高斯泼溅变成生产级数据类型：采集数据可以在渲染农场上训练并清理，泼溅可以用标准变形工具绑定和制作动画，或由仿真驱动，可以用 SideFX Labs 的原型工具重新打光，进行合成，还能直接从 Karma 渲染结果生成。Houdini 21 对泼溅只支持只读的查看与渲染。
works.idea_en: Splats stop being a viewer format and become editable material in the same professional pipeline as meshes, rigs and simulations.
works.idea_zh: 高斯泼溅不再只是一种查看格式，而成为与网格、骨骼绑定和仿真处在同一条专业管线中的可编辑素材。
works.method: Splats are treated as points with attributes, so existing nodes such as Bone Deform and Surface Deform work on them unchanged; PDG/TOPs distributes splat training across machines, Copernicus rasterizes splats to color and depth for compositing, and Karma camera arrays turn rendered scenes into splats without camera estimation.
works.method_zh: 泼溅被当作带属性的点来处理，因此 Bone Deform、Surface Deform 等现有节点无需修改即可作用于泼溅；PDG/TOPs 把泼溅训练分发到多台机器，Copernicus 把泼溅光栅化为颜色与深度用于合成，Karma 相机阵列则无需相机位姿估计就能把渲染出的场景转成泼溅。
works.title_zh: Houdini 22 高斯泼溅

works.title: Lift4D
works.description: Lift4D turns a casual monocular video of a deforming animal or object into a complete moving 3D Gaussian model, filling in the sides the camera never saw.
works.description_zh: Lift4D 把一段随手拍摄的形变动物或物体单目视频变成完整的运动三维高斯模型，并补全相机从未拍到的那一侧。
works.idea_en: Generative priors close the gap between what one camera saw and a full 4D object, the step needed to bring real moving things into a 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 生成式先验弥补了单个相机所见与完整 4D 物体之间的差距，这是把真实运动物体带进三维场景所需的一步。
works.method: A single-view 3D reconstruction model is adapted with causal latent conditioning to give temporally consistent per-frame shapes that initialise deformable 3D Gaussians, which are refined against the video by occlusion-aware optimisation with a view-conditioned diffusion prior for unseen regions.
works.method_zh: 通过因果潜变量条件改造单视角三维重建模型，得到时间上一致的逐帧形状，用来初始化可形变三维高斯；再在遮挡感知的优化中对照视频细化，并用视角条件扩散先验补全未见区域。

paper.title: Lift4D: Harmonizing Single-View 3D Estimation for 4D Reconstruction In-the-Wild

works.title_zh: Lift4D 野外单目视频 4D 重建与补全

works.title: Moshi-Face
works.description: Moshi-Face extends the full-duplex voice model Moshi with a face: it takes in the user's voice and facial movement while it speaks, and generates its own speech and 3D facial motion at the same time, inheriting Moshi's ability to overlap speech, back-channel and be interrupted, now with a moving face. The authors report audiovisual alignment at low latency while keeping Moshi's dialogue quality.
works.description_zh: Moshi-Face 为全双工语音模型 Moshi 加上了一张脸：它在说话的同时接收用户的声音和面部动作，并同步生成自己的语音和三维面部动作，从而继承了 Moshi 话语重叠、附和与可被打断的能力，并配上了会动的脸。作者报告其在低延迟下实现了视听对齐，并保持了 Moshi 原有的对话质量。
works.idea_en: The first published model that both sees the user's face and shows its own while talking full-duplex: an inspectable academic counterpart to Tavus Griffin.
works.idea_zh: 首个公开发表、在全双工对话中既看用户的脸又展示自己面部的模型：可视为 Tavus Griffin 的可检视学术对照。
works.method: A VQ-VAE face codec turns 3D head meshes from video into discrete face tokens, and a Face Transformer added to Moshi predicts them non-autoregressively alongside Moshi's audio tokens, in sync with the user's audio and face streams.
works.method_zh: 先用 VQ-VAE 面部编解码器把视频中提取的三维头部网格编码成离散的面部 token，再在 Moshi 中加入一个 Face Transformer，与 Moshi 的音频 token 同步、非自回归地预测这些面部 token，并与用户的音频和面部输入流对齐。

paper.title: Integrating Facial Generation into Full-Duplex Spoken Dialogue Systems

works.title_zh: Moshi-Face：把面部生成接入全双工语音对话系统

works.title: WRBench
works.description: A diagnostic benchmark that asks whether a generated world keeps evolving while the camera looks away. Across 9,600 videos from 23 models and four control paradigms, it finds that current systems behave like a tracking shot: a returning object reappears in the state it was left in instead of having advanced the event that was under way.
works.description_zh: 一个诊断性基准，检验相机移开时生成的世界是否仍在继续演化。在来自 23 个模型、四种控制范式的 9600 段视频中，它发现当前系统表现得像跟拍镜头：重新看到的物体停留在被离开时的状态，而不是让原本进行中的事件继续推进。
works.idea_en: Separates looking consistent from being a world: an event should run its course even when no one is watching, and today's models do not do that.
works.idea_zh: 把“看起来一致”与“真正是一个世界”区分开：即使无人注视，事件也应继续发展，而当今的模型做不到。
works.method: Treats camera motion as an intervention on observability and scores a human-calibrated chain: does the camera execute the requested move, does the scene stay continuous and identifiable while in view, and is a returning target consistent with the event that was set in motion.
works.method_zh: 把相机运动视为对“可观测性”的干预，并按经人工校准的链条逐级评分：相机是否执行了要求的动作，场景在视野内是否连续且可辨认，以及重新出现的目标是否与此前启动的事件相符。

paper.title: Current World Models Lack a Persistent State Core

works.title_zh: WRBench：当前世界模型缺少持久的状态核心

works.title: ActWorld
works.description: An interactive world model from ByteDance's Intelligent Creation team and Washington University in St. Louis in which a player, under keyboard and mouse control, can act on things mid-rollout, such as inserting a coin, pressing a button or picking up a helmet, instead of only walking and looking around; objects keep their new state as play continues.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动智能创作团队与圣路易斯华盛顿大学提出的交互世界模型：玩家在键盘鼠标控制下，不只是行走和环顾，还能在生成过程中操作物体，例如投币、按按钮、拿起头盔；物体的新状态会在之后的游玩中保持下来。
works.idea_en: Turns a world you can look at into one you can act in: the action vocabulary grows from walking and turning to handling objects.
works.idea_zh: 把“可以看的世界”变成“可以动手的世界”：动作从行走、转身扩展到操作物体。
works.method: A chunk-autoregressive DiT takes high-level interaction commands and per-frame keyboard and mouse controls; a hierarchical action-aware memory keeps interaction-critical frames in the sliding window and a persistent bank of event-update and object-identity tokens beyond it, trained on a new 100K-video interaction dataset (40 action categories) captioned per chunk by a chain-of-thought VLM and evaluated on the authors' I-Bench.
works.method_zh: 分块自回归 DiT，输入高层交互指令与逐帧键盘鼠标控制；分层的动作感知记忆在滑动窗口内保留对交互关键的帧，并在窗口之外用持久记忆库保存事件更新与物体身份 token。训练数据是作者新建的 10 万段交互视频数据集（40 类动作），由思维链视觉语言模型逐块标注，并在作者提出的 I-Bench 上评测。
works.specs: 100K interaction videos · 40 action categories · per-frame keyboard + mouse

paper.title: ActWorld: From Explorable to Interactive World Model via Action-Aware Memory

works.title_zh: ActWorld：可操作物体的交互世界模型

works.title: NVIDIA ACE Game Agent SDK
works.description: An open-source C/C++ framework, released in beta at Unreal Fest 2026, for building game characters that run entirely on the player's RTX GPU: an agent API that keeps chat history and drives multi-step tool use, a stateless chat API and a retrieval API over the game's own data. It shipped with Unreal Engine 5 plugins for local speech recognition, a small language model and text-to-speech.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的 C/C++ 框架，于 Unreal Fest 2026 以测试版发布，用于构建完全在玩家 RTX GPU 上运行的游戏角色：包括保存对话历史并驱动多步工具调用的智能体 API、无状态的对话 API，以及面向游戏自身数据的检索 API。同时推出的 Unreal Engine 5 插件提供本地语音识别、小语言模型与语音合成。
works.idea_en: The NPC stack that PUBG Ally and the Total War advisor used is now a free local toolkit, so a lab can run a talking, acting character without a cloud bill or a vendor changing the model underneath.
works.idea_zh: PUBG Ally 与《全面战争》顾问所用的 NPC 技术栈，如今成了免费的本地工具包；实验室无需云端费用、也不必担心供应商更换底层模型，就能运行会说话、会行动的角色。
works.method: A lightweight agent loop optimized for small models on RTX hardware, with tool calling and hybrid semantic-lexical retrieval; the UE5 plugins bundle nemo-conformer-ctc-120m speech recognition, a Qwen 3.5 4B model in GGUF format and Chatterbox Turbo 350M text-to-speech, usable from Blueprints or C++.
works.method_zh: 针对 RTX 硬件上小模型优化的轻量智能体循环，支持工具调用与语义-词法混合检索；UE5 插件内置 nemo-conformer-ctc-120m 语音识别、GGUF 格式的 Qwen 3.5 4B 模型与 Chatterbox Turbo 350M 语音合成，可通过蓝图或 C++ 调用。
works.specs: C/C++ · on-device (GeForce RTX) · Qwen 3.5 4B SLM · ASR 120M · TTS 350M · beta
works.title_zh: NVIDIA ACE 游戏智能体 SDK

works.title: DreamX-World 1.0
works.description: Amap's (Alibaba) general-purpose interactive world model: from text or an image it streams a photorealistic, game-style or stylized world under camera navigation, keeps earlier views when the user returns, and responds to prompted events; only the technical report was public as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 高德（阿里巴巴）的通用交互世界模型：根据文字或图像，在镜头漫游中流式生成写实、游戏或风格化的世界，用户回到原处时保留先前的画面，并能响应提示的事件；截至 2026 年 10 月只公开了技术报告。
works.idea_en: Bundles the main persistence and event-control techniques of 2026 into one model, a useful reference point for what a general world model now does.
works.idea_zh: 把 2026 年主要的持久性与事件控制技术集于一个模型，是了解通用世界模型现状的一个参照点。
works.method: A bidirectional video generator converted into a few-step autoregressive model via causal forcing and DMD-style distillation, with E-PRoPE camera encoding, memory retrieval by camera geometry, event instruction tuning and RL alignment; trained on Unreal Engine renders, gameplay and real video.
works.method_zh: 通过因果强制与 DMD 式蒸馏，把双向视频生成器改造为少步自回归模型；采用 E-PRoPE 相机编码、按相机几何检索记忆、事件指令微调与强化学习对齐；训练数据包括虚幻引擎渲染、游戏录像与真实视频。
works.specs: up to 16 fps on eight RTX 5090 (developer-reported)

paper.title: DreamX-World 1.0: A General-Purpose Interactive World Model

works.title: Editing Reality
works.description: A mixed-reality system for co-creating with generative AI inside a physical room: by speaking, sketching and grabbing, a person generates, modifies, erases and retextures virtual and reconstructed objects anchored where they stand.
works.description_zh: 一个在真实房间里与生成式 AI 共同创作的混合现实系统：通过说话、画草图和直接抓取，人可以就地生成、修改、擦除和重新贴图锚定在身边的虚拟物体与重建物体。
works.idea_en: Treats generation as a material you shape in place, round after round, rather than a one-shot command typed on a screen.
works.idea_zh: 把生成当作可以在现场一轮轮塑造的材料，而不是在屏幕上敲下的一次性指令。
works.method: Research through design: iterative system development combining speech, sketch and direct manipulation with generative 3D and texture models, a formative workshop and an expert review, distilled into design framings for in-situ co-creation.
works.method_zh: 设计研究（Research through Design）：结合语音、草图、直接操作与生成式三维和纹理模型迭代开发系统，并通过形成性工作坊与专家评审，提炼现场共创的设计框架。

paper.title: Editing Reality: Designing In-Situ Co-Creation with Generative AI in Mixed Reality

works.title_zh: 编辑现实：混合现实中与生成式 AI 的现场共创

works.title: MoVerse
works.description: A real-time world model that turns one ordinary photo into a scene you can roam: it completes a 360° panorama, lifts it into a persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold, then renders photoreal video along the user's camera path; from Youku's Orange 3DV team (Alibaba), at a reported 8 fps.
works.description_zh: 一个实时世界模型，把一张普通照片变成可以漫游的场景：先补全为 360° 全景，再提升为持久的三维高斯“骨架”，最后沿用户的相机路径渲染出照片级视频；由优酷（阿里巴巴）Orange 3DV 团队推出，作者报告帧率为 8 fps。
works.idea_en: An explicit 3D scaffold under a video renderer keeps geometry fixed when you look away, while the picture stays photoreal.
works.idea_zh: 在视频渲染器下面垫一层显式三维骨架，转头再回来时几何保持不变，画面依然逼真。
works.method: Topology-aware diffusion expands the input into a gravity-aligned 360° panorama; panoramic geometry-aware residual prediction lifts it to a 3D Gaussian scaffold; a Gaussian-conditioned video renderer, a bidirectional teacher distilled into a causal student, turns scaffold renders into video.
works.method_zh: 用拓扑感知的扩散模型把输入扩展为重力对齐的 360° 全景；通过全景几何感知的残差预测，把全景提升为三维高斯骨架；再由以高斯渲染为条件的视频渲染器（双向教师模型蒸馏为因果学生模型）把骨架渲染结果转成视频。
works.specs: 1 image in · 360° panorama → 3D Gaussian scaffold · 8 fps (developer-reported)

paper.title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold

works.title_zh: MoVerse：基于全景高斯骨架的实时视频世界模型

works.title: VideoMDM
works.description: Technion and NVIDIA research that trains a 3D human motion diffusion model from 2D poses extracted from ordinary monocular video, with no 3D ground truth; on HumanML3D it nearly matches the fully 3D-supervised MDM, and on Fit3D and NBA footage it learns motions that people preferred.
works.description_zh: 以色列理工学院与英伟达的研究：只用从普通单目视频中提取的二维姿态，不用任何三维真值，就训练出三维人体动作扩散模型；在 HumanML3D 上几乎追平全三维监督的 MDM，在 Fit3D 和 NBA 视频上学到的动作更受人类评审偏好。
works.idea_en: If motion generators can learn from video instead of motion capture, the range of behaviours they can produce stops being limited by what was recorded in a mocap studio.
works.idea_zh: 如果动作生成模型能从视频而不是动捕中学习，它能生成的行为种类就不再受限于动捕棚里录过什么。
works.method: A pretrained 2D-to-3D lifter gives noisy 3D pose sequences that are diffused and denoised in 3D, then supervised in 2D by reprojecting the prediction against accurate keypoints with a depth-weighted loss, plus 3D regularisers adapted to 2D.
works.method_zh: 用预训练的二维到三维提升模型得到带噪声的三维姿态序列，在三维空间中加噪去噪，再把预测重投影到二维、用深度加权损失与准确的关键点比对来监督，并把常用的三维正则项改造到二维设定。

paper.title: VideoMDM: Towards 3D Human Motion Generation From 2D Supervision

works.title_zh: VideoMDM：用二维监督训练三维人体动作生成

works.title: Oasis 3
works.description: Decart's interactive world model for physical AI, starting with autonomous driving: it generates diverse, photorealistic driving environments from a single prompt that respond to the vehicle's actions in real time, and was available by API from launch.
works.description_zh: Decart 面向物理 AI 的交互式世界模型，先从自动驾驶入手：根据一句提示生成多样、逼真的驾驶环境，并实时响应车辆的动作；发布当天即可通过 API 使用。
works.idea_en: Rare long-tail events become something you can request by prompt and drive through, rather than wait for on real roads.
works.idea_zh: 罕见的长尾事件变成可以通过提示调用、直接驶入的场景，而不必在真实道路上苦等。
works.method: A real-time generative world model served on Decart's optimized inference stack (DOS), conditioned on prompts and vehicle controls for closed-loop robot training.
works.method_zh: 运行在 Decart 优化推理栈（DOS）上的实时生成式世界模型，以提示与车辆控制为条件，用于闭环机器人训练。

works.title: ABot-Earth
works.description: Amap's generative 3D Earth model builds walkable 3D Gaussian-splat city districts from satellite imagery, in under ten minutes per square kilometre, and streams them with level of detail in a public web viewer where visitors fly between generated cities, the Moon and Mars. Version 0.5 (technical report, June 2026) was followed by 0.7 on 2026-09-10; creating your own 1 km² tile from text or a reference image is whitelist-only as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 高德的生成式三维地球模型：以卫星影像为条件生成可漫游的三维高斯泼溅城市街区，每平方公里不到 10 分钟，并以分级细节（LOD）在公开的网页浏览器中流式加载，访客可以在生成的城市、月球和火星之间穿梭。0.5 版技术报告发布于 2026 年 6 月，0.7 版于 2026 年 9 月 10 日上线；截至 2026 年 10 月，用文字或参考图创作自己的 1 平方公里地块仍仅向白名单用户开放。
works.idea_en: Grounding generation in satellite imagery yields city-scale scenes that follow a real place's layout, so a study could stage an encounter on a recognisable street without capturing it on foot.
works.idea_zh: 以卫星影像为生成依据，得到的城市级场景遵循真实地点的布局，研究可以在一条可辨认的街道上布置情境，而无需实地采集。
works.method: A generative model formulated directly on 3D Gaussian splats is trained on a corpus of real-world urban reconstructions and, at inference, synthesises geometry and texture conditioned only on geo-referenced satellite tiles, packed into hierarchical LOD for web map engines.
works.method_zh: 直接在三维高斯泼溅表示上构建的生成模型，用大量真实城市重建数据训练；推理时仅以带地理坐标的卫星影像为条件合成几何与纹理，并打包成分级 LOD，供网页地图引擎实时渲染。
works.specs: < 10 min per km² · 1 km² tiles · hierarchical LOD · web viewer

paper.title: ABot-Earth 0.5: Generative 3D Earth Model

works.title_zh: 高德 ABot-Earth 生成式三维地球

works.title: Grok Imagine Video 1.5
works.description: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is xAI's image-to-video model in the Grok app and, from 2026-06-03, in the xAI API (as grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview): it animates a still frame from a prompt that describes camera move, pacing and sound, at up to 720p in about 25 seconds per clip. A version with text, image and voice references and 1080p output followed on 2026-08-07.
works.description_zh: Grok Imagine Video 1.5 是 xAI 的图生视频模型，提供于 Grok 应用中，并自 2026-06-03 起以 grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview 进入 xAI API：根据描述运镜、节奏与声音的提示让一张静态画面动起来，最高 720p，每段约 25 秒生成。2026-08-07 又推出支持文字、图像与声音参考、可输出 1080p 的版本。
works.idea_en: A frontier video model sold through a chat app and a developer API at once: generation speed is becoming a headline number alongside quality.
works.idea_zh: 前沿视频模型同时通过聊天应用和开发者 API 提供：生成速度正与画质一样成为主要指标。
works.method: Closed image-to-video generation model with prompt-controlled camera, motion and sound (architecture not disclosed).
works.method_zh: 闭源图生视频模型，可用提示控制镜头、运动与声音（架构未公开）。
works.specs: 720p in ~25 s (claimed) · up to 10 s per API call · references version: up to 1080p

works.title: MeshFlow
works.description: Meta AI and HKUST model that generates artist-style meshes, with clean polygon layouts rather than dense scanned-looking triangles, in about one second, conditioned on input geometry and an optional reference image; weights are released under Meta's non-commercial research licence.
works.description_zh: Meta AI 与香港科技大学的模型，约一秒即可生成艺术家风格的网格（布线干净，而不是扫描式的密集三角面），以输入几何为条件，并可附参考图像；权重以 Meta 非商用研究许可发布。
works.idea_en: Artist topology used to require slow token-by-token generation; generating it in parallel makes clean, game-ready meshes cheap enough to produce on demand.
works.idea_zh: 艺术家风格的拓扑过去只能缓慢地逐 token 生成；并行生成让干净、可直接用于游戏的网格便宜到可以按需生产。
works.method: A MeshVAE trained with a contrastive loss maps continuous vertex positions and discrete connectivity into a compact continuous latent, which a flow-matching diffusion transformer denoises in parallel, avoiding coordinate quantization and scaling linearly with mesh size.
works.method_zh: 用对比损失训练的 MeshVAE 把连续的顶点位置和离散的连接关系映射到紧凑的连续潜空间，再由流匹配扩散 Transformer 并行去噪；无需坐标量化，计算量随网格规模线性增长。
works.specs: ~1 s per mesh · ~18× faster than autoregressive mesh generation (author claims)

paper.title: MeshFlow: Efficient Artistic Mesh Generation via MeshVAE and Flow-based Diffusion Transformer

works.title_zh: MeshFlow：高效的艺术家风格网格生成

works.title: DyaPlex
works.description: DyaPlex (NVIDIA with HKUST, NeurIPS 2026) is a streaming model that talks and moves while it listens to and watches its partner: from the partner's speech and body motion it generates the agent's speech and body motion, including visual backchannels and gesture mirroring. NVIDIA shows it driving a virtual agent and a robot, and generating synthetic two-person conversation data.
works.description_zh: DyaPlex（英伟达与香港科技大学，NeurIPS 2026）是一个流式模型，在听和看对方的同时说话和做动作：它根据对方的语音和身体动作生成智能体自己的语音和身体动作，包括点头之类的视觉回应信号和手势模仿。英伟达展示了用它驱动虚拟智能体和机器人，以及生成合成的双人对话数据。
works.idea_en: Speech, listening behaviour and gesture come from one full-duplex model that also perceives the partner's body, so a virtual interlocutor can nod or mirror while the participant is still talking.
works.idea_zh: 语音、倾听行为和手势出自同一个能感知对方身体的全双工模型，虚拟对话者因此能在参与者还在说话时点头或模仿其动作。
works.method: A dual-tower Transformer keeps a frozen full-duplex speech model (PersonaPlex, which overlaps speech and backchannels) and adds a trainable causal motion tower over RVQ-VAE motion tokens for both participants, aligned to speech by dyadic token interleaving and a time-aligned speech-motion RoPE; trained on 4,000 hours of Meta's Seamless Interaction dataset.
works.method_zh: 双塔 Transformer 保留一个冻结的全双工语音模型（PersonaPlex，可重叠说话并发出回应信号），再加上一个可训练的因果动作塔，对双方的 RVQ-VAE 动作 token 建模；通过双人 token 交织和时间对齐的语音-动作 RoPE 与语音对齐；在 Meta 的 Seamless Interaction 数据集（4000 小时）上训练。
works.specs: 4,000 h of dyadic training data · streaming, causal · speech + body motion

paper.title: DyaPlex: Full-Duplex Speech-Motion Model for Dyadic Interaction

works.title_zh: DyaPlex：面向双人互动的全双工语音-动作模型

works.title: HumanNOVA
works.description: HumanNOVA (The University of Texas at Austin, CVPR 2026 Highlight) builds a photoreal 3D avatar of a whole person from one photo in under a second, without per-person optimisation. It is trained on 100,000 avatars produced by posing rigged assets and refitting multi-camera captures; code and a Colab demo are public.
works.description_zh: HumanNOVA（得克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校，CVPR 2026 Highlight）能在一秒内由一张照片生成一个人的照片级全身三维化身，无需针对每个人做优化。它的训练数据是 10 万个化身，来自给已绑定骨骼的资产摆出大量姿态，以及对多机位拍摄重新拟合；代码和 Colab 演示已公开。
works.idea_en: Turning a single photo into a full-body 3D person in a second is what makes participant- or confederate-specific avatars cheap enough to make per session.
works.idea_zh: 一秒内把一张照片变成全身三维人物，使按参与者或实验助手定制化身的成本低到可以每次实验都做。
works.method: Encodes the image and an estimated SMPL body mesh into compact tokens that are fused by cross-attention into a triplane avatar in one feed-forward pass; the training set is scaled to 100k assets by animating rigged assets with everyday poses and fitting multi-camera captures for extra views.
works.method_zh: 把图像和估计出的 SMPL 人体网格编码为紧凑的 token，通过交叉注意力在一次前馈中融合成三平面（triplane）化身；训练集通过给绑定资产套用日常姿态、以及对多机位拍摄做拟合补充视角，扩充到 10 万个资产。
works.specs: <1 s per avatar · single image · 100k training assets

paper.title: HumanNOVA: Photorealistic, Universal and Rapid 3D Human Avatar Modeling from a Single Image

works.title_zh: HumanNOVA：由单张图像快速生成照片级三维人体化身

works.title: Virtual Human for Police Training in Virtual Reality: A Dynamic Model of a Suspect With Modulated Resistance and Means
works.description: A virtual suspect in a police intervention whose face, posture, gaze, movement and voice are driven by two parameters: resistance (from compliance to aggression) and means (bare hands or a wrench). Fifty-eight active-duty Geneva police officers each handled six resistance × means scenarios in VR; resistance mainly changed perceived danger and intent, means changed perceived capacity and opportunity.
works.description_zh: 一个警务处置场景中的虚拟嫌疑人，其表情、姿态、视线、移动与声音由两个参数驱动：抵抗程度（从服从到攻击）与手段（徒手或扳手）。58 名日内瓦在职警察在 VR 中各自处理了六种“抵抗 × 手段”组合场景；抵抗程度主要改变感知到的危险与意图，手段则改变感知到的能力与机会。
works.idea_en: Two interpretable dials produce distinct threat appraisals in trained officers, the controllable baseline that LLM-driven suspects will have to be compared with.
works.idea_zh: 两个可解释的“旋钮”就能让受过训练的警察产生可区分的威胁评估——这是大语言模型驱动的嫌疑人日后必须与之比较的可控基线。
works.method: State-machine behavior model grounded in proportional-use-of-force doctrine, built in Unity with an HTC Vive Pro Eye; constrained speech recognition with instructor validation of commands; within-subjects evaluation with counterbalanced scenario order and in-VR questionnaires.
works.method_zh: 基于“相称使用武力”原则的状态机行为模型，用 Unity 开发并在 HTC Vive Pro Eye 上运行；受限语音识别，由教官确认指令；被试内评估，场景顺序平衡，问卷在 VR 内完成。

paper.venue: Computer Animation and Virtual Worlds (CASA XR 2026)
paper.title: Virtual Human for Police Training in Virtual Reality: A Dynamic Model of a Suspect With Modulated Resistance and Means

works.title_zh: 用于 VR 警务训练的虚拟人：抵抗程度与手段可调的嫌疑人动态模型

works.title: An elephant in the room amplifies discomfort when the virtual reality space matches physical reality
works.description: Twenty-nine participants met a wolf, dog, rabbit or squirrel in three rooms: the real lab seen through mixed-reality passthrough, a VR replica of that lab, or an unrelated virtual living room, with a Newton's cradle on or off. A probabilistic agent asked them to change one factor at a time; the most discomforting configuration was the wolf in mixed reality with the cradle running.
works.description_zh: 29 名参与者在三种房间里遇到狼、狗、兔子或松鼠：通过混合现实透视看到的真实实验室、该实验室的 VR 复制品，或一个无关的虚拟客厅；牛顿摆可开可关。一个概率智能体请他们每次只改变一个因素；最令人不适的配置是混合现实中出现狼且牛顿摆在摆动。
works.idea_en: A threat placed in the participant's own room feels worse, which matters for generative MR that writes content into real surroundings, for both design and ethics.
works.idea_zh: 把威胁放进参与者自己的房间会让人更难受——对于把内容写进真实环境的生成式 MR，这既是设计问题也是伦理问题。
works.method: Within-subjects paradigm (animal × room × cradle) in which participants moved between configurations at a probabilistic agent's prompting; transitions were modelled as Markov matrices to rank configurations by discomfort.
works.method_zh: 被试内范式（动物 × 房间 × 牛顿摆）：参与者在概率智能体的提示下在各配置间切换；用马尔可夫转移矩阵对配置的不适程度排序。

paper.title: An elephant in the room amplifies discomfort when the virtual reality space matches physical reality

works.title_zh: 当虚拟空间与真实空间一致时，“房间里的大象”会放大不适感

works.title: Exploring Mediation by an Embodied Virtual Agent in Immersive Triadic Collaborative Decision-Making
works.description: Pairs of users with conflicting goals designed an office together in XR while an LLM-driven agent mediated, either embodied or as a disembodied voice, compared with no agent (reported as n=24 pairs). Embodiment raised co-presence and perceived collaboration but not task efficiency, and the agent adopted facilitating and evaluating mediation strategies without being programmed to.
works.description_zh: 目标相互冲突的两名用户在 XR 中共同设计一间办公室，由一个大语言模型驱动的智能体进行调解；智能体或有具身形象，或只是无形的声音，并与无智能体条件比较（论文报告 n=24 组）。具身形象提高了共同临场感与感知到的协作质量，但没有提高任务效率；智能体还在未经专门编程的情况下，自发采用了促进式与评估式的调解策略。
works.idea_en: An LLM teammate's value in a group lies in how it shapes the social dynamics, and its strategies emerge rather than being scripted, which makes them harder to control.
works.idea_zh: 大语言模型“队友”在群体中的价值在于它如何塑造社会互动；它的策略是涌现的而非预设的，因此也更难控制。
works.method: XR collaboration study varying agent presence and embodiment, with co-presence, collaboration, preference and efficiency measures and qualitative coding of the agent's mediation strategies against conflict-resolution modes.
works.method_zh: XR 协作研究，操纵智能体是否在场及是否具身，测量共同临场感、协作、偏好与效率，并对照冲突解决模式对智能体的调解策略做质性编码。

paper.title: Exploring Mediation by an Embodied Virtual Agent in Immersive Triadic Collaborative Decision-Making

works.title_zh: 探索沉浸式三方协作决策中具身虚拟智能体的调解作用

works.title: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5
works.description: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 is Meituan's open, MIT-licensed model for audio-driven talking video: from speech plus a text prompt, and optionally a reference image, it generates long, stable 480p or 720p clips of one or several people speaking, singing or handling objects, including anime and animal characters, and can continue an existing video. It upgrades LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.0 (December 2025).
works.description_zh: LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.5 是美团以 MIT 协议开源的音频驱动说话视频模型：根据语音和文字提示（可选参考图），生成稳定的长时 480p 或 720p 视频，人物可以是一人或多人，能说话、唱歌或拿取物品，也支持动漫和动物角色，还能续写已有视频。它是 LongCat-Video-Avatar 1.0（2025 年 12 月）的升级版。
works.idea_en: An open, pinnable model for multi-person talking scenes, so a lab can render scripted conversations between several virtual people offline and keep the exact version.
works.idea_zh: 一个可固定版本的开源多人说话场景模型，让实验室可以离线渲染多名虚拟人之间的脚本对话，并保留确切的模型版本。
works.method: Fine-tuned from the LongCat-Video foundation model for audio-text-to-video, audio-text-image-to-video and video continuation with single- or multi-stream audio; Meituan also released a human-evaluation benchmark of 508 image-audio pairs across six scenarios rated by 770 crowd workers.
works.method_zh: 在 LongCat-Video 基础模型上微调，支持音频+文本生视频、音频+文本+图像生视频以及视频续写，可输入单路或多路音频；美团同时发布了一个人类评测基准：6 类场景共 508 组图像-音频样本，由 770 名众包评测者打分。

works.title: Cosmos 3
works.description: An open 'omni-model' announced at GTC Taipei that reasons about a scene, generates video and ambient sound, and outputs robot action data such as joint angles and gripper positions, so one model can describe, simulate and act. Cosmos 3 Edge, a 4B variant built to run in real time on device, was released openly at SIGGRAPH 2026 (2026-07-20).
works.description_zh: 在 GTC 台北发布的开源“全能模型”：先理解场景，再生成视频与环境声，还能输出关节角度、夹爪位置等机器人动作数据，让一个模型同时负责描述、模拟与行动。2026 年 7 月 20 日的 SIGGRAPH 2026 上，NVIDIA 开放发布了可在设备端实时运行的 4B 版本 Cosmos 3 Edge。
works.idea_en: Reasoning about a situation before simulating it is the step that makes generated outcomes checkable against an explanation.
works.idea_zh: 先推理情境、再进行模拟，这一步让生成的结果可以对照解释加以核查。
works.method: A mixture-of-transformers model in which a reasoning block interprets the scene and a generation block produces physically grounded video, audio and numerical action outputs; it can be post-trained as a world-action model.
works.method_zh: 混合 Transformer 架构：推理模块先解读场景，生成模块再输出符合物理的视频、音频与数值动作；可后训练为世界-动作模型。

works.title: MBench
works.description: A benchmark from Tsinghua University and Tencent WeChat Vision for whether video world models remember: it splits memory into entity, environment and causal consistency, with twelve sub-dimensions from object geometry and human identity to epipolar consistency, lighting and state evolution, tested on curated real long videos. The paper evaluates eight text-conditioned continuation models and six action-conditioned world models (among them Matrix-Game 3.0, HY-WorldPlay and Yume-1.5) and finds long-term state retention is their common weak point.
works.description_zh: 清华大学与腾讯微信视觉团队推出的基准，检验视频世界模型“记不记得住”：它把记忆拆成实体、环境与因果三类一致性，下设十二个子维度，从物体几何、人物身份到对极几何一致性、光照与状态演化，测试素材是精选的真实拍摄长视频。论文评测了八个文本条件续写模型与六个动作条件世界模型（包括 Matrix-Game 3.0、HY-WorldPlay 与 Yume-1.5），发现长期保持状态是它们共同的短板。
works.idea_en: Separates whether a generated world keeps its objects, its stage and its causal rules, the three things a returning participant would check.
works.idea_zh: 把生成世界是否保住了物体、场地与因果规则分开衡量；这正是参与者回到原处时会检查的三件事。
works.method: Test cases from real long videos, scored by a hybrid of rule-based metrics (e.g. epipolar and reprojection consistency) and vision-language-model question answering, with separate tracks for text- and action-conditioned models.
works.method_zh: 测试用例取自真实长视频，评分结合基于规则的指标（如对极几何与重投影一致性）和视觉语言模型问答，文本条件与动作条件模型分开评测。
works.specs: 3 dimensions · 12 sub-dimensions · 8 text-conditioned + 6 action-conditioned models · dataset on Hugging Face

paper.title: MBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark on Memory Capability for Video World Models

works.title: Meshy 3D Agent
works.description: A conversational agent inside Meshy: a person describes an idea or uploads a photo or sketch, and the agent brainstorms directions, generates concept images in batches, turns the chosen one into a downloadable 3D model, and can rig and animate characters through chat; Meshy opened it to all users on 14 October 2026.
works.description_zh: Meshy 内置的对话式智能体：用户描述想法或上传照片、草图，智能体会提出方向、批量生成概念图，把选中的方案变成可下载的三维模型，还能通过对话为角色绑定和制作动画；2026 年 10 月 14 日起向所有 Meshy 用户开放。
works.idea_en: Moves asset generation from a single prompt box to a dialogue that plans and iterates, the pattern a researcher could use to author scenario props by talking.
works.idea_zh: 把资产生成从单个提示框变成能规划、能迭代的对话，研究者也可以用这种方式“说”出情境所需的道具。
works.method: An LLM-driven agent that orchestrates Meshy's image generation, image-to-3D, texturing, rigging and animation tools in one chat; Meshy also exposes these tools to outside agents through an MCP server.
works.method_zh: 由大语言模型驱动的智能体，在一次对话中调度 Meshy 的图像生成、图生三维、贴图、绑定和动画工具；Meshy 还通过 MCP 服务器把这些工具开放给外部智能体。
works.title_zh: Meshy 3D 智能体

works.title: Archon
works.description: Archon is one model for a whole digital human: from a text description it can write the character's script, speak it, animate the face and body, and render the talking video, and it can take any of these as input and generate or edit the others (for example change the script and keep the performance). It was trained on 72 tasks over seven synchronised modalities.
works.description_zh: Archon 用一个模型完成整个数字人：根据一段文字描述，它可以写出角色台词、念出来、驱动面部和身体动画，并渲染出说话视频；也能以其中任一模态为输入，生成或编辑其余模态（例如改写台词而保留表演）。它在七种同步模态上的 72 项任务中训练。
works.idea_en: When description, words, voice, motion and pixels live in one model, a virtual person can be specified once and revised in whichever channel the experiment varies.
works.idea_zh: 当描述、台词、声音、动作和画面都在同一个模型里，虚拟人只需设定一次，就能在实验要改变的那个通道中修改。
works.method: A natively autoregressive multimodal model with modality-specific tokenizers for description, script, speech, animation (identity, expression, pose), semantic video, image and RGB video, a semantic video reparameterisation that cuts video tokens 4×, a semantic-driven video diffusion decoder, and 'Thinking in Modality' chains for ambiguous cross-modal tasks.
works.method_zh: 一个原生自回归多模态模型，为描述、台词、语音、动画（身份、表情、姿态）、语义视频、图像和 RGB 视频分别配备分词器；用语义视频重参数化把视频 token 减少 4 倍，配合语义驱动的视频扩散解码器，并以“模态内思考”链处理含糊的跨模态任务。

paper.title: Archon: A Unified Multimodal Model for Holistic Digital Human Generation

works.title_zh: Archon：面向完整数字人生成的统一多模态模型

works.title: NeuROK
works.description: Stanford model that turns a static 3D object, including one scanned with a smartphone, into an interactable 4D asset that deforms plausibly under a given initial physical condition, without physical annotations or category-specific assumptions; the demos make objects in scanned offices and kitchens respond to interaction.
works.description_zh: 斯坦福大学的模型：把静态三维物体（包括用智能手机扫描的物体）变成可交互的 4D 资产，在给定的初始物理条件下产生合理的形变，不需要物理标注，也不对物体类别做结构假设；演示中，扫描得到的办公室和厨房里的物体都能对交互做出反应。
works.idea_en: A scanned room can be made touchable: its objects bend and wobble plausibly when acted on, without a hand-built physics rig for each.
works.idea_zh: 扫描下来的房间也能“摸得着”：物体被作用时会合理地弯曲、晃动，而不必为每件物体手工搭建物理装置。
works.method: A transformer encoder-decoder trained on a curated large-scale 4D dataset learns a latent space of an object's possible deformation states and a decoder from latent to deformed shape; dynamics are then simulated in that low-dimensional latent space with Lagrangian mechanics, solved as an ODE.
works.method_zh: 在大规模整理的 4D 数据集上训练 Transformer 编码—解码器，学习物体所有可能形变状态的潜空间，以及从潜变量到形变形状的解码器；随后从拉格朗日力学出发，在这一低维潜空间中以常微分方程求解来模拟动力学。

paper.title: NeuROK: Generative 4D Neural Object Kinematics

works.title_zh: NeuROK 生成式 4D 神经物体运动学

works.title: SANA-Streaming
works.description: SANA-Streaming (NVIDIA, 2026-05-28) is a 2B open model that edits a live or recorded video stream from a text instruction, for example restyling it or replacing the background or an object, at 1280×704 and 24 fps end to end on one RTX 5090, for videos up to about a minute. Weights were released in June 2026 and training code in July, with a hosted demo on Reactor.
works.description_zh: SANA-Streaming（英伟达，2026-05-28）是一个 2B 参数的开源模型，可按文字指令实时编辑直播或录制的视频流，例如改变风格、替换背景或物体；在单张 RTX 5090 上以 1280×704、端到端 24 fps 运行，可处理约一分钟长的视频。权重于 2026 年 6 月发布，训练代码于 7 月发布，Reactor 上有托管演示。
works.idea_en: Consumer-GPU, minute-long video-to-video editing makes it practical to restyle a participant's camera feed or a recorded scenario live, with the original motion as the control signal.
works.idea_zh: 在消费级显卡上做分钟级的视频到视频编辑，使实时改写参与者的摄像头画面或录制好的情境变得可行，原视频的动作就是控制信号。
works.method: A hybrid diffusion transformer mixes linear-attention (gated DeltaNet) blocks with some softmax-attention blocks, is trained with a cycle-reverse regulariser that predicts the source frames back from the edit, and is served with fused kernels and mixed-precision quantisation tuned for Blackwell GPUs.
works.method_zh: 混合扩散 Transformer 把线性注意力（gated DeltaNet）模块与部分 softmax 注意力模块结合；训练时加入循环反推正则，从编辑结果反向预测源视频帧；部署时使用融合算子和针对 Blackwell 显卡调优的混合精度量化。
works.specs: 1280×704 · 24 fps end-to-end (DiT 58 fps) on one RTX 5090 · 2B parameters · up to ~1 min

paper.title: SANA-Streaming: Real-time Streaming Video Editing with Hybrid Diffusion Transformer

works.title_zh: SANA-Streaming：实时流式视频编辑

works.title: VideoFDB
works.description: VideoFDB is the first benchmark for full-duplex audio-visual-to-audio-visual conversational agents: 237 expert-annotated dyadic clips from real video calls covering 11 nonverbal dynamics, scored separately for perception (does the agent read the moment) and generation (does it respond with fitting speech, gaze and expression), with a public leaderboard.
works.description_zh: VideoFDB 是第一个评测全双工“视听到视听”对话智能体的基准：包含来自真实视频通话、由专家标注的 237 段双人片段，覆盖 11 种非语言互动动态；分别对感知（智能体能否读懂当下）和生成（能否以恰当的语音、视线和表情回应）打分，并设有公开排行榜。
works.idea_en: Gives full-duplex virtual humans a shared yardstick with a human reference score, so vendor claims can be compared.
works.idea_zh: 为全双工虚拟人提供带有人类参照分数的共同标尺，让各家厂商的说法可以相互比较。
works.method: Clips from natural video calls annotated with a taxonomy that separates perception from generation behaviours, scored by a rubric-based LM-as-judge on fluency, affect matching, nonverbal fit and timing.
works.method_zh: 从自然视频通话中截取片段，按区分感知与生成行为的分类体系标注，再由基于评分细则的语言模型评审，从流畅度、情绪匹配、非语言契合度和时机等维度打分。

paper.title: VideoFDB: Evaluating Full-Duplex Vision-Speech Capabilities in Conversational Agents

works.title_zh: VideoFDB 全双工视听对话基准

works.title: minWM
works.description: An open-source, end-to-end framework and tutorial from Shengshu (the Vidu company) that turns an existing text- or image-to-video model into a camera-controllable, few-step autoregressive world model for low-latency streaming, demonstrated on Wan2.1-1.3B and HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B.
works.description_zh: 生数科技（Vidu 背后的公司）开源的端到端框架与教程：把现有的文生视频或图生视频模型改造成可控相机、少步自回归、低延迟流式输出的世界模型，并在 Wan2.1-1.3B 与 HunyuanVideo-1.5-8B 上做了演示。
works.idea_en: Makes the recipe for a real-time world model a reproducible pipeline that a lab can run on open backbones.
works.idea_zh: 把实时世界模型的配方变成实验室能在开源骨干模型上复现的流程。
works.method: Fine-tunes a bidirectional video diffusion model with camera control, then applies the Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++ pipeline (autoregressive diffusion training, causal ODE or consistency distillation, asymmetric DMD) for few-step rollout; it can also adapt existing world models such as HY-WorldPlay.
works.method_zh: 先为双向视频扩散模型加入相机控制微调，再套用 Causal Forcing / Causal Forcing++ 流程（自回归扩散训练、因果 ODE 或一致性蒸馏、非对称 DMD），得到少步自回归生成器；也可用于改造 HY-WorldPlay 等现有世界模型。

paper.title: minWM: A Full-Stack Open-Source Framework for Real-Time Interactive Video World Models

works.title_zh: minWM：实时交互视频世界模型全栈开源框架

works.title: CubePart
works.description: Roblox's open part-controllable 3D generator: given a prompt and a list of part names (for example a helicopter's body, rotor and tail), it returns one complete mesh per named part that together form the object, ready to be scripted or animated in a game.
