works.description_zh: Roblox 开源的部件可控三维生成模型：给出提示词和一份部件名称列表（例如直升机的机身、旋翼和尾部），它为每个部件生成一个完整网格，组合起来就是整个物体，可直接在游戏里编写脚本或做动画。
works.idea_en: Lets the author decide which parts an object has before it is generated, so a door that must open or a rotor that must spin exists as its own piece.
works.idea_zh: 让创作者在生成之前就决定物体由哪些部件组成，需要能开的门、能转的旋翼从一开始就是独立的部件。
works.method: A two-stage generator that first synthesises the global shape and then decodes it into one mesh per element of an open-vocabulary parts schema, trained on a large part-labelled 3D dataset built with a scalable labelling pipeline.
works.method_zh: 两阶段生成：先合成整体形状，再按开放词汇的部件清单逐个解码出每个部件的网格；训练数据是用可扩展标注流程构建的大规模部件标注三维数据集。

paper.title: CubePart: An Open-Vocabulary Part-Controllable 3D Generator

works.title_zh: CubePart：开放词汇、部件可控的三维生成

works.title: EchoAvatar
works.description: Zhejiang University model that generates full-body 3D character motion from streaming speech or music with low latency, without being told which of the two it is hearing; the demos connect it to ChatGPT, Doubao and ElevenLabs voice agents so that the agent's voice drives a moving body, and the LLM can trigger specific actions through a tool call. Code and pretrained models are public.
works.description_zh: 浙江大学的模型：根据实时输入的语音或音乐以低延迟生成三维角色的全身动作，而且不需要事先告诉它听到的是哪一种；演示中把它接到 ChatGPT、豆包和 ElevenLabs 的语音智能体上，让智能体的声音驱动一个会动的身体，大语言模型还能通过工具调用触发特定动作。代码与预训练模型已公开。
works.idea_en: Gives any voice agent a body that gestures while it talks and moves to music, with the LLM able to cue deliberate actions.
works.idea_zh: 为任何语音智能体配上一副身体：说话时有手势，听到音乐会随之起舞，大语言模型还能下达特定动作。
works.method: A unified streaming architecture synthesises continuous motion from incremental audio; training enforces strong audio dependency so it generalises across speech and music without mode labels, reinforcement learning refines online generation, and a tool-call interface lets an upstream LLM inject semantic control.
works.method_zh: 统一的流式架构根据持续到来的音频片段合成连续动作；训练时强化动作对音频的依赖，使其无需模式标签即可同时适用于语音和音乐；再用强化学习改进在线生成质量，并通过工具调用接口接受上游大语言模型的语义控制。
works.specs: streaming speech and music input · full-body motion · MIT code and pretrained models

paper.title: EchoAvatar: Real-time Generative Avatar Animation from Audio Streams

works.title_zh: EchoAvatar 音频流实时驱动的角色动画

works.title: Gamma-World (γ-World)
works.description: A world model in which two to four independently controlled players act at once in one generated world, each seeing a consistent shared scene, extending from multiplayer games to coordinating real robots; the authors report action-responsive generation at 24 fps.
works.description_zh: 一个世界模型：两到四名可独立操控的玩家同时在同一个生成世界中行动，每人看到的共享场景保持一致，应用从多人游戏延伸到真实机器人协作；作者称其能以 24 fps 对动作作出响应。
works.idea_en: Shared worlds with several participants are what social situations need; this one adds players without retraining for each count.
works.idea_zh: 社会情境需要多人共享的世界；这个模型增加参与者时无需针对人数重新训练。
works.method: Simplex Rotary Agent Encoding (agents as vertices of a regular simplex in RoPE angle space, so identity needs no fixed slots), Sparse Hub Attention through learnable hub tokens for linear cross-agent cost, and distillation of a diffusion teacher into a causal KV-cached student.
works.method_zh: “单纯形旋转智能体编码”（把智能体表示为 RoPE 角度空间中正单纯形的顶点，身份无需固定槽位），用可学习枢纽 token 实现线性跨智能体代价的“稀疏枢纽注意力”，以及把扩散教师模型蒸馏为带 KV 缓存的因果学生模型。

paper.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players

works.title: Pantheon360
works.description: Pantheon360 (USC, NYCU, Cornell and Bosch Research, CVPR 2026) generates 360° video along any user-defined camera path from sparse 360° captures of a place: an explicit 3D cache reconstructed from the input keeps the geometry consistent while a video diffusion model refines appearance, aimed at digital twins for simulation. Code was announced as coming soon.
works.description_zh: Pantheon360（南加州大学、阳明交通大学、康奈尔大学与博世研究院，CVPR 2026）根据对某个地点的稀疏 360° 拍摄，沿用户自定的任意镜头路径生成 360° 视频：从输入重建的显式 3D 缓存保证几何一致，视频扩散模型负责细化外观，目标是用于仿真的数字孪生。代码标注为即将发布。
works.idea_en: A few panoramic captures of a real site can become a freely re-walkable 360° video, with geometry held fixed rather than re-imagined per frame.
works.idea_zh: 对真实场所的几次全景拍摄，就能变成可沿任意路径重走的 360° 视频，而且几何是固定的，不会逐帧重新想象。
works.method: Reconstruct a 3D cache from sparse 360° inputs, render it along the target camera path as a geometric scaffold, and let a 360° video diffusion model refine texture and fill gaps.
works.method_zh: 从稀疏的 360° 输入重建 3D 缓存，沿目标镜头路径渲染作为几何支架，再由 360° 视频扩散模型细化纹理并补全空缺。

paper.title: Pantheon360: Taming Digital Twin Generation via 3D-Aware 360° Video Diffusion

works.title_zh: Pantheon360：用 3D 感知 360° 视频扩散生成数字孪生

works.title: WBench
works.description: A multi-turn benchmark for interactive world models from Fudan University and Meituan's LongCat team: 289 cases with 1,058 interaction turns (navigation, subject actions, event edits, perspective switches) scored on video quality, setting and interaction adherence, consistency and physics. It runs a public leaderboard, and its paper finds that none of 20 tested models is strong on every dimension.
works.description_zh: 复旦大学与美团 LongCat 团队推出的交互世界模型多轮基准：289 个用例、1058 个交互轮次（导航、主体动作、事件编辑、视角切换），从视频质量、设定遵循、交互遵循、一致性与物理合理性五个维度打分。它设有公开排行榜，论文发现受测的 20 个模型没有一个在所有维度上都表现出色。
works.idea_en: Tests a world model the way a session unfolds, turn after turn, and lets text-, pose- and keyboard-driven models be compared on the same cases.
works.idea_zh: 按体验实际展开的方式逐轮测试世界模型，并让文字、位姿与键盘驱动的模型在同一批用例上比较。
works.method: Each case specifies a world setting and a multi-turn interaction sequence in first or third person; navigation is unified across text, 6-DoF pose and discrete actions; 22 automatic sub-metrics combine specialist vision models with large multimodal models and are validated against human judgments.
works.method_zh: 每个用例规定一个世界设定和一段第一或第三人称的多轮交互序列；导航指令在文字、六自由度位姿与离散动作之间统一；22 项自动子指标结合专用视觉模型与多模态大模型，并经过人工评判校验。
works.specs: 289 cases · 1,058 turns · 5 dimensions · 22 sub-metrics · 20 models · public leaderboard

paper.title: WBench: A Comprehensive Multi-turn Benchmark for Interactive Video World Model Evaluation

works.title_zh: WBench：交互视频世界模型多轮评测基准

works.title: PhysX-Omni
works.description: Open model from NTU that generates simulation-ready objects from a single image across rigid, deformable and articulated types, predicting geometry together with absolute scale, material, affordance, joints and a function description; released with the PhysXVerse dataset and the PhysX-Bench benchmark.
works.description_zh: 南洋理工大学的开源模型，可由单张图像生成可直接仿真的物体，覆盖刚体、可变形体和铰接体三类，同时预测几何、绝对尺度、材质、可供性、关节和功能描述；一并发布了 PhysXVerse 数据集和 PhysX-Bench 基准。
works.idea_en: A generated object that knows how big and how heavy it is and how it bends or opens can behave plausibly when a person or robot touches it.
works.idea_zh: 一个知道自己多大、多重、怎样弯曲或打开的生成物体，在人或机器人触碰它时才能表现得合理。
works.method: A fine-tuned Qwen2.5-VL vision-language model reasons coarse to fine over global physical properties and part-level geometry, using a geometry representation designed for VLMs that encodes high-resolution 3D structure without compression.
works.method_zh: 经微调的 Qwen2.5-VL 视觉语言模型由粗到细地推理整体物理属性和部件级几何，并采用专为视觉语言模型设计、无需压缩即可编码高分辨率三维结构的几何表示。

paper.title: PhysX-Omni: Unified Simulation-Ready Physical 3D Generation for Rigid, Deformable, and Articulated Objects

works.title_zh: PhysX-Omni：统一的可仿真物理三维生成

works.title: Gemini Omni
works.description: Google's successor to the Veo line, announced at I/O on 2026-05-19. Its first model, Gemini Omni Flash, takes any mix of text, images, audio and video and generates or conversationally edits video with sound in the Gemini app, Flow, YouTube Shorts and Google Vids; in the Gemini API it entered preview on 2026-06-30 and became generally available as gemini-omni-1.1-flash on 2026-08-27.
works.description_zh: Google 在 2026-05-19 I/O 上发布的 Veo 系列后继。首个模型 Gemini Omni Flash 可接受文本、图像、音频与视频的任意组合，生成带声音的视频或通过对话修改视频，已上线 Gemini 应用、Flow、YouTube Shorts 与 Google Vids；在 Gemini API 中于 2026-06-30 进入预览，2026-08-27 以 gemini-omni-1.1-flash 正式发布（GA）。
works.idea_en: Generation and editing merge into one conversation, so a scenario can be revised shot by shot ('make the bystander turn around') instead of re-rolled.
works.idea_zh: 生成与编辑合并为一场对话：情境可以逐镜修改（“让旁观者转过身”），而不必整段重新抽卡。
works.method: Natively multimodal Gemini-family generator that accepts up to three seconds of reference video plus images and audio; DeepMind reports leading human-rater preference for editing and for text-, image- and reference-to-video.
works.method_zh: 原生多模态的 Gemini 系列生成模型，可接收最长约 3 秒的参考视频以及图像和音频；DeepMind 称其在编辑以及文生、图生、参考生成视频的人工评测中领先。
works.specs: 360p / 720p · 1080p and 4K via upscaling · up to 3 s video reference · API GA 2026-08-27

works.title: Project Genie: Street View grounding
works.description: An I/O 2026 update that lets Project Genie start a world from a real place: users drop a Maps pin in the U.S., pick a style such as 'Ocean World' or 'B&W film', describe a character, and Genie builds the world from Street View imagery; access widened the same day to Google AI Ultra subscribers worldwide.
works.description_zh: 2026 年 I/O 大会上的更新，让 Project Genie 可以从真实地点出发：用户在地图上为美国某处放置图钉，选择“海洋世界”或“黑白电影”等风格并描述角色，Genie 便基于街景图像生成世界；同日向全球 Google AI Ultra 订阅用户开放。
works.idea_en: Grounds a generated world in a specific real street, which makes place-based scenarios possible, though only as a stylised starting point that drifts as you move.
works.idea_zh: 让生成的世界锚定在一条真实的街道上，使基于具体地点的情境成为可能；但它只是带风格化的起点，随着移动会逐渐偏离。
works.method: Street View imagery retrieved through Google's Maps Imagery Grounding conditions the opening frames, after which Genie 3 continues the world in real time from user actions.
works.method_zh: 通过谷歌的 Maps Imagery Grounding 调取街景图像作为开场画面的条件，之后由 Genie 3 根据用户动作实时延续世界。
works.specs: U.S. places at launch · global Google AI Ultra rollout (developer-reported)
works.title_zh: Project Genie：街景锚定

works.title: Rodin Gen-2.5
works.description: Rodin Gen-2.5 generates meshes of up to 10 million polygons and lets users set an adaptive 'thinking effort' that trades seconds for detail, from roughly 4-second drafts to slower hero assets, with 3D-native textures, batches of up to 10 results and manual part splitting.
works.description_zh: Rodin Gen-2.5 可生成最多 1000 万面的网格，并允许用户调节自适应的“思考强度”，用时间换细节：从约 4 秒的草稿到耗时更长的主角级资产；同时提供原生三维贴图、单次最多 10 个结果以及手动部件拆分。
works.idea_en: Adds an LLM-style speed–quality dial to 3D generation, useful when a scenario needs many cheap background props and a few detailed focal objects.
works.idea_zh: 给三维生成加入类似大语言模型的速度—质量调节，适合需要大量廉价背景道具和少数精细焦点物体的情境。
works.method: Proprietary; Deemos describes adaptive inference-time compute ('thinking effort') for geometry and texture and 3D-native texture generation, building on Gen-2's part-based pipeline.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；影眸科技称其对几何和贴图采用自适应的推理时计算（“思考强度”）和原生三维贴图生成，并沿用 Gen-2 的部件式流程。
works.specs: up to 10M polygons · 1M-poly mesh in ~4 s (developer claims)

works.title: Starchild-1
works.description: A research preview of a world model that generates synchronized sound and video in real time while the user keeps streaming in text, speech and actions, so ambient sound, conversation and events in the scene change as they are steered.
works.description_zh: 一个世界模型的研究预览：用户持续输入文字、语音与动作时，它实时生成同步的声音与画面，场景中的环境声、对话和事件都随之改变。
works.idea_en: Puts sound inside the interactive loop of a world model; in many situations what people hear (a voice, an alarm) is what drives what they do.
works.idea_zh: 把声音纳入世界模型的交互回路；在许多情境中，人听到的东西（一个声音、一声警报）正是驱动其行为的关键。
works.method: Causal distillation of a bidirectional audio-video foundation model into an autoregressive world model, with an asynchronous KV cache that handles the different time scales of audio and video during long rollouts (Odyssey technical report).
works.method_zh: 把一个双向音视频基础模型因果蒸馏为自回归世界模型，并用异步 KV 缓存处理长时推演中音频与视频不同的时间尺度（据 Odyssey 技术报告）。

works.title: Articraft
works.description: Cambridge and Oxford system in which a language model writes the program that builds an articulated object from a description and optional reference image, producing assets with parts and joints that the authors load into VR for hands-on interaction and into simulators for robot manipulation.
works.description_zh: 剑桥大学与牛津大学的系统：由语言模型根据文字描述（可附参考图）编写搭建程序，生成带部件和关节的可活动物体；作者把这些资产载入 VR 供人亲手操作，也载入仿真器用于机器人操作。
works.idea_en: Generating an object as code makes every hinge and drawer explicit and testable, so a generated room can be touched in a headset, not only looked at.
works.idea_zh: 把物体生成为代码，每个铰链和抽屉都显式可测，于是生成的房间可以在头显里伸手去碰，而不只是看。
works.method: An LLM agent writes code against a domain-specific SDK for parts, geometry, joints and tests inside a restricted harness that validates each asset and returns structured feedback, so the model never edits URDF directly.
works.method_zh: 大模型智能体在受限的运行框架中，调用一个专用 SDK 编写代码来定义部件、组合几何、设定关节并编写测试；框架验证每个资产并返回结构化反馈，模型无需直接编写 URDF。

paper.title: Articraft: An Agentic System for Scalable Articulated 3D Asset Generation

works.title_zh: Articraft：规模化生成可活动三维资产的智能体系统

works.title: Emergence World
works.description: A continuously running town of LLM agents with memories, diaries, relationships, more than 120 tools, a constitution they can amend and an energy economy, fed with live New York weather and news. In Emergence AI's first study, five 10-agent worlds that differed only in the underlying model diverged within 15 days, from zero recorded crimes in one world to hundreds in another; a second season (September 2026) injected misinformation and prompt attacks.
works.description_zh: 一个持续运行的大语言模型智能体小镇：智能体拥有记忆、日记与人际关系，可使用 120 多种工具，能修订自己的宪章，并受能量经济约束，还接入了纽约实时天气与新闻。在 Emergence AI 的第一项研究中，五个各有 10 名智能体、只在底层模型上不同的世界，在 15 天内走向截然不同的结局：有的世界没有一起犯罪记录，有的多达数百起；第二季（2026 年 9 月）又向其中投放了错误信息与提示注入攻击。
works.idea_en: Weeks-long, fully logged agent societies make drift, conformity and collapse measurable, and the same persona behaves differently depending on which models share its world.
works.idea_zh: 持续数周、全程记录的智能体社会，让行为漂移、从众与崩溃变得可以测量；而同一个人设的表现，会随与它共处同一世界的模型不同而改变。
works.method: A model-agnostic multi-agent simulation with 40+ locations, episodic, reflective and relationship memory per agent, a three-tier tool catalog, proposals that need 70% approval and decaying energy; parallel worlds start from identical conditions and vary only the foundation model, with every action recorded.
works.method_zh: 与模型无关的多智能体模拟：40 多个地点，每个智能体有情景记忆、反思日记与关系状态三种记忆，三层工具目录，提案需 70% 赞成才通过，能量随时间衰减；多个平行世界从相同条件出发，只改变底层基础模型，并记录每一个动作。
works.specs: 10 agents per world · 40+ locations · 120+ tools · 15–16-day runs · Season 2: 8 worlds, >850,000 LLM calls

paper.title: Emergence World: A Platform for Evaluating Long-Horizon Multi-Agent Autonomy

works.title: SANA-WM
works.description: NVIDIA's open 2.6B-parameter world model, trained natively for one-minute 720p videos that follow a given 6-DoF camera path; NVIDIA reports quality comparable to LingBot-World and HY-WorldPlay at far lower cost, with 15 days of training on 64 H100s and one GPU per one-minute clip.
works.description_zh: 英伟达开源的 26 亿参数世界模型，原生训练即面向一分钟、720p、沿给定六自由度相机路径运动的视频；英伟达称其画质可与 LingBot-World、HY-WorldPlay 相当而成本低得多：在 64 张 H100 上训练 15 天，每段一分钟视频只需一张 GPU。
works.idea_en: Minute-long camera-controlled worlds from a model small enough for one consumer GPU bring world generation within reach of a single lab machine.
works.idea_zh: 小到能在一张消费级显卡上运行的模型就能生成一分钟可控相机的世界，让单台实验室机器也能做世界生成。
works.method: Hybrid linear attention (frame-wise Gated DeltaNet plus softmax attention) for long context, dual-branch camera control, a two-stage pipeline with a long-video refiner, and metric-scale 6-DoF camera poses extracted from about 213K public clips.
works.method_zh: 用混合线性注意力（逐帧 Gated DeltaNet 加 softmax 注意力）处理长上下文，采用双分支相机控制、带长视频精修器的两阶段生成流程，并从约 21.3 万段公开视频中提取真实尺度的六自由度相机位姿作为监督。
works.specs: 2.6B · 720p · 60 s clips · distilled NVFP4 variant denoises a 60 s clip in 34 s on one RTX 5090 (developer-reported)

paper.title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer

works.title_zh: SANA-WM：高效的分钟级世界模型

works.title: VGGT-Ω
works.description: VGGT-Ω is the 2026 successor to VGGT: a larger feed-forward reconstructor for both static and dynamic scenes, with a text-aligned variant and a public Hugging Face demo.
works.description_zh: VGGT-Ω 是 VGGT 在 2026 年的后续版本：一个更大的前馈式重建模型，同时处理静态与动态场景，另有文本对齐版本和公开的 Hugging Face 演示。
works.idea_en: The authors report that reconstruction quality scales predictably with model and data size, which suggests feed-forward 3D will keep improving the way language models did.
works.idea_zh: 作者报告重建质量随模型与数据规模可预测地提升，这意味着前馈式三维会像语言模型那样持续进步。
works.method: A simplified VGGT with a single multi-task dense head, registers and no high-resolution convolutions, trained at larger scale with a dynamic-scene annotation pipeline and self-supervision.
works.method_zh: 简化后的 VGGT：单一多任务稠密预测头、加入寄存器标记、去掉高分辨率卷积层，并借助支持动态场景的标注流程与自监督在更大规模上训练。
works.specs: ~1B parameters · 256–512 px checkpoints · gated weights on Hugging Face

paper.title: VGGT-Ω

works.title: R-DMesh
works.description: Tencent Hunyuan's R-DMesh animates a user's static 3D mesh so that it follows the motion in a reference video, even when the mesh starts in a different pose from the first video frame. Code and weights were released in May 2026.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元的 R-DMesh 能让用户提供的静态三维网格跟随参考视频中的动作运动，即使网格的初始姿态与视频首帧不一致也能对齐。代码与权重已于 2026 年 5 月发布。
works.idea_en: Video becomes a motion-control handle for any 3D asset: film or generate the movement, then transfer it to the mesh.
works.idea_zh: 视频成为任意三维资产的动作控制手柄：先拍摄或生成动作，再迁移到网格上。
works.method: A VAE splits the input into a base mesh, relative motion trajectories and a learned rectification offset that first moves the mesh into the video's starting pose; a rectified-flow diffusion transformer conditioned on pretrained video latents generates the motion, trained on Video-RDMesh (over 500k dynamic mesh sequences).
works.method_zh: VAE 把输入分解为基础网格、相对运动轨迹以及一个学习得到的“校正跳变”偏移，先把网格移到视频的起始姿态；再由以预训练视频潜变量为条件的整流流扩散 Transformer 生成运动，训练数据为包含 50 多万条动态网格序列的 Video-RDMesh。

paper.title: R-DMesh: Video-Guided 3D Animation via Rectified Dynamic Mesh Flow

works.title_zh: R-DMesh 视频引导的三维动画

works.title: CARA-4
works.description: CARA-4 is Anam's real-time avatar diffusion model: from a single photo it renders a conversational face at 25 fps in landscape (1152×768) or portrait (768×1152), with Director Notes that let a builder set how the avatar performs (warm, distressed, angry) and let the LLM shift that direction mid-reply.
works.description_zh: CARA-4 是 Anam 的实时虚拟人扩散模型：只需一张照片即可以 25 fps 渲染横屏（1152×768）或竖屏（768×1152）的对话人脸；Director Notes 让开发者设定虚拟人的表演方式（温和、痛苦、愤怒等），并允许大模型在一次回复中途改变表演方向。
works.idea_en: Directable performance (a distressed patient versus a calm coach) turns the avatar's affect into an experimental condition you can write down.
works.idea_zh: 可导演的表演（痛苦的病人与沉着的教练）让虚拟人的情绪成为可以写下来的实验条件。
works.method: A diffusion model generating every pixel in real time, conditioned on speech audio and text performance cues, inside a conversation engine with sub-second median latency from end of user speech.
works.method_zh: 一个实时生成每个像素的扩散模型，以语音和文本表演提示为条件，运行在对话引擎中；从用户说完到虚拟人回应的中位延迟低于 1 秒。

works.title: Pixal3D
works.description: Image-to-3D model from Tencent ARC Lab and Tsinghua University that generates the asset aligned with the input photo's viewpoint instead of in a canonical pose, so the mesh matches the picture pixel by pixel; it also accepts several views and, through a modular pipeline, rebuilds a photo as a scene of separate objects. Code and weights are MIT-licensed.
works.description_zh: 腾讯 ARC Lab 与清华大学的图生三维模型：不在标准姿态下生成，而是直接按输入照片的视角生成资产，使网格与照片逐像素对齐；它也能接收多视角图像，并可借助模块化流程把一张照片重建为由独立物体组成的场景。代码与权重以 MIT 许可证开放。
works.idea_en: A generated prop finally matches the photo it came from, so a real object, or a room of them, can be rebuilt from a snapshot rather than approximated.
works.idea_zh: 生成的道具终于能和原照片对得上：真实物体乃至一整间屋子的物品，都可以从一张照片重建，而不只是近似。
works.method: Pixel back-projection conditioning lifts multi-scale image features into a view-aligned 3D feature volume, giving explicit pixel-to-3D correspondence for a 3D-native latent generator; multi-view input aggregates the back-projected volumes.
works.method_zh: 通过“像素反投影”条件，把多尺度图像特征提升到与视角对齐的三维特征体中，为原生三维潜空间生成器提供明确的像素—三维对应关系；多视角输入时把各视角反投影得到的特征体聚合起来。
works.specs: MIT licence · single- or multi-view input · ComfyUI packaging ≈786k downloads in 30 days (Hugging Face, 2026-10-18)
keywords: official video is a 250 MB release download (not linked)

paper.title: Pixal3D: Pixel-Aligned 3D Generation from Images

works.title_zh: Pixal3D 像素对齐的图生三维

works.title: GPT-Realtime-2
works.description: OpenAI's first voice model with GPT-5-class reasoning, launched with GPT-Realtime-Translate (live translation from 70+ input into 13 output languages) and GPT-Realtime-Whisper (streaming transcription). It can say short preambles such as 'let me check that', call several tools in parallel and keep the conversation going while it works. GPT-Realtime-2.1 and 2.1 mini (6 July 2026) improved alphanumeric recognition, noise handling and interruption behaviour.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 第一个具备 GPT-5 级推理能力的语音模型，同时发布 GPT-Realtime-Translate（70 多种输入语言到 13 种输出语言的实时翻译）和 GPT-Realtime-Whisper（流式转写）。它会先说一句“我查一下”之类的过渡语，可以并行调用多个工具，并在处理任务时继续对话。GPT-Realtime-2.1 及 2.1 mini（2026 年 7 月 6 日）改进了字母数字识别、噪声处理和被打断时的表现。
works.idea_en: Voice agents that reason and act mid-conversation make multi-step role-play scenarios (a dispatcher, a clerk, a negotiator) feasible over a phone line.
works.idea_zh: 能在对话中推理并采取行动的语音智能体，让多步骤角色扮演情境（调度员、办事员、谈判对手）可以在电话中实现。
works.method: Speech-to-speech model with adjustable reasoning effort, preambles and parallel tool calls in the Realtime API; conversation is still segmented into turns.
works.method_zh: 在 Realtime API 中提供的语音到语音模型，可调节推理强度，支持过渡语与并行工具调用；对话仍按轮次切分。

works.title: GenAI-Supported Virtual Patients in Health Care Education: Systematic Review
works.description: A systematic review of 15 studies (645 participants) that evaluated generative-AI virtual patients in nursing, medicine, pharmacy, radiography and first-responder training. Thirteen used OpenAI GPT models, six had 3D embodied avatars and only one delivered the patient in a head-mounted display; most interventions were single sessions without follow-up, so the authors rate the evidence as promising for feasibility but preliminary for learning effects.
works.description_zh: 一篇系统综述，纳入 15 项评估生成式 AI 虚拟病人的研究（共 645 名参与者），涵盖护理、医学、药学、放射学与急救人员培训。其中 13 项使用 OpenAI 的 GPT 模型，6 项采用三维具身化身，只有 1 项在头戴显示器中呈现病人；多数干预只有一次训练、没有随访，因此作者认为证据在可行性上有希望，但在学习效果上仍属初步。
works.idea_en: The evidence base for generative virtual patients is almost entirely flat-screen; immersive, controlled studies are the gap.
works.idea_zh: 生成式虚拟病人的证据几乎都来自平面屏幕；沉浸式的对照研究正是空白所在。
works.method: Systematic search of CINAHL, Medline, Embase, Scopus and Web of Science to March 2026; dual independent screening and extraction; JBI critical-appraisal checklists; narrative synthesis.
works.method_zh: 检索 CINAHL、Medline、Embase、Scopus 与 Web of Science 至 2026 年 3 月；两人独立筛选与提取；采用 JBI 质量评价清单；叙述性综合。

paper.title: GenAI-Supported Virtual Patients in Health Care Education: Systematic Review

works.title_zh: 生成式 AI 支持的虚拟病人在医疗卫生教育中的应用：系统综述

works.title: TripoSplat
works.description: VAST's open model that turns a single image into 3D Gaussians rather than a mesh, with the Gaussian density learned so that primitives concentrate where geometry is complex; released with code, weights and a ComfyUI workflow.
works.description_zh: VAST 的开源模型，把单张图像生成为三维高斯而非网格，并学习高斯的分布密度，让基元集中在几何复杂的区域；同时发布了代码、权重和 ComfyUI 工作流。
works.idea_en: Generated assets in splat form can sit natively inside Gaussian-splat captures of real places, narrowing the gap between captured environments and generated props.
works.idea_zh: 以高斯泼溅形式生成的资产，可以直接放进真实场所的高斯泼溅扫描中，缩小了实拍环境与生成道具之间的差距。
works.method: Density-Sampled Gaussians (DeG): Gaussian centres are sampled from a learnable density over an octree and trained with a differentiable render-contribution gradient, and a latent diffusion model is trained on the DeG representation.
works.method_zh: 密度采样高斯（DeG）：高斯中心从八叉树上的可学习概率密度中采样，用可微的渲染贡献梯度训练，再在 DeG 表示上训练潜扩散模型。

paper.title: Generative 3D Gaussians with Learned Density Control

works.title: Virtual Reality Intervention to Empower Autistic People to Interact With Police: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial for Autistic Teens and Adults
works.description: Forty-seven autistic people aged 12 to 60 were randomized to three 45-minute sessions of Floreo's VR Police Safety Module or of a video-modeling program, then were tested in live interactions with police officers. Fidgeting during those live interactions fell only in the VR group; for responding as expected and overall behavior, the group-by-time interactions were not significant, though planned tests showed gains after VR.
works.description_zh: 47 名 12 至 60 岁的自闭症人士被随机分配，接受三次各 45 分钟的 Floreo VR 警察安全模块训练或视频示范训练，然后在与真实警察的现场互动中接受测试。现场互动中的小动作只在 VR 组减少；对“按预期回应”和整体表现，组别 × 时间交互作用不显著，但计划内检验显示 VR 训练后有所改善。
works.idea_en: The outcome was measured in live encounters with officers, the transfer test most VR training studies skip, and only one of three outcomes showed a reliable group difference.
works.idea_zh: 结局在与真实警察的现场接触中测量——这是多数 VR 训练研究省略的迁移检验；三项结局中只有一项显示出可靠的组间差异。
works.method: Parallel RCT (Floreo VR vs. BeSAFE video modeling), three sessions about nine days apart, with behavior coded during live police interactions before and after training; NIH-funded, with the Center for Autism Research at the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia.
works.method_zh: 平行随机对照试验（Floreo VR 对比 BeSAFE 视频示范），三次训练间隔约九天，在训练前后的真实警察互动中对行为编码；由美国国立卫生研究院资助，与费城儿童医院自闭症研究中心合作。

paper.venue: Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders (2026)
paper.title: Virtual Reality Intervention to Empower Autistic People to Interact With Police: A Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial for Autistic Teens and Adults

works.title_zh: 帮助自闭症人士与警察互动的虚拟现实干预：面向自闭症青少年与成人的随机对照临床试验

works.title: Realtime TTS-2
works.description: Inworld's text-to-speech model for live conversation: it hears the audio of the previous turns, so the same line sounds softer after bad news and brighter after a joke, and it takes stage directions in plain English such as [speak tired but warm]. Launched on 5 May 2026 and generally available since 31 August 2026; Inworld's Realtime API wraps it in a speech-to-speech session that is marketed as full-duplex but waits for the end of the user's turn and stops when interrupted.
works.description_zh: Inworld 面向实时对话的语音合成模型：它能听到前几轮对话的音频，因此同一句话在坏消息之后会更柔和，在玩笑之后会更明快；它还接受用日常英语写的表演指示，例如 [speak tired but warm]。2026 年 5 月 5 日发布，8 月 31 日起正式可用；Inworld 的 Realtime API 把它封装成语音到语音会话，宣传为全双工，但实际上要等用户说完才回应，被打断时停止说话。
works.idea_en: Delivery conditioned on how the person actually sounded gives a scripted character an affective reaction without hand-tagging every line.
works.idea_zh: 根据对方实际的说话语气来调整发声，让脚本化的角色无需逐句标注也能有情绪上的回应。
works.method: TTS model that takes prior-turn audio as context, with natural-language steering tags and prose voice design; a Flash variant (9 August 2026) drops steering for lower latency.
works.method_zh: 以前几轮对话音频为上下文的语音合成模型，支持自然语言表演指示标签和用文字描述设计声音；2026 年 8 月 9 日推出的 Flash 版本去掉表演指示以换取更低延迟。
works.specs: TTS-2 ~100 ms · TTS-2 Flash 20 ms time to first audio (server-side P90, developer claim) · 100+ languages
works.title_zh: Realtime TTS-2 实时语音合成

works.title: iWorld-Bench
works.description: An ICML 2026 benchmark from Tsinghua University for the interaction abilities of world models: 330K collected clips, 2.1K curated samples across perspectives, weather and scenes, and 4.9K test samples in six task types covering visual quality, trajectory following and memory. An action-generation framework lets models with different control interfaces be tested alike, and 14 models are on its public leaderboard.
works.description_zh: 清华大学在 ICML 2026 发表的世界模型交互能力基准：收集 33 万段视频，精选 2100 个覆盖不同视角、天气与场景的样本，构造六类任务共 4900 个测试样本，涵盖画面质量、轨迹跟随与记忆。它用一个“动作生成框架”让控制接口不同的模型能被同样测试，公开排行榜上有 14 个模型。
works.idea_en: Translates one test into each model's own control language, so camera-, keyboard- and text-driven world models can be compared on distance perception and memory.
works.idea_zh: 把同一个测试翻译成各个模型自己的控制方式，使相机、键盘与文字驱动的世界模型能在距离感知与记忆上比较。
works.method: An Action Generation Framework converts each task into the input modality a model accepts; six task types are scored with metrics such as brightness and color-temperature consistency, trajectory alignment and memory symmetry.
works.method_zh: “动作生成框架”把每个任务转换为模型可接受的输入形式；六类任务用亮度与色温一致性、轨迹对齐、记忆对称性等指标评分。
works.specs: 330K clips · 2.1K curated samples · 4.9K test samples · 6 task types · 14 models

paper.title: iWorld-Bench: A Benchmark for Interactive World Models with a Unified Action Generation Framework

works.title_zh: iWorld-Bench：交互世界模型基准

works.title: Prop-Chromeleon
works.description: Hold a water bottle, type 'a magic lantern', and a virtual lantern shaped to fit the bottle is generated and anchored onto it in mixed reality, so what you see matches what you feel.
works.description_zh: 手握一个水瓶，输入“魔法灯笼”，系统就生成一个贴合水瓶形状的虚拟灯笼并锚定在它上面，让你看到的与摸到的一致。
works.idea_en: Constraining generation to the shape of a real object turns any household item into a passive haptic prop for generated content.
works.idea_zh: 把生成约束在真实物体的形状之内，任何家居物品都能成为生成内容的被动触觉道具。
works.method: A generative pipeline produces 3D assets from text prompts under geometric constraints from the scanned prop and anchors them to it; a generation study scores shape similarity and prompt fidelity, and a user study compares realism and enjoyment with static props.
works.method_zh: 生成流程在扫描道具的几何约束下，根据文字提示生成三维资产并锚定在道具上；生成实验评估形状相似度与提示忠实度，用户研究则与静态道具比较真实感和乐趣。

paper.title: Prop-Chromeleon: Adaptive Haptic Props in Mixed Reality through Generative Artificial Intelligence

works.title: Echo-2
works.description: SpAItial's second world model generates real-time navigable 3D scenes from text or images that run in a browser on any device; in June 2026 the company added a Claude plugin and hosted MCP server for generating and editing worlds from a chat.
works.description_zh: SpAItial 的第二代世界模型，根据文字或图像生成可实时漫游、在任何设备浏览器中运行的三维场景；2026 年 6 月又推出 Claude 插件和托管 MCP 服务器，可在对话中生成与编辑世界。
works.idea_en: World generation is becoming a tool call: an agent can now request, edit and hand over a 3D place in the middle of a conversation.
works.idea_zh: 世界生成正在变成一次“工具调用”：智能体可以在对话中途请求、编辑并交付一个三维场所。
works.method: Generates one spatially persistent 3D scene per prompt instead of a frame sequence; SpAItial claims it outperforms Marble 1.1 on the WorldScore benchmark (company claim, not independently verified).
works.method_zh: 每个提示词生成一个空间上持久的三维场景，而不是一串画面；SpAItial 称其在 WorldScore 基准上优于 Marble 1.1（公司自述，未经独立验证）。

works.title: Leveraging Generative AI for High-Fidelity 360° Spatial Images: Methodological Validation for Use as Experimental Stimuli
works.description: A workflow for producing controlled 360° stimuli for environmental-psychology experiments: Skybox AI (Model 4) generates a fixed atrium panorama and Gemini 3 Flash Image (Nano Banana 2) inpaints greenery in eight placement and density variants. Image-quality metrics showed few stitching artefacts, and seven senior experts viewing the scenes in a Meta Quest 3 rated presence higher for the generated stimuli than for a conventionally modelled 3D reference (6.14 vs. 4.40 on a 7-point scale).
works.description_zh: 一套为环境心理学实验制作受控 360° 刺激材料的流程：先用 Skybox AI（Model 4）生成固定的中庭全景，再用 Gemini 3 Flash Image（Nano Banana 2）以局部重绘方式加入绿植，形成八种布置与密度变体。图像质量指标显示拼接处畸变很少；七位资深专家在 Meta Quest 3 中观看后，对生成刺激的临场感评分高于传统三维建模的对照场景（7 分制 6.14 对 4.40）。
works.idea_en: Generated panoramas can be held constant except for one manipulated factor, which is what an experiment needs; the validation so far rests on expert ratings, not on participant behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 生成的全景可以只改变一个被操纵的因素、其余保持不变，这正是实验所需要的；不过目前的验证依据是专家评分，而不是被试的行为。
works.method: Three-stage pipeline (prompted base panorama with fixed structure, materials and lighting; AI inpainting of greenery on walls, columns and balustrades; validation) evaluated with SSIM, LPIPS, BRISQUE, NIQE, MUSIQ, aesthetic and CLIP-IQA scores and a seven-expert HMD rating against a conventionally modelled reference (Wilcoxon signed-rank test).
works.method_zh: 三阶段流程（以提示词生成结构、材质与光照固定的基础全景；用 AI 局部重绘在墙面、柱子与栏杆上加入绿植；验证），以 SSIM、LPIPS、BRISQUE、NIQE、MUSIQ、美学评分与 CLIP-IQA 评估，并由七位专家在头显中与传统建模的对照场景比较评分（Wilcoxon 符号秩检验）。
works.specs: 8K equirectangular base · 4K final · 8 variants · 7 expert raters · Meta Quest 3

paper.title: Leveraging Generative AI for High-Fidelity 360° Spatial Images: Methodological Validation for Use as Experimental Stimuli

works.title_zh: 用生成式 AI 制作高保真 360° 空间图像：作为实验刺激的方法学验证

works.title: Seed3D 2.0
works.description: Second Seed3D generation focused on geometric precision and material quality; it adds part-level segmentation and completion, articulated assets exported with joint information in URDF for simulators such as Isaac Sim, and scene composition from images, videos or text. It is offered through ByteDance's Volcano Engine Ark platform.
works.description_zh: 第二代 Seed3D，重点提升几何精度与材质质量；新增部件级分割与补全、以 URDF 格式导出带关节信息的可动资产（可用于 Isaac Sim 等仿真器），以及由图像、视频或文字进行场景组合。通过字节跳动火山引擎方舟平台提供。
works.idea_en: Articulated output, such as drawers that open and doors that swing, turns a generated prop into something a person or a robot can manipulate.
works.idea_zh: 可动结构的输出（能拉开的抽屉、能转动的门）让生成的道具变成人或机器人可以操作的东西。
works.method: Coarse-to-fine two-stage geometry generation and a unified Mixture-of-Experts PBR material model with vision-language priors for material decomposition under unknown lighting (ByteDance Seed blog).
works.method_zh: 由粗到细的两阶段几何生成，加上统一的混合专家（MoE）PBR 材质模型，并引入视觉语言先验以在未知光照下分解材质（据字节跳动 Seed 博客）。

works.title: Vista4D
works.description: Vista4D (Eyeline Labs and Netflix with Columbia, UCLA and others, CVPR 2026 highlight) re-shoots an existing video from a new camera trajectory while keeping the same action: the input is lifted into a 4D point cloud that preserves what was seen and guides the camera, and the model fills in the rest; it also supports scene expansion and recomposition. Code and models are public.
works.description_zh: Vista4D（Eyeline Labs 与 Netflix，联合哥伦比亚大学、加州大学洛杉矶分校等，CVPR 2026 Highlight）用新的镜头轨迹“重拍”已有视频，同时保持原有动作：输入被提升为 4D 点云，用来保留已拍到的内容并引导镜头，其余部分由模型补全；它还支持场景扩展与重新组合。代码与模型已公开。
works.idea_en: One recorded take can be viewed from other camera positions, so a filmed scenario can be varied in viewpoint after the fact.
works.idea_zh: 一次拍摄可以从其他机位观看，录好的情境在事后也能改变视角。
works.method: 4D reconstruction with static-pixel segmentation builds a point cloud that is rendered along the target camera path; a video model trained on reconstructed multi-view dynamic data turns it into the final video while tolerating point-cloud artefacts.
works.method_zh: 通过带静态像素分割的 4D 重建得到点云，沿目标镜头路径渲染；视频模型在重建的多视角动态数据上训练，可容忍点云伪影，并据此生成最终视频。

paper.title: Vista4D: Video Reshooting with 4D Point Clouds

works.title_zh: Vista4D：基于 4D 点云的视频重拍

works.title: HappyHorse
works.description: HappyHorse is an Alibaba audio-video model that first appeared anonymously on the Artificial Analysis Video Arena in April 2026, where press reports say it took first place before Alibaba's ATH group claimed it. HappyHorse 1.0 reached the Model Studio API on 2026-04-21 (text-, image- and reference-to-video, plus video editing) and HappyHorse 1.1 followed on 2026-06-16; both generate up to 15 s of 1080p video with sound in one pass.
works.description_zh: HappyHorse 是阿里巴巴的音视频模型，2026 年 4 月先以匿名身份出现在 Artificial Analysis 视频竞技场，据媒体报道一度排名第一，之后阿里巴巴 ATH 集团才认领。HappyHorse 1.0 于 2026-04-21 登陆百炼 API（文生、图生、参考生视频及视频编辑），HappyHorse 1.1 于 2026-06-16 推出；两者都能一次生成最长 15 秒、带声音的 1080p 视频。
works.idea_en: A blind arena debut shows how quickly the frontier moves: an unannounced model from a second Alibaba team beat established video lines on human preference.
works.idea_zh: 匿名登榜说明前沿变化之快：阿里另一支团队未经发布的模型，在人类偏好评测中胜过了老牌视频模型。
works.method: Reported as a single 15B-parameter transformer that attends jointly over text, image, video and audio tokens (community documentation; not confirmed by an Alibaba paper).
works.method_zh: 据社区整理的资料，是一个对文本、图像、视频与音频 token 统一做自注意力的 150 亿参数 Transformer（未经阿里论文证实）。

works.title: EmbodiedHead
works.description: EmbodiedHead gives an LLM voice agent a real-time talking head that both speaks and listens: while the user talks it keeps its mouth still and reacts, and when the LLM replies it lip-syncs, switching between the two states from a single audio stream without looking ahead at the other speaker.
works.description_zh: EmbodiedHead 为大模型语音智能体提供一个既会说也会听的实时头部虚拟人：用户说话时它闭着嘴做出反应，大模型回复时它对口型说话；两种状态在单路音频流中切换，不需要预知对方接下来会说什么。
works.idea_en: Listening is a state the face must represent explicitly; otherwise an avatar either mouths along with the user or freezes while they talk.
works.idea_zh: “正在倾听”是脸部必须显式表达的状态；否则虚拟人要么跟着用户的话动嘴，要么在对方说话时僵住。
works.method: A Rectified-Flow Diffusion Transformer, sampled in as few as four steps, generates face-model coefficients conditioned on the reference, motion magnitude and a per-frame listening/speaking state, fed by a streaming audio scheduler that merges user and LLM audio, and a differentiable renderer produces the image.
works.method_zh: 一个最少四步采样的整流流扩散 Transformer，以参考图、动作幅度和逐帧的倾听/说话状态为条件生成人脸模型系数；流式音频调度器合并用户与大模型的音频作为输入，再由可微渲染器生成画面。

paper.title: EmbodiedHead: Real-Time Listening and Speaking Avatar for Conversational Agents

works.title_zh: EmbodiedHead：面向对话智能体的实时倾听与说话头像

works.title: HY-World 2.0
works.description: Tencent's second-generation open world model: text or a single image is expanded into a navigable 3D Gaussian-splat or mesh world, and multi-view photos or video are reconstructed into 3D, with outputs that import into Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine and Isaac Sim. Weights were released in April–May 2026; an HY World 2.1 update, usable in Tencent's web product, followed in July 2026.
works.description_zh: 腾讯第二代开源世界模型：把文字或单张图像扩展为可漫游的三维高斯泼溅或网格世界，也能把多视角照片或视频重建为三维，输出可直接导入 Blender、Unity、虚幻引擎和 Isaac Sim。权重于 2026 年 4–5 月陆续开源，7 月发布 HY World 2.1 更新，可在腾讯的网页产品中使用。
works.idea_en: Tencent frames it explicitly against video world models: build the world once as assets and render it for free, instead of paying per frame for a world that disappears.
works.idea_zh: 腾讯明确把它与视频世界模型对照：把世界一次性建成资产、此后渲染几乎零成本，而不是为一个会消失的世界逐帧付费。
works.method: Four stages: HY-Pano 2.0 (about 80B parameters) generates a panorama, WorldNav plans camera trajectories, WorldStereo 2.0 (about 17B) expands the world with keyframe views and geometric memory, and WorldMirror 2.0, a feed-forward model predicting depth, normals, cameras, points and 3DGS, composes the final world.
works.method_zh: 共四个阶段：HY-Pano 2.0（约 800 亿参数）生成全景图，WorldNav 规划镜头轨迹，WorldStereo 2.0（约 170 亿参数）借助关键帧视图与几何记忆扩展世界，最后由能前馈预测深度、法线、相机、点云和 3DGS 的 WorldMirror 2.0 合成完整世界。

paper.title: HY-World 2.0: A Multi-Modal World Model for Reconstructing, Generating, and Simulating 3D Worlds

works.title_zh: 混元世界模型 2.0（HY-World 2.0）

works.title: HappyOyster
works.description: Alibaba's real-time world-model product: in Directing mode a person steers a running scene for up to three minutes with text, voice or images, and in Wandering (later Adventure) mode explores an expanding world in first or third person; the HappyOyster 1.0 upgrade (2026-06-17) added sprinting, jumping, attacking, mounting horses or vehicles, and a rewind that returns to key moments to branch the story.
works.description_zh: 阿里巴巴推出的实时世界模型产品：在“执导”模式中，用户可用文字、语音或图片引导一段持续演进的场景，最长三分钟；在“漫游”（后改为“冒险”）模式中，可以第一或第三人称探索不断延展的世界。2026 年 6 月 17 日的 HappyOyster 1.0 加入了冲刺、跳跃、攻击、骑马或进入载具等动作，并可回溯到关键时刻，让剧情走向另一条分支。
works.idea_en: Treats a world model as a live directing tool: the person can step in at any moment and rewind to branch the story, which is closer to running a scenario than to rendering a clip.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型当作现场导演工具：人可以随时介入，也能回溯到某一刻改走另一条分支，更像在运行一个情境，而不是渲染一段视频。
works.method: A natively multimodal video model trained on long-form video that takes text, navigation actions and images as continuous control signals and generates audio and video in one stream; the architecture is not published.
works.method_zh: 一个原生多模态视频模型，在长视频数据上训练，把文字、导航动作和图像作为持续的控制信号，在同一条流中生成音频与视频；架构细节未公开。
works.specs: Directing up to 3 min at 480p / 720p · Wandering up to 1 min at 480p (developer-reported)
works.title_zh: 快乐生蚝

works.title: LingBot-Map
works.description: LingBot-Map is an open streaming 3D reconstruction model from Ant Group's Robbyant that turns a live video stream into camera poses and a point cloud at about 20 frames per second.
works.description_zh: LingBot-Map 是蚂蚁集团灵波科技（Robbyant）发布的开源流式三维重建模型，可将实时视频流以约每秒 20 帧的速度转换为相机位姿与点云。
works.idea_en: Feed-forward reconstruction that keeps up with a walking camera is what live mapping of a person's surroundings needs.
works.idea_zh: 能跟上行走相机速度的前馈式重建，正是实时映射人周围环境所需要的。
works.method: A geometric context transformer combines an anchor context, a pose-reference window and a trajectory memory in its attention to limit drift while keeping the streaming state compact.
works.method_zh: 几何上下文 Transformer 在注意力中结合锚点上下文、位姿参考窗口与轨迹记忆，在保持流式状态紧凑的同时抑制漂移。

paper.title: LingBot-Map: Geometric Context Transformer for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

works.title_zh: LingBot-Map 流式三维重建

works.title: Lyra 2.0
works.description: NVIDIA's open successor to Lyra for large environments: it generates long camera-controlled walkthroughs that can turn back and revisit places, and lifts them into a persistent 3D world exportable as splats or meshes, for example as robot training scenes in Isaac Sim. GUI and training code were released in July 2026.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 面向大场景的开源 Lyra 后继版本：生成可以回头、重访已到过地点的长距离镜头漫游视频，并把它提升为可导出为泼溅或网格的持久三维世界，例如用作 Isaac Sim 中的机器人训练场景。2026 年 7 月发布了图形界面与训练代码。
works.idea_en: It targets the two failures that limit long generated walks, forgetting places that fall out of context and drifting appearance, which are also what break a participant's sense of a stable place.
works.idea_zh: 它针对长距离生成漫游的两大问题——走出上下文后忘掉去过的地方、外观逐渐漂移——而这两点恰恰也是破坏参与者“稳定场所感”的原因。
works.method: Per-frame 3D geometry is kept only to retrieve relevant past frames and build dense correspondences with the target view (against spatial forgetting), the video model is trained on self-augmented histories of its own degraded outputs (against drift), and the long trajectories fine-tune feed-forward reconstruction into 3D Gaussians and meshes.
works.method_zh: 保留逐帧三维几何，只用于检索相关的历史帧并与目标视角建立稠密对应（应对空间遗忘）；用模型自身退化输出构成的“自增强历史”训练视频模型（应对漂移）；再用得到的长轨迹微调前馈式重建，输出三维高斯与网格。
works.specs: long-horizon walkthroughs with revisits · 3DGS and mesh export

paper.title: Lyra 2.0: Explorable Generative 3D Worlds

works.title: AgentHands
works.description: AgentHands is a Google XR research prototype in which a voice agent in a headset gets a pair of virtual hands that point at, trace and demonstrate real objects around the user, in sync with its words (for example outlining an orchid's aerial roots, or a warning glow over a hot 3D-printer nozzle). In a within-subjects study (N=12) against speech only with the same scripted words, participants found objects, directions and required actions significantly easier to understand.
works.description_zh: AgentHands 是 Google XR 的研究原型：头显中的语音智能体获得一双虚拟手，能随着话语指向、描摹和演示用户身边的真实物体（例如勾勒兰花的气生根，或在高温的 3D 打印机喷嘴上加一道警示光晕）。在一项被试内研究（N=12）中，与台词相同的纯语音条件相比，参与者明显更容易找到所指物体、理解方向和需要做的动作。
works.idea_en: Nonverbal behaviour can be anchored to the participant's real room: the agent's gestures land on physical objects at the moment it says 'this'.
works.idea_zh: 非语言行为可以锚定在参与者所处的真实房间里：智能体说“这个”的那一刻，手势正好落在实物上。
works.method: Objects are registered with eye gaze and scene reconstruction as 3D boxes; the LLM writes replies with inline GestureEvents (handedness, gesture, spatiality, temporal dynamics, interactivity, visual effect) attached to trigger words, and a headset-side parser plays them from a gesture library in sync with TTS word timestamps. Developed from a formative study with XR and gesture experts.
works.method_zh: 先借助眼动和场景重建把物体登记为三维包围盒；大模型在回复中插入与触发词绑定的 GestureEvent（惯用手、手势、空间性、时间动态、交互性、视觉效果），头显端解析器依据语音合成的逐词时间戳，从手势库中同步播放这些手部动作。系统设计基于一项面向 XR 与手势专家的形成性研究。
works.specs: N=12 within-subjects · 2 tasks (orchid care, 3D printer) · 6-dimension gesture taxonomy

paper.title: AgentHands: Generating Interactive Hand Gestures for Spatially Grounded Agent Conversations in XR

works.title_zh: AgentHands：为 XR 中空间锚定的智能体对话生成交互式手势

works.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality
works.description: VR system for training cognitive empathy in which users work with three LLM-driven avatars of clearly different personalities and switch roles to see situations through another person's eyes; the personalities were validated in an online experiment (n=90) and the system was tested in a lab study (n=32).
works.description_zh: 用于训练认知共情的 VR 系统：用户与三个性格迥异、由大语言模型驱动的化身协作，并通过角色互换从他人视角体验情境；化身性格在线上实验（n=90）中得到验证，系统在实验室研究（n=32）中接受了评估。
works.idea_en: Personality becomes a controllable, pre-validated parameter of LLM characters, a step toward treating generated people as calibrated stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 性格成为大语言模型角色可控且经预先验证的参数——朝着把生成的人物视为“经过校准的刺激”迈出了一步。
works.method: LLM-driven avatars with prompted personalities, technical and online validation of perceived personality, then a lab experiment on cognitive-empathy outcomes.
works.method_zh: 以提示词设定性格的大语言模型化身，先进行技术评估与线上性格感知验证，再开展关于认知共情结果的实验室实验。

paper.title: CoEmpaTeam: Enhancing Cognitive Empathy using LLM-based Avatars and Dynamic Role Play in Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: CoEmpaTeam：在虚拟现实中用大语言模型化身与动态角色扮演提升认知共情

works.title: Empowered XR through Generative AI
works.description: A CHI 2026 synthesis of 135 recent systems and studies that sorts what LLM-enabled XR gives people into 'superpowers', internal (cognitive and sensory enhancement) and external (changing environments and social situations), and maps the risks each one carries.
works.description_zh: CHI 2026 的一篇综合研究，梳理 135 项近期系统与研究，把大语言模型赋能的 XR 带给人的能力归为“超能力”：内在的（认知与感官增强）和外在的（改变环境与社交情境），并逐一对应其风险。
works.idea_en: Every generative superpower in a headset comes with a matching risk to autonomy, privacy or transparency, so a generated situation needs its safeguards designed alongside its capabilities.
works.idea_zh: 头显里的每一种生成式“超能力”都伴随着对自主性、隐私或透明度的风险，因此生成情境的防护措施必须与能力同步设计。
works.method: Multi-phase analysis of 135 recent works on generative AI in XR, producing a taxonomy of internal and external superpowers with their associated risks (user autonomy, data security, ethical transparency), plus design guidelines and a research agenda.
works.method_zh: 对 135 项 XR 中生成式 AI 的近期工作进行多阶段分析，得出内在与外在超能力及其风险（用户自主、数据安全、伦理透明）的分类，并提出设计准则与研究议程。

paper.title: Empowered XR through Generative AI: Balancing Superpowers and Risks

works.title_zh: 生成式 AI 赋能的 XR：在超能力与风险之间权衡

works.title: LLM-based Embodied Conversational Agent for Reducing Foreign Language Speaking Anxiety in Social VR
works.description: English learners practised role-plays for 30 minutes a day over five days with an LLM-driven embodied agent in three social VR scenarios. Self-reported foreign language anxiety fell significantly after three days, speaking measures improved slightly, and learners credited the agent's non-judgemental stance, scaffolding and encouragement.
works.description_zh: 英语学习者连续五天、每天 30 分钟，在三个社交 VR 场景中与大语言模型驱动的具身智能体进行角色扮演。三天后自评外语焦虑显著下降，口语指标略有提升；学习者认为这得益于智能体不评判的态度、语言支架和情感鼓励。
works.idea_en: A patient, non-judging conversation partner is hard to staff with people and easy to generate; the evidence is still one small cohort without a control group.
works.idea_zh: 一个耐心、不评判的对话伙伴很难长期由真人担任，却容易生成；不过目前的证据仍来自一个没有对照组的小样本。
works.method: Five-day mixed-methods study (N = 20, no control group) with daily 30-minute role-play against an LLM-based embodied agent in social VR; foreign language anxiety scale, speaking-proficiency measures and interviews.
works.method_zh: 为期五天的混合方法研究（N = 20，无对照组），每天在社交 VR 中与基于大语言模型的具身智能体进行 30 分钟角色扮演；测量外语焦虑量表、口语能力指标并进行访谈。

paper.title: LLM-based Embodied Conversational Agent for Reducing Foreign Language Speaking Anxiety in Social VR

works.title_zh: 社交 VR 中用于缓解外语口语焦虑的大语言模型具身对话智能体

works.title: Quantifying Latencies: A Conversation Analysis Approach to Human-Agent Interactions in Virtual Reality
works.description: Conversation analysis of spoken exchanges between people and LLM-based agents in social VR, timing responses and repairs. Agents took a median 4.1 s to respond versus 1.2 s for the human speakers, and the authors describe a 'conversational timing drift' in which agents start speaking too late and fail to stop quickly when interrupted.
works.description_zh: 对社交 VR 中人与大语言模型智能体的口语对话进行会话分析，测量回应时序与修复行为。智能体回应的中位延迟为 4.1 秒，人类说话者为 1.2 秒；作者将其描述为“对话时序漂移”：智能体开口太晚，被打断时又不能很快停下。
works.idea_en: Turn-taking, not content, is where LLM-driven characters break the illusion first; a few seconds of silence is a measurable cost to plausibility.
works.idea_zh: 最先打破错觉的是话轮转换，而不是内容；几秒钟的沉默是可以量化的似真性代价。
works.method: Conversation-analytic coding of human–agent talk in social VR, measuring response latency of agents and humans, start-up latency, wind-down latency after interruption and repair attempts; the authors present it as the first empirical quantification of human–agent conversational latency in VR.
works.method_zh: 对社交 VR 中人与智能体的对话进行会话分析编码，测量智能体与人的回应延迟、开口延迟、被打断后的收声延迟以及修复尝试；作者称这是首次在 VR 中对人与智能体的对话延迟进行实证量化。
works.specs: median response latency 4.1 s (agent) vs. 1.2 s (human)

paper.title: Quantifying Latencies: A Conversation Analysis Approach to Human-Agent Interactions in Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: 量化延迟：用会话分析研究虚拟现实中的人与智能体互动

works.title: Should the AI Speak First? Evaluating Proactive vs. Reactive Facilitation in Mixed-Reality Medical Training
works.description: Medical students practised lumbar puncture in a mixed-reality simulator with an AI facilitator that either offered guidance and encouragement on its own initiative or answered only when asked (n = 22). Learning outcomes, interaction frequency and experience ratings did not differ, but interviews and behaviour logs showed that unprompted help was welcome in some task phases and disruptive in others.
works.description_zh: 医学生在混合现实模拟器中练习腰椎穿刺，AI 引导者或主动提供指导与鼓励，或只在被询问时回答（n = 22）。两种方式在学习结果、互动频率和体验评分上没有差异，但访谈和行为记录显示：主动帮助在某些任务阶段受欢迎，在另一些阶段则造成干扰。
works.idea_en: When a generated character should take the initiative is a design variable of its own, and it depends on task phase and load rather than on one fixed setting.
works.idea_zh: 生成角色何时主动开口本身就是一个设计变量，它取决于任务阶段和认知负荷，而不是一个固定设置。
works.method: Mixed-methods comparison of proactive and reactive versions of an AI facilitator (likely LLM-based, as in the group's EmSim) in an XR lumbar-puncture simulator with 22 medical students; learning outcomes, interaction logs, experience ratings, behavioural analysis and interviews, synthesised into a boundary framework for AI proactivity.
works.method_zh: 在 XR 腰椎穿刺模拟器中，以 22 名医学生比较 AI 引导者（可能与该团队的 EmSim 一样基于大语言模型）的主动与被动两个版本；测量学习结果、互动日志、体验评分，并进行行为分析与访谈，最终归纳出 AI 主动性的边界框架。
works.specs: n=22 · proactive vs. reactive · lumbar puncture simulator

paper.title: Should the AI Speak First? Evaluating Proactive vs. Reactive Facilitation in Mixed-Reality Medical Training

works.title_zh: AI 该先开口吗？混合现实医学训练中主动与被动引导的比较

works.title: AniGen
works.description: Open model from the University of Hong Kong and VAST that turns a single image into a rigged 3D asset, generating the mesh, an articulated skeleton and skinning weights together for animals, humanoids and machines, so it can be driven by existing motion data straight away.
works.description_zh: 香港大学与 VAST 的开源模型，可由单张图像生成已绑定的三维资产：网格、关节骨骼和蒙皮权重一起生成，适用于动物、人形和机械，生成后可直接用现成的动作数据驱动。
works.idea_en: Rigging is generated with the shape rather than guessed afterwards, which removes the step where most generated characters fail to move properly.
works.idea_zh: 骨骼绑定与形状一起生成，而不是事后再推断，省去了多数生成角色“动不起来”的那一步。
works.method: Shape, skeleton and skin are represented as mutually consistent fields over a shared domain (S³ Fields), with a confidence-decaying skeleton field and a dual skin feature field, generated by a two-stage flow-matching pipeline built on TRELLIS-style structured latents.
works.method_zh: 把形状、骨骼和蒙皮表示为同一空间域上相互一致的场（S³ Fields），配合置信度衰减的骨骼场和双重蒙皮特征场，由基于 TRELLIS 式结构化潜空间的两阶段流匹配管线生成。

paper.title: AniGen: Unified S³ Fields for Animatable 3D Asset Generation

works.title_zh: AniGen：可直接做动画的三维资产生成

works.title: LPM 1.0 (Large Performance Model)
works.description: LPM 1.0 is a video model for conversational character performance: given a character image, it generates listening video from the user's audio and speaking video from synthesized speech, with text prompts for motion, in real time and at unbounded length while keeping identity stable. The authors propose LPM-Bench for interactive character performance.
works.description_zh: LPM 1.0 是一个用于对话角色表演的视频模型：给定一张角色图像，它会根据用户的音频生成倾听画面，根据合成语音生成说话画面，并可用文本提示控制动作；它实时运行、时长不受限，同时保持身份稳定。作者还提出了交互式角色表演基准 LPM-Bench。
works.idea_en: Frames expressiveness, real-time speed and long-horizon identity as one 'performance trilemma' that game NPCs and live characters must solve together.
works.idea_zh: 把表现力、实时速度和长时身份一致性视为同一个“表演三难”，游戏 NPC 和直播角色必须同时解决。
works.method: A 17B Diffusion Transformer trained on speaking-listening paired human video with identity-aware references, distilled into a causal streaming generator (Online LPM).
works.method_zh: 在说话-倾听配对的人物视频和身份参考上训练 17B 扩散 Transformer，再蒸馏为因果流式生成器（Online LPM）。

paper.title: LPM 1.0: Video-based Character Performance Model

works.title_zh: LPM 1.0 大型表演模型

works.title: Waypoint-1.5
works.description: An open-weight real-time world model that runs locally on gaming PCs or by streaming, turning a prompt or image into an explorable first-person world; it follows Waypoint-1 (January 2026), and a Waypoint 2 beta was inviting builders in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重的实时世界模型，可在游戏电脑上本地运行或通过串流使用，把一段提示或一张图像变成可探索的第一人称世界；它是 Waypoint-1（2026 年 1 月）的后继，2026 年 10 月 Waypoint 2 正在分批邀请开发者内测。
works.idea_en: World models on consumer hardware: a lab can run sessions offline, log them and avoid cloud latency.
works.idea_zh: 让世界模型跑在消费级硬件上：实验室可以离线运行、记录会话，并避开云端延迟。
works.method: A real-time diffusion world model with a prompting pipeline that rewrites user input into seed images, synthetic video and aligned controls, released in 720p and 360p tiers for local and streamed play.
works.method_zh: 实时扩散世界模型，配有把用户输入改写为种子图像、合成视频与对齐操控信号的提示流程；分为 720p 与 360p 两档，可本地运行或串流。
works.specs: up to 720p · 60 fps · 1B parameters · consumer GPUs (developer-reported)

paper.title: Waypoint-1.5: A Real-Time Video World Model for Consumer Hardware

works.title: Avatar V
works.description: Avatar V is HeyGen's avatar model and the successor to Avatar IV: from a 15-second phone recording it renders a person's digital twin speaking any script in 177+ languages and dialects, keeping the face consistent across camera angles, new outfits and settings, and long videos. Since June 2026 it renders up to 30 minutes of continuous talking video in one pass, on the web app and the API.
works.description_zh: Avatar V 是 HeyGen 接替 Avatar IV 的虚拟人模型：只需一段 15 秒的手机录像，就能生成一个人的数字分身，用 177 种以上语言和方言念出任意脚本，并在不同机位、更换服装与场景以及长视频中保持面孔一致。自 2026 年 6 月起，可在网页端和 API 中一次生成长达 30 分钟的连续讲话视频。
works.idea_en: Separates a person's recorded performance from their appearance, so one short take yields many looks of the same identity, which is useful for controlled variants of a speaker, and a risk for impersonation.
works.idea_zh: 把一个人录下的表演与外观分离，一段短录像就能生成同一身份的多种造型，便于制作受控的讲者变体，也带来冒充风险。
works.method: A proprietary video-diffusion avatar model trained on multi-angle and long-form footage that builds an identity representation from the reference clip and renders new looks and long takes with streaming inference; HeyGen has not published the architecture.
works.method_zh: 专有的视频扩散虚拟人模型，用多角度和长时长素材训练，从参考片段建立身份表征，再以流式推理生成新造型和长镜头；HeyGen 未公开架构。
works.specs: 15 s reference clip · up to 30 min continuous video (since June 2026) · 177+ languages and dialects (developer-reported)

works.title: GameWorld
works.description: A benchmark of 34 browser games and 170 tasks for testing multimodal models as game agents, either as computer-use agents that press keys and move the mouse or through a parsed semantic action space; every task is scored from the game's own state. Across 18 model-interface pairs, the best agent remained far from human play.
works.description_zh: 一个包含 34 款网页游戏、170 项任务的基准，用来测试多模态模型作为游戏智能体的能力：既可以作为直接按键、移动鼠标的计算机操作智能体，也可以通过解析后的语义动作空间行动；每项任务都依据游戏自身的状态评分。在 18 组模型与接口的组合中，表现最好的智能体仍远不及人类玩家。
works.idea_en: Scoring from game state rather than from a judge model makes agent behavior in a world checkable and repeatable, the property an experimental platform needs.
works.idea_zh: 依据游戏状态而不是评审模型来打分，让智能体在世界中的行为可核验、可重复，这正是实验平台所需的特性。
works.method: Games run in the browser with two agent interfaces, raw keyboard-and-mouse control and deterministic semantic action parsing; outcome metrics are read from game state, and repeated full reruns check the benchmark's stability.
works.method_zh: 游戏在浏览器中运行，提供两种智能体接口：原始键鼠操作与确定性的语义动作解析；结果指标直接从游戏状态读取，并通过多次完整重跑检验基准的稳定性。

paper.title: GameWorld: Towards Standardized and Verifiable Evaluation of Multimodal Game Agents

works.title: InSpatio-World
works.description: InSpatio-World turns a single reference video into a dynamic scene a person can move through in real time, pausing, slowing or reversing time while changing the viewpoint. 1.3B weights (Apache-2.0) and a browser demo are public.
works.description_zh: InSpatio-World 能把单段参考视频变成可实时漫游的动态场景：人可以一边改变视角，一边暂停、放慢或倒放时间。1.3B 权重（Apache-2.0）与网页演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Real-time 4D from footage: a recorded event becomes a place you can re-enter and view from new positions, while generation stays anchored to the source video.
works.idea_zh: 从视频素材实时得到 4D：一次被录下的事件变成可以重新进入、从新位置观看的地方，同时生成始终锚定原视频。
works.method: A spatiotemporal autoregressive (STAR) video model built on Wan2.1 is conditioned on depth-based point-cloud renders of the reference video along the user's path, keeps an implicit spatiotemporal cache of reference and past frames, and is distilled for real-time use with joint distribution matching distillation (JDMD).
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan2.1 的时空自回归（STAR）视频模型以参考视频沿用户路径渲染的深度点云为条件，维护参考帧与历史帧的隐式时空缓存，并通过联合分布匹配蒸馏（JDMD）实现实时生成。
works.specs: 1.3B open weights · real-time navigation · first among real-time methods on WorldScore-Dynamic (developer claim)

paper.title: INSPATIO-WORLD: A Real-Time 4D World Simulator via Spatiotemporal Autoregressive Modeling

works.title_zh: InSpatio-World 实时 4D 世界模拟器

works.title: MemoryDiorama
works.description: Turns an everyday photo into an animated 3D diorama in mixed reality on Meta Quest 3, adding generated objects, human motion, weather and particle effects inferred from the photo, to help people recall the moment it shows.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 的混合现实中，把一张日常照片变成会动的三维立体模型，加入从照片推断出的生成物体、人物动作、天气与粒子效果，帮助人回忆照片中的那一刻。
works.idea_en: Generated context around a personal photo can act as a memory cue: participants recalled more details, a hint that generated re-enactments can shape autobiographical memory.
works.idea_zh: 围绕个人照片生成的情境可以充当记忆线索：参与者回忆起更多细节，这也提示生成式重现可能影响自传体记忆。
works.method: LLM-based scene analysis extracts place, objects, lighting and atmosphere from a photo, then 3D object generation, animation and spatial composition build the diorama; a within-subject study (N=18) compared photo only, static diorama and MemoryDiorama.
works.method_zh: 基于大语言模型的场景分析从照片中提取地点、物体、光照与氛围，再经三维物体生成、动画与空间排布搭建立体模型；被试内研究（N=18）比较了仅照片、静态模型与 MemoryDiorama 三种条件。

paper.title: MemoryDiorama: Generating Dynamic 3D Diorama from Everyday Photos for Memory Recall

works.title_zh: MemoryDiorama：把日常照片变成动态三维模型，帮助唤起记忆

works.title: Android XR auto-spatialization
works.description: An experimental Android XR feature on the Samsung Galaxy XR headset that turns almost any app, game, website, image or video, including YouTube videos and 2D games, into a 3D experience at the push of a button.
works.description_zh: Android XR 在三星 Galaxy XR 头显上推出的实验功能：一键把几乎任何应用、游戏、网站、图像或视频（包括 YouTube 视频和二维游戏）变成三维体验。
works.idea_en: System-level 2D-to-3D conversion means every flat source becomes stereoscopic content in a headset, generated rather than captured.
works.idea_zh: 系统级的二维转三维意味着，任何平面内容在头显里都能成为立体内容，靠的是生成而不是拍摄。
works.method: Likely per-frame monocular depth estimation with stereo view synthesis at the system compositor; enabled from the Labs tab in Settings.
works.method_zh: 很可能是在系统合成器层面对每帧做单目深度估计并合成立体视图；在“设置”的 Labs 页面中开启。
works.title_zh: Android XR 自动空间化

works.title: Large-scale Codec Avatars (LCA)
works.description: LCA produces a full-body, high-fidelity 3D avatar of almost anyone in a single forward pass, with fine facial expressions and finger-level control, generalizing across hairstyles, clothing and demographics.
works.description_zh: LCA 只需一次前向推理就能为几乎任何人生成高保真的全身三维化身，具备细致的面部表情和手指级控制，并能泛化到不同发型、服装和人群。
works.idea_en: Applies the foundation-model recipe (pretrain on a million in-the-wild videos, post-train on studio data) to 3D avatars, so diversity of people stops being a capture bottleneck.
works.idea_zh: 把基础模型的做法（在一百万段真实视频上预训练，再用影棚数据后训练）用于三维化身，让人群多样性不再受限于采集。
works.method: Pre-training a feed-forward Gaussian avatar model on 1M in-the-wild videos for appearance and geometry priors, then post-training on curated multi-view data for expressivity and fidelity.
works.method_zh: 先在一百万段真实场景视频上预训练前馈高斯化身模型以获得外观与几何先验，再在精选多视角数据上后训练以提升表现力和保真度。

paper.title: Large-scale Codec Avatars: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Large-scale Avatar Pretraining

works.title_zh: 大规模 Codec Avatars（LCA）

works.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality
works.description: At IEEE VR 2025 a panel was held in social VR with each panellist in a look-alike avatar; midway two panellists swapped avatars and impersonated each other, and an LLM-controlled Alan Turing avatar took part. About 40 of the 100 audience members who answered a survey did not notice the swap.
works.description_zh: IEEE VR 2025 大会上，一场小组讨论在社交 VR 中进行，每位嘉宾都使用与本人相貌相似的化身；中途两位嘉宾互换化身并假扮对方，另有一个由大语言模型控制的艾伦·图灵化身参与讨论。在填写问卷的 100 名观众中，约 40 人没有察觉这次互换。
works.idea_en: Look-alike avatars plus LLM agents make identity itself manipulable, so studies with generated people need disclosure and consent rules of their own.
works.idea_zh: 相貌相似的化身加上大语言模型智能体，让“身份”本身变得可以操纵——使用生成人物的研究需要专属的告知与同意规则。
works.method: Field study during a live conference panel projected to the audience, with a post-panel survey on detecting the swap and perceiving the AI panellist.
works.method_zh: 在现场会议小组讨论中开展的实地研究，画面投影给观众，会后以问卷调查观众是否察觉互换以及如何看待 AI 嘉宾。

paper.title: Where extended reality and AI may take us: Ethical issues of impersonation and AI fakes in social virtual reality

works.title_zh: 扩展现实与 AI 可能把我们带向何方：社交虚拟现实中冒充与 AI 伪造的伦理问题

works.title: Adaptive Generative Music in VR
works.description: In a VR archery game on Meta Quest 3, the soundtrack is generated live by Google's MusicFX DJ and becomes tenser in four steps as the player's 20 arrows run out; a within-subjects study (N = 22) compared it with a fixed soundtrack in the same style.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 3 上的一款 VR 射箭游戏里，配乐由 Google 的 MusicFX DJ 实时生成，并随着玩家 20 支箭逐渐用完分四个阶段变得越来越紧张；一项被试内实验（N = 22）把它与风格相同的固定配乐作了比较。
works.idea_en: Generated music works as a behavioural manipulation, not just atmosphere: moderate tension sharpened aim and high tension degraded it, so an adaptive score can be tuned like any other experimental factor.
works.idea_zh: 生成音乐不只是氛围，而是一种行为操纵：适度的紧张让瞄准更准，过度的紧张则使其变差，因此自适应配乐可以像其他实验因素一样被调节。
works.method: Unity sends gameplay events through Ubiq-Genie to a controller that drives MusicFX DJ with four preloaded prompts and switches between them at arrow-count thresholds (preloading avoided the multi-second delays of on-demand generation). Within-subjects, N = 22, 20 shots per condition; adaptive music raised presence (5.32 vs 4.27 of 7) and showed an inverted U: more accurate and faster aiming than fixed music in phase 2, less accurate and slower in phase 4.
works.method_zh: Unity 把游戏事件经由 Ubiq-Genie 发送给控制器，控制器用四条预载提示驱动 MusicFX DJ，并在剩余箭数达到阈值时切换（预载避免了按需生成带来的数秒延迟）。被试内设计，N = 22，每种条件射 20 箭；自适应音乐提高了临场感（7 分制 5.32 对 4.27），并呈倒 U 型：第 2 阶段比固定配乐瞄得更准更快，第 4 阶段则更差更慢。
works.specs: Meta Quest 3 · 4 tension phases · N = 22 within-subjects

paper.title: Tuning Immersion and Performance with Adaptive Generative Music in VR

works.title_zh: VR 中的自适应生成音乐：调节沉浸感与表现

works.title: Body Oracle Translator
works.description: Looking through a handheld mixed-reality lens, people see each other's postures and movements translated in real time into speculative AI-generated characters inspired by Chinese oracle-bone script.
works.description_zh: 透过手持混合现实镜头，人们看到彼此的姿态和动作被实时“翻译”成受甲骨文启发的、由 AI 生成的思辨文字。
works.idea_en: Restyles people rather than rooms: the lens rewrites bodies as an alternative written language, an 'alternative present' to share.
works.idea_zh: 重绘的对象是人而不是房间：镜头把身体改写成另一种文字，营造一个可以共享的“另类当下”。
works.method: Pose tracking feeds an image-generation model trained to map body skeletons to oracle-bone-style glyphs (building on Body Oracle), and the glyphs are overlaid on people in the handheld MR view.
works.method_zh: 姿态追踪数据输入一个把身体骨架映射为甲骨文风格字形的图像生成模型（基于 Body Oracle），字形叠加在手持 MR 画面中的人物身上。
works.title_zh: 身体甲骨文翻译器

works.title: GenTouchVR
works.description: GenTouchVR (POSTECH, IEEE VR 2026, TVCG) turns one photo into a VR scene whose objects can be felt through force feedback: an LLM finds the objects and infers how each should feel, and the system generates the 3D models and their haptic parameters. In user studies participants rated the generated feedback as comparable to expert-designed feedback; the authors call it the first system to produce force-feedback VR scenes from a single image.
works.description_zh: GenTouchVR（POSTECH，IEEE VR 2026，TVCG）把一张照片变成可以通过力反馈“摸到”的 VR 场景：大语言模型识别图中物体并推断每个物体应有的触感，系统再生成三维模型及其触觉参数。用户研究中，参与者认为自动生成的反馈与专家设计的反馈相当；作者称这是首个从单张图像生成带力反馈 VR 场景的系统。
works.idea_en: Extends scene generation from what you see to what you feel, so a generated room can push back when touched without a haptics expert tuning each object.
works.idea_zh: 把场景生成从“看到的”扩展到“摸到的”，让生成的房间在被触碰时给出阻力，而不需要触觉专家逐个调参。
works.method: An LLM detects objects in the image and predicts their visual and haptic cues together with plausible ranges of haptic rendering parameters; 3D assets are generated for each object, and a perceptual optimisation spreads the parameters so that objects feel distinct while staying physically valid; the scene is felt through a kinesthetic (force-feedback) device.
works.method_zh: 大语言模型识别图像中的物体，预测其视觉与触觉线索以及触觉渲染参数的合理范围；系统为每个物体生成三维资产，并通过感知优化调整参数，使不同物体摸起来有区别，同时保持物理上合理；用户通过动觉（力反馈）设备感受场景。

paper.title: GenTouchVR: Generating a Touchable Virtual Reality Environment from a Single Image

works.title_zh: GenTouchVR：由单张图像生成可触摸的虚拟现实环境

works.title: InSpatio-WorldFM
works.description: An open-source real-time 'frame model' that renders each frame of a generated scene independently as the camera moves, keeping it consistent across viewpoints on consumer GPUs; the consistent-scene generator behind the demos is internal and not part of the release.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的实时“帧模型”：镜头移动时独立渲染生成场景的每一帧，并在消费级 GPU 上保持多视角一致；演示中用于生成一致场景的模型属于内部模型，不在开源范围内。
works.idea_en: Generating frames independently rather than as video windows cuts latency, which matters when the camera is a head.
works.idea_zh: 逐帧独立生成、而不是按视频窗口生成，可以降低延迟；当“镜头”就是人的头部时，这一点很重要。
works.method: Explicit 3D anchors plus implicit spatial memory enforce multi-view consistency; a pretrained image diffusion model is turned into a controllable frame model and then into a real-time generator by few-step distillation, in three stages.
works.method_zh: 用显式三维锚点与隐式空间记忆保证多视角一致；分三阶段把预训练图像扩散模型变成可控帧模型，再通过少步蒸馏变成实时生成器。

paper.title: InSpatio-WorldFM: An Open-Source Real-Time Generative Frame Model

works.title: What Makes a Virtual Celebrity Agent Trustworthy in VR? Exploring the Role of Stylization and Voice
works.description: Six VR versions of the TV character Sheldon Cooper, hand-sculpted, AI-reconstructed or non-stylized, each speaking with a cloned or a synthesized voice, were compared with the original video clip. In a 3×2 within-subjects study (N=30), visual style changed trust, realism, familiarity and social presence; voice type changed only realism and familiarity.
works.description_zh: 研究者为电视角色 Sheldon Cooper 制作了六个 VR 版本——手工雕刻、AI 重建或非风格化外观，各配克隆声音或合成声音——并与原始视频片段比较。3×2 被试内实验（N=30）显示：外观风格影响信任、真实感、熟悉度与社会临场感；声音类型只影响真实感与熟悉度。
works.idea_en: Generated and hand-made versions of the same person can be compared as stimuli; here appearance mattered more for trust than whether the voice was cloned.
works.idea_zh: 同一人物的生成版与手工版可以当作刺激来比较；在这里，外观对信任的影响大于声音是否克隆。
works.method: 3 (visual style) × 2 (vocal type) within-subjects VR experiment with a video baseline, questionnaires on trust, realism, familiarity and social presence, and interpersonal-distance logging.
works.method_zh: 3（外观风格）× 2（声音类型）被试内 VR 实验，以视频为基线，测量信任、真实感、熟悉度与社会临场感问卷，并记录人际距离。

paper.title: What Makes a Virtual Celebrity Agent Trustworthy in VR? Exploring the Role of Stylization and Voice

works.title_zh: 什么让 VR 中的虚拟名人智能体值得信任？风格化与声音的作用

works.title: GenerativeSurface
works.description: In mixed reality, a designer describes a concept in words and GenerativeSurface turns it into interactive 3D surfaces that serve as scaffolds to sketch on in mid-air, in a describe, generate, sketch and iterate loop.
works.description_zh: 在混合现实中，设计师用语言描述一个概念，GenerativeSurface 把它变成可交互的三维曲面，作为在空中画草图的支架，形成“描述、生成、草绘、迭代”的循环。
works.idea_en: A generated surface offered as something to draw on, not a finished object, keeps the person's hand in the design while removing the blank-canvas problem.
works.idea_zh: 生成的曲面是用来在上面画的，而不是成品，这样既保留了人的亲手设计，又解决了面对空白画布无从下手的问题。
works.method: Generative AI translates natural-language descriptions into editable 3D surfaces placed in the MR workspace for mid-air sketching; compared with primitive scaffolding and freehand mid-air sketching in a user evaluation on engineering conceptual design.
works.method_zh: 生成式 AI 把自然语言描述转成可编辑的三维曲面，放进 MR 工作空间供空中草绘；在工程概念设计任务中与基本几何体支架和徒手空中草绘作了对比评估。

paper.title: GenerativeSurface: GenAI-Assisted Semantic Scaffolding for 3D Conceptual Design in Mixed Reality

works.title_zh: GenerativeSurface：生成式 AI 辅助的混合现实三维概念设计语义支架

works.title: Look2React
works.description: VR NPCs that react to what they actually see: when the player looks at and approaches an NPC, a snapshot of the NPC's view goes to a vision-based reasoning model, which picks a body pose and a line of dialogue in response to the player's pose and the situation.
works.description_zh: 能对所见作出反应的 VR NPC：当玩家注视并走近 NPC 时，NPC 视角的画面会被送进一个基于视觉的推理模型，由它根据玩家的姿势和当时的情境选择身体姿态和一句台词。
works.idea_en: Giving characters eyes, triggered by gaze and proximity as in stealth games, lets them respond to body language at a cost low enough to run only when it matters.
works.idea_zh: 像潜行游戏那样用注视和距离来触发，给角色一双“眼睛”，它们就能回应肢体语言，而且成本低到只在需要时运行。
works.method: Gaze- and proximity-based triggering captures the NPC's view and sends it to a vision-language reasoning model that selects a pose and a text response; in an RPG compared with NPCs modelled on contemporary games (N = 20), players interacted more often and repeatedly and reported significantly higher social presence.
works.method_zh: 以注视和距离触发，截取 NPC 的视角画面送入视觉语言推理模型，由其选择姿态与文本回应；在一款 RPG 中与仿照当代游戏的 NPC 对比（N = 20），玩家与 NPC 的互动更频繁、更多次，报告的社会临场感显著更高。

paper.title: Look2React: Making VR NPCs Come Alive with Dynamic Vision-Guided Reactions

works.title_zh: Look2React：让 VR NPC 通过视觉引导作出动态反应

works.title: PixVerse V6
works.description: PixVerse V6 (2026-03-30) is the flagship video model of the PixVerse app: from one prompt it generates a multi-shot short film of up to 15 seconds at 1080p with native audio, holding a character's emotion across cuts, and it can be driven from a command-line tool by coding agents.
works.description_zh: PixVerse V6（2026-03-30）是 PixVerse 应用的旗舰视频模型：一条提示即可生成最长 15 秒、1080p、带原生音频的多镜头短片，并在镜头切换间保持角色情绪一致；它还可以通过命令行工具由编程智能体调用。
works.idea_en: Agents can now order a finished multi-shot clip with sound from the command line, so scenario variants can be produced in batches without an editor.
works.idea_zh: 智能体现在可以在命令行里直接生成带声音的多镜头成片，情境的多个变体无需剪辑即可批量产出。
works.method: Closed audio-video generation model with multi-shot planning (architecture not disclosed).
works.method_zh: 闭源音视频联合生成模型，支持多镜头规划（架构未公开）。
works.specs: up to 15 s · 1080p · native audio · multi-shot

works.title: Qwen3.5-Omni
works.description: Alibaba's 2026 omni-modal model that listens to speech, watches video and answers in speech, offered through Model Studio (qwen3.5-omni-plus) and Qwen Chat rather than as open weights. Qwen highlights semantic interruption, speech recognition in 74 languages, expressive speech in 29, and 'audio-visual vibe coding': building a website or game from a spoken description shown to the camera.
works.description_zh: 阿里巴巴 2026 年的全模态模型，能听语音、看视频并用语音回答，通过 Model Studio（qwen3.5-omni-plus）和 Qwen Chat 提供，没有开放权重。Qwen 重点介绍了语义打断、74 种语言的语音识别、29 种语言的富表现力语音生成，以及“音视频氛围编程”：对着摄像头口头描述，就能生成一个网站或小游戏。
works.idea_en: The open Qwen-Omni line moved behind an API in 2026, so labs that built on Qwen3-Omni's weights must keep the older model or accept a hosted one.
works.idea_zh: 开放的 Qwen-Omni 系列在 2026 年转为仅通过 API 提供，基于 Qwen3-Omni 权重开展工作的实验室只能沿用旧模型，或接受托管服务。
works.method: Thinker-Talker architecture with hybrid-attention mixture-of-experts in both parts, trained on over 100 million hours of audio-visual data; ARIA aligns text and speech units to stabilise streaming speech.
works.method_zh: Thinker-Talker 架构，两部分都采用混合注意力的混合专家结构，训练数据包含超过一亿小时的音视频内容；ARIA 对齐文本与语音单元，使流式语音更稳定。
works.specs: 256k context · 10+ h audio input · 400 s of 720p video at 1 fps

paper.title: Qwen3.5-Omni Technical Report

works.title_zh: 通义千问 Qwen3.5-Omni

works.title: GaussianGPT
works.description: A transformer that writes a 3D Gaussian-splat room token by token, the way a language model writes text, so one model can generate a scene from scratch, complete a partial one or extend a room outward, with sampling temperature controlling how varied the result is; code and checkpoints are open.
works.description_zh: 一个像语言模型写文字那样逐个 token 写出三维高斯泼溅房间的 Transformer：同一个模型既能从零生成场景，也能补全残缺场景或向外扩展房间，并用采样温度控制结果的多样程度；代码与检查点已开源。
works.idea_en: Building a scene step by step makes 'keep this part, regenerate the rest' a native operation, which is what controlled variation of a setting needs.
works.idea_zh: 逐步搭建场景，让“保留这部分、重新生成其余部分”成为原生操作，这正是有控制地改变一个情境所需要的。
works.method: A sparse 3D convolutional autoencoder with vector quantisation compresses Gaussians into a discrete latent grid; the serialised tokens are modelled by a causal transformer with 3D rotary position embeddings, trained on synthetic indoor scenes (3D-FRONT, Aria Synthetic Environments).
works.method_zh: 带向量量化的稀疏三维卷积自编码器把高斯基元压缩成离散潜网格；序列化后的 token 由带三维旋转位置编码的因果 Transformer 建模，训练数据为合成室内场景（3D-FRONT、Aria Synthetic Environments）。

paper.title: GaussianGPT: Towards Autoregressive 3D Gaussian Scene Generation

works.title: Matrix-Game 3.0
works.description: An open-weight, memory-augmented interactive world model that streams 720p video in real time and keeps scenes consistent over long sessions by retrieving relevant past frames by camera position; Matrix-Game 3.5 (patch memory, open 5B weights on Wan2.2) followed in August 2026, released under the Riemann Dynamics name by authors overlapping the 3.0 team.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重、带记忆增强的交互世界模型：实时流式输出 720p 视频，并按相机位置调取相关历史帧，使长时会话中的场景保持一致；2026 年 8 月，与 3.0 团队部分重合的作者以 Riemann Dynamics 名义发布后续版本 Matrix-Game 3.5（块记忆，基于 Wan2.2 的 5B 开源权重）。
works.idea_en: Shows memory and real-time speed together in an open model, at a hardware cost (8 GPUs) that still limits lab use.
works.idea_zh: 在开源模型中同时实现记忆与实时速度，但硬件成本（8 张 GPU）仍限制了实验室的使用。
works.method: A 5B autoregressive diffusion model building on Matrix-Game 2.0 with GPU-based camera-aware memory retrieval, few-step sampling, INT8 quantization, distillation and a lightweight VAE.
works.method_zh: 在 Matrix-Game 2.0 基础上构建的 50 亿参数自回归扩散模型，采用基于 GPU 的相机感知记忆检索、少步采样、INT8 量化、蒸馏和轻量 VAE。

paper.title: Matrix-Game 3.0: Real-Time and Streaming Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

works.title_zh: Matrix-Game 3.0（昆仑万维）

works.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review
works.description: PRISMA systematic review of 23 peer-reviewed articles, published up to November 2025, on using artificial intelligence to tailor VR exposure therapy to the needs of patients and therapists.
works.description_zh: 按 PRISMA 流程纳入截至 2025 年 11 月发表的 23 篇同行评审文章，系统梳理如何用人工智能让 VR 暴露疗法更贴合患者与治疗师的需要。
works.idea_en: Adaptive exposure, adjusting the feared situation to the patient in the moment, is the clinical use case closest to real-time generation, and its evidence base is still small.
works.idea_zh: 自适应暴露——根据患者当下状态调整所恐惧的情境——是最接近实时生成的临床用例，而其证据基础仍然有限。
works.method: Systematic review following PRISMA across PsycINFO, Web of Science, Google Scholar, EMBASE, CINAHL and MEDLINE; 23 of 377 screened records included.
works.method_zh: 遵循 PRISMA 的系统综述，检索 PsycINFO、Web of Science、Google Scholar、EMBASE、CINAHL 与 MEDLINE，从 377 条记录中纳入 23 篇。

paper.title: Artificial intelligence (AI) for virtual reality exposure therapy (VRET): A systematic review

works.title_zh: 人工智能用于虚拟现实暴露疗法（VRET）：一项系统综述

works.title: Suno v5.5
works.description: The 2026 version of Suno's song generator, which adds Voices (singing in your own recorded voice), custom models tuned to a creator's catalogue and a taste profile. It follows Suno v5 (September 2025).
works.description_zh: Suno 歌曲生成器的 2026 年版本，新增 Voices（用你自己录制的声音演唱）、按创作者作品定制的模型，以及个人口味画像。它是 Suno v5（2025 年 9 月）的后续版本。
works.idea_en: Personal voice and style models move music generation from generic tracks toward a person's own sonic identity.
works.idea_zh: 个人声音与风格模型，让音乐生成从千篇一律的曲目走向个人自己的声音身份。
works.method: Proprietary song-generation model (likely a Transformer over audio tokens) with voice cloning and per-user model customisation.
works.method_zh: 专有的歌曲生成模型（可能是基于音频标记的 Transformer），具备声音克隆与按用户定制模型的功能。

works.title: Vibe Coding XR
works.description: A prompt such as 'create a dandelion that reacts to my hand' becomes a working, physics-aware mixed-reality app that can be tested in a simulated room on the desktop and then sent to a headset.
works.description_zh: 像“做一朵会对我的手作出反应的蒲公英”这样的提示词，会直接变成一个具备物理效果的混合现实应用，先在桌面的模拟房间里测试，再部署到头显。
works.idea_en: Gives language models a compact vocabulary for users, rooms and agents, so a one-line request can produce a runnable XR prototype.
works.idea_zh: 为语言模型提供描述用户、房间与智能体的精简词汇，让一句话就能产出可运行的 XR 原型。
works.method: Gemini generates code against XR Blocks' semantic 'Reality Model' WebXR API; a desktop simulated-reality loop precedes headset deployment, and the VCXR60 set of 60 prompts with automated evaluation measures one-shot success.
works.method_zh: Gemini 基于 XR Blocks 的语义化“现实模型” WebXR API 生成代码；先在桌面模拟现实中循环测试，再部署到头显，并用 60 条提示组成的 VCXR60 与自动评估流程测量一次成功率。

paper.title: Vibe Coding XR: Accelerating AI + XR Prototyping with XR Blocks and Gemini

works.title: SIMART
works.description: ByteDance Seed and NTU model that takes a monolithic mesh, such as the output of an image-to-3D generator, and splits it into parts with predicted joints, returning a URDF that opens in physics simulators so drawers slide and lids hinge; weights are open under Apache 2.0.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 与南洋理工大学的模型：输入一个整体网格（例如图生三维模型的输出），把它拆分为部件并预测关节，输出可在物理仿真器中打开的 URDF，让抽屉能拉、盖子能翻；权重以 Apache 2.0 协议开源。
works.idea_en: Turns a generated statue of a cabinet into a cabinet that opens, the step between a prop that is looked at and one that is used.
works.idea_zh: 把一个“雕塑般”的生成柜子变成能打开的柜子，这是从“只能看的道具”到“能用的道具”之间的一步。
works.method: A sparse 3D VQ-VAE encodes the mesh into about 70% fewer tokens than dense voxels; a multimodal LLM fuses these with image and text inputs to ground parts and estimate joint parameters, output as URDF metadata plus part segments.
works.method_zh: 稀疏三维 VQ-VAE 把网格编码为比稠密体素少约 70% 的 token；多模态大模型将其与图像和文本输入融合，完成部件定位和关节参数估计，输出 URDF 元数据和分割后的部件。
