paper.title: SIMART: Decomposing Monolithic Meshes into Sim-ready Articulated Assets via MLLM

works.title_zh: SIMART：把整体网格拆解为可仿真的铰接资产

works.title: DreamCraft
works.description: DreamCraft is a VR prototyping tool with two generative workflows: generate a whole navigable environment at once, or build a scene up object by object from AI-generated assets; 12 VR designers used both.
works.description_zh: DreamCraft 是一个 VR 原型工具，提供两种生成流程：一次生成整个可漫游的环境，或者用 AI 生成的资产逐个物体地搭建场景；12 位 VR 设计师试用了两种流程。
works.idea_en: Whole-scene and object-by-object generation are different ways of authoring a situation; the study turns the choice between them into design guidelines instead of a default.
works.idea_zh: 整场景生成与逐物体生成是两种不同的情境创作方式，这项研究把两者之间的取舍变成设计准则，而不是默认选项。
works.method: A VR system combining scene-level generation (an entire environment) with object-level generation (assets added iteratively), likely driven by text or voice prompts; a user study with 12 VR designers compared the workflows on task completion time, creative exploration and perceived cognitive load.
works.method_zh: VR 系统结合场景级生成（整个环境）与物体级生成（逐步添加资产），很可能由文字或语音提示驱动；12 位 VR 设计师参与的用户研究，从任务完成时间、创意探索和感知认知负荷几方面比较两种流程。

paper.title: Investigating Generative Workflows for Immersive Prototyping: A Study on Scene- and Object-Level Creation in VR

works.title_zh: DreamCraft：VR 沉浸式原型的场景级与物体级生成流程

works.title: GenAssist
works.description: Describe an XR program in plain language and GenAssist writes it, runs it and hot-plugs it into the live scene: it places primitives and 3D models, animates them and wires up interactions, then looks at the result through virtual cameras and revises the code.
works.description_zh: 用自然语言描述想要的 XR 程序，GenAssist 就会编写、运行并把它热插入正在运行的场景：放置基本几何体和三维模型、让它们动起来并接上交互，再通过场景里的虚拟相机检查结果、修改代码。
works.idea_en: Generating the program rather than the pixels gives a scene whose behaviour can be read, logged and rerun, which is what an experimenter needs from a generated situation.
works.idea_zh: 生成的是程序而不是像素，得到的场景行为可以阅读、记录和重跑，这正是实验者对生成情境的要求。
works.method: Retrieval-augmented generation pulls platform documentation and example code into the LLM prompt; generated scripts run hot-pluggably, and a closed loop renders the scene from virtual cameras and feeds the views back to refine the program. Evaluated on a 50-prompt benchmark (under 10 s per run, fewer LLM calls than prior systems) and with 18 users (NASA-TLX 36.6).
works.method_zh: 检索增强生成把平台文档与示例代码放入大语言模型提示；生成的脚本以热插拔方式运行，并通过闭环从虚拟相机渲染场景、把画面反馈回去修正程序。在 50 条提示的基准上评估（每次运行不到 10 秒，调用次数少于以往系统），并做了 18 人的用户研究（NASA-TLX 36.6）。

paper.title: GenAssist: Interactive Prompt-Driven XR Program Generation

works.title_zh: GenAssist：交互式提示驱动的 XR 程序生成

works.title: Stereo World Model
works.description: Stereo World Model (StereoWorld; The University of Hong Kong, VAST and ByteDance Pico, CVPR 2026) generates left- and right-eye video together along a given camera path, instead of generating a flat clip and converting it to stereo afterwards. The authors report more than 3× faster generation than generate-then-convert pipelines with better disparity accuracy, and use it for binocular VR rendering without depth estimation or inpainting; code and weights are open.
works.description_zh: Stereo World Model（StereoWorld；香港大学、VAST 与字节跳动 Pico，CVPR 2026）沿给定的镜头路径同时生成左右眼视频，而不是先生成平面视频再转成立体。作者报告，它比“先生成再转换”的管线快 3 倍以上，视差也更准确，并可直接用于无需深度估计或补全的双目 VR 渲染；代码和权重均已开源。
works.idea_en: Generating both eyes at once keeps depth consistent with the camera path, a precondition for headset scenarios that people look around in rather than watch flat.
works.idea_zh: 同时生成双眼画面，使深度与镜头路径保持一致；这是人们在头显里环顾而不是平面观看情境的前提。
works.method: Fine-tunes a pretrained video diffusion model with a unified camera-frame RoPE for view- and time-consistent camera conditioning and a stereo-aware attention that factors full 4D attention into per-view 3D attention plus horizontal row attention along epipolar lines, working in RGB only without depth input.
works.method_zh: 在预训练视频扩散模型上微调：统一的相机-帧 RoPE 让镜头条件在视角和时间上保持一致；立体感知注意力把完整的 4D 注意力分解为单视角 3D 注意力加沿极线的水平行注意力；全程只用 RGB，不需要深度输入。
works.specs: >3× faster than monocular-then-convert pipelines · +5% viewpoint consistency (developer-reported)

paper.title: Stereo World Model: Camera-Guided Stereo Video Generation

works.title_zh: Stereo World Model：相机可控的立体视频生成

works.title: Kimodo
works.description: NVIDIA's open kinematic motion diffusion model, trained on 700 hours of optical motion capture, that generates 3D human and humanoid-robot motion from text plus constraints such as full-body keyframes, sparse joint targets, 2D waypoints and paths; released with SOMA, SMPL-X and Unitree G1 variants and a public benchmark, and updated to v1.2 in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 英伟达开源的运动学动作扩散模型，用 700 小时光学动捕数据训练，可由文字加上全身关键帧、稀疏关节目标、二维路径点和路径等约束生成三维人体及人形机器人动作；发布了 SOMA、SMPL-X 和宇树 G1 版本以及公开基准，并于 2026 年 10 月更新到 v1.2。
works.idea_en: A downloadable, constraint-following motion generator: an author can pin where a character must be and what it must do, and get plausible motion in between.
works.idea_zh: 一个可下载、能遵守约束的动作生成模型：作者可以规定角色必须在哪里、做什么，中间的动作由模型合理补全。
works.method: A two-stage transformer denoiser that predicts root trajectory and body pose separately over a purpose-built motion representation, which keeps motion artefacts low while letting constraints be injected flexibly; trained on the Bones Rigplay and BONES-SEED mocap datasets.
works.method_zh: 基于专门设计的动作表示，两阶段 Transformer 去噪器分别预测根轨迹和身体姿态，在减少动作瑕疵的同时能灵活注入约束；训练数据为 Bones Rigplay 和 BONES-SEED 动捕数据集。
works.specs: 700 h optical mocap · SOMA 77-joint, SMPL-X and Unitree G1 skeletons

paper.title: Kimodo: Scaling Controllable Human Motion Generation

works.title_zh: Kimodo：可控人体动作生成

works.title: Seed Speech 2.0
works.description: ByteDance's 2026 speech stack on BytePlus, pairing TTS 2.0 with ASR 2.0. TTS 2.0 reads the user's query together with the reply it is voicing, so tone, rhythm and pauses fit the exchange, and prompts or reference context set emotion, rate, pitch, timbre and style; BytePlus reports about 90% accuracy when reading mathematical and scientific formulas aloud.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 2026 年在 BytePlus 上推出的语音技术组合，包含 TTS 2.0 与 ASR 2.0。TTS 2.0 会把用户的问题和它要说出的回答一起理解，使语气、节奏和停顿契合这次交流；提示词或参考上下文可以设定情绪、语速、音高、音色和风格。BytePlus 报告其朗读数学与科学公式的准确率约为 90%。
works.idea_en: Like Inworld's TTS-2, it makes a reply's delivery depend on what was just said, a cue that scripted voice pipelines otherwise lack.
works.idea_zh: 与 Inworld 的 TTS-2 类似，它让回答的语气取决于对方刚刚说了什么，这是脚本化语音流程原本缺少的线索。
works.method: Query-response speech synthesis conditioned on both the conversational query and the response text, with prompt and reference-context control (architecture unpublished).
works.method_zh: 以对话中的提问和回答文本共同为条件的“问—答”式语音合成，并支持提示词与参考上下文控制（架构未公开）。
works.title_zh: Seed Speech 2.0 语音合成与识别

works.title: V4 Expressive Visual Agents
works.description: D-ID's V4 Expressive Visual Agents are real-time conversational avatars whose expressions follow the emotional tone of what they say, built from a short recording of a person and deployable on websites or via API, with a self-hosting option for enterprises.
works.description_zh: D-ID 的 V4 Expressive 可视化智能体是实时对话虚拟人，表情会跟随所说内容的情绪基调；只需一段真人短视频即可生成，可部署到网站或通过 API 调用，企业还可自行托管。
works.idea_en: Emotion-matched expression became a standard feature of commercial agents, but it follows the agent's own text, not the user's behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 与情绪匹配的表情已成为商用智能体的标配，但它跟随的是智能体自己的文本，而不是用户的行为。
works.method: A cascaded agent (knowledge base, LLM, TTS) drives D-ID's V4 avatar video model, which conditions facial expression on the sentiment of the generated speech.
works.method_zh: 级联智能体（知识库、大模型、语音合成）驱动 D-ID 的 V4 虚拟人视频模型，该模型以生成语音的情绪为条件控制面部表情。
works.title_zh: V4 Expressive 可视化智能体

works.title: Refugio
works.description: A Meta Quest 3 application in which users furnish a therapeutic 'safe place' by voice: a self-hosted Gemma 3 model filters the request, Sana v1.0 draws candidate images, and Zero123++ with InstantMesh turns the chosen one into a 3D object in about two minutes. In a single-session feasibility study with 30 non-clinical participants, usability was high (SUS 86.3) and workload low; valence rose during creation and arousal fell during the following meditation.
works.description_zh: 一款 Meta Quest 3 应用：用户用语音布置一个用于心理治疗的“安全之地”。自托管的 Gemma 3 模型先过滤请求，Sana v1.0 生成候选图像，再由 Zero123++ 与 InstantMesh 把选中的图像变成三维物体，每个约需两分钟。在一项 30 名非临床参与者的单次可行性研究中，可用性很高（SUS 86.3）、工作负荷低；创作过程中效价上升，随后的冥想中唤醒度下降。
works.idea_en: Generating the objects of a calming place on request lets the person author the therapeutic context, but at two minutes per object the waiting becomes part of the experience.
works.idea_zh: 按需生成平静之地中的物件，让当事人自己设计治疗情境；但每个物件约两分钟的等待，本身也成了体验的一部分。
works.method: Speech (Wit.ai) → Gemma 3 request filtering → Sana image generation → user selection → Zero123++ multiview → InstantMesh mesh, on a local three-GPU server; single-arm study (N = 30) with SUS, NASA-TLX, an adapted RJPQ and SAM ratings at three time points.
works.method_zh: 语音（Wit.ai）→ Gemma 3 过滤请求 → Sana 生成图像 → 用户挑选 → Zero123++ 生成多视角 → InstantMesh 重建网格，运行在本地三 GPU 服务器上；单组研究（N = 30），测量 SUS、NASA-TLX、改编版 RJPQ 与三个时间点的 SAM 评分。
works.specs: ~117 s per object · N=30 · Meta Quest 3 · SUS 86.3

paper.title: Refugio: a voice-driven generative virtual reality “safe place” for personalized emotion regulation – feasibility and usability study

works.title: Stimulating Future-Oriented Thinking and Goal-Achievement Through the Future Self Using Virtual Reality and a Smartphone App: Randomized Controlled Trial
works.description: FutureU: first-year students met an age-progressed avatar of themselves ten years older, either in a smartphone app or in three 30-minute VR sessions where they alternated between embodying their present and future self and answered their own recorded questions. A three-arm RCT (N=321, 107 per arm) compared app, VR and a goal-setting control over six months.
works.description_zh: FutureU：大一学生与“十年后的自己”——一个按年龄老化处理的自我化身——见面，方式是手机应用，或三次各约 30 分钟的 VR 会话；在 VR 中，他们轮流化身为现在的自己和未来的自己，并回答自己事先录下的问题。一项三臂随机对照试验（N=321，每组 107 人）在六个月内比较了应用、VR 与目标设定对照组。
works.idea_en: The same future-self intervention delivered by phone and by headset: VR raised weekly goal achievement (d=0.88), but most gains in future-self identification faded by six months in both formats.
works.idea_zh: 同一套“未来自我”干预分别用手机和头显实施：VR 显著提高了每周目标达成（d=0.88），但两种形式对未来自我认同的提升大多在六个月后消退。
works.method: Parallel three-arm RCT with block randomization; VR sessions used a photo-based full-body future-self avatar, body swapping between present and future self, and a researcher-controlled robot guide; outcomes modelled with latent growth curves over six time points.
works.method_zh: 平行三臂随机对照试验，区组随机化；VR 会话使用由照片生成的全身“未来自我”化身、在现在与未来自我之间切换身体，并由研究者操控的机器人向导引导；用潜变量增长曲线模型分析六个时间点的结局。

paper.title: Stimulating Future-Oriented Thinking and Goal-Achievement Through the Future Self Using Virtual Reality and a Smartphone App: Randomized Controlled Trial

works.title_zh: 借助虚拟现实与手机应用中的“未来自我”激发面向未来的思考与目标达成：随机对照试验

works.title: TADA
works.description: An open-source speech-language model from Hume that aligns text and audio one-to-one, so by construction it cannot skip or hallucinate words. Hume reports a real-time factor of 0.09, more than five times faster than comparable LLM-based TTS.
works.description_zh: Hume 开源的语音-语言模型，让文本与音频一一对齐，因此从结构上就不会漏词或凭空多出词。Hume 报告其实时率为 0.09，比同级别的大模型语音合成快五倍以上。
works.idea_en: Guaranteed text fidelity matters in experiments: a stimulus voice that never drops or invents a word is a controllable stimulus.
works.idea_zh: 文本忠实度有保证对实验很重要：一个从不漏词、不多词的刺激声音，才是可控的刺激。
works.method: Llama-based 1B (English) and 3B (multilingual) models over a tokenizer running at 2-3 audio frames per second with text-acoustic dual alignment.
works.method_zh: 基于 Llama 的 1B（英语）与 3B（多语言）模型，配合每秒仅 2–3 帧的音频分词器，实现文本与声学的双重对齐。
works.specs: 1B / 3B · RTF 0.09 · 2-3 tokens per second of audio

paper.title: TADA: A Generative Framework for Speech Modeling via Text-Acoustic Dual Alignment

works.title: CinemaWorld
works.description: While a 2D film plays, the viewer's own room on a Meta Quest 3 fills with generated 3D content synchronized to the scene: particle effects, surrounding objects, textures, character-driven effects and lighting.
works.description_zh: 在播放二维电影的同时，观者在 Meta Quest 3 中看到自己的房间里出现与镜头同步的生成三维内容：粒子特效、环绕物体、纹理覆盖、角色驱动的效果与灯光。
works.idea_en: Extends a fixed film into the viewer's physical space automatically, without hand-authored AR for each scene.
works.idea_zh: 无需为每个镜头手工制作 AR，就能把一部固定的电影自动延伸到观者的物理空间。
works.method: Films are preprocessed with multimodal LLMs to extract key features, generative AI produces dynamic 3D augmentations that are embedded spatially in the room; evaluated with 100 clips, a user study (N=12) and interviews with film creators (N=8).
works.method_zh: 先用多模态大语言模型预处理电影、提取关键特征，再用生成式 AI 制作动态三维增强并嵌入房间空间；通过 100 段片段的技术评估、用户研究（N=12）与电影创作者访谈（N=8）评估。

paper.title: CinemaWorld: Generative Augmented Reality with LLMs and 3D Scene Generation for Movie Augmentation

works.title_zh: CinemaWorld：用生成式 AR 延展电影

works.title: Runway Characters
works.description: Runway Characters is a real-time video agent API: from a single reference image, with no fine-tuning, it creates a conversational character (photoreal or stylised, human or not) with configurable voice, personality, knowledge and tool actions, which keeps facial expression, gaze and gestures going while it listens as well as while it speaks. It launched to all Runway developer customers on 2026-03-09, with preset characters in the Runway web app.
works.description_zh: Runway Characters 是一个实时视频智能体 API：只需一张参考图、无需微调，就能创建一个对话角色（写实或风格化、人类或非人类），并可配置声音、性格、知识和工具动作；角色在倾听和说话时都会保持面部表情、视线和手势。2026-03-09 向所有 Runway 开发者客户开放，Runway 网页应用中也提供预设角色。
works.idea_en: The avatar layer of a general world model, so a mascot, a historical figure or a stylised partner can hold a call; Meta's September 2026 study rates its mannerisms on par with Muse Realtime Avatar.
works.idea_zh: 通用世界模型的虚拟人分支，让吉祥物、历史人物或风格化的对话伙伴都能接通视频通话；Meta 2026 年 9 月的评测认为它的举止与 Muse Realtime Avatar 不相上下。
works.method: Built on the GWM Avatars variant of Runway's GWM-1 world model (December 2025), an autoregressive video model conditioned on a reference image and the agent's speech, served over a real-time API with LLM, voice and knowledge-base configuration.
works.method_zh: 基于 Runway GWM-1 世界模型的 GWM Avatars 变体（2025 年 12 月），这是一个以参考图像和智能体语音为条件的自回归视频模型，通过实时 API 提供，并可配置大模型、声音和知识库。

works.title: Roomify
works.description: Turns your physical room into a themed virtual environment, such as a forest cabin or a spaceship, in which every sofa, table and wall stays where it really is, and lets designers edit it in MR and preview it in VR.
works.description_zh: 把你的真实房间变成主题化的虚拟环境，例如林中小屋或宇宙飞船，其中每张沙发、桌子和每面墙都留在真实的位置，设计者可以在 MR 中编辑、在 VR 中预览。
works.idea_en: Keeping the room's functional layout while changing its style offers presence without losing spatial awareness.
works.idea_zh: 保留房间的功能布局、只改换风格，可以在不丢失空间感知的前提下获得临场感。
works.method: In-situ 3D scene understanding, AI spatial reasoning and style-aware generation replace each furnishing with a themed counterpart of matching geometry and function; studies with 18 VR users and 8 design professionals.
works.method_zh: 通过现场三维场景理解、AI 空间推理与风格感知生成，把每件陈设替换为几何与功能相匹配的主题对应物；分别对 18 名 VR 用户和 8 名设计专业人员开展研究。
works.specs: presence +63% vs passthrough, +26% vs fully virtual (reported, N=18)

paper.title: Roomify: Spatially-Grounded Style Transformation for Immersive Virtual Environments

works.title: CubeComposer
works.description: CubeComposer (CUHK and Tencent ARC Lab, CVPR 2026) expands an ordinary perspective video into a 360° video at native 4K, generating the six faces of a cubemap one after another in space and time instead of upscaling a low-resolution panorama. Code, weights and the 4K360Vid dataset are released.
works.description_zh: CubeComposer（香港中文大学与腾讯 ARC 实验室，CVPR 2026）把普通透视视频扩展为原生 4K 的 360° 视频：它按空间与时间顺序逐个生成立方体贴图的六个面，而不是把低分辨率全景图放大。代码、权重与 4K360Vid 数据集均已公开。
works.idea_en: Headset-grade 360° resolution from a phone clip: one filmed angle can become the full surround of a scene.
works.idea_zh: 用一段手机视频得到头显级分辨率的 360° 画面：拍到的一个角度可以变成整个场景的环绕视野。
works.method: Spatio-temporal autoregressive video diffusion over cubemap faces and time windows, with cube-face context management and sparse context attention.
works.method_zh: 在立方体贴图各面与时间窗口上进行时空自回归视频扩散，配合立方体面上下文管理与稀疏上下文注意力。

paper.title: CubeComposer: Spatio-Temporal Autoregressive 4K 360° Video Generation from Perspective Video

works.title_zh: CubeComposer：从透视视频时空自回归生成 4K 360° 视频

works.title: Helios
works.description: Helios (Peking University with ByteDance, 2026-03) is an open 14-billion-parameter model that generates minute-scale video in real time on a single H100, showing large real-time models can match small ones in speed.
works.description_zh: Helios（北京大学与字节跳动，2026 年 3 月）是 140 亿参数的开源模型，可在单张 H100 上实时生成分钟级视频，表明大规模实时模型在速度上也能追平小模型。
works.idea_en: Real-time no longer means 1.3B: quality and responsiveness stop being a trade-off.
works.idea_zh: 实时不再意味着只能用 13 亿参数的小模型：质量与响应速度不必二选一。
works.method: Autoregressive video diffusion with techniques for long-horizon stability and efficient inference (per the Helios paper).
works.method_zh: 自回归视频扩散，结合长时稳定性与高效推理技术（据 Helios 论文）。

paper.title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model

works.title: OasisMind
works.description: An AI-assisted VR system in which people describe, in natural language, a place that would help them emotionally and get a 360° environment, a matching ambient soundscape and a context-aware digital companion. In a study with 24 participants, people preferred the environments they had created over validated, pre-defined relaxation scenes, but satisfaction and presence did not differ.
works.description_zh: 一个 AI 辅助的 VR 系统：人们用自然语言描述一个能给自己情绪支持的地方，系统随之生成 360° 环境、相应的环境音景，以及能感知情境的数字陪伴者。在 24 人的研究中，参与者更偏爱自己创造的环境，而不是经过验证的预设放松场景，但满意度与临场感没有差异。
works.idea_en: Letting participants author the situation raises preference without raising presence, a split that matters when generated worlds are used as interventions.
works.idea_zh: 让参与者自己创作情境能提高偏好，却不会提高临场感；当生成世界被用作干预手段时，这种分离值得重视。
works.method: Prompt-driven pipeline that generates 360° panoramas, ambient audio and a (likely LLM-driven) companion inside a headset; user study (N = 24) comparing self-created environments with validated pre-defined VR scenes on preference, satisfaction and presence.
works.method_zh: 由提示词驱动的流程在头显中生成 360° 全景、环境音频和一个（可能由大语言模型驱动的）陪伴者；用户研究（N = 24）比较自建环境与经过验证的预设 VR 场景在偏好、满意度与临场感上的差异。

paper.title: From Prompt to Presence: Co-Creating Personalised Emotional Sanctuaries in VR with Generative AI

works.title: PlayWrite
works.description: Wearing a mixed-reality headset at a table, a writer moves small virtual characters and props and talks through scenes; AI agents read this play as story beats shown as rearrangeable 'story marbles', and an LLM writes the assembled sequence into a narrative.
works.description_zh: 写作者戴上混合现实头显，在桌面上移动小型虚拟角色和道具，并边玩边说出情节；AI 智能体把这些动作解读为故事节拍，以可重新排列的“故事弹珠”呈现，再由大语言模型把排好的序列写成完整叙事。
works.idea_en: Makes play with characters in space, not typed prompts, the input to story generation, a pattern that transfers to authoring scenarios by enacting them.
works.idea_zh: 让在空间中摆弄角色、而不是输入提示，成为故事生成的输入；这种模式可以迁移到“通过演出来编写情境”。
works.method: A multi-agent pipeline (environment, social, narrator and intent-frame agents) condenses manipulation, spatial relations and speech into Intent Frames that an LLM turns into prose; studied with 13 writers.
works.method_zh: 多智能体流程（环境、社交、叙述者与意图帧智能体）把操作、空间关系与语音压缩为“意图帧”，再由大语言模型写成文本；对 13 位写作者进行了用户研究。

paper.title: PlayWrite: A Multimodal System for AI Supported Narrative Co-Authoring Through Play in XR

works.title_zh: PlayWrite：在 XR 中通过“玩”与 AI 共写故事

works.title: PackUV
works.description: PackUV stores a 4D Gaussian volumetric video as a sequence of packed UV image atlases, so a multi-camera capture can be compressed and streamed with ordinary video codecs and stays consistent over sequences of up to 30 minutes. It comes with PackUV-2B, 100 sequences filmed by more than 50 synchronized cameras.
works.description_zh: PackUV 把 4D 高斯体积视频存成一串打包好的 UV 图像图集，使多相机拍摄的内容可以用普通视频编解码器压缩与传输，并在长达 30 分钟的序列中保持一致。它同时发布了 PackUV-2B 数据集：100 段由 50 台以上同步相机拍摄的序列。
works.idea_en: If a 4D capture is just a stack of video files, existing streaming infrastructure can deliver recorded people and events into headsets without a bespoke player stack.
works.idea_zh: 如果 4D 捕捉只是一叠视频文件，现有的流媒体基础设施就能把录下的人和事件送进头显，而不必另建专用播放系统。
works.method: PackUV-GS fits Gaussian parameters directly in a multi-scale UV atlas for each frame, using flow-guided labelling of dynamic Gaussians and video keyframing to stabilise static regions and handle large motion and disocclusion.
works.method_zh: PackUV-GS 直接在每帧的多尺度 UV 图集中拟合高斯参数，并借助光流引导的动态高斯标注与视频关键帧机制，稳定静态区域、处理大幅运动与遮挡变化。
works.specs: sequences up to 30 min · codec-compatible atlases (e.g. FFV1) · PackUV-2B: 100 sequences, 50+ cameras, 2B frames

paper.title: PackUV: Packed Gaussian UV Maps for 4D Volumetric Video

works.title: Solaris
works.description: A video world model that generates first-person views for two Minecraft players acting in the same world at once, keeping what each sees consistent with the other's actions; NYU released the weights, evaluation datasets and the multiplayer data-collection engine.
works.description_zh: 一个视频世界模型：同时为在同一个《我的世界》世界里行动的两名玩家分别生成第一人称画面，并让每人看到的内容与对方的动作保持一致；纽约大学公开了模型权重、评测数据集与多人数据采集引擎。
works.idea_en: Turns a world model from one observer into a shared space: when one player builds or walks away, the other player's view has to show it.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型从单一观察者变成共享空间：一名玩家建造或走开时，另一名玩家的画面也必须体现出来。
works.method: A staged pipeline moves from single-player to multiplayer modeling, combining bidirectional, causal and Self Forcing training, plus a memory-efficient Checkpointed Self Forcing variant for a longer-horizon teacher; trained on 12.6 million synchronized multiplayer frames collected by automated Minecraft bots.
works.method_zh: 分阶段训练，从单人建模过渡到多人建模，结合双向、因果与 Self Forcing 训练，并提出节省显存的 Checkpointed Self Forcing，以便使用更长时程的教师模型；训练数据是由自动化《我的世界》机器人采集的 1260 万帧同步多人画面。
works.specs: 2 players · Minecraft · 12.6M multiplayer training frames · JAX (TPU training, GPU inference)

paper.title: Solaris: Building a Multiplayer Video World Model in Minecraft

works.title_zh: Solaris：《我的世界》多人视频世界模型

works.title: Generated Reality
works.description: A video world model for VR driven by the wearer's tracked head pose and joint-level hand poses: reaching and grabbing in the headset changes the generated egocentric scene, which is streamed back at about 11 fps. In the Stanford team's user studies, participants completed tasks more often and reported significantly more control than with baselines.
works.description_zh: 一个面向 VR 的视频世界模型，由佩戴者被追踪的头部位姿和关节级手部姿态驱动：在头显中伸手抓取，生成的第一人称场景随之变化，并以约 11 fps 流式传回头显。斯坦福团队的用户研究中，参与者的任务成功率更高，主观控制感也明显强于基线。
works.idea_en: Puts the body, not a keyboard, in control of a generated world, which is what headset-based situations need; the frame rate is still far below comfortable VR.
works.idea_zh: 让身体而不是键盘来控制生成的世界，这正是基于头显的情境所需要的；不过帧率仍远低于舒适 VR 的要求。
works.method: Compares diffusion-transformer conditioning strategies and proposes one for 3D head and hand control (UmeTrack hand representation from a commercial VR headset); a bidirectional video diffusion teacher is distilled into a causal autoregressive model that streams to the headset; a human-subject study compares task success and perceived control against baselines (sample size not stated on the project page).
works.method_zh: 比较多种扩散 Transformer 条件注入方式，提出适用于三维头部与手部控制的方案（手部采用商用 VR 头显提供的 UmeTrack 表示）；把双向视频扩散教师模型蒸馏为因果自回归模型，向头显流式输出；通过人类被试研究与基线比较任务成功率与主观控制感（项目主页未给出样本量）。
works.specs: ~11 fps on a VR headset · head + joint-level hand pose control (developer-reported)

paper.title: Generated Reality: Human-centric World Simulation using Interactive Video Generation with Hand and Camera Control

works.title_zh: Generated Reality：手部与相机控制的以人为中心的交互世界模拟

works.title: Lyria 3
works.description: Google DeepMind's 2026 music model with vocals, launched in the Gemini app on 18 February 2026, followed by Lyria 3 Pro for full-length songs (25 March 2026) and Lyria 3.5 (generally available 3 September 2026). It accepts text and image prompts, and all outputs carry SynthID watermarks.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 2026 年带人声的音乐模型，2026 年 2 月 18 日在 Gemini 应用中上线，随后推出生成完整歌曲的 Lyria 3 Pro（2026 年 3 月 25 日）和 Lyria 3.5（2026 年 9 月 3 日正式可用）。它接受文字和图像提示，所有输出都带 SynthID 水印。
works.idea_en: Image-to-music lets a soundtrack be derived from how a scene looks, keeping score and setting consistent.
works.idea_zh: 从图像生成音乐，让配乐可以从场景的外观中推导出来，使音乐与场景保持一致。
works.method: Generative music model with vocals (architecture unpublished), exposed as 30-second clip and full-song variants; outputs are SynthID-watermarked.
works.method_zh: 带人声的生成式音乐模型（架构未公开），提供 30 秒片段与完整歌曲两种版本；输出带 SynthID 水印。

works.title: Phoenix-4
works.description: Phoenix-4 renders a full-face video replica of a real person in real time, with explicit emotion control and active-listening expressions while the user speaks; it is the face of Tavus' Conversational Video Interface. Phoenix-4.5 (2026-09-09) adds upper-body motion, zero-shot identities and about 134 ms audio-to-video latency.
works.description_zh: Phoenix-4 能实时渲染真人的全脸视频复刻，可显式控制情绪，并在用户说话时呈现主动倾听的表情；它是 Tavus 对话视频接口的“脸”。Phoenix-4.5（2026-09-09）加入上半身动作和零样本身份，音频到视频延迟约 134 ms。
works.idea_en: Makes the listening face, not just the speaking mouth, a controllable output of a real-time renderer.
works.idea_zh: 让“倾听时的脸”而不只是说话的嘴，成为实时渲染器的可控输出。
works.method: An audio feature encoder and behaviour model drive a real-time full-face rendering network trained on conversation video, with emotion and listening states as conditioning; it works alongside Sparrow (turn-taking) and Raven (perception) in a cascaded stack.
works.method_zh: 音频特征编码器和行为模型驱动一个在对话视频上训练的实时全脸渲染网络，以情绪和倾听状态作为条件；它与 Sparrow（轮流发言）和 Raven（感知）组成级联系统协同工作。

works.title: Hibiki-Zero
works.description: A simultaneous speech-to-speech translation model that listens to French, Spanish, Portuguese or German and speaks the English translation in the speaker's own voice while they are still talking. It follows Hibiki (February 2025) and no longer needs word-aligned training data.
works.description_zh: 一个同声传译式的语音到语音翻译模型：听法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语或德语，在对方还在说话时就用对方自己的声音说出英文译文。它是 Hibiki（2025 年 2 月）的后续，不再需要逐词对齐的训练数据。
works.idea_en: Live interpretation with voice transfer makes cross-language encounters stageable: a participant hears a foreign-language interlocutor in their own language with a short, natural delay.
works.idea_zh: 带声音迁移的实时传译让跨语言相遇可以被布置出来：参与者能以短而自然的延迟，用自己的语言听到外语对话者的话。
works.method: A 3B decoder-only multistream Transformer over Mimi tokens at 12.5 Hz that models source and target speech jointly and adapts its delay to gather just enough context, trained without word-level alignments.
works.method_zh: 一个 3B 的仅解码器多流 Transformer，基于 12.5 Hz 的 Mimi 音频标记，联合建模源语音与目标语音，并自适应调整延迟以积累恰好足够的上下文，训练时无需词级对齐。

paper.title: Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation Without Aligned Data

works.title_zh: Hibiki-Zero 同声传译模型

works.title: Seedance 2.0
works.description: Seedance 2.0 (public release in ByteDance's Jimeng and Doubao apps on 2026-02-12; global via BytePlus in April) generates audio and video jointly from any mix of text, image, audio and video references. Press reports say ByteDance paused real-person reference uploads soon after launch; Seedance 2.5 (2026-07-30) extends single generations to 30 seconds.
works.description_zh: Seedance 2.0（2026-02-12 在字节跳动的即梦与豆包中公开上线，4 月经 BytePlus 面向全球）可根据文本、图像、音频和视频参考的任意组合联合生成音视频。据媒体报道，字节跳动在发布后不久暂停了真人参考素材上传；Seedance 2.5（2026-07-30）把单次生成延长到 30 秒。
works.idea_en: Audio, motion and camera references in one prompt give director-level control, and also make consent for likeness a design requirement.
works.idea_zh: 在一个提示中同时给出音频、动作和镜头参考，带来导演级的控制，也让肖像授权成为必须的设计要求。
works.method: Unified multimodal audio-video joint generation architecture accepting text, image, audio and video inputs (per the Seedance 2.0 technical report).
works.method_zh: 统一的多模态音视频联合生成架构，接受文本、图像、音频与视频输入（据 Seedance 2.0 技术报告）。
works.specs: 4–15 s · joint audio-video · Seedance 2.5: up to 30 s

paper.title: Seedance 2.0: Advancing Video Generation for World Complexity

works.title: Simile
works.description: A commercial platform that simulates how real customer groups would respond to a product launch, price change or campaign, using agents built from interviews and survey data in the line of the Stanford 1,000-person study. In July 2026 it raised over US$200 million at a US$2 billion post-money valuation and reported a foundation model of human behavior and a confidence model that predicts each simulation's accuracy.
works.description_zh: 一个商业平台，用访谈与问卷数据构建的智能体，模拟真实客户群体对产品发布、价格调整或营销活动的反应，延续斯坦福 1,000 人研究的思路。2026 年 7 月，Simile 以 20 亿美元投后估值融资逾 2 亿美元，并称已建成人类行为基础模型，以及可预测每次模拟准确度的置信度模型。
works.idea_en: Population simulation has become a product; its accuracy claims are exactly what behavioral researchers would need to check before using such twins as participants.
works.idea_zh: 人群模拟已经成为产品；它的准确性声明，正是行为研究者把这类“数字孪生”当作被试之前必须检验的内容。
works.method: Likely the generative-agent architecture with interview-grounded personas, validated by comparing simulated and held-out human response distributions; Simile reports enterprise studies (e.g. with CVS Health) but does not publish full model details.
works.method_zh: 很可能沿用以访谈为基础人设的生成式智能体架构，并通过比较模拟回答与留出的真人回答分布来验证；Simile 披露了与企业（如 CVS Health）的合作研究，但未公开完整模型细节。

works.title: 4RC
works.description: Feed-forward model from NTU's S-Lab (with Oxford) that reconstructs the dense geometry and motion of a dynamic scene from a monocular video in one pass; after the video is encoded once, the 3D geometry of any frame can be queried at any other timestamp. Code is public.
works.description_zh: 南洋理工大学 S-Lab（与牛津大学合作）的前馈模型：一次前向即可从单目视频重建动态场景的稠密几何与运动；视频只需编码一次，之后就能在任意时间点查询任一帧的三维几何。代码已公开。
works.idea_en: Turns a phone video of a moving scene into queryable 4D geometry in one forward pass, a capture step for restaging real events in 3D.
works.idea_zh: 一次前向就把手机拍的动态场景视频变成可查询的 4D 几何，是把真实事件搬进三维重演的一道采集工序。
works.method: A transformer encodes the whole video into a compact spatio-temporal latent; a conditional decoder queries 3D geometry and motion for any frame at any target time, with per-view 4D attributes factorised into base geometry plus time-dependent relative motion.
works.method_zh: Transformer 把整段视频编码为紧凑的时空潜变量；条件解码器可按需查询任一帧在任一目标时刻的三维几何与运动，每个视角的 4D 属性被分解为基础几何加随时间变化的相对运动。

paper.title: 4RC: 4D Reconstruction via Conditional Querying Anytime and Anywhere

works.title_zh: 4RC 随时随地条件查询的 4D 重建

works.title: Raven-1
works.description: Raven-1 is Tavus' multimodal perception model for live conversation: it fuses the user's tone, facial expression, gaze, posture and hesitation into running natural-language descriptions that the agent's LLM reads, so a flat 'fine' and a cheerful 'fine' lead to different replies.
works.description_zh: Raven-1 是 Tavus 用于实时对话的多模态感知模型：它把用户的语气、面部表情、视线、姿态和迟疑融合成持续更新的自然语言描述供智能体的大模型读取，于是语气平淡的“还行”和愉快的“还行”会得到不同的回应。
works.idea_en: Perception of the human becomes a separate, swappable model whose outputs could be logged as a record of what the agent 'saw'.
works.idea_zh: 对人的感知成为一个可单独替换的模型，其输出可以记录下来，作为智能体“看到了什么”的日志。
works.method: Unified audio-visual fusion producing LLM-readable descriptions rather than emotion labels, with rolling updates so context is never more than about 300 ms stale.
works.method_zh: 统一的视听融合，输出大模型可读的描述而非情绪标签，并滚动更新，使上下文的滞后不超过约 300 ms。
works.specs: audio descriptions <100 ms · context ≤300 ms stale · pipeline <600 ms
works.title_zh: Raven-1 多模态感知模型

works.title: SAGE
works.description: Given an embodied task such as 'pick up a bowl and place it on the table', SAGE's agent generates a physically valid, simulation-ready room for it and refines it until it passes its own checks; NVIDIA released code and the SAGE-10k scene dataset.
works.description_zh: 给定“拿起碗放到桌上”这样的具身任务，SAGE 的智能体会为之生成一个物理上有效、可直接仿真的房间，并不断修正直到通过自身的检查；NVIDIA 公开了代码和 SAGE-10k 场景数据集。
works.idea_en: Generating the situation from the task description, then checking it with critics, is the same loop a study needs when its scenario must be both varied and valid.
works.idea_zh: 根据任务描述生成情境、再用评审器检查，这正是研究中既要变化多样又要保证有效的情境所需要的循环。
works.method: An LLM agent couples layout and object-composition generators (including TRELLIS assets) with critics for semantic plausibility, visual realism and physical stability, iterating until the scene meets intent and loads stably in Isaac Sim.
works.method_zh: 语言模型智能体把布局生成器、物体组合生成器（包括 TRELLIS 资产）与语义合理性、视觉真实感和物理稳定性评审器结合起来，反复迭代，直到场景符合意图并能在 Isaac Sim 中稳定加载。
works.specs: SAGE-10k dataset · Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab

paper.title: SAGE: Scalable Agentic 3D Scene Generation for Embodied AI

works.title: HOICraft
works.description: A VR designer selects a 3D object and states an intent; HOICraft uses GPT-4o to pick which parts should be interactive and to recommend how hand movements should drive them (physics grab, gesture or touch, manipulation or animation), which the designer then tests and tunes in the headset.
works.description_zh: VR 设计师选中一个三维物体并说明意图，HOICraft 用 GPT-4o 判断哪些部件应当可交互，并推荐手部动作如何驱动它们（物理抓取、手势或触碰，操纵或动画），设计师随后在头显里测试和调整。
works.idea_en: Generation can target how a world responds to hands, not only what it looks like, which is where most generated objects remain inert props.
works.idea_zh: 生成的对象可以是世界如何回应双手，而不只是它的外观；大多数生成物体恰恰停留在不可交互的道具阶段。
works.method: GPT-4o analyses the object and the designer's intent to recommend interactable parts, HOI properties and a ranked hand-to-behaviour mapping across five HOI designs (physics-, gesture- and contact-based manipulation or animation), with in-context examples from preference data of 20 participants. On Meta Quest 3, 12 VR interaction designers needed significantly fewer exploratory trial-and-error iterations than with manual mapping (p < .001); SUS 81.
works.method_zh: GPT-4o 分析物体与设计意图，推荐可交互部件、手物交互属性，以及在五类交互设计（基于物理、手势或接触的操纵或动画）中排好序的手部到行为映射，并以 20 名参与者的偏好数据作为上下文示例。在 Meta Quest 3 上，12 位 VR 交互设计师的试错次数显著少于手动映射（p < .001），SUS 为 81。

paper.title: HOICraft: In-Situ VLM-based Authoring Tool for Part-Level Hand-Object Interaction Design in VR

works.title_zh: HOICraft：基于视觉语言模型的 VR 部件级手物交互现场创作工具

works.title: MotionCrafter
works.description: MotionCrafter takes one ordinary video and returns a dense 3D point map for every frame together with the 3D motion of every point (scene flow), all in one shared coordinate frame. It was a CVPR 2026 Highlight; code, weights and a demo are public.
works.description_zh: MotionCrafter 输入一段普通视频，为每一帧输出稠密的三维点图，以及每个点的三维运动（场景流），全部位于同一个坐标系中。它入选 CVPR 2026 Highlight，代码、权重与在线演示均已公开。
works.idea_en: Video generators already encode how things move; MotionCrafter uses that knowledge to measure the motion in real footage instead of inventing new footage.
works.idea_zh: 视频生成模型已经学到了物体如何运动；MotionCrafter 用这些知识去测量真实画面中的运动，而不是生成新的画面。
works.method: A 4D VAE encodes point maps and scene flow into latents that a fine-tuned video diffusion backbone predicts from the RGB video; the authors report that forcing these latents to match RGB VAE latents hurts, and use a new normalization instead.
works.method_zh: 4D VAE 把点图与场景流编码为潜变量，再由微调过的视频扩散骨干根据 RGB 视频预测这些潜变量；作者发现强行让它们与 RGB VAE 潜变量对齐反而有害，因此改用新的归一化方式。
works.specs: +38.6% geometry, +25.0% scene flow vs. prior best (authors)

paper.title: MotionCrafter: Dense Geometry and Motion Reconstruction with a 4D VAE

works.title: Waymo World Model
works.description: A driving simulator built on Genie 3 that generates both camera and lidar data, controllable by language prompts, driving inputs and scene layouts, to rehearse rare events such as a tornado, an elephant on the road or a wrong-way driver.
works.description_zh: 一个基于 Genie 3 的驾驶模拟器，同时生成摄像头与激光雷达数据，可通过语言提示、驾驶输入和场景布局控制，用来演练龙卷风、路上出现大象或车辆逆行等罕见事件。
works.idea_en: A general world model's knowledge transfers to a safety-critical domain once post-trained on that domain's sensors, a pattern other high-stakes simulations could follow.
works.idea_zh: 通用世界模型的知识在用某一领域的传感器数据后训练之后，就能迁移到这个安全攸关的领域；其他高风险模拟也可以遵循这一模式。
works.method: Genie 3 post-trained on Waymo driving data to output multi-sensor 2D video and 3D lidar, with an efficient real-time variant used when a simulation departs from a logged event.
works.method_zh: 在 Waymo 驾驶数据上对 Genie 3 进行后训练，使其输出多传感器二维视频与三维激光雷达点云；当仿真偏离记录的事件时，改用高效的实时版本。
works.title_zh: Waymo 世界模型

works.title: Cube 4D generation
works.description: Beta of '4D generation' on Roblox: inside a game, a player types a prompt and receives a functional object, for example a car they can get into and drive, because Cube generates parts that match a schema and Roblox attaches behaviours to them.
works.description_zh: Roblox 上“4D 生成”的测试版：玩家在游戏中输入提示词，就能得到一个可用的物体，例如可以坐进去开的车；做法是 Cube 按“模式”（schema）生成各个部件，再由 Roblox 为部件附加行为。
works.idea_en: Generation at play time, by participants, of objects that obey the world's rules: a concrete template for letting people inside a generated situation create things that actually work. Roblox reports 160,000+ objects generated in early access in one game.
works.idea_zh: 由参与者在游玩过程中生成、并遵守世界规则的物体：为“让身处生成情境中的人创造真正能用的东西”提供了具体范例。Roblox 称在一款游戏的早期测试中已生成超过 16 万个物体。
works.method: Schemas such as Car-5 (body plus four wheels) and Body-1 (any single mesh) define the named mesh parts an object needs; Cube generates those parts and scripted behaviours make them work in the experience.
works.method_zh: Car-5（车身加四个车轮）、Body-1（任意单一网格）等模式规定物体所需的命名网格部件；Cube 生成这些部件，再由脚本行为让它们在体验中运转。
works.specs: beta schemas: Car-5, Body-1 · 160K+ objects in early access
works.title_zh: Cube 4D 生成

works.title: Kling 3.0
works.description: Kling 3.0 (2026-02-04) generates multi-shot sequences of up to 15 seconds with native audio and multilingual, lip-synced dialogue in which users assign who speaks; 'Omni' variants take reference videos and images to keep characters consistent.
works.description_zh: 可灵 3.0（2026-02-04）可生成最长 15 秒的多镜头序列，带原生音频和多语种、口型同步的对白，用户可指定由谁说话；“Omni”版本可用参考视频和图像保持角色一致。
works.idea_en: Directing who speaks and when makes short multi-character dialogue scenes feasible as stimulus material.
works.idea_zh: 可以指定谁在何时说话，多人短对话场景因此可以用作刺激材料。
works.method: Successor of the Kling-Omni architecture with joint audio-visual generation and storyboard-style multi-shot planning (per Kuaishou's press release).
works.method_zh: 沿用 Kling-Omni 架构，加入音视频联合生成与分镜式多镜头规划（据快手新闻稿）。
works.specs: up to 15 s · multi-shot · speech in EN / ZH / JA / KO / ES
works.title_zh: 可灵 3.0

works.title: SkinTokens (TokenRig)
works.description: Successor to UniRig from Tsinghua University and VAST: given any 3D mesh, from anime characters to quadrupeds, it generates the skeleton and the per-vertex skinning weights as one token sequence, ready to import into standard animation tools; weights and a demo are on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: 清华大学与 VAST 推出的 UniRig 后继工作：输入任意三维网格（从动漫角色到四足动物），把骨骼和逐顶点蒙皮权重作为同一个 token 序列一次生成，可直接导入常用动画工具；权重和演示已发布在 Hugging Face。
works.idea_en: Rigging, the step that decides whether a generated character can move at all, becomes a single generation pass that can be improved with reinforcement learning.
works.idea_zh: 骨骼绑定决定了生成角色能不能动起来；现在它变成一次生成就能完成的步骤，还可以用强化学习继续改进。
works.method: An FSQ-CVAE compresses sparse skinning weights into discrete SkinTokens; TokenRig predicts skeleton parameters and SkinTokens autoregressively in one sequence, then a reinforcement-learning stage with geometric and semantic rewards refines the rigs.
works.method_zh: 用 FSQ-CVAE 把稀疏的蒙皮权重压缩为离散的 SkinTokens；TokenRig 在同一序列中自回归预测骨骼参数和 SkinTokens，再通过带几何与语义奖励的强化学习阶段改进绑定结果。
works.specs: 98–133% better skinning accuracy, 17–22% better bone prediction than baselines (author claims)

paper.title: Skin Tokens: A Learned Compact Representation for Unified Autoregressive Rigging

works.title_zh: SkinTokens（TokenRig）：统一自回归骨骼绑定

works.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5
works.description: A 9B open omni-modal model that watches a live camera stream, listens and speaks at the same time, and can speak up on its own when it notices something. It runs locally through llama.cpp, Ollama and vLLM and clones a voice from a short reference clip.
works.description_zh: 一个 9B 的开源全模态模型，能看实时摄像头画面，同时听和说，发现情况时还能主动开口。它可以通过 llama.cpp、Ollama 和 vLLM 在本地运行，并用一小段参考音频克隆声音。
works.idea_en: Full-duplex audio-visual conversation small enough for one GPU, so a headset scenario can run its interlocutor offline and version-pinned.
works.idea_zh: 体量小到单张 GPU 即可运行的全双工视听对话，让头显情境中的对话者可以离线、锁定版本地运行。
works.method: End-to-end assembly of SigLIP2 vision, a Whisper-medium audio encoder, a CosyVoice2 speech decoder and a Qwen3-8B backbone, processing continuous audio-video input and concurrent text-speech output streams without mutual blocking.
works.method_zh: 由 SigLIP2 视觉编码器、Whisper-medium 音频编码器、CosyVoice2 语音解码器和 Qwen3-8B 主干端到端组装而成，持续处理音视频输入，并同时输出文本与语音流，二者互不阻塞。

paper.title: MiniCPM-o 4.5: Towards Real-Time Full-Duplex Omni-Modal Interaction

works.title: glTF Gaussian Splatting extension (KHR_gaussian_splatting)
works.description: A Khronos extension that stores 3D Gaussian splats (position, rotation, scale, opacity and spherical-harmonic color) as glTF 2.0 mesh primitives, giving engines and viewers a common baseline format. Khronos released it as a release candidate for industry feedback on 2026-02-03; as of October 2026 the spec is marked complete and ratified, with compression left to future extensions.
works.description_zh: Khronos 的一项扩展，把三维高斯泼溅（位置、旋转、缩放、不透明度与球谐颜色）存为 glTF 2.0 网格图元，为引擎与查看器提供共同的基础格式。Khronos 于 2026-02-03 发布候选版本征求业界意见；截至 2026 年 10 月，规范已标记为完成并获批准，压缩则留给后续扩展。
works.idea_en: A shared file format is what lets a generated world move unchanged from the model that made it to whichever engine runs the study.
works.idea_zh: 有了共享的文件格式，生成的世界才能原封不动地从生成它的模型，转到运行研究的任意引擎中。
works.method: Extends glTF mesh primitives with per-point attributes for Gaussian parameters and a defined rendering model, so splat scenes travel with standard glTF tooling.
works.method_zh: 在 glTF 网格图元上为高斯参数增加逐点属性，并规定渲染模型，使泼溅场景可以沿用标准 glTF 工具链。
works.specs: release candidate 2026-02-03 · ratified (status as of Oct 2026) · glTF 2.0 · uncompressed baseline
works.title_zh: glTF 高斯泼溅扩展（KHR_gaussian_splatting）

works.title: Causal Forcing
works.description: Causal Forcing (Tsinghua University, ICML 2026) is a distillation recipe and set of open checkpoints that turn a bidirectional video diffusion model into a few-step autoregressive generator for real-time interactive video. The authors report gains over Self Forcing of 19.3% in dynamic degree and 16.7% in instruction following at the same inference cost; later releases add 2-step and 1-step frame-wise models (Causal Forcing++), and several 2026 long-video methods use it as their base.
works.description_zh: Causal Forcing（清华大学，ICML 2026）是一套蒸馏方法和一组开源权重，可把双向视频扩散模型变成用于实时交互视频的少步自回归生成器。作者报告，在相同推理开销下，它在动态程度上比 Self Forcing 高 19.3%，在指令遵循上高 16.7%；后续版本 Causal Forcing++ 又推出了 2 步和 1 步逐帧模型，2026 年的多项长视频方法以它为基础模型。
works.idea_en: Fixes how real-time video students are initialised rather than how they are run, so the same streaming budget yields more motion; it has become a common starting point for interactive video work.
works.idea_zh: 改进的是实时视频学生模型的初始化方式，而不是推理方式，因此在相同的流式算力下能生成更多运动；它已成为交互视频研究常用的起点。
works.method: Initialises the causal student by ODE distillation from an autoregressive teacher, instead of the bidirectional teacher whose flow map a causal student cannot recover, then applies the DMD training of Self Forcing; released on Wan 1.3B in chunk-wise and frame-wise variants.
works.method_zh: 先用自回归教师模型做 ODE 蒸馏来初始化因果学生模型（双向教师的流映射无法被因果学生复现），再沿用 Self Forcing 的 DMD 训练；基于 Wan 1.3B 发布了分块与逐帧两种版本。
works.specs: Wan 1.3B base · 4-step chunk-wise and frame-wise · 2-step and 1-step frame-wise (Causal Forcing++)

paper.title: Causal Forcing: Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation Done Right for High-Quality Real-Time Interactive Video Generation

works.title_zh: Causal Forcing：面向实时交互视频的自回归扩散蒸馏

works.title: Dialogs with GenAI NPCs
works.description: Office Whispers is a speech-based VR adventure-puzzle game on Quest 2 in which players solve a mystery by talking freely with four Inworld-driven NPCs (a manager, a maintenance worker, a designer and an intern); 48 players in Canada and the Netherlands were surveyed and interviewed.
works.description_zh: Office Whispers 是一款运行在 Quest 2 上的语音 VR 解谜冒险游戏，玩家通过与四个由 Inworld 驱动的 NPC（经理、维修工、设计师和实习生）自由交谈来解开谜团；研究者对加拿大和荷兰的 48 名玩家进行了问卷与访谈。
works.idea_en: Free speech with NPCs made players feel immersed until the conversation failed: 77% hit speech-recognition errors, and wrong or off-context answers broke the game more often than latency did.
works.idea_zh: 与 NPC 自由对话让玩家感到沉浸，直到对话出错：77% 的人遇到过语音识别错误，而错误或离题的回答比延迟更常打断游戏。
works.method: Inworld provides speech recognition, dialogue memory and LLM replies with voiced output; exploratory study, N = 48, with the Player Experience Inventory, a custom questionnaire and semi-structured interviews, across two gender-swapped versions of the cast.
works.method_zh: 由 Inworld 提供语音识别、对话记忆和大语言模型回复，并以语音输出；探索性研究，N = 48，使用玩家体验量表（PXI）、自编问卷和半结构化访谈，角色设置有两个互换性别的版本。

paper.title: Dialogs with GenAI NPCs: Exploring Player Interactions with Speech Agents in a VR Game

works.title_zh: 与生成式 AI NPC 对话：VR 游戏中玩家与语音智能体的互动

works.title: Vidu Q3
works.description: Vidu Q3 (early February 2026) is Shengshu Technology's audio-visual model, generating clips with synchronized speech and sound and strong reference-to-video consistency. Shengshu launched the Vidu line with Tsinghua University in April 2024 as China's first Sora-class model; Vidu Q4 was in preview in October 2026.
works.description_zh: Vidu Q3（2026 年 2 月初）是生数科技的音视频模型，可生成带同步语音和声音的片段，参考生视频的一致性较强。生数科技于 2024 年 4 月与清华大学推出 Vidu 系列，是国内首个 Sora 级模型；2026 年 10 月 Vidu Q4 处于预览阶段。
works.idea_en: Shows how fast Chinese labs iterate: four major Vidu generations in under two years, each adding reference and audio features.
works.idea_zh: 体现了国内团队的迭代速度：不到两年推出四代 Vidu，每代都新增参考生成或音频能力。
works.method: U-ViT diffusion transformer (Tsinghua's architecture) extended to joint audio-visual generation; Q3 details not published.
works.method_zh: 基于清华提出的 U-ViT 扩散 Transformer，扩展到音视频联合生成；Q3 细节未公开。

works.title: Project Genie
works.description: A Google Labs web prototype, powered by Genie 3, Nano Banana Pro and Gemini, where Google AI Ultra subscribers sketch a world and character from text and images, explore it in first or third person, remix others' worlds and download the result; sessions are capped at 60 seconds.
works.description_zh: Google Labs 推出的网页原型，由 Genie 3、Nano Banana Pro 与 Gemini 驱动：Google AI Ultra 订阅用户用文字和图像勾勒世界与角色，以第一或第三人称探索，可改编他人的世界并下载视频；每次体验限时 60 秒。
works.idea_en: Puts a real-time world model in front of paying users for the first time: authoring a world now takes a sentence and a picture, but a session ends after a minute.
works.idea_zh: 首次把实时世界模型交到付费用户手中：创作一个世界只需一句话加一张图，但体验一分钟就会结束。
works.method: Nano Banana Pro renders a preview image the user can edit ('world sketching'), Gemini likely handles prompt understanding, and Genie 3 then generates the path ahead in real time from the user's movement and camera input.
works.method_zh: Nano Banana Pro 生成可编辑的预览图（“世界草图”），Gemini 可能负责理解提示，随后由 Genie 3 根据用户的移动与镜头输入实时生成前方的路。
works.specs: 60 s per generation · U.S. Google AI Ultra, 18+ at launch (developer-reported)

works.title: LingBot-World
works.description: An open-source world simulator from Ant Group's Robbyant that keeps realistic, scientific and cartoon worlds consistent over minute-long interaction and responds in under a second; a hosted demo runs on Reactor.
works.description_zh: 蚂蚁集团灵波科技推出的开源世界模拟器，可在分钟级交互中保持写实、科学与卡通等不同风格世界的一致性，响应延迟低于一秒；可在 Reactor 平台在线试用。
works.idea_en: An open, minute-horizon world model from a Chinese lab, released the day before Project Genie, which narrowed the gap between open and closed world models.
works.idea_zh: 来自中国实验室的开源分钟级世界模型，比 Project Genie 早一天发布，缩小了开源与闭源世界模型之间的差距。
works.method: A world model derived from a large video-generation backbone and post-trained for action conditioning, long-term memory and low-latency streaming; later releases added fast and action variants.
works.method_zh: 由大型视频生成骨干派生、再经后训练获得动作条件、长期记忆与低延迟流式能力的世界模型；后续版本加入了快速版与动作版。

paper.title: Advancing Open-source World Models

works.title_zh: LingBot-World（蚂蚁灵波）

works.title: EmSim: AI-Driven VR Simulation for De-Escalation Training in Law Enforcement
works.description: Police trainees talk freely with an emotionally distressed virtual person (an Unreal Engine digital human voiced through Convai) while a GPT-4-turbo evaluator scores each utterance against an empathy rubric; the scores decide whether the scenario escalates or calms, and a trainer dashboard shows them live. A pilot with 14 trainees and 5 trainers found two strategies, careful de-escalation and boundary testing.
works.description_zh: 警校学员与一位情绪激动的虚拟人（基于 Unreal Engine 数字人、由 Convai 驱动语音对话）自由交谈；GPT-4-turbo 评估器按共情量表为每句话打分，分数决定场景是升级还是缓和，教官仪表盘实时显示这些分数。一项有 14 名学员和 5 名教官参与的试点研究发现了两种策略：谨慎降级与试探边界。
works.idea_en: Two LLM roles in one scene: one plays the distressed person, another scores the trainee's words and moves the scene along an escalation path, so consequences follow from what is said.
works.idea_zh: 同一场景中大语言模型扮演两个角色：一个扮演情绪激动的人，另一个为学员的话打分并沿升级路径推动场景，让后果取决于所说的话。
works.method: Unreal Engine scene with a Convai speech-to-speech character streamed from a PC to Meta Quest 3; rubric-guided GPT-4-turbo scoring of each utterance feeds an escalation state manager and a web dashboard for trainers; mixed-methods pilot with behavioral trajectories and post-session interviews.
works.method_zh: Unreal Engine 场景配合 Convai 语音对语音角色，由 PC 串流到 Meta Quest 3；GPT-4-turbo 按量表为每句话打分，结果输入升级状态管理器和教官网页仪表盘；混合方法试点，分析行为轨迹与课后访谈。

paper.title: EmSim: AI-Driven VR Simulation for De-Escalation Training in Law Enforcement

works.title_zh: EmSim：面向执法人员冲突降级训练的 AI 驱动 VR 模拟

works.title: Lucy 2
works.description: Decart's Lucy 2 (2026-01-26) edits a live video stream at 1080p and 30 fps with near-zero latency, from character swaps and clothing changes to product placement and full environment changes driven by text and reference images; Lucy 2.5 (2026-07-16) improved temporal stability.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 Lucy 2（2026-01-26）能以 1080p、30 fps、近乎零延迟编辑实时视频流，依据文本和参考图完成角色替换、换装、植入商品乃至整体环境变换；Lucy 2.5（2026-07-16）提升了时间稳定性。
works.idea_en: Live, reference-guided transformation of a person's camera view is the building block for generative mixed-reality conditions.
works.idea_zh: 基于参考图对人的实时画面进行变换，是构建生成式混合现实实验条件的基本模块。
works.method: Real-time world-transformation video model building on MirageLSD and Lucy Edit; Decart reports it learns physical consistency without depth maps or 3D.
works.method_zh: 在 MirageLSD 与 Lucy Edit 基础上构建的实时“世界变换”视频模型；Decart 称其无需深度图或三维信息即可学到物理一致性。

works.title: Supplementing Patient Encounter Training for Preservice Nurses: Towards an AI×VR Approach
works.description: Preservice nurses practised with generative-AI virtual standardized patients in immersive VR before a standardized-patient exam (23 with the system, 34 controls). One session raised self-efficacy from 3.74 to 4.11 and usability was rated 81.6/100, but exam performance did not differ from controls and was unrelated to presence or immersion.
works.description_zh: 职前护士在参加标准化病人考核前，在沉浸式 VR 中与生成式 AI 驱动的虚拟标准化病人练习（使用系统 23 人，对照 34 人）。一次练习就把自我效能从 3.74 提高到 4.11，可用性评分 81.6/100；但考核表现与对照组没有差异，也与临场感和沉浸感无关。
works.idea_en: Confidence and presence went up while exam performance did not, a reminder to measure transfer and not only experience.
works.idea_zh: 信心和临场感提高了，考核表现却没有变化；这提醒我们要测量迁移效果，而不只是体验。
works.method: Mixed-methods study with an experimental group (n = 23) and a control group (n = 34); SUS, pre–post self-efficacy, standardized-patient encounter scores, engagement and presence questionnaires and interviews; the authors derive design steps such as capping reply length and enabling reliable barge-in.
works.method_zh: 混合方法研究，实验组 23 人、对照组 34 人；测量 SUS、前后测自我效能、标准化病人考核得分、投入度与临场感问卷，并进行访谈；作者据此提出限制回复长度、支持可靠插话打断等设计建议。

paper.title: Supplementing Patient Encounter Training for Preservice Nurses: Towards an AI×VR Approach

works.title_zh: 补充职前护士的病人接诊训练：迈向 AI×VR 方法

works.title: 360Anything
works.description: 360Anything (Google DeepMind with the University of Toronto, ECCV 2026) lifts any perspective image or video, including footage from the Genie 3 world model, to a seamless 360° panorama without camera calibration.
works.description_zh: 360Anything（Google DeepMind 与多伦多大学，ECCV 2026）无需相机标定，就能把任意透视图像或视频（包括 Genie 3 世界模型的画面）提升为无缝的 360° 全景。
works.idea_en: Any generated clip, even a world-model rollout, can be wrapped around the viewer after the fact.
works.idea_zh: 任何生成片段，哪怕是世界模型的推演画面，都可以事后“包裹”到观看者四周。
works.method: Geometry-free diffusion transformer that learns from data where the perspective input sits inside the panorama, without explicit camera intrinsics or extrinsics.
works.method_zh: 无需几何先验的扩散 Transformer，从数据中学习透视输入在全景中的位置，不依赖显式的相机内外参。

paper.title: 360Anything: Geometry-Free Lifting of Images and Videos to 360°

works.title_zh: 360Anything：无需几何的图像与视频 360° 提升

works.title: ActionMesh
works.description: Meta's ActionMesh turns a short video, an image or a text prompt (or a 3D mesh plus a text description of its motion) into an animated 3D mesh with fixed topology that can be textured, retargeted and imported into standard 3D software. Code, weights and a Hugging Face demo are public under Meta's licence.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 ActionMesh 能把一段短视频、一张图像或一句文字（也可以是一个三维网格加一句动作描述）变成拓扑固定的动画三维网格，可以贴图、重定向并导入常规三维软件。代码、权重和 Hugging Face 演示均以 Meta 的许可证公开。
works.idea_en: Generated 4D arrives as an ordinary animated mesh in about a minute, the format game engines and XR tools already use.
works.idea_zh: 生成的 4D 结果以普通动画网格的形式在大约一分钟内交付，正是游戏引擎与 XR 工具早已在用的格式。
works.method: Temporal 3D diffusion: an existing 3D diffusion model gains a time axis to generate synchronised latents of per-frame shapes, and a temporal 3D autoencoder converts them into deformations of one reference mesh, giving a rig-free, topology-consistent animation.
works.method_zh: “时序三维扩散”：在现有三维扩散模型上加入时间轴，生成逐帧形状的同步潜变量，再由时序三维自编码器把它们转换为同一参考网格的形变，得到无需骨骼、拓扑一致的动画。
works.specs: ≈45–75 s per animation on one H100 (developer figures) · 12 GB VRAM low-RAM mode · ActionBench: 128 video–animated point-cloud pairs

paper.title: ActionMesh: Animated 3D Mesh Generation with Temporal 3D Diffusion

works.title_zh: ActionMesh 动画三维网格生成

works.title: Arena Video Arena (LMArena)
works.description: Arena's crowdsourced leaderboard for video generation: visitors enter a prompt, watch clips from two anonymous models side by side and vote, and the votes become ratings for text-to-video and image-to-video. It was introduced on lmarena.ai in January 2026; the company has since rebranded from LMArena to Arena (arena.ai).
works.description_zh: Arena 的众包视频生成排行榜：访客输入提示词，并排观看两个匿名模型生成的片段并投票，票数汇总为文生视频与图生视频的评分。它于 2026 年 1 月在 lmarena.ai 上线；此后公司已由 LMArena 更名为 Arena（arena.ai）。
works.idea_en: Human pairwise preference is the closest public proxy for perceived realism, but it rewards impressive short clips, not consistency over a long interactive session.
works.idea_zh: 人类两两偏好是衡量感知真实感最接近的公开指标，但它奖励的是惊艳的短片，而不是长时间交互中的一致性。
works.method: Blind pairwise comparisons from public users, aggregated with a Bradley-Terry model into ratings with confidence intervals.
works.method_zh: 公众用户的盲测两两比较，用 Bradley-Terry 模型汇总为带置信区间的评分。
works.specs: text-to-video and image-to-video leaderboards · blind pairwise votes
works.title_zh: Arena 视频竞技场

works.title: World API
works.description: World Labs' public API for its Marble world model: send text, one image, several images, a 360° panorama or a video, and get back a navigable 3D world that renders in the browser or exports to other tools. World Labs reports uses such as turning 2D films into explorable spaces (Escape.ai) and generating environments for robot simulators like Isaac Sim and MuJoCo. On 2026-09-28 World Labs signed an agreement to join AMD, expected to close by the end of 2026.
works.description_zh: World Labs 为 Marble 世界模型开放的公开 API：输入文字、一张或多张图片、360° 全景图或一段视频，就能得到可在浏览器中渲染、也可导出到其他工具的可漫游三维世界。World Labs 介绍的用例包括把二维电影变成可探索的空间（Escape.ai），以及为 Isaac Sim、MuJoCo 等机器人仿真器生成环境。2026-09-28，World Labs 签署协议并入 AMD，交易预计于 2026 年底前完成。
works.idea_en: Turns 'build the room' into an API call that returns an explicit 3D world, so a lab can generate many variants of a setting and then keep each one fixed for every participant.
works.idea_zh: 把“搭建房间”变成一次返回显式三维世界的 API 调用：实验室可以生成同一场景的多种变体，再让每位被试面对完全相同的版本。
works.method: Asynchronous world-generation requests run Marble, which lifts the inputs into a 3D Gaussian-splat scene with optional mesh export.
works.method_zh: 异步的世界生成请求调用 Marble，把输入提升为三维高斯泼溅场景，并可导出网格。
works.specs: inputs: text, image, multi-image, 360° panorama, video · output: Gaussian splats + mesh · launched 2026-01-21

works.title: Motion 3-to-4
works.description: Westlake University feed-forward model that turns a monocular video of a moving object, plus an optional 3D mesh of it, into an animated mesh: it generates or takes the shape once and then reconstructs per-frame vertex motion, which keeps the geometry consistent from every side. Code is public.
works.description_zh: 西湖大学的前馈模型：输入一段运动物体的单目视频（可选再加一个该物体的三维网格），输出动画网格；它只生成或读取一次形状，再逐帧重建顶点运动，因此从任何角度看几何都保持一致。代码已公开。
works.idea_en: Separating what an object is from how it moves lets any video of a motion animate a given 3D asset.
works.idea_zh: 把“物体是什么”和“它怎么动”分开，任何一段动作视频都能拿来驱动给定的三维资产。
works.method: Decomposes 4D synthesis into static 3D shape generation and motion reconstruction: on a canonical reference mesh, a compact motion latent predicts per-frame vertex trajectories, with a frame-wise transformer that handles sequences of varying length.
works.method_zh: 把 4D 合成拆分为静态三维形状生成与动作重建：在标准参考网格上，用紧凑的动作潜变量预测逐帧顶点轨迹，逐帧 Transformer 可处理不同长度的序列。

paper.title: Motion 3-to-4: 3D Motion Reconstruction for 4D Synthesis

works.title_zh: Motion 3-to-4 由三维动作重建实现 4D 合成

works.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room
works.description: VORTeX is a multi-user VR operating room in which surgical teams handle laparoscopic emergencies (pneumothorax, intra-abdominal bleeding); an LLM then classifies the team's dialogue against the NOTSS framework and draws networks of who leads and who integrates.
works.description_zh: VORTeX 是一个多人 VR 手术室，外科团队在其中处理腹腔镜手术中的紧急情况（气胸、腹腔内出血）；随后由大语言模型依据 NOTSS 框架对团队对话进行分类，并绘制谁在主导、谁在整合信息的互动网络。
works.idea_en: Here the LLM is the measurement instrument, not the scenario: automated, structured coding of team behavior adds experimental control instead of removing it.
works.idea_zh: 这里的大语言模型是测量工具而非情境本身：对团队行为进行自动化、结构化的编码，是在增强而非削弱实验控制。
works.method: Multi-user VR simulation with recorded team speech; structured prompts derived from NOTSS classify behaviors and build directed communication graphs; pilot with 12 surgical professionals at SAGES 2024.
works.method_zh: 多人 VR 模拟并录制团队语音；依据 NOTSS 设计的结构化提示词对行为分类并构建有向沟通图；在 SAGES 2024 上由 12 名外科专业人员试用。

paper.title: Integrating Virtual Reality and Large Language Models for Team-Based Non-Technical Skills Training and Evaluation in the Operating Room

works.title_zh: 融合虚拟现实与大语言模型，用于手术室团队非技术技能的训练与评估

works.title: ShapeR
works.description: Generates metric 3D shapes of the objects in a casually captured video, for example from Aria glasses, using SLAM points, posed views and machine-generated captions for each detected object; it comes with a benchmark of 178 in-the-wild objects across 7 real scenes.
works.description_zh: 从随手拍摄的视频（例如 Aria 眼镜录制的画面）中，为每个检测到的物体利用 SLAM 点、带位姿的视图和自动生成的描述，生成具有真实尺度的三维形状；并附带一个包含 7 个真实场景、178 个物体的基准。
works.idea_en: From 'one clean product photo' to 'walk through a real room wearing glasses': object generation that works on the messy captures people actually make in situ.
works.idea_zh: 从“一张干净的产品照”到“戴着眼镜在真实房间走一圈”：能处理人们在现场随手拍下的杂乱素材的物体生成。
works.method: Visual-inertial SLAM, 3D detection and VLM captioning extract per-object conditions; a rectified-flow transformer trained with compositional augmentations and an object-to-scene curriculum generates each shape.
works.method_zh: 用视觉惯性 SLAM、三维检测和视觉语言模型描述提取每个物体的条件；再由以组合式数据增强和“物体到场景”课程训练的整流流 Transformer 生成各个形状。

paper.title: ShapeR: Robust Conditional 3D Shape Generation from Casual Captures

works.title: FrankenMotion
works.description: Text-to-motion model from the University of Tübingen and the Max Planck Institute for Informatics in which each body part follows its own timed text prompt, so arms, legs and torso can be directed separately and combined into motions not seen in training; it is trained on the 39-hour Frankenstein dataset of part-level annotations produced with an LLM.
works.description_zh: 图宾根大学与马克斯·普朗克信息学研究所的文本生成动作模型：每个身体部位都有自己带时间安排的文字提示，手臂、腿部和躯干可以分别指挥，并组合出训练中从未见过的动作；训练数据是借助大语言模型标注的 39 小时 Frankenstein 部位级数据集。
works.idea_en: Fine control of individual body parts over time, the kind that experiments on gesture, posture or other nonverbal cues need.
works.idea_zh: 可以随时间精细控制各个身体部位，这正是手势、姿态等非语言线索实验所需要的。
works.method: A diffusion model conditioned on hierarchical, temporally structured text for each body part, trained on motion clips whose atomic, asynchronous part-level captions were produced with an LLM.
works.method_zh: 扩散模型以每个身体部位分层、按时间组织的文字为条件，训练数据中的原子级、异步的部位描述由大语言模型生成。
works.specs: Frankenstein dataset: 39 h with part-level, time-stamped captions

paper.title: FrankenMotion: Part-level Human Motion Generation and Composition

works.title_zh: FrankenMotion 部位级人体动作生成与组合

works.title: PersonaPlex
works.description: An open full-duplex conversational model in which developers pick a voice and define any role in a text prompt (a customer-service agent, an astronaut, a fantasy character) while keeping Moshi-style interruptions, backchannels and conversational rhythm.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的全双工对话模型：开发者可以选择声音，并用文字提示定义任意角色（客服、宇航员、奇幻人物），同时保留 Moshi 式的打断、附和与对话节奏。
works.idea_en: Removes the trade-off between a configurable persona and full-duplex naturalness, which is what a scripted confederate in a behavioral study needs.
works.idea_zh: 消除了“可配置角色”与“全双工自然度”之间的取舍，这正是行为研究中按脚本行事的实验助手所需要的。
works.method: Moshi's 7B dual-stream architecture with hybrid voice-and-text system prompts, fine-tuned on Fisher conversations relabelled with LLM-written persona descriptions plus synthetic dialogues.
works.method_zh: 基于 Moshi 的 7B 双流架构，使用语音加文本的混合系统提示；在由大模型补写角色描述的 Fisher 对话以及合成对话上微调。

paper.title: PersonaPlex: Voice and Role Control for Full Duplex Conversational Speech Models

works.title: A$AP Rocky – HELICOPTER (4D-captured music video)
works.description: The official music video for A$AP Rocky's “HELICOPTER” (January 2026) was built from performers captured as 4D Gaussian splats by Evercoast's multi-camera system and then composed into the video's scenes; Evercoast says nearly every human in the video was shot and generated with its platform.
works.description_zh: A$AP Rocky《HELICOPTER》的官方音乐录影带（2026 年 1 月）由 Evercoast 多相机系统捕捉为 4D 高斯泼溅的表演者合成到各个场景中；Evercoast 称片中几乎所有人物都是用其平台拍摄并生成的。
works.idea_en: A mass-audience release treated 4D-captured people as footage that can be re-shot after the fact, a sign that the capture side of 4D media has moved from demos into commercial production.
works.idea_zh: 一部面向大众的作品把 4D 捕捉的人当作可以事后“重拍”的素材，说明 4D 媒体的捕捉环节已从演示走进商业制作。
works.method: Performers were filmed on a synchronized multi-camera rig (56 cameras, as reported by Radiancefields.com) and reconstructed with Evercoast's software (likely its Cloudbreak service) into 4D Gaussian splat sequences, which the VFX team rendered from new virtual camera paths.
works.method_zh: 表演者在同步多相机阵列上拍摄（据 Radiancefields.com 报道为 56 台相机），再用 Evercoast 的软件（很可能是其 Cloudbreak 服务）重建为 4D 高斯泼溅序列，由视效团队沿新的虚拟镜头路径渲染。
works.title_zh: A$AP Rocky《HELICOPTER》（4D 捕捉音乐录影带）

works.title: PixVerse R1
works.description: PixVerse's first real-time world model, which keeps generating a live audiovisual scene that viewers steer with prompts instead of waiting for a finished clip; later updates added 720p API access for partners, shared worlds and personalised avatars.
works.description_zh: PixVerse 的首个实时世界模型：持续生成一个带声音的实时场景，观看者用提示引导它，而不必等待成片；后续更新为合作伙伴开放 720p API，并加入共享世界与个性化虚拟形象。
works.idea_en: A consumer video app reframed as a live world: the shift from clips to sessions, at the cost of game-level control.
works.idea_zh: 一款消费级视频应用被重新定义为实时世界：从“片段”转向“会话”，但代价是缺少游戏级的操控。
works.method: PixVerse describes three parts: an 'Omni' native multimodal foundation model, autoregressive memory for continuous streaming, and an 'Instantaneous Response Engine' that cuts sampling cost for low latency.
works.method_zh: PixVerse 称其由三部分组成：原生多模态基础模型“Omni”、用于连续流式生成的自回归记忆，以及降低采样成本、实现低延迟的“即时响应引擎”。
works.title_zh: PixVerse R1（爱诗科技）

works.title: RigMo
works.description: Snap Research model that learns a rig and its motion together from raw deforming mesh sequences, with no skeleton annotations, and turns arbitrary moving meshes into animatable assets with explicit bones, skinning weights and motion; code and data were announced as coming soon.
works.description_zh: Snap Research 的模型，直接从原始的形变网格序列中同时学习绑定和动作，不需要骨骼标注，把任意运动中的网格变成带显式骨骼、蒙皮权重和动作的可动画资产；代码与数据已宣布即将公开。
works.idea_en: Treats rig and motion as one learning problem, a route to animating creatures and objects that have no standard skeleton.
works.idea_zh: 把绑定和动作当作同一个学习问题，为没有标准骨骼的生物和物体做动画提供了一条路。
works.method: Per-vertex deformations are encoded into a rig latent that decodes to Gaussian bones and skinning weights and a motion latent that yields time-varying SE(3) transforms; a Motion-DiT then generates motion in this latent space.
works.method_zh: 把逐顶点形变编码为两个潜变量：绑定潜变量解码为高斯骨骼和蒙皮权重，动作潜变量输出随时间变化的 SE(3) 变换；再用 Motion-DiT 在该潜空间中生成动作。

paper.title: RigMo: Unifying Rig and Motion Learning for Generative Animation

works.title_zh: RigMo：绑定与动作的统一学习

works.title: VerseCrafter
works.description: VerseCrafter (Fudan University, HKU and Tencent ARC Lab, CVPR 2026) generates video from an explicit 4D world state, a static background point cloud plus a 3D Gaussian trajectory for each object, so the camera path and the motion of several objects can be specified together and are followed in the result. Code, model, a Blender add-on and the 35K-clip VerseControl4D dataset are public.
works.description_zh: VerseCrafter（复旦大学、香港大学与腾讯 ARC 实验室，CVPR 2026）根据显式的 4D 世界状态生成视频：静态背景点云加上每个物体的 3D 高斯轨迹，因此可以同时指定镜头路径与多个物体的运动，生成结果会照此执行。代码、模型、Blender 插件与 3.5 万段的 VerseControl4D 数据集均已公开。
works.idea_en: Who moves where, and from which viewpoint, becomes an inspectable 3D specification rather than a prompt, the kind of control a staged experiment needs.
works.idea_zh: 谁往哪里走、从哪个视角看，变成可检查的 3D 规格而不是一句提示，这正是布置实验情境所需要的控制。
works.method: Renders the 4D geometric control (background points and per-object Gaussian trajectories) into control maps that condition a pretrained video diffusion model, trained on an automatically built real-world dataset.
works.method_zh: 把 4D 几何控制（背景点云与各物体的高斯轨迹）渲染为控制图，作为预训练视频扩散模型的条件；训练数据来自自动构建的真实世界数据集。

paper.title: VerseCrafter: Dynamic Realistic Video World Model with 4D Geometric Control

works.title_zh: VerseCrafter：具备 4D 几何控制的动态真实视频世界模型

works.title: Gen3R
works.description: Gen3R generates a scene from one or a few images as an RGB video together with its 3D geometry (camera poses, depth maps and a global point cloud), by letting a video diffusion model and the VGGT reconstruction model share aligned latents; code and checkpoints are open.
works.description_zh: Gen3R 由一张或几张图像生成场景：输出 RGB 视频及其三维几何（相机位姿、深度图和全局点云），做法是让视频扩散模型与 VGGT 重建模型共享对齐的潜变量；代码与检查点已开源。
works.idea_en: Coupling a generator with a reconstruction model means every generated view arrives with geometry that can be checked, a step from plausible footage toward measurable space.
works.idea_zh: 把生成器与重建模型耦合，每个生成视角都带有可检验的几何，从“看起来合理的画面”向“可测量的空间”迈进一步。
works.method: An adapter on VGGT's tokens produces geometric latents regularised to align with a pre-trained video diffusion model's appearance latents; the two are generated jointly and decoded into frames, cameras, depth and point clouds.
works.method_zh: 在 VGGT 的 token 上训练适配器，得到与预训练视频扩散模型外观潜变量对齐的几何潜变量；两者联合生成，再解码为画面、相机、深度与点云。

paper.title: Gen3R: 3D Scene Generation Meets Feed-Forward Reconstruction

works.title: AI-enhanced virtual reality simulation for nursing students' empathy: Automated scoring and inter-rater reliability in a randomised controlled study
works.description: Nursing students rehearsed empathic communication in obstetric scenarios inside a first-person VR simulation (VR-AI-ECS) with AI-guided dialogue and real-time feedback, while a control group used 360° video with a standardised-patient interaction (40 vs. 40). The VR-AI group scored higher on empathic communication right after training (d = 0.96) and at follow-up (d = 0.60), and AI ratings agreed closely with educators' ratings (ICC = 0.81).
works.description_zh: 护理学生在第一人称 VR 模拟（VR-AI-ECS）中练习产科情境下的共情沟通，系统提供 AI 引导的对话与实时反馈；对照组使用含标准化病人互动的 360° 视频（各 40 人）。VR-AI 组在训练后即刻（d = 0.96）和随访时（d = 0.60）的共情沟通得分更高，AI 评分与教师评分高度一致（ICC = 0.81）。
works.idea_en: The same AI can run the scenario and score it; if its ratings track expert judgement, assessment stops being the bottleneck for repeated practice.
works.idea_zh: 同一个 AI 既能运行情境、又能评分；只要其评分与专家判断一致，评估就不再是反复练习的瓶颈。
works.method: Randomised controlled mixed-methods trial (n = 40 + 40) comparing VR with AI-guided dialogue and feedback against 360° video with a standardised patient; Empathic Communication Performance Rating Scale at three time points, rated by AI and by educators, analysed with GEE and ICC, plus focus groups.
works.method_zh: 随机对照混合方法试验（40 + 40），比较含 AI 引导对话与反馈的 VR 和含标准化病人的 360° 视频；在三个时间点用共情沟通表现评定量表评估，由 AI 与教师分别评分，采用广义估计方程与组内相关系数分析，并辅以焦点小组访谈。
works.specs: N=80 (40 + 40) · d=0.96 post, d=0.60 follow-up · AI–educator ICC=0.81

paper.title: AI-enhanced virtual reality simulation for nursing students' empathy: Automated scoring and inter-rater reliability in a randomised controlled study

works.title_zh: AI 增强的 VR 模拟提升护生共情：自动评分与评分者一致性的随机对照研究

works.title: Total War: PHARAOH AI advisor (NVIDIA ACE demo)
works.description: A CES 2026 tech demo that adds a talking advisor to Creative Assembly's strategy game Total War: PHARAOH: players ask about the game's systems and their current campaign, and the advisor answers in voice.
works.description_zh: CES 2026 上的技术演示：为 Creative Assembly 的策略游戏《全面战争：法老》加入一位会说话的顾问；玩家询问游戏系统和当前战局，顾问用语音回答。
works.idea_en: An NPC whose job is to coach the player inside the game, a pattern that maps directly onto tutors in training simulations.
works.idea_zh: 一个在游戏内辅导玩家的 NPC，这一模式可以直接迁移到训练模拟中的导师角色。
works.method: NVIDIA ACE runs speech recognition, a small language model grounded in game data and current game state, and speech synthesis on the local RTX GPU.
works.method_zh: 英伟达 ACE 在本地 RTX GPU 上运行语音识别、基于游戏数据与当前游戏状态的小语言模型，以及语音合成。
works.title_zh: 《全面战争：法老》AI 顾问（NVIDIA ACE 演示）

works.title: NitroGen
works.description: An open vision-action foundation model for gaming agents, trained on 40,000 hours of public gameplay videos from more than 1,000 games, that plays 3D action games, 2D platformers and procedurally generated worlds from raw frames.
works.description_zh: 一个开放的游戏智能体视觉-动作基础模型，在 1,000 多款游戏、共 4 万小时的公开游戏视频上训练，能直接从画面游玩三维动作游戏、二维平台跳跃游戏和程序生成的世界。
works.idea_en: Internet gameplay video becomes training data for agents, the same way it is for video world models.
works.idea_zh: 互联网游戏视频成为智能体的训练数据，正如它是视频世界模型的训练数据一样。
works.method: Player actions are extracted automatically from on-screen controller overlays in gameplay videos, and a unified vision-action model is trained by large-scale behavior cloning; NVIDIA reports up to 52% relative improvement on unseen games over training from scratch.
works.method_zh: 从游戏视频画面中的手柄输入叠加层自动提取玩家动作，再以大规模行为克隆训练统一的视觉-动作模型；英伟达报告其在未见过的游戏上比从零训练最多提升 52%（相对值）。

paper.title: NitroGen: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Gaming Agents

works.title: Avatar Forcing
works.description: Avatar Forcing animates a head avatar that reacts in real time to the user's voice and visible behaviour (speech, nods, laughter) as well as its own speech, with about 500 ms latency on one GPU.
works.description_zh: Avatar Forcing 驱动的头部虚拟人能实时回应用户的声音和可见行为（说话、点头、笑声）以及它自己的语音，在单个 GPU 上延迟约 500 ms。
works.idea_en: Conditioning on the user's motion, not only audio, lets a portrait avatar react to what a participant does without speaking.
works.idea_zh: 以用户的动作（而不只是音频）为条件，让人像虚拟人能对参与者不说话时的行为作出反应。
works.method: Diffusion forcing over motion latents with causal, real-time multimodal conditioning on user audio and motion, plus preference optimization that uses samples with user conditions dropped as negatives.
works.method_zh: 在动作隐空间上做 diffusion forcing，以因果方式实时接收用户音频与动作等多模态条件；并用去掉用户条件的样本作为负例做偏好优化。
works.specs: ~500 ms latency · single H100 (14 GB) · 6.8× faster than baseline

paper.title: Avatar Forcing: Real-Time Interactive Head Avatar Generation for Natural Conversation

works.title_zh: Avatar Forcing：实时交互头部虚拟人

works.title: NeoVerse
works.description: NeoVerse reconstructs an ordinary monocular video as a moving 4D scene and generates new videos of it along camera paths the original never took, such as bullet-time shots. Code and weights are open (Apache-2.0).
works.description_zh: NeoVerse 能把一段普通单目视频重建为运动的 4D 场景，并沿原视频从未走过的相机路径生成新视频，例如子弹时间镜头。代码与权重以 Apache-2.0 开源。
works.idea_en: Training 4D world models on everyday monocular videos rather than rare multi-view captures widens the range of scenes they can handle.
works.idea_zh: 用日常单目视频而非稀缺的多视角采集数据训练 4D 世界模型，扩大了它能处理的场景范围。
works.method: Pose-free feed-forward 4D reconstruction of the input video is rendered along a new trajectory, and a video diffusion model trained with online simulation of monocular degradation patterns turns these renders into clean novel-trajectory video.
works.method_zh: 先对输入视频进行无需位姿的前馈式 4D 重建并沿新轨迹渲染，再由训练时在线模拟单目退化模式的视频扩散模型把渲染结果变成干净的新轨迹视频。

paper.title: NeoVerse: Enhancing 4D World Model with in-the-wild Monocular Videos

works.title_zh: NeoVerse 基于真实单目视频的 4D 世界模型

works.title: Decart API Platform
works.description: Decart's API streams real-time generative video: Lucy 2.5 edits or restyles a live camera feed (swapping characters, objects or backgrounds) over WebRTC, and the Oasis 3 Preview world model returns camera frames in response to driving actions over gRPC. Billing is per second of active generation, $0.01–0.04 per second at 720p as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 API 提供实时生成视频流：Lucy 2.5 通过 WebRTC 实时编辑或重绘摄像头画面（替换人物、物体或背景），Oasis 3 Preview 世界模型则通过 gRPC 根据驾驶动作返回相机画面。按实际生成时长计费，截至 2026 年 10 月，720p 每秒 0.01–0.04 美元。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation sold by the second makes a live, generatively altered surrounding something a lab can rent rather than train.
works.idea_zh: 按秒出售的实时生成，让“被生成式改写的实时环境”成了实验室可以租用、而不必自己训练的东西。
works.method: WebRTC (Lucy) and gRPC (Oasis) sessions to Decart-hosted autoregressive video models, with JavaScript and Python SDKs; Decart reports serving them on AWS Trainium 3.
works.method_zh: 通过 WebRTC（Lucy）与 gRPC（Oasis）会话连接 Decart 托管的自回归视频模型，提供 JavaScript 与 Python SDK；Decart 称其模型运行在 AWS Trainium 3 上。
works.specs: Lucy 2.5: 720p, $0.02/s ($0.04/s fast mode) · Lucy Restyle 2: $0.01/s · Oasis 3 Preview: $0.02/s

works.title: Gracia
works.description: Gracia captures performers and scenes as 4D Gaussian splat video and streams it to apps on Quest, Pico, Apple Vision Pro, desktop and the browser, where viewers can walk around the recorded moment.
works.description_zh: Gracia 把表演者和场景捕捉为 4D 高斯泼溅视频，并流式传输到 Quest、Pico、Apple Vision Pro、桌面和浏览器上的应用中，观众可以绕着录下的时刻走动。
works.idea_en: One of the first services to put streamed Gaussian video into consumer headsets (first 4DGS streaming in March 2026 and a free Apple Vision Pro app in June 2026, as reported by Radiancefields.com), so it shows where file size and bandwidth limit what can be shown.
works.idea_zh: 最早把流式高斯视频送进消费级头显的服务之一（据 Radiancefields.com 报道，2026 年 3 月首次实现 4DGS 流式传输，6 月推出免费的 Apple Vision Pro 应用），因此也能看出文件大小和带宽在哪里限制了可展示的内容。
works.method: Multi-camera captures are reconstructed into per-frame splat sequences and encoded as keyframes plus motion deltas for streaming (as described by Radiancefields.com); Unity and Unreal plug-ins and WebGPU playback are offered.
works.method_zh: 多相机捕捉被重建为逐帧泼溅序列，并编码为关键帧加运动增量以便流式传输（据 Radiancefields.com 介绍）；提供 Unity、Unreal 插件与 WebGPU 播放。
works.title_zh: Gracia 体积高斯视频

works.title: Immersive Web SDK (IWSDK)
works.description: Meta's open-source framework for WebXR apps built on Three.js: an entity-component runtime with grab interactions, locomotion, spatial audio, physics, scene understanding and HTML-like spatial UI, plus a Spatial Editor. As of October 2026 its site calls it 'AI-native': coding agents can take screenshots, send controller input and inspect the running XR scene to debug it.
works.description_zh: Meta 基于 Three.js 的开源 WebXR 应用框架：实体组件运行时，内置抓取交互、移动、空间音频、物理、场景理解与类 HTML 语法的空间界面，并配有 Spatial Editor。截至 2026 年 10 月，其官网称之为“AI 原生”：编程智能体可以截图、发送手柄输入、检查正在运行的 XR 场景并调试。
works.idea_en: Agent-operable XR scenes mean an LLM can build and test a study environment end to end, not only write the code for it.
works.idea_zh: XR 场景可由智能体直接操作，意味着大语言模型不仅能为研究环境写代码，还能从头到尾搭建并测试它。
works.method: Three.js renderer under an entity-component architecture, with UIKitML for spatial UI and an agent tool interface for scene inspection and simulated input.
works.method_zh: 实体组件架构之下的 Three.js 渲染器，用 UIKitML 编写空间界面，并提供供智能体检查场景、模拟输入的工具接口。
works.title_zh: Immersive Web SDK（沉浸式网页 SDK）

works.title: Uthana
works.description: Web app and API that generate editable skeletal animation from a text prompt or a video and retarget it to a person's own character or to humanoid robots; Text-to-Motion 3.0 (14 July 2026) follows longer prompts about pacing, posture and style, and Uthana runs inside Unity AI since May 2026.
works.description_zh: 可由文字提示或视频生成可编辑骨骼动画的网页应用与 API，并能把动作重定向到用户自己的角色或人形机器人上；Text-to-Motion 3.0（2026 年 7 月 14 日）能理解关于节奏、姿态和风格的长提示，2026 年 5 月起已接入 Unity AI。
works.idea_en: Generated motion delivered the way animators already work (on their own character's rig, inside Unity, Blender or Maya), which is what makes it usable for authoring the characters of a situation.
works.idea_zh: 生成的动作以动画师现有的工作方式交付（直接用在自己角色的骨骼上，可在 Unity、Blender 或 Maya 中使用），这才让它能真正用来为情境中的角色编排动作。
works.method: Proprietary motion models, with separate text-to-motion, video-to-motion, locomotion and retargeting models; Uthana also sells studio-captured motion data, likely its training source, and has not published the architecture.
works.method_zh: 专有动作模型，文生动作、视频转动作、行走运动和重定向分别由不同模型完成；Uthana 同时出售棚内动捕数据，这很可能就是其训练数据来源，架构未公开。

works.title: Echo
works.description: SpAItial's first world model: a single image or short text prompt becomes a metric-scale 3D Gaussian-splat environment that can be explored freely in real time in a web browser.
works.description_zh: SpAItial 的第一个世界模型：把一张图像或一句简短文字变成具有真实尺度的三维高斯泼溅环境，可在网页浏览器中实时自由探索。
works.idea_en: A second company, from the Munich 3D-vision community, now sells persistent splat worlds, so researchers are not tied to a single vendor's format.
works.idea_zh: 又一家来自慕尼黑三维视觉圈的公司开始提供持久的泼溅世界，研究者不必绑定单一厂商的格式。
works.method: SpAItial describes inferring one unified metric-scale scene representation of geometry and appearance from which every frame and depth map is rendered, displayed with 3D Gaussian splatting; the architecture is unpublished.
works.method_zh: SpAItial 称其先推断出统一的、具有真实尺度的几何与外观场景表示，每一帧画面和深度图都由它渲染，再用三维高斯泼溅显示；架构未公开。

works.title: TRELLIS.2
works.description: Successor to TRELLIS: a 4-billion-parameter image-to-3D model built on O-Voxel, a sparse voxel structure that encodes arbitrary topology (open, non-manifold and fully enclosed surfaces) together with PBR material attributes.
works.description_zh: TRELLIS 的后继：40 亿参数的图生三维模型，基于稀疏体素结构 O-Voxel，可同时编码任意拓扑（开放、非流形和完全封闭的表面）与 PBR 材质属性。
works.idea_en: Native handling of thin, open and nested surfaces such as cloth, leaves and interiors removes a common reason generated props look like closed plastic shells.
works.idea_zh: 原生支持布料、树叶、内部结构等薄、开放和嵌套的表面，消除了生成道具常像封闭塑料壳的一个原因。
