works.method: A Sparse Compression VAE over O-Voxels gives a compact latent space; large flow-matching transformers (4B parameters) trained on public 3D datasets generate geometry and materials.
works.method_zh: 基于 O-Voxel 的稀疏压缩 VAE 提供紧凑的潜空间；在公开三维数据集上训练的大型流匹配 Transformer（40 亿参数）生成几何与材质。

paper.title: Native and Compact Structured Latents for 3D Generation

works.title: HY-Motion 1.0
works.description: Tencent's open-weight, billion-parameter text-to-motion model that generates 3D human motion for character animation from natural-language prompts across more than 200 motion categories, released with a Lite version and a Hugging Face demo.
works.description_zh: 腾讯开源权重的十亿参数文生动作模型，可由自然语言提示生成用于角色动画的三维人体动作，覆盖 200 多个动作类别，并发布了 Lite 版本和 Hugging Face 演示。
works.idea_en: Scaling reaches motion generation: much more data and a larger model give markedly better prompt following, narrowing the gap with text-to-video for bodies.
works.idea_zh: 规模化来到了动作生成：更多数据和更大模型显著提升了对提示的遵循，缩小了身体动作与文生视频之间的差距。
works.method: A Diffusion Transformer with flow matching, pretrained on 3,000+ hours of motion, fine-tuned on 400 hours of curated data, then aligned with reinforcement learning from human feedback and reward models.
works.method_zh: 基于流匹配的扩散 Transformer，先在 3000 多小时动作数据上预训练，再用 400 小时精选数据微调，最后用人类反馈与奖励模型做强化学习对齐。

paper.title: HY-Motion 1.0: Scaling Flow Matching Models for Text-To-Motion Generation

works.title_zh: 混元 HY-Motion 1.0

works.title: SoulX-FlashTalk
works.description: SoulX-FlashTalk streams a high-fidelity audio-driven avatar from a 14B model with sub-second start-up and real-time frame rate, for unbounded durations; weights are on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: SoulX-FlashTalk 用一个 14B 模型流式生成高保真的音频驱动虚拟人，启动时间不到一秒，帧率达到实时，时长不受限；权重已发布在 Hugging Face。
works.idea_en: An open real-time avatar from a social-app company, used as a baseline by commercial full-duplex systems in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 一家社交应用公司开源的实时虚拟人，2026 年被商用全双工系统用作对比基线。
works.method: Self-correcting bidirectional distillation that keeps bidirectional attention within chunks, a multi-step retrospective self-correction mechanism, and hybrid sequence parallelism with parallel VAE decoding.
works.method_zh: 自校正双向蒸馏（在片段内保留双向注意力），配合多步回溯自校正机制，以及混合序列并行和并行 VAE 解码。

paper.title: SoulX-FlashTalk: Real-Time Infinite Streaming of Audio-Driven Avatars via Self-Correcting Bidirectional Distillation

works.title: Step inside an AI-generated movie scene
works.description: A browser WebXR proof of concept, recorded on Apple Vision Pro, lets the viewer enter the Dojo from The Matrix, teleport around generated characters in motion and ask questions to an AI agent inside the scene.
works.description_zh: 一个浏览器 WebXR 概念验证（在 Apple Vision Pro 上录制）让观者走进《黑客帝国》的道场，在运动中的生成角色之间瞬移，还能向场景里的 AI 智能体提问。
works.idea_en: Assembles a walkable film scene entirely from off-the-shelf generators, hinting at films that become explorable situations.
works.idea_zh: 完全用现成的生成工具拼出可走进的电影场景，预示电影可以变成可探索的情境。
works.method: Environment generated as a Gaussian splat from source footage with World Labs, characters converted from images to rigged 3D models with Tripo, motion from AI motion capture, and an embedded AI agent answering questions.
works.method_zh: 环境由 World Labs 从原片素材生成高斯泼溅，角色用 Tripo 从图像转换为绑骨三维模型，动作来自 AI 动作捕捉，场景里嵌入一个回答问题的 AI 智能体。
works.title_zh: 走进 AI 生成的电影场景

works.title: StereoPilot
works.description: StereoPilot (HKUST (Guangzhou) with Kuaishou's Kling team, 2025-12) converts monocular video to stereo for both parallel and converged camera setups in a single efficient pass, using generative video priors.
works.description_zh: StereoPilot（港科大（广州）与快手可灵团队，2025 年 12 月）借助生成式视频先验，一次高效推理即可把单目视频转换为平行式或会聚式两种立体格式。
works.idea_en: Fast, format-aware stereo conversion lets a lab deliver generated scenes to different headsets without re-rendering.
works.idea_zh: 快速且区分立体格式的转换，让实验室无需重新渲染就能把生成场景投放到不同头显上。
works.method: Unified feed-forward stereo conversion on a video-generation backbone, trained on a curated dataset covering parallel and converged stereo.
works.method_zh: 基于视频生成主干的统一前馈式立体转换，在涵盖平行与会聚两种立体格式的数据集上训练。

paper.title: StereoPilot: Learning Unified and Efficient Stereo Conversion via Generative Priors

works.title: HY-World 1.5 (WorldPlay)
works.description: An open-source, real-time interactive world model that streams a navigable world from an image or text and keeps its geometry consistent when the user returns to a place; later releases added a lightweight 5B variant, training code and RL post-training (WorldCompass).
works.description_zh: 开源的实时交互世界模型：从一张图像或一段文字流式生成可漫游的世界，用户回到原处时几何结构保持一致；后续版本加入了轻量的 5B 版本、训练代码以及强化学习后训练方法 WorldCompass。
works.idea_en: Combines real-time play with long-term geometric memory in an open model, so persistence can be studied rather than taken on trust.
works.idea_zh: 在开源模型中同时做到实时交互与长期几何记忆，使“持久性”可以被研究，而不只是听厂商宣称。
works.method: An autoregressive video model (8B, built on HunyuanVideo) with dual action representation, reconstituted context memory that re-selects past frames by geometry, and context-forcing distillation for real-time speed.
works.method_zh: 基于 HunyuanVideo 的 8B 自回归视频模型，采用双重动作表示、按几何关系重新挑选历史帧的“重构上下文记忆”，以及用于实时提速的上下文强制蒸馏。

paper.title: WorldPlay: Towards Long-Term Geometric Consistency for Real-Time Interactive World Modeling

works.title_zh: 混元世界 1.5（WorldPlay）

works.title: SS4D
works.description: Native 4D generative model from CUHK and Shanghai AI Laboratory that turns a single monocular video of a moving object into a dynamic 3D object, trained directly on 4D data instead of optimising a 3D or video model for each object. Code and weights are MIT-licensed.
works.description_zh: 香港中文大学与上海人工智能实验室的原生 4D 生成模型：把一段运动物体的单目视频直接转换为动态三维物体；它直接在 4D 数据上训练，而不是针对每个物体去优化三维或视频模型。代码与权重以 MIT 许可证开放。
works.idea_en: A phone video of a moving object becomes a 4D asset viewable from any side in one model pass, instead of hours of per-object optimisation.
works.idea_zh: 手机拍下的运动物体视频，经一次模型推理就能变成可从任意角度观看的 4D 资产，不必再为每个物体花数小时优化。
works.method: Extends a pretrained single-image-to-3D generator with structured spacetime latents: dedicated temporal layers reason across frames, factorised 4D convolutions and temporal downsampling compress long sequences, and training is made robust to occlusion.
works.method_zh: 在预训练的单图生三维生成器上加入结构化时空潜变量：专门的时间层跨帧推理，分解式 4D 卷积与时间下采样压缩长序列，训练策略增强对遮挡的鲁棒性。

paper.title: SS4D: Native 4D Generative Model via Structured Spacetime Latents

works.title_zh: SS4D 基于结构化时空潜变量的原生 4D 生成

works.title: Gemini live speech translation
works.description: Continuous speech-to-speech translation from Gemini's native audio models: with headphones, the Google Translate app (beta from December 2025) renders what people around you say in your language while keeping the speaker's intonation, pacing and pitch, across more than 70 languages and 2,000 language pairs. Google now offers the model to developers as Gemini 3.5 Live Translate in AI Studio.
works.description_zh: Gemini 原生音频模型提供的连续语音到语音翻译：戴上耳机，Google 翻译应用（2025 年 12 月起测试）会把身边人说的话转成你的语言，同时保留说话人的语调、节奏和音高，覆盖 70 多种语言、2000 多个语言对。谷歌现在在 AI Studio 中以 Gemini 3.5 Live Translate 的名称向开发者提供该模型。
works.idea_en: Lets two people without a shared language stay in one spoken exchange, widening who can take part in a voice-driven scenario.
works.idea_zh: 让没有共同语言的两个人也能留在同一场口语交流中，扩大了能参与语音驱动情境的人群。
works.method: Streaming audio-to-audio translation on Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio (December 2025 update) with voice-style preservation and noise filtering; succeeded by Gemini 3.5 Live Translate.
works.method_zh: 基于 Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio（2025 年 12 月更新）的流式音频到音频翻译，保留说话风格并过滤噪声；后续由 Gemini 3.5 Live Translate 接替。
works.title_zh: Gemini 实时语音翻译

works.title: GWM-1
works.description: Runway's first general world model family, released as three post-trained variants: GWM Worlds for explorable environments, GWM Avatars for conversational characters and GWM Robotics for action-conditioned robot video, with a Robotics SDK.
works.description_zh: Runway 的首个通用世界模型系列，以三个后训练变体发布：用于可探索环境的 GWM Worlds、用于对话角色的 GWM Avatars，以及以机器人动作为条件生成视频的 GWM Robotics，并提供机器人 SDK。
works.idea_en: One video backbone serves places, people and robots, which hints at a single model for a whole situation, though the variants are still separate models.
works.idea_zh: 同一个视频骨干同时服务于场景、人物与机器人，预示着用一个模型承载整个情境的可能，尽管各变体目前仍是独立模型。
works.method: An autoregressive model built on Gen-4.5 that generates frame by frame and is conditioned on camera pose, robot commands or audio.
works.method_zh: 基于 Gen-4.5 的自回归模型，逐帧生成，以镜头位姿、机器人指令或音频为条件。

works.title: SHARP
works.description: Apple's open model that converts a single photo into a metric-scale 3D Gaussian representation in under a second on a standard GPU, which then renders photorealistic nearby views in real time.
works.description_zh: Apple 的开源模型：在普通 GPU 上不到一秒就把一张照片转换成具有真实尺度的三维高斯表示，随后可实时渲染出照片级的邻近视角。
works.idea_en: Sub-second, metric splats from one photo make 'step into this picture' cheap enough to do for every stimulus image, though only for small head movements.
works.idea_zh: 一秒之内从一张照片得到带真实尺度的泼溅，让“走进这张照片”便宜到可以对每张刺激图都这样做，不过只适用于小幅度的头部移动。
works.method: A single feed-forward network regresses the parameters of 3D Gaussians from one image with absolute scale; the authors report LPIPS 25–34% and DISTS 21–43% lower than the best prior model with three orders of magnitude less synthesis time.
works.method_zh: 单个前馈网络从一张图像直接回归具有绝对尺度的三维高斯参数；作者报告其 LPIPS 比此前最佳模型低 25–34%，DISTS 低 21–43%，合成时间缩短三个数量级。
works.specs: < 1 s per image on a standard GPU · metric-scale 3DGS · real-time rendering

paper.title: Sharp Monocular View Synthesis in Less Than a Second

works.title: StereoWorld
works.description: StereoWorld (Beijing Jiaotong University with Dzine AI, CVPR 2026) turns a pretrained video generator into a monocular-to-stereo converter: given ordinary video it generates the second eye's view with geometry-aware supervision, trained on more than 11 million Blu-ray side-by-side frames aligned to human interpupillary distance.
works.description_zh: StereoWorld（北京交通大学与 Dzine AI，CVPR 2026）把预训练视频生成模型改造成单目转立体的转换器：输入普通视频，在几何约束监督下生成另一只眼的画面；训练数据是 1100 多万帧按人眼瞳距对齐的蓝光左右格式视频。
works.idea_en: Generated or archival flat footage can be shown in a headset with plausible depth, without a stereo camera rig.
works.idea_zh: 生成的或已有的平面素材无需立体摄影机，也能以可信的深度在头显中播放。
works.method: End-to-end fine-tuning of a video diffusion model conditioned on the monocular input, with geometry-aware regularization and spatio-temporal tiling for high resolution.
works.method_zh: 以单目视频为条件端到端微调视频扩散模型，配合几何感知正则化与时空分块以支持高分辨率。

paper.title: StereoWorld: Geometry-Aware Monocular-to-Stereo Video Generation

works.title_zh: StereoWorld：几何感知的单目转立体视频生成

works.title: D4RT
works.description: D4RT is a single Google DeepMind model that takes an ordinary video and returns its depth, camera path and the 3D position of any pixel at any moment, so moving people and objects are tracked as one consistent 4D scene. It won the CVPR 2026 Best Paper award; as of October 2026 no code or weights are public.
works.description_zh: D4RT 是 Google DeepMind 的一个统一模型：输入一段普通视频，就能给出深度、相机轨迹，以及任意像素在任意时刻的三维位置，把运动中的人和物体作为一个连贯的 4D 场景来追踪。它获得了 CVPR 2026 最佳论文奖；截至 2026 年 10 月，代码和权重仍未公开。
works.idea_en: Turning a filmed situation into a moving 3D record becomes a matter of seconds, which makes captured real events a practical source for replayable 4D scenes rather than a lab-only process.
works.idea_zh: 把拍下的情境变成会动的三维记录只需几秒钟，真实事件因此可以实际地成为可回放 4D 场景的素材，而不再只是实验室里的流程。
works.method: An encoder-decoder transformer compresses the whole video into a global scene representation; a lightweight decoder is queried with a pixel, a source time, a target time and a camera frame to return that point's 3D position, giving depth, tracking and camera estimates from one model.
works.method_zh: 编码器-解码器 Transformer 先把整段视频压缩为全局场景表示；轻量解码器再以“像素、源时刻、目标时刻、相机坐标系”为查询，返回该点的三维位置，由同一个模型同时得到深度、追踪与相机估计。
works.specs: 1-min video in ~5 s on one TPU chip · 18–300× faster than prior state of the art (DeepMind)

paper.title: Efficiently Reconstructing Dynamic Scenes One D4RT at a Time

works.title: Live Avatar
works.description: Live Avatar streams an audio-driven avatar from a 14B diffusion model in real time and for hours (over 10,000 seconds) without identity drift; its demos show live interaction with a voice agent.
works.description_zh: Live Avatar 用一个 14B 扩散模型实时流式生成音频驱动的虚拟人，可连续生成数小时（超过 10000 秒）而身份不漂移；演示展示了与语音智能体的实时互动。
works.idea_en: Shows that frontier-size video models can run as live avatars if the denoising steps are spread across GPUs.
works.idea_zh: 说明只要把去噪步骤分摊到多块 GPU 上，前沿规模的视频模型也能作为实时虚拟人运行。
works.method: Two-stage distillation of a bidirectional model into a causal few-step streamer, long-horizon anti-drift strategies, and Timestep-forcing Pipeline Parallelism (one denoising timestep per GPU).
works.method_zh: 两阶段地把双向模型蒸馏为因果、少步的流式模型，加上长时防漂移策略，以及时间步强制流水线并行（每块 GPU 负责一个去噪时间步）。
works.specs: 14B params · 45 fps · 1.21 s time to first frame on 5× H800 · >10,000 s stable

paper.title: Live Avatar: Streaming Real-time Audio-Driven Avatar Generation with Infinite Length

works.title_zh: Live Avatar：无限时长实时流式虚拟人

works.title: GAIA-3
works.description: The third GAIA world model, built to evaluate driving policies: it re-drives a recorded scene along a changed ego trajectory while other road users, lighting and weather stay as recorded, producing collisions, near-misses and NCAP-style test cases, and can re-render the same scene for a different camera rig.
works.description_zh: 第三代 GAIA 世界模型，用于评估驾驶策略：沿着改变后的自车轨迹重新“驾驶”一段录制场景，其他交通参与者、光照与天气保持原样，从而生成碰撞、险情和 NCAP 式测试案例，还能为不同的相机配置重新渲染同一场景。
works.idea_en: A 'world on rails': change one actor and hold everything else fixed, the logic of a controlled experiment applied to generated scenes.
works.idea_zh: “沿轨道运行的世界”：只改变一个行动者、其余一切保持不变，正是把对照实验的逻辑用在生成场景上。
works.method: A video world model conditioned on real driving sequences and parameterized ego-trajectory changes; consistency is checked against the recorded LiDAR scans, and Wayve reports that policy rankings in its generated tests correlate with on-road results.
works.method_zh: 以真实驾驶序列和参数化的自车轨迹变化为条件的视频世界模型；生成结果与录制的激光雷达扫描对齐以检验一致性，Wayve 称策略在生成测试中的排名与实际道路表现相关。

works.title: Gradium
works.description: A voice-AI company founded in 2025 by Kyutai's Moshi researchers (Neil Zeghidour, Alexandre Défossez, Laurent Mazaré, Olivier Teboul) that sells streaming text-to-speech, speech-to-text, live translation, voice cloning, prompt-based voice design and on-device TTS for voice agents. It launched in December 2025 with a $70M seed, extended to $100M in July 2026, and reports sub-50 ms TTS latency and a catalogue of 1,400 voices (October 2026).
works.description_zh: 一家 2025 年由 Kyutai 的 Moshi 研究者（Neil Zeghidour、Alexandre Défossez、Laurent Mazaré、Olivier Teboul）创立的语音 AI 公司，为语音智能体提供流式语音合成、语音识别、实时翻译、声音克隆、提示式声音设计和端侧语音合成。2025 年 12 月以 7000 万美元种子轮亮相，2026 年 7 月扩展到 1 亿美元，并报告语音合成延迟低于 50 毫秒、声音库达 1400 个（2026 年 10 月）。
works.idea_en: The team behind the first open full-duplex model now sells fast cascade components, which suggests where production voice agents stood in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 做出第一个开源全双工模型的团队，如今出售的是快速的级联组件，这说明了 2026 年生产环境中语音智能体所处的位置。
works.method: Streaming TTS and STT models (likely descended from Kyutai's delayed-streams work) plus prompt-based voice design, which Gradium reports native speakers preferred over five competitors in 72.6% of blind pairwise comparisons.
works.method_zh: 流式语音合成与语音识别模型（很可能源自 Kyutai 的延迟流建模工作），以及提示式声音设计；Gradium 报告在盲听两两比较中，母语者有 72.6% 的情况更偏好其声音而非五家竞品。
works.specs: sub-50 ms TTS latency (developer claim) · 1.4k voices · EN/FR/ES/DE/PT

works.title: Gen-4.5
works.description: Gen-4.5 (2025-12-01) improves motion quality, physical weight and prompt adherence; Runway reported it ranked first on the Artificial Analysis text-to-video benchmark at launch with 1,247 Elo. Image-to-video followed in early 2026.
works.description_zh: Gen-4.5（2025-12-01）提升了动作质量、物体的重量感与提示遵循；Runway 称其发布时以 1247 Elo 位列 Artificial Analysis 文生视频榜首。图生视频功能于 2026 年初推出。
works.idea_en: The physical plausibility of bodies and objects, more than resolution, became the axis frontier models compete on.
works.idea_zh: 前沿模型竞争的重点从分辨率转向身体与物体的物理合理性。
works.method: Runway's next-generation video diffusion model, trained on NVIDIA Hopper and Blackwell GPUs; details not published.
works.method_zh: Runway 新一代视频扩散模型，在 NVIDIA Hopper 与 Blackwell GPU 上训练；细节未公开。
works.specs: #1 Artificial Analysis T2V at launch · 1,247 Elo (Runway claim)

works.title: Kling O1
works.description: Kling O1 (2025-12-01), billed as the first unified video model, handles generation, reference-based creation and video editing (swapping subjects, restyling, changing shots) within one multimodal prompt.
works.description_zh: 可灵 O1（2025-12-01）号称首个统一视频模型，在一个多模态提示中同时完成生成、基于参考的创作和视频编辑（替换主体、改变风格、更换镜头）。
works.idea_en: A single model that both shoots and edits means a scene can be iterated by instruction while the characters stay fixed.
works.idea_zh: 一个模型同时负责“拍摄”和“剪辑”，场景可以按指令迭代，而角色保持不变。
works.method: Multimodal visual-language backbone driving a diffusion video generator, described in the Kling-Omni technical report.
works.method_zh: 多模态视觉-语言主干驱动扩散视频生成器，详见 Kling-Omni 技术报告。

paper.title: Kling-Omni Technical Report

works.title_zh: 可灵 O1

works.title: Life Stories × World Labs
works.description: A true memory collected by Liquid City's AI interviewer is turned into descriptions, then images, and finally an explorable 3D Gaussian-splat world made with World Labs' Marble, such as 'Night Lake'.
works.description_zh: Liquid City 的 AI 采访者收集一段真实回忆，先把它变成文字描述，再变成图像，最后用 World Labs 的 Marble 生成可漫游的三维高斯泼溅世界，例如《Night Lake》。
works.idea_en: A spoken memory becomes a place you can walk into, a route from oral history to an immersive situation.
works.idea_zh: 一段口述回忆变成可以走进去的地方，这是从口述史通往沉浸情境的一条路径。
works.method: Pipeline: AI interview, LLM scene description, image generation, then World Labs Marble image-to-world generation into Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 流程：AI 采访，大语言模型撰写场景描述，图像生成，再用 World Labs Marble 从图像生成高斯泼溅世界。
works.title_zh: 人生故事 × World Labs

works.title: LiveAvatar (Interactive Avatar)
works.description: LiveAvatar is HeyGen's real-time avatar streaming API, the successor to its Interactive Avatar: a half- or full-body 1080p avatar, cloned from an image or two minutes of footage, speaks a voice agent's replies over WebRTC. HeyGen reports under 300 ms median time to first frame and prices from about $0.01 per minute at volume. In June 2026 HeyGen added an Avatar Realtime API for always-on streaming avatars, and on 2026-09-10 it open-sourced (MIT) a reference stack in which OpenAI's full-duplex GPT-Live-1 voice model drives a LiveAvatar.
works.description_zh: LiveAvatar 是 HeyGen 的实时虚拟人流式 API，接替了此前的 Interactive Avatar：一个由图像或两分钟视频克隆而来的半身或全身 1080p 虚拟人，通过 WebRTC 说出语音智能体的回复。HeyGen 称首帧中位时间低于 300 ms，大批量时约每分钟 0.01 美元。2026 年 6 月，HeyGen 推出用于全天候直播虚拟人的 Avatar Realtime API；2026-09-10，又以 MIT 协议开源了一套参考实现，由 OpenAI 的全双工语音模型 GPT-Live-1 驱动 LiveAvatar。
works.idea_en: Real-time avatars became cheap enough to give every voice agent a face, which moves the open question from 'can it render' to 'does it behave'.
works.idea_zh: 实时虚拟人便宜到可以给每个语音智能体配一张脸，问题从“能不能渲染”转向“行为像不像”。
works.method: Avatar-only rendering streamed via LiveKit/WebRTC, driven either by HeyGen's managed ASR-LLM-TTS stack or by the developer's own voice agent.
works.method_zh: 仅负责虚拟人渲染，通过 LiveKit/WebRTC 推流；驱动它的可以是 HeyGen 托管的语音识别-大模型-语音合成流程，也可以是开发者自己的语音智能体。
works.specs: 1080p · <300 ms median time to first frame · unlimited concurrency
works.title_zh: LiveAvatar 实时虚拟人

works.title: PAT3D
works.description: Carnegie Mellon University system, with The University of Hong Kong and HKUST, that turns a text prompt into a 3D scene whose objects rest under gravity without passing through one another, so the scene can be loaded straight into a simulator for editing or robot manipulation. Published at ICLR 2026 with code and data.
works.description_zh: 卡内基梅隆大学与香港大学、香港科技大学合作的系统：把一句文字提示变成三维场景，其中的物体在重力下稳定放置、彼此不穿插，因此场景可以直接载入仿真器做编辑或机器人操作。发表于 ICLR 2026，并公开了代码和数据。
works.idea_en: Generated rooms that obey gravity and contact can be pushed, grasped and rearranged instead of only looked at.
works.idea_zh: 遵守重力与接触的生成房间可以被推、被抓取、被重新布置，而不只是用来看。
works.method: A generated reference image fixes the spatial relations, 3D assets come from vision foundation models, a vision-language model extracts a hierarchical scene tree, and a differentiable rigid-body simulator settles the layout to static equilibrium, with simulation-in-the-loop optimization keeping it consistent with the prompt.
works.method_zh: 先生成一张参考图确定物体间的空间关系，用视觉基础模型生成三维资产，再由视觉语言模型提取层级场景树；可微刚体仿真器让布局在重力下达到静态平衡，仿真在环的优化则保证结果仍符合提示词。

paper.title: PAT3D: Physics-Augmented Text-to-3D Scene Generation

works.title_zh: PAT3D 物理增强的文本生成三维场景

works.title: Teammates
works.description: A playable first-person shooter level in which the player gives spoken orders to two AI squadmates, Pablo and Sofia, and to an in-game assistant, Jaspar, who can highlight enemies, explain lore, change settings or pause the game. It was playtested with a few hundred players.
works.description_zh: 一个可游玩的第一人称射击关卡：玩家用语音向两名 AI 队友 Pablo 与 Sofia，以及游戏内助手 Jaspar 下达指令；Jaspar 能标记敌人、讲解背景故事、调整设置或暂停游戏。该实验曾向数百名玩家开放测试。
works.idea_en: Moves generative NPCs from conversation to coordinated action: natural speech becomes the controller for teammates in a live combat situation.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式 NPC 从“聊天”推进到“协同行动”：在实时战斗情境中，自然语音成为指挥队友的操作方式。
works.method: Built on Ubisoft's Snowdrop engine; speech is transcribed and interpreted together with game-state context by an LLM layer (reported as Google Gemini with internal middleware) that selects squad behaviors and generates voiced replies.
works.method_zh: 基于育碧 Snowdrop 引擎；语音被转写后，与游戏状态上下文一起交给大语言模型层（据报道为 Google Gemini 与内部中间件）理解，由其选择小队行为并生成配音回复。
works.title_zh: Teammates（育碧 AI 队友实验）

works.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5
works.description: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (2025-11-20) is a lightweight 8.3-billion-parameter open model that produces 720p video (1080p with its super-resolution stage) and runs on consumer GPUs.
works.description_zh: HunyuanVideo 1.5（2025-11-20）是 83 亿参数的轻量开源模型，可生成 720p 视频（配合超分辨率阶段可达 1080p），能在消费级显卡上运行。
works.idea_en: The open-model race shifted to quality per parameter; a lab can run it without a cluster.
works.idea_zh: 开源模型的竞争转向“每个参数的质量”；实验室不需要集群就能运行。
works.method: DiT with selective and sliding tile attention (SSTA), glyph-aware bilingual text encoding and a video super-resolution network.
works.method_zh: 采用选择性滑动分块注意力（SSTA）的 DiT，配字形感知的中英文本编码和视频超分辨率网络。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Technical Report

works.title_zh: 混元视频 1.5

works.title: WorldGen
works.description: Meta Reality Labs' research system that turns a single text prompt into a traversable, fully textured 3D world (reported up to about 50 × 50 m) with a navigation mesh, ready to explore or edit in Unity or Unreal Engine. Research only as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Meta Reality Labs 的研究系统：把一句文字变成可行走、完整贴图的三维世界（报道称最大约 50 × 50 米），自带导航网格，可直接在 Unity 或虚幻引擎中探索或编辑。截至 2026 年 10 月仍仅限研究。
works.idea_en: Walkability comes first: the layout and navmesh are planned before appearance, so the world works as a level, not only as a view.
works.idea_zh: 可行走性优先：先规划布局和导航网格，再决定外观，所以这个世界首先是一个“关卡”，而不只是一幅画面。
works.method: LLM-driven layout reasoning and procedural blockout produce a navmesh-aware scene plan, a reference image is generated, image-to-3D reconstruction builds the scene, and object-aware decomposition and per-object enhancement and texturing finish the world.
works.method_zh: 由语言模型推理布局并程序化生成白盒，得到考虑导航网格的场景规划；再生成参考图像，经图生三维重建出场景，最后进行按物体的分解、增强与贴图。
works.specs: scenes up to ~50 × 50 m (reported) · navmesh · Unity / Unreal export

paper.title: WorldGen: From Text to Traversable and Interactive 3D Worlds

works.title: SAM 3D (Objects and Body)
works.description: Meta's pair of open models that lift things in an ordinary photo into 3D: SAM 3D Objects reconstructs the geometry, texture and layout of selected objects even in clutter or under occlusion, and SAM 3D Body recovers a full-body human mesh including hands and feet, promptable with masks or keypoints.
works.description_zh: Meta 的一对开源模型，可把普通照片中的东西“抬升”为三维：SAM 3D Objects 即使在杂乱或遮挡情况下也能重建选中物体的几何、贴图和摆放位置；SAM 3D Body 恢复包括手脚在内的全身人体网格，可用遮罩或关键点进行提示。
works.idea_en: Grounds asset generation in real photographs: any snapshot of a room or a person becomes a source of 3D props and bodies for rebuilding that situation.
works.idea_zh: 把资产生成扎根于真实照片：任何一张房间或人物的快照，都能成为重建该情境所需的三维道具和人体的来源。
works.method: Objects: multi-stage training (synthetic pretraining, then real-world alignment) on data annotated with a human- and model-in-the-loop pipeline; Body: an encoder-decoder over the new Momentum Human Rig (MHR) parametric mesh.
works.method_zh: Objects：在人与模型协同标注的数据上进行多阶段训练（先合成数据预训练，再与真实世界对齐）；Body：基于新的参数化网格 Momentum Human Rig（MHR）的编码器—解码器。
works.specs: ≥5:1 human-preference win rate on real-world objects (Meta)

paper.title: SAM 3D: 3Dfy Anything in Images

works.title_zh: SAM 3D（物体与人体）

works.title: Depth Anything 3
works.description: Depth Anything 3 from ByteDance Seed predicts consistent depth and camera rays from one image or any number of views, and can output a 3D Gaussian scene for novel views.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的 Depth Anything 3 可从一张图像或任意数量的视角预测一致的深度与相机射线，并能输出用于新视角渲染的三维高斯场景。
works.idea_en: Collapses monocular depth, multi-view reconstruction and feed-forward splatting into one open model.
works.idea_zh: 把单目深度、多视角重建和前馈式泼溅合并到一个开源模型中。
works.method: A plain DINOv2 transformer with cross-view attention predicts a depth-ray representation, trained with a teacher-student scheme on synthetic and real data; a Gaussian head is added for rendering.
works.method_zh: 一个普通的 DINOv2 Transformer 加跨视角注意力，预测“深度-射线”表示，在合成与真实数据上以师生方式训练，并附加高斯预测头用于渲染。

paper.title: Depth Anything 3: Recovering the Visual Space from Any Views

works.title: SIMA 2
works.description: A Gemini-based game companion that reasons about goals, talks with the player, follows instructions given as text in several languages, emoji or images, and carries skills into games it has never seen, including 3D worlds generated on the fly by Genie 3.
works.description_zh: 基于 Gemini 的游戏伙伴：能推理目标、与玩家交谈，理解多种语言的文字、表情符号或图像形式的指令，并把技能带到从未见过的游戏中，包括 Genie 3 即时生成的三维世界。
works.idea_en: The first public pairing of a generalist agent with a world model: Genie 3 makes the world, SIMA 2 acts in it and improves there without new human data.
works.idea_zh: 首次公开把通用智能体与世界模型配对：Genie 3 生成世界，SIMA 2 在其中行动，并在不需要新人类数据的情况下自我提升。
works.method: A Gemini foundation model fine-tuned on human gameplay and Gemini-labelled data maps screen frames and instructions to keyboard-mouse actions; in a self-improvement loop Gemini proposes tasks and estimates rewards, and the agent's own trajectories train its next version.
works.method_zh: 在人类游戏数据与 Gemini 标注数据上微调的 Gemini 基础模型，把屏幕画面与指令映射为键鼠动作；在自我提升循环中，由 Gemini 提出任务并估计奖励，智能体自身的轨迹用于训练下一代版本。

paper.title: SIMA 2: A Generalist Embodied Agent for Virtual Worlds

works.title: Lumine
works.description: A vision-language agent that plays Genshin Impact in real time, finishing the five-hour Mondstadt main storyline at roughly human pace, and without fine-tuning completes 100-minute missions in Wuthering Waves and the first chapter of Honkai: Star Rail.
works.description_zh: 一个视觉语言智能体，能实时游玩《原神》，以接近人类的效率完成五小时的蒙德主线剧情；无需微调，还能完成《鸣潮》中 100 分钟的任务以及《崩坏：星穹铁道》第一章。
works.idea_en: Real-time, hours-long play in a commercial open world means an agent can now be a long-lived companion or test player inside 3D worlds.
works.idea_zh: 能在商业开放世界中实时、连续游玩数小时，意味着智能体可以在三维世界里成为长期陪伴者或测试玩家。
works.method: A vision-language model trained on a curriculum of 1,731 hours of human gameplay (action primitives), 200 hours of instruction-following data and 15 hours of reasoning data reads frames at 5 Hz, emits 30 Hz keyboard-mouse action chunks and calls on reasoning only when needed.
works.method_zh: 一个视觉语言模型按课程式训练：1,731 小时人类游戏录像（动作基元）、200 小时指令跟随数据与 15 小时推理数据，以 5 Hz 读取画面，输出 30 Hz 的键鼠动作块，并只在需要时调用推理。

paper.title: Lumine: An Open Recipe for Building Generalist Agents in 3D Open Worlds

works.title: Marble
works.description: World Labs' world-generation product: text, one or more photos, a video or a coarse 3D layout become a persistent 3D world that can be edited, expanded, stitched with others and exported as Gaussian splats, meshes or video. Beta from 2025-09-16, generally available from 2025-11-12; Marble 1.1 and 1.1 Plus (larger worlds) followed in 2026, and the World API opened it to developers on 2026-01-21.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的世界生成产品：文字、一张或多张照片、一段视频或粗略的三维布局，都能变成持久的三维世界，可以编辑、扩展、与其他世界拼接，并导出为高斯泼溅、网格或视频。2025 年 9 月 16 日开放测试，11 月 12 日全面上线；2026 年推出 Marble 1.1 与可生成更大世界的 1.1 Plus，并于 2026 年 1 月 21 日通过 World API 向开发者开放。
works.idea_en: A researcher can author a whole set from a prompt or a few photos and then keep, version and reload exactly the same world for every participant.
works.idea_zh: 研究者可以用一句提示词或几张照片搭出整个场景，之后为每位参与者保存、版本化并重新加载完全相同的世界。
works.method: A proprietary multimodal world model generates a 3D Gaussian-splat world (with optional mesh extraction) from the inputs; a layout editor (Chisel) separates coarse 3D structure from visual style, and worlds render on web, mobile and VR through World Labs' open-source Spark renderer.
works.method_zh: 专有的多模态世界模型根据输入生成三维高斯泼溅世界（可另行提取网格）；布局编辑器 Chisel 把粗略的三维结构与视觉风格分开控制；世界通过 World Labs 开源的 Spark 渲染器在网页、手机和 VR 中显示。
works.specs: text / image / multi-image / video / 3D layout in · Gaussian splats, mesh or video out · Marble 1.1 Plus for larger worlds

works.title: Steam Frame
works.description: Valve's standalone, streaming-first VR headset, announced on 2025-11-12 and sold from September 2026 ($1,059 for 256 GB, $1,299 for 1 TB). It runs SteamOS on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 and streams PC VR wirelessly with eye-tracked foveated streaming; it ships no generative features of its own but brings PC-rendered worlds to a wireless headset.
works.description_zh: Valve 的一体式、以串流为主的 VR 头显，2025-11-12 发布，2026 年 9 月开售（256 GB 版 1,059 美元，1 TB 版 1,299 美元）。它在骁龙 8 Gen 3 上运行 SteamOS，并通过眼动追踪注视点串流无线传输 PC VR 画面；它本身不带生成式功能，但能把 PC 渲染的世界送到无线头显上。
works.idea_en: Wireless PC streaming lets a headset show worlds generated on a desktop GPU, which matters while real-time world models still need workstation or datacenter hardware.
works.idea_zh: 无线 PC 串流让头显可以显示由台式机 GPU 生成的世界；在实时世界模型仍需工作站或数据中心硬件的阶段，这一点很重要。
works.method: Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 with 16 GB LPDDR5X, 2160×2160 LCD per eye, inside-out tracking, eye tracking, and a dedicated wireless adapter for PC streaming.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 8 Gen 3 与 16 GB LPDDR5X 内存，单眼 2160×2160 LCD，由内向外追踪与眼动追踪，并配有专用无线适配器用于 PC 串流。
works.specs: 2160×2160 LCD per eye · 72–144 Hz · Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 · 16 GB · $1,059 / $1,299

works.title: Inworld Unreal AI Runtime
works.description: Inworld's plug-in for Unreal Engine that bundles speech-to-text, LLMs and text-to-speech behind one API key (100+ models from several providers), with a visual graph editor for building pipelines such as speech-to-speech NPC dialogue, NPC and chatbot templates, and built-in logs, traces and cost dashboards.
works.description_zh: Inworld 面向 Unreal Engine 的插件：用一个 API 密钥统一调用语音识别、大语言模型和语音合成（来自多家提供商的 100 多个模型），配有可视化节点图编辑器来搭建语音到语音的 NPC 对话等流水线，并提供 NPC 与聊天机器人模板，以及内置的日志、链路追踪和成本面板。
works.idea_en: The NPC stack becomes a configurable graph with tracing, so one character pipeline can be switched between models and every step logged, the kind of inspection a study needs.
works.idea_zh: NPC 技术栈变成一张可配置、可追踪的流程图：同一个角色流水线可以在不同模型之间切换，每一步都有记录，这正是研究所需要的可检查性。
works.method: Unreal Engine SDK exposing STT, LLM and TTS building blocks through a unified multi-provider API and a node-graph editor, with templates (including Inworld's Character Template) and observability and experimentation tools; a Unity AI Runtime SDK entered early access the same day. It follows Inworld's earlier character engine, which the launch post names as the company's starting point with game developers.
works.method_zh: Unreal Engine SDK，通过统一的多提供商 API 和节点图编辑器提供语音识别、大语言模型与语音合成模块，附带模板（包括 Inworld 的 Character Template）以及可观测性与实验工具；同日推出 Unity AI Runtime SDK 抢先体验版。它承接 Inworld 早期的角色引擎；发布文章称后者是公司服务游戏开发者的起点。
works.specs: 100+ models via one API key · Unreal Engine (Unity in early access)

works.title: Game-TARS
works.description: A generalist game agent that controls any game through native keyboard and mouse input; ByteDance reports about twice the previous best success rate on open-world Minecraft tasks and near novice-human generality in unseen web 3D games.
works.description_zh: 一个通过原生键鼠输入操控任意游戏的通用游戏智能体；字节跳动称其在开放世界 Minecraft 任务上的成功率约为此前最佳模型的两倍，在未见过的网页三维游戏中接近新手玩家的泛化水平。
works.idea_en: One action space for every game lets agent training scale like language-model pretraining.
works.idea_zh: 所有游戏共用一个动作空间，让智能体训练可以像语言模型预训练一样扩展。
works.method: Continual pretraining on more than 500B tokens of multimodal trajectories across OS, web and game domains, with a decaying continual loss against causal confusion and a sparse-thinking strategy that reasons only at key steps.
works.method_zh: 在操作系统、网页与游戏领域超过 5,000 亿 token 的多模态轨迹上持续预训练，用衰减式持续损失缓解因果混淆，并采用只在关键步骤推理的稀疏思考策略。

paper.title: Game-TARS: Pretrained Foundation Models for Scalable Generalist Multimodal Game Agents

works.title: Odyssey-2
works.description: A world model that begins streaming video within seconds of a typed prompt and keeps changing it as the viewer types new instructions, for multi-minute sessions in a web app; it follows Odyssey-1 (May 2025) and was later offered through an API as Odyssey-2 Pro. Odyssey-2 Max (2026-04-21), about three times the size of Odyssey-2 Pro, raised its VBench 2 physics score from 49.67 to 58.52 (developer-reported).
works.description_zh: 一个世界模型：输入提示几秒后便开始流式生成视频，观看者继续输入指令，画面随之改变，单次可持续数分钟，可在网页应用中体验；它是 Odyssey-1（2025 年 5 月）的后继，之后以 Odyssey-2 Pro 的形式开放 API。2026 年 4 月 21 日推出的 Odyssey-2 Max 规模约为 Odyssey-2 Pro 的三倍，VBench 2 物理得分由 49.67 提升到 58.52（开发者自述）。
works.idea_en: Makes video behave like a chat: you steer it by typing, which lowers the bar for authoring, but text is coarse compared with game controls.
works.idea_zh: 让视频像聊天一样运作：边打字边引导画面，降低了创作门槛，但与游戏操控相比，文字指令较为粗略。
works.method: A causal, autoregressive video model that generates each frame from past frames and the current text, producing a new frame every 50 ms.
works.method_zh: 因果自回归视频模型，根据此前的画面与当前文字生成每一帧，每 50 毫秒产出一帧。
works.specs: 20 fps · 50 ms per frame · multi-minute streams (developer-reported)

works.title: Storycaster
works.description: A projection room becomes a story space: a narrator agent guides participants, and by voice they co-create scenes that are projected on the walls with generated imagery, ambient audio and dialogue, while real objects in the room can turn into their story counterparts.
works.description_zh: 投影房间变成故事空间：叙述者智能体引导参与者，参与者用语音共同创作场景，墙面投出生成的图像，并配有生成的环境音与对白；房间里的真实物品也能变成故事中的对应物。
works.idea_en: A generative CAVE keeps people aware of the real room and of each other while the story around them changes.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 CAVE 让人在周围故事不断变化时，仍能感知真实房间与彼此。
works.method: Live camera feeds and cylindrical projection augment the walls; image, audio and dialogue generators, object-level editing of physical items and an LLM narrator respond to voice commands; a study with 13 participants.
works.method_zh: 通过实时摄像头画面与柱面投影增强墙面；图像、音频、对白生成器，对真实物品的物体级编辑，以及大语言模型叙述者共同回应语音指令；对 13 名参与者开展研究。

paper.title: Storycaster: An AI System for Immersive Room-based Storytelling

works.title: LTX-2
works.description: Lightricks' LTX-2 (announced 2025-10-23, weights released afterwards) generates synchronized audio and video at up to 4K and 50 fps; LTX-2.5 followed in August 2026 as a 22B open model with a family of control LoRAs.
works.description_zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-2（2025-10-23 发布，权重随后开放）可生成同步的音频与视频，最高 4K、50 fps；LTX-2.5 于 2026 年 8 月推出，是 220 亿参数的开源模型，配有一系列控制 LoRA。
works.idea_en: Open, version-pinnable audio-video generation at production resolution, with LoRA hooks for custom control.
works.idea_zh: 可锁定版本、达到生产级分辨率的开源音视频生成，并提供用于定制控制的 LoRA 接口。
works.method: Asymmetric dual-stream transformer that generates audio and video jointly through cross-modal attention (per the LTX-2 paper).
works.method_zh: 非对称双流 Transformer，通过跨模态注意力联合生成音频与视频（据 LTX-2 论文）。
works.specs: up to 4K · up to 50 fps · up to 20 s · synchronized audio

paper.title: LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model

works.title: HunyuanWorld-Mirror (WorldMirror)
works.description: WorldMirror is Tencent Hunyuan's open feed-forward reconstructor: from photos or video frames it predicts point clouds, depth, normals, cameras and 3D Gaussians in one pass, and it can take known camera poses, intrinsics or depth as extra prompts. WorldMirror 2.0 (April 2026) ships as the reconstruction stage of HY-World 2.0; the original paper was accepted to ICML 2026.
works.description_zh: WorldMirror 是腾讯混元开源的前馈式重建模型：输入照片或视频帧，一次前向即可预测点云、深度、法线、相机参数与三维高斯，并能把已知的相机位姿、内参或深度作为额外提示输入。WorldMirror 2.0（2026 年 4 月）作为 HY-World 2.0 的重建模块发布；原论文已被 ICML 2026 接收。
works.idea_en: Whatever is already known about a capture (poses from a tracked headset, depth from a phone) can be fed in to make the reconstruction better, instead of being thrown away.
works.idea_zh: 关于一次拍摄已经知道的信息（头显追踪得到的位姿、手机测得的深度）可以直接输入、让重建更准确，而不必丢弃。
works.method: A transformer encodes multi-view images together with optional prior tokens (camera pose, intrinsics, depth) and decodes them with task heads for points, depth, normals, cameras and 3DGS; Tencent reports that adding priors improves every task.
works.method_zh: Transformer 将多视角图像与可选的先验标记（相机位姿、内参、深度）一起编码，再由点云、深度、法线、相机与 3DGS 等任务头解码；腾讯报告称加入先验能提升所有任务的表现。
works.specs: one forward pass · outputs points, depth, normals, cameras, 3DGS · exports to COLMAP

paper.title: WorldMirror: Universal 3D World Reconstruction with Any-Prior Prompting

works.title_zh: 混元 WorldMirror

works.title: Seed3D 1.0
works.description: ByteDance Seed's image-to-3D foundation model aimed at simulation: it produces assets with accurate geometry, aligned textures and PBR materials that can be dropped into physics engines for robot manipulation training, and assembled into complete scenes.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 面向仿真的图生三维基础模型：生成几何准确、贴图对齐并带 PBR 材质的资产，可直接放入物理引擎用于机器人操作训练，也能组装成完整场景。
works.idea_en: Frames generated assets as training environments rather than art: the test is whether an agent can interact with them in a physics simulator.
works.idea_zh: 把生成资产当作训练环境而不是美术素材：检验标准是智能体能否在物理仿真器中与之交互。
works.method: Diffusion-transformer geometry generation followed by multi-view texture and PBR material synthesis; individual objects are assembled into scenes for simulation.
works.method_zh: 先用扩散 Transformer 生成几何，再进行多视角贴图与 PBR 材质合成；单个物体再被组装成用于仿真的场景。

paper.title: Seed3D 1.0: From Images to High-Fidelity Simulation-Ready 3D Assets

works.title: CLiVR: Conversational Learning System in Virtual Reality with AI-Powered Patients
works.description: Meta Quest 3 system in which medical trainees hold spoken conversations with LLM-driven virtual patients; each case is generated from a syndrome-symptom database, and sentiment analysis gives feedback on the trainee's tone. Thirteen medical-school faculty rated it usable and realistic.
works.description_zh: 基于 Meta Quest 3 的系统，医学受训者可与由大语言模型驱动的虚拟病人进行语音对话；每个病例都从“综合征—症状”数据库动态生成，情感分析对受训者的语气给出反馈。13 位医学院教师评价其易用且逼真。
works.idea_en: Sampling cases from a structured database gives LLM patients variety with a handle on what varies, a practical answer to the control problem.
works.idea_zh: 从结构化数据库中抽样病例，让大语言模型病人既有多样性，又能把握“变的是什么”——这是对可控性问题的一个务实回答。
works.method: Unity application combining speech processing, an LLM conditioned on a generated case and 3D avatars; expert user study (n=13) on usability, realism and educational value.
works.method_zh: Unity 应用，结合语音处理、以生成病例为条件的大语言模型与三维化身；以专家用户研究（n=13）评估易用性、真实感与教学价值。

paper.title: CLiVR: Conversational Learning System in Virtual Reality with AI-Powered Patients

works.title_zh: CLiVR：配有 AI 病人的虚拟现实对话式学习系统

works.title: Real-time AI video restyling an XR room
works.description: A room seen in XR is repainted by a live video model, first as a 'modern, Ikea style room', then as an 'industrial loft', with updates synced slowly to avoid dizziness.
works.description_zh: 在 XR 中看到的房间被实时视频模型重绘，先是“现代宜家风格”，再变成“工业风阁楼”；为避免眩晕，画面更新被刻意放慢同步。
works.idea_en: Shows a comfort constraint of restyling live: the generated view must change slowly enough not to fight the wearer's motion.
works.idea_zh: 揭示实时重绘的一条舒适性约束：生成画面的变化必须足够缓慢，才不会与佩戴者的运动冲突。
works.method: Rendered XR views are passed through a real-time video-to-video model and the restyled result is blended back into the scene at a reduced update rate.
works.method_zh: 把渲染出的 XR 画面送入实时视频到视频模型，再以较低的更新频率把重绘结果混合回场景。
works.title_zh: 用实时 AI 视频重绘 XR 房间

works.title: Samsung Galaxy XR
works.description: The first Android XR headset, made by Samsung with Google and Qualcomm and launched on 2025-10-21 at $1,799.99. It ships Gemini as a multimodal assistant that sees what the wearer sees, Media Auto-Spatialization that turns 2D photos and videos into 3D, and immersive Google Maps.
works.description_zh: 首款 Android XR 头显，由三星与 Google、高通合作打造，2025-10-21 上市，售价 1,799.99 美元。它内置能看到佩戴者所见画面的多模态助手 Gemini、把二维照片和视频转成三维的媒体自动空间化功能，以及沉浸式 Google 地图。
works.idea_en: The first mass-market headset whose operating system generates spatial content from flat media by default.
works.idea_zh: 首款由操作系统默认把平面媒体生成为空间内容的大众市场头显。
works.method: Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 with micro-OLED displays, eye and hand tracking, and an external battery pack.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 XR2+ Gen 2，配 micro-OLED 显示屏、眼动与手势追踪，以及外置电池。
works.specs: Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 · micro-OLED, 3,552×3,840 per eye · $1,799.99 · launched 2025-10-21 (US, Korea)

works.title: Embody 3D
works.description: A motion and behavior dataset from Meta's Codec Avatars Lab: 500 person-hours of tracked 3D motion (over 54 million frames) from 439 participants on a multi-camera stage. Beyond prompted motions, hand gestures and locomotion, it records multi-person discussions, conversations in different emotional states, collaborative activities and co-living in an apartment-like space, with hand tracking, body shape, text annotations and a separate audio track per participant.
works.description_zh: Meta Codec Avatars 实验室发布的动作与行为数据集：在多机位采集棚中记录了 439 名参与者共 500 人·小时的三维动作追踪数据（超过 5,400 万帧）。除了指定动作、手势与行走，它还记录了多人讨论、不同情绪状态下的对话、协作活动以及在类公寓空间中的共同生活，并提供手部追踪、体型、文字标注和每位参与者单独的音轨。
works.idea_en: Multi-person, emotional and everyday interaction captured in 3D with per-person audio: the training material virtual humans need to listen and react, not just gesture.
works.idea_zh: 以三维方式记录的多人、带情绪的日常互动，并为每人单独录音：这正是虚拟人学会倾听与回应、而不只是比划手势所需的训练素材。
works.method: Synchronized multi-camera capture with calibration, per-participant body-shape estimation, multi-person 3D pose tracking and microphone beamforming to separate each speaker's audio.
works.method_zh: 多机位同步采集并完成标定，估计每位参与者的体型，进行多人三维姿态追踪，并用麦克风波束成形分离每位说话者的声音。
works.specs: 500 person-hours · 439 participants · 54M+ frames · body + hands + shape · per-person audio · text annotations

paper.title: Embody 3D: A Large-scale Multimodal Motion and Behavior Dataset

works.title_zh: Embody 3D 动作与行为数据集

works.title: FlashWorld
works.description: An open model that produces a 3D Gaussian-splat scene from a single image or a text prompt in about 5–10 seconds on one GPU, with a browser demo for viewing the result.
works.description_zh: 开源模型：在单张 GPU 上约 5–10 秒即可由一张图像或一句文字生成三维高斯泼溅场景，并提供网页演示查看结果。
works.idea_en: When a world takes seconds instead of minutes, scenes can be regenerated between trials or sampled in large numbers for a study.
works.idea_zh: 当生成一个世界只需几秒而不是几分钟，就可以在两次试验之间重新生成场景，或为研究批量采样。
works.method: A multi-view diffusion model built on a video-diffusion prior is pre-trained in two modes (multi-view images and direct 3D Gaussians) and then distilled so that the fast 3D-oriented mode matches the visual quality of the multi-view mode.
works.method_zh: 基于视频扩散先验的多视角扩散模型先在“多视角图像”和“直接输出三维高斯”两种模式下预训练，再通过跨模式蒸馏，让快速的三维输出模式达到多视角模式的画质。
works.specs: 5–10 s per scene on one GPU · authors report 10–100× faster than prior work

paper.title: FlashWorld: High-quality 3D Scene Generation within Seconds

works.title: RTFM
works.description: A 'Real-Time Frame Model' research preview that renders a world generated from a single image as you move through it in the browser, with reflections, gloss and shadows; World Labs reports it runs on one H100 and that the world 'will never be forgotten'.
works.description_zh: “实时帧模型”的研究预览：在浏览器中边走边渲染由单张图像生成的世界，包含反射、光泽与阴影；World Labs 称它只需一张 H100，且世界“永远不会被遗忘”。
works.idea_en: Treats a learned model as a renderer with spatial memory, a route to persistent worlds without building explicit 3D.
works.idea_zh: 把学习得到的模型当作带空间记忆的渲染器，是一条无需构建显式三维也能获得持久世界的路线。
works.method: An end-to-end autoregressive diffusion transformer over frames whose stored frames carry 3D poses; it retrieves nearby frames as context ('context juggling') to keep the world consistent.
works.method_zh: 端到端的逐帧自回归扩散 Transformer，存储的每一帧都带有三维位姿；通过调取附近帧作为上下文（“上下文轮换”）保持世界一致。

works.title: Apple Vision Pro (M5)
works.description: Apple's mixed-reality headset, upgraded on 2025-10-15 with the M5 chip, refresh rates up to 120 Hz and the Dual Knit Band, at $3,499. For generated content it ships visionOS 26 Spatial Scenes (generative depth that makes a 2D photo explorable), Personas for video calls, 180° / 360° and wide-FOV video playback, and Apple Immersive video. visionOS 27, previewed at WWDC on 2026-06-08 for a fall 2026 release, lets users turn panoramas into spatial scenes and use them as Environments.
works.description_zh: Apple 的混合现实头显，2025-10-15 升级为 M5 芯片，刷新率最高 120 Hz，配 Dual Knit 头带，售价 3,499 美元。在生成内容方面，它搭载 visionOS 26 的空间场景（用生成式深度让二维照片可被探索）、用于视频通话的 Persona、180° / 360° 与广角视频播放，以及 Apple Immersive 视频。在 2026-06-08 的 WWDC 上预览、于 2026 年秋季推出的 visionOS 27，可以把全景照片变成空间场景并用作环境（Environments）。
works.idea_en: The highest-fidelity mainstream display for generated scenes and video, with eye and hand tracking built in, at a price that limits lab fleets.
works.idea_zh: 展示生成场景与视频保真度最高的主流设备，内置眼动与手势追踪，但价格限制了实验室的采购数量。
works.method: Dual micro-OLED displays (23 million pixels in total) driven by M5 together with the R1 sensor chip, with eye, hand and room tracking.
works.method_zh: 双 micro-OLED 显示屏（共 2,300 万像素），由 M5 与 R1 传感芯片驱动，支持眼动、手势与空间追踪。
works.specs: M5 + R1 · micro-OLED, 23M pixels total · up to 120 Hz · $3,499 · on sale 2025-10-22

works.title: Krea Realtime 14B
works.description: Krea Realtime 14B (2025-10-15) is an open text-to-video model distilled from Wan 2.1 14B that streams at about 11 fps on one B200 and lets users change prompts or restyle video while it is generating.
works.description_zh: Krea Realtime 14B（2025-10-15）是从 Wan 2.1 14B 蒸馏而来的开源文生视频模型，在单张 B200 上约 11 fps 流式生成，用户可在生成过程中更换提示或重绘画面风格。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation at 14B scale shows interactivity no longer requires a small, low-quality model.
works.idea_zh: 140 亿参数规模的实时生成表明，交互性不再必须以小而粗糙的模型为代价。
works.method: Self Forcing distillation of a bidirectional 14B model into an autoregressive one, with KV-cache recomputation and attention-bias techniques against error accumulation.
works.method_zh: 用 Self Forcing 把 140 亿参数的双向模型蒸馏为自回归模型，并用 KV 缓存重算与注意力偏置抑制误差累积。
works.specs: 14B · ~11 fps on 1 B200 · ~1 s to first frame

works.title: Veo 3.1
works.description: Veo 3.1 (2025-10-15) adds richer native audio and stronger prompt adherence to Veo 3, plus 'ingredients to video' (reference images), first-and-last-frame transitions and scene extension to a minute or more, in Flow and the Gemini API. A cheaper Veo 3.1 Lite entered preview on 2026-03-31; Google is shutting the Veo 3.1 preview endpoints in the Gemini API on 2026-10-22 in favour of gemini-omni-1.1-flash, while the GA veo-3.1-generate-001 on Vertex AI is supported until at least 2026-11-17.
works.description_zh: Veo 3.1（2025-10-15）在 Veo 3 基础上带来更丰富的原生音频和更好的提示遵循，并在 Flow 与 Gemini API 中提供“素材生成视频”（参考图）、首尾帧过渡，以及延展到一分钟以上的场景扩展。更便宜的 Veo 3.1 Lite 于 2026-03-31 进入预览；Google 将于 2026-10-22 关闭 Gemini API 中的 Veo 3.1 预览端点，改由 gemini-omni-1.1-flash 取代，而 Vertex AI 上正式版 veo-3.1-generate-001 至少支持到 2026-11-17。
works.idea_en: Reference images and first/last frames let a researcher hold a character and setting fixed across clips, a first step toward controlled stimulus sets.
works.idea_zh: 参考图和首尾帧让研究者能在多个片段中固定同一角色与场景，是迈向可控刺激材料集的第一步。
works.method: Veo 3 successor with reference conditioning, first/last-frame interpolation and extension that continues each new clip from the final second of the previous one.
works.method_zh: Veo 3 的后继版本，支持参考图条件、首尾帧插值，以及从上一段最后一秒接着生成的片段延展。
works.specs: 8 s per clip · extend to 60 s+ · 720p / 1080p · native audio

works.title: ShapeGen4D
works.description: Snap Research model (with Purdue and KAUST) that generates a textured mesh sequence end to end from a monocular video, capturing non-rigid motion, volume changes and even changes of topology without per-frame optimisation. No code had been released as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Snap Research（与普渡大学、阿卜杜拉国王科技大学合作）的模型：从单目视频端到端生成带纹理的网格序列，能捕捉非刚性运动、体积变化乃至拓扑变化，无需逐帧优化。截至 2026 年 10 月未公开代码。
works.idea_en: Objects that stretch, split or merge can be lifted from video into 4D, the cases where rig-based animation breaks down.
works.idea_zh: 会拉伸、分裂或合并的物体也能从视频提升为 4D，而这些正是骨骼动画应付不了的情形。
works.method: Adapts a large pretrained 3D generator to video with temporal attention over all frames, time-aware point sampling and 4D latent anchoring for consistent geometry and texture, and noise shared across frames for stability.
works.method_zh: 在大型预训练三维生成器上加入覆盖全部帧的时间注意力、时间感知的点采样与 4D 潜变量锚定，以保持几何和纹理一致，并在各帧之间共享噪声以提高稳定性。

paper.title: ShapeGen4D: Towards High Quality 4D Shape Generation from Videos

works.title_zh: ShapeGen4D 从视频生成高质量 4D 形状

works.title: OpenAI Videos API (Sora 2)
works.description: OpenAI's v1/videos endpoint put Sora 2 and Sora 2 Pro behind a public API, so developers could generate, remix, extend and edit clips with synchronized sound. OpenAI removed the Videos API and every Sora 2 snapshot from the API on 2026-09-24, with no replacement.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 的 v1/videos 接口通过公开 API 提供 Sora 2 与 Sora 2 Pro，开发者可以生成、改写、延长和编辑带同步声音的视频片段。OpenAI 已于 2026-09-24 从 API 中下线 Videos API 及全部 Sora 2 快照，没有替代接口。
works.idea_en: A frontier video model you could call and pin by snapshot until the vendor withdrew it: a study built on a hosted generator can lose its stimulus source on a fixed date.
works.idea_zh: 可以通过 API 调用、按快照锁定版本的前沿视频模型，直到厂商将其撤下：依赖托管生成器的研究，可能在某个确定日期失去刺激材料的来源。
works.method: Asynchronous REST jobs (POST /v1/videos) rendered by OpenAI's Sora 2 models (architecture undisclosed; likely diffusion transformers like the first Sora), with character references, extensions, edits and Batch API support added in March 2026.
works.method_zh: 异步 REST 任务（POST /v1/videos），由 OpenAI 的 Sora 2 模型渲染（架构未公开，很可能与第一代 Sora 一样是扩散 Transformer）；2026 年 3 月加入角色参考、视频延长、编辑与 Batch API 支持。
works.specs: sora-2 / sora-2-pro · up to 20 s · 1080p on sora-2-pro ($0.70/s) · launched 2025-10-06 · removed 2026-09-24
works.title_zh: OpenAI 视频 API（Sora 2）

works.title: Decart XR
works.description: On Meta Quest, the wearer speaks a prompt and watches the passthrough view of their own room transformed live by a real-time video model; the app is free on SideQuest and open source.
works.description_zh: 在 Meta Quest 上，佩戴者说出一个提示，就能看到自己房间的透视画面被实时视频模型当场改造；该应用在 SideQuest 上免费提供，并且开源。
works.idea_en: Real-time video-to-video turns any room into a prompt-selected world, but what you see stops matching what you touch.
works.idea_zh: 实时视频到视频模型能把任何房间变成按提示选择的世界，但你看到的东西不再与你摸到的一致。
works.method: Passthrough camera frames from QuestCameraKit are streamed over WebRTC to Decart's real-time video-to-video models and the restyled frames are rendered back into the headset; since July 2026 the app names them Lucy-Restyle-2 (renamed from Mirage, 61 world styles) and Lucy (15 person transformations).
works.method_zh: 通过 QuestCameraKit 获取透视摄像头画面，经 WebRTC 流式发送到 Decart 的实时视频到视频模型，再把重绘后的画面渲染回头显；自 2026 年 7 月起，应用中的模型名为 Lucy-Restyle-2（由 Mirage 更名，61 种世界风格）和 Lucy（15 种人物变换）。

works.title: Self-Forcing++
works.description: Self-Forcing++ (UCLA with ByteDance Seed, 2025-10) extends a few-step autoregressive video model, distilled from a teacher that only makes short clips, to coherent videos of minutes: the authors report up to 4 minutes 15 seconds, more than 50 times the baseline's length, without over-exposure or drift. The repository holds the paper and demos; code was not released as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: Self-Forcing++（加州大学洛杉矶分校与字节跳动 Seed，2025 年 10 月）把从只能生成短片的教师模型蒸馏而来的少步自回归视频模型延伸到数分钟仍保持连贯：作者报告最长 4 分 15 秒，是基线长度的 50 倍以上，且没有过曝或漂移。截至 2026 年 10 月，代码仓库只有论文与演示，尚未发布代码。
works.idea_en: Minute-scale continuity no longer requires minute-long training videos, which matters for scenarios that must unfold over a whole encounter.
works.idea_zh: 分钟级的连贯不再需要分钟级的训练视频，这对必须完整展开一段遭遇的情境很重要。
works.method: The short-horizon teacher corrects segments sampled from the student's own long rollouts (distribution matching on self-generated videos), without recomputing overlapping frames.
works.method_zh: 让短时长教师模型纠正从学生模型自身长序列中采样的片段（在自生成视频上做分布匹配），且无需重复计算重叠帧。
works.specs: up to 4 min 15 s · 20x beyond teacher horizon (reported)

paper.title: Self-Forcing++: Towards Minute-Scale High-Quality Video Generation

works.title_zh: Self-Forcing++：迈向分钟级高质量视频生成

works.title: NeXus Print
works.description: Groups wearing Meta Quest 3 enter one shared XR space and, with simple text prompts and hand gestures, generate 3D objects and environments to build or reimagine a world together.
works.description_zh: 多人戴上 Meta Quest 3 进入同一个 XR 空间，用简单的文字提示和手势生成三维物体与环境，一起搭建或重新想象一个世界。
works.idea_en: A public, festival-scale version of multi-user in-situ generation, framed as a tool for collective brainstorming and rethinking public spaces.
works.idea_zh: 多人现场生成的公众版、节展规模的实践，被定位为集体头脑风暴与重新构想公共空间的工具。
works.method: A shared Quest 3 session links hand-gesture interaction with text-to-3D generation of objects and environments (developed with Dai Nippon Printing).
works.method_zh: 在共享的 Quest 3 会话中，把手势交互与文字生成三维物体和环境结合起来（与大日本印刷合作开发）。
works.title_zh: NeXus Print 共创沙盒

works.title: Ovi
works.description: Character.AI's Ovi (2025-09-30) is an open model that generates five seconds of 720p video together with its audio (speech, effects, music) in one pass, one of the first open-weight answers to Veo 3-style talking clips.
works.description_zh: Character.AI 的 Ovi（2025-09-30）是一个开源模型，可一次生成 5 秒 720p 视频及其音频（语音、音效、音乐），是最早回应 Veo 3 式“会说话片段”的开源权重模型之一。
works.idea_en: Open joint audio-video generation lets labs study lip-synced speech stimuli without a closed API.
works.idea_zh: 开源的音视频联合生成，让实验室无需闭源 API 就能研究口型同步的语音刺激。
works.method: Twin-backbone design: identical audio and video diffusion transformers (the video branch initialized from Wan 2.2) fused block by block with bidirectional cross-attention.
works.method_zh: 双主干设计：结构相同的音频与视频扩散 Transformer（视频分支由 Wan 2.2 初始化），逐块通过双向交叉注意力融合。

paper.title: Ovi: Twin Backbone Cross-Modal Fusion for Audio-Video Generation

works.title: Sora 2
works.description: OpenAI's second video model, launched on 2025-09-30 with a social iOS app; it generates clips with synchronized dialogue and sound effects and can insert 'cameos' of verified users. The app closed on 2026-04-26 and the API on 2026-09-24.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 的第二代视频模型，2025-09-30 随一款社交 iOS 应用发布，可生成带同步对白和音效的片段，并能插入经过验证用户的“客串”（cameo）形象。该应用于 2026-04-26 关闭，API 于 2026-09-24 停止。
works.idea_en: Consented likeness insertion turned a video model into a social medium; its withdrawal within months is a warning for any study that needs a stable model version.
works.idea_zh: 经授权的肖像插入把视频模型变成了社交媒介；而它在数月内下线，也提醒需要稳定模型版本的研究注意风险。
works.method: Joint video-and-audio generation; OpenAI reports better physical plausibility (a missed shot rebounds instead of teleporting into the hoop) and multi-shot instruction following; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 音视频联合生成；OpenAI 称物理合理性有所提升（投篮不中会反弹，而不是瞬移进篮筐），并能遵循多镜头指令；架构未公开。

works.title: Dreamer 4
works.description: An agent that learns to obtain diamonds in Minecraft purely from offline video, by practising inside a learned world model that also runs in real time for human players on a single GPU.
works.description_zh: 一个仅凭离线视频就学会在 Minecraft 中获得钻石的智能体：它在学到的世界模型里练习，而这个世界模型也能在单张 GPU 上实时供人类玩家游玩。
works.idea_en: A world model accurate enough to train agents for long tasks, which is the same property needed to trust it as a test bed.
works.idea_zh: 一个精确到足以训练智能体完成长任务的世界模型，而这恰恰也是把它当作可信测试平台所需的特性。
works.method: A causal tokenizer and an efficient transformer dynamics model trained with a 'shortcut forcing' objective; the agent learns by reinforcement learning on imagined rollouts.
works.method_zh: 由因果分词器与高效 Transformer 动力学模型组成，采用“捷径强制”目标训练；智能体在想象推演上通过强化学习进行学习。

paper.title: Training Agents Inside of Scalable World Models

works.title_zh: Dreamer 4：在可扩展世界模型中训练智能体

works.title: Rolling Forcing
works.description: Rolling Forcing (Nanyang Technological University and Tencent ARC Lab, ICLR 2026) streams multi-minute videos in real time on a single GPU while keeping error accumulation low, by denoising a window of frames at staggered noise levels instead of one frame at a time.
works.description_zh: Rolling Forcing（南洋理工大学与腾讯 ARC 实验室，ICLR 2026）在单张 GPU 上实时流式生成数分钟视频且误差累积很小：它对一个窗口内的多帧以递增噪声水平同时去噪，而不是逐帧生成。
works.idea_en: Real-time and long are combined in one open model: a stream can run for minutes at interactive rates before it drifts.
works.idea_zh: 实时与长时长在一个开源模型中兼得：视频流能以交互速率持续数分钟才出现漂移。
works.method: Joint denoising over a rolling window with progressively increasing noise, an attention sink that keeps the first frames' key-value states as a global anchor, and few-step distillation on non-overlapping windows.
works.method_zh: 在滚动窗口内以递增噪声联合去噪，用注意力汇（attention sink）保留起始帧的键值状态作为全局锚点，并在不重叠窗口上做少步蒸馏。

paper.title: Rolling Forcing: Autoregressive Long Video Diffusion in Real Time

works.title_zh: Rolling Forcing：实时自回归长视频扩散

works.title: XR Blocks
works.description: An open-source WebXR framework from Google with plug-and-play modules for user, world, peers, interface, context and agents, so AI + XR prototypes (Gemini assistants, scene understanding) run in Chrome and on Android XR headsets.
works.description_zh: 谷歌开源的 WebXR 框架，提供用户、世界、同伴、界面、上下文与智能体等即插即用模块，让 AI + XR 原型（Gemini 助手、场景理解）可以在 Chrome 和 Android XR 头显上运行。
works.idea_en: Lowers the cost of wiring perception, rendering and generative models together, the step most AI + XR prototypes stall on.
works.idea_zh: 降低把感知、渲染与生成模型连在一起的成本，而这正是大多数 AI + XR 原型卡住的环节。
works.method: A modular architecture built on WebXR, three.js, TensorFlow and Gemini, with templates, samples and demos; the foundation for Vibe Coding XR. Still under active development in October 2026 (v0.23.0, 2026-10-15), with a 3D scene editor and avatars added in v0.19.0.
works.method_zh: 基于 WebXR、three.js、TensorFlow 与 Gemini 的模块化架构，附带模板、示例与演示，也是 Vibe Coding XR 的基础。截至 2026 年 10 月仍在活跃开发（2026-10-15 发布 v0.23.0），v0.19.0 起加入三维场景编辑器与虚拟形象。

paper.title: XR Blocks: Accelerating Human-centered AI + XR Innovation

works.title: LongLive
works.description: LongLive (NVIDIA, MIT, HKUST (Guangzhou) and others, 2025-09) generates video in real time for up to four minutes while the user types new prompts mid-stream, with smooth transitions between them.
works.description_zh: LongLive（NVIDIA、MIT、港科大（广州）等，2025 年 9 月）可实时生成最长 4 分钟的视频，用户能在生成过程中随时输入新提示，画面会平滑过渡。
works.idea_en: A running scene that changes when told to is the core of a directable situation.
works.idea_zh: 一个正在进行、听指令就能改变的场景，是可导演情境的核心。
works.method: Frame-level autoregressive model with KV re-caching on prompt switches, streaming long tuning and short-window attention with a frame sink.
works.method_zh: 帧级自回归模型，切换提示时重建 KV 缓存，采用流式长视频微调和带帧汇聚（frame sink）的短窗口注意力。

paper.title: LongLive: Real-time Interactive Long Video Generation

works.title: Audio2Face-3D
works.description: Audio2Face-3D generates lip sync and facial expression for a rigged 3D character from speech audio in real time, and NVIDIA open-sourced the models, SDK and training framework in September 2025, with plug-ins for Unreal Engine and Maya. Version 2.0 of the Audio2Face-3D microservice (March 2026) adds diffusion-based Multi v3.2 models and optional tongue blendshapes.
works.description_zh: Audio2Face-3D 可根据语音音频实时为绑定好的三维角色生成唇形同步和面部表情；NVIDIA 于 2025 年 9 月开源了模型、SDK 和训练框架，并提供 Unreal Engine 与 Maya 插件。Audio2Face-3D 微服务 2.0 版（2026 年 3 月）新增基于扩散的 Multi v3.2 模型和可选的舌部 blendshape。
works.idea_en: Gives game-engine NPCs and XR agents an open, inspectable speech-to-face layer that can run beside an LLM and TTS.
works.idea_zh: 为游戏引擎 NPC 和 XR 智能体提供开放、可检视的“语音到面部”层，可与大模型和语音合成并行运行。
works.method: Neural networks (regression and diffusion variants) map audio features to facial blendshape or vertex animation plus emotion, part of NVIDIA ACE.
works.method_zh: 神经网络（回归与扩散两种版本）把音频特征映射为面部 blendshape 或顶点动画以及情绪，属于 NVIDIA ACE 的一部分。

paper.title: Audio2Face-3D: Audio-driven Realistic Facial Animation For Digital Avatars

works.title_zh: Audio2Face-3D 语音驱动面部动画

works.title: Rodin Gen-2
works.description: Second-generation Rodin 3D generator from Deemos (Hyper3D), which Deemos says gives four times the mesh quality of Gen-1.5 and builds models recursively from parts ('BANG to Parts'), so a generated object can be split into editable components.
works.description_zh: 影眸科技（Hyper3D）的第二代 Rodin 三维生成模型，官方称网格质量是 Gen-1.5 的四倍，并能按部件递归构建模型（“BANG to Parts”），让生成的物体可拆分为可编辑的组件。
works.idea_en: Part-aware generation turns one blob of geometry into separable pieces such as doors, wheels and limbs that can later be animated or made interactive.
works.idea_zh: 部件感知的生成把一整块几何拆成门、轮子、四肢等可分离的部分，便于之后做动画或交互。
works.method: Proprietary 3D-native diffusion model continuing the CLAY line, combined with BANG (generative exploded dynamics) for part decomposition.
works.method_zh: 延续 CLAY 路线的专有原生三维扩散模型，结合 BANG（生成式爆炸视图动力学）进行部件分解。

works.title: Lyra
works.description: NVIDIA's open model that turns a single image (or a video, for dynamic scenes) into an explicit 3D Gaussian-splat scene in one feed-forward pass, ready for real-time rendering and simulation such as Isaac Sim.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的开源模型：一次前向推理就能把单张图像（或用于动态场景的一段视频）变成显式的三维高斯泼溅场景，可直接实时渲染或放进 Isaac Sim 等仿真环境。
works.idea_en: The 3D knowledge already inside a video model can be read out as a scene, without any multi-view training data.
works.idea_zh: 视频模型内部已有的三维知识可以直接读出为场景，完全不需要多视角训练数据。
works.method: Self-distillation: a 3DGS decoder is added beside the RGB decoder of a camera-controlled video diffusion model (GEN3C on Cosmos) and trained only on the model's own synthetic outputs to match the decoded video.
works.method_zh: 自蒸馏：在可控镜头的视频扩散模型（基于 Cosmos 的 GEN3C）的 RGB 解码器旁增加一个 3DGS 解码器，只用模型自己合成的数据训练，使其渲染结果与解码视频一致。

paper.title: Lyra: Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction via Video Diffusion Model Self-Distillation

works.title: Qwen3-Omni
works.description: An open-weight, natively omni-modal model that takes text, images, audio and video and answers in streaming text and natural speech. Alibaba reports open-source state of the art on 32 of 36 audio and audio-visual benchmarks, with 119 text languages, 19 speech-input and 10 speech-output languages.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重、原生全模态的模型，接收文本、图像、音频和视频，并以流式文本和自然语音回答。阿里巴巴报告它在 36 项音频与视听基准中的 32 项上达到开源最佳，支持 119 种文本语言、19 种语音输入语言和 10 种语音输出语言。
works.idea_en: An open model a lab can host that hears and watches the participant and replies in speech: a self-hosted alternative to closed realtime APIs.
works.idea_zh: 一个实验室可以自行部署的开源模型，能听、能看参与者并用语音回应，是闭源实时 API 的自托管替代方案。
works.method: Mixture-of-experts Thinker-Talker design (30B total, 3B active) with an AuT audio encoder and a multi-codebook Talker for streaming speech.
works.method_zh: 混合专家的 Thinker–Talker 架构（总参数 30B，激活 3B），采用 AuT 音频编码器，并用多码本 Talker 流式生成语音。
works.specs: 30B-A3B MoE · 234 ms theoretical first-packet latency (Qwen) · 119 / 19 / 10 languages

paper.title: Qwen3-Omni Technical Report

works.title_zh: 通义千问 Qwen3-Omni

works.title: Ray3
works.description: Ray3 (2025-09-18) is Luma's 'reasoning' video model, which judges and revises its own drafts and can export 16-bit HDR for studio pipelines; Ray3.14 (2026-01-26) moved to native 1080p and Ray3.2 (2026-06-09) added up to 16 keyframes per clip.
works.description_zh: Ray3（2025-09-18）是 Luma 的“推理型”视频模型，会评估并修正自己的草稿，并能导出 16 位 HDR 以接入影视流程；Ray3.14（2026-01-26）改为原生 1080p，Ray3.2（2026-06-09）支持每段最多 16 个关键帧。
works.idea_en: A model that critiques its own drafts hints at generation loops that check a scene against a specification before anyone sees it.
works.idea_zh: 会自我审阅草稿的模型，预示着在呈现之前先按规格检查场景的生成闭环。
works.method: Video diffusion model with a multimodal reasoning stage that plans and evaluates generations, trained for HDR output (per Luma).
works.method_zh: Luma 称其在视频扩散模型之上加入多模态推理阶段来规划与评估生成结果，并针对 HDR 输出进行训练。
works.specs: 16-bit HDR · draft mode · Ray3.2: up to 16 keyframes

works.title: Meta Horizon Hyperscape Capture
works.description: Hyperscape Capture lets a Meta Quest 3 or 3S owner scan a room by looking around it for a few minutes; Meta's servers then build a photoreal Gaussian-splat replica that can be revisited in the headset. Meta added link sharing for up to eight visitors on 20 November 2025, then removed sharing on 12 May 2026; worlds are now view-only in the Capture (Beta) app.
works.description_zh: Hyperscape Capture 让 Meta Quest 3 或 3S 用户戴着头显环顾房间几分钟即可完成扫描，随后 Meta 的服务器构建一个照片级的高斯泼溅复制品，可在头显中重新进入。Meta 于 2025 年 11 月 20 日加入链接分享（每个实例最多 8 人），又在 2026 年 5 月 12 日移除了分享功能；如今世界只能在 Capture（Beta）应用中“仅查看”。
works.idea_en: Capture by the headset itself turns any room into a revisitable VR setting, but the replica is static, processing is on Meta's servers, and the 2026 removal of sharing shows how quickly a beta platform can change under a study.
works.idea_zh: 由头显本身完成捕捉，让任何房间都能变成可重返的 VR 场景；但复制品是静态的，处理在 Meta 服务器上进行，而 2026 年移除分享功能也说明测试版平台可能在研究进行中迅速改变。
works.method: Headset cameras record during a single guided scan session; cloud processing (up to 8 hours per Meta's help page) produces Gaussian splats, now rendered on-device in the Capture app.
works.method_zh: 在一次完成的引导式扫描中由头显相机录制；云端处理（据 Meta 帮助页最长 8 小时）生成高斯泼溅，现由 Capture 应用在设备端渲染。
works.specs: Quest 3 / 3S · scan in minutes · processing up to 8 h (Meta help page)
works.title_zh: Meta Horizon Hyperscape 空间捕捉

works.title: Meta Horizon Studio generative AI tools
works.description: Meta's world-building editor for Horizon lets creators generate meshes, textures, TypeScript, audio and skyboxes from text prompts on top of the new Horizon Engine, with an agentic assistant announced to combine the tools.
works.description_zh: Meta 面向 Horizon 的世界搭建编辑器，让创作者在全新的 Horizon Engine 之上，用文字提示生成网格、纹理、TypeScript、音频和天空盒，并宣布将推出串联这些工具的智能体助手。
works.idea_en: Puts prompt-to-asset and prompt-to-code generation in the main authoring tool of a large social VR platform.
works.idea_zh: 把“提示生成资产”和“提示生成代码”放进一个大型社交 VR 平台的主要创作工具中。
works.method: Text-to-3D, texture, code, audio and skybox generators integrated into the editor, with the Horizon Engine rendering the results; in September 2026 Meta repositioned Horizon Studio as a browser tool for agentic creation of mobile games, in early access.
works.method_zh: 把文生三维、纹理、代码、音频与天空盒生成器集成进编辑器，由 Horizon Engine 渲染结果；2026 年 9 月，Meta 把 Horizon Studio 调整为在浏览器中以智能体方式创作手机游戏的工具，处于抢先体验阶段。
works.title_zh: Meta Horizon Studio 生成式 AI 工具

works.title: Meta Ray-Ban Display
works.description: Meta's first consumer glasses with a built-in display: a monocular full-color in-lens display in Ray-Ban frames, controlled by the Meta Neural Band EMG wristband, for $799. For generated content it shows Meta AI answers with visuals, live captions and translation, and navigation in the wearer's view. At Connect on 2026-09-23 Meta added online ordering, sales in the UK, Canada, France, Italy and Germany, and an early-access, voice-driven photoreal 'Hologram' of the wearer's face for WhatsApp calls.
works.description_zh: Meta 首款内置显示屏的消费级眼镜：Ray-Ban 镜框中带一块单眼全彩镜片内显示，由 Meta Neural Band 肌电腕带操控，售价 799 美元。在生成内容方面，它可以在佩戴者视野中显示带图像的 Meta AI 回答、实时字幕与翻译，以及导航。2026-09-23 的 Connect 大会上，Meta 开放了线上订购，新增英国、加拿大、法国、意大利与德国市场，并推出抢先体验的“Hologram”：在 WhatsApp 通话中用语音驱动佩戴者照片级真实的面部形象。
works.idea_en: A heads-up channel for generated text and images during everyday activity; not an immersive display, but an always-available one.
works.idea_zh: 在日常活动中显示生成文字与图像的抬头通道：它不是沉浸式显示，却随时可用。
works.method: A projector and waveguide in the right lens, camera and microphones on the frame, and surface-EMG decoding of finger gestures at the wrist.
works.method_zh: 右侧镜片内置投影与波导，镜框上有摄像头与麦克风，腕带通过表面肌电解码手指手势。
works.specs: monocular in-lens display, 600×600 px · $799 incl. Neural Band · US launch 2025-09-30

works.title: Wan-Animate
works.description: Wan-Animate (2025-09) animates a character image with the body motion and facial expressions of a driving video, or replaces the person in the video with that character while matching the scene's lighting; weights are open as Wan2.2-Animate-14B. Wan-Animate-2 (open weights 2026-08-07) takes the driving video directly in a redesigned diffusion transformer.
works.description_zh: Wan-Animate（2025 年 9 月）可用驱动视频中的身体动作与面部表情来驱动一张角色图，或把视频中的人替换成该角色并匹配场景光照；权重以 Wan2.2-Animate-14B 开源。Wan-Animate-2（2026-08-07 开源权重）改用重新设计的扩散 Transformer 直接读取驱动视频。
works.idea_en: Open-weight performance transfer: any recorded actor can drive any character on a lab's own GPUs.
works.idea_zh: 开源的表演迁移：任何录下的演员表演，都能在实验室自己的 GPU 上驱动任意角色。
works.method: Built on Wan 2.2, with skeleton signals for body motion, implicit facial features for expression and a relighting LoRA for character replacement.
works.method_zh: 基于 Wan 2.2，用骨架信号控制身体动作，用隐式面部特征控制表情，并用重光照 LoRA 完成角色替换。

paper.title: Wan-Animate: Unified Character Animation and Replacement with Holistic Replication

works.title_zh: 通义万相 Wan-Animate

works.title: A Latency-Optimized LLM-based Multimodal Dialogue System for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR
works.description: Dialogue system that shortens response latency for an LLM-driven embodied guide in a VR museum, who helps visitors explore artworks and artists with spoken replies and gestures.
works.description_zh: 为 VR 博物馆中由大语言模型驱动的具身导览员设计的对话系统，缩短其响应延迟；导览员以语音和手势帮助参观者了解艺术品与艺术家。
works.idea_en: Turn-taking delay is the first thing that breaks plausibility with LLM characters, so engineering for latency is part of the experimental apparatus.
works.idea_zh: 轮流发言的延迟是大语言模型角色最先破坏似真性的地方，因此为延迟做工程优化本身就是实验装置的一部分。
works.method: Multimodal agent pipeline (speech recognition, LLM, speech synthesis, gesture) optimized for end-to-end latency, likely by overlapping stages; a follow-up study on engagement appeared at IEEE AIxVR 2026.
works.method_zh: 针对端到端延迟优化的多模态智能体管线（语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成、手势），很可能通过各环节并行重叠来实现；关于参与度的后续研究发表于 IEEE AIxVR 2026。

paper.title: A Latency-Optimized LLM-based Multimodal Dialogue System for Embodied Conversational Agents in VR

works.title_zh: 面向 VR 具身对话智能体的低延迟大语言模型多模态对话系统

works.title: Hunyuan3D 3.0
works.description: Tencent's closed flagship for production assets, which Tencent says has three times the precision of earlier versions with 1536³ geometric resolution; it powers the Hunyuan 3D engine, launched globally with a Tencent Cloud API on 26 November 2025, and HY 3D Studio, which chains generation, retopology, UVs, texturing, rigging and animation.
works.description_zh: 腾讯面向生产资产的闭源旗舰模型，官方称精度是此前版本的三倍、几何分辨率达 1536³；它驱动混元3D 引擎（2025 年 11 月 26 日面向全球上线并开放腾讯云 API）以及 HY 3D Studio，后者把生成、重拓扑、UV、贴图、绑定和动画串成一条流程。
works.idea_en: Shows the pattern of Chinese labs releasing open weights (2.x) and then a closed flagship (3.x) sold through a cloud API and an end-to-end studio.
works.idea_zh: 体现了中国团队的一种模式：先开源权重（2.x），再推出通过云 API 和一体化工作台销售的闭源旗舰（3.x）。
works.method: Proprietary; Tencent describes a 3.6-billion-voxel high-resolution geometry representation with image, multi-view and sketch conditioning, likely a scaled-up successor of the Hunyuan3D-DiT shape model.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；腾讯称其采用 36 亿体素的高分辨率几何表示，支持图像、多视角和草图条件，很可能是混元3D-DiT 形状模型的放大版后继。
works.title_zh: 混元3D 3.0

works.title: Inceptor: Automated Generation of Social Scenarios in Virtual Reality
works.description: Pipeline that turns written scenario descriptions into social VR episodes with animated virtual characters; for a mental-health resilience training project it produced 32 episodes, more than two hours of content, in a short time, and the authors tested an LLM for choosing character animations.
works.description_zh: 一条把文字情境描述转化为带动画虚拟角色的社会 VR 片段的流水线；在一个心理健康韧性训练项目中，它在短时间内生成了 32 个片段、总时长超过两小时，作者还测试了用大语言模型为角色挑选动画。
works.idea_en: Generating many short social scenes of authored quality is where generation already pays off for training, before any live LLM conversation.
works.idea_zh: 在实时大语言模型对话之前，批量生成接近人工制作水准的简短社会场景，已经让训练受益。
works.method: Automated authoring pipeline from scripts to multi-character VR scenes, used in a deployed resilience-training program; the authors report that it will be released as open source.
works.method_zh: 从脚本到多角色 VR 场景的自动化创作流程，已用于实际部署的韧性训练项目；作者称将以开源形式发布。

paper.title: Inceptor: Automated Generation of Social Scenarios in Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: Inceptor：在虚拟现实中自动生成社会情境

works.title: MapAnything
works.description: MapAnything is a single model from Meta and Carnegie Mellon that turns images, optionally with known intrinsics, poses or depth, into metric-scale 3D geometry and cameras.
works.description_zh: MapAnything 是 Meta 与卡内基梅隆大学推出的单一模型，可将图像（可选地加上已知内参、位姿或深度）转换为公制尺度的三维几何与相机。
works.idea_en: Metric scale and optional sensor inputs make reconstructions measurable, which matters when a captured room is used as an experimental setting.
works.idea_zh: 公制尺度和可选的传感器输入让重建可测量，当捕捉的房间被用作实验场景时这一点很重要。
works.method: A multi-view transformer with a factored scene representation (per-view ray directions, depth along rays, poses and a global metric scale) is trained across many datasets and input configurations.
works.method_zh: 多视角 Transformer 使用因式分解的场景表示（逐视角射线方向、沿射线深度、位姿和全局公制尺度），在多种数据集与输入配置上训练。

paper.title: MapAnything: Universal Feed-Forward Metric 3D Reconstruction

works.title: Stable Audio 2.5
works.description: Stability AI's enterprise model for music and sound design, which Stability says generates tracks of up to three minutes in under two seconds on a GPU and supports audio inpainting. The open Stable Audio Open (2024) and the Stable Audio 3 family (May 2026, small and medium music and SFX models on Hugging Face) give labs downloadable alternatives.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 面向企业的音乐与声音设计模型；Stability 称其能在一块 GPU 上用不到两秒生成最长三分钟的曲目，并支持音频修补。开源的 Stable Audio Open（2024）和 Stable Audio 3 系列（2026 年 5 月，在 Hugging Face 上提供小型与中型的音乐与音效模型）为实验室提供了可下载的替代方案。
works.idea_en: Fast sound design with open siblings makes it a version-pinnable option for reproducible stimulus production.
works.idea_zh: 快速的声音设计加上开源的同系列模型，使其成为可锁定版本、可复现的刺激材料制作方案。
works.method: Latent diffusion Transformer with adversarial relativistic-contrastive (ARC) post-training for few-step sampling, trained on licensed data.
works.method_zh: 潜空间扩散 Transformer，采用对抗式相对-对比（ARC）后训练以实现少步采样，训练数据经过授权。
works.specs: up to 3 min of audio in < 2 s (Stability)

works.title: HunyuanWorld-Voyager
works.description: An open video-diffusion model that, from one image and a user-drawn camera path, generates aligned RGB and depth video, so each step of the walk is also a 3D point cloud that can be reconstructed directly into a scene.
works.description_zh: 开源视频扩散模型：给定一张图像和用户绘制的镜头路径，同时生成对齐的 RGB 与深度视频，因此每一步“行走”同时也是一份可直接重建为场景的三维点云。
works.idea_en: Generating depth with every frame means the world is rebuilt as you go instead of being recovered afterwards by structure-from-motion.
works.idea_zh: 每一帧都同时生成深度，意味着世界边走边建，而不必事后再用运动恢复结构去还原。
works.method: World-consistent video diffusion jointly denoises RGB and depth conditioned on a world cache of earlier points (with point culling), extended autoregressively with smooth video sampling for long-range exploration; trained on a scalable data engine of real and Unreal Engine video with estimated cameras and depth.
works.method_zh: 世界一致的视频扩散模型以先前点云构成的世界缓存（带点剔除）为条件，联合去噪 RGB 与深度，并通过自回归与平滑采样延伸到长距离探索；训练数据来自可扩展的数据引擎，包含估计了相机与深度的真实视频和虚幻引擎视频。
works.specs: RGB-D video along a user camera path · direct point-cloud reconstruction

paper.title: Voyager: Long-Range and World-Consistent Video Diffusion for Explorable 3D Scene Generation

works.title_zh: 混元世界模型 Voyager

works.title: HunyuanVideo-Foley
works.description: Tencent Hunyuan's open text-video-to-audio model that generates high-fidelity foley and ambience matched to the picture. Its demo page compares it side by side with MMAudio, FoleyCrafter and ThinkSound on the same clips.
works.description_zh: 腾讯混元的开源“文本+视频到音频”模型，生成与画面匹配的高保真拟音和环境声。它的演示页在相同片段上与 MMAudio、FoleyCrafter 和 ThinkSound 并排对比。
works.idea_en: Balances what the text asks for with what the video shows, so a sound designer can steer a scene's foley with a prompt.
works.idea_zh: 在文字要求与画面内容之间取得平衡，声音设计师可以用提示来引导一个场景的拟音。
works.method: Multimodal diffusion Transformer with joint audio-video attention and text cross-attention, representation alignment to self-supervised audio features, trained on a large automatically curated dataset.
works.method_zh: 多模态扩散 Transformer，采用音视频联合注意力与文本交叉注意力，并与自监督音频特征做表征对齐，在大规模自动筛选的数据集上训练。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo-Foley: Multimodal Diffusion with Representation Alignment for High-Fidelity Foley Audio Generation

works.title_zh: 混元 HunyuanVideo-Foley 视频拟音

works.title: SpatialGen
works.description: Manycore's open model generates a 3D indoor scene from a semantic room layout plus a text prompt or reference image: it synthesises matching colour, geometry and semantic views from many viewpoints and fuses them into Gaussian splats (3DV 2026).
works.description_zh: 群核科技的开源模型：根据语义房间布局加一句文字或一张参考图生成三维室内场景，从多个视点合成彼此一致的颜色、几何与语义视图，再融合为高斯泼溅（3DV 2026）。
works.idea_en: Fixing the floor plan and furniture boxes while sampling appearance separates what an experimenter controls from what the model varies.
works.idea_zh: 固定平面布局和家具包围盒、只让外观随机变化，把实验者控制的部分和模型变化的部分分开了。
works.method: A multi-view, multi-modal diffusion model conditioned on a 3D layout and a reference image (generated from text if needed) predicts colour images, scene-coordinate maps and semantic maps per view, which are optimised into 3D Gaussians; it is trained on a synthetic dataset of 12,328 annotated scenes with 57,440 rooms and 4.7M renderings.
works.method_zh: 多视角、多模态扩散模型以三维布局和参考图（需要时由文字生成）为条件，逐视角预测颜色图、场景坐标图和语义图，再优化为三维高斯；训练数据为包含 12,328 个标注场景、57,440 个房间和 470 万张渲染图的合成数据集。

paper.title: SpatialGen: Layout-guided 3D Indoor Scene Generation

works.title_zh: SpatialGen：布局引导的三维室内场景生成

works.title: Unity AI tools (Unity AI)
works.description: Unity's AI tooling for its engine: an agentic in-editor assistant that reads the open scene and performs editor actions, an AI gateway, an MCP server and CLI, and official plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Grok. The Unity AI open beta opened to all Unity 6+ developers on 2026-05-04; Unity has since retired the 'Unity AI' brand name, and on 2026-10-07 Unity and Google announced Unity Spark, a no-code, prompt-driven game maker coming to Google's Playground later in 2026 (waitlist only as of October 2026). Unity 7, announced on 2026-07-21 with a free MCP server for coding agents, enters beta in December 2026, with full release planned for Q1 2027.
works.description_zh: Unity 为自家引擎提供的 AI 工具：能读取当前场景并执行编辑器操作的智能体助手、AI 网关、MCP 服务器与命令行工具，以及面向 Claude Code、Codex 和 Grok 的官方插件。Unity AI 公开测试于 2026-05-04 向所有 Unity 6 及以上版本开发者开放；此后 Unity 不再使用“Unity AI”这一品牌名，并于 2026-10-07 与 Google 共同宣布无需写代码、用提示词做游戏的 Unity Spark，将在 2026 年晚些时候接入 Google 的 Playground（截至 2026 年 10 月仅开放候补名单）。2026-07-21 公布的 Unity 7 将为编程智能体提供免费的 MCP 服务器，计划 2026 年 12 月进入测试，2027 年第一季度正式发布。
works.idea_en: When an agent can edit the scene graph directly, a scenario script and its 3D implementation can be revised in the same conversation.
works.idea_zh: 当智能体可以直接修改场景图时，情境脚本与它的三维实现就能在同一段对话中一起修改。
works.method: An LLM agent with Unity-specific tools and project context (scene hierarchy, components, assets) issues Editor commands; external agents connect through MCP via the Unity CLI.
works.method_zh: 一个掌握 Unity 专用工具与项目上下文（场景层级、组件、资源）的大语言模型智能体发出编辑器指令；外部智能体通过 Unity CLI 以 MCP 接入。
