works.specs: Unity 6+ · CLI, MCP server and plugins free · in-editor assistant in Pro / Enterprise / Industry, $10/month for Personal after trial · open beta 2026-05-04
works.title_zh: Unity AI 工具

works.title: Drawings into playable XR worlds
works.description: A child's drawing is fed to the Mirage 2 world model and opens up in front of the viewer on Snap Spectacles as a world they can play in.
works.description_zh: 孩子画的一幅画被输入 Mirage 2 世界模型，在 Snap Spectacles 上于观者眼前展开为一个可以玩的世界。
works.idea_en: An early sign of action-conditioned world models streaming into AR glasses, with a drawing as the only authoring step.
works.idea_zh: 动作条件世界模型流式进入 AR 眼镜的早期信号，唯一的创作步骤只是一幅画。
works.method: Proof of concept: the drawing is sent as the starting image to Dynamics Lab's Mirage 2 interactive world model and the generated frame stream is displayed on Spectacles, with inputs passed back to the model.
works.method_zh: 概念验证：把画作为起始图像发送给 Dynamics Lab 的 Mirage 2 交互式世界模型，在 Spectacles 上显示生成的帧流，并把输入回传给模型。
works.title_zh: 把孩子的画变成可玩的 XR 世界

works.title: gpt-realtime
works.description: OpenAI's production speech-to-speech model for the Realtime API, released with remote MCP tools, image input and SIP phone calling. It follows spoken style instructions such as 'speak quickly and empathetically', switches languages mid-sentence, and adds the voices Cedar and Marin.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 面向 Realtime API 的生产级语音到语音模型，同时推出远程 MCP 工具、图像输入与 SIP 电话呼叫。它能遵循“说快一点、带点同理心”这类语气指令，在一句话中切换语言，并新增 Cedar 与 Marin 两种声音。
works.idea_en: Made instructible, tool-using voice agents an off-the-shelf API: a scenario author can define a phone-call character in a system prompt.
works.idea_zh: 让可被指令控制、会调用工具的语音智能体成为现成 API：情境作者可以在系统提示里定义一个电话中的角色。
works.method: One speech-to-speech model served over WebRTC, WebSocket or SIP; turns are segmented by server or semantic voice-activity detection with barge-in.
works.method_zh: 单一的语音到语音模型，通过 WebRTC、WebSocket 或 SIP 提供；轮次由服务器端或语义语音活动检测切分，支持用户插话打断。
works.specs: Big Bench Audio 82.8% vs 65.6% for the Dec 2024 model (OpenAI)

works.title: Meta Horizon Worlds embodied LLM NPCs
works.description: Creators in the Worlds Desktop Editor define a character's name, backstory, personality, guardrails and voice, and players then talk to the embodied NPC by voice in VR or mobile worlds, with replies mixing scripted lines and LLM-generated speech.
works.description_zh: 创作者在 Worlds Desktop Editor 中设定角色的名字、背景故事、性格、约束规则与声音，玩家随后就能在 VR 或手机世界里用语音与这个有形体的 NPC 交谈，回应由预设台词和大语言模型生成的话语混合而成。
works.idea_en: Puts LLM characters into the standard toolset of a large social VR platform, with scripted lines and guardrails as the creator's levers of control.
works.idea_zh: 把大语言模型角色放进一个大型社交 VR 平台的标准工具箱，预设台词与约束规则成为创作者手中的控制杆。
works.method: Character Builder settings plus TypeScript world-state context condition an LLM (UploadVR reports Llama 4) whose replies are voiced by synthetic TTS; announced with text-to-landscape Environment Generation, and reported open to all creators in September 2025 with conversations limited to adult users in the US.
works.method_zh: Character Builder 的设定与 TypeScript 提供的世界状态上下文共同约束一个大语言模型（据 UploadVR 报道为 Llama 4），回复由合成语音读出；与文本生成地形的 Environment Generation 同时发布，据报道 2025 年 9 月向所有创作者开放，但只有美国成年用户可以与之对话。
works.title_zh: Meta Horizon Worlds 具身大语言模型 NPC

works.title: MIDAS
works.description: MIDAS from Kuaishou's Kling team is a real-time, streaming digital human that takes audio, pose and text as control and generates video autoregressively, demonstrated in duplex two-person conversations and multilingual speech.
works.description_zh: 快手可灵团队的 MIDAS 是一个实时流式数字人，以音频、姿态和文本为控制信号自回归地生成视频，演示了双人双工对话和多语言说话。
works.idea_en: Uses an LLM backbone as the motion planner of a streaming avatar, so new control signals can be added like new tokens.
works.idea_zh: 用大语言模型骨干充当流式虚拟人的动作规划器，新的控制信号可以像新 token 一样加入。
works.method: A lightly modified LLM consumes multimodal condition encodings and guides a diffusion head, with a deep-compression autoencoder (up to 64×) and about 20,000 hours of dialogue video for training.
works.method_zh: 稍加修改的大语言模型接收多模态条件编码并引导扩散头；配合最高 64 倍压缩的深度压缩自编码器，并使用约 2 万小时对话视频训练。
works.specs: ~20,000 h training dialogue · up to 64× latent compression

paper.title: MIDAS: Multimodal Interactive Digital-humAn Synthesis via Real-time Autoregressive Video Generation

works.title_zh: MIDAS：实时自回归多模态交互数字人

works.title: OmniHuman-1.5
works.description: OmniHuman-1.5 generates minute-long videos of one or several characters whose gestures and expressions follow the meaning and emotion of the speech, not only its rhythm, and can be steered with text prompts; it is available through BytePlus and Dreamina.
works.description_zh: OmniHuman-1.5 可生成一个或多个角色、长达一分钟的视频，人物的手势和表情跟随语音的含义和情绪而不只是节奏，并可用文本提示引导；可通过 BytePlus 和即梦使用。
works.idea_en: Adds a 'deliberative' planner so a generated person acts on what is said, a step from lip sync toward behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 加入一个“深思”式规划器，让生成的人根据话语内容行动，这是从唇形同步走向行为的一步。
works.method: A dual-system design: a multimodal LLM reasons over audio, image and text to plan high-level actions, and a multimodal DiT with a pseudo last-frame identity design renders the video.
works.method_zh: 双系统设计：多模态大模型对音频、图像和文本进行推理以规划高层动作，再由带有“伪末帧”身份设计的多模态 DiT 渲染视频。

paper.title: OmniHuman-1.5: Instilling an Active Mind in Avatars via Cognitive Simulation

works.title: Wan-S2V
works.description: Wan-S2V (Alibaba Tongyi Lab, 2025-08-26) turns a still image and an audio track into a film-style video of a character speaking, singing or performing, with full- or half-body motion and camera work rather than only a talking head; the 14B model is open as part of Wan 2.2.
works.description_zh: Wan-S2V（阿里通义实验室，2025-08-26）把一张静态图和一段音频变成影视风格的角色视频：人物说话、唱歌或表演，带有全身或半身动作与运镜，而不只是一个说话的头像；140 亿参数模型作为 Wan 2.2 的一部分开源。
works.idea_en: Audio-driven characters with body language and camera movement move dialogue scenes beyond the talking-head frame.
works.idea_zh: 由音频驱动、带有肢体语言与运镜的角色，让对话场景走出“说话头像”的画框。
works.method: Audio-conditioned extension of the Wan video model with text control of the overall scene, plus long-video and lip-sync editing modes.
works.method_zh: 在 Wan 视频模型上加入音频条件，并用文字控制整体场景，另有长视频与口型同步编辑模式。

paper.title: Wan-S2V: Audio-Driven Cinematic Video Generation

works.title_zh: 通义万相 Wan-S2V

works.title: Mirage 2
works.description: A 'generative world engine' that turned any uploaded image, from a photo to a child's drawing, into a world playable in the browser with WASD keys, and let players change it with text mid-session; the online demo was offline when checked in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 一款“生成式世界引擎”：把任意上传的图像（从照片到儿童画）变成可在浏览器中用 WASD 键游玩的世界，并允许玩家在游玩中用文字修改世界；2026 年 10 月核查时在线演示已下线。
works.idea_en: Showed in 2025 that anyone could step into their own picture, while press tests found loose controls and sudden scene changes.
works.idea_zh: 在 2025 年展示了任何人都能走进自己的图片，但媒体实测发现操控松散、场景时有突变。
works.method: Reported as an autoregressive transformer-based diffusion model streaming frames from image and text prompts with live text edits.
works.method_zh: 据报道是一个基于 Transformer 的自回归扩散模型，根据图像与文字提示流式生成画面，并支持实时文字编辑。
works.specs: > 10 min sessions · ~200 ms latency · single GPU (developer-reported, via press)

works.title: Tripo 3.0
works.description: VAST's third-generation Tripo model with sharper geometry and an Ultra mode, available in Tripo Studio and the Tripo API; Tripo followed it with the H3.1 HD model (May 2026) and the P2.0 character model.
works.description_zh: VAST 的第三代 Tripo 模型，几何更锐利并提供 Ultra 模式，可在 Tripo Studio 和 Tripo API 中使用；之后 Tripo 又推出 H3.1 高清模型（2026 年 5 月）和 P2.0 角色模型。
works.idea_en: One of the main commercial image-to-3D services alongside Meshy, Rodin and Hunyuan3D, and the one most tightly linked to open research releases from the same lab.
works.idea_zh: 与 Meshy、Rodin、混元3D 并列的主要商用图生三维服务之一，也是与同一团队开源研究联系最紧密的一个。
works.method: Proprietary; VAST's published research (the TripoSG rectified-flow shape model) suggests a large rectified-flow transformer over a 3D shape latent, but the 3.0 architecture is unpublished.
works.method_zh: 专有模型；VAST 已发表的研究（TripoSG 整流流形状模型）表明其可能是基于三维形状潜空间的大型整流流 Transformer，但 3.0 的架构未公开。

works.title: InfiniteTalk
works.description: InfiniteTalk dubs or animates a person to new speech over unlimited length, moving lips, head, posture and expression together while keeping identity, from a source video or a single image.
works.description_zh: InfiniteTalk 能为人物配上新的语音并驱动其动作，时长不受限，嘴唇、头部、姿态和表情一起变化并保持身份，输入可以是一段源视频或一张图像。
works.idea_en: Open, long-form audio-driven video that many later real-time systems compare against or build on.
works.idea_zh: 开源的长时音频驱动视频模型，后来许多实时系统都拿它做对比或在其基础上构建。
works.method: Sparse-frame video dubbing on a Wan-based video diffusion model, conditioning on selected reference frames so whole-body motion follows audio across chunks.
works.method_zh: 在基于 Wan 的视频扩散模型上做稀疏帧视频配音，以选定的参考帧为条件，使全身动作在分段之间都跟随音频。

paper.title: InfiniteTalk: Audio-driven Video Generation for Sparse-Frame Video Dubbing

works.title: 4DNeX
works.description: 4DNeX generates a dynamic 3D point-cloud scene from a single image in one feed-forward pass, so a still photo becomes a short moving scene that can be viewed from new angles.
works.description_zh: 4DNeX 只需一次前向，就能从单张图像生成动态三维点云场景，让一张静态照片变成可以从新角度观看的短暂运动场景。
works.idea_en: Image-to-4D without per-scene optimisation, built by repurposing an open video model.
works.idea_zh: 无需逐场景优化的图像到 4D，是通过改造开源视频模型实现的。
works.method: A pretrained video diffusion model is fine-tuned to jointly output RGB and XYZ point-map sequences, trained on a large curated 4D dataset (4DNeX-10M).
works.method_zh: 微调预训练视频扩散模型，使其联合输出 RGB 与 XYZ 点图序列，在大规模精选 4D 数据集（4DNeX-10M）上训练。

paper.title: 4DNeX: Feed-Forward 4D Generative Modeling Made Easy

works.title: Hunyuan-GameCraft
works.description: An open-weight model that turns an image and a text prompt into high-dynamic, game-like video controlled by keyboard and mouse, keeping the scene consistent across long action sequences; paper June 2025, weights August 2025.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重模型，把一张图像和一段文字变成以键盘鼠标操控的高动态游戏画面，并在长动作序列中保持场景一致；论文发布于 2025 年 6 月，权重于 2025 年 8 月开源。
works.idea_en: Brings AAA-game visual quality to action-conditioned video, but each action chunk is generated in turn rather than streamed live.
works.idea_zh: 让以动作为条件的视频达到 3A 游戏级画质，但每段动作是逐段生成的，而不是实时流式输出。
works.method: Built on HunyuanVideo: keyboard and mouse inputs are unified into a continuous camera-action space, with a hybrid history condition for autoregressive extension and distillation for speed; trained on over a million gameplay clips from 100+ AAA games.
works.method_zh: 基于 HunyuanVideo：把键盘鼠标输入统一到连续的镜头动作空间，用混合历史条件实现自回归延展，并通过蒸馏提速；训练数据为来自 100 多款 3A 游戏的逾百万段游戏录像。

paper.title: Hunyuan-GameCraft: High-dynamic Interactive Game Video Generation with Hybrid History Condition

works.title_zh: 混元 GameCraft

works.title: Puppeteer
works.description: Rigs and animates arbitrary 3D models: an autoregressive transformer predicts the skeleton, an attention network predicts skinning weights, and an optimization stage produces stable, high-fidelity animation.
works.description_zh: 为任意三维模型绑定并制作动画：自回归 Transformer 预测骨架，注意力网络预测蒙皮权重，再由优化阶段生成稳定、高保真的动画。
works.idea_en: Closes the step between a static generated model and an animated asset for objects of any category, not only characters with standard skeletons.
works.idea_zh: 补上了从静态生成模型到动画资产之间的一步，而且适用于任何类别的物体，而不只是有标准骨架的角色。
works.method: Joint-based tokenization with hierarchical ordering and stochastic perturbation for skeleton generation, topology-aware joint attention for skinning, and a differentiable optimization-based animation pipeline.
works.method_zh: 骨架生成采用基于关节的分词、层级排序与随机扰动；蒙皮采用感知拓扑的关节注意力；动画由可微的基于优化的流程生成。

paper.title: Puppeteer: Rig and Animate Your 3D Models

works.title: Whispers from the Star
works.description: An interactive science-fiction story in which the player keeps Stella, an astronaut stranded on an alien planet, alive by talking to her through a communicator; there are no dialogue options, and what she does next depends on what the player says.
works.description_zh: 一款互动科幻故事：玩家通过通讯器与困在外星球的宇航员 Stella 交谈，帮助她活下去；没有对话选项，她接下来做什么取决于玩家说了什么。
works.idea_en: A whole commercial game built on one LLM character and open voice conversation, which tests whether a single relationship can carry an experience.
works.idea_zh: 一整款商业游戏建立在单个 LLM 角色与开放语音对话之上，检验一段关系能否撑起完整体验。
works.method: Likely a proprietary LLM pipeline with speech recognition, a persona and story-state model for Stella, synthesized voice and rendered character animation; Anuttacon has not published technical details.
works.method_zh: 很可能是专有的大语言模型管线：语音识别、Stella 的人设与剧情状态模型、合成语音以及渲染的角色动画；Anuttacon 未公开技术细节。

works.title: Immersity
works.description: Immersity is Leia Inc.'s platform for depth-based 3D: its web app converts photos, videos and album art into 3D for social media, advertising or VR, and the same 'Spatial AI' software drives switchable 2D/3D displays that Leia supplies to device makers. Leia unveiled the Immersity platform on 2025-08-13.
works.description_zh: Immersity 是 Leia Inc. 的深度 3D 平台：其网页应用把照片、视频和专辑封面转换为可用于社交媒体、广告或 VR 的 3D 内容，同一套“空间 AI”软件也驱动 Leia 提供给设备厂商的 2D/3D 可切换显示屏。Leia 于 2025-08-13 发布 Immersity 平台。
works.idea_en: Consumer-grade 2D-to-3D conversion means an existing library of flat clips can be shown with depth in a headset study at little cost.
works.idea_zh: 消费级的 2D 转 3D 意味着现有的平面素材库可以低成本地以深度形式用于头显研究。
works.method: Monocular depth estimation and view synthesis on ordinary images and video ('Spatial AI'), output for 3D displays and stereo formats (details not published).
works.method_zh: 对普通图像和视频做单目深度估计与视图合成（“空间 AI”），输出到 3D 显示屏与立体格式（细节未公开）。

works.title: Matrix-3D
works.description: An open framework that turns a text prompt or image into an omnidirectional, explorable 3D world: it first generates a 360° panoramic video along a chosen trajectory, then reconstructs that video into a 3D Gaussian-splat scene.
works.description_zh: 开源框架：把文字或图像变成全方位可探索的三维世界——先沿选定轨迹生成 360° 全景视频，再把视频重建为三维高斯泼溅场景。
works.idea_en: Generating panoramic rather than forward-facing video removes the empty regions behind the viewer that make most single-image worlds feel like stage sets.
works.idea_zh: 生成全景视频而不是正前方视频，消除了观看者身后的空白，让世界不再像单面布景。
works.method: A trajectory-guided panoramic video diffusion model conditioned on scene-mesh renders generates the walk; it is lifted to 3D either by a feed-forward large panorama reconstruction model or by an optimisation pipeline, trained on the synthetic Matrix-Pano dataset.
works.method_zh: 以场景网格渲染为条件、受轨迹引导的全景视频扩散模型生成行走画面，再由前馈式大型全景重建模型或优化流程提升为三维；训练使用合成数据集 Matrix-Pano。

paper.title: Matrix-3D: Omnidirectional Explorable 3D World Generation

works.title: Matrix-Game 2.0
works.description: An open-weight world model that streams minute-long interactive video from a single image, controlled by keyboard and mouse, in Minecraft-like, urban-driving and GTA-style scenes.
works.description_zh: 一个开源权重的世界模型，可从单张图像出发，以键盘鼠标操控，流式生成长达数分钟的交互视频，场景包括类 Minecraft、城市驾驶与 GTA 风格。
works.idea_en: The first widely used open real-time world model: a lab can download it, run it and pin the version.
works.idea_zh: 第一个被广泛使用的开源实时世界模型：实验室可以下载、运行并固定版本。
works.method: A few-step causal diffusion model distilled for autoregressive streaming, trained on about 1,200 hours of Unreal Engine and GTA5 interaction data with action injection modules.
works.method_zh: 经蒸馏的少步因果扩散模型，用于自回归流式生成，配有动作注入模块，训练数据约为 1200 小时的虚幻引擎与 GTA5 交互数据。

paper.title: Matrix-game 2.0: An open-source, real-time, and streaming interactive world model

works.title_zh: Matrix-Game 2.0（昆仑万维）

works.title: Yan
works.description: A framework for interactive video with three parts: Yan-Sim simulates a game world at 1080p and 60 fps from player input, Yan-Gen creates new interactive worlds from text and images, and Yan-Edit lets players change structure and style with text while they play.
works.description_zh: 一个由三部分组成的交互式视频框架：Yan-Sim 根据玩家输入以 1080p、60 fps 模拟游戏世界，Yan-Gen 根据文字和图像生成新的交互世界，Yan-Edit 允许玩家在游玩时用文字修改结构与风格。
works.idea_en: Splits a world into simulation, generation and live editing, a useful decomposition for anyone who needs to change a situation while it runs.
works.idea_zh: 把一个世界拆分为模拟、生成与实时编辑三部分；对需要在运行中修改情境的人来说，这是很有用的拆解方式。
works.method: A highly compressed low-latency 3D-VAE with KV-cache shift-window denoising for real-time simulation, plus a multimodal diffusion generator distilled for streaming and a hybrid model that separates mechanics from visual rendering for editing.
works.method_zh: 采用高压缩、低延迟的 3D-VAE 与基于 KV 缓存的移位窗口去噪实现实时模拟，并配有为流式生成而蒸馏的多模态扩散生成器，以及把机制与画面渲染分离以便编辑的混合模型。

paper.title: Yan: Foundational Interactive Video Generation

works.title_zh: Yan（腾讯）

works.title: Capybara
works.description: Children create 3D characters and accessories with text-to-3D AI, animate them with auto-rigging and their own body movements, and program how the characters react to real objects the camera recognizes.
works.description_zh: 孩子们用文生三维 AI 创造三维角色和配饰，通过自动绑骨和自己的身体动作让它们动起来，再编程设定角色如何回应摄像头识别到的真实物体。
works.idea_en: Positions children as authors of AI-driven AR, not only its audience.
works.idea_zh: 让孩子成为 AI 驱动 AR 的作者，而不只是观众。
works.method: An AR visual-programming environment combines text-to-3D generation, automatic rigging, body tracking and vision-based object recognition as programmable triggers; user studies with 20 children in the United States and Argentina.
works.method_zh: AR 可视化编程环境结合文生三维、自动绑骨、身体追踪和基于视觉的物体识别（作为可编程触发器）；在美国和阿根廷对 20 名儿童开展用户研究。

paper.title: Empowering Children to Create AI-Enabled Augmented Reality Experiences

works.title: S²VG
works.description: S²VG (The University of Hong Kong and Google, 2025-08) turns the output of an off-the-shelf monocular video generator into 3D stereoscopic and spatial video without training or camera poses: it warps the generated video to new viewpoints with estimated depth and inpaints the gaps across views and time.
works.description_zh: S²VG（香港大学与 Google，2025 年 8 月）无需训练、也无需相机位姿，就能把现成单目视频生成模型的输出变成 3D 立体视频与空间视频：它用估计的深度把生成视频扭曲到新视点，再在视角与时间上补全空洞。
works.idea_en: Any text-to-video model becomes a stereo or spatial-video generator for headsets as a post-process.
works.idea_zh: 任何文生视频模型都能通过后处理变成面向头显的立体或空间视频生成器。
works.method: Depth-based warping into a frame matrix of viewpoints and times, followed by training-free inpainting with the video model's denoising applied across both axes.
works.method_zh: 基于深度把画面扭曲成由视点与时间组成的帧矩阵，再在两个维度上用视频模型的去噪过程进行免训练补全。

paper.title: S^2VG: 3D Stereoscopic and Spatial Video Generation via Denoising Frame Matrix

works.title_zh: S²VG：基于去噪帧矩阵的 3D 立体与空间视频生成

works.title: Eleven Music
works.description: ElevenLabs' music model that generates studio-grade songs with or without vocals from a prompt, with section-by-section editing and multilingual lyrics; ElevenLabs says it is cleared for commercial use through licensing deals with music rights holders. Music v2 and Music v2.5 (11 September 2026) followed.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 的音乐模型，可根据提示生成录音室品质、带或不带人声的歌曲，支持按段落编辑和多语言歌词；ElevenLabs 表示，通过与音乐版权方的授权合作，它可用于商业用途。之后推出了 Music v2 和 Music v2.5（2026 年 9 月 11 日）。
works.idea_en: Licensed, editable music generation reduces rights risk for stimuli that will be published with a study.
works.idea_zh: 经授权、可编辑的音乐生成，降低了随研究一同发表的刺激材料的版权风险。
works.method: Text-to-music model with structure-level control over sections, lyrics and style (architecture unpublished).
works.method_zh: 文本到音乐模型，可在结构层面控制段落、歌词与风格（架构未公开）。

works.title: Genie 3
works.description: A general-purpose world model that generates a navigable world from a text prompt and streams it in real time; DeepMind reports 720p at 24 fps with consistency for a few minutes, plus 'promptable world events' that change weather or add objects mid-session.
works.description_zh: 一个通用世界模型：根据文字提示生成可漫游的世界并实时流式输出；DeepMind 称其分辨率为 720p、帧率 24 fps，一致性可维持数分钟，还支持在体验中途改变天气或加入物体的“可提示世界事件”。
works.idea_en: The first real-time general world model: a situation can be described in words and walked into, but it lasts minutes, not hours, and the person controls only one avatar.
works.idea_zh: 第一个实时的通用世界模型：情境可以用文字描述后直接走进去，但只能持续几分钟而非几小时，而且人只能操控一个化身。
works.method: Autoregressive frame-by-frame generation that attends to the trajectory so far, so revisited places stay consistent without an explicit 3D representation; trained on large-scale video.
works.method_zh: 逐帧自回归生成，并关注此前的整条轨迹，使回到原处时场景保持一致，而无需显式三维表示；在大规模视频上训练。
works.specs: 720p · 24 fps · consistent for a few minutes · promptable world events (developer-reported)

works.title: EchoLadder
works.description: A VR designer speaks instructions at any level of vagueness ('make it cosier', 'put a lamp by the sofa') and receives concrete scene changes that can be applied, regenerated or retracted with a toggle.
works.description_zh: VR 设计者可以用任意抽象程度的口头指令（“更温馨一点”“在沙发旁放盏灯”）提出要求，系统给出具体的场景修改，并可一键应用、重做或撤回。
works.idea_en: Breaking generation into reversible, progressive suggestions keeps people steering the scene instead of accepting one AI output.
works.idea_zh: 把生成拆成可逆、渐进的建议，让人持续掌舵场景，而不是被动接受 AI 的一次性结果。
works.method: A large vision-language model reads the current VR scene and the spoken instruction and proposes concrete edits through a progressive design pipeline; an ablation study and a user study against a no-suggestion baseline.
works.method_zh: 大型视觉语言模型读取当前 VR 场景与口头指令，通过渐进式设计流程给出具体编辑建议；做了消融实验，以及与无建议基线对比的用户研究。

paper.title: EchoLadder: Progressive AI-Assisted Design of Immersive VR Scenes

works.title: Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion (GVFDiffusion)
works.description: Turns a single video of a moving object, such as a running character, into an animated 3D Gaussian object that can be viewed from all sides; it can also animate an existing 3D model to follow a video.
works.description_zh: 把一段物体运动的单目视频（例如一个奔跑的角色）变成可从各个方向观看的动画三维高斯物体；也能按照视频为现有三维模型添加动画。
works.idea_en: A native 4D diffusion model: generation happens in a compressed space of 3D Gaussian animations instead of distilling a video model for each object.
works.idea_zh: 原生 4D 扩散模型：生成发生在压缩后的三维高斯动画空间中，而不是为每个物体蒸馏视频模型。
works.method: A 4DMesh-to-GS Variation Field VAE encodes canonical Gaussians and their per-frame variations from animated Objaverse objects into a compact latent, and a temporal diffusion transformer conditioned on the input video and canonical Gaussians generates these latents.
works.method_zh: 4DMesh-to-GS 变化场 VAE 把 Objaverse 动画物体的规范高斯及其逐帧变化编码为紧凑潜变量，再由以输入视频和规范高斯为条件的时序扩散 Transformer 生成这些潜变量。

paper.title: Gaussian Variation Field Diffusion for High-fidelity Video-to-4D Synthesis

works.title_zh: 高斯变化场扩散（GVFDiffusion）视频生成 4D

works.title: VoluMe
works.description: Microsoft Research's VoluMe turns an ordinary single webcam feed into a live 3D Gaussian reconstruction of the person, so a regular video call can be viewed in 3D from slightly different angles.
works.description_zh: 微软研究院的 VoluMe 把普通单路网络摄像头画面实时转换为人物的三维高斯重建，使常规视频通话可以从略有不同的角度以三维方式观看。
works.idea_en: 3D video calls without camera rigs, but with the trade-off that unseen sides are predicted rather than captured.
works.idea_zh: 无需相机阵列的三维视频通话，代价是看不到的一侧是预测出来的，而不是拍到的。
works.method: A network predicts per-frame 3D Gaussians conditioned on the input frame, trained so the reconstruction matches the input view exactly and stays temporally stable.
works.method_zh: 网络以输入帧为条件逐帧预测三维高斯，训练目标是使重建与输入视角完全一致并保持时间稳定。

paper.title: VoluMe -- Authentic 3D Video Calls from Live Gaussian Splat Prediction

works.title: Wan 2.2
works.description: Wan 2.2 (2025-07-28) is the first open mixture-of-experts video model, with cinematic controls for lighting, color and composition and a 5B model that makes 720p video on a single consumer GPU.
works.description_zh: 通义万相 Wan 2.2（2025-07-28）是首个开源的混合专家（MoE）视频模型，提供光照、色彩与构图等电影美学控制，其 50 亿参数版本可在单张消费级显卡上生成 720p 视频。
works.idea_en: Aesthetic parameters (light, lens, composition) become explicit, reproducible knobs in an open model.
works.idea_zh: 光线、镜头、构图等美学参数，在开源模型中变成明确且可复现的旋钮。
works.method: Two-expert MoE diffusion (a high-noise expert for layout, a low-noise expert for detail; 27B total, 14B active) plus a high-compression TI2V-5B model.
works.method_zh: 双专家 MoE 扩散模型（高噪声专家负责布局，低噪声专家负责细节；总参数 270 亿、激活 140 亿），另有高压缩比的 TI2V-5B 模型。
works.title_zh: 通义万相 2.2

works.title: HunyuanWorld 1.0
works.description: Tencent's open-weight world generator: a text prompt or image becomes a 360° panorama that is then decomposed into layered 3D meshes (sky, background, separable objects) for exploration in a browser, headset or game engine. A quantised 'lite' version (August 2025) runs on consumer GPUs such as the RTX 4090.
works.description_zh: 腾讯开源权重的世界生成模型：先把文字或图像变成 360° 全景图，再分解成分层的三维网格（天空、背景、可分离的物体），可在浏览器、头显或游戏引擎中探索。2025 年 8 月推出的量化 lite 版可在 RTX 4090 等消费级显卡上运行。
works.idea_en: Panorama-first generation gives a complete 360° surround in mesh form that ordinary CG pipelines can open, at the cost of limited walking range.
works.idea_zh: 先生成全景的路线一次给出完整的 360° 环绕，并以普通 CG 流程能直接打开的网格形式输出，代价是可行走范围有限。
works.method: Panorama diffusion models (PanoDiT) generate a 360° world proxy, which is segmented into semantic layers, lifted to 3D with depth estimation and inpainting, and exported as layered meshes with disentangled objects.
works.method_zh: 全景扩散模型（PanoDiT）先生成 360° 的世界代理图，再按语义分层，借助深度估计与补全提升为三维，最终导出为物体可分离的分层网格。
works.specs: 360° panorama proxy · layered mesh export · lite version on consumer GPUs

paper.title: HunyuanWorld 1.0: Generating Immersive, Explorable, and Interactive 3D Worlds from Words or Pixels

works.title_zh: 混元3D世界模型 1.0

works.title: Runway Aleph
works.description: Aleph (2025-07-25) is Runway's in-context video editing model: given existing footage it adds or removes objects, changes lighting, weather or season, restyles the clip, or renders a new camera angle of the same scene; Aleph 2.0 followed on 2026-05-21.
works.description_zh: Aleph（2025-07-25）是 Runway 的上下文视频编辑模型：给定已有画面，它能增删物体，改变光照、天气或季节，转换风格，或为同一场景生成新的机位；Aleph 2.0 于 2026-05-21 发布。
works.idea_en: Editing real footage by instruction lets a researcher change one factor (lighting, a prop, the weather) while the rest of a recorded scene stays the same.
works.idea_zh: 按指令编辑真实视频，研究者可以只改变一个因素（光照、道具、天气），而录制场景的其余部分保持不变。
works.method: In-context video model conditioned on the input clip plus text or image instructions; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 以输入视频加文本或图像指令为条件的上下文视频模型；架构未公开。

works.title: Yume
works.description: An open interactive world model that turns a photo into a realistic world explored with the keyboard; its authors describe the July 2025 preview as the first fully open-source real-world world model (data, training and inference code, weights), and Yume 1.5 (December 2025) added text-triggered events and real-time streaming.
works.description_zh: 一个开源交互世界模型，把一张照片变成可用键盘探索的写实世界；作者称 2025 年 7 月的预览版是首个完全开源（数据、训练与推理代码、权重）的真实场景世界模型，2025 年 12 月的 Yume 1.5 又加入了文字触发事件与实时流式生成。
works.idea_en: Starts from real photographs rather than game footage, which is closer to the everyday places behavioral studies often need.
works.idea_zh: 从真实照片而非游戏画面出发，更接近行为研究常常需要的日常场所。
works.method: Camera motions quantized into keyboard actions, a Masked Video Diffusion Transformer with a memory module for autoregressive generation, and in 1.5 unified context compression with linear attention plus distillation for real-time streaming.
works.method_zh: 把镜头运动量化为键盘动作，用带记忆模块的掩码视频扩散 Transformer 自回归生成；1.5 版本加入统一的上下文压缩与线性注意力，并通过蒸馏实现实时流式生成。

paper.title: Yume: An Interactive World Generation Model

works.title: Step-Audio 2
works.description: StepFun's end-to-end audio language model for spoken conversation that picks up emotion and other paralinguistic cues, switches timbre on spoken request and can search the web mid-conversation. StepFun reports state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech, MMAU and URO-Bench; the smaller Step-Audio 2 mini is open-weight.
works.description_zh: 阶跃星辰的端到端音频语言模型，用于口语对话：能捕捉情绪等副语言线索，按口头要求切换音色，并能在对话中联网搜索。阶跃星辰报告其在 LibriSpeech、MMAU 和 URO-Bench 上达到最佳；较小的 Step-Audio 2 mini 开源权重。
works.idea_en: Reads how something is said, not only what is said, which a virtual interlocutor needs to react to a participant's stress or hesitation.
works.idea_zh: 不仅理解说了什么，还能读出是怎么说的，这是虚拟对话者对参与者的紧张或犹豫做出反应的前提。
works.method: Audio encoder plus LLM that generates interleaved text and discrete audio tokens, trained with reasoning-oriented reinforcement learning and retrieval-augmented generation including audio search.
works.method_zh: 音频编码器加大模型，生成交错的文本与离散音频标记；训练中使用面向推理的强化学习，以及包含音频检索的检索增强生成。

paper.title: Step-Audio 2 Technical Report

works.title_zh: 阶跃星辰 Step-Audio 2

works.title: Using Virtual Reality to Examine Officer Decision-Making in Police Co-Response Interactions
works.description: Police officers worked through VR mental-health crisis calls with a clinician co-responder while thinking aloud, revealing how they decide where the clinician stands, what information to share and who takes which role.
works.description_zh: 警察在 VR 中与一名临床医生“协同出警”处理精神健康危机警情，并边做边出声思考，揭示了他们如何决定医生站在哪里、共享哪些信息、谁承担什么角色。
works.idea_en: VR plus think-aloud turns a rare, high-risk encounter into inspectable decision data, an easy base for generated variations of the subject's behavior.
works.idea_zh: VR 加出声思维，把罕见的高风险遭遇转化为可检视的决策数据；在此基础上很容易生成当事人行为的不同变体。
works.method: Qualitative study combining VR simulations, think-aloud protocols and semi-structured interviews with officers and a co-responder.
works.method_zh: 质性研究，结合 VR 模拟、出声思维与对警员及协同出警人员的半结构化访谈。

paper.title: Using Virtual Reality to Examine Officer Decision-Making in Police Co-Response Interactions

works.title_zh: 用虚拟现实考察警察在协同出警互动中的决策

works.title: AutoPartGen
works.description: Model from Meta AI and the University of Oxford's Visual Geometry Group that builds an object, or a whole scene, one 3D part at a time from an image, optional 2D part masks or an existing 3D shape, and decides by itself how many parts there are. Meta released code and gated weights (access on request) on Hugging Face in June 2026.
works.description_zh: Meta AI 与牛津大学视觉几何组（VGG）的模型：根据一张图像、可选的二维部件掩码或已有三维形状，一次生成一个三维部件，逐步搭出物体乃至整个场景，并自行决定部件数量。Meta 于 2026 年 6 月在 Hugging Face 发布了代码和需申请访问的权重。
works.idea_en: Objects arrive already split into the pieces an interaction needs, a lid, a handle, a door, without a separate segmentation step.
works.idea_zh: 物体生成出来时已经拆成交互所需的部件——盖子、把手、门——无需另做分割。
works.method: Autoregressive generation in the 3DShape2VecSet latent space: each part is predicted conditioned on the parts generated so far and on the image, masks or 3D input, until the model decides the object is complete; parts assemble without further optimisation.
works.method_zh: 在 3DShape2VecSet 潜空间中自回归生成：每个部件都以已生成的部件以及图像、掩码或三维输入为条件，直到模型判断物体已完整；各部件无需额外优化即可拼合。
works.specs: weights: facebook/autopartgen on Hugging Face (gated) · published 2026-06-09

paper.title: AutoPartGen: Autogressive 3D Part Generation and Discovery

works.title_zh: AutoPartGen 自回归三维部件生成

works.title: MirageLSD
works.description: Decart's MirageLSD (2025-07-17) transforms any live camera, game or video feed into a prompted style or world in real time (Decart cites under 40 ms latency at 24 fps); it was released as a web demo and mobile apps and later succeeded by Lucy 2.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 MirageLSD（2025-07-17）可按提示把任意实时摄像头、游戏或视频画面实时转换成另一种风格或世界（Decart 称延迟低于 40 毫秒、24 fps）；以网页演示和手机应用形式发布，后由 Lucy 2 接替。
works.idea_en: Live 'reskinning' of the real world is the most direct generative route to mixed-reality situations, as long as the transformation stays stable.
works.idea_zh: 对现实世界实时“换皮”，是通向混合现实情境最直接的生成路径，前提是转换保持稳定。
works.method: Live-Stream Diffusion: a causal, frame-by-frame video diffusion model that uses diffusion forcing and history augmentation to resist error accumulation, with custom GPU kernels.
works.method_zh: 实时流扩散（Live-Stream Diffusion）：逐帧因果视频扩散模型，借助扩散强制与历史增强抵抗误差累积，并使用定制 GPU 内核。
keywords: official clip from archived launch page

works.title: π³ (Pi3)
works.description: π³ is an open feed-forward model from Shanghai AI Lab that turns an unordered set of photos or video frames into camera poses and point maps without treating any frame as the reference, so the result does not depend on input order. It was accepted to ICLR 2026 and is used alongside VGGT as a backbone by later reconstruction methods.
works.description_zh: π³ 是上海人工智能实验室开源的前馈式模型：把一组无序的照片或视频帧转换为相机位姿与点图，而不把任何一帧当作参考帧，因此结果与输入顺序无关。它被 ICLR 2026 接收，并与 VGGT 一起被后续重建方法用作骨干网络。
works.idea_en: Dropping the reference view makes reconstruction of casually gathered, unordered footage (for example many people's phone clips of one place) more stable.
works.idea_zh: 去掉参考视角之后，随手收集、顺序混乱的素材（例如许多人用手机拍下的同一地点）也能更稳定地被重建。
works.method: A fully permutation-equivariant transformer with no reference-frame tokens predicts affine-invariant camera poses and scale-invariant local point maps for every view.
works.method_zh: 完全置换等变的 Transformer，不设参考帧标记，为每个视角预测仿射不变的相机位姿与尺度不变的局部点图。
works.specs: BSD-3 code and weights · ~2.2k GitHub stars (Oct 2026)

paper.title: π³: Permutation-Equivariant Visual Geometry Learning

works.title: Act-Two
works.description: Act-Two (2025-07-15) transfers an actor's recorded performance (face, head, body and hands) onto any character image or video; it succeeds Act-One (2024-10), which animated faces only.
works.description_zh: Act-Two（2025-07-15）可把演员录制的表演（面部、头部、身体与手部）迁移到任意角色图像或视频上，是只驱动面部的 Act-One（2024 年 10 月）的后继。
works.idea_en: A recorded human performance becomes the control signal: behavior is scripted by acting it once and re-cast onto many characters.
works.idea_zh: 人的表演录像成为控制信号：只需演一遍，就能把同一段行为套到许多不同角色身上。
works.method: Performance-driven video generation from a driving video and a character reference; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 以驱动视频与角色参考为输入的表演驱动视频生成；架构未公开。

works.title: Trinity-1
works.description: Trinity-1 is Simli's Gaussian-splat avatar model, launched in preview through its API on 2025-07-10: a face built from one portrait is lip-synced live to the audio of a voice agent and streamed into an app. Simli calls it the first interactive Gaussian avatar and prices it at under one US cent per minute.
works.description_zh: Trinity-1 是 Simli 的高斯泼溅虚拟人模型，2025-07-10 通过 API 以预览形式发布：由一张人像生成的面孔会跟随语音智能体的音频实时对口型，并以视频流推送到应用中。Simli 称它是首个可交互的高斯虚拟人，价格低于每分钟 1 美分。
works.idea_en: Moves the talking face from per-frame video generation to a drivable 3D Gaussian head, so giving every turn of a voice scenario a face costs well under a dollar per hour.
works.idea_zh: 把会说话的面孔从逐帧视频生成换成可驱动的三维高斯头像，让语音情境的每一轮都配上面孔，每小时成本远低于 1 美元。
works.method: A portrait is reframed and converted into a Gaussian-splat face by an offline API job ('Generate Trinity Face'); at run time an audio-to-motion model likely drives the splats from streamed speech, and frames reach the app over WebRTC, directly or through the LiveKit and Pipecat plug-ins.
works.method_zh: 先通过离线 API 任务（“Generate Trinity Face”）把人像重新构图并转换成高斯泼溅面孔；运行时很可能由一个音频到动作的模型根据流式语音驱动这些高斯点，画面通过 WebRTC 直接送达应用，或经由 LiveKit 与 Pipecat 插件接入。

works.title: Marey
works.description: Moonvalley's Marey (public launch July 2025) is trained only on licensed footage and built for filmmakers, with camera, motion and pose controls such as camera-path re-direction and pose transfer.
works.description_zh: Moonvalley 的 Marey（2025 年 7 月公开上线）只用授权素材训练，面向影视创作者，提供镜头路径重设、姿态迁移等镜头与动作控制。
works.idea_en: Licensed-only training data answers the provenance question institutions face before they can use generated footage.
works.idea_zh: 仅用授权数据训练，回应了机构使用生成素材前必须面对的数据来源问题。
works.method: Video diffusion model trained on commercially licensed video and co-developed with the animation studio Asteria (per Moonvalley).
works.method_zh: Moonvalley 称其基于商业授权视频训练，并与动画工作室 Asteria 共同开发。

works.title: 4DV.ai 4D Gaussian Video
works.description: 4DV.ai records scenes with multi-camera rigs and turns them into 4D Gaussian splat video that plays in a web, Quest or Vision Pro viewer, where you can pause, orbit and move through the action; it showed the work live at SIGGRAPH 2025 Real-Time Live and in an 11.5-minute all-4DGS film with Dell and Radiancefields.com at SIGGRAPH 2026.
works.description_zh: 4DV.ai 用多相机阵列录制场景，并转换为 4D 高斯泼溅视频，可在网页、Quest 或 Vision Pro 查看器中播放，观众可以暂停、环绕并在动作中移动；该公司在 SIGGRAPH 2025 Real-Time Live 上做了现场演示，并在 SIGGRAPH 2026 与 Dell、Radiancefields.com 合作首映了一部 11.5 分钟、全部由 4DGS 构成的影片。
works.idea_en: Treats 4D video as a medium of its own: recorded events become places a viewer can stand inside, but only at capture stages for now.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 视频当作一种独立媒介：录下的事件变成观众可以站在其中的地方，但目前只能在拍摄棚里完成捕捉。
works.method: Built on the FreeTimeGS line of research: Gaussians are tracked continuously through time rather than rebuilt per frame, which the company says reduces flicker and tolerates unsynchronised cameras.
works.method_zh: 基于 FreeTimeGS 的研究路线：高斯随时间被连续追踪，而不是逐帧重建，公司称这能减少闪烁并容忍相机不同步。
works.specs: 70-camera 4K PTZ rig shown at NAB 2026 with OBSBOT · 30–60 Mbps finished stream (reported)

paper.title: FreeTimeGS: Free Gaussian Primitives at Anytime and Anywhere for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

exhibited: SIGGRAPH 2025 Real-Time Live! Best in Show (as reported by Radiancefields.com)
works.title_zh: 4DV.ai 4D 高斯视频

works.title: Eleven v3
works.description: ElevenLabs' most expressive text-to-speech model at its launch, directed with inline audio tags such as [whispers], [sighs] or [excited] and able to render multi-speaker dialogue in 70+ languages. Released as an alpha in June 2025, it became generally available on 2 February 2026.
works.description_zh: ElevenLabs 发布时表现力最强的语音合成模型，可用 [whispers]、[sighs]、[excited] 等行内音频标签来“导戏”，并能以 70 多种语言生成多人对话。2025 年 6 月以 alpha 版发布，2026 年 2 月 2 日正式可用。
works.idea_en: Turns a script into an acted scene with interruptions and emotions, lowering the cost of recording varied voiced stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 把剧本变成有打断、有情绪的表演场景，降低录制多样化有声刺激材料的成本。
works.method: A new TTS architecture (details unpublished) that interprets text context and bracketed audio tags to control emotion, delivery and non-verbal sounds.
works.method_zh: 一种新的语音合成架构（细节未公开），根据文本上下文和方括号音频标签控制情绪、语气与非语言声音。

works.title: NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec
works.description: NVIDIA's neural-reconstruction libraries for Omniverse: they turn camera and lidar captures into 3D Gaussian-splat scenes packaged as OpenUSD and render them inside simulators (Isaac Sim, CARLA, AlpaSim). NVIDIA pairs NuRec with its Cosmos world models to generate variations of the reconstructed scenes.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 面向 Omniverse 的神经重建库：把相机与激光雷达采集的数据重建为以 OpenUSD 打包的三维高斯泼溅场景，并在仿真器（Isaac Sim、CARLA、AlpaSim）中渲染。NVIDIA 还把 NuRec 与 Cosmos 世界模型配合使用，为重建场景生成各种变化。
works.idea_en: A route from a real place to a controllable simulation: reconstruct a site once, then let generative models vary conditions while the geometry stays fixed.
works.idea_zh: 从真实地点到可控仿真的一条路径：把场地重建一次，再让生成模型改变条件，而几何结构保持不变。
works.method: Gaussian-splat reconstruction from multi-sensor logs (built on open-source gsplat, per NVIDIA), exported to OpenUSD with trajectories through the NCore data standard.
works.method_zh: 从多传感器记录中进行高斯泼溅重建（据 NVIDIA 介绍基于开源 gsplat），并通过 NCore 数据标准连同轨迹导出为 OpenUSD。
works.specs: OpenUSD output · camera + lidar input · integrations: Isaac Sim, CARLA, AlpaSim
works.title_zh: NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec 神经重建

works.title: Seamless Interaction
works.description: Seamless Interaction is Meta FAIR's dataset of over 4,000 hours of face-to-face conversation from more than 4,000 participants, released with dyadic motion models that generate a speaker's facial expressions and gestures from both people's audio and the other person's visual behaviour, for 2D video or 3D Codec Avatars.
works.description_zh: Seamless Interaction 是 Meta FAIR 发布的数据集，包含 4000 多名参与者超过 4000 小时的面对面对话，并附带双人动作模型：根据双方音频和对方的视觉行为生成说话者的面部表情与手势，可用于二维视频或三维 Codec Avatars。
works.idea_en: Open, large-scale dyadic data is what full-duplex avatars train and get evaluated on; the 2026 GENEA gesture challenge is built on it.
works.idea_zh: 开放的大规模双人互动数据是全双工虚拟人训练和评测的基础；2026 年的 GENEA 手势生成挑战赛就建立在它之上。
works.method: Multi-camera recordings of naturalistic and improvised dyadic sessions; audio-visual dyadic motion models (diffusion-based) with controllable emotion and expressivity, optionally driven by LLM speech.
works.method_zh: 多机位录制自然对话与即兴表演的双人会话；基于扩散的视听双人动作模型可控制情绪与表现力，也可由大模型生成的语音驱动。

paper.title: Seamless Interaction: Dyadic Audiovisual Motion Modeling and Large-Scale Dataset

works.title_zh: Seamless Interaction 双人互动数据集与模型

works.title: ThinkSound
works.description: An open video-to-audio model that reasons before it adds sound: it first generates a coherent foley track for a silent clip, then lets a user click an object to refine its sound, then edits the result from a written instruction, with a multimodal LLM writing a chain of thought at each stage. Released with the AudioCoT dataset by Alibaba's Tongyi speech team; NeurIPS 2025.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的视频生成音频模型，先推理再配声：先为无声片段生成连贯的拟音，再让用户点选某个物体细化它的声音，最后根据文字指令编辑结果；每个阶段都由多模态大模型写出思维链来引导。由阿里通义语音团队连同 AudioCoT 数据集一起发布，论文发表于 NeurIPS 2025。
works.idea_en: Sound design becomes an inspectable sequence of reasoned steps that a person can steer object by object.
works.idea_zh: 声音设计变成一串可以检查的推理步骤，人可以逐个物体地加以引导。
works.method: A multimodal LLM produces chain-of-thought descriptions of visual dynamics and acoustics that condition a unified flow-matching audio foundation model across generation, object-centric refinement and instruction-based editing.
works.method_zh: 多模态大模型生成关于画面动态与声学环境的思维链描述，用来驱动统一的流匹配音频基础模型，覆盖生成、以物体为中心的细化和基于指令的编辑三个阶段。

paper.title: ThinkSound: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal Large Language Models for Audio Generation and Editing

works.title_zh: ThinkSound：思维链引导的视频配音

works.title: AnimaX
works.description: Beihang University and VAST (Tripo) method that animates any rigged 3D mesh, from humanoids and animals to other articulated objects, from a text prompt by transferring motion knowledge from a video diffusion model, in one feed-forward pass that takes minutes. Code and model were still listed as coming soon in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 北京航空航天大学与 VAST（Tripo）的方法：借用视频扩散模型的运动知识，只需一句文字提示，就能以单次前馈在几分钟内为任意带骨骼的三维网格（人形、动物及其他关节物体）生成动画。截至 2026 年 10 月，代码与模型仍标注为“即将发布”。
works.idea_en: Motion priors learned from video reach skeletons of any shape, so creatures and props can move without a motion-capture library for their body plan.
works.idea_zh: 从视频中学到的运动先验可以用于任意形状的骨骼，生物与道具不需要针对自身结构的动捕库也能动起来。
works.method: Represents 3D motion as multi-view, multi-frame 2D pose maps generated jointly with video, conditioned on template renderings and a motion prompt; the poses are triangulated into 3D joints and converted to mesh animation by inverse kinematics; trained on 160,000 rigged sequences.
works.method_zh: 把三维动作表示为多视角、多帧的二维姿态图，以模板渲染图和动作提示为条件，与视频联合生成；再把姿态三角化为三维关节位置，并通过逆向运动学转换为网格动画；训练数据为 16 万条带骨骼的动画序列。
works.specs: trained on 160k rigged sequences · arbitrary skeletons

paper.title: AnimaX: Animating the Inanimate in 3D with Joint Video-Pose Diffusion Models

works.title_zh: AnimaX 借视频先验为任意三维网格生成动画

works.title: Kling-Foley
works.description: Kuaishou's video-to-audio model from the Kling team: from a video and an optional text prompt it generates synchronized stereo sound effects and background music of any length, matched to the clip. Kuaishou released the industrial benchmark Kling-Audio-Eval with it, but not the model weights.
works.description_zh: 快手可灵团队的视频生成音频模型：根据视频和可选的文字提示，生成与画面同步、任意时长的立体声音效与背景音乐。快手随之开源了工业级评测基准 Kling-Audio-Eval，但没有公开模型权重。
works.idea_en: Shows how a frontier video lab builds sound as a separate, length-adaptive stage before folding audio into the video model itself.
works.idea_zh: 展示了前沿视频团队如何先把声音做成独立、可适应时长的环节，再把音频并入视频模型本身。
works.method: Multimodal flow-matching MMDiT conditioned jointly on text, video and frame-level features predicts VAE latents, decoded to a mono mel-spectrogram, converted to stereo by a Mono2Stereo module and vocoded.
works.method_zh: 以文本、视频和逐帧特征联合为条件的多模态流匹配 MMDiT 预测 VAE 隐变量，解码为单声道梅尔谱，经 Mono2Stereo 模块转为立体声后再由声码器合成波形。

paper.title: Kling-Foley: Multimodal Diffusion Transformer for High-Quality Video-to-Audio Generation

works.title_zh: 可灵 Kling-Foley 视频拟音

works.title: BulletGen
works.description: Meta's BulletGen improves 4D Gaussian reconstructions of casual monocular videos by generating, at frozen bullet-time moments, the views the camera never saw and using them to supervise the reconstruction.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 BulletGen 在定格的子弹时间时刻生成相机从未看到的视角，并用它们监督重建，从而改进随手单目视频的 4D 高斯重建。
works.idea_en: Generation used as a repair tool inside reconstruction, keeping the captured motion while filling the gaps.
works.idea_zh: 把生成当作重建中的修补工具：保留拍到的运动，同时填补空缺。
works.method: A diffusion video model is aligned with the current 4D Gaussian scene at a single frozen time step; generated frames are added as supervision in an iterative optimisation that also improves 2D/3D tracking.
works.method_zh: 在单个定格时间步上，把扩散视频模型与当前 4D 高斯场景对齐，生成的帧作为监督加入迭代优化，同时改善二维/三维追踪。

paper.title: BulletGen: Improving 4D Reconstruction with Bullet-Time Generation

works.title: IndexTTS2
works.description: An open zero-shot TTS model from bilibili's Index team that clones a voice from a short sample, controls emotion separately from timbre and can fix the exact duration of the output, the combination dubbing needs. Its demos re-voice film and animation clips in Chinese and English.
works.description_zh: 哔哩哔哩 Index 团队的开源零样本语音合成模型：用一小段样本克隆声音，情绪与音色可分别控制，还能精确指定输出时长，正好满足配音所需。它的演示为电影和动画片段重新配音，涵盖中文与英文。
works.idea_en: Duration control lets generated speech land on exact timestamps, essential when speech must sync with generated video or a scripted VR event.
works.idea_zh: 时长控制让生成的语音准确落在指定时间点上；当语音必须与生成视频或预设的 VR 事件同步时，这一点必不可少。
works.method: Autoregressive text-to-semantic Transformer with explicit token-count duration control and disentangled speaker and emotion prompts, followed by a semantic-to-mel model and vocoder.
works.method_zh: 自回归的文本到语义 Transformer，通过显式的标记数量控制时长，并解耦说话人与情绪提示；之后接语义到梅尔谱模型和声码器。

paper.title: IndexTTS2: A Breakthrough in Emotionally Expressive and Duration-Controlled Auto-Regressive Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech

works.title: VMem
works.description: A memory module for video generators that explore a scene from one image: past views are indexed by the 3D surface elements (surfels) they observed, so when the camera returns, the generator retrieves only the views that saw that surface and redraws it consistently.
works.description_zh: 一个用于视频生成器的记忆模块，可从一张图像出发探索场景：历史视图按其观察到的三维面元（surfel）建立索引，镜头回到某处时，只调取看到过该表面的视图并据此一致地重绘。
works.idea_en: Index memory by where things are, not when they were seen, and revisits stay consistent at a fraction of the cost of attending to every past frame.
works.idea_zh: 按事物所在的位置、而不是看到它的时间来索引记忆，回访就能保持一致，算力只需关注全部历史帧的一小部分。
works.method: A surfel-indexed view memory built from estimated geometry selects the most relevant past views as context for a camera-conditioned video diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 基于估计几何构建以面元为索引的视图记忆，为相机条件视频扩散模型挑选最相关的历史视图作为上下文。

paper.title: VMem: Consistent Interactive Video Scene Generation with Surfel-Indexed View Memory

works.title_zh: VMem：面元索引视图记忆

works.title: 4Real-Video-V2
works.description: Snap Research's 4Real-Video-V2 generates a moving scene from a text prompt (or animates a captured 3D scene or asset) as a grid of videos over viewpoints and time, and lifts every time step into 3D Gaussians in a feed-forward pass.
works.description_zh: Snap Research 的 4Real-Video-V2 能根据文字提示生成运动场景（也可为捕捉的三维场景或资产添加动画），输出“视角 × 时间”的视频网格，并通过一次前向把每个时间步提升为三维高斯。
works.idea_en: Successor to 4Real (2024) and 4Real-Video (CVPR 2025): 4D scene generation without per-scene optimisation, from prompt to dynamic Gaussians.
works.idea_zh: 4Real（2024）与 4Real-Video（CVPR 2025）的后续：无需逐场景优化的 4D 场景生成，从提示直接得到动态高斯。
works.method: A 4D video diffusion model with fused view-time sparse attention (tokens attend within the same frame, timestamp or viewpoint, adding no parameters to the base video model) generates the grid, and a feed-forward reconstruction model with a Gaussian head recovers cameras and per-frame Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 4D 视频扩散模型采用融合的视角—时间稀疏注意力（token 只关注同一帧、同一时刻或同一视角的 token，不给基础视频模型增加参数）生成网格，再由带高斯头的前馈重建模型恢复相机与逐帧高斯。

paper.title: 4Real-Video-V2: Fused View-Time Attention and Feedforward Reconstruction for 4D Scene Generation

works.title_zh: 4Real-Video-V2 4D 场景生成

works.title: Hailuo 02
works.description: MiniMax's Hailuo 02 (2025-06-18) generates native 1080p clips and became known for complex full-body motion such as gymnastics and acrobatics.
works.description_zh: MiniMax 的海螺 02（2025-06-18）可生成原生 1080p 片段，以体操、杂技等复杂全身动作著称。
works.idea_en: Credible full-body motion is a prerequisite for scenes in which bodily behavior is the stimulus.
works.idea_zh: 可信的全身动作，是以身体行为作为刺激的情境的前提。
works.method: Noise-aware Compute Redistribution (NCR) architecture that MiniMax says makes training and inference about 2.5x more efficient, with 3x the parameters and 4x the data of Hailuo 01.
works.method_zh: MiniMax 称其采用 NCR（噪声感知计算重分配）架构，训练与推理效率约提升 2.5 倍，参数量为海螺 01 的 3 倍、训练数据为 4 倍。
works.title_zh: 海螺 02

works.title: Midjourney Video V1
works.description: Midjourney's first video model (2025-06-18) animates any Midjourney image into five-second clips, extendable to about 21 seconds, with automatic or prompted motion.
works.description_zh: Midjourney 首个视频模型（2025-06-18）可把任意 Midjourney 图像做成 5 秒动画，可延展到约 21 秒，运动方式可自动生成或由提示指定。
works.idea_en: Midjourney presents it as a step from its aesthetic image model toward real-time open-world simulation.
works.idea_zh: Midjourney 把它定位为从审美导向的图像模型迈向实时开放世界模拟的一步。
works.method: Image-to-video model with 'low' and 'high' motion settings; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 提供“低/高”两档运动强度的图生视频模型；架构未公开。

works.title: ViSAGe
works.description: Generates first-order ambisonic sound from a silent field-of-view video and its camera direction, so sound sources stay where they are on screen when the listener turns. The authors also release YT-Ambigen, a dataset of about 102K YouTube clips with ambisonic audio.
works.description_zh: 根据一段无声的视野视频及其镜头方向生成一阶全景声，使听者转头时声源仍停留在画面中对应的位置。作者还发布了 YT-Ambigen 数据集，包含约 10.2 万段带全景声的 YouTube 片段。
works.idea_en: Head-trackable spatial sound for video: the step from a stereo soundtrack to audio that belongs to a 3D scene in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 可随头部追踪变化的视频空间声音：从立体声配乐迈向属于头显中三维场景的音频。
works.method: Codec-based autoregressive generation of ambisonic channels conditioned on CLIP video features, patch-wise energy maps and camera direction, with new spatial-audio evaluation metrics.
works.method_zh: 基于神经编解码器的自回归模型，以 CLIP 视频特征、分块能量图和镜头方向为条件生成全景声各声道，并提出了新的空间音频评测指标。

paper.title: ViSAGe: Video-to-Spatial Audio Generation

works.title_zh: ViSAGe：视频生成空间音频

works.title: AnimateAnyMesh
works.description: AnimateAnyMesh animates any 3D mesh from a text prompt in a few seconds, for example making a dragon flap its wings, without rigging and without per-object optimisation.
works.description_zh: AnimateAnyMesh 能在几秒内根据文字提示为任意三维网格生成动画（例如让一条龙扇动翅膀），无需绑定骨骼，也无需逐物体优化。
works.idea_en: Mesh animation becomes a prompt-and-wait step of seconds, so animated props inside a generated scene are cheap to vary.
works.idea_zh: 网格动画变成“输入提示、等几秒”的一步，让生成场景中的动态道具可以低成本地变换。
works.method: A DyMeshVAE compresses dynamic mesh sequences into latent trajectories while keeping local topology, and a rectified-flow model generates these latents from text; training uses the DyMesh dataset, which the authors report holds over 4 million text-annotated dynamic mesh sequences.
works.method_zh: DyMeshVAE 把动态网格序列压缩为潜在轨迹并保留局部拓扑，再由整流流模型根据文字生成这些潜变量；训练数据为 DyMesh 数据集，作者称其包含 400 多万条带文字标注的动态网格序列。
works.specs: a few seconds per animation (developer claim) · arbitrary mesh topology

paper.title: AnimateAnyMesh: A Feed-Forward 4D Foundation Model for Text-Driven Universal Mesh Animation

works.title_zh: AnimateAnyMesh 文本驱动的网格动画

works.title: Seaweed APT2
works.description: ByteDance Seed's Seaweed APT2 (2025-06) streams 736×416 video at 24 fps on one H100 for up to a minute, steered in real time by camera moves or, in its virtual-human demo, by a person's pose.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的 Seaweed APT2（2025 年 6 月）在单张 H100 上以 24 fps 流式生成 736×416 视频，最长约一分钟，可通过镜头运动实时操控，其虚拟人演示中还能由人体姿态驱动。
works.idea_en: One network evaluation per frame makes video respond to input like a game engine, at least for a minute.
works.idea_zh: 每帧只需一次网络前向，视频便能像游戏引擎一样响应输入，至少能持续一分钟。
works.method: Autoregressive adversarial post-training (AAPT): a pretrained video diffusion model is converted to emit one latent frame per network evaluation, trained adversarially with student forcing on long rollouts.
works.method_zh: 自回归对抗后训练（AAPT）：把预训练视频扩散模型改造为每次网络前向生成一个潜帧，并在长序列上以学生强制方式进行对抗训练。

paper.title: Autoregressive Adversarial Post-Training for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation

works.title: Seedance 1.0
works.description: ByteDance Seed's Seedance 1.0 (2025-06-11) generates 1080p multi-shot clips that keep subjects consistent across cuts; ByteDance reported it ranked first in the Artificial Analysis text- and image-to-video arenas after release.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的 Seedance 1.0（2025-06-11）可生成 1080p 多镜头片段，切镜后主体保持一致；字节跳动称其发布后在 Artificial Analysis 文生与图生视频竞技场排名第一。
works.idea_en: Native multi-shot storytelling (cut, reverse shot, close-up) in a single generation.
works.idea_zh: 一次生成即可完成多镜头叙事（切换、反打、特写）。
works.method: Diffusion transformer with decoupled spatial and temporal layers, multi-source data curation, RLHF and a distillation stack giving about 10x faster inference (per the technical report).
works.method_zh: 据技术报告：采用时空解耦层的扩散 Transformer，结合多源数据筛选、RLHF，以及约 10 倍加速的蒸馏推理方案。

paper.title: Seedance 1.0: Exploring the Boundaries of Video Generation Models

works.title: V-JEPA 2
works.description: A self-supervised video world model that predicts in a learned representation space rather than in pixels; Meta reports that an action-conditioned version lets a robot arm plan pick-and-place tasks zero-shot in labs it has never seen.
works.description_zh: 一个自监督视频世界模型，在学到的表征空间而不是像素空间中做预测；Meta 称，其动作条件版本能让机械臂在从未见过的实验室中零样本规划抓取放置任务。
works.idea_en: A world model does not have to render pixels to be useful; predicting abstract consequences is enough for planning.
works.idea_zh: 世界模型不一定要渲染像素才有用；预测抽象的后果就足以支撑规划。
works.method: A joint-embedding predictive architecture pre-trained on over 1 million hours of internet video and images, then post-trained as V-JEPA 2-AC on under 62 hours of unlabeled robot video from the DROID dataset and used for model-predictive control.
works.method_zh: 联合嵌入预测架构，先在超过 100 万小时的网络视频与图像上预训练，再以 V-JEPA 2-AC 的形式在 DROID 数据集中不足 62 小时的无标注机器人视频上后训练，用于模型预测控制。
works.specs: 1.2B parameters · 1M+ hours of video · < 62 h robot data (developer-reported)

paper.title: V-JEPA 2: Self-Supervised Video Models Enable Understanding, Prediction and Planning

works.title: SPECS (Snap consumer AR glasses)
works.description: Snap's standalone see-through AR glasses for consumers, announced on 2025-06-10 for 2026, opened for pre-order at $2,195 at AWE on 2026-06-16 and launched at the SPECS event on 2026-09-16 ($2,395 with a cellular case), shipping later in fall 2026 in the US, UK and France. They run SPECS OS with Lens Studio apps, including generative AI Lenses, and SPECS Intelligence, an anticipatory AI service across iPhone, Mac and the glasses.
works.description_zh: Snap 面向消费者的一体式光学透视 AR 眼镜，2025-06-10 宣布将于 2026 年推出，2026-06-16 在 AWE 上开放预订（2,195 美元），并在 2026-09-16 的 SPECS 发布会上正式亮相（带蜂窝网络充电盒套装 2,395 美元），2026 年秋季晚些时候在美国、英国和法国发货。它运行 SPECS OS 与 Lens Studio 开发的应用（包括生成式 AI 滤镜），并搭载横跨 iPhone、Mac 与眼镜的预判式 AI 服务 SPECS Intelligence。
works.idea_en: Untethered AR glasses that place generated content in the wearer's real surroundings, from a company that already runs generative Lenses at phone scale.
works.idea_zh: 无需连线的 AR 眼镜，把生成内容放进佩戴者的真实环境；出品方已经在手机端大规模运行生成式滤镜。
works.method: On-glasses compute with no puck, see-through waveguide displays, hand and voice input, with Lens Studio as the authoring tool and cloud AI services.
works.method_zh: 计算单元集成在眼镜上，无需外接计算盒，采用光学透视波导显示，支持手势与语音输入；以 Lens Studio 为创作工具，并调用云端 AI 服务。
works.specs: 51° FOV · pre-order $2,195 (from 2026-06-16) · ships fall 2026 (US, UK, France) · standalone, no puck
works.title_zh: SPECS（Snap 消费级 AR 眼镜）

works.title: Spectacles AI release with Snap3D
works.description: A Spectacles OS release adds the Snap3D API, which generates 3D objects on demand inside Lenses, together with OpenAI and Gemini integrations and better speech recognition for multimodal AI Lenses.
works.description_zh: Spectacles 系统更新加入 Snap3D API，可在镜头内按需生成三维物体，同时接入 OpenAI 与 Gemini，并改进语音识别，用于多模态 AI 镜头。
works.idea_en: Makes text-to-3D a standard building block of AR glasses apps, so a Lens can create objects the developer never modelled.
works.idea_zh: 让文生三维成为 AR 眼镜应用的标准构件，镜头可以生成开发者从未建模过的物体。
works.method: Cloud text-to-3D generation exposed as a Lens Studio API and called at runtime from Spectacles Lenses, alongside hosted LLM and ASR services.
works.method_zh: 把云端文生三维作为 Lens Studio API 提供，在 Spectacles 镜头运行时调用，并配合托管的大语言模型与语音识别服务。
works.title_zh: Spectacles AI 更新与 Snap3D

works.title: Personas (visionOS 26)
works.description: A Persona is the 3D likeness of an Apple Vision Pro wearer, created from a quick face scan with the headset and animated live by its eye, face and hand tracking in FaceTime and shared spatial apps; visionOS 26 rebuilt Personas with more realistic hair, skin, eyelashes and side profiles.
works.description_zh: Persona 是 Apple Vision Pro 佩戴者的三维形象：用头显快速扫描面部生成，在 FaceTime 和共享空间应用中由头显的眼部、面部和手部追踪实时驱动；visionOS 26 重新打造了 Persona，头发、皮肤、睫毛和侧脸更逼真。
works.idea_en: The first photoreal self-avatar most XR users actually meet, which makes it the realistic baseline for embodied telepresence studies.
works.idea_zh: 多数 XR 用户真正接触到的第一个照片级自我化身，因此是具身远程临场研究的现实基线。
works.method: On-device reconstruction from the headset's front cameras (Apple describes 'volumetric rendering' and machine learning in visionOS 26), driven by internal eye and face cameras.
works.method_zh: 由头显前置摄像头在设备端重建（Apple 在 visionOS 26 中称使用了“体积渲染”和机器学习），并由内部的眼部和面部摄像头驱动。
works.title_zh: Persona 数字分身（visionOS 26）

works.title: Self Forcing
works.description: Self Forcing (Adobe Research and UT Austin, 2025-06) trains an autoregressive video model on its own rollouts, closing the train-test gap, and streams video at about 17 fps with sub-second latency on one H100.
works.description_zh: Self Forcing（Adobe Research 与 UT Austin，2025 年 6 月）让自回归视频模型在自身的生成结果上训练，弥合训练与推理的差距，在单张 H100 上以约 17 fps、亚秒级延迟流式生成视频。
works.idea_en: Became a common training recipe for real-time video models such as LongLive and Krea Realtime.
works.idea_zh: 成为 LongLive、Krea Realtime 等实时视频模型常用的训练方法。
works.method: Autoregressive rollout with KV caching during training, a holistic video-level distribution-matching loss and a rolling KV cache for extrapolation.
works.method_zh: 训练时就用 KV 缓存进行自回归展开，以整段视频级的分布匹配损失优化，并用滚动 KV 缓存外推更长视频。

paper.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion

works.title: Spatial Scenes (visionOS 26)
works.description: A visionOS 26 feature that turns any 2D photo into a spatial scene with depth and multiple perspectives, so the viewer can lean in and look around it on Apple Vision Pro (and as parallax on the iOS 26 Lock Screen), and developers get a Spatial Scene API. With visionOS 27, announced at WWDC on 2026-06-08 and released on 2026-09-14, Vision Pro users can also turn panoramas into spatial scenes and use them as personal Environments.
works.description_zh: visionOS 26 的功能：把任意二维照片变成带深度、可从多个角度观看的空间场景，在 Apple Vision Pro 上可以凑近、环顾（iOS 26 锁定屏幕上则呈现为视差效果）；开发者可使用 Spatial Scene API。2026 年 6 月 8 日 WWDC 发布、9 月 14 日正式推送的 visionOS 27 进一步让 Vision Pro 用户把全景照片变成空间场景，并设为个人“环境”。
works.idea_en: Photo-to-3D now ships by default in a headset OS, so personal photos become a ready source of familiar, real places for immersive studies.
works.idea_zh: 照片转三维已成为头显系统的默认功能，个人照片因此成为沉浸式研究中现成的、熟悉的真实场所来源。
works.method: Apple describes 'a new generative AI algorithm and computational depth' that infers geometry and fills disoccluded regions to create multiple perspectives; the model is not published (Apple's SHARP research addresses the same task).
works.method_zh: Apple 称其使用“新的生成式 AI 算法与计算深度”推断几何并补全去遮挡区域，以生成多个视角；模型未公开（Apple 的 SHARP 研究针对的是同一任务）。
works.title_zh: 空间场景（visionOS 26）

works.title: FreeTimeGS
works.description: FreeTimeGS lets Gaussians appear at any time and place and carry their own motion, reconstructing fast, complex movement from multi-camera rigs for real-time free-viewpoint playback.
works.description_zh: FreeTimeGS 允许高斯在任意时间、任意位置出现并带有各自的运动，从多相机阵列重建快速复杂的动作，实现实时自由视角回放。
works.idea_en: The published method behind 4DV.ai's 4D video, linking a CVPR paper directly to a production medium.
works.idea_zh: 4DV.ai 4D 视频背后的已发表方法，把一篇 CVPR 论文直接连接到一种制作媒介。
works.method: Each Gaussian has a temporal centre, velocity-based motion function and temporal opacity, with a 4D regularisation that avoids overfitting to individual frames.
works.method_zh: 每个高斯具有时间中心、基于速度的运动函数与时间不透明度，并通过 4D 正则化避免对单帧过拟合。

paper.title: FreeTimeGS: Free Gaussian Primitives at Anytime and Anywhere for Dynamic Scene Reconstruction

works.title: Milo: an LLM-based virtual human open-source platform for extended reality
works.description: Open-source system for putting LLM-driven virtual humans into VR and AR applications, demonstrated as a single conversational agent, an attendee of a multi-user VR meeting, a helper in a VR self-talk session and a participant in an AR live event.
works.description_zh: 开源系统，可把由大语言模型驱动的虚拟人接入 VR 与 AR 应用；论文展示了它作为单个对话智能体、多人 VR 会议参与者、VR 自我对话助手以及 AR 现场活动参与者的用法。
works.idea_en: Open, lab-owned virtual-human stacks matter for research: a study can pin the prompt, model and behavior pipeline it actually ran.
works.idea_zh: 开放、由实验室掌控的虚拟人技术栈对研究很重要：一项研究可以锁定它实际使用的提示词、模型与行为管线。
works.method: Architecture that integrates speech recognition, an LLM, speech synthesis and avatar animation into XR platforms, with lessons from several deployments.
works.method_zh: 把语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成与化身动画集成到 XR 平台中的架构，并总结了多次部署的经验。

paper.title: Milo: an LLM-based virtual human open-source platform for extended reality

works.title_zh: Milo：面向扩展现实的开源大语言模型虚拟人平台

works.title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory
works.description: A video world model that keeps a 3D point cloud of the static scene as long-term memory alongside recent frames and keyframes, so places revisited after long camera paths look the same.
works.description_zh: 一个视频世界模型：在保留近期画面与关键帧的同时，把静态场景的三维点云作为长期记忆，使长时间镜头移动后重访的地方看起来依然一致。
works.idea_en: Combines an explicit 3D store with a generative model: geometry for what must persist, generation for what can change.
works.idea_zh: 把显式三维存储与生成模型结合：几何负责必须持久的部分，生成负责可以变化的部分。
works.method: A geometry-grounded memory with three parts: a point-cloud spatial memory of static content, a working memory of recent frames and an episodic memory of keyframes, all conditioning a video diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 以几何为基础的三部分记忆：记录静态内容的点云空间记忆、记录近期画面的工作记忆和记录关键帧的情景记忆，共同作为视频扩散模型的条件。

paper.title: Video World Models with Long-term Spatial Memory

works.title_zh: 具备长期空间记忆的视频世界模型

works.title: Context-as-Memory
works.description: A method that keeps a generated scene consistent over long interactive videos by treating all previously generated frames as memory and retrieving only those whose camera views overlap the next view.
works.description_zh: 一种让长时交互视频中的生成场景保持一致的方法：把此前生成的所有画面都当作记忆，只调取与下一视角视野重叠的那些画面。
works.idea_en: Simple retrieval by field of view beats compressing the past, which makes memory inspectable frame by frame.
works.idea_zh: 按视野重叠做简单检索，效果胜过把过去压缩起来，而且记忆可以逐帧检查。
works.method: Past frames are concatenated as context to a video diffusion model, with a memory-retrieval module that selects frames by camera field-of-view overlap to bound compute.
works.method_zh: 把历史帧拼接为视频扩散模型的上下文，并用记忆检索模块按相机视野重叠挑选帧，以限制计算量。

paper.title: Context as Memory: Scene-Consistent Interactive Long Video Generation with Memory Retrieval

works.title_zh: 以上下文为记忆（Context-as-Memory）

works.title: TalkingMachines
works.description: TalkingMachines turns a pretrained image-to-video model into a real-time, audio-driven character animator for FaceTime-style calls with an audio LLM, streaming video of unbounded length without drift.
works.description_zh: TalkingMachines 把预训练的图生视频模型改造成实时的音频驱动角色动画器，与音频大模型配合实现 FaceTime 式通话，可流式生成不限时长且不漂移的视频。
works.idea_en: Showed the recipe most 2026 real-time avatars use: distil a big bidirectional video model into a causal few-step streamer.
works.idea_zh: 展示了 2026 年多数实时虚拟人采用的做法：把大型双向视频模型蒸馏成因果、少步的流式生成器。
works.method: An 18B audio-conditioned DiT adapted from a SOTA image-to-video model, distilled asymmetrically into a sparse causal autoregressive student, with DiT and VAE decoding split across GPUs.
works.method_zh: 由先进的图生视频模型改造而来的 18B 音频条件 DiT，经非对称蒸馏得到稀疏因果的自回归学生模型，并把 DiT 与 VAE 解码拆分到不同 GPU 上。

paper.title: TalkingMachines: Real-Time Audio-Driven FaceTime-Style Video via Autoregressive Diffusion Models

works.title_zh: TalkingMachines：实时 FaceTime 式音频驱动视频

works.title: Spark
works.description: Spark is World Labs' open-source Gaussian splat renderer for three.js; Spark 2.0 (April 2026) streams worlds of over 100 million splats into an ordinary web page. On 28 September 2026 AMD agreed to acquire World Labs (closing expected by the end of 2026); Spark remains MIT-licensed.
works.description_zh: Spark 是 World Labs 面向 three.js 的开源高斯泼溅渲染器；Spark 2.0（2026 年 4 月）可把超过 1 亿个泼溅的世界流式加载进普通网页。2026 年 9 月 28 日，AMD 同意收购 World Labs（预计 2026 年底完成交割）；Spark 仍采用 MIT 许可证。
works.idea_en: Lets captured or generated splat worlds be wrapped in web interactions, the cheapest route to putting them in front of study participants.
works.idea_zh: 让捕捉或生成的泼溅世界可以包上网页交互，这是把它们呈现给研究参与者的最省成本的途径。
works.method: A three.js renderer with GPU sorting, level of detail and streaming, plus programmable per-splat effects for editing and animation.
works.method_zh: 一个 three.js 渲染器，具备 GPU 排序、细节层次与流式加载，并支持可编程的逐泼溅效果用于编辑与动画。

works.title: Lyria RealTime
works.description: A music model that produces a continuous stream of music which people steer live by blending and re-weighting text prompts, used in MusicFX DJ and offered in the Gemini API. Its open counterpart, Magenta RealTime, can run locally.
works.description_zh: 一个持续输出音乐流的模型，人们可以通过混合、调整文字提示的权重来实时引导音乐走向；它用于 MusicFX DJ，并在 Gemini API 中提供。其开源对应版本 Magenta RealTime 可在本地运行。
works.idea_en: An adaptive score: music that changes with the scene as it unfolds rather than a track picked from a playlist.
works.idea_zh: 自适应配乐：音乐随情境的展开而变化，而不是从歌单里挑一首。
works.method: Generates music chunk by chunk, conditioned on the preceding audio and on weighted, changeable text prompts (details largely unpublished; Magenta RealTime, the open counterpart, likely uses the same streaming scheme).
works.method_zh: 逐段生成音乐，以前面的音频以及可变、带权重的文字提示为条件（细节大多未公开；开源的 Magenta RealTime 很可能采用相同的流式方案）。

works.title: AnySplat
works.description: AnySplat turns a set of unposed, uncalibrated photos into a complete 3D Gaussian splat scene, together with the camera poses, in a single forward pass of a few seconds.
works.description_zh: AnySplat 把一组无位姿、未标定的照片，在几秒的一次前向中变成完整的三维高斯泼溅场景，并同时给出相机位姿。
works.idea_en: Removes the per-scene training step that made splat capture slow, so a walkthrough can become explorable almost immediately.
works.idea_zh: 去掉了让泼溅捕捉变慢的逐场景训练步骤，使一段走拍几乎可以立刻变得可探索。
works.method: A geometry transformer (VGGT-style) predicts Gaussians, intrinsics and extrinsics; differentiable voxelisation merges per-pixel Gaussians, trained with rendering and distillation losses.
works.method_zh: 类似 VGGT 的几何 Transformer 预测高斯、内参与外参，可微体素化合并逐像素高斯，并用渲染与蒸馏损失训练。

paper.title: AnySplat: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Views

works.title: EVI 3
works.description: Hume's third Empathic Voice Interface, a speech-language model that can create a new voice and personality from a text prompt in under a second and then converse in it. In Hume's blind comparison it was rated above GPT-4o on empathy, expressiveness, naturalness, interruption quality and response speed. Hume announced on 2 October 2026 that it is sunsetting its EVI and TTS APIs; access ends on 13 November 2026.
works.description_zh: Hume 的第三代共情语音接口，一个语音-语言模型：能在一秒内根据文字提示生成新的声音和性格，并用它对话。在 Hume 的盲测比较中，它在同理心、表现力、自然度、被打断时的表现和响应速度上的评分高于 GPT-4o。Hume 于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布停止提供 EVI 与 TTS API，访问将于 2026 年 11 月 13 日结束。
works.idea_en: Prompt-designed voices with emotional delivery make it cheap to cast many distinct virtual characters for one study.
works.idea_zh: 通过提示设计、带情绪表达的声音，让一项研究可以低成本地“选角”出许多不同的虚拟角色。
works.method: A single voice-to-voice speech-language model that streams user speech in and produces speech and language together, consulting reasoning models and web search while it talks.
works.method_zh: 单一的语音到语音语言模型，流式接收用户语音并同时生成语音与语言，说话时还能调用推理模型与网络搜索。

works.title: HunyuanVideo-Avatar
works.description: HunyuanVideo-Avatar animates one or several characters in a scene from audio, with emotion taken from a reference image and separate audio streams driving different characters, for example a two-person comedy dialogue.
works.description_zh: HunyuanVideo-Avatar 可根据音频驱动场景中的一个或多个角色，情绪可取自参考图像，不同角色由各自的音频驱动，例如两人相声对话。
works.idea_en: Open weights for multi-character audio-driven scenes, a step from one talking head to a small generated social situation.
works.idea_zh: 多角色音频驱动场景的开源权重，从单个说话头像迈向一个小型生成的社交情境。
works.method: A multimodal DiT built on HunyuanVideo with a character image injection module, an audio emotion module and a face-aware audio adapter that masks audio to each character.
works.method_zh: 基于 HunyuanVideo 的多模态 DiT，配有角色图像注入模块、音频情绪模块，以及按人脸区域为每个角色分配音频的人脸感知音频适配器。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo-Avatar: High-Fidelity Audio-Driven Human Animation for Multiple Characters

works.title_zh: 混元 HunyuanVideo-Avatar

works.title: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models
works.description: A video world model that uses state-space layers to carry memory across long action-conditioned rollouts, so an agent revisiting a place in Memory Maze or Minecraft sees it as before, without the cost of attending over the whole history.
works.description_zh: 一个用状态空间层在长时动作条件推演中传递记忆的视频世界模型：智能体在 Memory Maze 或 Minecraft 中重回某处时，看到的与先前一致，又不必对全部历史做注意力计算。
works.idea_en: Memory does not have to grow with the session: a compact recurrent state can hold a place in mind at constant cost.
works.idea_zh: 记忆不必随会话变长而增长：一个紧凑的循环状态就能以恒定成本记住一个地方。
works.method: Block-wise state-space scanning over spatial blocks extends temporal memory, while dense local attention keeps consecutive frames coherent (Stanford, Princeton and Adobe Research).
works.method_zh: 在空间分块上做块式状态空间扫描以延长时间记忆，同时用稠密的局部注意力保证相邻帧连贯（斯坦福大学、普林斯顿大学与 Adobe Research）。

paper.title: Long-Context State-Space Video World Models

works.title_zh: 长上下文状态空间视频世界模型

works.title: WonderPlay
works.description: WonderPlay turns a single image into a 3D scene that reacts to actions: a person can add wind, push a glass or pour honey, and the scene's cloth, liquid, smoke or rigid objects move in response.
works.description_zh: WonderPlay 能把一张图像变成会对动作作出反应的三维场景：人可以加一阵风、推一下玻璃杯或倒入蜂蜜，场景中的布料、液体、烟雾或刚体随之运动。
works.idea_en: Couples a physics solver with a video generator so that generated 3D scenes have consequences, not only motion: closer to a situation than a clip.
works.idea_zh: 把物理求解器与视频生成器结合，让生成的三维场景有“后果”而不只是运动，更接近一个情境而非一段片段。
works.method: A hybrid generative simulator: a physics solver predicts coarse 3D dynamics for the input action, these condition a video generator that produces realistic motion, and the generated video updates the dynamic 3D scene in a loop.
works.method_zh: 混合生成式模拟器：物理求解器针对输入动作预测粗略的三维动态，以此为条件让视频生成器生成真实运动，再用生成的视频循环更新动态三维场景。

paper.title: WonderPlay: Dynamic 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image and Actions

works.title_zh: WonderPlay 由单图与动作生成动态三维场景

works.title: Unmute
works.description: A modular voice layer that lets any text LLM listen and speak, combining Kyutai's streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech with semantic turn detection. At unmute.sh people can talk to it, interrupt it and choose a voice and personality.
works.description_zh: 一个模块化的语音层，让任何文本大模型都能听会说：它把 Kyutai 的流式语音识别、流式语音合成与语义轮次检测组合在一起。在 unmute.sh 上，人们可以和它交谈、打断它，并选择声音与性格。
works.idea_en: Gives researchers a voice front-end they can put any LLM and persona behind, at the price of turn-taking instead of Moshi-style overlap.
works.idea_zh: 给研究者一个可以接入任意大模型和角色设定的语音前端，代价是采用轮流发言，而不是 Moshi 那样的重叠对话。
works.method: Cascade of streaming STT with semantic voice-activity detection, any text LLM, and a streaming TTS that starts speaking before the full reply is written; open-sourced in July 2025.
works.method_zh: 级联结构：带语义语音活动检测的流式语音识别、任意文本大模型，以及在回复写完之前就开始说话的流式语音合成；2025 年 7 月开源。

works.title: Google Beam
works.description: Google Beam is the commercial successor to Project Starline: an AI model turns several 2D camera streams into a 3D rendering of the remote person on a light-field display, sold built into HP's Dimension screen. On 23 September 2026 Google said Beam units now ship to customers in six countries (US, Canada, UK, France, Germany, Japan) through 18 channel partners, with bookable units at Industrious workspaces from October 2026.
works.description_zh: Google Beam 是 Project Starline 的商用后继：AI 模型把多路二维相机画面转换为远端人物的三维渲染，在光场显示屏上呈现，内置于 HP Dimension 显示设备出售。Google 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日表示，Beam 设备已通过 18 家渠道合作伙伴向六个国家（美国、加拿大、英国、法国、德国、日本）的客户发货，并自 2026 年 10 月起可在部分 Industrious 共享办公空间预约使用。
works.idea_en: Volumetric telepresence is now a product you can buy, but at about $25,000 per unit (reported) and for one-to-one calls only.
works.idea_zh: 体积式远程临场已经是可以买到的产品，但据报道每台约 2.5 万美元，并且只支持一对一通话。
works.method: Google reports a six-camera array and an AI volumetric video model that renders on a 3D light-field display with millimetre head tracking at 60 fps.
works.method_zh: Google 称其使用六相机阵列与 AI 体积视频模型，在三维光场显示屏上以 60 帧/秒和毫米级头部追踪进行渲染。
works.specs: 6 cameras · 60 fps · 65-inch light-field display (HP Dimension) · 1:1 calls · ~$25,000 per unit (reported)
works.title_zh: Google Beam 三维视频通话

works.title: Veo 3
works.description: Veo 3 (Google I/O, 2025-05-20) generates video together with dialogue, sound effects and ambient sound in one pass, which made talking characters in generated scenes common; a September 2025 DeepMind paper reports it solving perception and physics tasks zero-shot. Its veo-3.0 API endpoints were shut down in the Gemini API and on Vertex AI on 2026-06-30, with Veo 3.1 as the replacement.
works.description_zh: Veo 3（2025-05-20 Google I/O）可一次生成视频及对白、音效和环境声，使生成场景里“会说话的角色”变得普遍；DeepMind 2025 年 9 月的论文称它能零样本完成感知与物理类任务。其 veo-3.0 API 端点已于 2026-06-30 在 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI 上关闭，由 Veo 3.1 取代。
works.idea_en: Sound and lip-synced speech arrive with the picture, so a generated scene can carry a social interaction, not just a view.
works.idea_zh: 声音与口型同步的语音随画面一起生成，生成场景因此能承载社交互动，而不只是一段画面。
works.method: Joint audio-video diffusion model; the paper 'Video models are zero-shot learners and reasoners' probes it on 62 tasks by prompting alone.
works.method_zh: 音视频联合扩散模型；论文《Video models are zero-shot learners and reasoners》仅靠提示就用 62 类任务对其进行测试。

paper.title: Video models are zero-shot learners and reasoners

works.title: XREAL AURA
works.description: Optical see-through Android XR glasses (formerly Project Aura) co-developed with Google, with a compute puck on Snapdragon and Gemini assistance. As of October 2026 they are in reservation, with launch expected in fall 2026 in the US, Canada, Japan and South Korea, listed at $1,279 (12 GB / 256 GB) or $1,499 (16 GB / 512 GB).
works.description_zh: 与 Google 合作开发的光学透视 Android XR 眼镜（原名 Project Aura），配骁龙计算盒，并由 Gemini 提供辅助。截至 2026 年 10 月处于预约阶段，预计 2026 年秋季在美国、加拿大、日本和韩国上市，标价 1,279 美元（12 GB / 256 GB）或 1,499 美元（16 GB / 512 GB）。
works.idea_en: Brings full Android XR apps to glasses-weight hardware, so mixed-reality stimuli can leave the lab in a form people will wear in public.
works.idea_zh: 把完整的 Android XR 应用带到眼镜级重量的硬件上，让混合现实刺激能以人们愿意在公共场合佩戴的形态走出实验室。
works.method: A Snapdragon (Reality Elite) compute puck plus an X1S spatial coprocessor in the glasses, driving 70° optical see-through displays.
works.method_zh: 骁龙（Reality Elite）计算盒加上眼镜内的 X1S 空间协处理器，驱动 70° 光学透视显示。
works.specs: 70° FOV · Sony micro-OLED 1920×1200 per eye · 95 g · 3 ms motion-to-photon · listed $1,279 / $1,499

works.title: AI Darth Vader in Fortnite
works.description: Fortnite players could recruit Darth Vader to their squad and talk to him over the microphone; he answered in a synthesized James Earl Jones voice. Players got him to swear within hours, which Epic patched. The underlying tech went to creators as the Persona device, renamed Conversations and released as an experimental UEFN feature on 2026-04-16 (publishing not yet enabled).
works.description_zh: Fortnite 玩家可以招募达斯·维达加入小队，并用麦克风与他交谈；他以合成的 James Earl Jones 声音回答。上线数小时内就有玩家诱导他说脏话，Epic 随即修补。这项技术随后以 Persona 装置开放给创作者，后更名为 Conversations，并于 2026-04-16 作为 UEFN 实验功能推出（尚不能发布作品）。
works.idea_en: The largest public test of a licensed LLM character so far, and a clear lesson that a character's voice and persona need guardrails before release.
works.idea_zh: 迄今规模最大的授权 LLM 角色公开测试，也清楚表明：角色的声音与人设在上线前必须有护栏。
works.method: Push-to-talk speech goes to Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash, prompted with Vader's persona, and the text reply is voiced by ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 in a voice modeled on Jones, who had signed the rights over to Disney in 2022; reports say Conversations uses Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite with ElevenLabs.
works.method_zh: 按键说话的语音交给带有维达人设提示的 Google Gemini 2.0 Flash，文字回复再由 ElevenLabs Flash v2.5 以模仿 Jones 的声音合成（Jones 生前于 2022 年把声音权利授予迪士尼）；据报道 Conversations 使用 Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite 与 ElevenLabs。
works.title_zh: 《堡垒之夜》AI 达斯·维达

works.title: Confusing virtual reality with reality – An experimental study
works.description: Forty-nine participants interacted with a virtual experimenter in a virtual copy of a real room. 20% sat on a virtual chair without checking for a real one, and a week later, in the real room, 45% expected a tablet the virtual experimenter had put in a drawer to be there.
works.description_zh: 49 名参与者在一间真实房间的虚拟副本中与一位虚拟实验员互动。20% 的人没有确认现实中是否有椅子就坐了下去；一周后在真实房间里，45% 的人以为虚拟实验员放进抽屉的平板电脑就在那里。
works.idea_en: When a virtual situation matches physical reality closely, people carry virtual facts into the real world, a safety and ethics issue that grows as generated worlds become photoreal.
works.idea_zh: 当虚拟情境与物理现实高度吻合时，人们会把虚拟中的“事实”带回现实世界；随着生成世界越来越照片级逼真，这一安全与伦理问题会愈发突出。
works.method: Experiment with a virtual experimenter, behavioral measures (sitting, object expectations a week later) and implicit-attitude tests, analysed with Bayesian statistics.
works.method_zh: 以虚拟实验员开展实验，结合行为指标（是否坐下、一周后对物品位置的预期）与内隐态度测验，并用贝叶斯统计分析。

paper.title: Confusing virtual reality with reality – An experimental study

works.title_zh: 把虚拟现实误当作现实：一项实验研究

works.title: Agora Conversational AI Engine
works.description: A hosted service that drops a voice agent into an Agora real-time channel: developers bring any LLM and text-to-speech, and Agora handles audio transport over its global network, noise suppression, interruption and turn-taking. The same channel can carry a digital-human avatar from partner vendors.
works.description_zh: 一项托管服务，把语音智能体放进声网的实时频道：开发者自选大语言模型与语音合成，声网负责在其全球网络上传输音频，并处理降噪、打断与话轮。同一频道还能接入合作厂商的数字人形象。
works.idea_en: Network-level robustness (packet loss, noisy rooms) matters as much as model latency once virtual humans run outside the lab.
works.idea_zh: 一旦虚拟人走出实验室，网络层面的稳定性（丢包、嘈杂环境）与模型延迟同样重要。
works.method: REST calls start an agent that joins an Agora SD-RTN channel, runs speech recognition, an LLM and text-to-speech (or a speech-to-speech model) in a managed pipeline, and streams speech back into the channel.
works.method_zh: 通过 REST 调用启动智能体，它加入声网 SD-RTN 频道，在托管流水线中运行语音识别、大语言模型与语音合成（或语音到语音模型），再把语音推回频道。
works.specs: launched 2025 · bring-your-own LLM and TTS · Agora SD-RTN global network
works.title_zh: 声网对话式 AI 引擎

works.title: Eye2Eye
works.description: Eye2Eye (Google DeepMind and the Weizmann Institute, 2025-04) takes a real monocular video as the right-eye view and generates the left-eye video with a fine-tuned text-to-video model, so the pair can be watched in 3D glasses or a VR headset; because it skips depth estimation and warping, it handles reflections and semi-transparent objects such as glass and snow.
