works.description_zh: Eye2Eye（Google DeepMind 与魏茨曼科学研究所，2025 年 4 月）把一段真实单目视频当作右眼画面，用微调后的文生视频模型生成左眼视频，两者可以用 3D 眼镜或 VR 头显观看；由于跳过了深度估计与扭曲，它能处理玻璃、雪花等反光与半透明物体。
works.idea_en: Stereo from a generative prior rather than a depth map avoids the warping artefacts that break presence on reflective or transparent surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 用生成先验而非深度图来合成立体画面，避免了在反光或透明表面上破坏临场感的扭曲伪影。
works.method: A pretrained text-to-video diffusion model fine-tuned to generate the other eye's view directly, conditioned on the input view, without explicit depth or warping.
works.method_zh: 以输入视角为条件微调预训练文生视频扩散模型，直接生成另一只眼的视图，不使用显式深度或扭曲。

paper.title: Eye2Eye: A Simple Approach for Monocular-to-Stereo Video Synthesis

works.title_zh: Eye2Eye：单目转立体视频合成的简单方法

works.title: ImaginateAR
works.description: Outdoors, a person says 'a dragon enjoying a campfire' and a phone AR app generates the 3D assets and arranges them in the real park or street, ready to be adjusted by hand.
works.description_zh: 在户外，人说一句“一条在篝火旁享受的龙”，手机 AR 应用就生成三维资产并把它们布置在真实的公园或街道里，之后还可以手动调整。
works.idea_en: Pairs pre-computed scene understanding of a real place with fast 3D generation so anyone can author AR anywhere by speaking.
works.idea_zh: 把对真实地点预先计算的场景理解与快速三维生成结合，让任何人都能在任何地方用说话来创作 AR。
works.method: Offline outdoor scene-graph construction, a fast text-to-3D asset pipeline and LLM-based layout reasoning run in a mobile AR tool; a technical evaluation and a three-part user study (N=20).
works.method_zh: 移动 AR 工具结合离线构建的户外场景图、快速文生三维资产流程与基于大语言模型的布局推理；做了技术评估与三阶段用户研究（N=20）。

paper.title: ImaginateAR: AI-Assisted In-Situ Authoring in Augmented Reality

works.title: AI-Powered Talking Characters on Everyday Objects
works.description: Through an AR headset or a phone, a kettle, a plant or a chair gets an animated face and a personality drawn from what it is, chats with you about the room and reacts when things around it change.
works.description_zh: 透过 AR 头显或手机，水壶、植物或椅子会长出动画面孔，拥有与自身用途相符的性格，和你聊起这个房间，并在周围发生变化时作出反应。
works.idea_en: Grounds generated characters in real objects and their surroundings, so conversation refers to what is actually there.
works.idea_zh: 把生成角色扎根于真实物体及其周边环境，让对话指向真实存在的东西。
works.method: Language, vision and speech models give each recognized object a personality and dialogue grounded in its function and in scene changes; a preliminary evaluation on HoloLens 2 and an Android phone.
works.method_zh: 语言、视觉与语音模型为每个识别出的物体赋予性格，并根据其功能与场景变化生成对话；在 HoloLens 2 和安卓手机上做了初步评估。

paper.title: Bringing Everyday Objects to Life in Augmented Reality with AI-Powered Talking Characters

works.title_zh: 会说话的日常物件：AI 驱动的 AR 角色

works.title: Sketch2Terrain
works.description: A person draws a few freehand 3D strokes in AR and a generative model turns them into a complete terrain with hills and valleys in real time.
works.description_zh: 人在 AR 中徒手画几笔三维线条，生成模型就实时把它们变成带有山丘与山谷的完整地形。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation from sketches gives non-experts a way to externalize remembered landscapes, and gives researchers one uniform setup to collect that data.
works.idea_zh: 从草图实时生成地形，让非专业者能把记忆中的地貌表达出来，也为研究者提供统一的数据采集环境。
works.method: Freehand AR strokes condition a generative terrain model that outputs elevation meshes in real time; a between-subjects study (N=36) compared it with conventional sketch mapping.
works.method_zh: 以徒手 AR 笔画为条件，生成式地形模型实时输出高程网格；被试间研究（N=36）将其与传统草图地图比较。

paper.title: Sketch2Terrain: AI-Driven Real-Time Terrain Sketch Mapping in Augmented Reality

works.title: Generative-AI earthquake rehearsal overlaid on a real room
works.description: From a single photo of a real room, a generative video model creates an earthquake scenario with falling ceiling panels; it is converted to spatial video and overlaid on the same room in Apple Vision Pro, with rewind and slow motion.
works.description_zh: 仅凭一张真实房间的照片，生成视频模型就制作出天花板面板掉落的地震情境；视频被转为空间视频，在 Apple Vision Pro 中叠加到同一个房间，并可倒放和慢放。
works.idea_en: Stages a dangerous event inside the very room where people would have to respond, with adjustable severity and replay.
works.idea_zh: 把危险事件“搬进”人们真正需要应对的那个房间，并可调节严重程度、反复回放。
works.method: Image-to-video generation from a photo of the room, with the degree of ceiling-panel collapse adjusted, then conversion to stereo spatial video aligned with the physical room.
works.method_zh: 以房间照片做图生视频，调整天花板面板掉落的程度，再转为与实体房间对齐的立体空间视频。
works.title_zh: 叠加在真实房间里的生成式 AI 地震演练

works.title: AvatarFX
works.description: AvatarFX lets Character.AI users turn a character image into a video of it speaking, singing or emoting with a chosen voice, for human, animal and stylized characters, inside the Character.AI app.
works.description_zh: AvatarFX 让 Character.AI 用户在应用内把角色图像变成该角色用选定声音说话、唱歌或表达情绪的视频，适用于人类、动物和风格化角色。
works.idea_en: Brought face video to a mass companion-chat platform, together with the safety questions (minors, impersonation) that follow.
works.idea_zh: 把会动的脸带进大众陪伴聊天平台，也带来了随之而来的安全问题（未成年人、冒充）。
works.method: A DiT-based diffusion video model with audio conditioning (per Character.AI's announcement; architecture details unpublished).
works.method_zh: 据 Character.AI 的发布说明，是一个带音频条件的 DiT 扩散视频模型（架构细节未公开）。

works.title: MAGI-1
works.description: Sand AI's MAGI-1 (2025-04-21) is an open 24-billion-parameter autoregressive video model that generates video chunk by chunk, enabling streaming output, unlimited extension and prompt changes per chunk. Sand AI followed with MAGI-2 Preview (2026-08-05), an open 114-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 6 billion active parameters that generates 10-second clips with sound.
works.description_zh: Sand AI 的 MAGI-1（2025-04-21）是 240 亿参数的开源自回归视频模型，逐块生成视频，支持流式输出、无限延展和逐块更换提示。Sand AI 随后于 2026-08-05 发布 MAGI-2 Preview：开源的 1140 亿参数混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 60 亿参数，可生成带声音的 10 秒片段。
works.idea_en: Chunk-wise autoregression gives second-by-second control over how a scene unfolds.
works.idea_zh: 分块自回归让人能逐秒控制场景如何展开。
works.method: Autoregressive denoising over 24-frame chunks, with later chunks kept noisier while earlier ones are refined, on a transformer-based VAE.
works.method_zh: 以 24 帧为一块进行自回归去噪，越靠后的块噪声越高、前面的块逐步细化，配合基于 Transformer 的 VAE。

paper.title: MAGI-1: Autoregressive Video Generation at Scale

works.title: OmniAudio
works.description: Generates first-order ambisonics from 360° video, so the soundscape of a panoramic clip matches what surrounds the viewer in every direction. The authors built Sphere360, a dataset of over 103,000 real 360° clips with spatial audio.
works.description_zh: 根据 360° 视频生成一阶全景声，使全景片段的声景在各个方向上都与观看者周围的画面一致。作者构建了 Sphere360 数据集，包含 10.3 万多段带空间音频的真实 360° 片段。
works.idea_en: Pairs naturally with generated 360° video: turns a watched panorama into a place that is also spatially audible.
works.idea_zh: 与生成的 360° 视频天然配合：让一段被观看的全景画面变成一个在听觉上也有空间感的地方。
works.method: Self-supervised flow-matching pre-training on spatial and non-spatial audio, followed by dual-branch conditioning on panoramic and field-of-view video features.
works.method_zh: 先在空间与非空间音频上做自监督流匹配预训练，再用全景视频与视野视频特征的双分支进行条件生成。

paper.title: OmniAudio: Generating Spatial Audio from 360-Degree Video

works.title_zh: OmniAudio：从 360° 视频生成空间音频

works.title: SkyReels-V2
works.description: Skywork's SkyReels-V2 (2025-04) is an open 'infinite-length film' model that keeps extending a video while holding shots consistent, trained with film-grammar annotations. Skywork released SkyReels V3, which adds multi-subject reference-to-video, audio-guided and video-to-video generation, as open weights on 2026-01-29.
works.description_zh: 昆仑万维 Skywork 的 SkyReels-V2（2025 年 4 月）是开源的“无限时长电影”模型，可在保持镜头一致的同时不断延展视频，训练时使用了电影语法标注。Skywork 于 2026-01-29 以开源权重发布 SkyReels V3，新增多主体参考生视频、音频引导生成与视频到视频生成。
works.idea_en: Diffusion forcing turns a clip model into a continuous storyteller, though drift still accumulates over minutes.
works.idea_zh: 扩散强制（diffusion forcing）把片段模型变成连续讲故事的模型，但时长到数分钟时漂移仍会累积。
works.method: Diffusion-forcing framework (per-token noise levels) with a multimodal captioner (SkyCaptioner) for shot language and reinforcement learning for motion quality.
works.method_zh: 采用扩散强制框架（每个 token 噪声水平不同），用多模态字幕模型 SkyCaptioner 标注镜头语言，并用强化学习提升运动质量。

paper.title: SkyReels-V2: Infinite-length Film Generative Model

works.title: FramePack
works.description: FramePack (Lvmin Zhang and Maneesh Agrawala, Stanford, 2025-04) generates one- to two-minute image-to-video clips on a 6 GB laptop GPU by compressing past frames into a fixed-size context.
works.description_zh: FramePack（斯坦福的张吕敏与 Maneesh Agrawala，2025 年 4 月）把历史帧压缩进固定大小的上下文，从而在 6 GB 显存的笔记本 GPU 上生成 1–2 分钟的图生视频。
works.idea_en: Constant memory regardless of length makes long takes possible on ordinary hardware.
works.idea_zh: 无论视频多长，显存占用都恒定，普通硬件也能生成长镜头。
works.method: Next-frame-section prediction with progressive context packing (older frames get fewer tokens) and anti-drifting bidirectional sampling, on a HunyuanVideo backbone.
works.method_zh: 下一帧段预测，配合渐进式上下文打包（越早的帧分到越少的 token）和防漂移的双向采样，以 HunyuanVideo 为主干。

paper.title: Packing Input Frame Context in Next-Frame Prediction Models for Video Generation

works.title: UniRig
works.description: Unified auto-rigging model from Tsinghua University and VAST that generates topologically valid skeletons and skinning weights for humans, animals and other characters with very different skeleton structures.
works.description_zh: 清华大学与 VAST 合作的统一自动绑定模型，可为人类、动物以及骨架结构差异很大的其他角色生成拓扑正确的骨架和蒙皮权重。
works.idea_en: One model for every kind of creature, which matters once generators produce arbitrary characters rather than only humanoids.
works.idea_zh: 一个模型适用于各种生物——当生成器产出的不再只是人形角色时，这一点很关键。
works.method: An autoregressive transformer with Skeleton Tree Tokenization generates the bone hierarchy and a bone-point cross-attention module predicts skinning weights; trained on Rig-XL, 14,000+ rigged models.
works.method_zh: 采用“骨架树分词”的自回归 Transformer 生成骨骼层级，骨骼—点交叉注意力模块预测蒙皮权重；在包含 1.4 万多个已绑定模型的 Rig-XL 上训练。

paper.title: One Model to Rig Them All: Diverse Skeleton Rigging with UniRig

works.title: WorldMem
works.description: A world model with an explicit memory bank: when a player in Minecraft turns back to a place built or seen earlier, the model retrieves stored frames and their poses and regenerates the place consistently, including changes made over time.
works.description_zh: 一个带显式记忆库的世界模型：当 Minecraft 玩家回头看向先前建造或见过的地方时，模型会调取存储的画面及其位姿，一致地重新生成该处，包括随时间发生的变化。
works.idea_en: Persistence can be engineered: store what was seen with where and when, and look it up instead of hoping the model remembers.
works.idea_zh: 持久性可以被工程化：把看到的内容连同位置和时间一起存下来，需要时去查，而不是指望模型自己记得。
works.method: A memory bank of past frames tagged with camera poses and timestamps, read by a memory-attention module inside a video diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 存储带有相机位姿与时间戳的历史帧的记忆库，由视频扩散模型中的记忆注意力模块读取。

paper.title: WorldMem: Long-term Consistent World Simulation with Memory

works.title_zh: WorldMem：带记忆的长期一致世界模拟

works.title: VideoPanda
works.description: VideoPanda (NVIDIA Toronto AI Lab, 2025-04) generates 360° videos from a text prompt or from one ordinary video by producing consistent views in every direction and combining them into a panorama, and can continue them autoregressively into longer clips.
works.description_zh: VideoPanda（NVIDIA 多伦多 AI 实验室，2025 年 4 月）可根据文字提示或一段普通视频生成 360° 视频：它生成各个方向上一致的视图并拼成全景，还能以自回归方式延长成更长的片段。
works.idea_en: A single filmed view or a sentence can become a surround scene for a headset, the immersive counterpart of text-to-video.
works.idea_zh: 一个拍摄视角或一句话就能变成头显中的环绕场景，相当于文生视频的沉浸版。
works.method: A video diffusion model extended with multi-view attention layers, trained jointly on text-only and single-view-video conditions with random subsampling of frames and views.
works.method_zh: 在视频扩散模型中加入多视角注意力层，在纯文字与单视角视频两种条件下联合训练，并对帧与视角随机下采样。

paper.title: VideoPanda: Video Panoramic Diffusion with Multi-view Attention

works.title_zh: VideoPanda：基于多视角注意力的全景视频扩散

works.title: MineWorld
works.description: Microsoft Research's real-time interactive world model of Minecraft: from game frames and keyboard and mouse actions it generates the next scenes fast enough to play in a web demo; the code is open, but the checkpoints on Hugging Face were taken down in May 2025.
works.description_zh: 微软研究院的 Minecraft 实时交互世界模型：根据游戏画面与键鼠动作生成后续场景，速度足以在网页演示中游玩；代码开源，但 Hugging Face 上的模型权重已于 2025 年 5 月下架。
works.idea_en: A reminder that open releases can be withdrawn: a lab building on a world model needs its own copy and version record.
works.idea_zh: 提醒人们开源发布也可能被撤回：基于某个世界模型开展研究的实验室，需要保存自己的副本与版本记录。
works.method: A visual-action autoregressive transformer over interleaved discrete image and action tokens trained by next-token prediction, with a parallel decoding algorithm that predicts spatially redundant tokens of a frame at once.
works.method_zh: 一个视觉–动作自回归 Transformer，以交错排列的离散图像 token 与动作 token 为输入，按下一个 token 预测训练，并用并行解码算法一次预测同一帧中空间上冗余的 token。

paper.title: MineWorld: a Real-Time and Open-Source Interactive World Model on Minecraft

works.title: Gemini API video generation (Veo, Omni)
works.description: Google's Gemini API and Vertex AI (documented in 2026 as the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) serve DeepMind's video models as versioned endpoints: Veo 2 from April 2025, Veo 3 and 3.1 with native audio, 4K output from January 2026 and Veo 3.1 Lite from March 2026. In 2026 Google added Gemini Omni Flash, a conversational video generation and editing model (preview 2026-06-30, GA 2026-08-27).
works.description_zh: Google 的 Gemini API 与 Vertex AI（2026 年文档中称 Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform）以带版本号的接口提供 DeepMind 视频模型：2025 年 4 月起提供 Veo 2，之后是带原生音频的 Veo 3 与 3.1，2026 年 1 月起支持 4K 输出，2026 年 3 月推出 Veo 3.1 Lite。2026 年 Google 又加入了可对话式生成与编辑视频的 Gemini Omni Flash（2026-06-30 预览，2026-08-27 正式发布）。
works.idea_en: The most complete hosted video stack for labs: model ids you can pin, preview-to-GA lifecycles you can track, and shutdown notices that tell you when a stimulus model will go away.
works.idea_zh: 对实验室来说最完整的托管视频技术栈：模型 ID 可以锁定，从预览到正式发布的生命周期可以追踪，下线通知也会提前告诉你某个刺激生成模型何时停用。
works.method: Long-running prediction operations on model ids such as veo-3.1-generate-preview and gemini-omni-1.1-flash; Google marks Veo output with SynthID watermarks.
works.method_zh: 通过长时运行的预测操作调用 veo-3.1-generate-preview、gemini-omni-1.1-flash 等模型 ID；Google 会给 Veo 输出加上 SynthID 水印。
works.specs: Veo 3.1: 4 / 6 / 8 s · 720p–4K · native audio · Omni Flash: 360p–4K, extend, first + last frame
works.title_zh: Gemini API 视频生成（Veo / Omni）

works.title: Amazon Nova Sonic
works.description: A speech-to-speech foundation model on Amazon Bedrock that streams conversation in both directions, adapts its delivery to the speaker's tone and handles users talking over it. Nova 2 Sonic followed in December 2025.
works.description_zh: Amazon Bedrock 上的语音到语音基础模型，双向流式对话，能根据说话人的语气调整表达，也能处理用户插话。Nova 2 Sonic 于 2025 年 12 月推出。
works.idea_en: Brings speech-to-speech agents with tool use into an enterprise cloud, relevant for institutions bound to AWS for data governance.
works.idea_zh: 把会调用工具的语音到语音智能体带进企业云，对受数据治理要求限制、只能使用 AWS 的机构很有意义。
works.method: Unified speech understanding and generation model served through Bedrock's bidirectional streaming API with barge-in.
works.method_zh: 统一的语音理解与生成模型，通过 Bedrock 的双向流式 API 提供，支持插话打断。

works.title: WHAMM
works.description: A real-time playable AI rendition of a Quake II level in Copilot Labs, generated from controller input at 640×360; Microsoft notes it forgets objects that leave view for about a second and has noticeable latency; the project page now lists it as WHAM-RT.
works.description_zh: 在 Copilot Labs 中推出的《雷神之锤 II》关卡实时 AI 版本，根据手柄输入以 640×360 生成画面；微软指出，物体离开视野约一秒后就会被遗忘，延迟也较明显；项目页面现将其称为 WHAM-RT。
works.idea_en: Shows how little data is needed to clone one level, and how short the memory of such a clone is.
works.idea_zh: 展示了复刻一个关卡所需的数据少得惊人，也展示了这种复刻的记忆有多短暂。
works.method: A MaskGIT-style World and Human Action model that generates image tokens in parallel, trained on one week of curated Quake II play with a 0.9-second (9-frame) context.
works.method_zh: MaskGIT 式的世界与人类动作模型，可并行生成图像 token；训练数据仅为一周经过精选的《雷神之锤 II》游玩录像，上下文长度为 0.9 秒（9 帧）。

works.title: WorldScore
works.description: A unified benchmark for world generation from Stanford that evaluates 3D scene generators, 4D generators and video models on the same task: generate a sequence of scenes that follows layout and camera-trajectory instructions. It scores controllability, quality and dynamics on 3,000 test examples and keeps a public leaderboard; the paper evaluates 19 models.
works.description_zh: 斯坦福提出的世界生成统一基准，让三维场景生成器、4D 生成器与视频模型在同一任务上接受评测：按布局与镜头轨迹指令生成一连串场景。它在 3,000 个测试样例上从可控性、质量与动态三方面打分，并维护公开排行榜；论文评测了 19 个模型。
works.idea_en: Puts video models and explicit 3D generators on one scale for camera control and consistency, the comparison that matters when choosing a route to an explorable world.
works.idea_zh: 把视频模型与显式三维生成器放在同一把尺子上比较镜头控制与一致性；在选择通往可探索世界的技术路线时，正需要这种比较。
works.method: World generation decomposed into next-scene tasks with explicit camera-trajectory layouts, scored by automatic metrics for camera and object control, content alignment, 3D and photometric consistency, style, subjective quality and motion.
works.method_zh: 把世界生成拆解为带显式镜头轨迹布局的“下一个场景”任务，由自动指标评估镜头与物体控制、内容对齐、三维与光度一致性、风格、主观质量与运动。

paper.title: WorldScore: A Unified Evaluation Benchmark for World Generation

works.title: BlenderMCP
works.description: An open-source add-on and Model Context Protocol server that lets Claude and other language models inspect and edit a live Blender scene: creating and placing objects, applying materials, pulling Poly Haven assets and calling 3D generators.
works.description_zh: 开源插件与 Model Context Protocol 服务器，让 Claude 等语言模型可以查看并编辑正在运行的 Blender 场景：创建和摆放物体、应用材质、调用 Poly Haven 资产以及三维生成服务。
works.idea_en: Scene building by conversation inside a professional tool: the language model writes the code, the person keeps the file.
works.idea_zh: 在专业工具中通过对话搭建场景：语言模型写代码，人保留文件。
works.method: A Blender add-on opens a socket server; an MCP server exposes tools (scene inspection, object creation, Python execution, asset search) that the language model calls turn by turn.
works.method_zh: Blender 插件开启一个套接字服务；MCP 服务器把场景查看、物体创建、Python 执行、资产搜索等功能暴露为工具，由语言模型逐轮调用。

works.title: Gen-4
works.description: Gen-4 (2025-03-31) keeps characters, objects and locations consistent across shots from a single reference image, so the same person can appear in different lighting and settings.
works.description_zh: Gen-4（2025-03-31）只需一张参考图即可在多个镜头间保持角色、物体与场景一致，同一个人可以出现在不同光照和场景中。
works.idea_en: Identity that holds across shots is what turns isolated clips into a scenario with recurring characters.
works.idea_zh: 跨镜头保持身份一致，是把零散片段变成有固定角色的情境的关键。
works.method: Image-to-video diffusion with visual reference conditioning ('References') for identity and style; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 带视觉参考（References）条件的图生视频扩散模型，用参考图约束身份与风格；架构未公开。

works.title: MoCha
works.description: MoCha generates movie-style "talking characters" directly from speech and a text prompt: not just a face but the whole framed character, with gestures and actions, and with structured prompts it stages turn-based conversations between two or more characters across shots.
works.description_zh: MoCha 直接根据语音和文本提示生成电影风格的“说话角色”：不仅是脸，而是画面中的整个角色，包括手势和动作；借助结构化提示，它还能跨镜头编排两个或更多角色之间的轮流对话。
works.idea_en: Generates the social scene, not only the speaker: two generated people trading lines is the material for scripted vignettes in behavioural studies.
works.idea_zh: 生成的是社交场景，而不只是说话的人：两个生成的人物你来我往地对话，正是行为研究中剧本化情景片段的素材。
works.method: A diffusion transformer video model with speech-video window attention that aligns speech and video tokens, trained jointly on speech-labelled and text-labelled video, with character-tagged prompt templates for multi-character dialogue.
works.method_zh: 一个扩散 Transformer 视频模型，用语音-视频窗口注意力对齐语音与视频 token，在带语音标注和带文本标注的视频上联合训练，并用带角色标签的提示模板实现多角色对话。

paper.title: MoCha: Towards Movie-Grade Talking Character Synthesis

works.title_zh: MoCha：迈向电影级说话角色生成

works.title: Introducing The Virtual Burglary Project – Pennsylvania (VBPP): An Open Access Virtual Reality Environment for Criminology Research
works.description: Paper that releases two open-access virtual neighborhoods from the Pennsylvania arm of the Virtual Burglary Project, built to study burglary-related behavior, emotion and cognition and reusable by other criminologists.
works.description_zh: 该论文公开了虚拟入室盗窃项目宾夕法尼亚分支的两个开放获取虚拟街区，用于研究与盗窃相关的行为、情绪与认知，其他犯罪学者也可直接复用。
works.idea_en: Shared, open virtual stimuli let different labs run the same situation, the replication infrastructure generated scenarios will also need.
works.idea_zh: 共享、开放的虚拟刺激材料让不同实验室能运行同一情境——生成式情境同样需要这样的复现基础设施。
works.method: Description of two VR neighborhoods, their adjustable features and data logging, with example research questions; the project ran VR burglary tasks in US prisons.
works.method_zh: 介绍两个 VR 街区及其可调整的要素与数据记录方式，并给出研究问题示例；该项目曾在美国监狱中开展 VR 盗窃任务。

paper.title: Introducing The Virtual Burglary Project – Pennsylvania (VBPP): An Open Access Virtual Reality Environment for Criminology Research

works.title_zh: 虚拟入室盗窃项目——宾夕法尼亚（VBPP）：面向犯罪学研究的开放获取虚拟现实环境

works.title: VBench-2.0
works.description: A follow-up benchmark that tests 'intrinsic faithfulness' rather than surface quality: 18 dimensions grouped into human fidelity, controllability, creativity, physics and commonsense, scored with vision-language models, LLMs and anomaly detectors.
works.description_zh: VBench 的后续基准，检验的是“内在可信度”而非表面画质：18 个维度分为人物保真、可控性、创造力、物理与常识五类，由视觉语言模型、大语言模型与异常检测器打分。
works.idea_en: Asks whether generated events obey physics and common sense, the properties that decide whether a generated situation is behaviorally plausible.
works.idea_zh: 它追问生成的事件是否符合物理与常识，而这正决定了一个生成情境在行为上是否可信。
works.method: Dimension-specific prompt sets evaluated by VLM / LLM judges and specialist detectors, with agreement checked against human annotations.
works.method_zh: 按维度设计的提示集，由视觉语言模型 / 大语言模型评审与专用检测器评估，并与人类标注对照检验一致性。

paper.title: VBench-2.0: Advancing Video Generation Benchmark Suite for Intrinsic Faithfulness

works.title: Free4D
works.description: Free4D builds a 4D Gaussian scene from a single image or a text prompt, so a still scene comes alive and can be explored from new viewpoints while it moves, without training a dedicated model.
works.description_zh: Free4D 能从一张图像或一句文字构建 4D 高斯场景，让静态画面动起来，并可在运动过程中从新视角探索，且无需训练专门模型。
works.idea_en: Distils existing image-to-video and multi-view models into a consistent 4D scene, so scene-level 4D does not have to wait for large 4D training sets.
works.idea_zh: 把现有的图生视频与多视角模型蒸馏成一致的 4D 场景，使场景级 4D 不必等待大规模 4D 训练数据。
works.method: The image is animated with an image-to-video model and a coarse 4D structure is initialised; consistent multi-view videos are generated with adaptive guidance and latent replacement, and a 4D Gaussian representation is optimised with modulation-based refinement.
works.method_zh: 先用图生视频模型让图像动起来并初始化粗略的 4D 结构；再通过自适应引导与潜变量替换生成一致的多视角视频，最后以基于调制的细化优化 4D 高斯表示。

paper.title: Free4D: Tuning-free 4D Scene Generation with Spatial-Temporal Consistency

works.title_zh: Free4D 免训练 4D 场景生成

works.title: GAIA-2
works.description: A generative driving world model that produces consistent multi-camera driving video from structured inputs such as ego-vehicle motion, other agents, weather, time of day and road layout, across UK, US and German roads; it followed GAIA-1 (2023).
works.description_zh: 一个生成式驾驶世界模型：根据自车运动、其他交通参与者、天气、时间与道路布局等结构化输入，生成一致的多摄像头驾驶视频，覆盖英国、美国与德国的道路；它是 GAIA-1（2023）的后继。
works.idea_en: Rare and dangerous traffic situations can be specified as parameters and generated on demand, a template for scenario-controlled studies.
works.idea_zh: 罕见且危险的交通情境可以用参数指定、按需生成，为情境可控的研究提供了范本。
works.method: A latent diffusion world model with a dedicated video tokenizer and rich structured conditioning (ego dynamics, agent configurations, environment, road semantics) plus external driving-model embeddings.
works.method_zh: 潜空间扩散世界模型，配有专用视频分词器和丰富的结构化条件（自车动力学、交通参与者配置、环境、道路语义），并可接入外部驾驶模型的嵌入。

paper.title: GAIA-2: A Controllable Multi-View Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

works.title: Aether
works.description: Shanghai AI Lab's Aether is an open world model that reconstructs a video as moving 3D geometry with camera paths, predicts future video from an image and a camera trajectory, and plans a path between a start and a goal image.
works.description_zh: 上海人工智能实验室的 Aether 是一个开源世界模型：能把视频重建为带相机轨迹的运动三维几何，根据图像与相机轨迹预测未来视频，并在起始图像与目标图像之间规划路径。
works.idea_en: A world model whose predictions come with 4D geometry, so what it imagines can be checked and measured in 3D rather than judged as pixels.
works.idea_zh: 一个预测结果自带 4D 几何的世界模型，它“想象”出的内容可以在三维中检查和度量，而不只是看像素。
works.method: A video diffusion model (CogVideoX) is post-trained to output video, depth and camera raymaps jointly for reconstruction, action-conditioned prediction and goal-conditioned planning, using only synthetic 4D data; the authors report zero-shot transfer to real videos.
works.method_zh: 对视频扩散模型（CogVideoX）进行后训练，使其联合输出视频、深度与相机射线图，用于重建、动作条件预测与目标条件规划；只使用合成 4D 数据，作者称可零样本迁移到真实视频。

paper.title: Aether: Geometric-Aware Unified World Modeling

works.title_zh: Aether 几何感知的统一世界模型

works.title: SV4D 2.0
works.description: SV4D 2.0 improves Stability AI's video-to-4D model with sharper, more consistent multi-view videos that hold up better under large motion and can be optimised into 4D assets.
works.description_zh: SV4D 2.0 改进了 Stability AI 的视频到 4D 模型，生成的多视角视频更清晰、更一致，在大幅运动下也更稳定，并可被优化为 4D 资产。
works.idea_en: Shows the open-weight object-4D line maturing toward usable animated assets.
works.idea_zh: 说明开放权重的物体级 4D 路线正走向可用的动画资产。
works.method: Blended 3D and frame attention without reference multi-views, more and cleaner animated training data and progressive 3D-to-4D training improve consistency; outputs are refined in a two-stage 4D optimisation.
works.method_zh: 融合三维注意力与帧注意力且不再依赖参考多视角，使用更多更干净的动画训练数据，并采用由 3D 到 4D 的渐进训练来提升一致性，输出再经两阶段 4D 优化细化。

paper.title: SV4D 2.0: Enhancing Spatio-Temporal Consistency in Multi-View Video Diffusion for High-Quality 4D Generation

works.title: Bolt3D
works.description: Generates a 3D Gaussian-splat scene from one or a few images in under seven seconds on a single GPU, without per-scene optimisation.
works.description_zh: 从一张或几张图像出发，在单张 GPU 上不到七秒就生成三维高斯泼溅场景，无需逐场景优化。
works.idea_en: Direct sampling of 3D, rather than of images to be reconstructed later, is what brings scene generation down to seconds.
works.idea_zh: 直接采样三维表示，而不是先生成图像再重建，才让场景生成缩短到几秒。
works.method: A latent diffusion model built on 2D diffusion architectures directly outputs splatter-image-style 3D Gaussians and geometry, trained on a large multi-view dataset whose geometry was densely reconstructed beforehand.
works.method_zh: 基于二维扩散架构的潜空间扩散模型，直接输出类似 Splatter Image 的三维高斯与几何；训练数据是一个预先做过稠密重建的大规模多视角数据集。
works.specs: < 7 s per scene on one GPU · up to 300× lower inference cost than optimisation-based methods (authors)

paper.title: Bolt3D: Generating 3D Scenes in Seconds

works.title: Stable Virtual Camera
works.description: Stability AI's open view-synthesis model: from one or more photos and any target camera path (orbits, spirals, dolly zooms), it generates 3D-consistent novel views and smooth videos up to about half a minute long, with loop closure.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 的开源视图合成模型：给定一张或多张照片以及任意目标镜头路径（环绕、螺旋、滑动变焦等），即可生成三维一致的新视角和最长约半分钟、首尾闭合的流畅视频。
works.idea_en: A scene can be 'filmed' along an exact camera path from a handful of photos without building 3D at all, useful for standardised stimulus videos.
works.idea_zh: 仅凭几张照片就能沿精确的镜头路径“拍摄”一个场景，完全不必先建三维，适合制作标准化的刺激视频。
works.method: A 1.3B-parameter multi-view diffusion model conditioned on input views and target camera rays, with a two-pass procedural sampling strategy for long trajectories, without 3D distillation.
works.method_zh: 13 亿参数的多视角扩散模型，以输入视图和目标相机射线为条件，长轨迹采用两轮程序化采样，不需要三维蒸馏。

paper.title: Stable Virtual Camera: Generative View Synthesis with Diffusion Models

works.title: Cube 3D
works.description: The first open-source part of Roblox's Cube 3D foundation model: text-to-shape generation available in Roblox Studio and through an in-game API, so creators and their games can generate meshes from prompts.
works.description_zh: Roblox Cube 三维基础模型首个开源部分：文字生成形状，可在 Roblox Studio 中使用，也能通过游戏内 API 调用，让创作者和他们的游戏都能由提示词生成网格。
works.idea_en: Treats 3D shapes as tokens a language model can read and write, a step toward one model that generates objects, scenes, rigs and scripts for a game platform.
works.idea_zh: 把三维形状当作语言模型能读写的词元，朝着一个能为游戏平台生成物体、场景、绑定和脚本的统一模型迈出一步。
works.method: A 3D shape tokenizer converts meshes into discrete tokens; an autoregressive transformer generates shape tokens from text, which are decoded back into meshes, and the same tokens support shape-to-text and LLM-assisted text-to-scene.
works.method_zh: 三维形状分词器把网格转成离散词元；自回归 Transformer 由文字生成形状词元并解码回网格，同一套词元还支持形状转文字以及借助大语言模型的文字生成场景。

paper.title: Cube: A Roblox View of 3D Intelligence

works.title: MR + Diffusion passthrough prototype
works.description: A Quest mixed-reality prototype reads the passthrough camera and replaces parts of the room with diffusion-generated imagery that stays in place as the wearer looks around.
works.description_zh: 一个 Quest 混合现实原型读取透视摄像头画面，用扩散模型生成的图像替换房间的部分区域，佩戴者环顾四周时这些图像保持在原位。
works.idea_en: One of the first diffusion-on-passthrough demos after Meta opened the Passthrough Camera API in 2025.
works.idea_zh: Meta 在 2025 年开放透视摄像头 API 之后最早的扩散模型叠加透视演示之一。
works.method: Frames from Meta's Passthrough Camera API are sent to an image diffusion model and the results are re-projected onto the matching surfaces of the room.
works.method_zh: 把 Meta 透视摄像头 API 获取的画面送入图像扩散模型，再把生成结果重新投射到房间中对应的表面上。
works.title_zh: 混合现实 + 扩散模型透视原型

works.title: ReCamMaster
works.description: ReCamMaster (2025-03-14, Zhejiang University with Kuaishou's Kling team) re-renders an existing video along a new camera trajectory, producing the same dynamic scene from a different viewpoint.
works.description_zh: ReCamMaster（2025-03-14，浙江大学与快手可灵团队）可沿新的镜头轨迹重新渲染已有视频，从不同视角呈现同一动态场景。
works.idea_en: Re-shooting a recorded event from a new angle is a step toward free-viewpoint video without 3D capture.
works.idea_zh: 从新角度“重拍”已录下的事件，是不经三维采集就迈向自由视点视频的一步。
works.method: Conditions a pretrained text-to-video model on the source video by frame-dimension concatenation, trained on a synchronized multi-camera dataset rendered in Unreal Engine 5.
works.method_zh: 在帧维度拼接源视频，以此条件化预训练文生视频模型；训练数据是用虚幻引擎 5 渲染的多机位同步数据集。

paper.title: ReCamMaster: Camera-Controlled Generative Rendering from A Single Video

works.title: VGGT
works.description: VGGT (Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer) takes one to hundreds of images and, in a single forward pass of about a second, predicts every camera, depth map, point map and point track.
works.description_zh: VGGT（视觉几何基础 Transformer）输入一张到数百张图像，在约一秒的单次前向中预测出所有相机、深度图、点图和点轨迹。
works.idea_en: Made one network pass the default first step for turning photos or a video into a 3D scene.
works.idea_zh: 让一次网络前向成为把照片或视频变成三维场景的默认第一步。
works.method: A 1.2B-parameter transformer alternates frame-wise and global attention over DINO patch tokens and decodes camera, depth, point and tracking heads, trained on many 3D datasets.
works.method_zh: 一个 12 亿参数的 Transformer 在 DINO 图块标记上交替进行帧内与全局注意力，并解码出相机、深度、点图与追踪等预测头，在大量三维数据集上训练。
works.specs: 1.2B parameters · up to hundreds of views · under 1 s per scene (paper)

paper.title: VGGT: Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer

works.title: LHM
works.description: LHM (Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model) turns a single full-body photo into an animatable 3D Gaussian avatar in seconds, keeping clothing and face detail, which can then be driven by motion extracted from a video. Its successor LHM++, open-sourced in March 2026, accepts any number of views and runs 8-view input on 8 GB of GPU memory.
works.description_zh: LHM（大型可动画人体重建模型）能在几秒内把一张全身照片变成可驱动的三维高斯化身，保留服装和面部细节，并可用从视频中提取的动作来驱动。其后继版本 LHM++ 于 2026 年 3 月开源，支持任意数量的视角输入，8 视角输入只需 8 GB 显存。
works.idea_en: Any photographed person, including a specific confederate or the participant, can become a full-body 3D character for a scene in seconds.
works.idea_zh: 任何被拍下的人，包括特定的实验助手或参与者本人，都能在几秒内成为场景中的全身三维角色。
works.method: A multimodal transformer encodes body positional features and image features with attention, adds a head-feature pyramid for face identity, and predicts 3D Gaussians in a canonical pose in one feed-forward pass, animated by SMPL-X-based skinning.
works.method_zh: 多模态 Transformer 用注意力编码人体位置特征和图像特征，并加入头部特征金字塔以保留面部身份，一次前馈即可预测标准姿态下的三维高斯，再通过基于 SMPL-X 的蒙皮驱动。
works.specs: single image → animatable 3D Gaussian human in seconds · LHM++ (open-sourced 2026-03): any-view input, 8 views on 8 GB GPU

paper.title: LHM: Large Animatable Human Reconstruction Model from a Single Image in Seconds

works.title_zh: LHM：数秒内从单张图像重建可动画人体

works.title: Character-3
works.description: Character-3 animates any character image (photo, illustration, 3D render) into a talking or singing video from audio and a text prompt that sets emotion and body movement, inside the Hedra Studio app. Hedra followed it in February 2026 with Omnia, which adds camera, body-motion and background direction from a single image, and an Avatar model for takes of up to five minutes, both also available through its API.
works.description_zh: Character-3 能把任意角色图像（照片、插画、三维渲染）根据音频和设定情绪与肢体动作的文本提示，变成说话或唱歌的视频，在 Hedra Studio 应用中使用。2026 年 2 月，Hedra 推出后继模型 Omnia，可从单张图像控制镜头、身体动作和背景，同时推出可一次生成最长五分钟视频的 Avatar 模型，两者均可通过 API 使用。
works.idea_en: Made audio-driven character video a creator tool used at scale, including for non-human and stylized characters.
works.idea_zh: 让音频驱动的角色视频成为大规模使用的创作工具，也适用于非人类和风格化角色。
works.method: An 'omnimodal' video model that jointly conditions on image, text and audio (architecture not published).
works.method_zh: 一个同时以图像、文本和音频为条件的“全模态”视频模型（架构未公开）。

works.title: VACE
works.description: VACE (paper 2025-03-10; open weights on Wan 2.1 in May 2025) is Alibaba's all-in-one model for reference-to-video, video-to-video and masked editing: move, swap, expand or animate anything in a clip with one network.
works.description_zh: VACE（论文 2025-03-10；2025 年 5 月基于 Wan 2.1 开源权重）是阿里巴巴的一体化模型，涵盖参考生视频、视频到视频和遮罩编辑：用同一个网络移动、替换、扩展或驱动片段中的任意对象。
works.idea_en: Combining pose, depth, mask and reference conditions in one open model gives labs fine-grained, reproducible control over generated stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 在一个开源模型中组合姿态、深度、遮罩与参考条件，实验室可以对生成刺激进行细粒度、可复现的控制。
works.method: A Video Condition Unit packs text, frames and masks into one input that is injected into a diffusion transformer through context adapters.
works.method_zh: 用视频条件单元（VCU）把文本、帧和遮罩打包成统一输入，经上下文适配器（Context Adapter）注入扩散 Transformer。

paper.title: VACE: All-in-One Video Creation and Editing

works.title: Full-Duplex-Bench
works.description: An open benchmark suite for full-duplex spoken dialogue models from National Taiwan University and UC Berkeley that scores pause handling, backchanneling, smooth turn-taking and user interruption (v1, ASRU 2025). Later versions add overlapping speech (v1.5), live multi-turn sessions with an automated AI examiner over WebRTC (v2) and tool use under real disfluent speech (v3, 2026); Artificial Analysis uses part of it for the conversational-dynamics score in its Speech to Speech Index.
works.description_zh: 台湾大学与加州大学伯克利分校推出的开源全双工口语对话模型评测套件，评估停顿处理、附和回应、顺畅的轮流发言与用户打断（v1，ASRU 2025）。后续版本加入重叠语音（v1.5）、通过 WebRTC 由自动 AI 考官主持的实时多轮会话（v2），以及在真实不流利语音下的工具调用（v3，2026 年）；Artificial Analysis 在其 Speech to Speech Index 中用它的一部分来评“对话动态”。
works.idea_en: Turns 'does it feel like a conversation?' into numbers a lab can rerun: when the model waits, when it backchannels and when it yields.
works.idea_zh: 把“这像不像一场对话”变成实验室可以复现的数字：模型何时等待、何时附和、何时让出话轮。
works.method: Pre-recorded and, from v2, live user audio is streamed to the model; automatic metrics on time-aligned transcripts (takeover rate, latency, backchannel frequency) score each behavior, and v2 adds an LLM examiner that converses with the model and grades it.
works.method_zh: 把预先录制的（从 v2 起也包括实时的）用户音频流式输入模型，基于时间对齐转写的自动指标（接管率、延迟、附和频率）为每种行为打分；v2 另加一个与模型对话并评分的大语言模型考官。
works.specs: v1 (2025-03) · v1.5 (2025-07) · v2 (2025-10, WebRTC examiner) · v3 (2026-04, tool use + disfluency)

paper.title: Full-Duplex-Bench: A Benchmark to Evaluate Full-duplex Spoken Dialogue Models on Turn-taking Capabilities

works.title: GEN3C
works.description: A video model with precise camera control: from one or a few images (or a video) it renders new camera trajectories that stay consistent with the 3D content, with a GUI for drawing camera paths; built on NVIDIA Cosmos and released openly in June 2025.
works.description_zh: 一个能精确控制镜头的视频模型：从一张或几张图像（或一段视频）出发，渲染与三维内容保持一致的新镜头轨迹，并提供绘制镜头路径的图形界面；基于 NVIDIA Cosmos，于 2025 年 6 月开源。
works.idea_en: Keeping an explicit 3D cache under a video generator is a middle road: video-quality pixels, but the world stays where it was when the camera returns.
works.idea_zh: 在视频生成器之下保留一个显式三维缓存是一条折中路线：画面达到视频级质量，而镜头回来时世界仍在原处。
works.method: Depth predicted from the inputs is unprojected into a point-cloud 3D cache; renders of the cache along the user's camera path condition a video diffusion model, which fills holes and corrects artifacts.
works.method_zh: 由输入预测的深度被反投影成点云三维缓存；沿用户镜头路径渲染该缓存，再以渲染结果为条件驱动视频扩散模型补洞并修正瑕疵。

paper.title: GEN3C: 3D-Informed World-Consistent Video Generation with Precise Camera Control

works.title: Sesame CSM (Maya & Miles)
works.description: Sesame's Conversational Speech Model, presented through the voice companions Maya and Miles, which pause, laugh, change tone and correct themselves in ways many listeners found hard to tell from a person. A 1B CSM was released as open weights in March 2025; since 6 October 2026 Sesame's voice assistants are available to everyone in its iOS and Android apps, with glasses planned for 2027.
works.description_zh: Sesame 的对话语音模型，通过语音伴侣 Maya 与 Miles 展示：它们会停顿、发笑、变换语气、自我纠正，许多听众难以分辨是否真人。1B 规模的 CSM 于 2025 年 3 月开源权重；自 2026 年 10 月 6 日起，Sesame 的语音助手在其 iOS 与 Android 应用中向所有人开放，眼镜计划于 2027 年推出。
works.idea_en: Targets 'voice presence': the conversation so far, not only the text, decides prosody, which is the cue that makes a virtual interlocutor feel present.
works.idea_zh: 瞄准“声音临场感”：决定语调的不只是文本，还有此前的对话上下文，而这正是让虚拟对话者显得“在场”的线索。
works.method: Two autoregressive Transformers over interleaved text and audio tokens (a backbone predicts the first RVQ codebook from conversation history, a small decoder the rest), trained on about one million hours of mostly English audio.
works.method_zh: 两个基于交错文本与音频标记的自回归 Transformer：主干根据对话历史预测第一层 RVQ 码本，小型解码器预测其余各层；训练数据约一百万小时，以英语为主。
works.specs: Tiny 1B · Small 3B · Medium 8B backbones · CSM-1B open (Apache 2.0)
works.title_zh: Sesame 对话语音模型 CSM（Maya 与 Miles）

works.title: Octave
works.description: Hume's LLM-based text-to-speech, which infers how a line should be delivered from the script (whispering a secret, shouting in triumph) and creates new voices from a text description. Octave 2 later extended it to more languages. Hume announced on 2 October 2026 that it is sunsetting its EVI and TTS APIs; access ends on 13 November 2026.
works.description_zh: Hume 基于大模型的语音合成：能从剧本中推断台词该怎么说（低声说出秘密、得意地高喊），并能根据文字描述创造新的声音。之后的 Octave 2 扩展到更多语言。Hume 于 2026 年 10 月 2 日宣布停止提供 EVI 与 TTS API，访问将于 2026 年 11 月 13 日结束。
works.idea_en: Voice design by description lets an experimenter specify a character ('a nervous young paramedic') instead of searching a stock voice library.
works.idea_zh: 用描述来设计声音，实验者可以直接指定角色（“一位紧张的年轻急救员”），而不必在现成声音库里翻找。
works.method: A speech-language model trained to understand and synthesise speech, predicting tune, rhythm and timbre from text, acting instructions and context.
works.method_zh: 一个经训练能理解并合成语音的语音-语言模型，根据文本、表演指示和上下文预测语调、节奏与音色。

works.title: LAM (Large Avatar Model)
works.description: LAM turns a single photo into an animatable 3D Gaussian head in one forward pass that runs in real time on phones and in WebGL, and Alibaba pairs it with audio-driven animation for chat avatars.
works.description_zh: LAM 只需一张照片、一次前向推理就能生成可驱动的三维高斯头部，可在手机和 WebGL 中实时运行；阿里巴巴还把它与音频驱动动画结合用于聊天虚拟人。
works.idea_en: One-shot 3D heads cheap enough for a browser make embodied agents deployable without GPU streaming.
works.idea_zh: 单图生成、成本低到能在浏览器里运行的三维头部，让具身智能体无需 GPU 推流也能部署。
works.method: A transformer whose FLAME canonical points query multi-scale image features to predict canonical Gaussian attributes, animated by standard linear blend skinning with corrective blendshapes.
works.method_zh: 以 FLAME 规范点为查询、与多尺度图像特征交互的 Transformer 预测规范空间中的高斯属性，再用标准线性混合蒙皮和修正 blendshape 驱动。

paper.title: LAM: Large Avatar Model for One-shot Animatable Gaussian Head

works.title_zh: LAM 大型化身模型

works.title: Wan 2.1
works.description: Alibaba's Wan 2.1 (open-sourced 2025-02-25 under Apache 2.0) provides 14B and 1.3B text- and image-to-video models; the small one needs about 8 GB of VRAM. It became the base of many research and community models, including VACE, Self Forcing and Krea Realtime.
works.description_zh: 阿里巴巴的通义万相 Wan 2.1（2025-02-25 以 Apache 2.0 开源）提供 140 亿和 13 亿参数的文生/图生视频模型，小模型约需 8 GB 显存。它成为 VACE、Self Forcing、Krea Realtime 等众多研究与社区模型的基础。
works.idea_en: The open base most 2025 real-time and control research was built on, so findings transfer between labs.
works.idea_zh: 2025 年的实时与控制研究大多以它为基础，因此不同实验室的结果可以相互迁移。
works.method: Diffusion transformer trained with flow matching and a new causal 3D VAE (Wan-VAE) that encodes 1080p video of unlimited length.
works.method_zh: 以流匹配训练的扩散 Transformer，配合新的因果 3D VAE（Wan-VAE），可编码任意长度的 1080p 视频。

paper.title: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models

works.title_zh: 通义万相 2.1

works.title: Muse (WHAM)
works.description: A 'World and Human Action Model' trained on seven years of human play of the Xbox game Bleeding Edge that generates gameplay visuals, controller actions or both, consistent for up to two minutes; weights and the WHAM Demonstrator tool were released for researchers, and on 2026-09-23 Microsoft moved the WHAM team and technology into its Microsoft AI product group.
works.description_zh: 一个“世界与人类动作模型”，用 Xbox 游戏《Bleeding Edge》约七年的人类游玩数据训练，可生成游戏画面、手柄动作或两者，一致性可维持长达两分钟；权重与 WHAM Demonstrator 工具已向研究者开放；2026 年 9 月 23 日，微软把 WHAM 团队与技术并入 Microsoft AI 产品部门。
works.idea_en: Models the player's actions as well as the world, so it can predict what a person is likely to do next, not only what they will see.
works.idea_zh: 它不仅模拟世界，也模拟玩家的动作，因此能预测人接下来可能做什么，而不仅是会看到什么。
works.method: A 1.6B-parameter transformer that predicts interleaved image tokens and controller-action tokens, trained on more than 1 billion images and controller actions (over 7 years of play) at 300×180 resolution, developed with Ninja Theory.
works.method_zh: 16 亿参数的 Transformer，交替预测图像 token 与手柄动作 token，在超过 10 亿帧 300×180 分辨率的画面与手柄动作（相当于 7 年以上的游玩时长）上训练，与 Ninja Theory 合作开发。

paper.title: World and Human Action Models towards gameplay ideation

works.title_zh: Muse（世界与人类动作模型 WHAM）

works.title: CAST
works.description: Rebuilds a single RGB photo as a 3D scene of separate, complete object meshes placed with physically consistent contacts and support, so the scene can be edited or simulated object by object.
works.description_zh: 把一张 RGB 照片重建为由独立、完整的物体网格组成的三维场景，物体之间的接触与支撑关系在物理上一致，因此可以逐个物体地编辑或仿真。
works.idea_en: A photo becomes a set of objects that rest on and touch each other correctly, the precondition for anything in the scene to be picked up or pushed.
works.idea_zh: 照片变成了一组彼此正确放置、相互接触的物体，这是场景里任何东西能被拿起或推动的前提。
works.method: Object-level segmentation and relative depth estimation feed an occlusion-aware generator that produces each object's full geometry; a pose-alignment model places objects, and a physics-aware correction step uses a relation graph to remove interpenetration and floating.
works.method_zh: 先做物体级分割与相对深度估计，再由考虑遮挡的生成模型生成每个物体的完整几何；位姿对齐模型负责摆放，物理感知的修正步骤借助关系图消除穿插与悬空。

paper.title: CAST: Component-Aligned 3D Scene Reconstruction from an RGB Image

works.title: Step-Video-T2V
works.description: StepFun's Step-Video-T2V (2025-02-17) is a 30-billion-parameter open text-to-video model that generates up to 204 frames from Chinese or English prompts.
works.description_zh: 阶跃星辰的 Step-Video-T2V（2025-02-17）是 300 亿参数的开源文生视频模型，可根据中文或英文提示生成最多 204 帧。
works.idea_en: Pushed open-model scale to 30B and documented the practical limits of scaling video diffusion.
works.idea_zh: 把开源模型规模推到 300 亿参数，并记录了视频扩散规模化的实际瓶颈。
works.method: DiT with 3D full attention, a deep-compression video VAE (16x16 spatial, 8x temporal) and Video-DPO preference tuning.
works.method_zh: 采用三维全注意力的 DiT，配深度压缩视频 VAE（空间 16×16、时间 8 倍），并用 Video-DPO 做偏好优化。

paper.title: Step-Video-T2V Technical Report: The Practice, Challenges, and Future of Video Foundation Model

works.title_zh: 阶跃 Step-Video-T2V

works.title: AgentSociety
works.description: A simulator that gives more than 10,000 LLM agents jobs, homes, mobility and social ties inside a modelled city, then runs social experiments on them: polarization, inflammatory messages, universal basic income and a hurricane shock.
works.description_zh: 一个模拟器：让一万多个 LLM 智能体在建模的城市中拥有工作、住所、出行与社会关系，再在其上开展社会实验，包括极化、煽动性信息传播、全民基本收入与飓风冲击。
works.idea_en: Treats an agent population as a lab where interventions that are unethical or impossible with people can be piloted first.
works.idea_zh: 把智能体人群当作实验室，先行试验那些在真人身上不道德或无法实施的干预。
works.method: LLM agents with needs, emotions and memories act in an urban environment (mobility, economy, social network) on a distributed simulation engine; the authors report about 5 million agent and environment interactions and compare outcomes with findings from human studies.
works.method_zh: 具备需求、情绪与记忆的 LLM 智能体在城市环境（出行、经济、社交网络）中行动，运行于分布式模拟引擎之上；作者报告约 500 万次智能体之间及与环境的交互，并与真人研究结论对比。

paper.title: AgentSociety: Large-Scale Simulation of LLM-Driven Generative Agents Advances Understanding of Human Behaviors and Society

works.title: Firefly Video Model
works.description: Adobe's Firefly Video Model (public beta 2025-02-12) generates video clips from text or images in the Firefly web app and Premiere Pro, with camera-angle and shot controls; Adobe presents it as trained only on licensed and public-domain content and therefore 'commercially safe'.
works.description_zh: Adobe 的 Firefly 视频模型（2025-02-12 公开测试）可在 Firefly 网页应用与 Premiere Pro 中根据文字或图像生成视频片段，并提供镜头角度与景别控制；Adobe 称其只用授权与公有领域内容训练，因此“可安全商用”。
works.idea_en: Provenance of training data becomes a product feature, which matters for institutions that must clear stimulus material.
works.idea_zh: 训练数据的来源成了产品卖点，这对需要审核刺激材料版权的机构很重要。
works.method: Diffusion video model trained only on licensed content such as Adobe Stock and on public-domain material, never on customers' content (per Adobe; architecture not disclosed).
works.method_zh: 扩散视频模型，只用 Adobe Stock 等授权内容与公有领域素材训练，从不使用用户内容（据 Adobe；架构未公开）。
works.title_zh: Firefly 视频模型

works.title: AI-Enhanced Virtual Reality Self-Talk for Psychological Counseling: Formative Qualitative Study
works.description: Adds an AI agent to embodied VR self-talk, where people alternate between their own avatar and a counsellor avatar; the agent steps in with guidance when participants get stuck, and a formative qualitative study explored how people experienced its help.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 具身自我对话（参与者在自己的化身与咨询者化身之间切换）中加入一个 AI 智能体，在参与者卡住时介入引导；一项形成性质性研究探讨了参与者如何体验这种帮助。
works.idea_en: Instead of replacing the therapist, the LLM nudges a person's own reasoning, a lower-risk role for generative agents in clinical VR.
works.idea_zh: 大语言模型不是取代治疗师，而是推动当事人自己的思考——这是生成式智能体在临床 VR 中风险较低的角色。
works.method: Formative qualitative study with interviews after AI-supported VR self-talk sessions, by Reichman University's Advanced Reality Lab with Mel Slater.
works.method_zh: 形成性质性研究，在 AI 辅助的 VR 自我对话后进行访谈，由赖克曼大学先进现实实验室与 Mel Slater 合作完成。

paper.title: AI-Enhanced Virtual Reality Self-Talk for Psychological Counseling: Formative Qualitative Study

works.title_zh: AI 增强的虚拟现实自我对话用于心理咨询：一项形成性质性研究

works.title: History-Guided Video Diffusion
works.description: Introduces the Diffusion Forcing Transformer, a video model that can condition on any number of past frames, and 'history guidance', which strengthens the pull of that history at sampling time; together they give much longer stable rollouts, including camera navigation through a scene from a single image.
works.description_zh: 提出 Diffusion Forcing Transformer：一种可以以任意数量历史帧为条件的视频模型；并提出“历史引导”，在采样时加强历史的作用。两者结合可得到长得多的稳定推演，包括从单张图像出发在场景中移动镜头。
works.idea_en: Lets a world model lean on its past more or less strongly, a dial between drifting and staying faithful.
works.idea_zh: 让世界模型可以更强或更弱地依赖过去，在“漂移”与“忠于历史”之间提供一个调节旋钮。
works.method: Per-frame independent noise levels in training (diffusion forcing) applied to a transformer, then classifier-free-style guidance over different history subsets and noise levels at inference.
works.method_zh: 训练时为每帧设置独立噪声水平（扩散强制）并应用到 Transformer 上，推理时对不同的历史子集与噪声水平做类似无分类器引导的组合。

paper.title: History-Guided Video Diffusion

works.title_zh: 历史引导视频扩散

works.title: TripoSG
works.description: VAST's open 1.5-billion-parameter image-to-shape model, released under the MIT licence with a scribble-conditioned variant, that generates detailed watertight geometry from a single image and became a common open baseline for 3D shape generation in 2025.
works.description_zh: VAST 开源的 15 亿参数图生形状模型，以 MIT 协议发布，另有草图条件版本；可由单张图像生成细节丰富的封闭几何，成为 2025 年三维形状生成常用的开源基线之一。
works.idea_en: An open, permissively licensed shape generator close to commercial quality, which lets a lab pin and inspect the model that makes its props.
works.idea_zh: 一个接近商用水准、许可宽松的开源形状生成模型，让实验室可以固定版本并检查生成道具所用的模型。
works.method: A rectified-flow transformer over the latent space of a 3D VAE trained with SDF, normal and eikonal losses, plus a data pipeline that curates about 2M high-quality 3D samples.
works.method_zh: 在三维 VAE 潜空间上训练的整流流 Transformer，VAE 采用 SDF、法线和 eikonal 损失训练，并配有一条筛选约 200 万个高质量三维样本的数据管线。

paper.title: TripoSG: High-Fidelity 3D Shape Synthesis using Large-Scale Rectified Flow Models

works.title: OmniHuman-1
works.description: OmniHuman-1 turns one image (portrait, half body or full body; real or cartoon) plus audio into a video of the person talking, singing or gesturing, including hands and objects; ByteDance later offered it in Dreamina / Jimeng.
works.description_zh: OmniHuman-1 只需一张图像（头像、半身或全身，真人或卡通）加一段音频，就能生成此人说话、唱歌或做手势的视频，包括手部和手持物体；字节跳动后来在即梦 / Dreamina 中上线了它。
works.idea_en: Scaling one model over mixed conditions (text, audio, pose) brought audio-driven video from heads to whole bodies.
works.idea_zh: 用一个模型在混合条件（文本、音频、姿态）上扩大训练规模，让音频驱动视频从头部扩展到全身。
works.method: A DiT video model trained with an 'omni-conditions' strategy that mixes weaker (text, audio) and stronger (pose) conditions so more training data stays usable.
works.method_zh: 视频 DiT 模型，采用“全条件”训练策略，混合较弱（文本、音频）和较强（姿态）的条件，使更多训练数据可被利用。

paper.title: OmniHuman-1: Rethinking the Scaling-Up of One-Stage Conditioned Human Animation Models

works.title: CUT3R
works.description: CUT3R reconstructs a scene online from a stream of images, updating a persistent internal state with each new frame and outputting camera pose and a metric point map per frame, including for moving content.
works.description_zh: CUT3R 从图像流在线重建场景：每来一帧就更新一个持续的内部状态，并逐帧输出相机位姿和公制点图，也能处理运动内容。
works.idea_en: A state that accumulates the world as you move is closer to how a headset should perceive a room than batch reconstruction.
works.idea_zh: 随移动不断累积世界的状态，比批量重建更接近头显感知房间的方式。
works.method: A recurrent transformer reads each image against a learned state token set, writes back to it, and can also query the state from unseen viewpoints.
works.method_zh: 循环 Transformer 让每张图像与一组可学习的状态标记交互并回写，也能从未见过的视角查询该状态。

paper.title: Continuous 3D Perception Model with Persistent State

works.title: Hunyuan3D 2.0
works.description: Tencent's open-weight two-stage 3D asset system: Hunyuan3D-DiT generates the shape from an image and Hunyuan3D-Paint textures it; it shipped with a Blender add-on and a web studio, and Hunyuan3D 2.1 (June 2025) added open PBR materials.
works.description_zh: 腾讯开源权重的两阶段三维资产系统：混元3D-DiT 由图像生成形状，混元3D-Paint 负责上贴图；同时提供 Blender 插件和网页工作台，2025 年 6 月的混元3D 2.1 又开源了 PBR 材质。
works.idea_en: The open-weight model much of the community and many Chinese apps built on; Tencent reports more than 3 million Hugging Face downloads across its open 3D models by November 2025.
works.idea_zh: 社区和许多中国应用所依赖的开源权重模型；腾讯称截至 2025 年 11 月，其开源三维模型在 Hugging Face 的下载量已超过 300 万。
works.method: A flow-based diffusion transformer over a shape VAE latent generates geometry aligned to the condition image, then a multi-view diffusion texture model paints generated or hand-made meshes.
works.method_zh: 基于流的扩散 Transformer 在形状 VAE 潜空间中生成与条件图像对齐的几何，随后多视角扩散贴图模型为生成或手工制作的网格上色。

paper.title: Hunyuan3D 2.0: Scaling Diffusion Models for High Resolution Textured 3D Assets Generation

works.title_zh: 混元3D 2.0

works.title: CityDreamer4D
works.description: CityDreamer4D generates unbounded 4D cities, with buildings, roads and moving traffic, that a camera can fly through while the vehicles drive.
works.description_zh: CityDreamer4D 能生成无边界的 4D 城市，包含建筑、道路与行驶中的车流，相机可以在车辆行驶时于其中飞行穿梭。
works.idea_en: Splits a city into a static background and dynamic actors, so traffic can change while the place stays the same: a template for street-scale generated situations.
works.idea_zh: 把城市拆分为静态背景与动态参与者，使车流可以变化而地点保持不变，为街道尺度的生成情境提供了模板。
works.method: Compositional neural fields: separate generators for buildings, roads and background and for vehicle instances, driven by a bird's-eye-view layout and a traffic scenario, trained on OpenStreetMap, Google Earth and the CityTopia dataset.
works.method_zh: 组合式神经场：建筑、道路、背景与车辆实例各有生成器，由鸟瞰布局与交通场景驱动，在 OpenStreetMap、Google Earth 与 CityTopia 数据集上训练。

paper.title: Compositional Generative Model of Unbounded 4D Cities

works.title_zh: CityDreamer4D 无边界 4D 城市生成

works.title: GameFactory
works.description: A method for creating new games as interactive video: action control learned from Minecraft is transferred to open-domain scenes generated from text, so a player can walk and look around in worlds that were never in the training data.
works.description_zh: 一种把新游戏当作交互视频来创作的方法：把在 Minecraft 中学到的动作控制迁移到由文字生成的开放场景，玩家可以在训练数据中从未出现过的世界里行走、环顾。
works.idea_en: Separates 'how to move' from 'what the world looks like', which is what lets a lab script new scenarios without new game data.
works.idea_zh: 把“怎么移动”与“世界长什么样”分开，正是这一点让实验室无需新的游戏数据就能编排新情境。
works.method: A pretrained video diffusion model with a style-decoupling LoRA and a separate action-control module trained on the GF-Minecraft dataset, extended autoregressively for long videos.
works.method_zh: 在预训练视频扩散模型上加入风格解耦 LoRA，以及在 GF-Minecraft 数据集上训练的独立动作控制模块，并以自回归方式延展为长视频。

paper.title: GameFactory: Creating New Games with Generative Interactive Videos

works.title_zh: GameFactory：用生成式交互视频创造新游戏

works.title: GARP (Generative Agents Realtime Playground)
works.description: A tech demo of a village with more than 20 generative agents that have their own personalities, memories and daily plans, form relationships and react to each other, rebuilt after Stanford's Smallville to run in real time on a single NVIDIA RTX 3090 instead of in slow, paid cloud turns.
works.description_zh: 一个技术演示：村庄里有 20 多个生成式智能体，各有性格、记忆与日程，会建立关系、相互回应；它仿照斯坦福的 Smallville 重新实现，在一块 NVIDIA RTX 3090 上实时运行，而不是依赖缓慢且收费的云端回合。
works.idea_en: Generative-agent towns no longer need a cloud budget: run locally, a whole population can live in real time inside a game or VR scene.
works.idea_zh: 生成式智能体小镇不再需要云端预算：在本地运行时，一整个群体可以在游戏或 VR 场景中实时生活。
works.method: Atelico's on-device engine runs proprietary small language models with a cognitive memory architecture and hot-swappable adapters; Atelico reports that the original Smallville ran in turns at about US$500 per simulated game day, while GARP runs locally at no per-use cost.
works.method_zh: Atelico 的本地端引擎运行自研小语言模型，配合认知记忆架构与可热切换的适配器；Atelico 称原版 Smallville 以回合方式运行，每模拟一个游戏日约需 500 美元，而 GARP 在本地运行，没有按次费用。
works.title_zh: GARP：实时生成式智能体村庄

works.title: SPAR3D (Stable Point Aware 3D)
works.description: Stability AI's open single-image-to-mesh model that first samples a point cloud of the object, which a person can edit, and then builds the textured mesh from it in under a second, including the unseen back of the object.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 的开源单图生成网格模型：先采样物体的点云（用户可以编辑），再在一秒内由点云生成带纹理的网格，包括图像中看不到的背面。
works.idea_en: Inserts an editable intermediate between photo and mesh, so a person can fix the hidden side of an object instead of accepting the model's guess.
works.idea_zh: 在照片和网格之间加入一个可编辑的中间结果，人可以修正物体被遮住的那一面，而不必全盘接受模型的猜测。
works.method: A point diffusion model samples a sparse point cloud from the image, and a feed-forward meshing stage conditioned on the image and points predicts geometry, texture and materials; released under the Stability AI Community License.
works.method_zh: 点扩散模型先由图像采样稀疏点云，再由以图像和点云为条件的前馈网格化阶段预测几何、纹理与材质；以 Stability AI 社区许可证发布。

paper.title: SPAR3D: Stable Point-Aware Reconstruction of 3D Objects from Single Images

works.title_zh: SPAR3D（稳定点感知三维）

works.title: Cosmos
works.description: An open platform of 'world foundation models' for physical AI, announced at CES 2025: video tokenizers, a data-curation pipeline and diffusion and autoregressive models that generate physically plausible video for training robots and autonomous vehicles, later extended with Predict, Transfer and Reason models.
works.description_zh: 在 CES 2025 上发布的面向物理 AI 的开放“世界基础模型”平台：包括视频分词器、数据筛选流程，以及生成物理上合理视频的扩散与自回归模型，用于训练机器人和自动驾驶；后续又加入 Predict、Transfer 与 Reason 系列模型。
works.idea_en: Open, permissively licensed world models that labs can fine-tune to their own environments, the default base for robot and driving simulation.
works.idea_zh: 采用宽松许可的开源世界模型，实验室可以针对自己的环境微调，是机器人与驾驶仿真的默认基座。
works.method: Diffusion and autoregressive transformer models pre-trained on about 100M clips curated from 20M hours of video, with guardrails and post-training recipes for camera control, robotics and driving.
works.method_zh: 扩散与自回归 Transformer 模型，在从 2000 万小时视频中筛选出的约 1 亿个片段上预训练，配有安全防护与针对镜头控制、机器人和驾驶的后训练方法。

paper.title: Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI

works.title: MIR5 AI boss Asterion
works.description: A boss for Wemade Next's MMORPG MIR5, shown at CES 2025, that analyzes the skills, gear and tactics of the players it faces, recalls earlier battles and changes its attacks, so a fight with the same boss plays out differently each time. As of October 2026 no launch of the AI boss in the live game was confirmed.
works.description_zh: Wemade Next 为 MMORPG《MIR5》打造的首领角色，在 CES 2025 上展示：它会分析对手玩家的技能、装备与战术，回忆以往的战斗并调整攻击方式，因此同一个首领每次的战斗过程都不相同。截至 2026 年 10 月，尚未确认这一 AI 首领已在正式游戏中上线。
works.idea_en: Generative characters as adversaries rather than helpers: an opponent that adapts to a person's habits is the gaming version of an adaptive training scenario.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式角色用作对手而不是帮手：一个会适应人习惯的对手，正是自适应训练情境在游戏中的对应物。
works.method: Small language models tuned for MIR5 and served through NVIDIA ACE perceive the encounter, compare the current party with past fights and choose the boss's next action instead of following a scripted pattern.
works.method_zh: 为《MIR5》调优、通过 NVIDIA ACE 提供的小语言模型感知战斗情况，把当前队伍与以往战斗对比，并选择首领的下一步动作，而不是按预设套路行动。
works.title_zh: 《MIR5》AI 首领 Asterion

works.title: NARAKA: BLADEPOINT AI Teammate
works.description: Since 27 March 2025, players of NetEase's NARAKA: BLADEPOINT Mobile PC Version (Chinese market) can add an on-device AI teammate to their party in Free Training: it fights alongside them, finds items they need, swaps gear and suggests which skills to unlock.
works.description_zh: 自 2025 年 3 月 27 日起，网易《永劫无间》手游 PC 版（国服）玩家可以在自由训练中邀请一名本地运行的 AI 队友：它与玩家并肩作战、寻找玩家需要的物品、交换装备，并建议解锁哪些技能。
works.idea_en: One of the first shipped LLM teammates in a large Chinese action game, run on the player's GPU rather than a server.
works.idea_zh: 最早在大型中国动作游戏中上线的 LLM 队友之一，运行在玩家的 GPU 上而不是服务器上。
works.method: Likely an NVIDIA ACE small language model on the local GeForce RTX GPU that picks high-level actions and suggestions, while the game's own combat AI executes moves; NetEase has not published model details.
works.method_zh: 很可能由本地 GeForce RTX GPU 上运行的英伟达 ACE 小语言模型选择高层行动与建议，再由游戏自身的战斗 AI 执行具体操作；网易未公开模型细节。
works.title_zh: 《永劫无间》AI 队友

works.title: PUBG Ally
works.description: An AI teammate for PUBG: Battlegrounds that the player talks to by voice: it calls out enemies in game lingo, shares loot, drives vehicles and fights alongside the player. KRAFTON calls it a Co-Playable Character; after demos at CES 2025 and GDC 2026 it was playable in a two-week public beta, Ally Duo Mode in PUBG Arcade on Steam, from 17 to 30 June 2026.
works.description_zh: 《绝地求生》中可语音交流的 AI 队友：用游戏术语报点、分享物资、驾驶载具并与玩家并肩作战。魁匠团称之为“可共玩角色”（CPC）；在 CES 2025 与 GDC 2026 展示后，于 2026 年 6 月 17 日至 30 日在 Steam 版 PUBG 街机模式中以“Ally 双排模式”进行了为期两周的公开测试。
works.idea_en: A teammate that both talks and acts in a fast competitive game, running on the player's own GPU rather than in the cloud.
works.idea_zh: 一个在快节奏竞技游戏中既能说话又能行动的队友，运行在玩家自己的 GPU 上，而不是云端。
works.method: First shown with the Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B small language model through NVIDIA ACE; KRAFTON then moved from a behavior-tree-plus-SLM workflow to an autonomous tool-calling agent loop on a distilled on-device Nemotron model, adding long-term memory (announced at CES 2026).
works.method_zh: 最初通过英伟达 ACE 使用 Mistral-NeMo-Minitron-8B 小语言模型展示；随后魁匠团从“行为树 + 小模型”的工作流，转向在蒸馏后的本地 Nemotron 模型上运行的自主工具调用智能体循环，并加入长期记忆（CES 2026 宣布）。
works.title_zh: PUBG Ally（AI 队友）

works.title: inZOI Smart Zoi
works.description: In KRAFTON's life simulation inZOI, Smart Zoi lets every resident of a city act on its own life goals, react to events around it and adjust tomorrow's schedule from today's experiences, instead of waiting for player commands; players can read a Smart Zoi's inner thoughts as they happen and nudge them. The experimental setting shipped with the game's Steam early access in March 2025 for GeForce RTX GPUs.
works.description_zh: 在魁匠团的人生模拟游戏 inZOI 中，Smart Zoi 让城市里的每个居民依照自己的人生目标行动、对周围事件作出反应，并根据当天经历调整第二天的日程，而不是等待玩家指令；玩家可以实时查看 Smart Zoi 的内心想法并加以引导。这一实验性设置随游戏于 2025 年 3 月在 Steam 抢先体验上线，需要 GeForce RTX GPU。
works.idea_en: A whole simulated town of LLM-driven residents in a mass-market game, running locally, which is close to a playable Smallville.
works.idea_zh: 大众市场游戏中整座由 LLM 驱动居民构成的模拟小镇，并在本地运行，接近一个可玩的 Smallville。
works.method: A 0.5B-parameter Mistral-NeMo-Minitron small language model running on-device through NVIDIA ACE selects each Zoi's next action from the game's action set, guided by goals, memories and reflections, with the game simulation executing and animating the choice.
works.method_zh: 通过英伟达 ACE 在本地运行的 5 亿参数 Mistral-NeMo-Minitron 小语言模型，依据目标、记忆与反思，从游戏动作集中为每个 Zoi 选择下一步行动，再由游戏模拟系统执行并呈现动画。

works.title: Artificial Analysis Video Arena
works.description: Independent benchmarking firm Artificial Analysis runs a blind-vote arena for video models with separate text-to-video, image-to-video and video-editing leaderboards, next to price and speed comparisons across API providers. Video labs routinely cite its rankings in launch posts.
works.description_zh: 独立评测公司 Artificial Analysis 运营的视频模型盲投竞技场，分设文生视频、图生视频与视频编辑排行榜，并附有各 API 服务商的价格与速度对比。视频模型厂商发布新模型时常引用它的排名。
works.idea_en: Puts quality ratings next to price and latency per provider, the three numbers a lab weighs when it chooses a hosted generator.
works.idea_zh: 把质量评分与各服务商的价格和延迟放在一起，这正是实验室选择托管生成器时要权衡的三个数字。
works.method: Pairwise human preference votes on clips from shared prompts, aggregated into Elo-style ratings, alongside measured generation time and listed price per provider.
works.method_zh: 对同一提示生成的片段进行人类两两偏好投票，汇总为 Elo 式评分，并给出各服务商实测的生成时间与标价。
works.specs: text-to-video · image-to-video · video editing · online since at least 2024-10
works.title_zh: Artificial Analysis 视频竞技场

works.title: Figmin XR AI creation tools
works.description: Inside the mixed-reality creation app Figmin XR, users generate 3D models from a text prompt (via Luma Genie in the built-in browser) and drop them into their room, and later had language models write scripts that make objects interactive.
works.description_zh: 在混合现实创作应用 Figmin XR 中，用户可以通过内置浏览器里的 Luma Genie 用文字生成三维模型并放进房间，后来还能让语言模型编写脚本，让物体变得可交互。
works.idea_en: A consumer headset app where generated assets and generated behaviour land directly in the space you are standing in.
works.idea_zh: 一款消费级头显应用：生成的资产与生成的行为都直接落在你所站立的空间里。
works.method: Text-to-3D results from Luma Genie are imported as scene objects, and LLMs (including GPT-5 in 2025) write code against Figmin XR's scripting API.
works.method_zh: 把 Luma Genie 的文生三维结果导入为场景物体，并由大语言模型（2025 年包括 GPT-5）基于 Figmin XR 的脚本 API 编写代码。
works.title_zh: Figmin XR 的 AI 创作工具

works.title: Kling AI API (KlingAI Open Platform)
works.description: Kuaishou's KlingAI Open Platform gives developers API access to the Kling video and image models, with per-model references and unit pricing. Along with resellers such as fal, it is one of the main routes by which a Chinese frontier video model reaches third-party apps worldwide.
works.description_zh: 快手的可灵 AI 开放平台为开发者提供可灵视频与图像模型的 API，附有各模型的参考文档与计费单价。与 fal 等转售平台一起，它是中国前沿视频模型进入全球第三方应用的主要途径之一。
works.idea_en: Puts a Chinese frontier video model behind the same kind of versioned API as Veo or Ray, so cross-lab stimulus comparisons do not have to go through a consumer app.
works.idea_zh: 让中国的前沿视频模型拥有与 Veo、Ray 同类的版本化 API，跨机构比较刺激材料时不必再通过消费级应用。
works.method: Asynchronous REST tasks (text-to-video, image-to-video, extension) signed with access and secret keys; results return as hosted video URLs.
works.method_zh: 以访问密钥签名的异步 REST 任务（文生视频、图生视频、视频延长），结果以托管视频链接返回。
works.specs: API since 2024 · v1.5 1080p professional mode and video extension added 2024-11
works.title_zh: 可灵 AI 开放平台 API

works.title: Luma API (Ray)
works.description: Luma's API serves its Ray video models and Photon image models to developers. The Ray3.2 API (2026-06-09) exposes the model's full control surface: up to 16 keyframes per clip, performance tracking, HDR generation and EXR export.
works.description_zh: Luma 的 API 向开发者提供 Ray 视频模型与 Photon 图像模型。Ray3.2 API（2026-06-09）开放了模型的全部控制项：单个片段最多 16 个关键帧、表演追踪、HDR 生成与 EXR 导出。
works.idea_en: Keyframe-level control through an API is what turns a video model into something an experimenter can script shot by shot.
works.idea_zh: 通过 API 实现关键帧级控制，视频模型才成为实验者可以逐个镜头编排的工具。
works.method: Asynchronous generation jobs on Luma's Ray video models with multi-keyframe conditioning, video-to-video and reframing endpoints.
works.method_zh: 在 Luma 的 Ray 视频模型上运行异步生成任务，支持多关键帧条件、视频到视频与重新构图等接口。
works.specs: Ray3.2 API (2026-06-09) · up to 16 keyframes per clip · HDR · EXR export

works.title: Postshot
works.description: Jawset Postshot is a Windows desktop application that trains Gaussian splats and radiance fields from video or photos on a local NVIDIA GPU, with live preview, editing and plug-ins for After Effects and Unreal.
works.description_zh: Jawset Postshot 是一款 Windows 桌面应用，在本地 NVIDIA GPU 上从视频或照片训练高斯泼溅与辐射场，提供实时预览、编辑以及 After Effects 和 Unreal 插件。
works.idea_en: Local training gives labs control over data and versions, which cloud capture apps do not.
works.idea_zh: 本地训练让实验室能掌控数据与版本，这是云端捕捉应用做不到的。
works.method: Camera tracking and splat optimisation run locally with a progressive preview; v1.1 (May 2026) is the current release line.
works.method_zh: 相机追踪与泼溅优化都在本地运行，并提供渐进式预览；当前版本线为 v1.1（2026 年 5 月）。

works.title: MMAudio
works.description: An open video-to-audio model that adds synchronised sound effects and ambience to silent video; the authors report about 1.2 seconds to generate audio for an 8-second clip with the smallest model. It became a widely used open baseline for foley generation.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的视频配音模型，为无声视频添加同步的音效与环境声；作者报告最小的模型约 1.2 秒即可为 8 秒视频生成音频。它已成为被广泛使用的开源拟音基线。
works.idea_en: Fast, open foley lets a pipeline give every generated clip plausible sound, though it does not produce intelligible speech or structured music.
works.idea_zh: 快速、开源的拟音能力，让生成流程可以为每段视频配上可信的声音，但它不生成可懂的语音或有结构的音乐。
works.method: Flow-matching multimodal Transformer trained jointly on video-audio and large text-audio data, with a synchronisation module that aligns audio with video frame features.
works.method_zh: 基于流匹配的多模态 Transformer，在视频-音频与大规模文本-音频数据上联合训练，并用同步模块将音频与视频帧特征对齐。
works.specs: 157M-1.03B parameters · 8 s audio in ~1.2 s (small model, authors)

paper.title: MMAudio: Taming Multimodal Joint Training for High-Quality Video-to-Audio Synthesis

works.title: Meta Motivo
works.description: Meta FAIR's behavioral foundation model for a physics-simulated humanoid: without further training it can track a motion, reach a goal pose or optimize a reward specified at test time, and it comes with an interactive web demo.
works.description_zh: Meta FAIR 面向物理仿真人形的行为基础模型：无需再训练，就能在测试时追踪一段动作、到达目标姿态或优化指定的奖励，并提供交互式网页演示。
works.idea_en: One pretrained body controller that is prompted with goals instead of retrained per task: a candidate for virtual bodies whose behaviour an experimenter can specify on the fly.
works.idea_zh: 一个用目标来“提示”而不必按任务重训的预训练身体控制器：有望成为实验者可以随时设定行为的虚拟身体。
works.method: Forward-backward representations with conditional policy regularization (FB-CPR): unsupervised reinforcement learning in a shared latent space of states, motions and rewards, regularized toward unlabeled motion-capture data, on an SMPL-based humanoid in MuJoCo.
works.method_zh: 带条件策略正则化的前向—后向表示（FB-CPR）：在状态、动作与奖励共享的潜空间中进行无监督强化学习，并向无标注动捕数据正则化；在 MuJoCo 中的 SMPL 人形上训练。

paper.title: Zero-Shot Whole-Body Humanoid Control via Behavioral Foundation Models

works.title: Temporal Gaussian Hierarchy (Long Volumetric Video)
works.description: This ZJU method stores minutes-long multi-camera recordings of people as one hierarchy of Gaussians shared across time segments, so long volumetric video can be played back in real time without running out of GPU memory.
works.description_zh: 浙江大学的这一方法把几分钟长的多相机人物录制存为一个跨时间段共享的高斯层级结构，使长时体积视频可以实时回放而不耗尽显存。
works.idea_en: Length is what separates a clip from a scene someone can spend time in; this work removed the seconds-long limit of earlier 4D Gaussians.
works.idea_zh: 长度决定了一个片段能否成为让人停留其中的场景；这项工作打破了早期 4D 高斯只能持续几秒的限制。
works.method: A temporal tree assigns each Gaussian to the segment span where it is needed, so static regions are shared across long spans while dynamic regions get short-lived Gaussians; appearance uses a lightweight Gaussian-based model.
works.method_zh: 时间树把每个高斯分配到它所需要的时间段范围：静态区域在长时间段内共享，动态区域使用短暂存在的高斯；外观采用轻量的基于高斯的模型。

paper.title: Representing Long Volumetric Video with Temporal Gaussian Hierarchy

works.title_zh: 时间高斯层级（长时体积视频）

works.title: Explorer
works.description: Odyssey's first world model turned a single image into a photorealistic 3D Gaussian-splat world in about ten minutes, which artists could open and hand-edit in Unreal, Houdini or Blender; Odyssey tested the worlds on a virtual-production stage at Garden Studios in London. Access was by contact request rather than a public app, and Odyssey has since moved to real-time interactive video world models (Odyssey-2, Odyssey-3).
works.description_zh: Odyssey 的第一个世界模型：约 10 分钟把一张图像变成照片级的三维高斯泼溅世界，艺术家可以在 Unreal、Houdini 或 Blender 中打开并手工修改；Odyssey 还在伦敦 Garden Studios 的虚拟制片棚里测试了这些世界。它通过联系申请提供，而非公开应用；Odyssey 此后转向实时交互的视频世界模型（Odyssey-2、Odyssey-3）。
works.idea_en: Choosing splats as the output meant a generated world could go straight into film and game tools for hand-editing, trading real-time generation for an editable asset.
works.idea_zh: 选择高斯泼溅作为输出，意味着生成的世界可以直接进入影视和游戏工具供人手工修改：放弃实时生成，换来可编辑的资产。
works.method: An image-to-world generative model (architecture unpublished) outputs a 3D Gaussian-splat scene; Odyssey reported average generation times of about 10 minutes and early experiments with moving elements such as snow, water and fire.
works.method_zh: 图像到世界的生成模型（架构未公开）输出三维高斯泼溅场景；Odyssey 称平均生成时间约 10 分钟，并在早期实验中加入了雪、水、火等运动元素。

works.title: 3DGUT
works.description: 3DGUT keeps the speed of splat rasterisation while supporting distorted cameras such as fisheye lenses and rolling shutters, so footage from robots, cars and headsets can be reconstructed directly.
works.description_zh: 3DGUT 保留了泼溅光栅化的速度，同时支持鱼眼镜头、卷帘快门等畸变相机，使机器人、汽车和头显拍摄的素材可以直接用于重建。
works.idea_en: Removes the requirement that captures come from an ideal pinhole camera, which widens what real footage can become a scene.
works.idea_zh: 去掉了必须使用理想针孔相机拍摄的前提，让更多真实素材可以变成场景。
works.method: The unscented transform projects sigma points of each Gaussian through the exact camera model instead of linearising it, and is shared with 3DGRT for hybrid rendering.
works.method_zh: 用无迹变换把每个高斯的 sigma 点通过精确相机模型投影，而不是对其线性化，并与 3DGRT 共用以实现混合渲染。

paper.title: 3DGUT: Enabling Distorted Cameras and Secondary Rays in Gaussian Splatting

works.title: Veo 2
works.description: Second Veo model (2024-12-16) with better physics and camera control and output up to 4K; DeepMind reported it was preferred over Sora Turbo, Kling and Minimax in human comparisons at launch. It became available in the Gemini API, Gemini app and YouTube Shorts; its Gemini API endpoint (veo-2.0-generate-001) was shut down on 2026-06-30.
works.description_zh: 第二代 Veo（2024-12-16），物理表现与镜头控制更好，最高可输出 4K；DeepMind 称其在发布时的人类偏好对比中优于 Sora Turbo、可灵与 MiniMax。后来开放于 Gemini API、Gemini 应用与 YouTube Shorts；其 Gemini API 端点（veo-2.0-generate-001）已于 2026-06-30 关闭。
works.idea_en: Lens type and camera moves became reliable prompt parameters, useful when a scenario needs a specific viewpoint.
works.idea_zh: 镜头类型和运镜成为可靠的提示参数，适合需要特定视角的情境素材。
works.method: Diffusion-based video model with improved modeling of physics, human motion and cinematography; details not published.
works.method_zh: 基于扩散的视频模型，强化了对物理、人体运动与电影摄影的建模；细节未公开。

works.title: Wonderland
works.description: From a single image, Wonderland reconstructs a wide-scope 3D Gaussian-splat scene in a feed-forward pass, including background regions far outside the photo.
works.description_zh: Wonderland 从一张图像出发，以前馈方式重建大范围的三维高斯泼溅场景，连照片之外很远的背景区域也一并生成。
works.idea_en: The compressed latents of a camera-controlled video model already encode a multi-view scene; reading 3D straight from them saves decoding and optimisation.
works.idea_zh: 可控镜头视频模型的压缩潜变量本身就编码了多视角场景，直接从中读出三维可以省去解码与优化。
works.method: A camera-guided video diffusion model produces latents along specified trajectories; a large reconstruction model trained progressively on that latent space predicts the 3D Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 可控镜头的视频扩散模型沿指定轨迹生成潜变量；在该潜空间上渐进训练的大型重建模型预测出三维高斯。

paper.title: Wonderland: Navigating 3D Scenes from a Single Image

works.title: Android XR SDK (Jetpack XR)
works.description: Google's SDK for Android XR apps on headsets (Galaxy XR), wired XR glasses (XREAL AURA) and AI glasses: Jetpack Compose for XR, SceneCore, ARCore for Jetpack XR (plane and object tracking with semantic labels), and Unity, OpenXR and WebXR paths. As of October 2026 it is at Developer Preview 4.
works.description_zh: Google 面向 Android XR 应用的 SDK，覆盖头显（Galaxy XR）、有线 XR 眼镜（XREAL AURA）与 AI 眼镜：包括 Jetpack Compose for XR、SceneCore、ARCore for Jetpack XR（带语义标签的平面与物体追踪），以及 Unity、OpenXR 与 WebXR 的开发路径。截至 2026 年 10 月，它处于开发者预览第 4 版。
works.idea_en: One Android toolchain spans headsets and glasses, so a study app can follow participants from full immersion to heads-up overlays.
works.idea_zh: 同一套 Android 工具链覆盖头显与眼镜，研究应用可以从完全沉浸一路延伸到抬头显示的叠加界面。
works.method: Kotlin Jetpack libraries over an OpenXR-based perception stack, with Gemini APIs available to apps on the device.
works.method_zh: 基于 OpenXR 感知栈的 Kotlin Jetpack 库，设备上的应用还可调用 Gemini API。
works.specs: Developer Preview 4 (2026) · targets Galaxy XR, XREAL AURA, AI glasses · Unity / OpenXR / WebXR

works.title: LIVE-GS
works.description: LIVE-GS (Shanghai Jiao Tong University and Shanghai AI Lab; arXiv 2024-12-12, published at IEEE VR 2026 in TVCG) turns static Gaussian-splat scenes into physically interactive VR: GPT-4o estimates each object's physical properties from rendered views in about 10 seconds, after which a Quest 3 user can push, throw at, bend or break objects; in the teaser a doll swings, a mug shatters and a ball bounces off a hammer.
works.description_zh: LIVE-GS（上海交通大学与上海人工智能实验室；arXiv 2024-12-12，发表于 IEEE VR 2026 / TVCG）把静态的高斯泼溅场景变成可物理交互的 VR：GPT-4o 根据渲染视图在约 10 秒内估计每个物体的物理属性，之后 Quest 3 用户就能推、扔、弯折或打碎物体；在示例中，玩偶会摆动，杯子会碎裂，球打到锤子上会弹开。
works.idea_en: Lets a language model author the physics of a captured scene, so a real place can be made touchable and breakable in VR without a simulation expert tuning parameters.
works.idea_zh: 让语言模型为采集到的场景编写物理属性，无需模拟专家调参，就能让一个真实地点在 VR 中可触碰、可破坏。
works.method: Objects are segmented from a 3D Gaussian scene and GPT-4o infers parameters such as mass and elasticity from rendered images; elastic bodies are simulated with XPBD and rigid bodies with invisible proxy meshes, and Gaussian inpainting fills surfaces revealed when objects move; the system was compared with people experienced in physical simulation who tuned parameters by hand and rated in a usability study (SUS 88.6).
works.method_zh: 先从三维高斯场景中分割出物体，由 GPT-4o 根据渲染图像推断质量、弹性等参数；弹性体用 XPBD 模拟，刚体借助不可见的代理网格模拟，物体移动后露出的表面用高斯修补填充；系统与有物理模拟经验、手动调参的参与者进行了对比，并通过可用性研究评估（SUS 88.6）。
works.specs: ~10 s parameter estimation · 30 fps in the parameter study · Quest 3 + RTX 4080 SUPER

paper.title: LIVE-GS: LLM Powers Interactive VR Experience with Physics-Aware Gaussian Splatting

works.title_zh: LIVE-GS：大语言模型驱动的物理感知高斯泼溅交互式 VR

works.title: Stereo4D
works.description: Stereo4D mines stereoscopic VR180 videos from the internet to produce a large dataset of real-world scenes with dense 3D point tracks of how things actually move.
works.description_zh: Stereo4D 从互联网 VR180 立体视频中挖掘数据，构建了一个包含真实世界场景及其稠密三维点轨迹（即物体真实运动方式）的大型数据集。
works.idea_en: Real 3D motion at scale is the missing training signal for 4D generators that should move things plausibly.
works.idea_zh: 大规模的真实三维运动，正是让 4D 生成模型生成合理运动所缺少的训练信号。
works.method: Stereo depth, camera poses and 2D tracks are fused and filtered into world-space 3D trajectories; a DUSt3R variant (DynaDUSt3R) is trained on them to predict motion.
works.method_zh: 把立体深度、相机位姿与二维轨迹融合并过滤为世界坐标系下的三维轨迹，并以此训练 DUSt3R 变体（DynaDUSt3R）来预测运动。

paper.title: Stereo4D: Learning How Things Move in 3D from Internet Stereo Videos

works.title: Gemini Live API
works.description: Google's bidirectional streaming API for voice-and-vision agents: an app streams microphone audio and camera or screen video to Gemini over a WebSocket and gets spoken replies the user can interrupt. It launched as the Multimodal Live API with Gemini 2.0 in December 2024; since 2026-09-15 the default models are Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, with asynchronous function calling and proactive audio.
works.description_zh: Google 面向“语音 + 视觉”智能体的双向流式 API：应用通过 WebSocket 把麦克风音频与摄像头或屏幕画面实时传给 Gemini，并收到可被用户打断的语音回复。它于 2024 年 12 月随 Gemini 2.0 以 Multimodal Live API 之名推出；自 2026-09-15 起，默认模型为 Gemini 3.8 Live 与 Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking，支持异步函数调用与主动音频。
works.idea_en: Because it watches video while it talks, it can react to what a participant does in front of the camera, not only to what they say.
works.idea_zh: 它在说话的同时也在看画面，因此不仅能回应被试说了什么，还能回应被试在镜头前做了什么。
works.method: Stateful WebSocket sessions to native audio-to-audio Gemini models with voice-activity detection, session resumption, context compression and tool calls; ephemeral tokens let browsers connect directly.
works.method_zh: 与原生音频到音频 Gemini 模型建立有状态 WebSocket 会话，支持语音活动检测、会话恢复、上下文压缩与工具调用；临时令牌允许浏览器直接连接。
works.specs: audio + video in · audio out · GA models gemini-3.8-live and gemini-3.8-live-extended-thinking (2026-09-15)

works.title: Gemini native audio (Live API)
works.description: Gemini 2.0 introduced native audio output and the Multimodal Live API for streaming voice-and-camera conversations; Gemini 2.5 Flash Native Audio (preview from May 2025, updated in September and December 2025) added affective dialogue and proactive audio.
works.description_zh: Gemini 2.0 推出原生音频输出和多模态 Live API，可进行语音加摄像头的流式对话；Gemini 2.5 Flash 原生音频（2025 年 5 月起预览，9 月与 12 月更新）加入了情感对话与主动音频。
works.idea_en: Lets a voice agent see what the participant's camera sees while it talks: the audio-visual input a headset scenario needs.
