works.idea_zh: 让语音智能体在说话的同时看到参与者摄像头里的画面，这正是头显情境需要的视听输入。
works.method: Natively multimodal Gemini model that consumes streamed audio and video and emits audio tokens directly, served over a bidirectional WebSocket with voice-activity detection and barge-in.
works.method_zh: 原生多模态的 Gemini 模型，接收流式音频与视频并直接输出音频标记，通过双向 WebSocket 提供，带语音活动检测与插话打断。
works.title_zh: Gemini 原生音频（Live API）

works.title: CausVid
works.description: CausVid (MIT and Adobe, 2024-12) converts a slow bidirectional video diffusion model into a causal one that starts streaming frames after about 1.3 seconds at roughly 9 fps on one GPU.
works.description_zh: CausVid（MIT 与 Adobe，2024 年 12 月）把缓慢的双向视频扩散模型转换为因果模型，在单张 GPU 上约 1.3 秒后即可开始以约 9 fps 流式输出画面。
works.idea_en: Video that plays the moment you press generate: the hinge between offline clips and live, steerable streams.
works.idea_zh: 按下生成就开始播放的视频，是离线片段与可实时操控视频流之间的转折点。
works.method: Distribution-matching distillation of a bidirectional teacher into a 4-step autoregressive student with block-causal attention and KV caching.
works.method_zh: 用分布匹配蒸馏，把双向教师模型蒸馏成 4 步、块因果注意力并带 KV 缓存的自回归学生模型。

paper.title: From Slow Bidirectional to Fast Causal Video Generators

works.title: INFP
works.description: INFP animates a single portrait in a two-person conversation from both speakers' audio, switching on its own between speaking and listening, with nods, gaze and expressions while the other person talks.
works.description_zh: INFP 根据对话双方的音频驱动一张人像，在说话和倾听之间自动切换，在对方说话时呈现点头、视线和表情等反应。
works.idea_en: Removes the manual 'now speak / now listen' switch that most talking heads need, a precondition for natural turn-taking.
works.idea_zh: 去掉了多数说话头像需要的“现在说 / 现在听”手动切换，这是自然轮流发言的前提。
works.method: Stage 1 learns a low-dimensional motion latent from real conversation video (head imitation); stage 2 maps dual-track audio to those latents with a denoising model; trained on the new DyConv dyadic dataset.
works.method_zh: 第一阶段从真实对话视频中学习低维动作隐空间（头部模仿）；第二阶段用去噪模型把双轨音频映射到这些隐变量；训练数据为新构建的双人对话数据集 DyConv。

paper.title: INFP: Audio-Driven Interactive Head Generation in Dyadic Conversations

works.title_zh: INFP：双人对话中的交互式头部生成

works.title: MegaSaM
works.description: MegaSaM estimates accurate camera paths and consistent depth from casual, dynamic videos, including handheld footage with little camera motion, where classic SLAM and structure-from-motion fail.
works.description_zh: MegaSaM 能从随手拍摄的动态视频中估计准确的相机路径与一致的深度，包括相机几乎不动的手持素材，而这些正是传统 SLAM 与运动恢复结构失效的地方。
works.idea_en: A dependable camera and depth estimate is the first thing any 4D capture or video-to-world pipeline needs.
works.idea_zh: 可靠的相机与深度估计，是任何 4D 捕捉或视频转世界流程首先需要的。
works.method: A differentiable SLAM system in the style of DROID-SLAM is combined with monocular depth priors and uncertainty-aware optimisation, then refined into consistent video depth.
works.method_zh: 将 DROID-SLAM 风格的可微 SLAM 与单目深度先验和考虑不确定性的优化相结合，再细化为一致的视频深度。

paper.title: MegaSaM: Accurate, Fast, and Robust Structure and Motion from Casual Dynamic Videos

works.title: BTimer
works.description: NVIDIA's BTimer reconstructs a full 3D Gaussian snapshot of any moment in a monocular video in a single forward pass, giving a bullet-time view of moving scenes, including clips from video generators.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 BTimer 只需一次前向，就能为单目视频中的任意时刻重建完整的三维高斯快照，为运动场景提供子弹时间视角，也适用于视频生成模型的片段。
works.idea_en: Brings the feed-forward speed of VGGT-style models to moving scenes, and applies directly to generated video.
works.idea_zh: 把 VGGT 类模型的前馈速度带到运动场景中，并能直接用于生成的视频。
works.method: A transformer takes the context frames plus a target timestamp and outputs pixel-aligned Gaussians for that instant, trained on static and dynamic data with a curriculum.
works.method_zh: Transformer 输入上下文帧与目标时间戳，输出该时刻的像素对齐高斯，采用静态与动态数据的课程式训练。

paper.title: Feed-Forward Bullet-Time Reconstruction of Dynamic Scenes from Monocular Videos

works.title: Genie 2
works.description: A foundation world model that turns one prompt image into a 3D-looking world a person or agent can play with keyboard and mouse, with physics, lighting, NPCs and object interactions; DeepMind reports consistent play for up to about a minute.
works.description_zh: 一个基础世界模型：把一张提示图像变成看起来立体、可用键盘鼠标游玩的世界，包含物理、光照、NPC 与物体交互；DeepMind 称其一致性最长可维持约一分钟。
works.idea_en: Moves world models from 2D games to rich 3D-looking scenes, but only for short sessions and not in real time.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型从二维游戏推进到丰富、具立体感的场景，但只能短时运行，且不是实时的。
works.method: An autoregressive latent diffusion model over video frames, conditioned on keyboard and mouse actions, trained on a large video dataset; prompt images were generated with Imagen 3.
works.method_zh: 在视频帧潜空间上进行自回归扩散、以键盘鼠标动作为条件的模型，在大规模视频数据上训练；提示图像由 Imagen 3 生成。
works.specs: 10–20 s typical · up to ~1 min consistency (developer-reported)

works.title: Imagine360
works.description: Imagine360 (CUHK and Shanghai AI Laboratory, NeurIPS 2025) expands an ordinary perspective video into a full 360° video, inventing the surroundings outside the original frame while keeping its motion.
works.description_zh: Imagine360（香港中文大学与上海人工智能实验室，NeurIPS 2025）可把普通透视视频扩展成完整的 360° 视频，在保留原有运动的同时补全画框之外的周边环境。
works.idea_en: Turns phone footage of an event into surround material a participant can look around in.
works.idea_zh: 把手机拍下的事件画面变成参与者可以环顾的环绕素材。
works.method: Dual-branch perspective/panorama diffusion with antipodal masking and elevation-aware design, trained on panoramic video.
works.method_zh: 透视/全景双分支扩散，配合对跖遮罩（antipodal mask）与仰角感知设计，在全景视频上训练。

paper.title: Imagine360: Immersive 360 Video Generation from Perspective Anchor

works.title_zh: Imagine360：从透视锚点生成沉浸式 360 视频

works.title: Navigation World Models
works.description: A controllable video model that imagines what an agent will see along a candidate path, so a robot can plan a route by simulating trajectories and checking whether they reach the goal, including in unfamiliar places from a single image.
works.description_zh: 一个可控视频模型，能想象智能体沿某条候选路线会看到什么；机器人因此可以通过模拟轨迹、检查是否到达目标来规划路线，甚至能从单张图像出发在陌生环境中规划。
works.idea_en: Uses a world model as an imagination for planning, with constraints that can be added at planning time.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型当作规划时的想象力，并且可以在规划时临时加入约束。
works.method: A 1B-parameter Conditional Diffusion Transformer (CDiT) trained on egocentric videos of humans and robots, conditioned on past frames and navigation actions.
works.method_zh: 10 亿参数的条件扩散 Transformer（CDiT），在人类与机器人的第一人称视频上训练，以历史帧与导航动作为条件。

paper.title: Navigation World Models

works.title_zh: 导航世界模型

works.title: The Matrix
works.description: A world simulator that streams continuous 720p video of driving or walking through deserts, grassland, water and cities in first or third person, for uncut hour-long sequences at 16 fps; trained on a small amount of action-labelled play from games such as Forza Horizon 5 and Cyberpunk 2077 plus unlabelled real footage, it carries the game controls over to real scenes.
works.description_zh: 一个世界模拟器，以第一或第三人称连续流式生成 720p 视频，可在沙漠、草地、水面与城市中驾驶或行走，单段不间断长达一小时、速度为 16 fps；它在《极限竞速：地平线 5》《赛博朋克 2077》等游戏的少量带动作标注录像以及大量无标注真实画面上训练，能把游戏中的操控迁移到真实场景。
works.idea_en: Suggests that a little labelled game play can teach controls that transfer to real places, where recording controlled movement is hard.
works.idea_zh: 表明少量带标注的游戏录像就能教会可迁移到真实场所的操控，而在真实场所录制受控运动往往很难。
works.method: A video diffusion transformer with an interactive control module, trained on labelled AAA-game recordings and unlabelled real-world video, and run as a continuous stream for unbounded length (Tongyi Lab with HKU, Waterloo and the Vector Institute).
works.method_zh: 带交互控制模块的视频扩散 Transformer，在带标注的 3A 游戏录像与无标注真实视频上训练，以连续流的方式生成无限长度视频（通义实验室与香港大学、滑铁卢大学、Vector Institute 合作）。

paper.title: The Matrix: Infinite-Horizon World Generation with Real-Time Moving Control

works.title_zh: The Matrix：无限时长世界生成

works.title: HunyuanVideo
works.description: Tencent's HunyuanVideo (2024-12-03) was the largest open video model at release, at 13 billion parameters; Tencent reported it outperformed Runway Gen-3 and Luma 1.6 in professional human evaluation.
works.description_zh: 腾讯的 HunyuanVideo（2024-12-03）发布时是参数规模最大的开源视频模型（130 亿）；腾讯称其在专业人工评测中优于 Runway Gen-3 和 Luma 1.6。
works.idea_en: Briefly closed the gap between open and closed video quality and seeded a large ecosystem of LoRAs and control adapters.
works.idea_zh: 一度缩小了开源与闭源视频模型的质量差距，并带动了大量 LoRA 与控制适配器生态。
works.method: Dual-stream-to-single-stream diffusion transformer with a 3D causal VAE and a multimodal LLM as text encoder.
works.method_zh: 从双流到单流的扩散 Transformer，配 3D 因果 VAE，并用多模态大语言模型作为文本编码器。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework For Large Video Generative Models

works.title_zh: 混元视频 HunyuanVideo

works.title: Large World Model demo (Generating Worlds)
works.description: World Labs' first public result: a single image is turned into a 3D scene that can be explored in the browser in real time, with interactive camera effects such as depth of field and dolly zoom.
works.description_zh: World Labs 的首次公开成果：把一张图像变成可以在浏览器中实时探索的三维场景，并可交互地加入景深、滑动变焦等镜头效果。
works.idea_en: A generated world becomes a place you can return to rather than a clip that ends, though these first worlds were small and bounded.
works.idea_zh: 生成的世界第一次成为可以反复回到的“地方”，而不是播完即止的片段；不过这批早期世界范围较小、边界有限。
works.method: A generative model (details unpublished) lifts one image into an explicit 3D representation that is rendered client-side in real time; World Labs describes it as a first step toward large world models.
works.method_zh: 一个未公开细节的生成模型把单张图像提升为显式三维表示，在浏览器端实时渲染；World Labs 称之为迈向“大世界模型”的第一步。
works.specs: single image in · real-time browser rendering
works.title_zh: 大世界模型演示（Generating Worlds）

works.title: TRELLIS
works.description: Microsoft's open-source 3D generator built on a Structured LATent (SLAT) representation that decodes to meshes, 3D Gaussians or radiance fields; it generates assets from an image or text and supports local 3D edits.
works.description_zh: 微软开源的三维生成模型，基于结构化潜变量（SLAT）表示，可解码为网格、三维高斯或辐射场；可由图像或文字生成资产，并支持局部三维编辑。
works.idea_en: One latent, several output formats: the same generated object can become a game mesh or a splat for a photoreal scene, and parts can be regenerated without starting over.
works.idea_zh: 一个潜变量、多种输出格式：同一个生成物体既可做游戏网格，也可做照片级场景里的高斯泼溅，局部还能重新生成而不必从头来过。
works.method: A sparse 3D voxel grid carrying multiview DINOv2 features is encoded into structured latents and generated with rectified-flow transformers of up to 2B parameters trained on 500K assets.
works.method_zh: 携带多视角 DINOv2 特征的稀疏三维体素网格被编码为结构化潜变量，再由最多 20 亿参数、在 50 万个资产上训练的整流流 Transformer 生成。
works.specs: up to 2B parameters · 500K training assets · MIT licence

paper.title: Structured 3D Latents for Scalable and Versatile 3D Generation

works.title: CAT4D
works.description: Google DeepMind's CAT4D turns a single monocular video of a dynamic scene into a 4D Gaussian scene by first generating the missing camera viewpoints with a multi-view video diffusion model.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 的 CAT4D 先用多视角视频扩散模型生成缺失的相机视角，再把单目动态场景视频变成 4D 高斯场景。
works.idea_en: Generation fills what one camera could not see, which is how a casual clip can become a navigable moment.
works.idea_zh: 生成补足了单个相机看不到的部分，这正是一段随手视频能变成可漫游时刻的途径。
works.method: A multi-view video diffusion model, trained on mixed static, dynamic and synthetic data, samples novel views at chosen times; an alternating sampling strategy keeps them consistent before 4D Gaussian fitting.
works.method_zh: 在静态、动态与合成数据混合上训练的多视角视频扩散模型，可在指定时间采样新视角，交替采样策略保证一致性，然后拟合 4D 高斯。

paper.title: CAT4D: Create Anything in 4D with Multi-View Video Diffusion Models

works.title: Make-It-Animatable
works.description: Makes any 3D humanoid model, mesh or Gaussian splat, animation-ready in under one second by predicting blend weights, bones and pose transformations, whatever the input pose.
works.description_zh: 无论输入姿态如何，都能在一秒内预测混合权重、骨骼和姿态变换，让任意三维人形模型（网格或高斯泼溅）可以直接做动画。
works.idea_en: Sub-second rigging means a character generated during a session can be animated immediately.
works.idea_zh: 亚秒级绑定意味着在体验中生成的角色可以马上动起来。
works.method: A particle-based shape autoencoder with coarse-to-fine, structure-aware prediction of skinning weights, bone positions and pose-to-rest transforms against a standard humanoid skeleton.
works.method_zh: 基于粒子的形状自编码器，以由粗到细、感知结构的方式，相对标准人形骨架预测蒙皮权重、骨骼位置和姿态到静止姿态的变换。

paper.title: Make-It-Animatable: An Efficient Framework for Authoring Animation-Ready 3D Characters

works.title: LTX-Video
works.description: Lightricks' LTX-Video (2024-11-22) was the first open video model fast enough to generate clips faster than they play: about five seconds of 768×512 video in roughly four seconds on an H100. A 13B version followed in May 2025.
works.description_zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-Video（2024-11-22）是首个生成速度快于播放速度的开源视频模型：在 H100 上约 4 秒生成 5 秒 768×512 视频。13B 版本于 2025 年 5 月推出。
works.idea_en: Generation faster than real time is the precondition for any loop in which a scene reacts to a participant.
works.idea_zh: 生成快于实时，是场景能对参与者作出反应的任何闭环的前提。
works.method: DiT with a highly compressed VAE (1:192) whose decoder also performs the final denoising step.
works.method_zh: 采用高压缩比 VAE（1:192）的 DiT，VAE 解码器同时完成最后一步去噪。
works.specs: 2B / 13B · 768×512 · 24 fps · faster than real time on H100

paper.title: LTX-Video: Realtime Video Latent Diffusion

works.title: OASIS
works.description: A social-media simulator in which up to one million LLM agents follow, post, comment and repost on X- and Reddit-like platforms with recommendation feeds, used to replicate information spread, group polarization and herd effects.
works.description_zh: 一个社交媒体模拟器：多达一百万个 LLM 智能体在带推荐流的类 X、类 Reddit 平台上关注、发帖、评论与转发，用来复现信息扩散、群体极化与从众效应。
works.idea_en: Lets you test how a feed algorithm or a rumor changes a crowd before trying anything on real users.
works.idea_zh: 可以先在模拟人群中测试推荐算法或谣言会如何改变群体，再考虑在真实用户身上尝试。
works.method: Agents built on the CAMEL framework act through a shared action space over a dynamic social graph; an environment server and interest- or hot-score-based recommender update what each agent sees, and parallel LLM inference lets it scale to very large populations.
works.method_zh: 基于 CAMEL 框架的智能体在动态社交图上通过统一的动作空间行动；环境服务器与基于兴趣或热度的推荐系统决定每个智能体看到的内容，并借助并行的大语言模型推理扩展到超大规模人群。

paper.title: OASIS: Open Agent Social Interaction Simulations with One Million Agents

works.title: Generative Agent Simulations of 1,000 People
works.description: Stanford researchers interviewed 1,052 Americans for two hours each and turned every transcript into an agent that answers surveys, personality tests and economic games as that person would. The agents were scored against the participants' own answers given two weeks later.
works.description_zh: 斯坦福研究者对 1,052 名美国人各做了两小时访谈，把每份访谈记录变成一个智能体，让它像本人一样回答问卷、人格测验与经济博弈。评估标准是参与者本人两周后再次作答的一致性。
works.idea_en: Agents grounded in a real person's own words, not demographics, can stand in for that individual on held-out questions; this is the bridge from Smallville to participant 'digital twins' in behavioral research.
works.idea_zh: 以真实个体自己的话（而非人口统计标签）为基础的智能体，能在未见过的问题上替代这个人作答；这是从 Smallville 走向行为研究中参与者“数字孪生”的桥梁。
works.method: An AI interviewer ran semi-structured American Voices Project interviews; full transcripts were placed in an LLM's context to build per-person agents, evaluated on General Social Survey items, Big Five, economic games and replicated experiments, normalised by each participant's two-week test-retest consistency.
works.method_zh: 由 AI 访谈员按 American Voices Project 提纲进行半结构化访谈；将完整访谈记录放入大语言模型上下文，构建每个人的智能体，并在综合社会调查（GSS）题目、大五人格、经济博弈与复现实验上评估，以参与者本人两周重测一致性作归一化。
works.specs: 1,052 participants · 2-hour interviews · 83–86% of test-retest consistency on GSS

paper.title: LLM Agents Grounded in Self-Reports Enable General-Purpose Simulation of Individuals

works.title_zh: 1,000 人的生成式智能体模拟

works.title: DimensionX
works.description: DimensionX turns a single photo into either a 3D scene (the camera moves, time stands still) or a 4D scene (time moves and can be viewed from several angles), reconstructed as Gaussian splats.
works.description_zh: DimensionX 能把一张照片变成三维场景（相机移动、时间静止）或 4D 场景（时间流动、可从多个角度观看），并重建为高斯泼溅。
works.idea_en: Separating 'move the camera' from 'let time pass' inside one video model gives a cheap route from any image to a 3D or 4D scene.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个视频模型中把“移动相机”与“让时间流逝”分开，就能以较低成本把任意图像变成三维或 4D 场景。
works.method: ST-Director trains dimension-aware LoRAs on the CogVideoX-5B image-to-video model to control spatial and temporal change separately; the generated view sets are then reconstructed into 3D or 4D Gaussians.
works.method_zh: ST-Director 在 CogVideoX-5B 图生视频模型上训练维度感知的 LoRA，分别控制空间与时间变化；生成的视角集合再被重建为三维或 4D 高斯。

paper.title: DimensionX: Create Any 3D and 4D Scenes from a Single Image with Controllable Video Diffusion

works.title_zh: DimensionX 单图生成三维与 4D 场景

works.title: GenXD
works.description: Model from the National University of Singapore and Microsoft that generates either static 3D or moving 4D scenes from one or more images: it outputs camera-controlled videos and consistent multi-view frames that can be lifted into 3D or 4D Gaussian representations. It introduced CamVid-30K, a real-world 4D scene dataset mined from videos; code, model and data are public.
works.description_zh: 新加坡国立大学与微软的模型：根据一张或多张图像生成静态三维场景或运动的 4D 场景，输出沿指定镜头路径的视频和一致的多视角画面，可再提升为三维或 4D 高斯表示。它还发布了从视频中挖掘得到的真实世界 4D 场景数据集 CamVid-30K；代码、模型与数据均已公开。
works.idea_en: One model learns from both static scans and everyday video, so the shortage of 4D data matters less.
works.idea_zh: 一个模型同时学习静态扫描和日常视频，4D 数据稀缺的问题因此缓解不少。
works.method: A curation pipeline estimates camera poses and object-motion strength from videos to build CamVid-30K; multiview-temporal modules disentangle camera and object motion so that one diffusion model trains on 3D and 4D data, and masked latent conditions accept any number of input views.
works.method_zh: 数据整理流程从视频中估计相机位姿与物体运动强度，构建 CamVid-30K；多视角—时间模块把相机运动与物体运动解耦，使同一个扩散模型可以同时用三维和 4D 数据训练，掩码潜变量条件则支持任意数量的输入视角。

paper.title: GenXD: Generating Any 3D and 4D Scenes

works.title_zh: GenXD 生成任意三维与 4D 场景

works.title: GameGen-X
works.description: A diffusion transformer that generates open-world game footage (characters, environments, actions, events) from text, then lets a player steer the following clips with keyboard-style controls or new prompts; it was trained on OGameData, over a million clips from more than 150 games.
works.description_zh: 一个扩散 Transformer：先根据文字生成开放世界游戏画面（角色、环境、动作与事件），再让玩家用键盘式操作或新的提示控制后续片段；训练数据 OGameData 包含来自 150 多款游戏的一百多万段视频。
works.idea_en: An early case of prototyping a game-like situation as generated video plus clip-level control, with no engine underneath.
works.idea_zh: 较早把类游戏情境做成“生成视频 + 片段级控制”的原型，底层没有游戏引擎。
works.method: Two-stage training: a text-to-video foundation model pre-trained on OGameData, then an InstructNet of game-related control experts tuned while the foundation model stays frozen.
works.method_zh: 两阶段训练：先在 OGameData 上预训练文生视频基础模型，再冻结基础模型，只微调由游戏相关控制专家组成的 InstructNet。

paper.title: GameGen-X: Interactive Open-world Game Video Generation

works.title: Oasis
works.description: A Minecraft-like open world generated frame by frame from keyboard and mouse input and playable in the browser at about 20 fps; the code and a 500M-parameter checkpoint were released openly alongside a live demo of a larger model.
works.description_zh: 一个类 Minecraft 的开放世界，根据键盘鼠标输入逐帧生成，可在浏览器中以约 20 fps 游玩；代码与 5 亿参数的模型权重随在线演示（使用更大的模型）一同开源。
works.idea_en: The first real-time AI game world played at scale, which also exposed how quickly an unanchored world forgets what you left behind.
works.idea_zh: 第一个被大规模试玩的实时 AI 游戏世界，也暴露出缺少锚定的世界会多么迅速地忘记你身后的东西。
works.method: A ViT autoencoder and a diffusion transformer generate each frame autoregressively from past frames and actions, trained with Diffusion Forcing; Etched targeted its Sohu chip for higher resolutions.
works.method_zh: 由 ViT 自编码器与扩散 Transformer 根据历史帧与动作自回归生成每一帧，采用 Diffusion Forcing 训练；Etched 计划用其 Sohu 芯片支撑更高分辨率。

works.title: Project Sid
works.description: Up to more than 1,000 LLM agents share a Minecraft server for hours: they take on roles such as farmer or guard, vote to change a tax law, and pass a parody religion from agent to agent.
works.description_zh: 多达 1,000 多个 LLM 智能体在同一个 Minecraft 服务器里共同生活数小时：它们自发分工成农民、守卫等角色，投票修改税法，还把一种戏仿宗教在彼此之间传播。
works.idea_en: Scale changes the questions: with hundreds of agents in one persistent world, you can watch institutions and culture form, or fail to.
works.idea_zh: 规模改变了问题：数百个智能体共处一个持续世界时，可以观察制度与文化如何形成或瓦解。
works.method: The PIANO architecture runs concurrent modules (memory, action, talking, social awareness, goals) and a cognitive controller that keeps an agent's speech and actions coherent in real time; societies were scored on civilizational benchmarks such as specialization, rule adherence and meme transmission.
works.method_zh: PIANO 架构让多个模块（记忆、行动、对话、社会感知、目标）并发运行，再由认知控制器实时保持智能体言行一致；以“文明基准”评估社会表现，如分工、规则遵守与文化传播。

paper.title: Project Sid: Many-agent simulations toward AI civilization

works.title: URAvatar
works.description: URAvatar creates a relightable, drivable photoreal head avatar from a phone scan, using a universal prior learned from hundreds of studio-captured people, and renders it in real time under new lighting.
works.description_zh: URAvatar 只需一次手机扫描就能生成可重光照、可驱动的照片级头部化身；它利用从数百名影棚采集者身上学到的通用先验，并能在新光照下实时渲染。
works.idea_en: Brings Codec-Avatar quality from the capture studio to a phone, the step that would let a study include participants' own faces.
works.idea_zh: 把 Codec Avatar 的质量从采集影棚带到手机上，这一步让研究可以使用参与者自己的脸。
works.method: A universal relightable Gaussian avatar prior trained on multi-view, multi-light captures; a phone scan is fitted by inverse rendering and fine-tuning the prior.
works.method_zh: 在多视角、多光照采集数据上训练通用的可重光照高斯化身先验；手机扫描通过逆向渲染对先验进行拟合与微调。

paper.title: URAvatar: Universal Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars

works.title_zh: URAvatar：通用可重光照高斯化身

works.title: Digital AVATAR therapy for distressing voices in psychosis: the phase 2/3 AVATAR2 trial
works.description: People who hear distressing voices held therapist-facilitated dialogues with a digital face whose voice the therapist produced live through voice conversion. In a multisite phase 2/3 trial with 345 participants, a brief (6-session) and an extended (12-session) form, each added to usual care, reduced voice-related distress at 16 weeks but not at 28 weeks.
works.description_zh: 听到痛苦幻听的人与一个数字面孔进行由治疗师引导的对话，这个面孔的声音由治疗师通过实时变声现场发出。在一项有 345 名参与者的多中心 II/III 期试验中，简短版（6 次）和扩展版（12 次）分别叠加常规治疗，都在第 16 周降低了与幻听相关的痛苦，但第 28 周时效果不再显著。
works.idea_en: A controllable embodiment of an inner voice can be confronted and changed, but the benefit faded by 28 weeks, a reminder that immersive therapy trials need long follow-up.
works.idea_zh: 内心声音的可控化身可以被直面和改变，但获益在第 28 周已消退——提醒沉浸式治疗试验需要长期随访。
works.method: Multisite, assessor-blinded randomized trial of AVATAR-Brief and AVATAR-Extended plus treatment as usual versus usual care alone, intention-to-treat analysis; therapists voice the avatar through real-time voice conversion.
works.method_zh: 多中心、评估者盲法随机试验，比较 AVATAR 简短版和扩展版（均叠加常规治疗）与单纯常规治疗，采用意向性分析；治疗师通过实时变声为化身配音。

paper.title: Digital AVATAR therapy for distressing voices in psychosis: the phase 2/3 AVATAR2 trial

works.title_zh: 针对精神病痛苦幻听的数字化身疗法：II/III 期 AVATAR2 试验

works.title: Centaur
works.description: A language model fine-tuned to predict what people do in psychology experiments, trial by trial: given any experiment described in natural language, it produces choices like a participant's. The Nature paper (July 2025) reports that it predicts held-out participants better than existing cognitive models and generalizes to new cover stories, task changes and domains.
works.description_zh: 一个经过微调、能逐个试次预测人在心理学实验中如何行动的语言模型：只要用自然语言描述实验，它就能像被试一样作出选择。《自然》论文（2025 年 7 月）报告，它对未参与训练的被试的预测优于现有认知模型，并能推广到新的情境设定、任务变化与新领域。
works.idea_en: A simulated participant for any experiment that can be written down; it makes piloting generated situations cheap, but agreement with averages is not evidence about any one person.
works.idea_zh: 一个可用于任何能写成文字的实验的“模拟被试”；它让生成情境的预实验变得廉价，但与群体平均一致，并不等于能代表任何一个具体的人。
works.method: Llama 3.1 70B fine-tuned with QLoRA on Psych-101, a dataset that transcribes trial-by-trial data from 160 experiments (more than 60,000 participants and 10,000,000 choices) into natural language; evaluated on held-out participants, modified tasks and alignment with human neural activity.
works.method_zh: 在 Psych-101 上用 QLoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 70B；Psych-101 把 160 项实验（6 万多名被试、1,000 多万次选择）的逐试次数据转写成自然语言；评估包括未参与训练的被试、修改后的任务以及与人类神经活动的对齐程度。
works.specs: Llama 3.1 70B + QLoRA · Psych-101: 160 experiments, 60,000+ participants, 10M+ choices

paper.title: A foundation model to predict and capture human cognition

works.title_zh: Centaur：人类认知基础模型

works.title: MoGe
works.description: Microsoft's open models that recover a 3D point map of an open-domain photo (geometry plus camera field of view) in one pass; MoGe-2 (July 2025) added metric scale and sharper detail and MoGe-3 (August 2026) finer point-map geometry.
works.description_zh: 微软的开源模型，一次前向即可恢复任意照片的三维点图（几何及相机视场角）；MoGe-2（2025 年 7 月）加入真实尺度和更锐利的细节，MoGe-3（2026 年 8 月）进一步提升点图几何的精细度。
works.idea_en: Predicting a point map rather than a depth map gives a usable 3D layout of a photo, including the camera, in a single step.
works.idea_zh: 预测点图而不是深度图，一步就能得到照片可用的三维布局，连相机参数也一并给出。
works.method: A ViT model predicts affine-invariant point maps trained with a robust, optimal alignment solver and multi-scale local geometry losses; later versions add metric-scale prediction.
works.method_zh: ViT 模型预测仿射不变的点图，训练时使用稳健的最优对齐求解器和多尺度局部几何损失；后续版本加入真实尺度预测。

paper.title: MoGe: Unlocking Accurate Monocular Geometry Estimation for Open-Domain Images with Optimal Training Supervision

works.title: Mochi 1
works.description: Genmo's Mochi 1 (2024-10-22) was a 10-billion-parameter open text-to-video model under Apache 2.0, with motion quality and prompt adherence that were strong for its time.
works.description_zh: Genmo 的 Mochi 1（2024-10-22）是 100 亿参数、Apache 2.0 许可的开源文生视频模型，运动质量与提示遵循在当时表现较强。
works.idea_en: Permissive licensing made it a common base for academic fine-tuning and benchmarking.
works.idea_zh: 宽松的许可使其成为学术微调与评测中常用的基础模型。
works.method: Asymmetric Diffusion Transformer (AsymmDiT) with a video VAE that compresses 128x and a single T5-XXL text encoder.
works.method_zh: 非对称扩散 Transformer（AsymmDiT），视频 VAE 压缩 128 倍，只用一个 T5-XXL 文本编码器。

works.title: The MAXLab Aggression and Bystander Intervention Scenario Set (MAXLab_ABISS)
works.description: A modular set of 360° videos set in a bar, available in English, German and Dutch, that places participants in a stranger's insult, the harassment of a young woman or a bar fight, so researchers can measure emotions and decisions about violence and intervention. Two samples (n=101, n=55) showed the scenes evoked the targeted emotions.
works.description_zh: 一套以酒吧为场景、可模块化组合的 360° 视频，提供英语、德语和荷兰语版本，让参与者置身于被陌生人羞辱、目睹年轻女性被骚扰或酒吧斗殴等情境，研究者可借此测量与暴力和干预相关的情绪与决策。两个样本（n=101、n=55）显示这些场景能引发预期的情绪。
works.idea_en: A shared, modular stimulus set makes violent situations comparable across labs and languages: the authored baseline that generated variants would have to match.
works.idea_zh: 共享且可模块化的刺激材料，让暴力情境可以跨实验室、跨语言比较——这正是生成式变体需要达到的人工制作基线。
works.method: Modular 360° video scenes viewed in a headset, published with production notes, technical specifications and an access procedure for researchers; validated against self-reported emotions at the moment of decision in two samples.
works.method_zh: 在头显中观看的模块化 360° 视频场景，论文公开了制作过程、技术规格与研究者获取方式；在两个样本中以决策时刻的自评情绪进行验证。
works.specs: 360° video · EN / DE / NL · validation n=101 and n=55

paper.title: The MAXLab aggression and bystander intervention scenario set (MAXLab_ABISS): A modular scenario set for studying decision making in situations of interpersonal violence in virtual reality

works.title_zh: MAXLab 攻击与旁观者干预情境集（MAXLab_ABISS）

works.title: VidPanos
works.description: VidPanos (University of Washington and Google DeepMind, SIGGRAPH Asia 2024) turns a casual panning video into a panoramic video of the same length, as if filmed with a wide-angle camera, so people and objects outside the current frame keep moving instead of freezing as in a stitched photo panorama.
works.description_zh: VidPanos（华盛顿大学与 Google DeepMind，SIGGRAPH Asia 2024）把随手拍的摇镜头视频变成同等长度的全景视频，就像用广角镜头拍摄一样：当前画面外的人和物体仍在运动，而不是像拼接的全景照片那样静止。
works.idea_en: Generative completion fills in what the camera did not see at each moment, a step from a filmed angle toward a surrounding scene.
works.idea_zh: 生成式补全填上了摄像机每一刻没有拍到的部分，是从一个拍摄角度走向环绕场景的一步。
works.method: Space-time outpainting of the panorama volume, using a pretrained generative video model as one component of a synthesis system that works around the model's limited spatial and temporal context.
works.method_zh: 对全景时空体进行外扩补全：把预训练视频生成模型作为合成系统的一个组件，并绕开其有限的空间与时间上下文。

paper.title: VidPanos: Generative Panoramic Videos from Casual Panning Videos

works.title_zh: VidPanos：从随手摇拍视频生成全景视频

works.title: Both Ears Wide Open (BEWO)
works.description: Generates binaural spatial audio from a text description, placing and moving sound sources as written (e.g. a dog barking on the left that runs to the right), and also accepts image prompts. The authors release BEWO-1M, about one million text-spatial audio pairs.
works.description_zh: 根据文字描述生成双耳空间音频，按描述放置并移动声源（例如左边一只狗在叫，然后跑到右边），也接受图像提示。作者发布了约一百万对“文本—空间音频”的 BEWO-1M 数据集。
works.idea_en: Text control over where a sound is and how it moves lets authors script spatial cues for a VR scene without a sound engine.
works.idea_zh: 用文字控制声音的位置与移动，作者无需声音引擎就能为 VR 场景编排空间线索。
works.method: SpatialSonic, a one-stage latent diffusion model guided by spatial-aware text and image encoders and azimuth-state conditioning, trained on BEWO-1M.
works.method_zh: SpatialSonic：单阶段潜空间扩散模型，由具备空间感知的文本与图像编码器以及方位角状态条件引导，在 BEWO-1M 上训练。

paper.title: Both Ears Wide Open: Towards Language-Driven Spatial Audio Generation

works.title_zh: Both Ears Wide Open：语言驱动的空间音频生成

works.title: Dreamcrafter
works.description: A VR editor for captured scenes (NeRFs and Gaussian splats): add or restyle objects by voice or by direct manipulation, and keep working with quick previews while slower generations finish.
works.description_zh: 一个用于捕捉场景（NeRF 与高斯泼溅）的 VR 编辑器：可以用语音或直接操作添加、重绘物体，并在较慢的生成完成前借助快速预览继续工作。
works.idea_en: Proxies that stand in during high-latency generation keep immersive editing fluid even when the model is slow.
works.idea_zh: 在高延迟生成期间用代理表示顶替，即使模型很慢，沉浸式编辑也能保持流畅。
works.method: A modular VR architecture plugs in generative 2D, 3D and radiance-field editing models, mixes natural-language and direct-manipulation control, and shows proxy representations during slow operations.
works.method_zh: 模块化 VR 架构接入二维、三维与辐射场编辑等生成模型，混合自然语言与直接操作两种控制方式，并在慢速操作时显示代理表示。

paper.title: Dreamcrafter: Immersive Editing of 3D Radiance Fields Through Flexible, Generative Inputs and Outputs

works.title: Thing2Reality
works.description: During an XR call, a participant grabs a 2D image or a physical object from the video feed and it materializes as a 3D object between everyone, which they can move, rotate and point at.
works.description_zh: 在 XR 通话中，参与者从视频画面里“抓取”一张二维图片或一个实物，它就在大家之间变成三维物体，可以移动、旋转并指着讨论。
works.idea_en: Turning shared 2D content into 3D on the spot makes remote discussion spatial: people can reference parts of an object, not just a picture of it.
works.idea_zh: 把共享的二维内容当场变成三维，让远程讨论具有空间性：人们可以指向物体的某个部位，而不只是一张图。
works.method: Segmented 2D content is converted into conditioned multiview renderings and then 3D Gaussians with image-to-3D generation, and shared in a multi-user XR session; a user study measured discussion efficiency.
works.method_zh: 把分割出的二维内容先生成条件多视图渲染，再用图像到三维生成得到三维高斯，并在多人 XR 会话中共享；用户研究测量了讨论效率。

paper.title: Thing2Reality: Enabling Spontaneous Creation of 3D Objects from 2D Content using Generative AI in XR Meetings

works.title: MonST3R
works.description: MonST3R extends DUSt3R-style pointmaps to videos with motion, estimating per-frame geometry, camera trajectory and moving-object masks directly from a monocular clip.
works.description_zh: MonST3R 把 DUSt3R 式点图扩展到有运动的视频，直接从单目片段估计逐帧几何、相机轨迹与运动物体掩码。
works.idea_en: Showed that feed-forward geometry need not assume a frozen world.
works.idea_zh: 说明前馈式几何不必假设世界是静止的。
works.method: DUSt3R is fine-tuned on a small mix of synthetic dynamic datasets to predict per-timestep pointmaps, followed by a light global optimisation over windows.
works.method_zh: 在少量合成动态数据集的混合上微调 DUSt3R，使其预测逐时间步点图，再在时间窗口上做轻量的全局优化。

paper.title: MonST3R: A Simple Approach for Estimating Geometry in the Presence of Motion

works.title: Movie Gen
works.description: Meta's Movie Gen (2024-10-04) is a research suite that generates 16-second 1080p video, personalizes it from a photo of a person, edits it by text and adds synchronized sound effects and music; it was not released as a standalone product.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 Movie Gen（2024-10-04）是一套研究模型，可生成 16 秒 1080p 视频，用一张人物照片做个性化，用文字编辑视频，并配上同步音效和音乐；未作为独立产品发布。
works.idea_en: Put personalization, editing and sound into one documented system, with one of the most detailed public technical reports of its generation.
works.idea_zh: 把个性化、编辑和声音放进同一个系统，并发布了同代最详细的公开技术报告之一。
works.method: 30B-parameter transformer trained with flow matching for video, plus a 13B audio model, described in a 92-page report.
works.method_zh: 300 亿参数、以流匹配训练的视频 Transformer，外加 130 亿参数的音频模型，详见 92 页技术报告。

paper.title: Movie Gen: A Cast of Media Foundation Models

works.title: Depth Pro
works.description: Apple's open monocular depth model that predicts a sharp, metric-scale depth map from a single photo, without camera intrinsics, in a fraction of a second.
works.description_zh: Apple 的开源单目深度模型：不需要相机内参，在不到一秒内从一张照片预测出边缘锐利、具有真实尺度的深度图。
works.idea_en: Metric depth from any photo is the cheapest step from a picture to geometry; most photo-to-scene pipelines start here.
works.idea_zh: 从任意照片得到真实尺度的深度，是从图像走向几何最便宜的一步；多数照片转场景流程都从这里开始。
works.method: A multi-scale vision-transformer encoder with a combined real and synthetic training curriculum predicts metric depth and estimates focal length from the image itself.
works.method_zh: 多尺度视觉 Transformer 编码器，结合真实与合成数据的训练课程，预测真实尺度深度，并直接从图像估计焦距。
works.specs: 2.25-megapixel depth map in 0.3 s on a standard GPU (authors)

paper.title: Depth Pro: Sharp Monocular Metric Depth in Less Than a Second

works.title: OpenAI Realtime API and GPT-Live
works.description: OpenAI's low-latency speech-to-speech interface over WebRTC, WebSocket or SIP: beta at DevDay 2024, generally available on 2025-08-28 with gpt-realtime, then gpt-realtime-2 (2026-05-07) and 2.1 (2026-07-06). On 2026-09-10 OpenAI made GPT-Live 1 generally available, a full-duplex voice layer that keeps talking while a separate backend model or agent runs tools ('delegation').
works.description_zh: OpenAI 的低延迟语音到语音接口，支持 WebRTC、WebSocket 或 SIP：2024 年 DevDay 推出测试版，2025-08-28 随 gpt-realtime 正式发布，之后有 gpt-realtime-2（2026-05-07）与 2.1（2026-07-06）。2026-09-10，OpenAI 正式发布 GPT-Live 1：一个全双工语音层，在后台模型或智能体调用工具时仍能继续对话（称为“委托”）。
works.idea_en: Separates the voice that keeps a conversation going from the reasoning that decides what a character does, the architecture a responsive virtual confederate needs.
works.idea_zh: 把维持对话的声音与决定角色行为的推理分开，这正是一个反应灵敏的虚拟实验同谋所需要的架构。
works.method: Persistent sessions stream audio in and out of a native audio model; server-side voice-activity detection handles turn-taking and interruption, and function calls or delegated backend tasks run while audio continues.
works.method_zh: 持久会话把音频持续送入并取出原生音频模型；服务器端语音活动检测负责话轮与打断，函数调用或委托给后台的任务在语音继续时并行执行。
works.specs: WebRTC / WebSocket / SIP · beta 2024-10-01 · GA 2025-08-28 · beta interface removed 2026-05-12 · GPT-Live 1 GA 2026-09-10
works.title_zh: OpenAI Realtime API 与 GPT-Live

works.title: Runway API (Runway Dev)
works.description: Runway's developer platform serves its own video, image and audio models and models from other labs through one API, with a model router, reusable workflows and real-time conversational 'Characters'. Runway ran its first online API hackathon in May 2026 around real-time video agents.
works.description_zh: Runway 的开发者平台通过一个 API 提供自家及其他机构的视频、图像与音频模型，并配有模型路由、可复用工作流和实时对话角色“Characters”。2026 年 5 月，Runway 举办了首届线上 API 黑客松，主题是实时视频智能体。
works.idea_en: One integration covers pre-rendered clips and live conversational characters, so a study can move between offline and real-time stimuli without changing vendor.
works.idea_zh: 一次接入就能同时覆盖预渲染片段与实时对话角色，研究可以在离线刺激与实时刺激之间切换，而不必更换供应商。
works.method: REST task API with SDKs; a router picks a model per request from a cost, latency or quality preference, and Characters stream in real time (likely over WebRTC).
works.method_zh: 带 SDK 的 REST 任务 API；路由器按成本、延迟或质量偏好为每个请求选择模型，Characters 以实时流方式输出（很可能基于 WebRTC）。
works.specs: launched 2024-09 · credit-based billing · model router · real-time Characters

works.title: Social Conjuring
works.description: Several people stand in the same virtual world and build and change it together at runtime by prompting an AI, which places and modifies objects while they talk and react to each other's requests.
works.description_zh: 多人同处一个虚拟世界，在运行中通过向 AI 发出提示共同搭建和修改它；AI 一边放置、调整物体，大家一边交谈并回应彼此的请求。
works.idea_en: Shows that prompting a world into existence becomes a social act: what gets generated depends on who else is in the room.
works.idea_zh: 表明“用提示词召唤世界”会变成一种社交行为：生成什么，取决于房间里还有谁。
works.method: The Social Conjurer framework combines LLM-driven 3D scene generation with social, tool-based and spatial-reasoning interactions for multi-user real-time co-creation, evaluated in a preliminary user study (N=12).
works.method_zh: Social Conjurer 框架把大语言模型驱动的三维场景生成，与社交互动、工具操作和空间推理结合起来，支持多人实时共创，并通过初步用户研究（N=12）评估。

paper.title: Social Conjuring: Multi-User Runtime Collaboration with AI in Building Virtual 3D Worlds

works.title_zh: 社交召唤：多人与 AI 实时协作搭建虚拟三维世界

works.title: Meta Spatial SDK
works.description: Meta's Kotlin / Android framework for building Horizon OS apps on Quest without a game engine: 2D Android panels, 3D glTF content, mixed-reality scene understanding and passthrough camera access in one entity-component runtime, with a desktop Spatial Editor. It lets mobile developers add mixed-reality features, including AI that reads the passthrough camera feed, to existing apps.
works.description_zh: Meta 推出的 Kotlin / Android 框架，无需游戏引擎即可开发 Quest 上的 Horizon OS 应用：在一个实体组件运行时中整合二维 Android 面板、三维 glTF 内容、混合现实场景理解与透视摄像头访问，并配有桌面端 Spatial Editor。移动开发者可以借此为现有应用加入混合现实功能，包括读取透视摄像头画面的 AI。
works.idea_en: Lowers the cost of a mixed-reality study app to that of an Android app, including access to the headset camera for AI that reads the participant's surroundings.
works.idea_zh: 把开发一款混合现实研究应用的成本降到与 Android 应用相当，还能访问头显摄像头，让 AI 读取被试所处的环境。
works.method: Entity-component-system scene graph with a physically based renderer, the Android activity lifecycle, and Horizon OS mixed-reality APIs (scene, anchors, passthrough camera).
works.method_zh: 实体组件系统场景图，配合基于物理的渲染器、Android Activity 生命周期以及 Horizon OS 混合现实 API（场景、锚点、透视摄像头）。
works.specs: Kotlin / Android · Quest 3 and 3S · Spatial Editor · announced 2024-09-25

works.title: MaskedMimic
works.description: A single physics-based controller for simulated humanoids that fills in full-body motion from any partial description, such as sparse keyframes, VR head and hand tracking, text, or objects to interact with, and runs inside a physics simulator.
works.description_zh: 一个用于仿真人形的统一物理控制器，可根据任意不完整的描述（稀疏关键帧、VR 头部与手部追踪、文字或要交互的物体）补全全身动作，并在物理仿真器中运行。
works.idea_en: Physically simulated characters that react to pushes, terrain and objects, steered by whatever constraints a scenario author sets, are closer to behaving actors than kinematic animation clips.
works.idea_zh: 会对推挤、地形和物体作出反应、并能按情境设计者设定的任意约束来操控的物理仿真角色，比运动学动画片段更接近真正“会表演”的演员。
works.method: Motion inpainting: a motion-tracking teacher policy is distilled into a conditional VAE policy that takes masked motion descriptions, trained on large motion-capture datasets in NVIDIA Isaac Gym; code is released in ProtoMotions.
works.method_zh: 动作补全：把动作追踪教师策略蒸馏为以掩码动作描述为输入的条件 VAE 策略，在 NVIDIA Isaac Gym 中用大规模动捕数据训练；代码在 ProtoMotions 中开源。

paper.title: MaskedMimic: Unified Physics-Based Character Control Through Masked Motion Inpainting

works.title: SpaceBlender
works.description: Each participant contributes photos of their own room, and SpaceBlender stitches them into one generated VR space where remote collaborators meet amid familiar surroundings.
works.description_zh: 每位参与者提供自己房间的照片，SpaceBlender 把它们拼接成一个生成的 VR 空间，异地协作者在彼此熟悉的环境中会面。
works.idea_en: Generating a meeting place from everyone's real context helps familiarity, but generated clutter can also pull attention away from the task.
works.idea_zh: 用每个人的真实环境生成会面空间能带来熟悉感，但生成出的杂乱细节也可能分散对任务的注意。
works.method: Depth estimation lifts 2D photos to meshes, which are aligned and joined by diffusion-based space completion guided by geometric priors and adaptive prompts; a within-subjects study (N=20, in pairs) compared it with a generic VR room and a scene-generation baseline.
works.method_zh: 通过深度估计把二维照片抬升为网格，再在几何先验和自适应提示引导下，用扩散模型补全空间、对齐拼接；被试内研究（N=20，两两一组）将其与普通 VR 房间及一个场景生成基线比较。

paper.title: SpaceBlender: Creating Context-Rich Collaborative Spaces Through Generative 3D Scene Blending

works.title: AI People
works.description: A sandbox game in which every character is an LLM agent with its own emotions and motivations; players talk to them, set up and share custom scenarios, and watch stories emerge in sessions of about ten minutes. The alpha opened on 19 September 2024 at US$10 a month; by October 2026 the game's website redirects to GoodAI's homepage and its current status is unclear.
works.description_zh: 一款沙盒游戏：每个角色都是有自己情绪与动机的大语言模型智能体；玩家与他们交谈，创建并分享自定义情境，在约十分钟的游玩中观察故事自然展开。测试版于 2024 年 9 月 19 日开放，月费 10 美元；到 2026 年 10 月，游戏网站已跳转到 GoodAI 首页，现状不明。
works.idea_en: Lets players author a situation and its cast, then see what LLM characters do with it, but cloud costs and an unclear business model can end such a world.
works.idea_zh: 让玩家自己设定情境与角色，再观察大语言模型角色如何演绎；但云端成本与不明朗的商业模式也可能让这样的世界终止。
works.method: Cloud-hosted LLMs drive each NPC's dialogue, emotions and choice of actions from a scenario description and per-character memory, which is why GoodAI charged a subscription; GoodAI was also listed as an NVIDIA ACE partner at CES 2025.
works.method_zh: 云端大语言模型根据情境描述与每个角色的记忆，驱动 NPC 的对话、情绪与行动选择，这也是 GoodAI 采用订阅收费的原因；GoodAI 也是 CES 2025 上列出的 NVIDIA ACE 合作方。
works.title_zh: AI People（AI NPC 沙盒游戏）

works.title: 1X World Model
works.description: A learned simulator for 1X's humanoid robots that imagines several futures from the same starting frames under different action proposals, including rigid, deformable and articulated objects such as laundry, doors and drawers; 1X released a dataset and public challenge.
works.description_zh: 1X 为其人形机器人打造的学习型模拟器：从同一组起始画面出发，根据不同的动作方案想象多种未来，涵盖衣物、门、抽屉等刚性、可形变与带关节的物体；1X 还发布了数据集和公开挑战赛。
works.idea_en: World models as an evaluation tool: comparing policies in imagination before running them on hardware.
works.idea_zh: 把世界模型当作评估工具：先在想象中比较不同策略，再拿到真机上运行。
works.method: An action-conditioned video prediction model trained on 1X's own robot logs, with tokenized video and a public 1xgpt baseline.
works.method_zh: 以 1X 自有机器人日志训练的动作条件视频预测模型，采用视频分词，并提供公开的 1xgpt 基线。
works.title_zh: 1X 世界模型

works.title: StereoCrafter
works.description: StereoCrafter (Tencent ARC Lab, 2024-09) converts ordinary 2D videos into long, high-fidelity stereoscopic 3D for headsets such as Apple Vision Pro, using a video diffusion model to fill disoccluded regions.
works.description_zh: StereoCrafter（腾讯 ARC 实验室，2024 年 9 月）可把普通 2D 视频转换为长时、高保真的立体 3D 视频，供 Apple Vision Pro 等头显观看，并用视频扩散模型补全视差暴露出的遮挡区域。
works.idea_en: Any existing or generated clip can become stereo, the cheapest path from flat stimuli to headset stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 任何现有或生成的片段都能转成立体视频，是从平面刺激走向头显刺激成本最低的路径。
works.method: Depth-based forward warping to a second view, then a stereo video inpainting diffusion model trained on large stereo video data fills the holes.
works.method_zh: 先基于深度做前向变换得到第二视角，再用在大规模立体视频上训练的扩散修补模型填补空洞。

paper.title: StereoCrafter: Diffusion-based Generation of Long and High-fidelity Stereoscopic 3D from Monocular Videos

works.title_zh: StereoCrafter：单目视频生成长时高保真立体 3D

works.title: Loopy
works.description: Loopy animates a portrait from audio alone, with sighs, eyebrow movement and head motion that follow the speech rhythm and emotion, without spatial motion templates.
works.description_zh: Loopy 仅凭音频驱动人像，叹气、眉毛动作和头部运动都跟随语音的节奏和情绪，不需要空间动作模板。
works.idea_en: Long-range temporal context lets non-verbal motion arise from the audio, not from a looped template.
works.idea_zh: 长时间的时间上下文让非语言动作从音频中自然产生，而不是来自循环播放的模板。
works.method: A video diffusion model with inter- and intra-clip temporal modules and an audio-to-latents module for long-term motion dependency.
works.method_zh: 视频扩散模型，配有片段间与片段内的时间模块，以及音频到隐变量的模块，以建模长期动作依赖。

paper.title: Loopy: Taming Audio-Driven Portrait Avatar with Long-Term Motion Dependency

works.title: ViewCrafter
works.description: From one or a few photos, ViewCrafter generates new views along a chosen camera path with a video diffusion model guided by a point cloud, then fits 3D Gaussians to the result so the scene can be viewed in real time; code and weights are open.
works.description_zh: ViewCrafter 从一张或几张照片出发，用以点云为引导的视频扩散模型沿指定镜头路径生成新视角，再用这些画面拟合三维高斯，使场景可以实时浏览；代码与权重均已开源。
works.idea_en: Coarse 3D points tell the video model where things are and the video model fills in how they look: a division of labour many later world generators adopted.
works.idea_zh: 粗略的三维点告诉视频模型物体在哪里，视频模型补上它们看起来的样子：后来许多世界生成器都采用了这种分工。
works.method: A point cloud reconstructed from the input images is rendered along the target trajectory and conditions an image-to-video diffusion model; iterative view synthesis with camera-trajectory planning extends coverage, and the generated frames are used to optimise 3D Gaussian splats.
works.method_zh: 先由输入图像重建点云，沿目标轨迹渲染后作为图生视频扩散模型的条件；再通过迭代视角合成与镜头轨迹规划逐步扩大覆盖范围，最后用生成的画面优化三维高斯泼溅。

paper.title: ViewCrafter: Taming Video Diffusion Models for High-fidelity Novel View Synthesis

works.title: GameNGen
works.description: The first game engine run entirely by a neural model: DOOM played interactively at about 20 fps on a single TPU, with human raters only slightly better than chance at telling short generated clips from the real game (developer-reported).
works.description_zh: 第一个完全由神经模型驱动的游戏引擎：在单个 TPU 上以约 20 fps 交互式运行《毁灭战士》；开发者报告，人类评审区分生成片段与真实游戏的准确率仅略高于随机。
works.idea_en: Proves real-time neural rendering of a full game is possible, for one game whose rules the model has memorised.
works.idea_zh: 证明了用神经网络实时渲染一整款游戏是可行的，但仅限于模型已“背熟”规则的那一款游戏。
works.method: An RL agent records gameplay, then a Stable Diffusion v1.4 model fine-tuned on past frames and actions predicts the next frame, with noise augmentation on the context to prevent drift.
works.method_zh: 先由强化学习智能体录制游玩数据，再把 Stable Diffusion v1.4 在历史帧与动作上微调以预测下一帧，并对上下文加噪以防止漂移。

paper.title: Diffusion Models Are Real-Time Game Engines

works.title_zh: GameNGen：扩散模型即实时游戏引擎

works.title: LayerPano3D
works.description: Generates a full-view 360° panorama from text and splits it into depth layers turned into 3D Gaussians, so a viewer can walk a short distance and see occluded content appear behind objects.
works.description_zh: 根据文字生成 360° 全景图，并按深度拆成多个图层再转成三维高斯，观看者可以走动一小段距离，看到被物体遮挡的内容显现出来。
works.idea_en: Layering the panorama is a cheap way to add parallax and disocclusion, which is what makes a 360° image feel like a place in a headset.
works.idea_zh: 把全景图分层，是增加视差与去遮挡效果的低成本办法，而这正是 360° 图像在头显中“像一个地方”的关键。
works.method: Text-guided anchor views are synthesised into a high-resolution panorama, decomposed into layered panoramas by depth with inpainting of hidden content, and each layer is optimised as 3D Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 先合成文字引导的锚点视图并拼成高分辨率全景图，再按深度分解为多层全景并补全被遮挡内容，每一层都优化为三维高斯。

paper.title: LayerPano3D: Layered 3D Panorama for Hyper-Immersive Scene Generation

works.title: Meshy-4
works.description: Fourth-generation Meshy model that remastered geometry quality for text-to-3D and image-to-3D, with cleaner hard-surface shapes and a two-step text-to-3D workflow: an untextured preview first, then texturing.
works.description_zh: Meshy 第四代模型，重做了文生三维和图生三维的几何质量，硬表面造型更干净，并采用两步式文生三维流程：先出无贴图预览，再上贴图。
works.idea_en: Marked the shift of commercial 3D generators from 'looks fine from a distance' to geometry detailed enough for game props.
works.idea_zh: 标志着商用三维生成从“远看还行”转向几何细节足以用作游戏道具。
works.method: Proprietary 3D generative model (architecture unpublished); text-to-3D is split into a fast preview mesh stage and a separate PBR texturing stage.
works.method_zh: 专有三维生成模型（架构未公开）；文生三维拆成快速预览网格阶段和单独的 PBR 贴图阶段。

works.title: VRCopilot
works.description: Inside VR, a person furnishes a room together with generative models: they speak and point to request furniture, sketch wireframes the AI fills in, or let it lay out the whole scene.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，人与生成模型一起布置房间：可以边说边指来要家具，也可以先画线框让 AI 填充，或者让它直接排好整个场景。
works.idea_en: Finds that scaffolded creation (you draw a wireframe, AI fills it) keeps more sense of agency than fully automatic generation.
works.idea_zh: 发现“搭好脚手架再生成”（人画线框、AI 填充）比完全自动生成更能保住人的能动感。
works.method: A mixed-initiative system integrates pre-trained 3D layout and object generators with multimodal speech-and-pointing input and wireframe intermediate representations; user studies compare manual, scaffolded and automatic creation.
works.method_zh: 混合主导系统把预训练的三维布局与物体生成模型，与语音加指点的多模态输入和线框中间表示结合；用户研究比较了手动、脚手架式和自动三种创作方式。

paper.title: VRCopilot: Authoring 3D Layouts with Generative AI Models in VR

works.title: Conversational Video Interface (Phoenix-2)
works.description: Tavus' Conversational Video Interface puts a video replica of a real person into a live call that answers spoken questions; it launched in August 2024 with the Phoenix-2 rendering model, which Tavus describes as the step that broke the real-time barrier. As of October 2026 a CVI 'PAL' is configured with a persona, face, voice, objectives, guardrails, knowledge base and memories, and runs on the full Tavus pipeline, in Echo mode, or inside LiveKit, Pipecat or Agora.
works.description_zh: Tavus 的对话视频接口（CVI）把真人的视频复刻放进实时通话中回答口头提问；它于 2024 年 8 月与 Phoenix-2 渲染模型一同发布，Tavus 称这一步突破了实时门槛。截至 2026 年 10 月，CVI 中的“PAL”可配置人设、面孔、声音、目标、护栏、知识库和记忆，可运行于完整的 Tavus 流程、Echo 模式，或接入 LiveKit、Pipecat、Agora。
works.idea_en: Packaged speech recognition, an LLM, voice and a rendered face into one API, which made a talking video person something a lab could rent by the minute.
works.idea_zh: 把语音识别、大模型、语音合成和渲染出的人脸打包成一个 API，让“会说话的视频人”变成实验室可以按分钟租用的东西。
works.method: A cascaded pipeline: speech-to-text, an LLM, text-to-speech and the Phoenix-2 audio-driven face renderer (likely a 3D-prior talking-head model fitted per replica from a short training video), streamed over WebRTC with interruption handling.
works.method_zh: 级联流程：语音转文字、大语言模型、文字转语音，再由 Phoenix-2 音频驱动的人脸渲染器生成画面（很可能是用一段短训练视频为每个复刻拟合、带三维先验的说话头模型），通过 WebRTC 流式传输并支持打断。
works.title_zh: Tavus 对话视频接口（CVI）

works.title: CogVideoX
works.description: Zhipu AI's CogVideoX (open-sourced 2024-08-06) was the first strong open text-to-video model from a Chinese lab, generating 6-second 720×480 clips; it powers Zhipu's Qingying product.
works.description_zh: 智谱的 CogVideoX（2024-08-06 开源）是国内实验室首个表现强劲的开源文生视频模型，可生成 6 秒 720×480 视频，也是智谱“清影”产品的底座。
works.idea_en: Showed an open model could run on a single consumer GPU and be fine-tuned by labs for their own scenarios.
works.idea_zh: 证明开源模型能在单张消费级显卡上运行，并能被实验室按自身场景微调。
works.method: Diffusion transformer with a 3D causal VAE and an 'expert transformer' whose expert adaptive LayerNorm fuses text and video tokens.
works.method_zh: 带 3D 因果 VAE 的扩散 Transformer，用带专家自适应 LayerNorm 的“专家 Transformer”融合文本与视频 token。

paper.title: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer

works.title_zh: CogVideoX（清影）

works.title: Stable Fast 3D (SF3D)
works.description: Stability AI's single-image-to-mesh model that returns a UV-unwrapped, textured mesh with predicted material parameters in about 0.5 seconds, with lighting removed from the texture so the asset can be relit.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 的单图生网格模型，约 0.5 秒返回已展开 UV、带贴图并预测了材质参数的网格，贴图中的光照已被去除，可重新打光。
works.idea_en: Sub-second, relightable meshes make it plausible to generate props while a session is running rather than in a pre-production step.
works.idea_zh: 亚秒级、可重新打光的网格，使在体验进行中生成道具成为可能，而不必放在前期制作阶段。
works.method: A large reconstruction transformer trained specifically for mesh output, with fast UV unwrapping, material and normal-map prediction, and a delighting step.
works.method_zh: 专门为网格输出训练的大型重建 Transformer，带快速 UV 展开、材质与法线贴图预测以及去光照步骤。

paper.title: SF3D: Stable Fast 3D Mesh Reconstruction with UV-unwrapping and Illumination Disentanglement

works.title: Stable Video 4D (SV4D)
works.description: Stability AI's SV4D takes a video of an object and generates consistent novel-view videos around it, which are then used to fit a dynamic 3D representation.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 的 SV4D 输入一段物体视频，生成围绕该物体的、彼此一致的新视角视频，再据此拟合动态三维表示。
works.idea_en: An open-weight multi-view video model that labs can run and pin for object-level 4D content.
works.idea_zh: 一个开放权重的多视角视频模型，实验室可以本地运行并锁定版本，用于物体级 4D 内容。
works.method: Stable Video Diffusion is extended with view and frame attention to denoise a grid of views × frames jointly; outputs supervise a dynamic NeRF.
works.method_zh: 在 Stable Video Diffusion 上加入视角注意力与帧注意力，联合去噪“视角 × 帧”网格，输出用于监督动态 NeRF。

paper.title: SV4D: Dynamic 3D Content Generation with Multi-Frame and Multi-View Consistency

works.title_zh: Stable Video 4D（SV4D）

works.title: Desensitizing Anxiety Through Imperceptible Change: Feasibility Study on a Paradigm for Single-Session Exposure Therapy for Fear of Public Speaking
works.description: People afraid of public speaking talked with a virtual therapist who, over a single session, turned into an entire audience through almost imperceptible changes; a week later this single session reduced anxiety about speaking on a virtual stage at least as much as five conventional exposure sessions.
works.description_zh: 害怕公开演讲的人与一位虚拟治疗师交谈，在一次治疗过程中，这位治疗师以几乎察觉不到的变化逐渐变成了一整群听众；一周后在虚拟舞台上演讲时，这一次治疗降低焦虑的效果至少与五次常规暴露治疗相当。
works.idea_en: A situation that morphs continuously and below awareness compresses a whole exposure ladder into one session, a kind of control only generated or procedural scenes allow.
works.idea_zh: 一个持续且在意识阈限以下变化的情境，可以把整套暴露阶梯压缩进一次治疗——这种控制只有生成式或程序化场景才能做到。
works.method: Feasibility study with three arms (single-session imperceptible change n=16, five-session exposure n=14, control conversation n=15) and a VR speaking test a week later, analysed with Bayesian models.
works.method_zh: 三组可行性研究（单次“不可察觉变化”组 n=16、五次暴露组 n=14、日常对话对照组 n=15），一周后进行 VR 演讲测试，并以贝叶斯模型分析。

paper.title: Desensitizing Anxiety Through Imperceptible Change: Feasibility Study on a Paradigm for Single-Session Exposure Therapy for Fear of Public Speaking

works.title_zh: 以不可察觉的变化消除焦虑：针对公开演讲恐惧的单次暴露疗法范式可行性研究

works.title: Shape of Motion
works.description: Shape of Motion reconstructs a single casual phone video of a moving scene into 4D Gaussians with full-length 3D trajectories, so the event can be replayed from new angles.
works.description_zh: Shape of Motion 把一段随手拍摄的运动场景手机视频重建为带完整三维轨迹的 4D 高斯，使事件可以从新角度回放。
works.idea_en: Moves 4D capture from camera rigs to footage anyone already has, with honest limits on unseen regions.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 捕捉从相机阵列推向任何人手头已有的素材，同时如实暴露未拍到区域的局限。
works.method: Scene motion is a small set of shared SE(3) motion bases, fitted with monocular depth and 2D track priors from foundation models.
works.method_zh: 场景运动由一小组共享的 SE(3) 运动基表示，并借助基础模型提供的单目深度与二维轨迹先验进行拟合。

paper.title: Shape of Motion: 4D Reconstruction from a Single Video

works.title_zh: Shape of Motion：单视频 4D 重建

works.title: Animate3D
works.description: Animate3D takes an existing static 3D model and a text prompt and makes the model move, keeping its look and shape consistent from every viewing angle.
works.description_zh: Animate3D 以现有的静态三维模型和一句文字提示为输入，让模型动起来，并在各个视角下保持外观与形状一致。
works.idea_en: 4D generation as an animation pass on assets that already exist, rather than generating new objects from scratch.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 生成当作给现有资产添加动画的一道工序，而不是从零生成新物体。
works.method: A multi-view video diffusion model (MV-VDM), conditioned on multi-view renderings of the static object and trained on a new multi-view video dataset (MV-Video), generates consistent motion; motion is first reconstructed from these videos and then refined with 4D score distillation.
works.method_zh: 以静态物体的多视角渲染为条件、在新建的多视角视频数据集 MV-Video 上训练的多视角视频扩散模型（MV-VDM）生成一致的运动；先从这些视频中重建运动，再用 4D 分数蒸馏细化。

paper.title: Animate3D: Animating Any 3D Model with Multi-view Video Diffusion

works.title_zh: Animate3D 为任意三维模型生成动画

works.title: 4DiM
works.description: Google DeepMind's 4DiM generates new views of a real scene from one or a few photos at any requested camera position and moment in time, for example moving the camera through a room or re-angling a video.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 的 4DiM 能根据一张或几张照片，在任意指定的相机位置与时间点生成真实场景的新视角画面，例如让相机在房间中移动，或为一段视频换一个角度。
works.idea_en: Treats camera pose and time as two separate controls of one diffusion model, the basic interface later 4D scene generators adopted.
works.idea_zh: 把相机位姿与时间作为同一扩散模型的两个独立控制量，这正是后来的 4D 场景生成器采用的基本接口。
works.method: A cascaded diffusion model conditioned on input images, camera poses and timestamps is trained jointly on posed 3D data, posed video (4D) and unposed video, with structure-from-motion poses calibrated to metric scale using monocular depth.
works.method_zh: 级联扩散模型以输入图像、相机位姿和时间戳为条件，在带位姿的三维数据、带位姿的视频（4D）与无位姿视频上联合训练，并用单目度量深度把运动恢复结构得到的位姿校准到真实尺度。

paper.title: Controlling Space and Time with Diffusion Models

works.title_zh: 4DiM 用扩散模型控制空间与时间

works.title: 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing (3DGRT)
works.description: NVIDIA's 3DGRT ray-traces Gaussian particles instead of rasterising them, enabling reflections, refractions, shadows and fisheye or wide-angle cameras inside captured scenes.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 3DGRT 用光线追踪而不是光栅化来渲染高斯粒子，使捕捉场景中可以出现反射、折射、阴影以及鱼眼或广角相机。
works.idea_en: Lets captured places be mixed with inserted objects and lighting effects that rasterised splats cannot show.
works.idea_zh: 让捕捉的场景可以与插入的物体和光照效果混合，这是光栅化泼溅做不到的。
works.method: Each Gaussian is wrapped in a bounding mesh inside a hardware-accelerated BVH, and hits are processed in depth order in chunks along each ray.
works.method_zh: 每个高斯被包裹在硬件加速的 BVH 中的包围网格里，沿每条光线按深度顺序分块处理命中。

paper.title: 3D Gaussian Ray Tracing: Fast Tracing of Particle Scenes

works.title_zh: 3D 高斯光线追踪（3DGRT）

works.title: Meshy auto-rigging and animation
works.description: Meshy's rigging and animation tools: an uploaded or generated humanoid or quadruped character is auto-rigged in seconds and animated with a library of more than 600 motion presets (walk cycles, idles, jumps, attacks), then exported to game engines.
works.description_zh: Meshy 的绑定与动画工具：上传或生成的人形、四足角色可在几秒内自动绑定，并从 600 多个动作预设（走路循环、待机、跳跃、攻击等）中选择动画，再导出到游戏引擎。
works.idea_en: The commercial default for turning a prop into an actor: a generated character becomes a moving extra with one click, though from a fixed preset library rather than generated motion.
works.idea_zh: 把道具变成演员的商用默认方案：生成的角色一键就能成为会动的群演，只是动作来自固定预设库而非生成。
works.method: Automatic skeleton fitting and skinning for humanoid and quadruped meshes, followed by retargeting of motion-capture-style presets from Meshy's animation library.
works.method_zh: 为人形和四足网格自动拟合骨架和蒙皮，再把 Meshy 动画库中动捕风格的预设重定向到角色上。
works.title_zh: Meshy 自动绑定与动画

works.title: LivePortrait
works.description: LivePortrait transfers a driving video's expressions and head pose onto a still portrait (people, and in a later release animals) in about 13 ms per frame, with explicit controls for eye and lip opening and stitching back into the original image.
works.description_zh: LivePortrait 能把驱动视频中的表情和头部姿态迁移到一张静态人像上（后续版本也支持动物），每帧约 13 ms，并可显式控制眼睛和嘴唇的开合，再无缝拼回原图。
works.idea_en: A fast, controllable, open retargeting tool that became the default way to puppeteer a generated face with a real performer.
works.idea_zh: 一个快速、可控的开源表情迁移工具，成为用真人表演操控生成人脸的默认方式。
works.method: An implicit-keypoint (non-diffusion) animation framework scaled to about 69M training frames, with small MLP stitching and eye/lip retargeting modules.
works.method_zh: 基于隐式关键点（非扩散）的动画框架，训练数据扩展到约 6900 万帧，并配有小型 MLP 拼接模块和眼部/唇部重定向模块。

paper.title: LivePortrait: Efficient Portrait Animation with Stitching and Retargeting Control

works.title: Moshi
works.description: An open speech-text foundation model that listens and speaks at the same time, so it can be interrupted, interject and backchannel in real time. Kyutai demonstrated it live in July 2024 and released weights, code and the paper in September 2024.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的语音-文本基础模型，能边听边说，因此可以被打断、主动插话并实时附和。Kyutai 在 2024 年 7 月现场演示，并于 2024 年 9 月发布权重、代码与论文。
works.idea_en: The first openly released full-duplex voice model: a lab can run, pin and inspect a conversational partner that overlaps speech like a person instead of waiting for silence.
works.idea_zh: 第一个公开发布的全双工语音模型：实验室可以运行、锁定版本并检查一个像人一样会重叠说话、而不是等待沉默的对话伙伴。
works.method: A 7B Helium text LLM extended with parallel audio streams for the user and the model, tokenised by the streaming Mimi codec at 12.5 Hz, with an 'inner monologue' of time-aligned text tokens.
works.method_zh: 在 7B 的 Helium 文本大模型上增加用户与模型两路并行音频流，由流式 Mimi 编解码器以 12.5 Hz 编码，并加入时间对齐的文本“内心独白”。
works.specs: 7B · Mimi codec 12.5 Hz · 160 ms theoretical / ~200 ms practical latency

paper.title: Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue

works.title: Meta 3D Gen (AssetGen)
works.description: Meta's text-to-3D pipeline that combines 3D AssetGen (text to mesh with PBR materials) and 3D TextureGen (texturing and retexturing), producing an asset in under a minute according to Meta.
works.description_zh: Meta 的文生三维流程，结合 3D AssetGen（由文字生成带 PBR 材质的网格）与 3D TextureGen（贴图与重新贴图），Meta 称可在一分钟内生成一个资产。
works.idea_en: Physically based materials rather than baked colours are what let a generated asset sit convincingly under a VR scene's own lighting.
works.idea_zh: 真正让生成资产在 VR 场景自身光照下显得可信的，是基于物理的材质，而不是烘焙进去的颜色。
works.method: AssetGen generates multi-view images with shaded and albedo channels, reconstructs a signed distance field and PBR materials with a large reconstruction model, then refines texture in UV space.
works.method_zh: AssetGen 先生成带着色与反照率通道的多视角图像，用大型重建模型重建有向距离场和 PBR 材质，再在 UV 空间细化贴图。

paper.title: Meta 3D AssetGen: Text-to-Mesh Generation with High-Quality Geometry, Texture, and PBR Materials

works.title: Diffusion Forcing
works.description: A training method that gives each frame its own noise level, so a video model can roll out stably far beyond its training length and be guided toward goals; it underlies many later real-time world models.
works.description_zh: 一种训练方法：为每一帧分配各自的噪声水平，使视频模型能远超训练长度稳定地向前推演，并能被引导朝向目标；许多后来的实时世界模型都以它为基础。
works.idea_en: Long, stable rollouts are a training problem before they are a memory problem; this recipe fixed much of the drift.
works.idea_zh: 长时间、稳定的推演首先是训练问题，然后才是记忆问题；这一方法解决了很大一部分漂移。
works.method: Sequence diffusion in which every token is denoised at an independently sampled noise level, combining next-token prediction with full-sequence diffusion and enabling guidance over future tokens.
works.method_zh: 序列扩散中每个 token 以独立采样的噪声水平去噪，把下一 token 预测与全序列扩散结合起来，并支持对未来 token 的引导。

paper.title: Diffusion Forcing: Next-token Prediction Meets Full-Sequence Diffusion

works.title_zh: 扩散强制（Diffusion Forcing）

works.title: 3D Arena
works.description: An open Hugging Face Space where people compare two anonymous image-to-3D results (meshes or Gaussian splats) generated from the same input image and vote. The 2025 paper reports 123,243 votes from 8,096 users across 19 models since its June 2024 launch, and finds preferences for Gaussian-splat and textured outputs.
works.description_zh: Hugging Face 上的一个开放 Space：人们对比同一张输入图片生成的两个匿名图生三维结果（网格或高斯泼溅）并投票。2025 年的论文报告，自 2024 年 6 月上线以来，共有 8,096 名用户为 19 个模型投出 123,243 票，结果显示人们更偏好高斯泼溅与带纹理的输出。
works.idea_en: The largest public human judgement of generated 3D assets, useful for choosing which generator to trust for scene props.
works.idea_zh: 规模最大的生成三维资产公开人类评判，可用来决定场景道具该信任哪个生成器。
works.method: Pairwise preference voting in a web 3D viewer on the 100-prompt iso3d set, with statistical fraud detection, aggregated into Elo ratings.
works.method_zh: 在网页三维查看器中，以 100 个提示的 iso3d 数据集进行两两偏好投票，配合统计学作弊检测，汇总为 Elo 评分。

paper.title: 3D Arena: An Open Platform for Generative 3D Evaluation

works.title_zh: 3D 竞技场（3D Arena）

works.title: TEN Framework
works.description: An open-source framework, supported by Agora and its community, for real-time multimodal conversational agents. It ships TEN Agent demos, its own voice-activity-detection and turn-detection models, and connectors for RTC and WebSocket transport; the latest release is 0.11.73 (2026-09-22).
works.description_zh: 由声网及社区支持的开源框架，用于构建实时多模态对话智能体。它提供 TEN Agent 示例、自研的语音活动检测与话轮检测模型，以及 RTC 与 WebSocket 传输连接器；最新版本为 0.11.73（2026-09-22）。
works.idea_en: Open turn-detection and VAD models matter because when a virtual human decides to speak is itself an experimental variable.
works.idea_zh: 开源的话轮检测与语音活动检测模型很重要，因为虚拟人何时开口，本身就是一个实验变量。
works.method: A graph of extensions written in C++, Go, Python or Node.js runs inside one runtime and exchanges audio, video and data messages with low overhead.
works.method_zh: 由 C++、Go、Python 或 Node.js 编写的扩展组成图，在同一运行时内以低开销交换音频、视频与数据消息。
works.specs: ~11.2k GitHub stars (Oct 2026) · TEN VAD and TEN Turn Detection models · RTC and WebSocket

works.title: MagicItem
works.description: In the commercial social VR platform Cluster, users with no programming background describe what an object should do and an LLM writes the Cluster Script that makes it behave that way.
works.description_zh: 在商业社交 VR 平台 Cluster 中，没有编程基础的用户只需描述物体该做什么，大语言模型就会写出让它照此行动的 Cluster Script。
works.idea_en: One of the first LLM behaviour-authoring tools tested with ordinary users of a live metaverse rather than lab participants.
works.idea_zh: 最早在真实运营的元宇宙中、而非实验室里，由普通用户实际测试的大语言模型行为创作工具之一。
works.method: An LLM is prompted with the Cluster Script API to generate object behaviours from natural language, integrated into the platform and evaluated online with 63 general users.
works.method_zh: 用 Cluster Script API 提示大语言模型，从自然语言生成物体行为，集成进平台后在线上与 63 名普通用户一起评估。

paper.title: MagicItem: Dynamic Behavior Design of Virtual Objects With Large Language Models in a Commercial Metaverse Platform

works.title: Real-time on-device generative AR model
works.description: Snap previewed an image diffusion model small enough to run on a smartphone and fast enough to re-render the camera view live from a text prompt, meant for AR Lenses, alongside Lens Studio 5.0's generative tools.
works.description_zh: Snap 预览了一个图像扩散模型：小到能在手机上运行、快到能按文字提示实时重绘摄像头画面，用于 AR 镜头，同时发布了 Lens Studio 5.0 的生成工具。
works.idea_en: Moves restyling of the live camera view from the cloud onto the device that the person is holding.
works.idea_zh: 把对实时摄像头画面的重绘，从云端搬到人手中的设备上。
works.method: A compact text-conditioned image diffusion model optimized for on-device inference re-renders camera frames in real time; Snap said Lenses using it would reach users first and creators later.
works.method_zh: 一个为端侧推理优化的紧凑型文本条件图像扩散模型实时重绘摄像头画面；Snap 表示使用该模型的镜头会先面向用户上线，之后再开放给创作者。
works.title_zh: Snap 端侧实时生成式 AR 模型

works.title: Teleport by Varjo
works.description: Teleport is Varjo's cloud service that turns phone scans or 360° camera footage of real places into Gaussian splat scenes that can be explored on the web, in VR headsets or inside game engines.
works.description_zh: Teleport 是 Varjo 的云服务，把真实地点的手机扫描或 360° 相机素材转换为高斯泼溅场景，可在网页、VR 头显或游戏引擎中探索。
works.idea_en: Connects capture of real sites to professional XR training and visualisation.
works.idea_zh: 把真实场地的捕捉与专业 XR 培训和可视化连接起来。
works.method: Uploaded captures are reconstructed in the cloud into splats, with large-area capture and automatic 360° video conversion added in later releases.
works.method_zh: 上传的素材在云端重建为泼溅，后续版本加入了大范围捕捉与 360° 视频自动转换。
works.title_zh: Varjo Teleport

works.title: Gen-3 Alpha
works.description: Gen-3 Alpha (2024-06-17) was the first model trained on Runway's new large-scale multimodal infrastructure, with expressive human characters and fine-grained temporal control; Runway presented it as a step toward 'General World Models'.
works.description_zh: Gen-3 Alpha（2024-06-17）是 Runway 在新的大规模多模态训练设施上训练的第一个模型，人物表情丰富，时间维度的控制更细；Runway 把它定位为迈向“通用世界模型”的一步。
works.idea_en: Framed commercial video generation explicitly as world modeling, a line Runway later carried into its interactive GWM models.
works.idea_zh: 明确把商用视频生成定义为世界建模，Runway 后来把这条路线延续到交互式 GWM 模型中。
works.method: Diffusion model trained jointly on videos and images with highly descriptive, temporally dense captions.
works.method_zh: 在视频与图像上联合训练的扩散模型，使用描述详细、时间上密集的字幕。

works.title: Hierarchical 3D Gaussians for Very Large Datasets
works.description: A level-of-detail hierarchy of Gaussians lets city-block captures from tens of thousands of photos be rendered in real time, switching detail smoothly as you move.
works.description_zh: 一种高斯的细节层次结构，使由数万张照片构成的街区级捕捉可以实时渲染，并在移动时平滑地切换细节。
works.idea_en: Shows that captured places can grow from a room to a neighbourhood without losing real-time viewing.
works.idea_zh: 说明捕捉的场景可以从一个房间扩展到一个街区，同时保持实时观看。
works.method: Scenes are split into chunks trained independently, merged into a tree of Gaussians, and rendered by selecting a cut through the tree per view.
works.method_zh: 场景被切分成独立训练的块，合并成一棵高斯树，渲染时为每个视角选取树上的一个切面。
works.specs: tens of thousands of photos · kilometre-scale trajectories · level of detail

paper.title: A Hierarchical 3D Gaussian Representation for Real-Time Rendering of Very Large Datasets

works.title_zh: 面向超大数据集的层级 3D 高斯

works.title: V2A (video-to-audio)
works.description: Google DeepMind's video-to-audio research that generates soundtracks, sound effects and even dialogue for silent video, steered by optional positive and negative text prompts.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 的视频配音研究：为无声视频生成配乐、音效甚至对白，并可用可选的正向与反向文字提示来引导。
works.idea_en: Sound that follows the picture frame by frame turns a silent generated clip into an audiovisual event.
works.idea_zh: 逐帧跟随画面的声音，把一段无声的生成视频变成视听事件。
works.method: Diffusion model that refines audio from noise conditioned on encoded video frames and text, trained with AI-generated sound annotations and dialogue transcripts; output watermarked with SynthID.
works.method_zh: 扩散模型以编码后的视频帧和文本为条件，从噪声中逐步生成音频；训练时使用 AI 生成的声音标注与对白文本；输出带 SynthID 水印。
works.title_zh: V2A（视频生成音频）

works.title: Depth Anything V2
works.description: Open monocular depth models (from about 25M to 1.3B parameters) that estimate fine-grained relative depth for any image, widely built into 3D-photo, 2D-to-3D video and scene-generation tools; it follows Depth Anything (January 2024).
works.description_zh: 开源单目深度模型（参数规模约从 2500 万到 13 亿），能为任意图像估计细致的相对深度，被广泛集成进三维照片、二维转三维视频和场景生成工具；它是 Depth Anything（2024 年 1 月）的后续版本。
works.idea_en: Reliable depth for any picture is the hidden layer under many 'generated' 3D scenes: errors in depth become errors in the world.
works.idea_zh: 任意图像的可靠深度，是许多“生成”三维场景之下看不见的一层：深度上的错误会变成世界里的错误。
works.method: A teacher trained only on precise synthetic depth labels pseudo-labels about 62 million real images, on which smaller student models are trained (DINOv2 encoder with a DPT head).
works.method_zh: 只在精确的合成深度标签上训练的教师模型，为约 6200 万张真实图像生成伪标签，再用这些数据训练较小的学生模型（DINOv2 编码器加 DPT 解码头）。

paper.title: Depth Anything V2

works.title: L4GM
works.description: NVIDIA's L4GM (Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model) turns a single-view video of an object into an animated 3D Gaussian object in about a second.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 L4GM（大型 4D 高斯重建模型）能在约一秒内把物体的单视角视频变成带动画的三维高斯物体。
works.idea_en: Shows 4D object generation as a forward pass, fast enough to sit inside an interactive tool.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 物体生成变成一次前向，快到可以嵌入交互式工具之中。
works.method: A multi-view LGM backbone is extended with temporal self-attention and trained on renders of animated Objaverse objects, with an interpolation model to raise frame rate.
works.method_zh: 在多视角 LGM 骨干上加入时间自注意力，用 Objaverse 动画物体的渲染数据训练，并配合插帧模型提高帧率。

paper.title: L4GM: Large 4D Gaussian Reconstruction Model

works.title: MASt3R
works.description: MASt3R adds dense feature matching and metric scale to DUSt3R, so image pairs yield reliable correspondences for mapping, localisation and large reconstructions.
works.description_zh: MASt3R 在 DUSt3R 的基础上加入稠密特征匹配和公制尺度，使图像对能给出可靠的对应关系，用于建图、定位和大规模重建。
works.idea_en: Turned pointmap models into the front end of SLAM and structure-from-motion systems.
works.idea_zh: 让点图模型成为 SLAM 与运动恢复结构系统的前端。
works.method: A second head predicts local descriptors trained with a matching loss, and a fast reciprocal matcher finds correspondences on top of metric pointmaps.
works.method_zh: 第二个预测头输出用匹配损失训练的局部描述子，快速互近邻匹配器在公制点图之上寻找对应关系。

paper.title: Grounding Image Matching in 3D with MASt3R

works.title: WonderWorld
works.description: From one image, a user moves the camera and types what should appear there; WonderWorld generates each new connected 3D scene in under ten seconds, so a world is built interactively piece by piece.
works.description_zh: 从一张图像开始，用户移动镜头并输入那里应该出现什么；WonderWorld 在十秒内生成相连的新三维场景，让世界一块一块地被交互式搭建出来。
works.idea_en: Generation fast enough to answer a user's request turns the participant into a co-author of the world.
works.idea_zh: 生成快到能及时回应用户的请求，参与者就成了这个世界的共同作者。
works.method: Fast Layered Gaussian Surfels (FLAGS) are initialised directly from estimated geometry in foreground, background and sky layers, avoiding slow per-scene optimisation, with guided depth diffusion to keep new scenes geometrically connected.
works.method_zh: 快速分层高斯面元（FLAGS）直接由前景、背景和天空三层的估计几何初始化，避免缓慢的逐场景优化，并用引导式深度扩散让新场景在几何上与旧场景衔接。
works.specs: < 10 s per new scene on one A6000 GPU (authors)

paper.title: WonderWorld: Interactive 3D Scene Generation from a Single Image

works.title: Dream Machine
works.description: Luma's Dream Machine (2024-06-12) made a high-quality text- and image-to-video model free to try on the web, producing 120-frame clips in about two minutes; it was among the first Sora-class tools open to anyone.
works.description_zh: Luma 的 Dream Machine（2024-06-12）让高质量的文生/图生视频模型可以在网页上免费试用，约两分钟生成 120 帧片段，是最早向所有人开放的 Sora 级工具之一。
works.idea_en: Free public access in mid-2024 turned video generation into something a student could test the same afternoon.
works.idea_zh: 2024 年年中的免费公开访问，让学生当天下午就能上手测试视频生成。
works.method: Transformer-based video diffusion model (Luma Ray1) trained directly on video.
works.method_zh: 直接在视频上训练的 Transformer 视频扩散模型（Luma Ray1）。

works.title: 4Real
works.description: 4Real, from Snap Research and CMU, generates photorealistic dynamic scenes with backgrounds from a text prompt, viewable from a range of angles, rather than isolated cartoon-like objects.
works.description_zh: Snap Research 与卡内基梅隆大学的 4Real 可根据文字提示生成带背景的照片级动态场景，可从一定角度范围观看，而不是孤立的卡通式物体。
works.idea_en: Moved text-to-4D from objects on a white background to whole scenes.
works.idea_zh: 把文本到 4D 从白底上的物体推进到完整场景。
works.method: A text-to-video model generates a reference video and a freeze-time orbit video; a canonical 3D Gaussian scene is built from the orbit and deformed to match the reference with score distillation.
works.method_zh: 文生视频模型先生成参考视频和定格环绕视频，由环绕视频构建标准三维高斯场景，再通过分数蒸馏使其变形以匹配参考视频。

paper.title: 4Real: Towards Photorealistic 4D Scene Generation via Video Diffusion Models

works.title: visionOS 2 spatial photos from 2D images
works.description: In visionOS 2, Apple Vision Pro users can turn any 2D photo in their library into a spatial photo with depth that comes to life in the headset.
works.description_zh: 在 visionOS 2 中，Apple Vision Pro 用户可以把图库里的任意二维照片转成带深度的空间照片，在头显中鲜活呈现。
works.idea_en: Made generated depth a default way to revisit personal memories in a headset; visionOS 26 later extended it to Spatial Scenes.
works.idea_zh: 让生成的深度成为在头显中重温个人回忆的默认方式；visionOS 26 随后把它扩展为“空间场景”。
works.method: Apple says visionOS uses advanced machine learning to transform a 2D image into a stereo spatial photo, likely monocular depth estimation plus view synthesis with inpainting.
works.method_zh: Apple 表示 visionOS 用先进的机器学习把二维图像转化为立体空间照片，做法很可能是单目深度估计加带修补的视图合成。
works.title_zh: visionOS 2：二维照片转空间照片

works.title: Kling
works.description: Kuaishou's first Kling model (2024-06-06) was the first Sora-class text-to-video model the public could use, with clips of up to two minutes at 1080p and 30 fps claimed; it opened worldwide in July 2024.
works.description_zh: 快手首个可灵模型（2024-06-06）是第一个公众能用上的 Sora 级文生视频模型，官方称可生成最长两分钟、1080p、30 fps 的视频；2024 年 7 月面向全球开放。
works.idea_en: Showed that a Chinese short-video platform could put frontier video generation in millions of users' hands months before OpenAI did.
works.idea_zh: 表明一家中国短视频平台能比 OpenAI 早数月把前沿视频生成交到数百万用户手中。
works.method: Diffusion transformer with a 3D VAE and 3D spatiotemporal attention, trained on Kuaishou-scale video data (per Kuaishou).
works.method_zh: 快手称其采用扩散 Transformer、3D VAE 与三维时空注意力，并基于快手规模的视频数据训练。
works.title_zh: 可灵

works.title: Pipecat
works.description: An open-source Python framework, maintained by Daily, for voice and multimodal agents built as pipelines of frames passing through speech, LLM, video and avatar services; Pipecat Flows adds structured conversation graphs and Pipecat Cloud hosts agents. Pipecat 1.0 shipped on 2026-04-14 and 1.12 on 2026-09-26.
works.description_zh: 由 Daily 维护的开源 Python 框架，用于搭建语音与多模态智能体：数据帧依次流经语音、大语言模型、视频与虚拟人等服务。Pipecat Flows 提供结构化的对话图，Pipecat Cloud 负责托管。Pipecat 1.0 于 2026-04-14 发布，1.12 于 2026-09-26 发布。
works.idea_en: A frame-level pipeline makes every stage of a conversational stimulus explicit and swappable, which helps when a study must report which models produced what.
works.idea_zh: 帧级流水线让对话刺激的每个环节都清晰可见、可替换；当研究需要报告每一部分由哪个模型生成时，这一点很有用。
works.method: Asynchronous pipelines of processors exchange audio, video, text and control frames over transports such as Daily WebRTC, WebSocket or telephony; Flows encode dialogue states and transitions.
works.method_zh: 由处理器组成的异步流水线，通过 Daily WebRTC、WebSocket 或电话等传输层交换音频、视频、文本与控制帧；Flows 负责描述对话状态与转移。

works.title: CLAY (Rodin Gen-1)
works.description: The 3D-native generative model behind Deemos's Rodin Gen-1: a latent diffusion transformer trained directly on 3D geometry that produces meshes and PBR materials from text, images or 3D controls such as voxels, bounding boxes and point clouds.
works.description_zh: 影眸科技 Rodin Gen-1 背后的原生三维生成模型：直接在三维几何上训练的潜扩散 Transformer，可由文字、图像或体素、包围盒、点云等三维控制生成网格与 PBR 材质。
works.idea_en: Argued for training on native 3D data instead of distilling 2D models, which became the dominant recipe (Hunyuan3D, TRELLIS, TripoSG) for production-grade assets.
works.idea_zh: 主张直接用原生三维数据训练，而不是从二维模型蒸馏，这成为生产级资产的主流做法（混元3D、TRELLIS、TripoSG）。
works.method: A multi-resolution VAE over neural-field geometry plus a minimal latent Diffusion Transformer, trained progressively on a large curated 3D dataset, with a separate multi-view diffusion model for PBR materials.
works.method_zh: 基于神经场几何的多分辨率 VAE，加上简洁的潜扩散 Transformer，在大规模精选三维数据上分阶段训练；PBR 材质由单独的多视角扩散模型生成。

paper.title: CLAY: A Controllable Large-scale Generative Model for Creating High-quality 3D Assets

works.title_zh: CLAY（Rodin Gen-1）

works.title: Video2MR
works.description: Turns an online sports or exercise video into a mixed-reality coach: the person in the 2D video becomes a 3D avatar in your room, with highlighted posture differences, motion trails, speed control and repositioning.
works.description_zh: 把网上的运动或健身视频变成混合现实教练：视频里的人变成你房间中的三维虚拟人，并带有姿态差异高亮、运动轨迹、速度控制和位置调整。
works.idea_en: Any 2D video becomes an embodied demonstration you can walk around, a cheap source of situated instruction.
works.idea_zh: 任何二维视频都能变成可以绕着看的具身示范，是一种低成本的情境化教学来源。
works.method: 3D human motion is extracted from monocular video and retargeted onto an avatar placed in mixed reality, with automatically generated visual augmentations.
