works.method_zh: 从单目视频中提取三维人体动作，重定向到放置在混合现实中的虚拟人身上，并自动生成可视化增强。

paper.title: Video2MR: Automatically Generating Mixed Reality 3D Instructions by Augmenting Extracted Motion from 2D Videos

works.title: DIAMOND
works.description: A diffusion world model that trains Atari agents in imagination and, as a demo, turns recorded Counter-Strike: Global Offensive gameplay into a Dust II map people can play on a consumer GPU.
works.description_zh: 一个扩散世界模型：在想象中训练 Atari 智能体；作为演示，它还把《反恐精英：全球攻势》的游戏录像变成可在消费级显卡上游玩的 Dust II 地图。
works.idea_en: Visual detail matters for agents, and an open, small diffusion model is enough for a playable 3D game world.
works.idea_zh: 画面细节对智能体很重要，而一个开源的小型扩散模型就足以构成可玩的三维游戏世界。
works.method: An EDM-style diffusion model conditioned on past frames and actions, used both as the RL environment and, for CS:GO, as a two-stage generator with an upsampler.
works.method_zh: 以历史帧与动作为条件的 EDM 式扩散模型，既充当强化学习环境，又在 CS:GO 演示中作为带上采样器的两阶段生成器。
works.specs: Atari 100k mean HNS 1.46 · CS:GO playable at ~10 fps on RTX 3090 (developer-reported)

paper.title: Diffusion for World Modeling: Visual Details Matter in Atari

works.title_zh: DIAMOND：扩散世界模型

works.title: CAT3D
works.description: Creates a full 3D scene from any number of photos, even a single image or a text-generated picture, by first imagining many consistent novel views and then reconstructing them, in about a minute.
works.description_zh: 从任意数量的照片（甚至一张图片或文生图的结果）出发，先想象出大量彼此一致的新视角，再加以重建，约一分钟即可得到完整的三维场景。
works.idea_en: Multi-view diffusion fills what the camera never saw, which is why one casual photo can now become a navigable place.
works.idea_zh: 多视角扩散补上了相机从未拍到的部分，这就是一张随手拍的照片如今能变成可漫游场所的原因。
works.method: A multi-view latent diffusion model conditioned on input views and target camera poses generates large sets of consistent novel views, which are fed to a robust NeRF reconstruction.
works.method_zh: 以输入视图和目标相机位姿为条件的多视角潜空间扩散模型，生成大量一致的新视角图像，再交给稳健的 NeRF 重建。

paper.title: CAT3D: Create Anything in 3D with Multi-View Diffusion Models

works.title: Veo
works.description: Google DeepMind's first Veo model, announced at Google I/O on 2024-05-14, generating 1080p clips that can run beyond a minute and follow cinematic terms such as 'timelapse' or 'aerial shot'; it first reached selected creators through VideoFX.
works.description_zh: Google DeepMind 首个 Veo 模型，于 2024-05-14 Google I/O 发布，可生成超过一分钟的 1080p 片段，并理解“延时”“航拍”等电影术语；最初只通过 VideoFX 向部分创作者开放。
works.idea_en: Treated film vocabulary as the control interface: you direct a shot with the words a cinematographer would use.
works.idea_zh: 把电影语言当作控制接口：用摄影师的术语来指挥一个镜头。
works.method: Latent diffusion transformer conditioned on text, image or video; DeepMind describes it as building on GQN, Phenaki, WALT, VideoPoet and Lumiere.
works.method_zh: 以文本、图像或视频为条件的潜空间扩散 Transformer；DeepMind 称其建立在 GQN、Phenaki、WALT、VideoPoet 与 Lumiere 等工作之上。

works.title: GPT-4o voice (Advanced Voice Mode)
works.description: OpenAI's first end-to-end audio model in ChatGPT: it hears tone, answers with emotion, laughter or singing, and stops when interrupted, with OpenAI reporting 320 ms average response time. Shown live in May 2024, it reached ChatGPT as Advanced Voice Mode later that year and developers through the Realtime API beta in October 2024.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 中的第一个端到端音频模型：能听出语气，用带情绪、笑声甚至歌唱的声音回答，被打断时会停下；OpenAI 报告平均响应时间为 320 毫秒。2024 年 5 月现场演示，同年晚些时候以“高级语音模式”进入 ChatGPT，并于 2024 年 10 月通过 Realtime API 测试版向开发者开放。
works.idea_en: Collapsed the speech-to-text, LLM and TTS cascade into one model so that paralinguistic cues survive; OpenAI itself later called it turn-based because it waits for silence.
works.idea_zh: 把“语音识别—大模型—语音合成”的级联压缩为一个模型，使副语言线索得以保留；但 OpenAI 后来自己也称其为回合制，因为它要等用户停下来。
works.method: A single multimodal Transformer trained end-to-end on text, vision and audio; the end of a turn is detected from silence by voice-activity detection.
works.method_zh: 一个在文本、视觉和音频上端到端训练的多模态 Transformer；轮次结束由语音活动检测根据静音判断。
works.specs: 232 ms min / 320 ms avg audio response (OpenAI)
works.title_zh: GPT-4o 语音（高级语音模式）

works.title: Exploring the Use of Large Language Model-Driven Chatbots in Virtual Reality to Train Autistic Individuals in Job Communication Skills
works.description: VR application in which autistic trainees practise customer conversations by speaking with avatars driven by GPT-3.5 Turbo, while job coaches create the training scenarios by writing text prompts; a preliminary study involved three trainees and two job coaches.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 应用：自闭症受训者通过语音与 GPT-3.5 Turbo 驱动的化身练习与顾客对话，就业辅导员则通过撰写文字提示来创建训练情境；初步研究有三名受训者和两名就业辅导员参与。
works.idea_en: Prompting replaces branching scripts, so the coach rather than a developer authors the scenario: the VR-JIT idea with the authoring bottleneck removed.
works.idea_zh: 提示词取代了分支脚本，于是由辅导员而非开发者来编写情境——这是去掉了创作瓶颈的 VR-JIT 思路。
works.method: Speech-to-text, LLM response generation and text-to-speech for VR avatars, evaluated in a preliminary usability study; the RIT lab has since extended the line to environment-grounded role play.
works.method_zh: 为 VR 化身串联语音转文字、大语言模型生成回复与文字转语音，并进行初步可用性研究；罗切斯特理工学院团队随后把这条研究线扩展到与环境关联的角色扮演。

paper.title: Exploring the Use of Large Language Model-Driven Chatbots in Virtual Reality to Train Autistic Individuals in Job Communication Skills

works.title_zh: 探索用虚拟现实中的大语言模型聊天机器人训练自闭症人士的职场沟通技能

works.title: PhysDreamer
works.description: PhysDreamer makes a captured 3D object, such as a flower or a plant, respond physically when it is poked or pulled: it sways, bends and springs back with dynamics learned from a video generator.
works.description_zh: PhysDreamer 让一个捕捉得到的三维物体（例如花或盆栽）在被戳、被拉时作出物理响应：它会摇摆、弯曲再弹回，这种动态是从视频生成模型中学来的。
works.idea_en: Uses a video model as a source of physical properties, so generated motion is a consequence of a person's action rather than a fixed clip.
works.idea_zh: 把视频模型当作物理属性的来源，使生成的运动成为人的动作的后果，而不是一段固定的片段。
works.method: A video generation model animates a rendered view of a static 3D Gaussian object; a spatially varying material field (Young's modulus) is optimised so that a differentiable material point method (MPM) simulation matches that video, after which new forces can be simulated; realism was rated in a user study.
works.method_zh: 先用视频生成模型让静态三维高斯物体的渲染图动起来，再优化空间变化的材料场（杨氏模量），使可微物质点法（MPM）仿真与该视频一致，之后即可仿真新的外力；真实感通过用户研究评估。

paper.title: PhysDreamer: Physics-Based Interaction with 3D Objects via Video Generation

works.title_zh: PhysDreamer 基于物理的三维物体交互

works.title: VASA-1
works.description: VASA-1 turns one portrait photo and a speech clip into a lifelike talking face with synchronized lips, expressive micro-movements and natural head motion, generated online at 512×512 and up to 40 fps. Microsoft did not release it publicly; in 2025 it reported using VASA-1 for the stylized faces of Copilot Portraits in Copilot Labs.
works.description_zh: VASA-1 只需一张人像照片和一段语音，就能生成唇形同步、带细微表情和自然头部动作的逼真说话人脸，可在线以 512×512、最高 40 fps 生成。微软没有公开发布它；2025 年微软称在 Copilot Labs 的 Copilot Portraits 中用 VASA-1 驱动风格化的面孔。
works.idea_en: Showed that a single photo could become a real-time conversational face, and why its makers withheld it over impersonation risk.
works.idea_zh: 证明了一张照片就能变成实时对话的人脸，也说明了开发者为何因冒充风险而不公开它。
works.method: A diffusion transformer generates holistic facial dynamics and head motion in a disentangled face latent space learned from video, then a decoder renders frames from the latent codes.
works.method_zh: 扩散 Transformer 在从视频中学到的解耦人脸隐空间里生成整体面部动态和头部动作，再由解码器根据隐编码渲染画面。
works.specs: 512×512 · up to 40 fps online · negligible starting latency

paper.title: VASA-1: Lifelike Audio-Driven Talking Faces Generated in Real Time

works.title_zh: VASA-1：实时生成的逼真说话人脸

works.title: DreamScene360
works.description: Turns a text prompt into a full 360° 3D scene: a generated panorama is lifted into Gaussian splats that can be viewed from any direction with limited movement.
works.description_zh: 把一句文字变成完整的 360° 三维场景：先生成全景图，再提升为高斯泼溅，可以从任意方向观看，并允许小范围移动。
works.idea_en: A panorama is a convenient first layer for a VR scene: it fixes the whole surround before any 3D is built.
works.idea_zh: 全景图是 VR 场景方便的第一层：在构建任何三维内容之前就先确定了整个环绕环境。
works.method: A GPT-4V self-refinement loop improves the prompt, a 2D diffusion model generates the panorama, monocular depth initialises a panoramic 3D Gaussian set, and semantic and geometric regularisation on synthesised virtual views fills unseen regions.
works.method_zh: 先用 GPT-4V 自我修正循环优化提示词，再用二维扩散模型生成全景图，以单目深度初始化全景三维高斯，并在合成的虚拟视角上施加语义与几何正则以补全未见区域。

paper.title: DreamScene360: Unconstrained Text-to-3D Scene Generation with Panoramic Gaussian Splatting

works.title: 2D Gaussian Splatting
works.description: 2D Gaussian Splatting replaces 3D blobs with flat oriented discs, so a capture yields accurate surfaces and a clean mesh as well as photoreal views.
works.description_zh: 2D 高斯泼溅用有朝向的扁平圆盘替代三维高斯团块，使一次捕捉既能得到照片级视图，也能得到准确的表面和干净的网格。
works.idea_en: Gives captured scenes geometry you can collide with, which interactive situations need.
works.idea_zh: 让捕捉的场景拥有可以碰撞的几何，这是可交互情境所需要的。
works.method: Surfels with ray-splat intersection, depth distortion and normal-consistency losses are optimised per scene; meshes are extracted with TSDF fusion.
works.method_zh: 使用光线与面元求交的面元表示，配合深度畸变与法线一致性损失逐场景优化，再用 TSDF 融合提取网格。

paper.title: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields

works.title_zh: 2D 高斯泼溅

works.title: Scaniverse
works.description: Scaniverse trains Gaussian splats on the phone itself, so a walk around an object or place yields a viewable splat within minutes without uploading; in 2026 it sits inside Niantic Spatial's capture service.
works.description_zh: Scaniverse 直接在手机上训练高斯泼溅，绕物体或地点走一圈，几分钟内就能得到可查看的泼溅，无需上传；2026 年它已成为 Niantic Spatial 捕捉服务的一部分。
works.idea_en: On-device processing keeps raw footage local, which can matter for ethics review when capturing real spaces.
works.idea_zh: 在设备端处理让原始素材留在本地，在捕捉真实空间时这可能关系到伦理审查。
works.method: Phone video and ARKit/ARCore poses feed an on-device Gaussian optimisation; scans can be shared to Niantic Spatial's map and reconstruction services.
works.method_zh: 手机视频与 ARKit/ARCore 位姿输入设备端的高斯优化，扫描结果可共享到 Niantic Spatial 的地图与重建服务。

works.title: Covert Protocol
works.description: A GDC 2024 tech demo in which the player is a private detective in a hotel and must talk information out of AI-driven characters; what each character reveals depends on how the conversation goes, so each playthrough differs.
works.description_zh: GDC 2024 上的技术演示：玩家扮演酒店里的私家侦探，必须通过对话从 AI 驱动的角色口中套出信息；角色透露什么取决于对话走向，因此每次游玩都不同。
works.idea_en: Makes conversation itself the game mechanic: social skill, not dialogue-tree choice, decides progress.
works.idea_zh: 让对话本身成为玩法：推进剧情靠的是社交能力，而不是对话树选项。
works.method: Inworld's character engine handles personas, goals and knowledge for each character, while NVIDIA ACE supplies Riva speech recognition and Audio2Face facial animation; the scene is built in Unreal Engine.
works.method_zh: Inworld 角色引擎负责每个角色的人设、目标与知识，英伟达 ACE 提供 Riva 语音识别与 Audio2Face 面部动画；场景基于 Unreal Engine 构建。

works.title: NEO NPC
works.description: A Ubisoft Paris prototype shown at GDC 2024 in which players negotiate and plan with characters such as Bloom and Iron by speaking freely, while the characters stay within backstories written by a narrative director.
works.description_zh: 育碧巴黎工作室在 GDC 2024 展示的原型：玩家可以自由说话，与 Bloom、Iron 等角色谈判和制定计划，而角色始终保持叙事总监写下的背景设定。
works.idea_en: Recasts the game writer's job: instead of writing every line, the writer writes the person and then tests what the model makes of them.
works.idea_zh: 重新定义了游戏编剧的工作：不再逐句写台词，而是写出“这个人”，再检验模型如何演绎他。
works.method: Inworld's LLM-based character engine generates dialogue from authored backstories and guardrails, NVIDIA Audio2Face animates the faces, and performance capture from actors sets each character's expressive range.
works.method_zh: Inworld 基于大语言模型的角色引擎依据编写的背景与护栏生成对话，英伟达 Audio2Face 驱动面部动画，演员的表演捕捉决定每个角色的表现幅度。

works.title: SIMA
works.description: A Scalable Instructable Multiworld Agent that watches the screen and presses keys to follow spoken-style instructions such as 'chop down the tree' or 'open the map' across nine commercial games, including No Man's Sky, Valheim and Teardown, and four research environments.
works.description_zh: “可扩展、可指令、多世界”智能体：观看屏幕画面并按键操作，在《无人深空》《英灵神殿》《拆迁》等九款商业游戏和四个研究环境中执行“砍倒那棵树”“打开地图”之类的语言指令。
works.idea_en: Uses the same pixels-in, keyboard-out interface as a human, so one agent can enter any game, including generated worlds, without an API.
works.idea_zh: 采用与人相同的“像素输入、键鼠输出”接口，因此一个智能体无需 API 就能进入任何游戏，包括生成的世界。
works.method: Pretrained image and video encoders plus a text encoder feed a transformer policy trained by behavioral cloning on human gameplay annotated with instructions; about 600 basic skills of roughly 10 seconds were evaluated.
works.method_zh: 预训练的图像与视频编码器加上文本编码器，输入一个 Transformer 策略，在带指令标注的人类游戏录像上做行为克隆训练；共评估约 600 个时长约 10 秒的基础技能。

paper.title: Scaling Instructable Agents Across Many Simulated Worlds

works.title: Cradle
works.description: A framework that lets a multimodal LLM play Red Dead Redemption 2's main story missions using only screenshots and keyboard-mouse output, and that transfers to Stardew Valley, Cities: Skylines and everyday software.
works.description_zh: 一个框架，让多模态大语言模型只凭截图和键鼠输出就能完成《荒野大镖客：救赎 2》的主线任务，并可迁移到《星露谷物语》《城市：天际线》和日常软件。
works.idea_en: Showed that a general agent can enter a commercial 3D game through the same screen a player sees, at the price of being far slower than real time.
works.idea_zh: 证明通用智能体可以通过与玩家相同的屏幕进入商业三维游戏，代价是速度远低于实时。
works.method: GPT-4V / GPT-4o models run a loop of information gathering, self-reflection, task inference, skill curation, action planning and memory, writing and reusing skill code that issues keyboard and mouse events.
works.method_zh: 由 GPT-4V / GPT-4o 模型循环执行信息收集、自我反思、任务推断、技能整理、动作规划与记忆，编写并复用发出键鼠事件的技能代码。

paper.title: Cradle: Empowering Foundation Agents Towards General Computer Control

works.title: TripoSR
works.description: Open-weight image-to-3D model released by Stability AI and Tripo AI that reconstructs a textured mesh from a single image in under half a second on an NVIDIA A100.
works.description_zh: Stability AI 与 Tripo AI 联合发布的开源权重图生三维模型，在 NVIDIA A100 上不到半秒即可由单张图像重建带贴图的网格。
works.idea_en: Fast and permissive (MIT) enough to run inside other tools, it became a building block for inserting props on demand.
works.idea_zh: 速度快、许可宽松（MIT），可直接嵌入其他工具，成为按需插入道具的基础组件。
works.method: LRM-style transformer that maps DINO image features to a triplane NeRF, with changes to data curation, model design and training, followed by marching-cubes mesh extraction.
works.method_zh: LRM 式 Transformer 将 DINO 图像特征映射为三平面 NeRF，并改进了数据筛选、模型设计和训练，最后用 Marching Cubes 提取网格。
works.specs: <0.5 s per object on A100 · MIT licence

paper.title: TripoSR: Fast 3D Object Reconstruction from a Single Image

works.title: Panda-70M
works.description: A dataset of 70.7 million captioned video clips (about 167,000 hours) cut from 3.8 million long YouTube videos, released by Snap Research with UC Merced and others at CVPR 2024. It is widely used as pretraining data for open video generation models.
works.description_zh: 包含 7,070 万段带字幕视频片段（约 16.7 万小时）的数据集，片段切自 380 万条 YouTube 长视频，由 Snap Research 联合加州大学默塞德分校等在 CVPR 2024 发布。它被广泛用作开源视频生成模型的预训练数据。
works.idea_en: Much of what open video models know about how scenes move comes from corpora like this one: automatically captioned web clips, with the biases of the web.
works.idea_zh: 开源视频模型对场景如何运动的认识，很大一部分来自这类语料：自动加字幕的网络片段，也带着网络内容的偏差。
works.method: Long videos are split into semantically coherent clips; several cross-modality teacher models (image and video captioners given frames, titles and subtitles) propose captions, and a fine-tuned retrieval model picks the best caption for each clip.
works.method_zh: 先把长视频切成语义连贯的片段，再由多个跨模态“教师”模型（输入画面、标题与字幕的图像和视频描述模型）为每段提出候选字幕，最后由微调过的检索模型挑出最合适的一条。

paper.title: Panda-70M: Captioning 70M Videos with Multiple Cross-Modality Teachers

works.title_zh: Panda-70M 视频字幕数据集

works.title: EMO (Emote Portrait Alive)
works.description: EMO makes a single portrait talk or sing along to any audio, with expressive faces and head motion, and no 3D face model or facial landmarks in between.
works.description_zh: EMO 能让一张人像随任意音频说话或唱歌，表情和头部动作丰富，中间不经过三维人脸模型或面部关键点。
works.idea_en: Moved talking heads from mouth-only lip sync to whole-face emotional performance driven directly by audio.
works.idea_zh: 让说话头像从只动嘴的唇形同步，进化到由音频直接驱动的整张脸的情绪表演。
works.method: An audio-to-video diffusion model (Stable Diffusion backbone with ReferenceNet identity features, audio cross-attention and speed/face-region controls) trained on 250+ hours of talking video.
works.method_zh: 音频到视频的扩散模型（以 Stable Diffusion 为骨干，结合 ReferenceNet 身份特征、音频交叉注意力以及速度和人脸区域控制），在 250 多小时的说话视频上训练。

paper.title: EMO: Emote Portrait Alive -- Generating Expressive Portrait Videos with Audio2Video Diffusion Model under Weak Conditions

works.title_zh: EMO：让人像活起来

works.title: Genie
works.description: An 11-billion-parameter model that turns a single image, sketch or photo into a playable 2D platformer, learned from internet gameplay videos without any action labels.
works.description_zh: 一个 110 亿参数的模型，能把一张图像、草图或照片变成可游玩的二维平台游戏；它从网络游戏视频中学习，完全不需要动作标注。
works.idea_en: Shows that controls can be learned from unlabeled video, so any picture can become a world with a small set of discovered actions.
works.idea_zh: 证明了操控方式可以从无标注视频中学出来，于是任何一张图片都能变成一个拥有少量“自发现动作”的世界。
works.method: A spatiotemporal video tokenizer, a latent action model that infers 8 discrete actions between frames, and an autoregressive dynamics model, trained on 30,000 hours of 2D platformer videos filtered from about 200,000 hours of internet footage.
works.method_zh: 由时空视频分词器、在帧间推断 8 个离散动作的潜在动作模型和自回归动力学模型组成，训练数据是从约 20 万小时网络视频中筛选出的 3 万小时二维平台游戏画面。

paper.title: Genie: Generative Interactive Environments

works.title: Mindcraft
works.description: An open-source bot framework in which LLM agents join a Minecraft server as players you can talk to: they mine, craft, build, fight and chat, write their own code for new tasks, and cooperate or argue with other bots. Emergent Garden's videos of several models surviving together made it widely known; the 2025 MineCollab benchmark built on it tests collaboration.
works.description_zh: 一个开源机器人框架：大语言模型智能体以玩家身份加入 Minecraft 服务器，可以与人交谈，会采矿、合成、建造、战斗与聊天，为新任务自行编写代码，并与其他机器人合作或争执。Emergent Garden 频道中多个模型一起生存的视频让它广为人知；2025 年基于它构建的 MineCollab 基准用于测试协作能力。
works.idea_en: A cheap, hackable way to put talking, acting AI players into a shared 3D world with people, which is close to a ready-made multi-agent social testbed.
works.idea_zh: 一种低成本、易改造的方式，把会说话、会行动的 AI 玩家放进与人共享的三维世界，几乎是现成的多智能体社会试验平台。
works.method: A Node.js agent loop on the Mineflayer bot library: the LLM (OpenAI by default, other providers and local models supported) reads chat and game state, calls built-in commands or writes sandboxed JavaScript, and keeps a memory of its progress; in MineCollab, agent performance dropped by up to 15% when agents had to communicate detailed plans, which the authors identify as the main bottleneck.
works.method_zh: 基于 Mineflayer 机器人库的 Node.js 智能体循环：大语言模型（默认 OpenAI，也支持其他服务商与本地模型）读取聊天与游戏状态，调用内置命令或编写沙箱化的 JavaScript，并记录自身进展；在 MineCollab 中，当智能体必须交流详细计划时，表现最多下降 15%，作者认为沟通是主要瓶颈。

paper.title: Collaborating Action by Action: A Multi-agent LLM Framework for Embodied Reasoning

works.title: Sora
works.description: OpenAI's first text-to-video model, previewed in February 2024 with up to one-minute 1080p shots that keep scenes and camera motion consistent; it shipped as a product in December 2024. OpenAI closed the Sora app on 2026-04-26 and the API on 2026-09-24.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 的首个文生视频模型，2024 年 2 月以预览形式发布，展示了长达一分钟、场景与镜头运动保持连贯的 1080p 镜头，2024 年 12 月作为产品上线。OpenAI 已于 2026-04-26 关闭 Sora 应用，并于 2026-09-24 停止 API。
works.idea_en: Made 'video model as world simulator' the field's framing: minute-long shots that keep objects and space mostly consistent, but nothing a person can act in.
works.idea_zh: 让“视频模型即世界模拟器”成为整个领域的叙事：一分钟长镜头基本保持物体与空间一致，但人无法在其中行动。
works.method: Diffusion transformer over spacetime patches of a compressed video latent, trained on videos and images of varying duration, resolution and aspect ratio.
works.method_zh: 在压缩视频潜空间的时空块（spacetime patches）上训练扩散 Transformer，训练数据为不同时长、分辨率与画幅的视频和图像。
works.specs: up to 60 s · up to 1080p (Feb 2024 preview)

paper.title: Video generation models as world simulators

works.title: Lumiere
works.description: Google Research's Lumiere (2024-01-23) generates a clip's whole duration in one pass instead of keyframes plus interpolation, giving more coherent motion; demos included stylized generation, cinemagraphs and video inpainting.
works.description_zh: Google Research 的 Lumiere（2024-01-23）一次性生成整段时长，而不是先生成关键帧再插帧，因此运动更连贯；演示包括风格化生成、动态照片（cinemagraph）和视频修补。
works.idea_en: Global temporal coherence beats stitched keyframes for motion that has to look physically continuous.
works.idea_zh: 对需要在物理上看起来连续的运动而言，整体的时间一致性胜过拼接关键帧。
works.method: Space-Time U-Net (STUNet) that downsamples in both space and time, built on a pretrained text-to-image diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 在预训练文生图扩散模型上构建的时空 U-Net（STUNet），在空间和时间两个维度同时下采样。

paper.title: Lumiere: A Space-Time Diffusion Model for Video Generation

works.title: 360DVD
works.description: 360DVD (Peking University, CVPR 2024) generates 360° equirectangular panorama videos from text, with optional motion conditions, for viewing in a VR headset.
works.description_zh: 360DVD（北京大学，CVPR 2024）可从文字生成 360° 等距柱状全景视频，并可加入运动条件，供 VR 头显观看。
works.idea_en: One of the first ways to generate surround video a person can look around in, rather than a framed view.
works.idea_zh: 最早能生成可环顾四周的环绕视频（而不是一个画框）的方法之一。
works.method: Lightweight 360-Adapter with 360°-specific enhancements on a pretrained text-to-video model, trained on the WEB360 panorama-video dataset.
works.method_zh: 在预训练文生视频模型上加入轻量的 360-Adapter 及针对 360° 的增强技术，使用 WEB360 全景视频数据集训练。

paper.title: 360DVD: Controllable Panorama Video Generation with 360-Degree Video Diffusion Model

works.title_zh: 360DVD：可控全景视频生成

works.title: Genie (Luma)
works.description: Luma's text-to-3D generator: a prompt returns several candidate 3D models within seconds, and one can be refined into a higher-quality textured mesh for download, in the browser or on Discord.
works.description_zh: Luma 的文生三维工具：输入提示词，几秒内返回多个候选三维模型，可选其一细化为质量更高的带贴图网格并下载，可在浏览器或 Discord 中使用。
works.idea_en: Made text-to-3D a consumer action measured in seconds; Luma has since moved its focus to video models and the standalone Genie page now redirects to its main site.
works.idea_zh: 让文生三维变成以秒计的大众操作；此后 Luma 把重心转向视频模型，Genie 的独立页面如今已跳转到其主站。
works.method: Proprietary feed-forward 3D generative model (architecture unpublished), with a fast draft stage and a separate refinement stage.
works.method_zh: 专有的前馈式三维生成模型（架构未公开），分为快速草稿阶段和单独的细化阶段。
works.title_zh: Genie（Luma 文生三维）

works.title: Audio2Photoreal
works.description: Audio2Photoreal turns the audio of a two-person conversation into the face, body and hand gestures of a photorealistic 3D avatar, including listening behaviour, and renders it with Meta's Codec Avatars.
works.description_zh: Audio2Photoreal 把两人对话的音频转换成照片级三维化身的面部、身体和手势动作（包括倾听时的行为），并用 Meta 的 Codec Avatars 渲染。
works.idea_en: Shows that photoreal rendering exposes subtle gesture errors that stick figures hide, so behaviour and appearance must be evaluated together.
works.idea_zh: 说明照片级渲染会暴露火柴人看不出的细微手势错误，所以行为与外观必须一起评估。
works.method: A VQ-transformer predicts guide poses, a diffusion model fills in body motion, and a separate audio-conditioned diffusion model generates face codes, trained on a new multi-view conversational capture dataset.
works.method_zh: 先由 VQ-Transformer 预测引导姿态，再由扩散模型补全身体动作，另一个以音频为条件的扩散模型生成面部编码；训练数据为新采集的多视角对话数据集。

paper.title: From Audio to Photoreal Embodiment: Synthesizing Humans in Conversations

works.title_zh: Audio2Photoreal：从音频到照片级对话化身

works.title: Convai
works.description: A platform for building characters that hold voice conversations, perceive their surroundings and carry out actions such as fetching an object or guiding a player, with plugins for Unreal Engine, Unity and web 3D, and use in VR training scenes.
works.description_zh: 一个用于构建角色的平台：角色能进行语音对话、感知周围环境，并执行取物、引导玩家等动作；提供 Unreal Engine、Unity 与网页三维插件，也用于 VR 训练场景。
works.idea_en: A ready-made path from a written character sheet to an embodied NPC in a 3D or XR scene, without building the speech and action pipeline yourself.
works.idea_zh: 从一份书面角色设定直达三维或 XR 场景中具身 NPC 的现成路径，无需自建语音与动作管线。
works.method: Characters are configured in a web dashboard (backstory, knowledge base, voice, actions); the engine streams speech recognition, LLM responses with action selection, speech synthesis and lip-sync to the game client, and supports NPC-to-NPC conversation and live game-state context.
works.method_zh: 在网页后台配置角色（背景、知识库、声音、动作）；引擎把语音识别、带动作选择的大语言模型回复、语音合成与口型同步流式传给游戏客户端，并支持 NPC 之间的对话与实时游戏状态上下文。

works.title: Skybox AI
works.description: A web tool and API that generates 360° equirectangular skyboxes from a prompt or a rough sketch, with style packs, remixing of existing 360° photos, HDRI lighting export and a depth-based 'world mesh' export for game engines and VR.
works.description_zh: 网页工具与 API：根据提示词或粗略草图生成 360° 等距柱状天空盒，提供风格包、对已有 360° 照片的重混、HDRI 光照导出，以及基于深度的“世界网格”导出，可用于游戏引擎和 VR。
works.idea_en: The quickest way to put a participant inside a generated surround, but a skybox stays a backdrop: nothing in it can be reached or moved.
works.idea_zh: 这是让参与者置身于生成环境中最快的办法，但天空盒始终只是背景：其中的任何东西都无法触及或移动。
works.method: Proprietary diffusion models (Model 3 and later) trained for seamless equirectangular output; depth estimation turns the panorama into a simple enclosing mesh.
works.method_zh: 专为无缝等距柱状输出训练的专有扩散模型（Model 3 及之后版本）；通过深度估计把全景图变成一个简单的包围网格。

works.title: fal
works.description: A generative-media inference host: one API and SDK for more than 1,000 image, video, audio and 3D models from many labs (Kling, Seedance, MiniMax, FLUX and open-weight models), plus serverless GPUs to deploy your own. fal reports more than 1.5 million developers as of October 2026.
works.description_zh: 生成式媒体推理平台：一个 API 和 SDK 即可调用来自多家机构的 1,000 多个图像、视频、音频与三维模型（可灵、Seedance、MiniMax、FLUX 以及开源权重模型），也可以用 Serverless GPU 部署自己的模型。截至 2026 年 10 月，fal 称其开发者超过 150 万。
works.idea_en: Lets a lab swap the generator behind a stimulus pipeline by changing one parameter, which makes model comparisons cheap but ties reproducibility to a third party's catalogue.
works.idea_zh: 实验室只需改一个参数就能更换刺激生成流程背后的模型，比较模型的成本很低，但可复现性也因此取决于第三方平台的模型目录。
works.method: Queued and streaming HTTP / WebSocket endpoints in front of optimized inference on H100, H200 and B200 clusters; custom models deploy as serverless apps.
works.method_zh: 在 H100、H200、B200 集群的优化推理之上，提供排队与流式的 HTTP / WebSocket 接口；自定义模型以 Serverless 应用形式部署。
works.specs: 1,000+ models · billed per output · serverless and dedicated GPUs

works.title: Suck Up!
works.description: A comedy game in which the player is a vampire who must talk AI-driven townsfolk into opening their doors, using disguises and improvised lies; each resident has a personality and reacts to what the player says. On Steam since October 2025.
works.description_zh: 一款喜剧游戏：玩家扮演吸血鬼，借助伪装和即兴谎言说服由 AI 驱动的镇民开门；每位居民都有自己的性格，并对玩家说的话作出反应。2025 年 10 月登陆 Steam。
works.idea_en: Persuasion of LLM characters as the whole mechanic, and a showcase of how players probe and break character prompts.
works.idea_zh: 把说服 LLM 角色作为全部玩法，也展示了玩家如何试探并突破角色提示词。
works.method: Likely a cloud LLM per character with persona prompts and game-state context (disguise, time, prior visits), speech recognition for voice input and synthesized replies; the developer has not published details.
works.method_zh: 很可能为每个角色调用云端大语言模型，结合人设提示与游戏状态上下文（伪装、时间、此前的拜访），配合语音输入识别与合成回复；开发者未公开细节。

works.title: DreamGaussian4D
works.description: DreamGaussian4D animates a 3D Gaussian object generated from a single image, driven by a reference video, and exports it as an animated mesh, in minutes rather than hours.
works.description_zh: DreamGaussian4D 以参考视频驱动，由单张图像生成的三维高斯物体动起来，并导出为带动画的网格，耗时几分钟而非几小时。
works.idea_en: Brought 4D object generation down to minutes and to a format game engines can load.
works.idea_zh: 把 4D 物体生成缩短到几分钟，并变成游戏引擎能加载的格式。
works.method: A static Gaussian object from DreamGaussianHD is deformed by a HexPlane deformation network fitted to an image-to-video driving clip, then refined by video-to-video texture optimisation.
works.method_zh: DreamGaussianHD 生成的静态高斯物体由 HexPlane 形变网络变形，以拟合图生视频得到的驱动片段，再通过视频到视频的纹理优化细化。

paper.title: DreamGaussian4D: Generative 4D Gaussian Splatting

works.title: Spacetime Gaussians
works.description: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting gives each Gaussian its own lifespan, motion and rotation curves, playing back multi-view recordings at very high resolution in real time.
works.description_zh: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting 为每个高斯赋予各自的存续时间、运动与旋转曲线，可实时以极高分辨率回放多视角录制。
works.idea_en: Gaussians that appear and disappear over time handle flames, smoke and occlusion better than deforming one fixed set.
works.idea_zh: 随时间出现与消失的高斯，比让一组固定高斯变形更能处理火焰、烟雾与遮挡。
works.method: Temporal opacity, polynomial motion and rotation per Gaussian are combined with neural splatted features decoded by a small MLP, with guided sampling of new Gaussians in poorly covered regions.
works.method_zh: 每个高斯具有时间不透明度、多项式运动与旋转，并结合由小型多层感知机解码的神经泼溅特征，在覆盖不足的区域引导采样新高斯。
works.specs: 8K at 60 fps on RTX 4090, lite model (paper)

paper.title: Spacetime Gaussian Feature Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic View Synthesis

works.title_zh: 时空高斯

works.title: DL3DV-10K
works.description: A dataset of 10,510 videos (51.2 million frames) of real indoor and outdoor scenes from 65 types of locations, with varied reflection, transparency and lighting, built to train and benchmark novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction. It has become a standard training source for feed-forward reconstruction and camera-controlled video models.
works.description_zh: 包含 10,510 段视频（5,120 万帧）的数据集，覆盖 65 类地点的真实室内外场景，反射、透明与光照条件各异，用于训练和评测新视角合成与三维重建。它已成为前馈式重建与镜头可控视频模型的标准训练数据之一。
works.idea_en: Real-world scene diversity at this scale is what lets reconstruction and world models generalize beyond a handful of benchmark rooms.
works.idea_zh: 这种规模的真实场景多样性，才让重建模型与世界模型能泛化到少数基准房间之外。
works.method: Phone and drone video captures with camera poses estimated by structure-from-motion, labeled by scene complexity, plus a benchmark split for novel-view synthesis.
works.method_zh: 用手机与无人机拍摄视频，以运动恢复结构估计相机位姿，按场景复杂度标注，并划出新视角合成的评测子集。

paper.title: DL3DV-10K: A Large-Scale Scene Dataset for Deep Learning-based 3D Vision

works.title: Align Your Gaussians (AYG)
works.description: NVIDIA's Align Your Gaussians turns a text prompt into an animated 3D object made of moving Gaussians, and can chain and combine several such animations into longer scenes with more than one actor.
works.description_zh: 英伟达的 Align Your Gaussians 把文字提示变成由运动高斯组成的动画三维物体，还能把多段动画串联、组合成包含多个角色的更长场景。
works.idea_en: Gaussian 4D content can be composed like clips: separately generated moving objects can be placed together in one scene.
works.idea_zh: 高斯表示的 4D 内容可以像片段一样组合：分别生成的运动物体可以放进同一个场景。
works.method: Dynamic 3D Gaussians with deformation fields are optimised by composed score distillation from a text-to-image, a multi-view and a text-to-video model (VideoLDM), with a regulariser on Gaussian motion and autoregressive extension for longer sequences.
works.method_zh: 以带形变场的动态三维高斯为表示，用文生图、多视角与文生视频模型（VideoLDM）的组合分数蒸馏进行优化，对高斯运动加入正则，并以自回归方式延长序列。

paper.title: Align Your Gaussians: Text-to-4D with Dynamic 3D Gaussians and Composed Diffusion Models

works.title_zh: Align Your Gaussians 动态高斯文本生成 4D

works.title: DUSt3R
works.description: DUSt3R takes two photos with unknown cameras and directly regresses a 3D point for every pixel, so depth, camera poses and a point cloud fall out of one network instead of a structure-from-motion pipeline.
works.description_zh: DUSt3R 输入两张相机未知的照片，直接为每个像素回归一个三维点，于是深度、相机位姿和点云都来自同一个网络，而不再需要运动恢复结构流程。
works.idea_en: Started the move from fragile photogrammetry to models that reconstruct from whatever photos you have.
works.idea_zh: 开启了从脆弱的摄影测量转向“用手头任意照片就能重建”的模型。
works.method: A ViT encoder-decoder pretrained with cross-view completion outputs pointmaps for both images in the first camera's frame; a global alignment step merges many views.
works.method_zh: 以跨视角补全预训练的 ViT 编码器-解码器，在第一台相机坐标系中输出两张图像的点图；全局对齐步骤合并多个视角。

paper.title: DUSt3R: Geometric 3D Vision Made Easy

works.title: StreamDiffusion
works.description: StreamDiffusion (2023-12-19) restyles a live webcam or screen feed with Stable Diffusion at up to about 90 fps on one RTX 4090, and became the engine of many TouchDesigner and live-performance installations; StreamDiffusionV2 (2025-11) extends it to video diffusion models.
works.description_zh: StreamDiffusion（2023-12-19）可用 Stable Diffusion 实时重绘摄像头或屏幕画面，在单张 RTX 4090 上最高约 90 fps，成为许多 TouchDesigner 与现场表演装置的引擎；StreamDiffusionV2（2025 年 11 月）把它扩展到视频扩散模型。
works.idea_en: Per-frame diffusion on a live camera feed was the first practical way to change what a person sees as it happens.
works.idea_zh: 对实时摄像头画面逐帧扩散，是第一个能在当下改变人所见画面的实用方案。
works.method: Pipeline-level optimizations (stream batching of denoising steps, residual classifier-free guidance, a stochastic similarity filter) around few-step models such as SD-Turbo and LCM.
works.method_zh: 围绕 SD-Turbo、LCM 等少步模型的流水线级优化：去噪步的流式批处理、残差无分类器引导、随机相似度过滤。
works.specs: up to 91 fps img2img on RTX 4090 (reported)

paper.title: StreamDiffusion: A Pipeline-level Solution for Real-time Interactive Generation

works.title: pixelSplat
works.description: pixelSplat predicts a 3D Gaussian scene from just two photos in one network pass, with no per-scene optimisation, and renders new views between them.
works.description_zh: pixelSplat 只用两张照片、一次网络前向就预测出三维高斯场景，无需逐场景优化，并能渲染两者之间的新视角。
works.idea_en: An early sign that splat scenes could come out of a network instead of a training run.
works.idea_zh: 早期迹象之一：泼溅场景可以直接由网络输出，而不必经过一次训练。
works.method: An epipolar transformer encodes the image pair, and per-pixel depth distributions are sampled differentiably to place Gaussians.
works.method_zh: 对极 Transformer 编码图像对，并对逐像素的深度分布进行可微采样来放置高斯。

paper.title: pixelSplat: 3D Gaussian Splats from Image Pairs for Scalable Generalizable 3D Reconstruction

works.title: Holodeck
works.description: From a prompt such as 'a 1b1b apartment of a researcher who has a cat', Holodeck builds a complete interactive multi-room environment in AI2-THOR, with floor plan, materials, doors, windows and furnished objects that embodied agents can navigate.
works.description_zh: 输入“一位养猫研究者的一室一厅公寓”这样的提示，Holodeck 就会在 AI2-THOR 中搭建完整的、可交互的多房间环境，包括平面图、材质、门窗和摆放好的家具，具身智能体可以在其中导航。
works.idea_en: The language model writes the scene as constraints, so every generated room is an inspectable specification that can be logged, varied and rebuilt.
works.idea_zh: 语言模型把场景写成约束，因此每个生成的房间都是一份可检查的规格说明，可以记录、变化和重建。
works.method: GPT-4 proposes floor plans, materials and object lists with spatial-relation constraints; assets are retrieved from Objaverse and a constraint solver optimises the layout before the scene is loaded into the AI2-THOR simulator.
works.method_zh: GPT-4 提出平面图、材质和带空间关系约束的物体清单；从 Objaverse 检索资产，再由约束求解器优化布局，最后载入 AI2-THOR 模拟器。

paper.title: Holodeck: Language Guided Generation of 3D Embodied AI Environments

works.title: SMERF
works.description: SMERF streams house-sized radiance fields into a web browser and renders them in real time on laptops and phones, with quality close to the slow Zip-NeRF it is distilled from.
works.description_zh: SMERF 把房屋大小的辐射场流式加载到网页浏览器，在笔记本和手机上实时渲染，质量接近其所蒸馏自的、较慢的 Zip-NeRF。
works.idea_en: Shows that a large captured place can be explored in a browser tab without a dedicated GPU.
works.idea_zh: 说明一个大型捕捉场景无需专用 GPU，也能在浏览器标签页中被探索。
works.method: The scene is tiled into independent MERF submodels loaded by camera position, trained by distillation from a Zip-NeRF teacher.
works.method_zh: 场景被划分为按相机位置加载的独立 MERF 子模型，通过从 Zip-NeRF 教师模型蒸馏得到。

paper.title: SMERF: Streamable Memory Efficient Radiance Fields for Real-Time Large-Scene Exploration

works.title: SayMotion
works.description: DeepMotion's text-to-3D-animation tool: describe an action in words and get a 3D character animation that can be refined, looped or combined with motion captured from ordinary video, then exported to common 3D formats.
works.description_zh: DeepMotion 的文生三维动画工具：用文字描述动作即可得到三维角色动画，可继续细化、循环，或与从普通视频中捕捉的动作组合，再导出为常见三维格式。
works.idea_en: An early commercial example of animators typing motions instead of capturing them, useful for quickly blocking out what generated characters do.
works.idea_zh: 较早的商业实例：动画师用打字代替动作捕捉，适合快速为生成角色排出动作草稿。
works.method: Proprietary text-to-motion generation, likely combined with DeepMotion's markerless video motion capture (Animate 3D).
works.method_zh: 专有的文生动作模型，很可能结合了 DeepMotion 的无标记视频动作捕捉（Animate 3D）。

works.title: Concordia
works.description: An open-source Python library for generative agent-based models: researchers write characters and a scenario, and a 'Game Master' agent narrates what happens when the characters act, much like a tabletop role-playing game.
works.description_zh: 一个开源的 Python 生成式智能体建模库：研究者编写角色与情境，再由一个“游戏主持人”（Game Master）智能体叙述角色行动的后果，类似桌面角色扮演游戏。
works.idea_en: Separates who acts from what the world says happened, which gives social scientists one place to set, log and audit the rules of a simulated situation.
works.idea_zh: 把“谁在行动”与“世界判定发生了什么”分开，让社会科学研究者能在一个地方设定、记录和审查模拟情境的规则。
works.method: Agents are built from composable LLM components (memory, observation, plans, identity); the Game Master resolves free-text actions into events grounded in physical, social or digital state; v2.0 restructured the components, and the NeurIPS 2024 Concordia Contest used it for cooperation research.
works.method_zh: 智能体由可组合的 LLM 组件（记忆、观察、计划、身份）构成；游戏主持人把自由文本行动裁定为基于物理、社会或数字状态的事件；2.0 版重构了组件体系，NeurIPS 2024 的 Concordia Contest 用它研究合作行为。

paper.title: Generative agent-based modeling with actions grounded in physical, social, or digital space using Concordia

works.title: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars
works.description: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars render a drivable 3D head with individual hair strands, skin pores and eye reflections under any lighting, in real time, so the avatar fits the light of the scene it is placed in.
works.description_zh: 可重光照高斯 Codec Avatars 能在任意光照下实时渲染可驱动的三维头部，包括单根发丝、皮肤毛孔和眼睛反光，使化身与所处场景的光照一致。
works.idea_en: Lighting consistency is part of believability: a face that ignores the room's light reads as pasted in.
works.idea_zh: 光照一致是可信度的一部分：无视房间光线的脸看起来就像贴上去的。
works.method: 3D Gaussians attached to a deformable head model with learnable radiance transfer (diffuse spherical-harmonics and spherical-Gaussian specular), plus an explicit eye model, trained on light-stage multi-view capture.
works.method_zh: 把三维高斯附着在可变形头部模型上，学习辐射传输（漫反射球谐与球面高斯镜面反射），再加上显式的眼睛模型，在光场舞台多视角采集数据上训练。

paper.title: Relightable Gaussian Codec Avatars

works.title_zh: 可重光照高斯 Codec Avatars

works.title: WonderJourney
works.description: Starting from any image or text, WonderJourney generates a long sequence of connected 3D scenes, flying from a painting into a mountain range or a poem's landscape, rendered as a continuous camera journey.
works.description_zh: WonderJourney 从任意一张图像或一段文字出发，生成一长串彼此相连的三维场景，例如从一幅画飞入群山或诗中的风景，并渲染成一段连续的镜头旅程。
works.idea_en: Letting a language model write 'what comes next' turns scene generation into open-ended travel, but each step is only a short, view-dependent 3D patch.
works.idea_zh: 让语言模型来写“接下来是什么”，场景生成就变成了无尽的旅行；不过每一步都只是一小块依赖视角的三维片段。
works.method: An LLM proposes the next scene description, a text-to-image model with depth estimation builds a point-cloud scene, and a vision-language model checks the result before the camera moves on.
works.method_zh: 语言模型提出下一个场景的描述，文生图模型配合深度估计构建点云场景，再由视觉语言模型检查结果，镜头才继续前进。

paper.title: WonderJourney: Going from Anywhere to Everywhere

works.title: GaussianAvatars
works.description: GaussianAvatars builds a photoreal 3D head from multi-view video by binding 3D Gaussians to a FLAME face mesh, so the head can be re-animated with new expressions and poses and rendered in real time from any viewpoint.
works.description_zh: GaussianAvatars 把三维高斯绑定到 FLAME 人脸网格上，从多视角视频中构建照片级三维头部，可用新的表情和姿态重新驱动，并能从任意视角实时渲染。
works.idea_en: Rigging splats to a standard face model made Gaussian avatars drivable by the same parameters games and trackers already use.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯绑定到标准人脸模型上，让高斯化身可以用游戏和追踪器已在使用的参数来驱动。
works.method: 3D Gaussians parented to FLAME mesh triangles, moving with them, with binding inheritance during densification, optimized jointly with FLAME parameters on multi-view video.
works.method_zh: 三维高斯挂接在 FLAME 网格三角形上并随之运动，致密化时继承绑定关系，在多视角视频上与 FLAME 参数联合优化。

paper.title: GaussianAvatars: Photorealistic Head Avatars with Rigged 3D Gaussians

works.title_zh: GaussianAvatars：绑定三维高斯的照片级头部化身

works.title: LiveKit Agents
works.description: An open-source framework for real-time voice, video and physical-AI agents that join LiveKit WebRTC rooms as participants. It wires speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech (or speech-to-speech) models and avatar providers into one session, with turn detection, interruption handling, telephony and evaluation tools; 1.0 shipped on 2025-04-10 and 1.8.8 on 2026-10-15, and LiveKit Cloud hosts deployments.
works.description_zh: 开源的实时语音、视频与物理 AI 智能体框架，智能体以参与者身份加入 LiveKit WebRTC 房间。它把语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成（或语音到语音模型）以及虚拟人服务串进同一会话，并提供话轮检测、打断处理、电话接入与评测工具；1.0 版于 2025-04-10 发布，1.8.8 版于 2026-10-15 发布，LiveKit Cloud 负责托管部署。
works.idea_en: The plumbing that lets a researcher swap the voice, model or avatar of a virtual human while keeping the same room, logging and timing behavior.
works.idea_zh: 这套底层管线让研究者可以更换虚拟人的声音、模型或形象，同时保持同样的房间、日志与时序行为。
works.method: Python and Node.js workers connect to a LiveKit media server over WebRTC; a pipeline of plugins (STT, LLM, TTS, VAD and a transformer turn-detection model) or a realtime model handles each conversation.
works.method_zh: Python 与 Node.js 工作进程通过 WebRTC 连接 LiveKit 媒体服务器；每段对话由插件流水线（语音识别、大语言模型、语音合成、语音活动检测与 Transformer 话轮检测模型）或实时模型处理。

works.title: 4D-fy
works.description: 4D-fy generates a short animated 3D scene, such as a bear driving a car, from a text prompt; the result can be watched from any angle while it moves.
works.description_zh: 4D-fy 能根据一句文字提示生成一段会动的三维场景（例如一只开车的熊），在播放时可以从任意角度观看。
works.idea_en: Text-to-4D needs several teachers at once: image models for appearance, multi-view models for shape and video models for motion.
works.idea_zh: 文本到 4D 需要同时向多个“老师”学习：图像模型管外观，多视角模型管形状，视频模型管运动。
works.method: A 4D radiance field built on multi-resolution hash encodings is optimised per prompt with hybrid score distillation, which alternates gradients from a text-to-image, a 3D-aware multi-view and a text-to-video diffusion model.
works.method_zh: 以多分辨率哈希编码的 4D 辐射场为表示，针对每个提示用“混合分数蒸馏”优化，交替使用文生图、三维感知多视角与文生视频扩散模型的梯度。

paper.title: 4D-fy: Text-to-4D Generation Using Hybrid Score Distillation Sampling

works.title_zh: 4D-fy 文本生成 4D

works.title: MoMask
works.description: Text-to-motion model that represents motion as hierarchical residual tokens and generates them with masked transformers, reaching higher fidelity on HumanML3D than diffusion baselines and supporting temporal inpainting.
works.description_zh: 把动作表示为分层残差词元、并用掩码 Transformer 生成的文生动作模型，在 HumanML3D 上的保真度高于扩散基线，并支持时间维度上的补全。
works.idea_en: Discrete, masked generation gave a large jump in motion quality and remains a strong open baseline for text-driven bodies.
works.idea_zh: 离散的掩码生成让动作质量大幅提升，至今仍是文字驱动身体的强力开源基线。
works.method: A residual VQ-VAE quantizes motion into a base layer and residual layers; a masked transformer predicts base tokens from text and a residual transformer fills the finer layers.
works.method_zh: 残差 VQ-VAE 把动作量化为基础层和若干残差层；掩码 Transformer 由文字预测基础层词元，残差 Transformer 补全更细的层。

paper.title: MoMask: Generative Masked Modeling of 3D Human Motions

works.title: VBench
works.description: A benchmark suite that scores text-to-video models on 16 dimensions such as subject consistency, motion smoothness, temporal flickering, dynamic degree and spatial relationship, each with its own prompt set and automatic evaluator checked against human preference. Its public leaderboard is cited by many video-model releases, and VBench++ (2024) adds image-to-video and trustworthiness tests.
works.description_zh: 一套视频生成评测基准，从主体一致性、运动平滑度、时间闪烁、动态程度、空间关系等 16 个维度为文生视频模型打分，每个维度都有专门的提示集与自动评估器，并以人类偏好标注加以校验。许多视频模型发布时都会引用它的公开排行榜；VBench++（2024）又加入了图生视频与可信度测试。
works.idea_en: Breaks 'video quality' into separately measurable dimensions, though high temporal-smoothness scores can reward videos that barely move.
works.idea_zh: 把“视频质量”拆成可以分别测量的维度；不过时间平滑度得分高，也可能是在奖励几乎不动的视频。
works.method: Per-dimension prompt suites scored by automatic metrics built on pretrained vision models (feature similarity, optical flow, detectors, aesthetic predictors), validated with human preference annotations per dimension.
works.method_zh: 按维度设计的提示集，由基于预训练视觉模型的自动指标打分（特征相似度、光流、检测器、美学预测器），并用逐维度的人类偏好标注加以验证。

paper.title: VBench: Comprehensive Benchmark Suite for Video Generative Models

works.title: Pika 1.0
works.description: Pika 1.0 (2023-11-28) turned the Discord-born Pika bot into a web 'idea-to-video' platform with text-to-video, image animation and in-video edits such as region modification and canvas expansion.
works.description_zh: Pika 1.0（2023-11-28）把起家于 Discord 的 Pika 机器人变成网页上的“想法生成视频”平台，提供文生视频、让图片动起来，以及局部修改、画面扩展等视频内编辑。
works.idea_en: An early sign that playful editing features, not raw quality, drive mass adoption of generative video.
works.idea_zh: 较早表明推动生成视频大众化的是好玩的编辑功能，而不只是画质。
works.method: Proprietary video diffusion model; later Pika 2.x versions added effects such as Pikaffects and scene ingredients.
works.method_zh: 自研视频扩散模型；后续 Pika 2.x 加入了 Pikaffects 特效和场景素材组合等功能。

works.title: Mip-Splatting
works.description: Mip-Splatting removes the shimmering and thin-line artefacts that appear when a Gaussian splat scene is zoomed in or out relative to how it was captured.
works.description_zh: Mip-Splatting 消除了高斯泼溅场景在放大或缩小（相对于拍摄尺度）时出现的闪烁与细线伪影。
works.idea_en: Matters for headsets, where people lean in and step back far more than a capture camera did.
works.idea_zh: 对头显很重要，因为人在头显里靠近和后退的幅度远大于拍摄相机。
works.method: A 3D smoothing filter bounds Gaussian size by the sampling rate of the training views, and a 2D Mip filter replaces screen-space dilation.
works.method_zh: 三维平滑滤波器依据训练视角的采样率限制高斯尺寸，二维 Mip 滤波器替代屏幕空间膨胀。

paper.title: Mip-Splatting: Alias-free 3D Gaussian Splatting

works.title: LucidDreamer
works.description: Generates a whole 3D Gaussian-splat scene, not a single object, from a text prompt or an image, in any style, by repeatedly imagining new views and stitching them into one point cloud.
works.description_zh: 根据一句文字或一张图像生成整片三维高斯泼溅场景（而不只是一个物体），风格不限：方法是反复想象新视角，再把它们拼进同一个点云。
works.idea_en: Inpainting plus depth was enough to grow a coherent splat scene from one prompt, the recipe many later world generators refined.
works.idea_zh: 图像补全加深度估计就足以从一句提示词“长出”连贯的泼溅场景，后来许多世界生成器都在完善这套做法。
works.method: 'Dreaming' alternates Stable Diffusion inpainting of a moved camera view with monocular depth lifting into a shared point cloud; 'alignment' merges the points, which initialise a 3D Gaussian splatting optimisation.
works.method_zh: “做梦”阶段交替进行：用 Stable Diffusion 补全移动后的视角，再用单目深度把它提升进共享点云；“对齐”阶段合并点云，并以此初始化三维高斯泼溅的优化。

paper.title: LucidDreamer: Domain-free Generation of 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes

works.title: Stable Video Diffusion
works.description: Stable Video Diffusion (2023-11-21) was the first widely used open-weight image-to-video model, turning a still image into 14- or 25-frame clips; it also served as the base for multi-view 3D generators.
works.description_zh: Stable Video Diffusion（2023-11-21）是首个被广泛使用的开源图生视频模型，可把一张静态图变成 14 或 25 帧短片，也被用作多视角三维生成的基础模型。
works.idea_en: Gave researchers a video prior they could fine-tune; many later 3D and 4D generators start from SVD weights.
works.idea_zh: 为研究者提供了可微调的视频先验，后来许多三维、四维生成方法都从 SVD 权重起步。
works.method: Latent video diffusion with temporal layers added to Stable Diffusion 2.1, trained in three stages: image pretraining, curated video pretraining and high-quality fine-tuning.
works.method_zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 2.1 上加入时间层的潜空间视频扩散模型，分三阶段训练：图像预训练、精选视频预训练和高质量微调。

paper.title: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets

works.title: LRM: Large Reconstruction Model
works.description: A 500-million-parameter transformer that predicts a triplane NeRF of an object from one image in about five seconds, trained on roughly one million objects from Objaverse and MVImgNet.
works.description_zh: 一个 5 亿参数的 Transformer，约 5 秒即可从单张图像预测物体的三平面 NeRF，训练数据为来自 Objaverse 和 MVImgNet 的约一百万个物体。
works.idea_en: Replaced per-object optimization with a single feed-forward pass, moving image-to-3D from hours to seconds; TripoSR, InstantMesh and most production pipelines follow this template.
works.idea_zh: 用一次前馈推理取代逐物体优化，把图生三维从数小时缩短到数秒；TripoSR、InstantMesh 和多数生产流程都沿用了这一模板。
works.method: Learnable triplane tokens cross-attend to DINO image features in an image-to-triplane transformer decoder, trained end to end with rendering losses on multi-view data.
works.method_zh: 在图像到三平面的 Transformer 解码器中，可学习的三平面词元对 DINO 图像特征做交叉注意力，并用多视角数据上的渲染损失端到端训练。
works.specs: 500M parameters · ~5 s per object · ~1M training objects

paper.title: LRM: Large Reconstruction Model for Single Image to 3D

works.title_zh: LRM：大型重建模型

works.title: Consistent4D
works.description: Consistent4D takes one uncalibrated video of a moving object, such as a phone clip or a segment of an animated film, and generates a 360° dynamic 3D version that can be viewed from any angle as it moves. It is an early reference point for video-to-4D generation, and its evaluation set is widely used as the Consistent4D benchmark by later 4D generators.
works.description_zh: Consistent4D 以一段未标定的运动物体视频为输入（例如手机拍摄的片段或动画电影的一段），生成可在运动中从任意角度观看的 360° 动态三维版本。它是视频到 4D 生成的早期参照，其评测集作为 Consistent4D 基准被后来的 4D 生成方法广泛使用。
works.idea_en: Turning dynamic capture into a generation problem: a single handheld video, with no camera rig or calibration, is enough to get a moving object you can walk around.
works.idea_zh: 把动态捕捉变成生成问题：不需要相机阵列或标定，一段手持视频就能得到可以绕着看的运动物体。
works.method: A Cascade DyNeRF is optimized with an object-level 3D-aware image diffusion model as the main supervision, plus an interpolation-driven consistency loss that compares rendered frames with frames from a pretrained video interpolation model; a video enhancer trained afterwards refines the renders.
works.method_zh: 以物体级三维感知图像扩散模型作为主要监督来优化级联动态神经辐射场（Cascade DyNeRF），并用基于插帧的一致性损失把渲染帧与预训练视频插帧模型生成的帧进行比对；之后训练的视频增强器再对渲染结果做精修。

paper.title: Consistent4D: Consistent 360° Dynamic Object Generation from Monocular Video

works.title_zh: Consistent4D 由单目视频生成一致的 360° 动态物体

works.title: Sounding Bodies
works.description: Renders the full 3D sound field produced by a human body (speech, footsteps, claps, finger snaps) from headset microphone audio and tracked body pose, so a virtual person sounds right from any listening position. Developed with Meta Reality Labs Research.
works.description_zh: 根据头显麦克风音频和被追踪的身体姿态，渲染人体发出的完整三维声场（说话、脚步、拍手、打响指），让虚拟人从任何听音位置听起来都正确。与 Meta Reality Labs Research 合作完成。
works.idea_en: Spatially correct body sound is what makes a co-present avatar sound co-present; this model ties it to tracked pose.
works.idea_zh: 空间上正确的身体声音，才让“同在”的虚拟化身听起来真的同在；这个模型把它与被追踪的姿态联系起来。
works.method: Neural network that maps head-mounted microphone signals and 3D body pose to the sound field around the body, trained on multi-view captures recorded with a large spherical microphone array.
works.method_zh: 神经网络把头戴麦克风信号与三维身体姿态映射为身体周围的声场，训练数据来自大型球形麦克风阵列录制的多视角采集。

paper.title: Sounding Bodies: Modeling 3D Spatial Sound of Humans Using Body Pose and Audio

works.title_zh: Sounding Bodies：由身体姿态与音频建模人体三维空间声音

works.title: SuperSplat
works.description: SuperSplat is PlayCanvas's free, open-source browser editor for Gaussian splats, plus a hosting site, for cleaning, cropping, combining and publishing splat scenes; version 3.0 (September 2026) was rebuilt on WebGPU.
works.description_zh: SuperSplat 是 PlayCanvas 推出的免费开源浏览器高斯泼溅编辑器及托管网站，用于清理、裁剪、合并和发布泼溅场景；3.0 版（2026 年 9 月）基于 WebGPU 重建。
works.idea_en: The common place where captured splats are cleaned and shared, which makes it part of most capture pipelines.
works.idea_zh: 捕捉得到的泼溅通常在这里被清理与分享，因此它是大多数捕捉流程的一部分。
works.method: A web app on the PlayCanvas engine edits PLY/SOG splats with selection tools and exports compressed formats for viewers and engines.
works.method_zh: 基于 PlayCanvas 引擎的网页应用，用选择工具编辑 PLY/SOG 泼溅，并导出供查看器与引擎使用的压缩格式。

works.title: UniSim
works.description: A 'universal simulator' that predicts what a camera would see after a person or robot carries out an action described in text, such as 'cut the carrot' or 'open the drawer', so that planners and RL policies can be trained in simulation and then deployed on real robots.
works.description_zh: 一个“通用模拟器”：预测一个人或机器人执行文字描述的动作（如“切胡萝卜”“打开抽屉”）之后，摄像头会看到什么，从而让规划器和强化学习策略先在模拟中训练，再部署到真实机器人上。
works.idea_en: Reframes video generation as a simulator of real-world interaction, the conceptual step from 'video model' to 'world model'.
works.idea_zh: 把视频生成重新定义为真实世界交互的模拟器，这是从“视频模型”迈向“世界模型”的概念性一步。
works.method: A video diffusion model conditioned on past frames and text or low-level actions, trained on an orchestrated mix of image, video, robot and navigation datasets; it is rolled out autoregressively for long-horizon interaction.
works.method_zh: 以历史帧及文字或底层动作为条件的视频扩散模型，在精心组合的图像、视频、机器人与导航数据上训练，并通过自回归推演实现长时交互。

paper.title: Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators

works.title_zh: UniSim：可交互的真实世界模拟器

works.title: DreamSpace
works.description: Type a style such as 'Van Gogh' or 'cyberpunk' and a scanned room is re-textured end to end, with coherent textures across walls, floor and furniture that you can walk through in a VR headset.
works.description_zh: 输入“梵高”或“赛博朋克”等风格，扫描好的房间就会被整体重新贴图，墙面、地板与家具的纹理彼此连贯，戴上 VR 头显即可走进其中。
works.idea_en: Restyles a real room's geometry instead of replacing it, so the generated world keeps the layout your body already knows.
works.idea_zh: 重绘的是真实房间的外观而不是替换其几何，生成的世界保留了身体早已熟悉的布局。
works.method: A stylized 360-degree panorama is generated from the room's centre with coarse-to-fine diffusion and dual texture alignment, then propagated to the rest of the mesh by inpainting and an implicit imitation network for occluded parts.
works.method_zh: 先从房间中心用由粗到细的扩散模型和双重纹理对齐生成风格化 360° 全景纹理，再通过图像修补和隐式模仿网络，把纹理传播到网格其余部分及被遮挡区域。

paper.title: DreamSpace: Dreaming Your Room Space with Text-Driven Panoramic Texture Propagation

works.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS)
works.description: 4D Gaussian Splatting represents a moving scene as one set of 3D Gaussians plus a learned deformation field, so recorded dynamic scenes play back from free viewpoints in real time.
works.description_zh: 4D 高斯泼溅把运动场景表示为一组三维高斯加上一个学习得到的形变场，使录制的动态场景能以自由视角实时回放。
works.idea_en: The reference point for treating recorded events, not just places, as something a viewer can walk around.
works.idea_zh: 把录下来的事件（而不仅是地点）当作观众可以绕着走的东西，这项工作是参照点。
works.method: A HexPlane spatio-temporal encoder feeds a small MLP that predicts per-Gaussian position, rotation and scale offsets at each timestamp.
works.method_zh: HexPlane 时空编码器为一个小型多层感知机提供特征，预测每个时间戳下每个高斯的位置、旋转与尺度偏移。
works.specs: 82 fps at 800×800 on RTX 3090 (paper, synthetic scenes)

paper.title: 4D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Dynamic Scene Rendering

works.title_zh: 4D 高斯泼溅（4DGS）

works.title: Soul Machines Digital People (Digital Brain)
works.description: Soul Machines' Digital People are rendered 3D digital humans for customer service, coaching and companionship whose faces are animated by what the company calls a Digital Brain of reciprocal sensory, motor, attention and autonomic nervous systems, so that they breathe, react and form memories; a large language model supplies the words. The official explainer shown here is dated 2023-10-02; the company had built Digital People since its 2016 founding, and AppDirect acquired it on 2026-09-28.
works.description_zh: Soul Machines 的 Digital People 是经过渲染的三维数字人，用于客服、辅导和陪伴。公司称其面部由一个“数字大脑”驱动，这个大脑由相互作用的感觉、运动、注意与自主神经系统组成，因此数字人会呼吸、作出反应并形成记忆；对话内容由大语言模型生成。这里展示的官方介绍视频发布于 2023-10-02；公司自 2016 年成立起就在开发 Digital People，并于 2026-09-28 被 AppDirect 收购。
works.idea_en: An alternative to faces generated from video data: breathing, gaze and reactive expression come from a simulated nervous system that can in principle be inspected, while the 2026 acquisition shows how much a study built on one avatar vendor depends on that vendor.
works.idea_zh: 这是另一条路线：呼吸、视线和反应性表情不是从视频数据中生成，而是来自一个原则上可以检查的模拟神经系统；2026 年的收购也说明，基于单一虚拟人供应商的研究在多大程度上依赖这家供应商。
works.method: A cognitive model descended from the BabyX research simulates sensory, motor, attention/perception and autonomic systems and drives the expressions and idle behaviour of a rendered 3D character from camera and microphone input, while dialogue comes from integrated LLMs such as ChatGPT; the character is likely rendered in the cloud and streamed to a browser.
works.method_zh: 一个源自 BabyX 研究的认知模型模拟感觉、运动、注意/知觉与自主神经系统，根据摄像头和麦克风输入驱动渲染出的三维角色的表情与静息行为；对话则来自接入的大语言模型（如 ChatGPT）；角色很可能在云端渲染后以视频流传到浏览器。
works.title_zh: Soul Machines 数字人（数字大脑）

works.title: Animate Anything
works.description: Anything World's service that automatically rigs and animates uploaded 3D models, including animals, vehicles and other non-humanoid shapes, and returns engine-ready animated assets.
works.description_zh: Anything World 的服务：自动为上传的三维模型（包括动物、交通工具和其他非人形物体）绑定并制作动画，返回可直接用于引擎的动画资产。
works.idea_en: Extends auto-rigging beyond humanoids, so the animals and machines of a scene can move as well.
works.idea_zh: 把自动绑定扩展到人形之外，让场景中的动物和机械也能动起来。
works.method: Proprietary; the system likely classifies the model's category, places a category-specific skeleton, computes skinning and applies a matching animation set.
works.method_zh: 专有系统；很可能先识别模型类别，再放置对应类别的骨架、计算蒙皮，并套用相应的动画集。
works.title_zh: Animate Anything（万物动画）

works.title: DreamGaussian
works.description: Generates a textured mesh from one image (or a text prompt) in about two minutes by optimizing 3D Gaussians with score distillation, then extracting a mesh and refining its UV texture.
works.description_zh: 通过分数蒸馏优化三维高斯，再提取网格并细化 UV 贴图，约两分钟即可由一张图像（或一句文字提示）生成带贴图的网格。
works.idea_en: Brought Gaussian splatting into generation and cut optimization-based image/text-to-3D from hours to minutes, a step toward explicit 3D representations in asset models.
works.idea_zh: 把高斯泼溅引入生成任务，将基于优化的图生 / 文生三维从数小时缩短到几分钟，是资产模型走向显式三维表示的一步。
works.method: Progressive densification of 3D Gaussians under SDS guidance (Zero-1-to-3 for images, Stable Diffusion for text), followed by mesh extraction and texture refinement in UV space.
works.method_zh: 在 SDS 指导下（图像用 Zero-1-to-3，文字用 Stable Diffusion）逐步加密三维高斯，随后提取网格并在 UV 空间细化贴图。

paper.title: DreamGaussian: Generative Gaussian Splatting for Efficient 3D Content Creation

works.title: Polycam Gaussian Splatting
works.description: Polycam, a widely used phone and web 3D scanning app, added Gaussian splat processing so uploaded photos or video become splat scenes viewable at high frame rates in a browser.
works.description_zh: Polycam 是一款广泛使用的手机与网页三维扫描应用，加入了高斯泼溅处理，上传的照片或视频会变成可在浏览器中高帧率观看的泼溅场景。
works.idea_en: Put splat capture in the same app people already used for photogrammetry and LiDAR scans.
works.idea_zh: 把泼溅捕捉放进人们已经在用的摄影测量与 LiDAR 扫描应用里。
works.method: Photos or video are processed in the cloud into 3D Gaussians alongside mesh and point-cloud outputs, with in-browser editing and export.
works.method_zh: 照片或视频在云端处理为三维高斯，同时提供网格与点云输出，支持浏览器内编辑和导出。
works.title_zh: Polycam 高斯泼溅

works.title: LLMR
works.description: Type or say 'make a timer out of a rotating cube' or 'recolor the scene for a color-blind user' and LLMR writes, checks and runs the Unity code that changes the live mixed-reality world.
works.description_zh: 输入或说出“用旋转的立方体做一个计时器”或“为色盲用户重新配色”，LLMR 就会编写、检查并运行 Unity 代码，直接改变正在运行的混合现实世界。
works.idea_en: Makes the behaviour of an immersive world, not just its look, something a person can ask for in plain language.
works.idea_zh: 让沉浸世界的行为（而不只是外观）变成可以用日常语言提出的要求。
works.method: An orchestration of GPT-4 modules for scene understanding, task planning, code building, self-debugging and memory runs inside Unity; the authors report a 4x lower average error rate than plain GPT-4 and a usability study (N=11).
works.method_zh: 在 Unity 中编排多个 GPT-4 模块，分别负责场景理解、任务规划、代码生成、自我调试与记忆；作者报告其平均错误率比直接使用 GPT-4 低 4 倍，并做了可用性研究（N=11）。
works.specs: Unity · 4x lower error rate vs GPT-4 (reported) · N=11

paper.title: LLMR: Real-time Prompting of Interactive Worlds using Large Language Models

works.title: CityDreamer
works.description: Generates unbounded 3D cities, street layouts, buildings and background, that can be flown through with a consistent camera, learned from Google Earth imagery and OpenStreetMap layouts.
works.description_zh: 生成无边界的三维城市——街道布局、建筑与背景——可以用连贯的镜头飞越其中，训练数据为 Google Earth 影像与 OpenStreetMap 布局。
works.idea_en: City scale is where situations like crowds, traffic and getting lost live; CityDreamer shows generated layout and appearance can be separated at that scale.
works.idea_zh: 人群、交通、迷路这类情境都发生在城市尺度；CityDreamer 表明在这个尺度上可以把生成的布局与外观分开控制。
works.method: An unbounded layout generator produces a semantic and height map; separate neural-field generators render buildings (instance-wise) and background, composed with compact bird's-eye-view scene representations.
works.method_zh: 无边界布局生成器先输出语义图与高度图；再由分别负责建筑（逐实例）和背景的神经场生成器渲染，并以紧凑的鸟瞰图场景表示组合起来。

paper.title: CityDreamer: Compositional Generative Model of Unbounded 3D Cities

works.title: AI Town
works.description: A deployable, MIT-licensed town in the browser where LLM characters walk around, start conversations and remember them; a visitor can join as a character and chat with the residents.
works.description_zh: 一个可部署、MIT 许可的浏览器小镇：LLM 角色四处走动、主动搭话并记住对话；访客也可以作为一个角色加入，与居民聊天。
works.idea_en: Turned the generative-agents paper into a template people fork for their own simulated communities and games.
works.idea_zh: 把生成式智能体论文变成一个模板，人们可以复刻它来搭建自己的模拟社群与游戏。
works.method: A TypeScript game loop on the Convex reactive database stores world state, agent memories and embeddings, and calls a hosted or local LLM (OpenAI, Together or Ollama) for conversations and memory summaries.
works.method_zh: 基于 Convex 响应式数据库的 TypeScript 游戏循环保存世界状态、智能体记忆与向量嵌入，并调用托管或本地大语言模型（OpenAI、Together 或 Ollama）生成对话与记忆摘要。

works.title: Tulpamancer
works.description: Visitors answer questions about their lives at an old computer terminal, then put on a VR headset and are led by their 'tulpa' through uniquely generated scenes about their past and possible futures; each work is deleted after viewing.
works.description_zh: 观众先在一台旧电脑终端前回答关于自己人生的问题，再戴上 VR 头显，由自己的“图帕”带领穿过专门生成的场景，回望过去、设想未来；每件作品在观看后即被删除。
works.idea_en: A personal VR journey generated from one person's answers, made once and then discarded.
works.idea_zh: 根据一个人的回答生成的私人 VR 旅程，只做一次，看完即弃。
works.method: A machine-learning pipeline, likely language and image generation, turns each participant's answers into a sequence of virtual scenes and narration before the headset session.
works.method_zh: 机器学习流程（很可能结合语言与图像生成）在佩戴头显之前，把每位参与者的回答变成一系列虚拟场景与旁白。

works.title: Mantella
works.description: A free mod that lets players speak aloud to more than 1,000 NPCs in Skyrim, and later Fallout 4, and hear them answer in their own synthesized voices; characters remember earlier conversations and are aware of in-game events.
works.description_zh: 一个免费模组：玩家可以直接开口与《上古卷轴 V：天际》（后来也包括《辐射 4》）中的 1,000 多个 NPC 交谈，并听到他们以各自的合成声音回答；角色会记住之前的对话，也能感知游戏中发生的事件。
works.idea_en: A large, hand-built world plus speech-to-text, an LLM and voice cloning already yields open-ended conversations with its whole cast, a low-cost template for conversational scenes in existing 3D worlds.
works.idea_zh: 一个大型手工构建的世界，加上语音识别、大语言模型与声音克隆，就能与其中全部角色进行开放式对话；这为在现成三维世界中搭建对话场景提供了低成本的模板。
works.method: Speech is transcribed with Whisper or Moonshine, a cloud or local LLM generates the reply from each NPC's bio, conversation memory and current game events, and xVASynth, Piper or XTTS speaks it in the character's game voice with lip-sync.
works.method_zh: 用 Whisper 或 Moonshine 转写语音，由云端或本地大语言模型根据每个 NPC 的人物小传、对话记忆与当前游戏事件生成回复，再用 xVASynth、Piper 或 XTTS 以角色原有的游戏嗓音说出并口型同步。
works.title_zh: Mantella（《上古卷轴 V》AI NPC 模组）

works.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians
works.description: Dynamic 3D Gaussians reconstructs multi-camera recordings of people juggling or playing sports as Gaussians that move over time, so every point is tracked through the sequence as it is rendered from new views.
works.description_zh: Dynamic 3D Gaussians 把多相机录制的人物抛接、运动等片段重建为随时间移动的高斯，在从新视角渲染的同时，每个点在整段序列中都被追踪。
works.idea_en: Tracking comes for free with the reconstruction, so captured motion can drive or be compared with other content.
works.idea_zh: 追踪随重建一起得到，因此捕捉到的运动可以用来驱动其他内容或与之比较。
works.method: Gaussians keep fixed colour, size and opacity and only move and rotate per timestep, regularised by local rigidity, rotation-similarity and isometry losses.
works.method_zh: 高斯保持颜色、尺寸与不透明度不变，只在每个时间步移动和旋转，并用局部刚性、旋转相似性与等距约束进行正则。

paper.title: Dynamic 3D Gaussians: Tracking by Persistent Dynamic View Synthesis

works.title_zh: 动态 3D 高斯

works.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting
works.description: 3D Gaussian Splatting represents a captured scene as millions of small coloured, semi-transparent 3D Gaussians that are rasterised rather than ray-marched, giving photoreal novel views at real-time frame rates.
works.description_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅把拍摄的场景表示为数以百万计的彩色半透明三维高斯，用光栅化而不是光线步进来渲染，以实时帧率得到照片级的新视角。
works.idea_en: Made photoreal captured places fast enough for headsets, and its explicit primitives can be edited, streamed, and later animated in time.
works.idea_zh: 让照片级的捕捉场景快到足以在头显中使用，而且它的显式基元可以被编辑、流式传输，之后还能随时间运动。
works.method: Gaussians are initialised from structure-from-motion points and optimised with adaptive densification through a differentiable tile-based rasteriser.
works.method_zh: 高斯从运动恢复结构得到的点云初始化，通过基于图块的可微光栅化器优化，并自适应地增删高斯。
works.specs: ≥30 fps at 1080p · per-scene training in tens of minutes (paper)

paper.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering

works.title_zh: 3D 高斯泼溅

works.title: Virtual Reality for Criminologists: A Road Map
works.description: Essay in Crime and Justice that reviews VR studies in criminogenic contexts and related fields, explains the technology's features, limits and ethical challenges, and argues that VR may become 'the criminological equivalent of the petri dish'.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Crime and Justice 的长文，回顾犯罪相关情境中的 VR 研究及相关领域成果，阐述这项技术的特点、局限与伦理挑战，并认为 VR 可能成为“犯罪学的培养皿”。
works.idea_en: Criminology's case for VR rests on observing behavior in situations that are illegal or unsafe to create, the class of situation generative tools could make cheaper to vary.
works.idea_zh: 犯罪学之所以需要 VR，是因为它能在违法或不安全、无法真实创设的情境中观察行为——而生成工具恰好能让这类情境的变化成本更低。
works.method: Review and research agenda covering ecological validity, theory testing, ethics and practical design choices for VR criminology.
works.method_zh: 综述与研究议程，涵盖 VR 犯罪学的生态效度、理论检验、伦理与实际设计选择。

paper.title: Virtual Reality for Criminologists: A Road Map

works.title_zh: 写给犯罪学家的虚拟现实：一份路线图

works.title: Objaverse-XL
works.description: An open dataset of more than 10 million deduplicated 3D objects (hand-modeled objects, photogrammetry scans and professional scans of historic artifacts) gathered from public sources by the Allen Institute for AI. It is a main pretraining corpus for image-to-3D and multi-view diffusion models; the paper trains Zero123-XL on more than 100 million renders from it.
works.description_zh: 艾伦人工智能研究所从公开来源收集的开放数据集，包含 1,000 多万个去重的三维物体（手工建模物体、摄影测量扫描以及历史文物的专业扫描）。它是图生三维与多视角扩散模型的主要预训练语料之一；论文用其中超过 1 亿张渲染图训练了 Zero123-XL。
works.idea_en: The asset generators that furnish generated worlds learned their sense of objects largely from this corpus, including its biases and uneven licenses.
works.idea_zh: 为生成世界提供道具的资产生成器，对物体的理解很大程度上来自这一语料，也继承了它的偏差与参差不齐的授权。
works.method: Crawling and deduplicating public 3D repositories, with metadata and rendering scripts; licenses vary per object.
works.method_zh: 爬取并去重公开三维资源库，附带元数据与渲染脚本；每个物体的授权各不相同。

paper.title: Objaverse-XL: A Universe of 10M+ 3D Objects

works.title: AnimateDiff
works.description: AnimateDiff (CUHK, Shanghai AI Lab and Stanford, 2023-07; ICLR 2024 spotlight) adds a plug-in motion module to Stable Diffusion so that any community fine-tuned image model can generate short animations in its own style, with MotionLoRA for camera moves; it became a staple of open video tooling in ComfyUI.
works.description_zh: AnimateDiff（香港中文大学、上海人工智能实验室与斯坦福，2023 年 7 月；ICLR 2024 spotlight）为 Stable Diffusion 增加一个即插即用的运动模块，让任何社区微调的图像模型都能以自身画风生成短动画，并用 MotionLoRA 控制镜头运动；它成为 ComfyUI 开源视频工具链的常用组件。
works.idea_en: Separating motion from appearance let any image style move, an early sign that open communities would build their own video tools.
works.idea_zh: 把运动与外观分开，让任何图像画风都能动起来，这是开源社区自建视频工具的早期信号。
works.method: A temporal motion module trained on video and inserted into a frozen text-to-image U-Net; MotionLoRA adapts it to new motion patterns with little data.
works.method_zh: 在视频上训练时间运动模块，并插入冻结的文生图 U-Net；MotionLoRA 只需少量数据即可适配新的运动模式。

paper.title: AnimateDiff: Animate Your Personalized Text-to-Image Diffusion Models without Specific Tuning

works.title_zh: AnimateDiff：无需专门调优即可让个性化文生图模型动起来

works.title: MVDiffusion
works.description: Generates a seamless 360° panorama from text by producing eight overlapping perspective views at once that agree with each other; the same idea also textures a scanned room mesh consistently.
works.description_zh: 通过一次性生成八张相互重叠且彼此一致的透视视图，根据文字合成无缝的 360° 全景图；同样的思路也能一致地为扫描的房间网格上色。
works.idea_en: Treating a panorama as many views that must agree, rather than one wide image, removes seams and drift at the wrap-around edge.
works.idea_zh: 把全景图视为多个必须彼此一致的视角，而不是一张宽幅图像，从而消除了接缝和首尾相接处的漂移。
works.method: Correspondence-aware attention layers inserted into a pretrained Stable Diffusion model share features between pixel-correspondent locations of the views, which are denoised in parallel.
works.method_zh: 在预训练的 Stable Diffusion 中插入对应关系感知的注意力层，使各视图中像素对应的位置共享特征，所有视图并行去噪。

paper.title: MVDiffusion: Enabling Holistic Multi-view Image Generation with Correspondence-Aware Diffusion

works.title: GAIA-1
works.description: Wayve's first generative world model for driving: prompted with a few seconds of real driving video, text or ego-vehicle actions, it rolls out minutes of plausible driving video, imagines several futures from the same start and can be forced into behaviour absent from its training data, such as steering onto the pavement.
works.description_zh: Wayve 的第一个驾驶生成式世界模型：以几秒真实驾驶视频、文字或自车动作为提示，生成数分钟合理的驾驶视频，能从同一起点设想多种未来，也能被强制做出训练数据中没有的行为，比如驶上人行道。
works.idea_en: Showed early that a world model can stage dangerous counterfactual moments that cannot be filmed safely, the core of situational reach.
works.idea_zh: 较早证明世界模型可以演出无法安全拍摄的危险反事实时刻，这正是“情境可达性”的核心。
works.method: Video, text and action inputs mapped to discrete tokens and modelled as next-token prediction by an autoregressive transformer, with a video diffusion decoder turning predicted tokens back into frames.
works.method_zh: 把视频、文字与动作输入映射为离散 token，用自回归 Transformer 做下一个 token 预测，再由视频扩散解码器把预测的 token 还原为画面。

paper.title: GAIA-1: A Generative World Model for Autonomous Driving

works.title: Volcano Engine Ark / BytePlus ModelArk
works.description: ByteDance's model-as-a-service platform (Volcano Engine Ark in China, BytePlus ModelArk internationally) serves the Doubao language models and the Seedance video models through an API. BytePlus added first- and last-frame control for Seedance 1.0 Pro on ModelArk in 2025 and lists Seedance 2.0 and 2.5 in 2026.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动的模型即服务平台（国内为火山方舟，海外为 BytePlus ModelArk）通过 API 提供豆包大语言模型与 Seedance 视频模型。2025 年 BytePlus 在 ModelArk 上为 Seedance 1.0 Pro 加入首尾帧控制，2026 年又上架 Seedance 2.0 与 2.5。
works.idea_en: The official route to ByteDance's Seedance models, with enterprise terms that matter when a study needs a stable endpoint it can contract for.
works.idea_zh: 调用字节跳动 Seedance 模型的官方途径；当研究需要一个可签约、稳定的接口时，企业级条款很关键。
works.method: Managed inference endpoints with REST APIs, model versions and quotas; video jobs run asynchronously and return hosted MP4 files.
works.method_zh: 托管推理接口，提供 REST API、模型版本与配额管理；视频任务异步执行，返回托管的 MP4 文件。
works.specs: launched 2023-06-28 (China) · Seedance 1.0 Pro first/last-frame control (2025) · Seedance 2.0 / 2.5 (2026)
works.title_zh: 火山方舟 / BytePlus ModelArk

works.title: MotionGPT
works.description: Treats human motion as a foreign language: motion is tokenized and a language model is trained on mixed text and motion tokens, so one model can generate motion from text, caption motion, and predict or in-between motion.
works.description_zh: 把人体动作当作一门外语：先把动作分词，再让语言模型在文字与动作混合的词元上训练，于是一个模型就能由文字生成动作、为动作写描述，以及预测或补间动作。
works.idea_en: Puts body motion into the same token stream as language, the step that lets later conversational agents speak and move from one model.
works.idea_zh: 让身体动作和语言处在同一个词元序列中，后来的对话智能体由此可以用一个模型同时说话和动作。
works.method: A VQ-VAE motion tokenizer plus a T5 language model pre-trained on a motion–language corpus and instruction-tuned on prompt-based motion tasks.
works.method_zh: VQ-VAE 动作分词器，加上在动作—语言语料上预训练、并在基于提示的动作任务上做指令微调的 T5 语言模型。

paper.title: MotionGPT: Human Motion as a Foreign Language

works.title: Infinigen
works.description: An open-source procedural generator that creates unlimited photorealistic natural worlds, terrain, plants, animals, weather, entirely from code in Blender, with exact ground truth for depth, segmentation and geometry. Infinigen Indoors (CVPR 2024) extended it to furnished rooms, followed by articulated simulation-ready assets (2025) and the ProcFunc abstractions (2026).
works.description_zh: 开源的程序化生成器，完全在 Blender 中用代码创造无限多的照片级自然世界——地形、植物、动物和天气，并附带深度、分割和几何的精确真值。Infinigen Indoors（CVPR 2024）把它扩展到布置好的室内房间，随后又加入可铰接、可用于仿真的资产（2025）和 ProcFunc 抽象（2026）。
works.idea_en: Procedural generation gives what learned generators cannot: every parameter of a scene is known, seedable and reproducible.
works.idea_zh: 程序化生成能给出学习式生成器做不到的东西：场景的每个参数都已知、可设种子、可复现。
works.method: Every asset, from geometry to materials, is generated by randomised mathematical rules (no external assets), composed into scenes by constraint-based arrangement and rendered with Blender's path tracer.
works.method_zh: 从几何到材质，每个资产都由随机化的数学规则生成（不依赖外部资产），再通过基于约束的摆放组成场景，并用 Blender 路径追踪渲染。
works.specs: fully procedural · no external assets · ground-truth depth, normals, segmentation

paper.title: Infinite Photorealistic Worlds using Procedural Generation

works.title: MetaHuman Animator
works.description: MetaHuman Animator turns an actor's performance filmed on an iPhone or stereo head-mounted camera into high-fidelity facial animation on any MetaHuman within minutes; later versions add animation from a webcam or from audio alone, and Unreal Engine 5.8 (2026) adds markerless body capture of one actor from a single webcam or phone camera.
works.description_zh: MetaHuman Animator 能在几分钟内把用 iPhone 或立体头戴相机拍摄的演员表演，转换为任意 MetaHuman 上的高保真面部动画；后续版本支持仅用网络摄像头或仅用音频生成动画，Unreal Engine 5.8（2026）又加入了用单个网络摄像头或手机摄像头对单名演员做无标记身体捕捉的功能。
works.idea_en: Performance capture for everyone, the authored-but-recorded route to believable virtual-human behaviour.
works.idea_zh: 人人可用的表演捕捉，一条“人工制作但基于真实录制”的可信虚拟人行为路线。
works.method: A 4D solver fits a person-specific MetaHuman identity from a few frames, then tracks the captured video and depth to transfer the performance onto the standard facial rig.
works.method_zh: 4D 求解器先用少量帧拟合出该演员的 MetaHuman 身份，再追踪采集的视频与深度，把表演迁移到标准面部绑定上。

works.title: Meta Quest 3 / Quest 3S
works.description: Meta's standalone mixed-reality headsets: Quest 3 (announced 2023-06-01, launched 2023-10-10 at $499) and the cheaper Quest 3S (2024-09-25, from $299.99), both on Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with color passthrough. They are widely used in VR research labs, and Horizon OS gives apps passthrough-camera access for AI and runs Meta's Hyperscape photoreal captures.
works.description_zh: Meta 的一体式混合现实头显：Quest 3（2023-06-01 发布，2023-10-10 上市，售价 499 美元）与更便宜的 Quest 3S（2024-09-25，起价 299.99 美元），均采用骁龙 XR2 Gen 2 与彩色透视。它们在 VR 研究实验室中使用广泛；Horizon OS 允许应用访问透视摄像头以运行 AI，并支持 Meta 的 Hyperscape 照片级场景采集。
works.idea_en: The default delivery device for VR studies: cheap enough to deploy in numbers, with camera access that lets generated content respond to the participant's real room.
works.idea_zh: VR 研究默认的交付设备：价格低到可以批量部署，摄像头访问又能让生成内容回应被试所在的真实房间。
works.method: Snapdragon XR2 Gen 2 with inside-out tracking, hand tracking and color passthrough; pancake lenses and a depth sensor on Quest 3, Fresnel lenses on Quest 3S.
works.method_zh: 骁龙 XR2 Gen 2，具备由内向外追踪、手势追踪与彩色透视；Quest 3 采用 pancake 透镜并配有深度传感器，Quest 3S 采用菲涅耳透镜。
works.specs: Quest 3: 2064×2208 per eye, $499 at launch · Quest 3S: 1832×1920 per eye, from $299.99

works.title: NVIDIA ACE for Games: Kairos demo
works.description: In a ray-traced Unreal Engine 5 ramen shop, the player speaks to Jin, the owner, and he answers in voice with lip-synced facial animation, staying within his backstory. Shown in the Computex 2023 keynote.
works.description_zh: 在光线追踪的 Unreal Engine 5 拉面店里，玩家开口与店主 Jin 交谈，他用语音回答并带有口型同步的面部动画，且始终符合自己的背景设定。在 Computex 2023 主题演讲中展示。
works.idea_en: The demo that set the template for voice-in, voice-and-face-out game characters: speech recognition, an LLM with a persona, speech synthesis and audio-driven facial animation in one loop.
works.idea_zh: 确立了“语音输入、语音加面部输出”游戏角色模板的演示：语音识别、带人设的大语言模型、语音合成与音频驱动面部动画串成一个循环。
works.method: Convai's character platform runs on NVIDIA ACE modules: Riva speech recognition and synthesis, a NeMo language model given Jin's backstory with guardrails, and Audio2Face generating facial animation from the synthesized voice.
works.method_zh: Convai 的角色平台基于英伟达 ACE 模块运行：Riva 语音识别与合成、注入 Jin 背景故事并带护栏的 NeMo 语言模型，以及根据合成语音生成面部动画的 Audio2Face。
works.title_zh: NVIDIA ACE 游戏演示：Kairos

works.title: Voyager
works.description: A GPT-4 agent that plays Minecraft without human input: it proposes its own next goals, writes JavaScript to reach them, and saves working code as reusable skills, going from punching trees to mining diamonds.
works.description_zh: 一个无需人工干预、自己玩 Minecraft 的 GPT-4 智能体：它自行提出下一个目标，编写 JavaScript 代码去完成，并把有效代码存为可复用技能，从徒手砍树一路做到挖出钻石。
works.idea_en: An agent that stores what it learns as code can keep growing in an open world, a pattern later NPC and world-agent systems reuse.
works.idea_zh: 把学到的东西存成代码的智能体，能在开放世界里持续成长；后来的 NPC 与世界智能体系统也沿用了这一模式。
works.method: An automatic curriculum, an iterative prompting loop with environment feedback, execution errors and self-verification, and a vector-indexed skill library drive GPT-4 through the Mineflayer API; the authors report 3.3x more unique items and up to 15.3x faster tech-tree progress than prior methods.
works.method_zh: 由自动课程、结合环境反馈与执行报错和自我验证的迭代提示循环，以及向量索引的技能库，通过 Mineflayer API 驱动 GPT-4；作者报告获取的独特物品数为此前方法的 3.3 倍，科技树进度最快提升 15.3 倍。

paper.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models

works.title: LayoutGPT
works.description: Shows that a text-only language model, prompted with CSS-style examples, can write numeric layouts: bounding boxes for images and object positions and sizes for 3D indoor rooms.
works.description_zh: 表明只懂文字的语言模型，在类似 CSS 的示例提示下，就能写出带数值的布局：为图像给出包围框，为三维室内房间给出物体的位置与尺寸。
works.idea_en: Layout written as text is the most controllable layer of a generated scene: it can be read, edited and diffed before anything is rendered.
works.idea_zh: 以文字写成的布局是生成场景中最可控的一层：在渲染之前就能阅读、编辑和比对。
works.method: In-context learning with retrieved exemplars in a CSS-like format lets GPT-3.5/4 output layouts, which condition a layout-to-image model or place furniture in 3D-FRONT rooms.
works.method_zh: 用检索到的示例，以类似 CSS 的格式进行上下文学习，让 GPT-3.5/4 输出布局，再用于驱动布局到图像的模型，或在 3D-FRONT 房间中摆放家具。
