paper.title: LayoutGPT: Compositional Visual Planning and Generation with Large Language Models

works.title: Shap-E (and Point-E)
works.description: OpenAI's open text- and image-to-3D models: Point-E (December 2022) generated coloured point clouds in one to two minutes on a single GPU, and Shap-E (May 2023) generated implicit functions that render as textured meshes or neural radiance fields in seconds.
works.description_zh: OpenAI 开源的文生 / 图生三维模型：Point-E（2022 年 12 月）可在单张 GPU 上用一到两分钟生成彩色点云，Shap-E（2023 年 5 月）生成隐式函数，几秒内即可渲染为带纹理的网格或神经辐射场。
works.idea_en: The first widely used feed-forward text-to-3D models: fast and open but rough, the baseline that later native 3D generators were measured against.
works.idea_zh: 最早被广泛使用的前馈式文生三维模型：快速、开源但粗糙，是后来原生三维生成模型的比较基线。
works.method: Shap-E trains an encoder that maps 3D assets to the parameters of an implicit function (usable as a mesh or NeRF), then a conditional diffusion model over those parameters; Point-E chains a text-to-image model with an image-to-point-cloud diffusion model.
works.method_zh: Shap-E 先训练一个编码器，把三维资产映射为隐式函数的参数（可作为网格或 NeRF 渲染），再在这些参数上训练条件扩散模型；Point-E 则把文生图模型与图像到点云的扩散模型串联起来。

paper.title: Shap-E: Generating Conditional 3D Implicit Functions

works.title_zh: Shap-E（及 Point-E）

works.title: Generative Agents (Smallville)
works.description: Twenty-five LLM-driven characters live in Smallville, a pixel-art town: they wake, work, gossip, form opinions and remember each other. Seeded with one agent's wish to host a Valentine's Day party, the others spread invitations, ask each other on dates and show up at the right time.
works.description_zh: 25 个由大语言模型驱动的角色生活在像素风小镇 Smallville：起床、工作、闲聊、形成看法，并记得彼此。研究者只给一个角色设定“想办情人节派对”的念头，其他角色便自发传播邀请、互相约会，并在约定时间到场。
works.idea_en: Memory, reflection and planning on top of an LLM are enough to make a small society that coordinates over days without a script.
works.idea_zh: 在大语言模型之上加入记忆、反思与计划，就足以让一个小社会在没有脚本的情况下跨越数天彼此协调。
works.method: Each agent keeps a natural-language memory stream; retrieval by recency, importance and relevance feeds GPT-3.5 prompts that write reflections and hierarchical day plans, which a sandbox game engine turns into movement and dialogue; believability was rated by human evaluators against ablations.
works.method_zh: 每个智能体保存一条自然语言记忆流；按时间近度、重要性与相关性检索记忆，输入 GPT-3.5 生成反思与分层的日程计划，再由沙盒游戏引擎转化为移动与对话；可信度由人类评估者与消融版本对比打分。

paper.title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior

works.title_zh: 生成式智能体（Smallville 小镇）

works.title: Text2Room
works.description: From a text prompt, Text2Room builds a complete, textured 3D room mesh that can be walked around, by painting the room view by view with an image model.
works.description_zh: Text2Room 根据一句文字搭建出完整的、带纹理的三维房间网格，可以在其中走动：方法是用图像模型逐个视角“画”出整个房间。
works.idea_en: It was an early proof that a 2D image model plus depth can furnish an entire enterable room.
works.idea_zh: 它是早期的证明：二维图像模型加上深度估计，就能布置出一个可以走进去的完整房间。
works.method: Iterative text-conditioned inpainting along a chosen camera trajectory, with monocular depth estimation and depth alignment, fuses each new view into a single mesh; a second pass fills holes from additional viewpoints.
works.method_zh: 沿选定的镜头轨迹进行以文字为条件的迭代补全，结合单目深度估计与深度对齐，把每个新视角融合进同一个网格；第二轮再从更多视角补洞。

paper.title: Text2Room: Extracting Textured 3D Meshes from 2D Text-to-Image Models

works.title_zh: Text2Room：用文生图模型生成带纹理的房间网格

works.title: Gen-2
works.description: Runway's Gen-2 (2023-03-20) was the first commercially available text-to-video model, turning a prompt or an image into four-second clips inside a web editor used by filmmakers.
works.description_zh: Runway 的 Gen-2（2023-03-20）是首个商用文生视频模型，可在面向影视创作者的网页编辑器中把一句提示或一张图变成 4 秒短片。
works.idea_en: Put prompt-to-clip generation in the hands of non-engineers two years before it became photorealistic.
works.idea_zh: 在视频生成达到照片级真实之前两年，就把“用提示生成片段”交到了非工程师手中。
works.method: Latent video diffusion that extends Runway's Gen-1 structure-and-content model with text and image conditioning.
works.method_zh: 潜空间视频扩散模型，在 Runway Gen-1（结构与内容引导）的基础上加入文本和图像条件。

works.title: Zero-1-to-3
works.description: Fine-tunes Stable Diffusion to render an object from a new viewpoint given one photo and a relative camera rotation; the generated views can then be lifted into a 3D model with score distillation.
works.description_zh: 微调 Stable Diffusion，使其根据一张照片和相对相机旋转，生成同一物体在新视角下的图像；这些视图再通过分数蒸馏提升为三维模型。
works.idea_en: Turned a 2D image model into a viewpoint-controllable object renderer, which made a single photo the default input for 3D asset generation.
works.idea_zh: 把二维图像模型变成可控视角的物体渲染器，从此一张照片成为三维资产生成的默认输入。
works.method: A latent diffusion model conditioned on the input image and the relative camera pose, fine-tuned on renderings of Objaverse objects; 3D reconstruction by score distillation into a neural field.
works.method_zh: 以输入图像和相对相机位姿为条件的潜扩散模型，在 Objaverse 物体渲染图上微调；再用分数蒸馏把结果重建为神经场。

paper.title: Zero-1-to-3: Zero-shot One Image to 3D Object

works.title: SceneScape
works.description: SceneScape turns a text prompt and a camera path into a long walk-through video of an imagined place (a cave, a haunted house, a medieval forge) by building one textured mesh as it goes, so surfaces seen earlier stay consistent; NeurIPS 2023, open code.
works.description_zh: SceneScape 由一句文字和一条镜头路径生成穿行于想象场所（洞穴、鬼屋、中世纪铁匠铺）的长视频，边走边构建同一个带纹理的网格，使先前看到的表面保持一致；NeurIPS 2023，代码开源。
works.idea_en: Keeping an explicit mesh while painting new views with an image model was one of the first ways to make an endless generated walk remember where it had been.
works.idea_zh: 一边用图像模型绘制新视角、一边维护显式网格，是让无限生成的漫游“记得走过哪里”的最早做法之一。
works.method: Each new frame is rendered from a unified mesh, its missing regions are filled by a pre-trained text-to-image inpainting model, a monocular depth model fine-tuned at test time for consistency lifts the new content, and it is fused back into the mesh.
works.method_zh: 每一帧先从统一网格渲染，缺失区域由预训练的文生图补全模型填充，再用测试时微调以保持一致的单目深度模型把新内容提升到三维，并融合回网格。

paper.title: SceneScape: Text-Driven Consistent Scene Generation

works.title_zh: SceneScape：文本驱动的一致场景生成

works.title: MAV3D (Make-A-Video3D)
works.description: Meta's MAV3D generated short dynamic 3D scenes, such as an animated corgi viewable from any angle, from a text prompt alone, by distilling a text-to-video model.
works.description_zh: Meta 的 MAV3D 仅凭文字提示就能生成短小的动态三维场景（例如可从任意角度观看的动画柯基），方法是蒸馏一个文生视频模型。
works.idea_en: The first text-to-4D system; it set the template of borrowing motion from video models.
works.idea_zh: 第一个文本到 4D 系统，确立了“从视频模型借用运动”的范式。
works.method: A HexPlane dynamic NeRF is optimised with score distillation from Make-A-Video, using a static-to-dynamic schedule and super-resolution fine-tuning.
works.method_zh: 用 Make-A-Video 的分数蒸馏优化一个 HexPlane 动态 NeRF，采用由静态到动态的训练日程并进行超分辨率微调。

paper.title: Text-To-4D Dynamic Scene Generation

works.title_zh: MAV3D 文本生成 4D 动态场景

works.title: Automated virtual reality therapy to treat agoraphobic avoidance and distress in patients with psychosis (gameChange): a multicentre, parallel-group, single-blind, randomised, controlled trial in England with mediation and moderation analyses
works.description: Multicentre randomized trial across nine NHS trusts of gameChange, automated VR therapy in which a virtual coach guides people with psychosis through everyday situations they avoid, such as a café, a bus or a shop, at graded difficulty; it reduced avoidance and distress, most clearly for people with severe agoraphobia.
works.description_zh: 在英格兰九个 NHS 机构开展的多中心随机试验：自动化 VR 疗法 gameChange 由一位虚拟教练引导精神病患者，按难度分级进入他们回避的日常情境（如咖啡馆、公交车、商店）；疗法减少了回避与痛苦，对重度广场恐惧者效果最明显。
works.idea_en: Therapy can run without a therapist in the room once the situation and the coach are automated; this trial standard is what generated therapies will have to match.
works.idea_zh: 当情境与教练都实现自动化后，治疗无需治疗师在场即可进行；这一试验标准正是生成式疗法需要达到的。
works.method: Single-blind RCT (gameChange plus usual care vs. usual care alone) with graded VR exposure led by a pre-recorded virtual coach, plus mediation and moderation analyses.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验（gameChange 加常规护理 vs. 仅常规护理），由预先录制的虚拟教练引导分级 VR 暴露，并进行中介与调节分析。

paper.title: Automated virtual reality therapy to treat agoraphobic avoidance and distress in patients with psychosis (gameChange): a multicentre, parallel-group, single-blind, randomised, controlled trial in England with mediation and moderation analyses

works.title_zh: gameChange：用自动化虚拟现实疗法治疗精神病患者的广场回避与痛苦（多中心随机对照试验）

works.title: Imagen Video
works.description: Google Research's Imagen Video (2022-10-05) generated 5.3-second clips at 1280×768 and 24 fps from text, the highest-fidelity text-to-video results of its time; it was never released.
works.description_zh: Google Research 的 Imagen Video（2022-10-05）可从文字生成 5.3 秒、1280×768、24 fps 的片段，是当时保真度最高的文生视频结果，但从未公开发布。
works.idea_en: Cascaded diffusion showed high resolution was reachable, at the cost of chaining seven models.
works.idea_zh: 级联扩散证明了高分辨率可以实现，代价是串联七个模型。
works.method: Cascade of seven video diffusion models (a base model plus three spatial and three temporal super-resolution stages) conditioned on a T5-XXL text encoder.
works.method_zh: 由七个视频扩散模型组成的级联（基础模型加 3 个空间超分和 3 个时间超分阶段），以 T5-XXL 文本编码为条件。

paper.title: Imagen Video: High Definition Video Generation with Diffusion Models

works.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives (Instant NeRF)
works.description: NVIDIA's instant-ngp trains a NeRF from a handful of photos in seconds to minutes and lets you fly through the result in an interactive viewer while it is still training.
works.description_zh: NVIDIA 的 instant-ngp 能在几秒到几分钟内用少量照片训练出 NeRF，并允许在训练过程中就用交互式查看器在结果里穿行。
works.idea_en: Made capturing a radiance field feel like taking a photo rather than running a batch job.
works.idea_zh: 让捕捉辐射场的体验更像拍照，而不像跑一个批处理任务。
works.method: A multiresolution hash table of trainable feature vectors replaces most of the MLP, and fully fused CUDA kernels train and render on one GPU.
works.method_zh: 用多分辨率哈希表存储可训练特征向量，替代了大部分多层感知机，并通过完全融合的 CUDA 内核在单张 GPU 上训练与渲染。
works.specs: NeRF training in seconds; 1920×1080 rendering in tens of milliseconds (paper)

paper.title: Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding

works.title_zh: Instant NGP 即时神经图形基元

works.title: Luma 3D Capture
works.description: Luma's phone app guided people through filming an object or place and returned a NeRF, later a Gaussian-splat 'interactive scene' that could be embedded on the web or exported to game engines.
works.description_zh: Luma 的手机应用引导用户拍摄物体或地点，并返回 NeRF 结果，后来改为可嵌入网页或导出到游戏引擎的高斯泼溅“交互场景”。
works.idea_en: Brought radiance-field capture to ordinary phones before most people had heard of NeRF.
works.idea_zh: 在大多数人听说 NeRF 之前，就把辐射场捕捉带到了普通手机上。
works.method: A guided capture UI collects video around the subject; cloud reconstruction trains a NeRF or 3D Gaussian scene with meshes and exports for Unreal and other tools.
works.method_zh: 引导式拍摄界面采集围绕主体的视频，由云端重建训练 NeRF 或三维高斯场景，并提供网格与 Unreal 等工具的导出。
works.title_zh: Luma 三维捕捉

works.title: Make-A-Video
works.description: Meta AI's Make-A-Video (2022-09-29) was one of the first text-to-video systems, producing short, low-resolution clips such as a teddy bear painting a portrait, learned without paired text-video data.
works.description_zh: Meta AI 的 Make-A-Video（2022-09-29）是最早的文生视频系统之一，可生成低分辨率短片（如泰迪熊画肖像），且不需要成对的文本-视频数据。
works.idea_en: Showed that motion can be learned from unlabeled video and appearance from captioned images, a recipe many later models reused.
works.idea_zh: 证明可以从无标注视频中学习运动、从带字幕的图像中学习外观，这一配方被后来许多模型沿用。
works.method: Extends a text-to-image diffusion model with spatiotemporal convolution and attention layers, frame interpolation and super-resolution.
works.method_zh: 在文生图扩散模型上加入时空卷积与注意力层，并配合插帧与超分辨率。

paper.title: Make-A-Video: Text-to-Video Generation without Text-Video Data

works.title: Mip-NeRF 360
works.description: Mip-NeRF 360 extends anti-aliased NeRF to unbounded real scenes captured by walking around an object, with a nine-scene dataset that became the standard test for splatting methods.
works.description_zh: Mip-NeRF 360 把抗锯齿 NeRF 扩展到绕物体一周拍摄的无界真实场景，并发布了一个九场景数据集，后来成为高斯泼溅方法的标准测试。
works.idea_en: Defined what a full walk-around capture of a real place should look like, including the far background.
works.idea_zh: 定义了一次完整绕行拍摄的真实场景应达到的效果，包括远处背景。
works.method: A non-linear scene contraction maps unbounded space into a bounded ball, an online proposal network distils density for sampling, and a distortion regulariser suppresses floaters.
works.method_zh: 非线性场景收缩把无界空间映射进有界球体，在线提议网络蒸馏密度以指导采样，畸变正则项抑制漂浮伪影。

paper.title: Mip-NeRF 360: Unbounded Anti-Aliased Neural Radiance Fields

works.title: Nerfstudio
works.description: Nerfstudio is an open-source framework and web viewer for training and comparing radiance fields and Gaussian splats (via gsplat) from your own captures.
works.description_zh: Nerfstudio 是一个开源框架与网页查看器，可用自己的捕捉数据训练并比较辐射场与高斯泼溅（通过 gsplat）。
works.idea_en: A shared, versioned codebase makes reconstruction choices reportable and repeatable across labs.
works.idea_zh: 共享、有版本的代码库，让重建中的各种选择可以在不同实验室之间被报告和复现。
works.method: Modular PyTorch components (data parsers, samplers, fields, renderers) with the Nerfacto and Splatfacto methods and a browser viewer.
works.method_zh: 模块化的 PyTorch 组件（数据解析、采样器、场、渲染器），内置 Nerfacto 与 Splatfacto 方法和浏览器查看器。

paper.title: Nerfstudio: A Modular Framework for Neural Radiance Field Development

works.title: Phenaki
works.description: Phenaki (Google, 2022-10-05) generated videos of variable length, up to minutes, from a sequence of prompts that change over time, for example a story told shot by shot.
works.description_zh: Phenaki（Google，2022-10-05）可根据随时间变化的一串提示生成可变长度、最长数分钟的视频，例如逐镜讲述一个故事。
works.idea_en: The first sketch of a story-driven, prompt-switching video stream, an idea later made interactive by real-time models such as LongLive.
works.idea_zh: 首次勾勒出由故事驱动、可切换提示的视频流，这一想法后来被 LongLive 等实时模型做成了交互式。
works.method: C-ViViT tokenizer that compresses video into discrete tokens, plus a bidirectional masked transformer conditioned on text that generates autoregressively in time.
works.method_zh: 用 C-ViViT 把视频压缩为离散 token，再由以文本为条件的双向掩码 Transformer 在时间维度上自回归生成。

paper.title: Phenaki: Variable Length Video Generation From Open Domain Textual Description

works.title: Text2Light
works.description: Generates high-resolution HDR 360° panoramas from a text description, usable both as an immersive backdrop and as physically based lighting for rendering 3D scenes.
works.description_zh: 根据文字描述生成高分辨率的 HDR 360° 全景图，既可作为沉浸式背景，也可作为三维场景渲染时基于物理的光照。
works.idea_en: A generated environment can also light the scene, so virtual people and objects look as if they belong in it.
works.idea_zh: 生成的环境还能为场景提供光照，让虚拟人物和物体看起来真的身处其中。
works.method: Zero-shot two-stage pipeline: a text-driven low-resolution LDR panorama is generated with CLIP guidance and hierarchical codebooks, then upscaled by a structure-aware super-resolution network and lifted to HDR.
works.method_zh: 零样本两阶段流程：先借助 CLIP 引导与分层码本生成文字驱动的低分辨率 LDR 全景图，再由结构感知的超分辨率网络放大并提升为 HDR。

paper.title: Text2Light: Zero-Shot Text-Driven HDR Panorama Generation

works.title: EDGE
works.description: Generates dance choreography from music with a diffusion model, with editing controls such as joint-wise constraints, in-betweening and continuation to arbitrary length.
works.description_zh: 用扩散模型由音乐生成舞蹈编排，并提供按关节约束、补间和任意长度续写等编辑控制。
works.idea_en: Audio-driven body generation with editable constraints: music (and by extension speech or sound) drives the body while chosen poses stay pinned.
works.idea_zh: 可加编辑约束的音频驱动身体生成：音乐（进而语音或声音）驱动身体，同时可以固定选定的姿态。
works.method: A transformer diffusion model conditioned on Jukebox music embeddings, with a contact-consistency loss for foot physics and a new Physical Foot Contact score; trained on AIST++.
works.method_zh: 以 Jukebox 音乐嵌入为条件的 Transformer 扩散模型，加入足部接触一致性损失并提出新的物理足部接触评分；在 AIST++ 上训练。

paper.title: EDGE: Editable Dance Generation From Music

works.title: DreamFusion
works.description: Text-to-3D method from Google Research that optimizes a NeRF from scratch using a frozen 2D text-to-image diffusion model (Imagen) as its only guide; a prompt yields a relightable 3D object after a long per-object optimization.
works.description_zh: 谷歌研究院的文生三维方法：以冻结的二维文生图扩散模型（Imagen）作为唯一指导，从零优化一个神经辐射场（NeRF）；输入一句提示词，经过较长的逐物体优化后得到可重新打光的三维物体。
works.idea_en: Showed that 3D objects can be pulled out of a 2D image model with no 3D training data, the starting point of the text-to-3D lineage, at the cost of a slow optimization per object.
works.idea_zh: 证明了无需任何三维训练数据就能从二维图像模型中“提取”出三维物体，是文生三维路线的起点，代价是每个物体都要缓慢优化。
works.method: Score Distillation Sampling: a randomly initialised NeRF is rendered from random viewpoints and updated with gradients from Imagen's denoising loss, with shading terms that encourage real geometry.
works.method_zh: 分数蒸馏采样（SDS）：从随机视角渲染随机初始化的 NeRF，用 Imagen 去噪损失的梯度更新它，并加入着色项以促使形成真实几何。

paper.title: DreamFusion: Text-to-3D using 2D Diffusion

works.title: MDM: Human Motion Diffusion Model
works.description: Diffusion model that generates human motion from text or action labels and supports editing such as in-betweening and body-part completion without retraining.
works.description_zh: 由文字或动作标签生成人体动作的扩散模型，无需重新训练即可完成补间、身体部位补全等编辑。
works.idea_en: Brought diffusion to motion and made it editable: keyframes or parts of the body can be fixed while the rest is generated, a basic form of experimental control over a generated body.
works.idea_zh: 把扩散模型带入动作生成并让其可编辑：可以固定关键帧或部分身体，其余部分由模型生成——这是对生成身体的一种基本实验控制。
works.method: A transformer-encoder diffusion model over pose sequences that predicts the clean sample instead of the noise, enabling geometric losses on foot contact and velocity; CLIP text conditioning; trained on HumanML3D and KIT-ML.
works.method_zh: 在姿态序列上运行的 Transformer 编码器扩散模型，直接预测干净样本而非噪声，从而可以加入足部接触和速度等几何损失；以 CLIP 编码文字条件；在 HumanML3D 和 KIT-ML 上训练。

paper.title: Human Motion Diffusion Model

works.title_zh: MDM：人体动作扩散模型

works.title: HumanML3D
works.description: Dataset of 14,616 human motion clips paired with 44,970 text descriptions (28.59 hours, drawn from AMASS and HumanAct12), released with a text-to-motion baseline; it is the standard benchmark for text-to-motion.
works.description_zh: 包含 14,616 段人体动作与 44,970 条文字描述的数据集（共 28.59 小时，来自 AMASS 和 HumanAct12），并附带一个文生动作基线模型；是文生动作的标准基准。
works.idea_en: Nearly every text-to-motion model since 2022 is trained and scored on it, so its coverage (everyday solo actions, little social interaction) shapes what generated bodies can do.
works.idea_zh: 2022 年以来几乎所有文生动作模型都在它上面训练和评测，因此它的覆盖范围（以日常单人动作为主，社交互动很少）决定了生成身体能做什么。
works.method: Crowd-sourced text annotations of AMASS and HumanAct12 motion clips, plus a temporal VAE that predicts motion length from text and then generates the motion.
works.method_zh: 对 AMASS 和 HumanAct12 动作片段进行众包文字标注，并提供一个先由文字预测动作长度、再生成动作的时序 VAE。

paper.title: Generating Diverse and Natural 3D Human Motions From Text

works.title: Video PreTraining (VPT)
works.description: A Minecraft agent that learned to play with the normal keyboard and mouse at 20 frames per second by watching about 70,000 hours of unlabeled YouTube gameplay; after fine-tuning it crafted diamond tools, a task that takes skilled humans about 20 minutes and some 24,000 actions.
works.description_zh: 一个 Minecraft 智能体：通过观看约 7 万小时无标注的 YouTube 游戏视频，学会以每秒 20 帧、用普通键盘鼠标玩游戏；微调后能制作钻石工具，这一任务熟练玩家约需 20 分钟、约 2.4 万次操作。
works.idea_en: Internet video can teach an agent to act once a small labeled set lets a model infer the missing actions, the recipe that NitroGen and later game agents scaled up.
works.idea_zh: 只要用少量标注数据训练模型去推断视频中缺失的操作，互联网视频就能教会智能体行动；NitroGen 等后来的游戏智能体正是放大了这一方法。
works.method: An inverse dynamics model trained on about 2,000 hours of contractor gameplay labels the actions in web videos; a large behavior-cloning policy is pretrained on the pseudo-labeled videos and fine-tuned with imitation and reinforcement learning.
works.method_zh: 先用约 2,000 小时外包玩家的游戏记录训练逆动力学模型，为网络视频标注操作；再在这些伪标注视频上预训练大型行为克隆策略，并通过模仿学习与强化学习微调。
works.specs: ~70,000 h of video · 20 Hz keyboard and mouse · diamond pickaxe after RL fine-tuning

paper.title: Video PreTraining (VPT): Learning to Act by Watching Unlabeled Online Videos

works.title_zh: 视频预训练（VPT）

works.title: MineDojo
works.description: A Minecraft research framework with thousands of open-ended, language-specified tasks in procedurally generated worlds, paired with an internet-scale knowledge base of YouTube videos, wiki pages and Reddit posts, and MineCLIP, a video-language model used as a reward for agents.
works.description_zh: 一个 Minecraft 研究框架：在程序化生成的世界中提供数千个以语言描述的开放式任务，并配套由 YouTube 视频、维基页面与 Reddit 帖子组成的互联网规模知识库，以及用作智能体奖励的视频-语言模型 MineCLIP。
works.idea_en: Turned one game and everything people post about it into a shared benchmark for open-ended agents; most later Minecraft agents were measured on it.
works.idea_zh: 把一款游戏以及人们发布的相关内容，变成开放式智能体共享的基准；此后的大多数 Minecraft 智能体都在它上面接受评测。
works.method: A simulator suite on MineRL with programmatic and creative tasks; MineCLIP is trained contrastively on time-aligned YouTube video and transcript pairs and scores how well an agent's recent frames match a text goal, which serves as a reward for reinforcement learning.
works.method_zh: 在 MineRL 之上构建的模拟器套件，包含程序化任务与创造性任务；MineCLIP 在时间对齐的 YouTube 视频与字幕对上做对比学习，评估智能体最近画面与文字目标的匹配程度，作为强化学习的奖励。
works.specs: 3,000+ tasks · 730,000+ YouTube videos · 7,000+ wiki pages · 340,000+ Reddit posts

paper.title: MineDojo: Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents with Internet-Scale Knowledge

works.title: Learning to Listen
works.description: Learning to Listen generates the facial reactions of a listener (nods, smiles, frowns) from the speaker's words, voice and face, producing several plausible listener responses for the same speaker turn.
works.description_zh: Learning to Listen 根据说话者的话语、声音和面部，生成倾听者的面部反应（点头、微笑、皱眉），并能为同一段发言生成多种合理的倾听反应。
works.idea_en: Treats listening as a generative, non-deterministic behaviour, the missing half of a conversational virtual human.
works.idea_zh: 把倾听当作一种非确定的、可生成的行为，补上了对话虚拟人缺失的另一半。
works.method: A VQ-VAE codebook of listener motion and a transformer that autoregressively predicts listener codes from multimodal speaker input, trained on in-the-wild dyadic interview video.
works.method_zh: 用 VQ-VAE 码本表示倾听者动作，再用 Transformer 根据说话者的多模态输入自回归地预测倾听者编码，训练数据为真实场景中的双人访谈视频。

paper.title: Learning to Listen: Modeling Non-Deterministic Dyadic Facial Motion

works.title_zh: 学会倾听：非确定性双人面部动作建模

works.title: Unreal Engine 5
works.description: Epic's real-time engine behind many high-fidelity VR studies and virtual-production stages, with Nanite geometry, Lumen lighting and MetaHuman digital humans. Unreal Engine 5.8 (2026-06-17) added MetaHuman Collections for crowds of hundreds, full-body markerless MetaHuman capture from a webcam, open-source OpenRigLogic (MIT) and an experimental MCP plugin that lets any LLM inspect and drive the editor.
works.description_zh: Epic 的实时引擎，许多高保真 VR 研究与虚拟制片舞台都用它，具备 Nanite 几何、Lumen 光照与 MetaHuman 数字人。Unreal Engine 5.8（2026-06-17）加入了可生成数百人群的 MetaHuman Collections、用网络摄像头即可完成的全身无标记 MetaHuman 动捕、以 MIT 许可开源的 OpenRigLogic，以及一个实验性 MCP 插件，让任意大语言模型都能查看并操控编辑器。
works.idea_en: Gives generated content a photoreal, deterministic runtime: the generative layer can sit in MetaHumans and scripts while the engine keeps timing and logging exact.
works.idea_zh: 为生成内容提供照片级、可确定复现的运行环境：生成层可以放在 MetaHuman 与脚本里，时序与日志则由引擎精确保证。
works.method: C++ engine with Blueprint visual scripting; Nanite virtualized geometry and Lumen global illumination render in real time, and MetaHuman tools rig and animate scanned or generated characters.
works.method_zh: C++ 引擎，配有 Blueprint 可视化脚本；Nanite 虚拟化几何与 Lumen 全局光照实时渲染，MetaHuman 工具为扫描或生成的角色绑定骨骼并驱动动画。
works.specs: UE 5.0 released 2022-04-05 · UE 5.8 released 2026-06-17 · free, 5% royalty above $1M gross for games

works.title: dGSLM (Generative Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling)
works.description: A textless model that generates two-channel spoken dialogue directly from audio, including overlapping speech, laughter and backchannels between two speakers. Given the start of a real conversation, it continues both sides as audio.
works.description_zh: 一个不依赖文本的模型，直接从音频生成双声道口语对话，包括两位说话人之间的重叠发言、笑声和附和语。给它一段真实对话的开头，它会以音频形式同时续写双方。
works.idea_en: Showed that turn-taking, overlap and 'mm-hm' can be learned from raw two-channel audio: the conceptual ancestor of full-duplex voice agents.
works.idea_zh: 证明了轮流说话、重叠发言和“嗯嗯”这类附和可以直接从双声道原始音频中学到，是全双工语音智能体在概念上的前身。
works.method: Discrete HuBERT units per speaker channel, modelled by a dual-tower Transformer with cross-attention and trained on about 2,000 hours of Fisher telephone conversations.
works.method_zh: 为每个说话人的声道提取离散 HuBERT 单元，用带交叉注意力的双塔 Transformer 建模，在约 2000 小时的 Fisher 电话对话上训练。

paper.title: Generative Spoken Dialogue Language Modeling

works.title_zh: dGSLM（生成式口语对话语言模型）

works.title: Neural 3D Video Synthesis (DyNeRF)
works.description: Meta Reality Labs' DyNeRF reconstructs short multi-camera recordings of people cooking, with flames and moving hands, as a radiance field you can replay from new viewpoints and at new moments.
works.description_zh: Meta Reality Labs 的 DyNeRF 把多相机录制的短视频（人在做饭，有火焰与移动的手）重建为辐射场，可以从新的视角、在新的时刻回放。
works.idea_en: Its multi-view kitchen recordings became the shared yardstick for every later 4D Gaussian method.
works.idea_zh: 它的多视角厨房录制成了此后所有 4D 高斯方法共用的衡量标准。
works.method: A NeRF conditioned on a compact learned latent code per frame is trained with hierarchical keyframe sampling and ray importance sampling over about 20 synchronised cameras.
works.method_zh: 以每帧一个紧凑可学习隐编码为条件的 NeRF，在约 20 台同步相机上用分层关键帧采样与光线重要性采样训练。

paper.title: Neural 3D Video Synthesis from Multi-view Video

works.title_zh: 神经三维视频合成（DyNeRF）

works.title: RelieVRx
works.description: Prescription home VR program for chronic low back pain that teaches pain-management skills such as breathing, relaxation and attention shifting through short daily sessions; it received FDA De Novo authorization in 2021. Two later FDA 510(k) clearances followed (December 2024, and August 2025 for the Pico G3 headset), and the product site is still live in October 2026.
works.description_zh: 用于慢性下背痛的处方型居家 VR 项目，通过每日简短课程教授呼吸、放松、注意力转移等疼痛管理技巧；2021 年获美国 FDA De Novo 授权。此后又获两次 FDA 510(k) 许可（2024 年 12 月；2025 年 8 月，适用于 Pico G3 头显），产品网站截至 2026 年 10 月仍在运行。
works.idea_en: Scripted VR became a regulated medical device; any generative or adaptive successor will have to clear the same evidence bar.
works.idea_zh: 脚本化 VR 已成为受监管的医疗器械；任何生成式或自适应的后继者都要跨过同样的证据门槛。
works.method: Pre-built modules grounded in cognitive behavioral therapy and mindfulness, delivered on a standalone headset at home and evaluated in randomized trials against sham VR.
works.method_zh: 基于认知行为疗法与正念的预制模块，在家中通过一体机头显交付，并在与假 VR 对照的随机试验中接受评估。

works.title: Replicate
works.description: Runs thousands of open and proprietary models behind one API, each addressed by a version id, and lets developers publish their own models packaged with the open-source Cog container format. Replicate announced on 2025-11-17 that it is joining Cloudflare; it keeps its brand and its API.
works.description_zh: 通过一个 API 运行数千个开源与闭源模型，每个模型都以版本 ID 调用；开发者也可以用开源的 Cog 容器格式打包并发布自己的模型。Replicate 于 2025-11-17 宣布并入 Cloudflare，品牌与 API 保持不变。
works.idea_en: Version ids per model make it one of the easier hosts on which to pin the exact generator a study used.
works.idea_zh: 每个模型都有版本 ID，在这里锁定研究所用的确切生成器相对容易。
works.method: Models packaged as Cog containers run on Replicate's GPU fleet; each prediction is an HTTP job addressed by a model version.
works.method_zh: 以 Cog 容器打包的模型运行在 Replicate 的 GPU 集群上；每次预测都是一个按模型版本寻址的 HTTP 任务。
works.specs: thousands of models · per-second GPU or per-output billing · joining Cloudflare (announced 2025-11-17)

works.title: Talespin CoPilot Designer
works.description: No-code tool for building VR soft-skills simulations with virtual humans, branching dialogue and feedback; by 2023 it had added generative AI for drafting content. Talespin's site now redirects to Cornerstone's immersive-learning platform, which advertises role play with AI-powered virtual humans.
works.description_zh: 无代码工具，用于搭建含虚拟人、分支对话与反馈的 VR 软技能模拟；到 2023 年已加入用于起草内容的生成式 AI。Talespin 官网现已跳转至 Cornerstone 的沉浸式学习平台，后者宣传与 AI 驱动的虚拟人进行角色扮演。
works.idea_en: Generative AI entered VR training first as an authoring aid, drafting branches that humans review, before it ran characters live.
works.idea_zh: 生成式 AI 最早以创作辅助的身份进入 VR 训练：先起草由人审阅的分支对话，之后才去实时驱动角色。
works.method: Flow editor for branching dialogue with animated virtual humans, extended with generative content tools, delivered on headsets and desktop.
works.method_zh: 基于流程编辑器编写分支对话并驱动动画虚拟人，后加入生成式内容工具，可在头显与桌面端交付。

works.title: The Cognitive Affective Model of Immersive Learning (CAMIL): a Theoretical Research-Based Model of Learning in Immersive Virtual Reality
works.description: Model that explains learning in immersive VR through two affordances, presence and agency, which act on learning through six affective and cognitive factors such as interest, self-efficacy, embodiment and cognitive load.
works.description_zh: 解释沉浸式 VR 学习的理论模型：临场感与能动性两种特性，通过兴趣、自我效能、具身化、认知负荷等六个情感与认知因素影响学习。
works.idea_en: More presence is not automatically more learning: a generated training scenario helps only when its realism and interactivity serve the learning goal instead of overloading the learner.
works.idea_zh: 临场感更强并不自动意味着学得更好：生成的训练情境只有当其真实感与交互性服务于学习目标、而非让学习者超载时才有帮助。
works.method: Theoretical synthesis by Makransky and Petersen of empirical work on immersive learning into a causal model with testable predictions.
works.method_zh: Makransky 与 Petersen 把沉浸式学习的实证研究整合为一个可检验的因果模型。

paper.title: The Cognitive Affective Model of Immersive Learning (CAMIL): a Theoretical Research-Based Model of Learning in Immersive Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: 沉浸式学习的认知情感模型（CAMIL）

works.title: XLand: Open-Ended Learning Agents
works.description: Agents trained in XLand, a procedurally generated universe of 3D worlds and multiplayer games, learn general behaviors such as experimenting, cooperating and using objects, and then play held-out games like hide-and-seek and capture the flag without further training.
works.description_zh: 在 XLand（一个由程序生成的三维世界与多人游戏构成的宇宙）中训练的智能体，学会了尝试、合作、利用物体等通用行为，随后无需再训练就能玩捉迷藏、夺旗等未见过的游戏。
works.idea_en: A precursor of SIMA and of agents in generated worlds: generality came from training across a generated space of situations rather than one handcrafted task.
works.idea_zh: SIMA 与“生成世界中的智能体”的先声：通用性来自在生成的情境空间中训练，而不是单一的人工任务。
works.method: Deep reinforcement learning with population-based training and a dynamic curriculum that generates worlds, goals and co-players matched to each agent's current ability, evaluated zero-shot on held-out tasks.
works.method_zh: 采用基于种群的深度强化学习，并以动态课程按每个智能体当前能力生成世界、目标与同伴，在留出的任务上进行零样本评估。

paper.title: Open-Ended Learning Leads to Generally Capable Agents

works.title_zh: XLand：开放式学习智能体

works.title: Project Starline
works.description: Google's Project Starline prototype is a booth in which two people talk across a light-field display that shows each other life-size and in 3D, captured and transmitted in real time.
works.description_zh: Google 的 Project Starline 原型是一个通话隔间：两个人隔着光场显示屏交谈，彼此以真人大小的三维形象出现，实时捕捉并传输。
works.idea_en: Eye contact and depth cues at life size, tested with users, make it a reference for what remote social presence can feel like.
works.idea_zh: 真人尺寸的眼神接触与深度线索，并经过用户测试，使它成为远程社交临场感的参照。
works.method: Several colour and depth cameras feed a real-time fusion and compression pipeline; a head-tracked autostereoscopic display renders the remote person with spatial audio.
works.method_zh: 多台彩色与深度相机接入实时融合与压缩流程，头部追踪的裸眼立体显示屏配合空间音频渲染远端的人。

paper.title: Project Starline: A high-fidelity telepresence system

works.title: MetaHuman Creator
works.description: MetaHuman Creator lets anyone design a realistic, fully rigged digital human in minutes by blending scanned faces and adjusting skin, hair and body, ready to animate in Unreal Engine; since Unreal Engine 5.6 (2025) it runs inside the engine and accepts mesh or scan input. MetaHuman 5.8 (June 2026) converts full-body meshes of any topology into MetaHumans, adds crowds of hundreds to thousands of real-time characters, and releases the RigLogic and DNA libraries as open source under MIT (OpenRigLogic).
works.description_zh: MetaHuman Creator 让任何人通过混合扫描人脸并调整皮肤、头发和体型，在几分钟内设计出逼真且完整绑定的数字人，可直接在 Unreal Engine 中驱动；自 Unreal Engine 5.6（2025）起，它在引擎内运行并接受网格或扫描输入。MetaHuman 5.8（2026 年 6 月）可把任意拓扑的全身网格转换为 MetaHuman，支持数百到数千个实时角色的人群，并以 MIT 协议开源 RigLogic 与 DNA 库（OpenRigLogic）。
works.idea_en: The non-generative baseline: authored, rigged, controllable humans whose every parameter can be logged, which generative avatars still struggle to match on control.
works.idea_zh: 非生成式的基线：人工制作、完整绑定、可控，每个参数都能记录；在可控性上，生成式虚拟人仍难以企及。
works.method: Parametric blending over a database of scanned faces and bodies (from 3Lateral and Cubic Motion), with a standard facial rig and LODs for real-time rendering.
works.method_zh: 在扫描人脸与身体数据库（来自 3Lateral 和 Cubic Motion）上做参数化混合，配有标准面部绑定和用于实时渲染的多级细节（LOD）。

works.title: 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting
works.description: Turns a single RGB-D photo (depth from a phone or a depth estimator) into a '3D photo' with real parallax, synthesising the color and depth hidden behind foreground objects so the camera can move slightly.
works.description_zh: 把一张 RGB-D 照片（深度来自手机或深度估计）变成具有真实视差的“三维照片”，并合成前景物体背后被遮挡的颜色与深度，让镜头可以小幅移动。
works.idea_en: The lineage anchor for today's spatial scenes: one photo plus inpainted hidden layers already gives a convincing sense of depth.
works.idea_zh: 今天“空间场景”的源头：一张照片加上补全的隐藏图层，就已经能带来令人信服的纵深感。
works.method: The photo is converted to a layered depth image; learned color and depth inpainting networks fill the occluded regions locally around depth discontinuities, and the result is rendered as a mesh.
works.method_zh: 先把照片转换为分层深度图像，再由学习得到的颜色与深度补全网络，在深度不连续处局部填补被遮挡区域，最后以网格形式渲染。

paper.title: 3D Photography using Context-aware Layered Depth Inpainting

works.title_zh: 基于上下文感知分层深度补全的三维摄影

works.title: Agence
works.description: A short 'dynamic film' about small creatures on a tiny planet whose behaviour is driven by AI agents; viewers can watch, or reach in and change their world, and the story plays out differently each time.
works.description_zh: 一部短篇“动态电影”：小星球上的小生物由 AI 智能体驱动；观众可以旁观，也可以伸手改变它们的世界，每次故事走向都不同。
works.idea_en: An early precursor: a story whose characters are trained agents rather than animation, so viewer interference has consequences.
works.idea_zh: 早期先例：故事里的角色是训练出来的智能体而不是动画，所以观众的干预会带来后果。
works.method: Characters run reinforcement-learning policies in real time within a game-engine film, and viewer interactions change their environment (co-produced with the National Film Board of Canada).
works.method_zh: 角色在游戏引擎构建的电影中实时运行强化学习策略，观众的交互会改变它们的环境（与加拿大国家电影局联合制作）。
works.title_zh: Agence 动态电影

works.title: An Embodied Perspective as a Victim of Sexual Harassment in Virtual Reality Reduces Action Conformity in a Later Milgram Obedience Scenario
works.description: Sixty men saw a group of men sexually harass a woman in a virtual bar, either only as one of the group or also from the woman's body; those who had been embodied as the victim later conformed less with the group in a Milgram-style scenario.
works.description_zh: 60 名男性在虚拟酒吧中目睹一群男性对一名女性的性骚扰，有人只以群体成员之一的身份在场，有人还以受害女性的身体体验了这一幕；后者在随后的米尔格拉姆式情境中更少随群体行动。
works.idea_en: Situations can be chained: one embodied experience changes behavior in the next, so a generated sequence of scenes is itself an experimental manipulation.
works.idea_zh: 情境可以串联：一次具身体验会改变下一个情境中的行为，因此一组生成的场景序列本身就是一种实验操纵。
works.method: Three groups of 20 (group member only, also embodied as the woman, empty-bar control) followed by a virtual Milgram task under group pressure.
works.method_zh: 三组各 20 人（仅作为群体成员、还以女性身体体验、只经历空酒吧的对照组），随后在群体压力下完成虚拟米尔格拉姆任务。

paper.title: An Embodied Perspective as a Victim of Sexual Harassment in Virtual Reality Reduces Action Conformity in a Later Milgram Obedience Scenario

works.title_zh: 在虚拟现实中以性骚扰受害者视角具身体验，可降低随后米尔格拉姆服从情境中的行动从众

works.title: HoloSuite (HoloEdit / HoloStream)
works.description: Arcturus HoloSuite is a production toolset for editing, compressing and streaming volumetric video of people into games, AR and web players; the company has since moved into Gaussian-splat replays of live sports.
works.description_zh: Arcturus HoloSuite 是一套制作工具，用于编辑、压缩体积视频中的人物，并将其流式传输到游戏、AR 与网页播放器中；该公司后来转向基于高斯泼溅的体育赛事回放。
works.idea_en: The editing and delivery layer volumetric capture needs before it can be dropped into an experience.
works.idea_zh: 体积捕捉在被放进一段体验之前，需要的正是这样的编辑与交付层。
works.method: Captured mesh sequences are cleaned, re-timed, retargeted (e.g. head gaze) and encoded into adaptive streams with plug-ins for Unity and Unreal.
works.method_zh: 对捕捉得到的网格序列进行清理、重定时、重定向（例如头部朝向），并编码为自适应码流，提供 Unity 与 Unreal 插件。
works.title_zh: HoloSuite 体积视频套件

works.title: Infinite Nature
works.description: From a single landscape photo, Infinite Nature generates an arbitrarily long video of a drone-like flight into the scene, inventing new coastline and mountains as the camera advances.
works.description_zh: Infinite Nature 从一张风景照片出发，生成任意长度的“无人机飞入画面”视频，镜头前进时不断创造新的海岸线与山峦。
works.idea_en: The lineage anchor for explorable worlds: it showed endless novel terrain from one image, and also how it falls apart without a persistent 3D memory.
works.idea_zh: 可探索世界这一脉的源头：它展示了从一张图像生成无尽的新地形，也暴露了没有持久三维记忆时世界会如何崩坏。
works.method: Render-refine-repeat: the current frame and its disparity are warped to the next camera pose, and a network inpaints and refines the result, trained on aerial nature videos.
works.method_zh: “渲染—修补—重复”：把当前画面及其视差变换到下一个相机位姿，再由网络补全和修饰，训练数据为航拍自然视频。

paper.title: Infinite Nature: Perpetual View Generation of Natural Scenes from a Single Image

works.title_zh: Infinite Nature：从单张图像无限生成自然风景

works.title: NeRF
works.description: Neural Radiance Fields represent a scene as a small neural network that returns colour and density for any point and viewing direction, so new photoreal views of a captured object or room can be rendered from about a hundred photos.
works.description_zh: 神经辐射场把场景表示为一个小型神经网络：给定任意位置和视角，它返回颜色与密度，因此只需大约一百张照片，就能为拍摄的物体或房间渲染出照片级的新视角。
works.idea_en: The point where a set of photos became a place you can look around in, at the cost of a day of training per scene and slow rendering.
works.idea_zh: 从这里开始，一组照片变成了可以环顾的地方，代价是每个场景要训练一天、渲染也很慢。
works.method: An MLP with positional encoding maps 5D coordinates to radiance and density, trained per scene by differentiable volume rendering against posed photos.
works.method_zh: 带位置编码的多层感知机把五维坐标映射为辐射与密度，通过可微体渲染与带位姿照片对比，逐场景训练。
works.specs: ~100 posed photos · per-scene training about 1–2 days on one V100 (paper)

paper.title: NeRF: Representing Scenes as Neural Radiance Fields for View Synthesis

works.title_zh: NeRF 神经辐射场

works.title: Wav2Lip
works.description: Wav2Lip re-syncs the lips of any talking face in a video to a new audio track, for arbitrary identities and languages, without per-speaker training.
works.description_zh: Wav2Lip 能把任意视频中说话人的唇形重新对齐到一段新的音频上，适用于任何身份和语言，无需针对说话人训练。
works.idea_en: The lineage's precursor: once lips could follow any voice, a face could be paired with a synthetic speaker, and its lip-sync metrics (LSE-C/D) are still used to score avatars in 2026.
works.idea_zh: 这一谱系的前身：一旦唇形能跟随任何声音，人脸就能与合成语音配对；它的唇形同步指标（LSE-C/D）在 2026 年仍被用来给虚拟人打分。
works.method: A GAN-based lip generator trained against a frozen, pre-trained lip-sync expert discriminator (SyncNet) that penalises out-of-sync mouth shapes.
works.method_zh: 基于 GAN 的唇形生成器，训练时用一个冻结的、预训练好的唇形同步专家判别器（SyncNet）惩罚不同步的口型。

paper.title: A Lip Sync Expert Is All You Need for Speech to Lip Generation In The Wild

works.title_zh: Wav2Lip 唇形同步

works.title: GameGAN
works.description: A generative model that learned to re-create a playable PAC-MAN purely from 50,000 recorded episodes of screen frames and key presses, without access to the game engine; NVIDIA released it for the game's 40th anniversary.
works.description_zh: 一个生成模型，仅凭 5 万局游戏录像（画面与按键）就学会重建可玩的《吃豆人》，完全不接触游戏引擎；英伟达在该游戏 40 周年之际发布了它。
works.idea_en: The first widely shown neural game engine: a game's rules and graphics can both be learned from play data.
works.idea_zh: 第一个被广泛展示的神经游戏引擎：游戏的规则与画面都可以从游玩数据中学出来。
works.method: A GAN with a dynamics engine, an external memory module that keeps the maze consistent, and a rendering engine that separates static background from moving agents.
works.method_zh: 由动力学引擎、保持迷宫一致的外部记忆模块，以及把静态背景与运动角色分开的渲染引擎组成的 GAN。

paper.title: Learning to Simulate Dynamic Environments with GameGAN

works.title: RigNet
works.description: Neural network that predicts a skeleton and skinning weights for an arbitrary articulated character mesh, the first learned auto-rigging method for diverse shapes beyond humanoids.
works.description_zh: 一个神经网络，可为任意关节角色网格预测骨架和蒙皮权重，是首个适用于人形之外多样形体的学习式自动绑定方法。
works.idea_en: The starting point of the 'generate a character, then make it move' lineage without a rigging artist.
works.idea_zh: “先生成角色、再让它动起来”且无需绑定师这一路线的起点。
works.method: Graph neural networks over the mesh predict joint locations, then bone connectivity via a minimum spanning tree over learned edge probabilities, then skinning weights; trained on about 2,700 rigged characters.
works.method_zh: 在网格上运行的图神经网络先预测关节位置，再通过对学习到的边概率求最小生成树得到骨骼连接，最后预测蒙皮权重；训练数据为约 2700 个已绑定角色。

paper.title: RigNet: Neural Rigging for Articulated Characters

works.title: Bodyswaps
works.description: Soft-skills training in VR and the browser in which learners hold role-play conversations with AI avatars, for example a nurse talking with a patient, then get a transcript and feedback from an AI coach on what they said and how they said it.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 与浏览器中进行的软技能训练：学习者与 AI 化身进行角色扮演对话（例如护士与病人交谈），之后获得完整对话记录，以及 AI 教练就说话内容与方式给出的反馈。
works.idea_en: Commercial training has moved from branching scripts to open AI role-play with automated scoring; whether that scoring is valid is the open research question.
works.idea_zh: 商业培训已从分支脚本转向开放式 AI 角色扮演与自动评分；这种评分是否有效，是尚待研究的问题。
works.method: AI avatar dialogue with speech input (likely LLM-based) on VR headsets, desktop and mobile, with automated analysis of speech content and nonverbal cues such as eye contact.
works.method_zh: 以语音输入与 AI 化身对话（很可能基于大语言模型），支持 VR 头显、桌面与移动端，并自动分析说话内容以及眼神交流等非语言线索。

works.title: Learning on the job: Studying expertise in residential burglars using virtual environments
works.description: Fifty-six incarcerated burglars, 50 other offenders and 55 non-offenders each carried out a mock burglary in a virtual neighborhood; the burglars scoped the area and searched houses in ways that showed domain expertise.
works.description_zh: 56 名在押入室盗窃犯、50 名其他罪犯和 55 名非罪犯各自在虚拟街区中完成一次模拟盗窃；入室盗窃犯侦察街区、搜索房屋的方式体现出专业技能。
works.idea_en: A virtual scene validated by expert behavior (burglars act like burglars) sets the bar any generated crime scenario should meet.
works.idea_zh: 以专家行为来检验虚拟场景（盗窃犯的行为像盗窃犯）——任何生成的犯罪情境都应达到这一标准。
works.method: Quasi-experiment comparing the three groups on routes, time allocation and target selection during a virtual burglary, interpreted through cognitive expertise theory.
works.method_zh: 准实验，比较三组人在虚拟盗窃中的路线、时间分配与目标选择，并以认知专长理论解释。

paper.title: Learning on the job: Studying expertise in residential burglars using virtual environments

works.title_zh: 在“工作”中学习：用虚拟环境研究入室盗窃者的专长

works.title: Multi-Agent Hide and Seek
works.description: Teams of hiders and seekers trained by reinforcement learning in a 3D physics world discover, over hundreds of millions of games, how to build forts from boxes, use ramps to climb walls and exploit physics glitches.
works.description_zh: 在三维物理世界中通过强化学习训练的躲藏者与寻找者队伍，在数亿局游戏中自己学会用箱子搭堡垒、用坡道翻墙，甚至利用物理引擎漏洞。
works.idea_en: A precursor of agents in worlds: competition alone produced a sequence of strategies nobody designed.
works.idea_zh: “世界中的智能体”的先声：仅靠对抗，就产生了一连串没人设计过的策略。
works.method: Multi-agent self-play with PPO and entity-centric attention policies in a MuJoCo environment; six phases of emergent strategy were identified and compared with intrinsic-motivation baselines.
works.method_zh: 在 MuJoCo 环境中，用 PPO 与以实体为中心的注意力策略进行多智能体自我博弈；识别出六个阶段的涌现策略，并与内在动机基线对比。

paper.title: Emergent Tool Use From Multi-Agent Autocurricula

works.title_zh: 多智能体捉迷藏

works.title: SHOTPROS: VR training for police decision-making under stress
works.description: EU Horizon 2020 project in which police organizations, psychologists and VR developers built and field-tested VR scenarios for training decision-making and acting under stress, with physiological monitoring and trainer controls.
works.description_zh: 欧盟“地平线 2020”项目：警务机构、心理学家与 VR 开发者共同构建并实地测试 VR 情境，用于训练警员在压力下的决策与行动，配有生理监测与教官控制。
works.idea_en: Stress becomes a controllable training parameter that trainers dial up or down, a natural slot for adaptive generation.
works.idea_zh: 压力成为可由教官调高调低的训练参数——这正是自适应生成可以接入的位置。
works.method: Requirements from police trainers, human-factors studies and multi-country field trials over three years, summarized as tools and guidelines by Zechner et al. (2023).
works.method_zh: 历时三年，收集警务教官需求、开展人因研究并在多国实地试验，成果由 Zechner 等人（2023）总结为工具与指南。

paper.title: Enhancing Operational Police Training in High Stress Situations with Virtual Reality: Experiences, Tools and Guidelines

works.title_zh: SHOTPROS：面向压力下警务决策的 VR 训练

works.title: WebXR Device API
works.description: The W3C web standard that lets a page open immersive VR and AR sessions on headsets and phones, with pose tracking, controller and hand input, and AR modules for hit testing, anchors and depth. Chromium browsers (including Meta Quest Browser and Chrome on Android XR) and Safari on visionOS implement it; the core spec is a W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft, latest dated 2026-06-09.
works.description_zh: W3C 的网页标准，让网页可以在头显和手机上开启沉浸式 VR 与 AR 会话，提供位姿追踪、手柄与手势输入，以及用于命中测试、锚点和深度的 AR 模块。Chromium 系浏览器（包括 Meta Quest 浏览器与 Android XR 上的 Chrome）以及 visionOS 上的 Safari 都已实现；核心规范为 W3C 候选推荐草案，最新版本日期为 2026-06-09。
works.idea_en: The lowest-friction delivery path for a generated scene: a URL that opens in a headset, which also makes remote and large-sample XR studies feasible.
works.idea_zh: 生成场景门槛最低的交付方式：一个能在头显中打开的网址，这也让远程与大样本 XR 研究变得可行。
works.method: A JavaScript API that supplies per-frame viewer and input poses and an XR-compatible WebGL / WebGPU layer to render into; feature modules add AR capabilities.
works.method_zh: 一个 JavaScript API，逐帧提供观察者与输入设备的位姿，以及可供渲染的 XR 兼容 WebGL / WebGPU 图层；功能模块补充 AR 能力。
works.specs: W3C Candidate Recommendation Draft (2026-06-09) · editors from Google and Meta
works.title_zh: WebXR 设备 API

works.title: Codec Avatars
works.description: Codec Avatars are Meta's photorealistic 3D avatars of real people, captured in multi-camera studios and driven live by cameras inside a VR headset, so two people in headsets see each other's faces in 3D. The best-known public demonstration was the 2023 Lex Fridman interview with Mark Zuckerberg held entirely between Codec Avatars.
works.description_zh: Codec Avatars 是 Meta 为真人打造的照片级三维化身：在多相机影棚中采集，由 VR 头显内部的摄像头实时驱动，让戴着头显的两个人能看到对方的三维面孔。最著名的公开演示是 2023 年 Lex Fridman 与扎克伯格完全通过 Codec Avatars 进行的访谈。
works.idea_en: Set the target that later Gaussian, phone-scan and feed-forward avatars chase: telepresence where a face is encoded, sent and decoded like a codec.
works.idea_zh: 确立了后来的高斯化身、手机扫描化身和前馈化身所追赶的目标：像编解码器一样编码、传输、解码一张脸的远程临场。
works.method: A deep appearance model (variational autoencoder) learns a person-specific latent code of face geometry and view-dependent texture from studio capture; headset cameras regress the code in real time and a decoder renders it.
works.method_zh: 深度外观模型（变分自编码器）从影棚采集数据中学习个人专属的面部几何与视角相关纹理的隐编码；头显摄像头实时回归该编码，再由解码器渲染。

paper.title: Deep appearance models for face rendering

works.title_zh: Codec Avatars 照片级远程临场化身

works.title: AVATAR therapy for auditory verbal hallucinations in people with psychosis: a single-blind, randomised controlled trial
works.description: People who hear persecutory voices created a digital face and voice for their main voice, then held dialogues with it while a therapist spoke as the avatar through a voice transformer and gradually made it less hostile; voices became less severe than with supportive counselling.
works.description_zh: 受迫害性幻听困扰的人为自己听到的主要“声音”创建一张数字面孔和一种声音，然后与它对话；治疗师通过变声器以化身的身份说话，并让它逐渐变得不那么敌意。与支持性咨询相比，幻听的严重程度有所下降。
works.idea_en: A personalized, human-voiced avatar of a patient's tormentor is a clinical use of virtual humans that LLMs could scale but must not let drift.
works.idea_zh: 为患者的“折磨者”定制、由真人配音的化身，是虚拟人的一种临床用途；大语言模型可以让它规模化，但绝不能让它失控偏离。
works.method: Single-blind RCT of AVATAR therapy (invented by Julian Leff in 2008) vs. supportive counselling, with avatars built from patients' descriptions and voiced live by the therapist; the larger AVATAR2 trial followed in 2024.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验，比较 AVATAR 疗法（由 Julian Leff 于 2008 年提出）与支持性咨询；化身依患者描述制作，由治疗师实时配音。规模更大的 AVATAR2 试验于 2024 年发表。

paper.title: AVATAR therapy for auditory verbal hallucinations in people with psychosis: a single-blind, randomised controlled trial

works.title_zh: AVATAR 疗法治疗精神病患者的言语性幻听：单盲随机对照试验

works.title: Automated psychological therapy using immersive virtual reality for treatment of fear of heights: a single-blind, parallel-group, randomised controlled trial
works.description: Randomized trial in which adults with fear of heights received about six 30-minute VR sessions over two weeks guided by an animated virtual coach, with no therapist present; fear of heights fell substantially compared with usual care.
works.description_zh: 随机试验：恐高的成年人在两周内接受约六次、每次 30 分钟的 VR 治疗，全程由一位动画虚拟教练引导，无需治疗师在场；与常规护理相比，恐高程度明显下降。
works.idea_en: Early rigorous evidence that a fully automated virtual coach can deliver psychological therapy, the precedent for LLM-guided therapy in VR.
works.idea_zh: 早期的严格证据：全自动的虚拟教练也能实施心理治疗，为 VR 中由大语言模型引导的治疗开了先例。
works.method: Single-blind RCT of automated cognitive VR therapy (virtual coach animated from an actor's motion and voice capture) on consumer headsets vs. usual care, with the Heights Interpretation Questionnaire as outcome.
works.method_zh: 单盲随机对照试验：在消费级头显上进行自动化认知 VR 治疗（虚拟教练由演员的动作与声音捕捉驱动），对照为常规护理，以恐高解释问卷为结局指标。

paper.title: Automated psychological therapy using immersive virtual reality for treatment of fear of heights: a single-blind, parallel-group, randomised controlled trial

works.title_zh: 用沉浸式虚拟现实进行自动化心理治疗以治疗恐高：单盲平行组随机对照试验

works.title: Axon VR Training
works.description: VR training for police from the maker of TASER and body cameras. It began in October 2018 with a 360-degree empathy scenario about schizophrenia, followed in 2019 by autism and suicide scenarios; today officers progress from empathy and crisis-response modules to de-escalation, tactical decision-making and simulator drills with replica TASERs and handguns.
works.description_zh: TASER 与执法记录仪制造商 Axon 推出的警务 VR 训练：2018 年 10 月以一个关于精神分裂症的 360° 共情情境起步，2019 年又加入自闭症与自杀相关情境；如今警员从共情与危机应对模块开始，逐步进阶到降级处置、战术决策，以及使用仿真 TASER 和手枪的模拟训练。
works.idea_en: De-escalation is now trained in headsets at police-department scale; Axon says some scenarios adapt in real time, a claim worth testing against scripted branching.
works.idea_zh: 降级处置训练如今已在警局规模上通过头显进行；Axon 称部分情境可实时调整，这一说法值得与脚本分支方案对照检验。
works.method: Authored live-action and CG scenarios on standalone headsets with tracked weapon replicas and instructor controls; adaptivity is developer-reported.
works.method_zh: 在一体机头显上运行的实拍与 CG 编写情境，配有可追踪的仿真武器与教官控制；“自适应”为开发方的说法。

works.title: Building long-term empathy: A large-scale comparison of traditional and virtual reality perspective-taking
works.description: Two experiments compared 'Becoming Homeless', a VR experience of losing one's job and home, with traditional perspective-taking; over eight weeks VR participants held more positive, longer-lasting attitudes toward homeless people and were more likely to sign a petition supporting affordable housing.
works.description_zh: 两项实验把 VR 体验《Becoming Homeless》（经历失业、失去住所）与传统换位思考任务相比较；在八周内，VR 组对无家可归者的态度更积极、更持久，也更愿意签署支持可负担住房的请愿书。
works.idea_en: Embodied perspective-taking can outlast the session; long follow-ups, not post-session ratings, are the right test for a generated empathy scenario.
works.idea_zh: 具身的换位思考可以延续到体验结束之后；检验生成的共情情境，应看长期追踪，而不是体验后的即时评分。
works.method: Large-sample experiments comparing VR, narrative perspective-taking and control conditions (and desktop vs. headset in Study 2), with attitude scales and a petition-signing behavioral measure over eight weeks.
works.method_zh: 大样本实验，比较 VR、叙事式换位思考与对照条件（研究二另比较桌面与头显），在八周内测量态度量表与签署请愿这一行为指标。

paper.title: Building long-term empathy: A large-scale comparison of traditional and virtual reality perspective-taking

works.title_zh: 建立长期共情：传统换位思考与虚拟现实换位思考的大规模比较

works.title: Offenders become the victim in virtual reality: impact of changing perspective in domestic violence
works.description: Male domestic-violence offenders and non-violent controls were embodied in a woman's virtual body while a virtual man verbally abused her; afterwards the offenders recognized fear in female faces better than before.
works.description_zh: 男性家暴罪犯和无暴力史的对照者被赋予一具女性虚拟身体，同时一名虚拟男性对“她”进行言语虐待；体验之后，罪犯识别女性面孔中恐惧情绪的能力有所提高。
works.idea_en: Swapping an offender into the victim's body is an intervention only VR can stage; generation could tailor the abuser, setting and script to each case.
works.idea_zh: 让罪犯换位进入受害者的身体，是只有 VR 才能布置的干预；生成技术可以按个案定制施暴者、场景与台词。
works.method: Full-body ownership illusion through a head-mounted display and motion capture, with emotion-recognition tests before and after the virtual abuse scene.
works.method_zh: 通过头显与动作捕捉诱发全身拥有错觉，并在虚拟施暴场景前后施测情绪识别。

paper.title: Offenders become the victim in virtual reality: impact of changing perspective in domestic violence

works.title_zh: 在虚拟现实中让施暴者成为受害者：家庭暴力中视角转换的影响

works.title: Participant concerns for the Learner in a Virtual Reality replication of the Milgram obedience study
works.description: Forty participants went through a VR version of the Milgram paradigm; compared with 20 controls, they tried to help the virtual Learner by stressing the correct word when reading the test items, a sign of concern for the victim rather than pure obedience.
works.description_zh: 40 名参与者经历了 VR 版米尔格拉姆范式；与 20 名对照者相比，他们在朗读测试题时会刻意加重正确选项来帮助虚拟学习者——这说明他们关心受害者，而非单纯服从。
works.idea_en: Logging fine-grained behavior inside a virtual replication can test theories, here the 'agentic state', that the original paradigm could only argue about.
works.idea_zh: 在虚拟复现中记录细粒度行为，可以检验原范式只能争论的理论（此处为“代理状态”）。
works.method: VR replication with acoustic analysis of how participants read the word pairs, compared with a control group not taken through the simulation.
works.method_zh: VR 复现实验，对参与者朗读词对的语音进行声学分析，并与未经历模拟的对照组比较。

paper.title: Participant concerns for the Learner in a Virtual Reality replication of the Milgram obedience study

works.title_zh: 米尔格拉姆服从实验 VR 复现中参与者对“学习者”的关切

works.title: RealEstate10K
works.description: A dataset of camera trajectories for about 10 million frames from some 80,000 clips of YouTube real-estate walkthrough videos, released by Google with the Stereo Magnification paper. It became the standard testbed for novel-view synthesis and, later, camera-controlled video generation.
works.description_zh: 约 8 万段 YouTube 房产看房视频片段、约 1,000 万帧的相机轨迹数据集，由 Google 随 Stereo Magnification 论文发布。它成为新视角合成、以及后来镜头可控视频生成的标准测试集。
works.idea_en: Ordinary walkthrough footage with recovered camera paths is what taught view-synthesis and camera-controlled video models how indoor space unfolds as you move.
works.idea_zh: 普通的看房视频加上恢复出的镜头路径，让新视角合成与镜头可控视频模型学会了人在室内移动时空间如何展开。
works.method: SLAM and bundle adjustment on walkthrough footage recover per-frame camera intrinsics and poses; the dataset ships poses and video ids, not the videos.
works.method_zh: 对看房视频进行 SLAM 与光束法平差，恢复逐帧相机内参与位姿；数据集提供位姿与视频 ID，不包含视频本身。

paper.title: Stereo Magnification: Learning View Synthesis using Multiplane Images

works.title: Why and how to use virtual reality to study human social interaction: The challenges of exploring a new research landscape
works.description: Review in the British Journal of Psychology on using VR to study face-to-face social interaction: what virtual characters let researchers control, and what is lost when the partner is not a real person.
works.description_zh: 发表于 British Journal of Psychology 的综述，讨论如何用 VR 研究面对面的社会互动：虚拟角色让研究者能控制什么，以及当互动对象不是真人时会失去什么。
works.idea_en: Virtual partners buy precise, repeatable social stimuli at the cost of two-way realism, the gap LLM-driven characters now try to close.
works.idea_zh: 虚拟互动对象以牺牲双向真实感为代价，换来精确、可重复的社会刺激；这正是由大语言模型驱动的角色如今试图弥合的缺口。
works.method: Narrative review with Antonia Hamilton of VR social-interaction paradigms, covering character realism, interaction loops and validity.
works.method_zh: 与 Antonia Hamilton 合作的叙述性综述，涵盖 VR 社会互动范式中的角色真实感、互动回路与效度问题。

paper.title: Why and how to use virtual reality to study human social interaction: The challenges of exploring a new research landscape

works.title_zh: 为何以及如何用虚拟现实研究人类社会互动：探索新研究版图的挑战

works.title: World Models
works.description: An interactive paper in which an agent learns a compressed model of a car-racing game and of VizDoom, then trains entirely inside its own generated 'dream' and transfers the learned policy back to the real game; readers can play inside the dream in the browser.
works.description_zh: 一篇交互式论文：智能体先学会赛车游戏和 VizDoom 的压缩模型，然后完全在自己生成的“梦境”中训练，再把学到的策略迁回真实游戏；读者可以在浏览器里进入这个梦境游玩。
works.idea_en: The lineage starts here: a learned simulator can stand in for the real environment, and its flaws can be exploited by whoever acts inside it.
works.idea_zh: 这条谱系从这里开始：学习得到的模拟器可以替代真实环境，而它的缺陷也可能被身处其中的行动者利用。
works.method: A VAE compresses frames, a mixture-density RNN predicts the next latent state from action, and a small controller is evolved with CMA-ES inside the RNN's rollouts.
works.method_zh: 用 VAE 压缩画面，用混合密度 RNN 根据动作预测下一潜在状态，再在 RNN 的推演中用 CMA-ES 进化一个小型控制器。

paper.venue: NeurIPS 2018 (as 'Recurrent World Models Facilitate Policy Evolution')
paper.title: World Models

works.title_zh: 世界模型（World Models）

works.title: Virtual Burglary: Exploring the Potential of Virtual Reality to Study Burglary in Action
works.description: Seventy-seven male undergraduates walked a virtual neighborhood in a headset and were asked to burgle one house; the system logged their route, the items they stole and their heart rate, while an alarm and beliefs about the chance of being caught were varied.
works.description_zh: 77 名男性本科生戴着头显在虚拟街区中行走，并被要求入室盗窃其中一户；系统记录了他们的路线、偷走的物品和心率，同时操纵是否响起警报以及他们对被抓概率的认知。
works.idea_en: Crime becomes an observable, logged behavior instead of a self-report, the kind of situational reach generated environments could extend to many more offences and settings.
works.idea_zh: 犯罪从自我报告变成了可观察、可记录的行为——生成环境有望把这种情境可达性扩展到更多罪行与场景。
works.method: Free-roaming VR burglary task with experimentally varied alarm and perceived-risk conditions, behavioral logs, heart rate and dispositional measures (self-control, sensation seeking).
works.method_zh: 可自由走动的 VR 盗窃任务，实验操纵警报与感知风险，记录行为日志与心率，并测量自我控制、感觉寻求等个体特质。

paper.venue: Journal of Research in Crime and Delinquency 54(1)
paper.title: Virtual Burglary: Exploring the Potential of Virtual Reality to Study Burglary in Action

works.title_zh: 虚拟入室盗窃：探索用虚拟现实研究“进行中”的盗窃

works.title: Crowd behaviour during high-stress evacuations in an immersive virtual environment
works.description: Groups of real participants, each controlling an avatar in a shared 3D virtual building, reproduced known crowd patterns during normal egress, and a high-stress evacuation condition showed how crowd movement changes under pressure.
works.description_zh: 多组真实参与者在共享的三维虚拟建筑中各自操控一个化身；常规疏散时重现了已知的人群模式，高压疏散条件则展示了人群移动在压力下如何变化。
works.idea_en: Multi-user virtual environments make crowd emergencies experimentally reachable; generated layouts and hazards could extend such tests far beyond one building.
works.idea_zh: 多人虚拟环境让人群紧急情况可以被实验研究；生成的建筑布局与险情可以把这类测试扩展到远不止一栋建筑。
works.method: Networked multi-participant experiments comparing virtual crowd patterns with real-world observations, plus a high-stress evacuation condition.
works.method_zh: 联网的多人实验，把虚拟人群模式与真实世界观察相比较，并加入高压疏散条件。

paper.venue: Journal of the Royal Society Interface 13(122)
paper.title: Crowd behaviour during high-stress evacuations in an immersive virtual environment

works.title_zh: 沉浸式虚拟环境中高压疏散时的人群行为

works.title: Enhancing Our Lives with Immersive Virtual Reality
works.description: Long review in Frontiers in Robotics and AI that surveys how immersive VR has been used in neuroscience, psychology, clinical therapy, training, education and entertainment, sets out its distinctive affordances and adds ethical cautions.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Frontiers in Robotics and AI 的长篇综述，回顾沉浸式 VR 在神经科学、心理学、临床治疗、训练、教育与娱乐中的应用，概括其独特能力，并提出伦理上的提醒。
works.idea_en: VR's value lies in situations that are impossible, dangerous or unethical in reality, including inhabiting another body, which generation could make much cheaper to build.
works.idea_zh: VR 的价值在于现实中不可能、危险或不合伦理的情境——包括进入另一具身体——而生成技术可能大幅降低构建这些情境的成本。
works.method: Narrative review with Maria V. Sanchez-Vives organized around presence, body ownership and application areas.
works.method_zh: 与 Maria V. Sanchez-Vives 合作的叙述性综述，围绕临场感、身体拥有感与应用领域展开。

paper.title: Enhancing Our Lives with Immersive Virtual Reality

works.title_zh: 用沉浸式虚拟现实改善我们的生活

works.title: Social Influence on Evacuation Behavior in Real and Virtual Environments
works.description: When a fire alarm went off, 150 participants decided whether to evacuate, alone or next to a bystander who either left or stayed; half were in the real lab and half in a matched VR replica with a virtual bystander. The same social influence appeared in both, but people responded less to the virtual alarm, and a bystander who stayed held people back less in VR.
works.description_zh: 火警响起时，150 名参与者要决定是否撤离：独自一人，或身边有一位要么离开、要么留下的旁观者；一半人在真实实验室，另一半在配有虚拟旁观者的、与之匹配的 VR 复制场景中。两种环境中都出现了同样的社会影响，但人们对虚拟火警的反应较弱，留下不走的旁观者在 VR 中的“拖住”作用也较弱。
works.idea_en: A matched real-versus-virtual test shows which effects carry over (positive social influence) and which shrink (urgency, negative influence), the kind of validation any generated emergency would need.
works.idea_zh: 真实与虚拟的匹配对照显示了哪些效应能延续（正向社会影响）、哪些会减弱（紧迫感、负向影响）——任何生成的紧急情境都需要这类验证。
works.method: One-trial between-subjects experiment with three bystander conditions, run in a physical laboratory and in a matched virtual environment presented in a head-mounted display.
works.method_zh: 单次试验的被试间实验，设三种旁观者条件，分别在真实实验室与在头戴显示器中呈现的匹配虚拟环境中进行。

paper.title: Social Influence on Evacuation Behavior in Real and Virtual Environments

works.title_zh: 真实与虚拟环境中疏散行为的社会影响

works.title: Conversations between self and self as Sigmund Freud—A virtual body ownership paradigm for self counselling
works.description: Participants explained a personal problem to a virtual counsellor, then swapped into the counsellor's body and answered themselves, hearing their own voice transformed; being embodied as Sigmund Freud when giving the advice improved mood more than counselling from a copy of their own body.
works.description_zh: 参与者先向一位虚拟咨询者讲述个人困扰，再换到咨询者的身体里回答自己，并听到经变声处理的自己的声音；与以“另一个自己”的身体提供建议相比，化身为西格蒙德·弗洛伊德时心情改善更明显。
works.idea_en: The counsellor can be the participant in another body, a design that later work extends with AI agents nudging the self-dialogue.
works.idea_zh: 咨询者可以是换了身体的参与者本人——后续研究在此基础上加入了推动自我对话的 AI 智能体。
works.method: Embodiment experiment with full-body tracking, alternating first-person perspective between participant and counsellor avatars with voice transformation, comparing a Freud body with a self-copy body.
works.method_zh: 具身实验，使用全身追踪，在参与者化身与咨询者化身之间切换第一人称视角并进行变声，比较弗洛伊德身体与“自我复制”身体两种条件。

paper.title: Conversations between self and self as Sigmund Freud—A virtual body ownership paradigm for self counselling

works.title_zh: 以西格蒙德·弗洛伊德身份进行的自我对话：一种用于自我咨询的虚拟身体拥有范式

works.title: High-Quality Streamable Free-Viewpoint Video
works.description: Microsoft's capture-stage system records performers with a dome of synchronised cameras and turns them into streamable textured 3D meshes that can be placed in AR, VR or film.
works.description_zh: 微软的捕捉舞台系统用一圈同步相机录制表演者，并把他们转换为可流式传输的带纹理三维网格，用于 AR、VR 或电影。
works.idea_en: The studio volumetric-video pipeline that preceded Gaussian video, and the baseline it is judged against.
works.idea_zh: 这是高斯视频出现之前的影棚体积视频流程，也是评价高斯视频时的基线。
works.method: Multi-view RGB and infrared stereo give point clouds that are meshed, tracked for temporal coherence, texture-mapped and compressed for streaming.
works.method_zh: 多视角 RGB 与红外立体得到点云，再经网格化、为时间一致性进行追踪、纹理映射并压缩以便流式传输。

paper.title: High-quality streamable free-viewpoint video

works.title_zh: 高质量可流式自由视角视频

works.title: Strivr
works.description: Enterprise VR training that grew out of Stanford's VHIL: 360-degree video and interactive modules let workers rehearse situations such as store rushes or difficult customers, and Walmart deployed it in its training academies. In 2026 its site leads with AI quality assurance on smart glasses while still offering the VR platform.
works.description_zh: 源自斯坦福 VHIL 的企业 VR 培训：员工借助 360° 视频与交互模块演练购物高峰、难缠顾客等情境，沃尔玛在其培训学院中部署了它。截至 2026 年，其官网主推基于智能眼镜的 AI 质检，同时仍提供 VR 平台。
works.idea_en: Filmed 360-degree situations took VR rehearsal to a large retail workforce; the company's next step was AI that watches real work through glasses.
works.idea_zh: 实拍的 360° 情境把 VR 演练带给了庞大的零售员工群体；这家公司的下一步，是让 AI 透过眼镜观察真实工作。
works.method: Captured 360-degree video and authored interactive scenarios delivered on standalone headsets, with analytics on trainee responses.
works.method_zh: 以实拍 360° 视频和人工编写的交互情境在一体机头显上交付，并对受训者的反应进行数据分析。

works.title: It's only a computer: Virtual humans increase willingness to disclose
works.description: People interviewed by the SimSensei virtual human reported less fear of self-disclosure, managed their impressions less and showed sadness more openly when they believed it was fully automated than when they believed a human was operating it.
works.description_zh: 接受 SimSensei 虚拟人访谈的人，若相信对方是全自动的，比相信有人在后台操控时，对自我暴露的顾虑更少、印象管理更少，也更坦然地流露悲伤。
works.idea_en: Believing no human is watching makes people more open, so what participants are told about an AI interlocutor is itself a variable to control.
works.idea_zh: 相信没有真人在看会让人更坦诚——因此告诉参与者对面的 AI 是什么，本身就是需要控制的变量。
works.method: 2x2 design crossing framing (computer vs. human operator) with actual control (automated vs. Wizard-of-Oz), measuring fear of disclosure, impression management and coded emotional expression.
works.method_zh: 2×2 设计，交叉操纵“告知”（计算机 vs. 真人操作）与“实际控制方式”（自动 vs. 绿野仙踪），测量自我暴露顾虑、印象管理与编码后的情绪表达。

paper.title: It's only a computer: Virtual humans increase willingness to disclose

works.title_zh: “它只是台计算机”：虚拟人提高人们的自我披露意愿

works.title: Mursion
works.description: Simulation platform where employees and teachers rehearse difficult conversations with avatars; trained simulation specialists voice and steer the avatars live, and by 2026 Mursion presents itself as an AI-powered upskilling platform.
works.description_zh: 一个让员工与教师和化身演练艰难对话的模拟平台：经过训练的模拟专员实时为化身配音并操控其行为；截至 2026 年，Mursion 把自己定位为 AI 驱动的技能提升平台。
works.idea_en: A human-in-the-loop virtual human shows what full reactivity looks like at scale; LLM agents are measured against this Wizard-of-Oz baseline.
works.idea_zh: 人在回路的虚拟人展示了大规模下“全面反应性”是什么样子；大语言模型智能体正是以这条“绿野仙踪”基线来衡量的。
works.method: Avatars puppeteered in real time by a trained human operator (voice, expression, behavior) following scenario guides and coaching; the company now also advertises AI-powered simulations.
works.method_zh: 由受过训练的真人操作员按情境指引实时操控化身（声音、表情、行为）并配合教练反馈；公司如今也宣传 AI 驱动的模拟。

works.title: PlayCanvas Engine
works.description: An MIT-licensed web graphics runtime (WebGL, WebGPU, WebXR, glTF) that has become one of the main browser renderers for Gaussian splats; PlayCanvas, owned by Snap, also builds the SuperSplat editor. Engine 2.20 (June 2026) added splat relighting, soft shadows and depth of field, streaming of scenes with billions of splats, and WebXR on WebGPU.
works.description_zh: 以 MIT 许可开源的网页图形运行时（WebGL、WebGPU、WebXR、glTF），已成为浏览器中渲染高斯泼溅的主要引擎之一；隶属 Snap 的 PlayCanvas 还开发了 SuperSplat 编辑器。引擎 2.20 版（2026 年 6 月）加入了泼溅重打光、软阴影与景深、数十亿泼溅点场景的流式加载，以及基于 WebGPU 的 WebXR。
works.idea_en: Generated worlds can ship as a link: a participant opens a splat scene in a desktop or headset browser with nothing to install.
works.idea_zh: 生成的世界可以以链接形式交付：被试在电脑或头显浏览器中直接打开泼溅场景，无需安装任何东西。
works.method: JavaScript / TypeScript engine with an entity-component system, a GPU splat renderer that sorts and rasterizes Gaussians, and WebXR session support.
works.method_zh: JavaScript / TypeScript 引擎，采用实体组件系统，带有在 GPU 上排序并光栅化高斯的泼溅渲染器，并支持 WebXR 会话。
works.specs: MIT · ~17k GitHub stars (Oct 2026) · v2.20 (2026-06) · billions of splats via streaming (PlayCanvas claim)

works.title: Reconsidering Fidelity in Simulation-Based Training
works.description: Commentary in Academic Medicine arguing that 'fidelity' should be replaced by physical resemblance and functional task alignment, and that learning is driven by engagement and correspondence with the task rather than surface realism.
works.description_zh: 发表于 Academic Medicine 的评论文章，主张用“物理相似性”与“功能任务一致性”取代笼统的“保真度”，并指出推动学习的是投入度以及与任务的对应，而非表面真实感。
works.idea_en: Generated realism is not the goal: a training scenario needs the cues that matter for the task, which is cheaper and more testable than photorealism.
works.idea_zh: 生成的真实感本身不是目标：训练情境需要的是对任务有意义的线索——这比照片级真实更便宜，也更容易检验。
works.method: Conceptual analysis of the simulation-training literature by Hamstra, Brydges, Hatala, Zendejas and Cook.
works.method_zh: Hamstra、Brydges、Hatala、Zendejas 与 Cook 对模拟训练文献的概念分析。

paper.title: Reconsidering Fidelity in Simulation-Based Training

works.title_zh: 重新审视模拟训练中的保真度

works.title: SimSensei Kiosk: a virtual human interviewer for healthcare decision support
works.description: Virtual human interviewer 'Ellie' who asks people about their lives and wellbeing while the MultiSense module tracks face, gaze, posture and voice; she gives listening feedback and follow-up questions, and the system extracts indicators of depression, anxiety and PTSD.
works.description_zh: 虚拟人访谈者“Ellie”询问受访者的生活与身心状况，同时 MultiSense 模块追踪面部、视线、姿态与语音；她会给出倾听反馈并追问，系统据此提取抑郁、焦虑与 PTSD 的指标。
works.idea_en: Built in three cycles, from face-to-face data to Wizard-of-Oz to full automation, the method a generative interviewer would still need to follow.
works.idea_zh: 经过三轮开发：从面对面访谈数据，到“绿野仙踪”原型，再到全自动——生成式访谈者仍然需要走这条方法路线。
works.method: Analysis of human interviews, a Wizard-of-Oz prototype with two operators choosing speech and gestures, then an automated system with multimodal perception, rule-based dialogue policies and authored utterances.
works.method_zh: 先分析真人访谈，再做由两名操作员选择话语与手势的“绿野仙踪”原型，最后实现具备多模态感知、基于规则的对话策略与预编写话语的全自动系统。

paper.title: SimSensei Kiosk: a virtual human interviewer for healthcare decision support

works.title_zh: SimSensei Kiosk：用于医疗决策支持的虚拟人访谈者

works.title: Virtual Reality Job Interview Training in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder
works.description: Randomized trial of Virtual Reality Job Interview Training, in which adults with autism repeatedly interview with a virtual hiring manager ('Molly Porter') whose difficulty can be raised and who gives feedback; trainees improved their role-play interview performance compared with controls.
works.description_zh: 虚拟现实求职面试训练（VR-JIT）的随机试验：自闭症成年人反复与虚拟招聘经理“Molly Porter”面试，难度可逐级提高并附带反馈；与对照组相比，受训者的模拟面试表现有所提升。
works.idea_en: Graded difficulty and endless repetition with a virtual interviewer already worked with branching scripts; generation removes the authoring ceiling, not the need for trials.
works.idea_zh: 分级难度加上与虚拟面试官的无限次重复，在分支脚本时代就已奏效；生成技术解除的是编写上限，而不是对试验验证的需要。
works.method: Randomized controlled efficacy trial of SIMmersion's branching-dialogue simulator, assessed with role-play interviews before and after training.
works.method_zh: 对 SIMmersion 分支对话模拟器的随机对照疗效试验，在训练前后以模拟面试评估。

paper.venue: Journal of Autism and Developmental Disorders 44
paper.title: Virtual Reality Job Interview Training in Adults with Autism Spectrum Disorder

works.title_zh: 自闭症谱系障碍成人的虚拟现实求职面试训练

works.title: Babylon.js
works.description: Microsoft's open-source (Apache-2.0) JavaScript rendering and game engine for the web, with WebXR, WebGPU and Gaussian-splat support. Babylon.js 9.0 shipped on 2026-03-26.
works.description_zh: 微软以 Apache-2.0 许可开源的网页 JavaScript 渲染与游戏引擎，支持 WebXR、WebGPU 与高斯泼溅。Babylon.js 9.0 于 2026-03-26 发布。
works.idea_en: A second mature open web engine for splat and WebXR delivery, useful when a study needs browser-based 3D without lock-in to one vendor.
works.idea_zh: 另一款成熟的开源网页引擎，可交付泼溅与 WebXR 内容；当研究需要在浏览器中呈现三维内容、又不想绑定单一厂商时很有用。
works.method: TypeScript engine with a node-based material editor, physics, WebXR experience helpers and a splat renderer, running on WebGL2 or WebGPU.
works.method_zh: TypeScript 引擎，带节点式材质编辑器、物理、WebXR 体验辅助工具与泼溅渲染器，运行于 WebGL2 或 WebGPU。

works.title: Bystander Responses to a Violent Incident in an Immersive Virtual Environment
works.description: Forty male Arsenal supporters watched an argument in a virtual bar escalate into violence; they intervened more often when the victim was a fellow Arsenal supporter, supporting a social-identity account of bystander behavior.
works.description_zh: 40 名男性阿森纳球迷在虚拟酒吧中目睹一场争执升级为暴力；当受害者也是阿森纳球迷时，他们更常出手干预，支持了用社会认同解释旁观者行为的观点。
works.idea_en: Violence that cannot be staged becomes a controlled 2x2 experiment, the template for generating many variants of a dangerous social scene.
works.idea_zh: 无法真实布置的暴力场景被变成可控的 2×2 实验——为生成大量危险社会场景的变体提供了样板。
works.method: Two-factor between-groups design (victim in-group vs. out-group x victim looks or does not look at the participant) with life-size virtual characters; interventions coded from recordings.
works.method_zh: 双因素组间设计（受害者为同群体 vs. 外群体 × 受害者是否望向参与者），使用真人大小的虚拟角色，并根据录像编码干预行为。

paper.title: Bystander Responses to a Violent Incident in an Immersive Virtual Environment

works.title_zh: 沉浸式虚拟环境中旁观者对暴力事件的反应

works.title: Putting yourself in the skin of a black avatar reduces implicit racial bias
works.description: Light-skinned participants embodied in a dark-skinned virtual body that moved with them showed lower implicit racial bias afterwards than participants in the other body conditions.
works.description_zh: 肤色较浅的参与者被赋予一具随自己动作而动的深肤色虚拟身体后，其内隐种族偏见低于其他身体条件下的参与者。
works.idea_en: Full-body ownership of a different identity measurably shifts attitudes, a strong and ethically loaded manipulation for any generated-avatar study.
works.idea_zh: 对另一种身份的全身拥有感能可测地改变态度——对任何使用生成化身的研究而言，这都是一种强效且有伦理分量的操纵。
works.method: Between-groups embodiment experiment with full-body motion capture and a virtual mirror; Implicit Association Test before and after exposure.
works.method_zh: 组间具身实验，使用全身动作捕捉与虚拟镜子，在体验前后施测内隐联想测验。

paper.title: Putting yourself in the skin of a black avatar reduces implicit racial bias

works.title_zh: 进入黑人化身的皮肤可降低内隐种族偏见

works.title: Illusory ownership of a virtual child body causes overestimation of object sizes and implicit attitude changes
works.description: Thirty adults were embodied in VR either as a 4-year-old child or as an adult body shrunk to the child's height, with body movements synchronized. Both produced strong body ownership, but only the child body made people overestimate object sizes more and associate themselves faster with child-like attributes; in a second experiment (n=16), asynchronous movement removed the illusion and the child-specific effects.
works.description_zh: 30 名成年人在 VR 中被赋予一个 4 岁儿童的身体，或一个缩小到儿童身高的成人身体，且身体动作同步。两种条件都产生了强烈的身体拥有感，但只有儿童身体让人更高估物体尺寸，并更快地把自己与儿童特质联系起来；第二项实验（n=16）中，动作不同步消除了拥有感错觉及儿童身体特有的效应。
works.idea_en: The body you are given changes perception and implicit attitudes, not only how you feel: avatar choice is an experimental variable.
works.idea_zh: 被赋予的身体会改变知觉与内隐态度，而不只是感受——化身的选择本身就是实验变量。
works.method: Between-groups embodiment experiment with full-body motion capture and first-person view in an HMD, object-size estimation and an implicit association test; a second experiment with asynchronous visuomotor feedback as control.
works.method_zh: 组间具身实验：头显第一人称视角配合全身动作捕捉，测量物体尺寸估计与内隐联想测验；第二项实验以视觉-运动不同步作为对照。

paper.title: Illusory ownership of a virtual child body causes overestimation of object sizes and implicit attitude changes

works.title_zh: 对虚拟儿童身体的错觉拥有感导致高估物体尺寸并改变内隐态度

works.title: Virtual Superheroes: Using Superpowers in Virtual Reality to Encourage Prosocial Behavior
works.description: Participants either flew over a virtual city by moving their arms like Superman or rode as a passenger in a helicopter, while searching for a diabetic child who needed insulin or simply touring. Afterwards, those who had flown helped the experimenter pick up spilled pens more than the helicopter passengers, whatever their task had been.
works.description_zh: 参与者要么像超人一样挥动手臂在虚拟城市上空飞行，要么作为乘客坐直升机；任务是寻找一个急需胰岛素的糖尿病儿童，或只是游览城市。之后，无论任务是什么，飞行组都比直升机组更多地帮实验者捡起洒落的笔。
works.idea_en: A capability granted in VR, not only a role or a story, can carry over into helping behavior outside the headset.
works.idea_zh: 在 VR 中被赋予的“能力”——而不只是角色或故事——也能延续到头显之外的助人行为。
works.method: 2 (super-flight vs. helicopter passenger) × 2 (rescue vs. tour task) between-subjects experiment with full-body tracking, followed by a staged spilled-pens helping measure.
works.method_zh: 2（超人飞行 / 直升机乘客）× 2（救援 / 游览任务）被试间实验，采用全身追踪；之后以安排好的“笔掉在地上”情境测量助人行为。

paper.title: Virtual Superheroes: Using Superpowers in Virtual Reality to Encourage Prosocial Behavior

works.title_zh: 虚拟超级英雄：用虚拟现实中的超能力促进亲社会行为

works.title: Increasing Saving Behavior Through Age-Progressed Renderings of the Future Self
works.description: Participants who met an age-progressed avatar of themselves in a virtual mirror, and in later studies on screen, put more money into a hypothetical retirement account than those who saw their current-age avatar.
works.description_zh: 在虚拟镜子中（后续研究中也在屏幕上）见到自己“变老”化身的参与者，比看到当前年龄化身的人，向假想的退休账户投入了更多钱。
works.idea_en: A generated self from another point in time can shift a real economic decision, an early case of synthetic faces used as a behavioral intervention.
works.idea_zh: 一个来自另一时间点的“生成的自己”就能改变真实的经济决策——这是把合成面孔用作行为干预的早期案例。
works.method: Series of experiments with Stanford VHIL using age-morphed 3D avatars, measuring hypothetical savings allocations.
works.method_zh: 与斯坦福 VHIL 合作的系列实验，使用经年龄变形的三维化身，测量假想储蓄的分配。

paper.title: Increasing Saving Behavior Through Age-Progressed Renderings of the Future Self

works.title_zh: 以年龄增长后的“未来自我”形象提升储蓄行为

works.title: Virtual Reality as an Adjunctive Non-pharmacologic Analgesic for Acute Burn Pain During Medical Procedures
works.description: Review of SnowWorld, the University of Washington VR world in which burn patients throw snowballs at snowmen and penguins during wound care; patients report 35-50% less procedural pain while immersed, and fMRI shows lower pain-related brain activity.
works.description_zh: 关于 SnowWorld 的综述：在这个华盛顿大学开发的 VR 世界里，烧伤患者在换药时向雪人和企鹅扔雪球；患者报告沉浸期间操作疼痛降低 35%–50%，功能磁共振成像也显示与疼痛相关的脑活动下降。
works.idea_en: Immersion itself works like a dose: attention drawn into a virtual world is attention taken from pain, so stronger immersion can mean stronger effect.
works.idea_zh: 沉浸本身就像一种剂量：被虚拟世界吸引走的注意力，就是从疼痛那里拿走的注意力，因此沉浸越强，效果可能越强。
works.method: Review of clinical and laboratory studies by Hoffman's group, including water-friendly and robot-arm-mounted headsets for hydrotank wound care.
works.method_zh: 回顾 Hoffman 团队的临床与实验室研究，包括可用于水疗换药的防水头显与机械臂支架头显。

paper.title: Virtual Reality as an Adjunctive Non-pharmacologic Analgesic for Acute Burn Pain During Medical Procedures

works.title_zh: SnowWorld：虚拟现实作为医疗操作中急性烧伤疼痛的非药物辅助镇痛

works.title: Place illusion and plausibility can lead to realistic behaviour in immersive virtual environments
works.description: Theory paper that splits presence into place illusion (the sense of being there, set by sensorimotor contingencies) and plausibility illusion (the sense that what happens is really happening), and argues that the two together produce realistic behavior.
works.description_zh: 理论论文，把临场感拆分为“地点错觉”（身处其中之感，由感觉运动的一致性决定）与“似真错觉”（觉得正在发生的事是真的），并论证二者结合才会引发真实的行为反应。
